ActivityAvgLevel.10001.3.en: A terrifying legend is told in a summer seaside town: A green light from a "Ghost Ship" flickers out on the distant sea. You witness that eerie light, and are engulfed by the ocean...
ActivityAvgLevel.10001.3.cn:
夏日的海滨小镇，流传着一则恐怖传说：
远海之上，闪烁着“幽灵船”的绿光。
你目睹了那诡异的光芒，被大海吞没……

ActivityAvgLevel.10002.3.en: Two strange rabbit girls rescued you. They're heading out to find the source of the ghost ship's glow.
ActivityAvgLevel.10002.3.cn:
两位陌生的兔子少女搭救了你。
她们要去寻找“幽灵船”光芒的源头。

ActivityAvgLevel.10003.3.en:
You learn about Shia and Karin's purpose for this journey:
They seek to clear their grandmother's name.
For some reason, Shia is unusually affectionate toward you...
ActivityAvgLevel.10003.3.cn:
你得知了希娅和花铃此行的目的：
她们要为奶奶正名。
不知为何，希娅对你异常亲近……

ActivityAvgLevel.10004.3.en: Midway through the journey, you stop on a small island to get some rest. There, Karin hears a strange voice. A group of ill-intentioned Trekkers reveals themselves.
ActivityAvgLevel.10004.3.cn:
行程过半，你们途经一座小岛，暂时休整。
在岛上，花铃听到了异样的声音——
一伙图谋不轨的旅人现身了。

ActivityAvgLevel.10005.3.en:
All the clues suggest that their grandma lied.
The "Ghost Ship" is merely a decoy to mislead others.
"Facing the truth requires courage."
ActivityAvgLevel.10005.3.cn:
种种线索表明，奶奶撒谎了。
“幽灵船”只是掩人耳目的幌子。
“面对真相，我们需要一些勇气。”

ActivityAvgLevel.10006.3.en: Shia has known that her grandma was hiding something for quite some time. She decides to go ahead and check things out before the others. However, a figure in the darkness has been watching her the entire time.
ActivityAvgLevel.10006.3.cn:
对于奶奶的隐瞒，希娅早已有所察觉。
她决定先走一步，去前方探查情况。
然而，黑暗中有一个身影始终注视着她。

ActivityAvgLevel.10007.3.en: A giant Hexhorn Whale attacks, but you and Karin manage to shake it off. Just as you think the danger is over, Shia gets caught in a whirlpool. In that moment of despair, that eerie green glow silently emerges.
ActivityAvgLevel.10007.3.cn:
巨大的六角鲸袭来，你和花铃合力甩掉了它。
就在你以为危机消散时，希娅却陷入了漩涡。
绝望之际，那片幽绿的光芒悄然降临。

ActivityAvgLevel.10008.3.en: You finally reach the source of the light. There is no ghost ship, only a desolate island. Toward the final goal, set forth!
ActivityAvgLevel.10008.3.cn:
你们终于来到了光芒的源头。
没有幽灵船，只有一片荒芜的岛屿。
朝着最终的目标，出发！

ActivityAvgLevel.10009.3.en: Amidst the heavy rain, the Hexhorn Whale skeletons emit a brilliant glow. This place is their habitat, their grave. It is also the place countless Travelers mistake for a heaven filled with treasure.
ActivityAvgLevel.10009.3.cn:
暴雨之中，六角鲸的骸骨散发着强烈的光。
这里是它们的栖息地、坟墓。
也是无数旅人误以为埋藏宝藏的天国。

ActivityAvgLevel.10010.3.en: You fight off the treasure-seeking Trekkers who have been tailing you. In the chaos, you accidentally recover Granny's diary. Now, you understand the secret behind that glow.
ActivityAvgLevel.10010.3.cn:
你们击退了一路尾随的寻宝旅人。
混乱之中，意外找回了奶奶当初留下的日记。
你洞悉了光芒的秘密。

ActivityAvgLevel.10011.3.en: All is well, and now you can finally relax. This is a summer that belongs to you, to everyone—a summer that never ends.
ActivityAvgLevel.10011.3.cn:
事情圆满结束，你终于可以安心享受。
属于你的、你们的、永不结束的夏天。

The event: Daring Adventure! The Ghost Ship Haunts the Deep has begun!

ActivityLevelsLevel.1040101.2.en: Firecrackers crackle, welcoming the new year! Walk the festive streets and clear the way for an auspicious beginning!

ActivityLevelsLevel.1040105.2.en: With countless homes lit up and midnight approaching, stay alert! Defend the light against all threats until the new year arrives!
ActivityLevelsLevel.1040105.2.cn: 千家万户，灯火通明。时钟的指针就要跨过零点了！别犯困哦，一定要拦住它们，不能让光亮熄灭！

ActivityLevelsLevel.1040108.2.cn: 来福来福，福到安康。今年……我们能像往年一样热热闹闹地团聚吗？

ActivityLevelsLevel.1040304.2.en: Fortune arrives, bringing prosperity and joy. If you're scared of firecrackers, we can watch fireworks instead! I've brought back lots of big toys for a spectacular display!
ActivityLevelsLevel.1040304.2.cn: 来福来福，福到安康。你要是害怕爆竹，我们就去看烟花！今年带回来了好多超大的烟花筒呢！

In a foreign land, a conspiracy is unfolding.
Beware—their tactics are more coordinated than ever.
ActivityLevelsLevel.1050101.2.cn:
陌生的土地上，一场阴谋拉开帷幕，
请小心，它们的行动比以往更具组织性。

燃烧的破坏本能就连雨雪都能蒸发。

ActivityLevelsLevel.1050106.2.en:
No longer driven by instinct alone, they now swing scythes and blades in lethal rhythm.
Coordinating seamlessly, they create a forbidden zone no life is welcome.
ActivityLevelsLevel.1050106.2.cn:
不再受本能的驱使，而是有节奏地挥动镰刀与利刃。
彼此间默契配合着，织出了一片生命的禁区。

ActivityLevelsLevel.1050107.2.en:
As if heeding a divine call—be it war drums or a trumpet from the heavens,
they muster their full might, striving to conjure a realm of nothing but blades and flames.
ActivityLevelsLevel.1050107.2.cn:
像是听见某种指令，是战鼓，还是自天而来的号角
它们集合全部的力量，似乎要创造出字面意义的刀山火海。

ActivityLevelsLevel.1050108.2.en: "I saw a knight on a red horse descend from the pinnacle of the Monolith. Bestowed with the power to wage war, he wanted to strip the world of its peace..."
ActivityLevelsLevel.1050108.2.cn: “见那骑着红马的骑士自星塔顶端而来，有战争的权柄赐它，要夺去世间的太平……”

As if heeding a divine call—be it war drums or a trumpet from the heavens,
they muster their full might, striving to conjure a realm of nothing but blades and flames.
ActivityLevelsLevel.1050207.2.cn:
像是听见某种指令，是战鼓，还是自天而来的号角
它们集合全部的力量，似乎要创造出字面意义的刀山火海。

ActivityLevelsLevel.1050208.2.en: "I saw a knight on a red horse descend from the pinnacle of the Monolith. Bestowed with the power to wage war, he wanted to strip the world of its peace..."
ActivityLevelsLevel.1050208.2.cn: “见那骑着红马的骑士自星塔顶端而来，有战争的权柄赐它，要夺去世间的太平……”

ActivityLevelsLevel.1050301.2.en:
No longer driven by instinct alone, they now swing scythes and blades in lethal rhythm.
Coordinating seamlessly, they create a forbidden zone no life is welcome.
ActivityLevelsLevel.1050301.2.cn:
不再受本能的驱使，而是有节奏地挥动镰刀与利刃。
彼此间默契配合着，织出了一片生命的禁区。

ActivityLevelsLevel.1050302.2.en:
Where the sharp edge and fire converge,
a destructive force is forged—so fierce it evaporates everything.
ActivityLevelsLevel.1050302.2.cn:
利刃与火焰彼此交融，
燃烧的破坏本能就连雨雪都能蒸发。

they muster their full might, striving to conjure a realm of nothing but blades and flames.

它们集合全部的力量，似乎要创造出字面意义的刀山火海。

ActivityLevelsLevel.1060101.2.en:
A monster has scattered Port Bellin's mail everywhere!
To make matters worse, the treasure hunters are causing trouble. Retrieve all those letters!
Picking up red letters increases DMG Dealt, and delivering them to a mailbox grants an additional boost.
ActivityLevelsLevel.1060101.2.cn:
贝林港的信件被魔物卷的到处都是！
明明是这种时候，寻宝团还在捣乱——把信件统统夺回来！
拾取红色信件会提高造成的伤害，将信件交付到信箱会有额外增益

ActivityLevelsLevel.1060108.2.en:
The mail thief has built a nest right by the cape!
Defeat the Gale Owl and make sure everyone's messages are delivered!
ActivityLevelsLevel.1060108.2.cn:
偷信魔物的真身竟在海岬边筑起了巢！
为了大家的心意能够传达，讨伐狂风青枭吧！

ActivityLevelsLevel.1060201.2.en:
A legendary treasure map hidden in an envelope? What a hoax!
Drive out the meddling treasure hunters and opportunistic Gale Owl!
ActivityLevelsLevel.1060201.2.cn:
传说中的藏宝图就在信封之中？这是哪儿来的假新闻！
把添乱的寻宝旅人和浑水摸鱼的青枭统统赶走！

ActivityLevelsLevel.1060208.2.en:
Letters are piled high in the Gale Owl's nest.
Time to punish the culprit in the way of our mail routes!
ActivityLevelsLevel.1060208.2.cn:
狂风青枭的巢穴里，信件堆积如山。
阻断邮路的罪魁祸首，觉悟吧！

ActivityLevelsLevel.1060301.2.en: The Treasure Hunters and Gale Owl mean business! Show your resolve as a courier and protect the mail!
ActivityLevelsLevel.1060301.2.cn: 寻宝旅人和青枭都动真格了！拿出信使的觉悟守护信件吧！

ActivityLevelsLevel.1060304.2.en: Put an end to the Gale Owl's rampage. Deliver the final blow to this arrogant monster and protect the beauty of Port Bellin!
ActivityLevelsLevel.1060304.2.cn: 结束狂风青枭在此地的肆虐吧——为了贝林港的美丽风光，给嚣张的魔物最后一击！

ActivityLevelsLevel.1070101.2.en: Messing around with Stellaroids? Well, that's not a good idea, unless you possess extraordinary power like the Weapon Girl.
ActivityLevelsLevel.1070101.2.cn: 和星骸们玩闹？！这可不是个好主意，除非……你有着像兵器少女那般的超凡实力。

ActivityLevelsLevel.1070208.2.cn: 被击败的星骸老大再次登场，连同被打倒的小弟们的份一起……这次是复仇战！

ActivityLevelsLevel.1070301.2.en: Warm-up's over. Time to show your real power!
ActivityLevelsLevel.1070301.2.cn: 热身结束，该拿出真正的实力啦！

ActivityLevelsLevel.1070304.2.cn: 正所谓不打不相识，老朋友又来了！不过，可不要因为认识就手下留情哦。

ActivityLevelsLevel.1080208.2.cn: 尽在掌握——这一切都是她特意搭建的陷阱。

ActivityLevelsLevel.1080301.2.en: Super Go-Getter, full speed ahead! Farewell, Imperial Guards—you'll never catch us!
ActivityLevelsLevel.1080301.2.cn: 超级行动派全速前进！拜拜啦，追不上我们的帝国卫队！

ActivityLevelsLevel.1080304.2.en: Going up against the finest Imperial Knights? Time to play our new trump card.

ActivityLevelsLevel.2010101.2.en:
A challenge from the Snowish Tree Spirit? Let's turn this place upside down!
Wipe the monsters and pick your prize!
ActivityLevelsLevel.2010101.2.cn:
这难道是雪愿树精灵的考验？那就来大闹一场吧！
消灭所有怪物，选择你所喜欢的礼物！

ActivityLevelsLevel.2010104.2.en:
Sneak Sherlock has made off with a stash of presents!
Catch it! It's our only lead on the missing gifts.
ActivityLevelsLevel.2010104.2.cn:
潜逃的夏洛克偷走了不少礼物！
抓住它！或许就能知道礼物的下落了！

ActivityLevelsLevel.2010105.2.en:
The bells have rung, and the party is heating up with much tougher dance partners!
Enjoy the fun, but stay sharp—you still need to recover those lost gifts!
ActivityLevelsLevel.2010105.2.cn:
节日的钟声已经敲响，派对升级，更强的舞伴纷纷登场！
可别在玩闹中忘记正事，寻找那些失散的礼物吧！

ActivityLevelsLevel.2010108.2.en:
Magic has awakened the furniture, and now even the stove is after your loot.
Stand your ground and defend the gifts you've earned!
ActivityLevelsLevel.2010108.2.cn:
魔法唤醒了器物，取暖的火炉也想要你手里的礼物。
直面它的挑战，守护你所得到的礼物吧！

ActivityLevelsLevel.2010201.2.en:
The gifts are set, and dinner is served!
But before the party kicks off, we need to deal with some unwanted crashers!
ActivityLevelsLevel.2010201.2.cn:
礼物已经就位，餐点也摆放上桌！
但在派对开始之前，还有一些扰人的家伙需要处理！

ActivityLevelsLevel.2010202.2.en:
The gift cart is way off course. Something's not right...
There! It's that thief Sherlock at it again!
ActivityLevelsLevel.2010202.2.cn:
礼物车偏离了派送礼物的轨迹，这是否有些异常？
发现了！又是偷礼物的夏洛克！

ActivityLevelsLevel.2010203.2.en:
The gifts are set, and dinner is served!
But before the party kicks off, we need to deal with some unwanted crashers!
ActivityLevelsLevel.2010203.2.cn:
礼物已经就位，餐点也摆放上桌！
但在派对开始之前，还有一些扰人的家伙需要处理！

ActivityLevelsLevel.2010204.2.en:
Denied a gift and twisted by magic, this thing shows no mercy!
It has morphed into a Stellaroid—taking it down is your duty!
ActivityLevelsLevel.2010204.2.cn:
得不到礼物的器物被魔法侵蚀，它不会放过阻拦它的人！
它已经变成星骸了，击败它是你的使命！

ActivityLevelsLevel.2010301.2.en:
Is this fantasy or reality?! We might only know when the music stops.
For the grand finale, defeat these Stellaroids and wait for the midnight bell to reveal the truth!
ActivityLevelsLevel.2010301.2.cn:
是幻境还是现实？！或许只有等派对结束才能知晓。
在这场奇境冒险的最末，击败这些星骸，等候零点钟声带来的答案！

ActivityLevelsLevel.2010303.2.en:
Sherlock never learns! It's back to stealing presents!
Foil its plans and reclaim the goods from that cart!
ActivityLevelsLevel.2010303.2.cn:
屡教不改的夏洛克又在偷礼物！
破坏它的计划，夺回小推车上的礼物！

ActivityLevelsLevel.2010304.2.en:
The Bizarre Stove has its eyes locked on your gifts. It won't go down without a fight!
Watch out! Never underestimate a Stellaroid's obsession!
ActivityLevelsLevel.2010304.2.cn:
怪诞暖炉紧盯着你手里的礼物，它绝不会放弃，它将让你看到它的决心！
注意安全，不要小看星骸的执念！

ActivityLevelsLevel.2020101.2.en: Every distinguished guest has received their banquet invitation, yet this elaborate gathering was fated for chaos from its inception.
ActivityLevelsLevel.2020101.2.cn: 宴会的请柬早已送至每位贵宾手中，只是这场精心安排的盛宴，从一开始就注定不会平静。

ActivityLevelsLevel.2020102.2.en: The banquet is about to begin, and guests are arriving. Spot the suspicious in the crowd—don't let them ruin tonight's fun!
ActivityLevelsLevel.2020102.2.cn: 晚宴即将开始，宾客已经陆续进场，找出人群中的可疑人员，别让他们影响了今夜的狂欢！

ActivityLevelsLevel.2020105.2.en: An uninvited guest sits in the host's chair, undoubtedly a provocation. Show her who's really in charge here.
ActivityLevelsLevel.2020105.2.cn: 不请自来的人坐在主位，这无疑是一种挑衅，是时候让她明白谁才是宴会的主人。

ActivityLevelsLevel.2020106.2.en: Wine glints and lamplight flickers—each smile masks a scheme. Be a little more patient, and the prey will fall for the trap.
ActivityLevelsLevel.2020106.2.cn: 酒杯与灯影交错，人群的笑容背后各有盘算，再多一点耐心，鱼很快就会上钩。

ActivityLevelsLevel.2020303.2.cn: 酒杯的碰撞声里夹杂着一丝不协调的杂音，有人正在席间快速移动——看来他们已经开始动手了。

ActivityLevelsLevel.2020304.2.en: She was never meant to be at your banquet. Since polite words won't get rid of her, it's time to "ask" her to leave the hard way.
ActivityLevelsLevel.2020304.2.cn: 她本就不是你宴会的宾客，既然礼貌的驱逐无效，那就换种方式“请”对方离开吧。

ActivityLevelsLevel.2030101.2.en: There's always someone ignoring beach safety rules! When warnings don't work, it's time to step in and stop them yourself!
ActivityLevelsLevel.2030101.2.cn: 海边总有人不把安全守则当回事！ 面对屡劝不听的家伙，只好亲自出手制止了！

ActivityLevelsLevel.2030112.2.cn: 这位寄居蟹！请不要乱跑！

ActivityLevelsLevel.2030201.2.cn: 明明已经反复提醒，海边的危险分子却越来越嚣张！看来要展开特别整顿了！

ActivityLevelsLevel.2030301.2.en: Your rule-breaking days are over! Time for the lifeguard to teach these troublemakers a real lesson in beach safety!
ActivityLevelsLevel.2030301.2.cn: 坏家伙们的违规行为到此为止了！让救生员给他们上一堂真正的安全课吧！

ActivityShop.1002.1.cn: 我们的旅团-商店(不用翻译）

ActivityStory.101040201.2.en: In the midst of the Springseek Festival, you caught sight of a familiar figure on Cangwu's streets...
ActivityStory.101040201.2.cn: 新春佳节之际，你在苍梧街头看到了一个熟悉的身影……

ActivityStory.101040202.2.en: You combed the streets of Cangwu for clues, soaking in the city's unique atmosphere.
ActivityStory.101040202.2.cn: 你们在苍梧城内四处打听消息，顺便体验了风土人情。

ActivityStory.101040203.2.en: You obtained a key clue and pursued it further.
ActivityStory.101040203.2.cn: 你们得到了关键线索，追查了下去。

ActivityStory.101040204.2.en: Using bait, you lured the "culprit" out...
ActivityStory.101040204.2.cn: 你们利用诱饵，引出了“犯人”……

ActivityStory.101040205.2.en: Make it quick and clean. Capture them in one sweep.
ActivityStory.101040205.2.cn: 速战速决，将犯人一网打尽。

ActivityStory.101040206.2.en: You learned the truth about your friends' disappearance.
ActivityStory.101040206.2.cn: 你们得知了朋友失踪的真相。

ActivityStory.101040207.2.en: A subtle, unnatural shift is taking place inside the Monolith...
ActivityStory.101040207.2.cn: 星塔中，有什么地方正在悄然改变……

ActivityStory.101040208.2.en: This creature is not as vicious as imagined.
ActivityStory.101040208.2.cn: 这只异兽，并不像想象中的那么凶恶。

ActivityStory.101040209.2.en: Stop running! Getting a shot will help you, I promise!
ActivityStory.101040209.2.cn: 别跑啊，打针是为了你好！

ActivityStory.101040210.2.en: They just want to celebrate the New Year in peace.

ActivityStory.101050202.2.en: The story will only begin when you finally brave the cold night.
ActivityStory.101050202.2.cn: 若不踏入寒夜，故事就不算开始。

ActivityStory.101050203.2.en: Without light and fire, civilizations will crumble.
ActivityStory.101050203.2.cn: 离开了光与火，文明将不复存在。

ActivityStory.101050204.2.en: What does it mean to miss home when you're already there?

ActivityStory.101050205.2.en: Some secrets are better left undisturbed...

ActivityStory.101050206.2.en: People say the darkest hour comes right before dawn.
ActivityStory.101050206.2.cn: 人们常说，黎明前的黑暗最深邃……

ActivityStory.101050207.2.en: Ambition will not be buried by storms or time...
ActivityStory.101050207.2.cn: 野心是不会被风雪和时间掩埋的……

ActivityStory.101050208.2.en: Wild mountains howl as ancient beings begin to awaken...
ActivityStory.101050208.2.cn: 疯狂的山脉正在呼啸，古老的存在将要苏醒……

ActivityStory.101050209.2.en: Load your courage and pull the trigger that heralds the daybreak.
ActivityStory.101050209.2.cn: 勇气上膛，扣下宣告破晓的扳机。

ActivityStory.101050210.2.en: Resistance is the final act of defiance before defeat.
ActivityStory.101050210.2.cn: 挣扎，是宣告失败前最后的倔强。

ActivityStory.101050211.2.en: With a raised weapon comes the burden of greater responsibility.
ActivityStory.101050211.2.cn: 举起武器，意味承担更大的责任。

ActivityStory.101050212.2.en: The storm will pass, and the sun will rise again.
ActivityStory.101050212.2.cn: 风将歇，雪将停，太阳总会照常升起。

ActivityStory.101060201.2.en: We will make sure every mail reaches its recipient!
ActivityStory.101060201.2.cn: 你邮我寄，让信件平安传递！

ActivityStory.101060202.2.en: Donna did such a great job, so how about a little bonus this time?
ActivityStory.101060202.2.cn: 多娜表现得这么好，这次报酬就多给点嘛！

ActivityStory.101060203.2.en: Do you reckon ... this land stretches on forever?
ActivityStory.101060203.2.cn: 您说，这片大地会有尽头吗？

ActivityStory.101060204.2.en: I usually mark every path I walk—that way, I never get lost!
ActivityStory.101060204.2.cn: 走过的路我都会做标记，这样就不怕迷路啦！

ActivityStory.101060205.2.en: It's finally here ... after all this time.
ActivityStory.101060205.2.cn: 事到如今，终于送来了……吗？

ActivityStory.101060206.2.en: "In the treasure hunting business, it's finders keepers!"
ActivityStory.101060206.2.cn: “寻宝业界，可是讲究一个先到先得的哦！”

ActivityStory.101060207.2.en: As for the rest of the reasoning, let's settle it with this weapon called "Reason's Edge" right here.
ActivityStory.101060207.2.cn: 剩下的道理……就用这把“理性”来沟通。

ActivityStory.101060208.2.en: "You mean we took that beating for nothing?"
ActivityStory.101060208.2.cn: “那我们岂不是白挨这顿打了——！”

ActivityStory.101060209.2.en: Besides the corn kernels, be sure to check out the trail markers I left behind!
ActivityStory.101060209.2.cn: 除了玉米粒，也记得观察我留下的路标噢！

ActivityStory.101060211.2.en: Across mountains and waters, it all begins with a letter. Through snow and storm, it's all for a single belief.
ActivityStory.101060211.2.cn: 万水千山，皆因信起，风雪无阻，只为信念。

ActivityStory.101060212.2.en: Take a moment and etch the view of Port Bellin deep into your memory...
ActivityStory.101060212.2.cn: 趁现在，把贝林港的景色好好印入脑海……

ActivityStory.101070201.2.en: Meet that girl again in a season without snow.
ActivityStory.101070201.2.cn: 在没有下雪的季节，与那个少女再度相遇。

ActivityStory.101070202.2.en: A wish made on a whim.

ActivityStory.101070204.2.en: Heavy shackles and a caged bird.
ActivityStory.101070204.2.cn: 沉重的枷锁，受缚的飞鸟。

ActivityStory.101070205.2.en: The first friend, and the dearest of all.
ActivityStory.101070205.2.cn: 第一个朋友，最重要的朋友。

ActivityStory.101070206.2.en: Spread your wings and save those in need.

ActivityStory.101070207.2.en: A smile is all it takes.

ActivityStory.101070208.2.en: This isn't the time for tears.

ActivityStory.101070209.2.en: Do your best to save them all.

ActivityStory.101070210.2.en: Tomorrow will be a better day.

ActivityStory.101070211.2.en: Take the first step toward that goal.
ActivityStory.101070211.2.cn: 向着那个目标，迈出第一步——

ActivityStory.101080201.2.en: The Lucky Oasis runs into a major crisis out in the Wilds, and you manage to get in touch with a mysterious merchant…
ActivityStory.101080201.2.cn: 绿洲号遭遇荒野大危机，你联系上了那位神秘的商人……

ActivityStory.101080202.2.en: Following the clues, you arrive in Philae and discover Sparkla is being held in the last place you expected.
ActivityStory.101080202.2.cn: 你们根据线索来到菲莱，得知斯帕克拉竟然在一个意料之外的地方。

ActivityStory.101080203.2.en: People from Neo Grace Organization are practically experts when it comes to prison breaks.
ActivityStory.101080203.2.cn: 我们柔光会社的人，对越狱这件事最熟练了。

ActivityStory.101080204.2.en: Neo-tech goods! Cheap prices, great quality.

ActivityStory.101080205.2.cn: 从你身上，我得到了新的灵感。

ActivityStory.101080206.2.en: Now then, let's welcome our first contestant to the stage.
ActivityStory.101080206.2.cn: 下面有请一号参赛选手登场。

ActivityStory.101080207.2.en: Don't move! You're surrounded by the Imperial Guard!
ActivityStory.101080207.2.cn: 不许动，你们已经被帝国卫队包围了。

ActivityStory.101080208.2.en: Tyrant, I saved you the best seat in the house.
ActivityStory.101080208.2.cn: 魔王，给你留了一个最佳观赏席。

ActivityStory.101080209.2.en: Now THAT was a beautiful explosion. Ten out of ten!

ActivityStory.101080210.2.en: For all the Dorra we lost, let's work hard and take more commissions!
ActivityStory.101080210.2.cn: 为了失去的朵拉，努力接订单吧！

ActivityStory.101090201.1.cn: 远征凯旋……黑暗之力的缺席

ActivityStory.101090201.2.en: The expedition is over. The White Cat Troupe finally returns to their desert outpost...
ActivityStory.101090201.2.cn: 远征的白猫终于回到了那座——位于西北沙漠中的佣兵小镇……

ActivityStory.101090202.1.cn: 苍梧之战……黑暗之力的证明

ActivityStory.101090202.2.en: Eager to prove she's got what it takes, Chaton launches into a story about the Cangwu gig...
ActivityStory.101090202.2.cn: 为了证明自己的有着完成任务的实力，猫眼说起了之前在苍梧的行动……

ActivityStory.101090203.1.cn: 千塔演出……黑暗之力的显现

ActivityStory.101090203.2.en: Next up: her adventures in the City of a Thousand Monoliths...
ActivityStory.101090203.2.cn: 猫眼继续说起了在千塔的经历……

ActivityStory.101090204.1.cn: 出发……猫眼大人的调查军团

ActivityStory.101090204.2.cn: 终于……轮到猫眼大人出场了！

ActivityStory.101090205.1.cn: 深入……黑暗侵蚀的地下巢穴

ActivityStory.101090205.2.en: What are those Desert Scorpions plotting now...?
ActivityStory.101090205.2.cn: 沙蝎那群家伙，究竟又在搞什么鬼……

ActivityStory.101090206.1.cn: 交火……米拉什大街的大混战

ActivityStory.101090206.2.en: Like a bunch of Desert Scorpions could ever touch the great Chaton!
ActivityStory.101090206.2.cn: 区区沙蝎，怎么会是猫眼大人的对手呢？

ActivityStory.101090207.1.en: Raid: Traps of the Dark Nest
ActivityStory.101090207.1.cn: 矿洞突袭……黑暗巢穴的陷阱

ActivityStory.101090207.2.en: Tipped off by an escaped miner, Kasimira orders a raid on the mine.
ActivityStory.101090207.2.cn: 根据逃出矿工的情报，卡西米拉决定突袭矿场

ActivityStory.101090208.1.cn: 魔物对决……拯救被困的旅人

ActivityStory.101090208.2.en: What is a monster this massive doing down in the mine...?
ActivityStory.101090208.2.cn: 矿洞里怎么会有一只如此巨大的魔物……

ActivityStory.101090209.1.cn: 冲出重围……黑暗之力的重生

ActivityStory.101090209.2.en: They're inches from victory, but it's never quite that easy...
ActivityStory.101090209.2.cn: 成功似乎近在眼前，但事情显然没有结束……

ActivityStory.101090210.1.cn: 干杯……敬最强大的猫眼大人

ActivityStory.101090210.2.en: Fresh out of danger, the crew hits a local bar to let loose...
ActivityStory.101090210.2.cn: 逃出生天不久之后，众人在水吧欢庆……

ActivityStory.101100202.2.en: Seasick already ... guess I'll note that down too!
ActivityStory.101100202.2.cn: 居然晕船了……这也得记录下来！

ActivityStory.101100203.2.en: Can't believe I ran into you guys like this!
ActivityStory.101100203.2.cn: 原来这样也能碰见你们的喔！

ActivityStory.101100204.2.en: A light you cannot catch and a whirlpool you cannot escape.
ActivityStory.101100204.2.cn: 追不上的光芒，躲不开的漩涡。

ActivityStory.101100205.2.en: Welcome to the secret world under the vortex!
ActivityStory.101100205.2.cn: 欢迎来到漩涡下的秘密世界！

ActivityStory.101100206.2.en: It just wants to find its way home.
ActivityStory.101100206.2.cn: 它只是想找回自己的家。

ActivityStory.101100207.2.en: You expect me to follow the rules?

ActivityStory.101100208.2.en: My vision's blurred, but I refuse to surrender!

ActivityStory.101100209.2.en: Won't own up? Then we'll knock some sense into it!

ActivityStory.101100210.2.en: Cracked and fractured, yet this is where it truly belongs.
ActivityStory.101100210.2.cn: 虽有裂痕，但这才是它真正的家！

ActivityStory.101100211.2.en: A summer complete, a holiday with purpose, and an adventure made perfect!
ActivityStory.101100211.2.cn: 圆满的夏日，工作的假期，完美的冒险！

ActivityStory.111000201.2.en: A terrifying legend is told in a summer seaside town: A green light from a "Ghost Ship" flickers out on the distant sea. You witness that eerie light, and are engulfed by the ocean...
ActivityStory.111000201.2.cn:
夏日的海滨小镇，流传着一则恐怖传说：
远海之上，闪烁着“幽灵船”的绿光。
你目睹了那诡异的光芒，被大海吞没……

ActivityStory.111000202.2.en: Two strange rabbit girls rescued you. They're heading out to find the source of the ghost ship's glow.
ActivityStory.111000202.2.cn:
两位陌生的兔子少女搭救了你。
她们要去寻找“幽灵船”光芒的源头。

ActivityStory.111000203.2.en:
You learn about Shia and Karin's purpose for this journey:
They seek to clear their grandmother's name.
For some reason, Shia is unusually affectionate toward you...
ActivityStory.111000203.2.cn:
你得知了希娅和花铃此行的目的：
她们要为奶奶正名。
不知为何，希娅对你异常亲近……

ActivityStory.111000204.2.en: Midway through the journey, you stop on a small island to get some rest. There, Karin hears a strange voice. A group of ill-intentioned Trekkers reveals themselves.
ActivityStory.111000204.2.cn:
行程过半，你们途经一座小岛，暂时休整。
在岛上，花铃听到了异样的声音——
一伙图谋不轨的旅人现身了。

ActivityStory.111000205.2.en:
All the clues suggest that their grandma lied.
The "Ghost Ship" is merely a decoy to mislead others.
"Facing the truth requires courage."
ActivityStory.111000205.2.cn:
种种线索表明，奶奶撒谎了。
“幽灵船”只是掩人耳目的幌子。
“面对真相，我们需要一些勇气。”

ActivityStory.111000206.2.en: Shia has known that her grandma was hiding something for quite some time. She decides to go ahead and check things out before the others. However, a figure in the darkness has been watching her the entire time.
ActivityStory.111000206.2.cn:
对于奶奶的隐瞒，希娅早已有所察觉。
她决定先走一步，去前方探查情况。
然而，黑暗中有一个身影始终注视着她。

ActivityStory.111000207.2.en: A giant Hexhorn Whale attacks, but you and Karin manage to shake it off. Just as you think the danger is over, Shia gets caught in a whirlpool. In that moment of despair, that eerie green glow silently emerges.
ActivityStory.111000207.2.cn:
巨大的六角鲸袭来，你和花铃合力甩掉了它。
就在你以为危机消散时，希娅却陷入了漩涡。
绝望之际，那片幽绿的光芒悄然降临。

ActivityStory.111000208.2.en: You finally reach the source of the light. There is no ghost ship, only a desolate island. Toward the final goal, set forth!
ActivityStory.111000208.2.cn:
你们终于来到了光芒的源头。
没有幽灵船，只有一片荒芜的岛屿。
朝着最终的目标，出发！

ActivityStory.111000209.2.en: Amidst the heavy rain, the Hexhorn Whale skeletons emit a brilliant glow. This place is their habitat, their grave. It is also the place countless Travelers mistake for a heaven filled with treasure.
ActivityStory.111000209.2.cn:
暴雨之中，六角鲸的骸骨散发着强烈的光。
这里是它们的栖息地、坟墓。
也是无数旅人误以为埋藏宝藏的天国。

ActivityStory.111000210.2.en: You fight off the treasure-seeking Trekkers who have been tailing you. In the chaos, you accidentally recover Granny's diary. Now, you understand the secret behind that glow.
ActivityStory.111000210.2.cn:
你们击退了一路尾随的寻宝旅人。
混乱之中，意外找回了奶奶当初留下的日记。
你洞悉了光芒的秘密。

ActivityStory.111000211.2.en: All is well, and now you can finally relax. This is a summer that belongs to you, to everyone—a summer that never ends.
ActivityStory.111000211.2.cn:
事情圆满结束，你终于可以安心享受。
属于你的、你们的、永不结束的夏天。

ActivityStory.201010201.2.en: The Snowish Festival is here. On the lively streets, you spot someone familiar...
ActivityStory.201010201.2.cn: 节日来临，热闹非凡的街道上，你看到一个熟悉的身影……

ActivityStory.201010202.2.en: Dressed up in your costumes, you and Laru come to the kids who have been expecting their gifts...
ActivityStory.201010202.2.cn: 穿上制服，你与菈露来到了期待着礼物的孩子们身边……

ActivityStory.201010203.2.en: The Snowish Tree Spirit will always grant your wish.
ActivityStory.201010203.2.cn: “雪愿树精灵”，总会帮你实现愿望。

ActivityStory.201010204.2.en: You decide to go and check out the Ashwind Clan...
ActivityStory.201010204.2.cn: 你选择去灰风俱乐部一探究竟……

ActivityStory.201010205.2.en: You decide to keep giving away gifts to the kids...
ActivityStory.201010205.2.cn: 你选择继续发放孩子们的礼物……

ActivityStory.201010206.2.en: You decide to follow the Messenger from the next block...
ActivityStory.201010206.2.cn: 你选择追上隔壁街信使的脚步……

ActivityStory.201010207.2.en: You finally catch up to the mysterious Spirit.
ActivityStory.201010207.2.cn: 你们终于跟上了“精灵”传闻的脚步。

ActivityStory.201010208.2.en: The tale about the Spirit turns out to be a melancholic memory.
ActivityStory.201010208.2.cn: 所谓的精灵传说，只是一段有些酸楚的回忆。

ActivityStory.201010209.2.en: That day, Laru experienced something new—the magic of friendship...
ActivityStory.201010209.2.cn: 那天，菈露见识到了她从未见过的“友谊”魔法……

ActivityStory.201010210.2.en: Looking at the fish in the water, she saw deep into her heart for the very first time.
ActivityStory.201010210.2.cn: 看向水底的鱼，她第一次直面心中的深海。

ActivityStory.201010211.2.en: The celebration is at its climax. You and Laru really outdid yourselves today!
ActivityStory.201010211.2.cn: 节日的氛围来到了最高潮，今天的魔王和菈露真是格外努力！

ActivityStory.201010212.2.en: To fulfill her wish, you make a rather daring decision...
ActivityStory.201010212.2.cn: 为了满足“她”的愿望，你们硬着头皮做了个有些刺激的决定……

ActivityStory.201010213.2.en: The Furnace's Delirium suddenly strikes. In order to "protect" Firefly, Laru steps forward...?
ActivityStory.201010213.2.cn: 暖炉之谗妄突然来袭，为了“保护”火垂，菈露挺身而出……？

ActivityStory.201010214.2.en: The festival went well. Now, the time belongs to just the two of you...
ActivityStory.201010214.2.cn: 有惊无险的节日过去了，接下来是属于你们的时间……

ActivityStory.201030201.2.en: A good rest makes you more productive!
ActivityStory.201030201.2.cn: 只有好好休息才能更好地工作！

ActivityStory.201030202.2.en: Why is this resort so ... quiet?
ActivityStory.201030202.2.cn: 这度假村怎么如此冷清……？

ActivityStory.201030204.2.en: There's always an explanation behind anything strange. Turns out this place is haunted!?
ActivityStory.201030204.2.cn: 事出蹊跷必有因，原来这里在“闹鬼”？

ActivityStory.201030205.2.en: Fight the coolest Treasure Hunters of Nova!
ActivityStory.201030205.2.cn: 与全诺瓦最酷炫的寻宝旅人的激烈战斗！

ActivityStory.201030206.2.en: Just how heavy a secret are you carrying?!
ActivityStory.201030206.2.cn: 你到底扛着多沉重的秘密？！

ActivityStory.201030207.2.en: The weather at sea is so unpredictable...
ActivityStory.201030207.2.cn: 海上的天气总是瞬息万变……

ActivityStory.201030208.2.en: Buried deep in her memory, unspeakable lasting pain.
ActivityStory.201030208.2.cn: 她模糊的记忆深处，埋着疼痛与伤痕

ActivityStory.201030209.2.en: The skies have finally cleared up... So has your mind.
ActivityStory.201030209.2.cn: 天气总算好起来了……心情也是。

ActivityStory.201030210.2.en: To be fair... It doesn't mean any harm, right?
ActivityStory.201030210.2.cn: 话说回来……它其实并没有什么恶意吧？

ActivityStory.201030211.2.en: Take your time and enjoy the endless summer...

Agent.100101.3.en:
"The main street is piled high with junk—not only is it hurting business at The Market, but it's a crash waiting to happen!

If only we could get a Trekker to come help clean it up..."
Agent.100101.3.cn:
“主干道上堆满了杂物，影响到了集市生意不说，要是撞了车可就不好了！
要是能有旅人来帮忙一起清理一下的话……”

Agent.100102.3.en: Recently, biker gang activity in Silver District has been on the rise, with noise disturbances severely affecting the residents' daily lives. We are now recruiting Trekker squads to help put a stop to it.
Agent.100102.3.cn: 近期，银城区的暴走族问题日益严重，噪音严重影响了居民们的日常生活。现招募旅人团队参与打击整治行动。

Agent.100103.3.en: Offering a huge reward for any Trekker who can locate a missing pet belonging to a distinguished resident. Generous compensation guaranteed upon completion.
Agent.100103.3.cn: 高薪聘请旅人伙伴帮助寻回本住宅区贵客的走失宠物，完成委托必重金酬谢。

Agent.100201.3.en:
Trekker Acrobats Tour now recruiting front-row professional spectators.

Payment? This is a rare learning opportunity! Do it for the experience!
Agent.100201.3.cn:
旅人杂技巡回表演——现招募前排专业观众。
报酬？这可是难得的经验！赶紧趁此好好学习吧！

Agent.100202.3.en:
"There are some monsters wandering near the city walls—might as well take care of them while we're here!"

"As for re-reward... Ahem, helping the people out is priceless! ...Just, uh...just stick close behind me and learn some proper combat skills, alright?"
Agent.100202.3.cn: “城墙周边游荡着一些魔物，顺手将它们解决吧！报……报酬……咳咳，为居民排忧解难怎么能要回报呢！……你就……就跟在我的身后，好好跟着我……学习战斗技巧吧！”

Agent.100203.3.en:
"There are books everywhere... Somehow they've piled up into hills, haha..."

"If you help me sort them, I can give you a few in return... I have already read them all anyway!"
Agent.100203.3.cn:
“到处都是书……不知不觉就……堆成了小山一样啊，哈哈……”
“如果能帮我整理好的话，送你几本当报酬也可以……反正我也都看过一遍了！”

Agent.100301.3.en:
"In my hands, these unwanted Blank Discs can become a beautiful piece of installation art."

"That's right, once the exhibition's over, these Discs are all yours!"
Agent.100301.3.cn:
“这些没人要的空唱片，也可以经由我之手，搭建起漂亮的装置艺术。”
“没错，展出结束之后，这些唱片就归你了！”

Agent.100302.3.en:
A collector has put up well-preserved records as a reward, issuing a bounty:

"A cat slipped in through the window and ran off with my treasured Disc!"

"It's been passed down to me from my great-great-grandfather—I must recover it!"
Agent.100302.3.cn:
收藏家以成色完好的其他唱片作为赌注，发起了悬赏：
“我珍藏的秘纹被从窗户溜进来的猫叼走了！”
“那可是从我爷爷的爷爷那一代传承下来的宝物——我不能接受！”

Agent.100303.3.en:
A composition challenge issued by a mysterious music master—

All to find you, the one with the perfect pitch.

The prize: a rare, exquisite, and beautiful glazed record.
Agent.100303.3.cn:
由神秘的音乐大师发起的填谱挑战——
只为从万千人群中找到“拥有绝对音感的你”。
奖品是不可多得的、精致而靓丽的琉璃唱片。

Agent.200101.3.en:
Oh no! My teammate just rushed into the dance studio and started fighting the Grotesque Dancer!

I can't stop them by myself. Someone, please help!
Agent.200101.3.cn: 不好了，我的同伴冲进练舞室和怪诞舞者打起来了！我一个人实在劝不动，谁来帮帮我？

Agent.200102.3.en: Ah! How can there be such a beautiful top hat! It belongs inside my display case! I must have it!
Agent.200102.3.cn: 啊！怎么会有如此精美的礼帽！我的展示柜里不能没有它，我一定要得到它！

Agent.200103.3.en: A dance machine is basically a rhythm game. The key to beating it isn't dancing skills but memorizing the patterns. I'll put together a team to record every single pattern.
Agent.200103.3.cn: 跳舞机本质上也是音游，攻克的关键的不是舞蹈能力，而是背谱。我会组织一支团队，把所有的谱面都记录下来。

Agent.200201.3.en:
How can I get buff?

If only someone could give me some tips.
Agent.200201.3.cn:
要怎样才能练成健硕又魁梧的身材呢？
如果有人能给我一些参考就好了。

Agent.200202.3.en:
I've heard that the Count's Reserve is a rare vintage. Its color is as clear as a gemstone, its texture as smooth as silk...

If I ever get the chance, I'd love to try it for myself...
Agent.200202.3.cn:
听闻“男爵的窖藏”是不可多得的珍品，其颜色如宝石般澄澈，口感如丝绸般柔顺……
如果有机会的话，真想品鉴一番啊……

Agent.200203.3.en:
Cursipots are a fascinating type of Stellaroid. Every so often, they pick a new leader. By my calculations, it won't be long before we have a new Count of the Duloos.

I'm too old to climb the Monolith myself, but I'm hoping a Trekker with a spirit of discovery can record the whole election process for me.
Agent.200203.3.cn:
热腾罐是一种很有趣的星骸，它们每隔一段时间，就会推举出新的首领。根据我的推算，近期就会有热嘟噜噗男爵的更新换代。
我已经老了，没办法自己去攀登星塔，希望有科研精神的旅人代替我记录下它们首领更替的全过程。

Agent.200301.3.en:
We're recruiting new product testers! Just put on our latest sunglasses, take a walk through the brightest place you can find, and write up a short review.

Easy enough, right?
Agent.200301.3.cn: 招募新品体验官。戴上我们最新研发的墨镜，去你能想到的最亮的地方走一圈，再写一个体验报告。怎么样，这活够简单吧？

Agent.200302.3.en:
"My new proposal is due this week, but I don't have a shred of inspiration right now..."

"Can you help me gather some reference material on lighting? Anything at all!"

"Not that it matters much... Whatever I end up drawing, they'll just go with the first draft anyway."
Agent.200302.3.cn:
“这周就要交新方案了，可我现在一点灵感都没有……”
“帮我搜集一下有关灯具的资料吧，随便什么都行！”
“反正不管我画出什么，最后肯定都是……用第一版。”

Agent.200303.3.en:
Have you ever had to shut down a party early because of neighbor complaints?

Have you ever had to turn off the lights the moment the clock struck, just because Grace is too expensive?

Do you always feel like the days are too long and the nights too short?

Join us! Come and party with us till dawn!
Contact address: ███████████
Agent.200303.3.cn:
你是否因为邻居投诉，不得不早早停止派对？
你是否因为恩赐太贵，只能一到点就熄灯？
你是否总是觉得白天太漫长，夜晚太短暂？
加入我们吧！与我们一同彻夜狂欢！
联系地址：███████████

Agent.300101.3.en:
Help the new Trekker recruits master their basic rhythm skills!

I'll give you these cartridges so you can give them some extra training!
Agent.300101.3.cn:
帮助新手旅人们掌握基础的节奏技巧吧！
这些卡带都留给你开小灶啦！

Agent.300102.3.en:
I've heard you're pretty good at chasing high scores in rhythm games...

Why not show my students how it's done? I'll trade you these cartridges for the favor. A pretty good deal, right?
Agent.300102.3.cn:
我听说，你很擅长挑战音乐游戏的最高分啊……
来为我的徒弟们示范一下吧……就用这些卡带来换，不错的买卖吧！

Agent.300103.3.en:
That's right! In the Monolith Game Room, there's one legendary rhythm game that shows up from time to time...

If you can challenge the "Boss's Tune," I can share a few treasures from my collection with you...
Agent.300103.3.cn: 是的！在星塔游戏厅里，偶尔会出现的传说中的音乐游戏……要是你也能挑战“魔王乐曲”的话，我可以分享一些我的收藏品……

Agent.300201.3.en:
If they can't even hit a stationary target, there's no way they're ready for the field! Help me put them through some intensive training!

These cartridges are all yours, as promised!
Agent.300201.3.cn:
连静止目标都无法打中的话，可没法上阵！帮忙给他们集训吧！
说好的，这些卡带也都归你了！

Agent.300202.3.en:
I've heard you can clear even the toughest danmaku games on a single credit...

I'll leave the demo for this open class to you. Finish the job, and these cartridges are yours!
Agent.300202.3.cn:
我听说，你可以一币通关那些最难的弹幕游戏……
这节公开课的展示环节就交给你了，事成之后就用这些卡带当报酬吧！

Agent.300203.3.en:
Clearing "Demon Bee" on a single credit is hailed as the ultimate milestone for any Trekker's training... Some even call it the next step in human evolution!

 If you can pull it off, these collectibles will be your reward...
Agent.300203.3.cn: 一币成功挑战“妖蜂”，被誉为旅人修行的终点……甚至可以视作人类的进化！要是你也能办到的话，这些收藏品，就是你的奖赏……

Agent.300301.3.en:
The new generation of Trekkers' reflexes and focus aren't where they need to be... They're going to need some serious, disciplined training!

 If you're willing to help out, these cartridges will be your reward!
Agent.300301.3.cn: 新一代的旅人，反应力和集中力都跟不上啊……得好好严格训练才行！要是能帮忙训练的话，这些卡带就当做报酬吧！

Agent.300302.3.en:
I've heard that in that fighting game, you've beaten everyone around without breaking a sweat...?

My students are itching for a challenge. Teach them a lesson for me, and you'll be handsomely rewarded!
Agent.300302.3.cn:
我听说，那款格斗游戏，你打遍周围无敌手……？
我的徒儿们跃跃欲试呢，替我把他们都教训一遍吧，我自有重赏！

Agent.300303.3.en:
You can withstand that lightning-fast fifteen-hit combo, too?! Amazzzzzzing... So you've heard of the legend of the game "The Phantom" as well...!

 Recreate that battle for me, and my collection will be your prize!
Agent.300303.3.cn: 你也能抵挡那连续15次的急速出拳？！太惊讶了……原来你也听说过“鬼神”的传奇……！再现这场对决吧，我的收藏就是奖品！

Agent.400101.3.en: I've heard there's a dance master inside the Monolith and I want to challenge him. Can someone show me the way?
Agent.400101.3.cn: 听说星塔里有一位舞蹈大师，我要去挑战他。谁能帮我带个路？

Agent.400102.3.en:
Last time I only lost by a hair! This time I've brought my teacher, and we'll be unstoppable together!

 Can someone show us the way?
Agent.400102.3.cn: 上次只是惜败！这次我喊来了老师，我们师徒联手，战无不胜！谁能帮我们带个路？

Agent.400103.3.en:
I've brought my teacher, my teacher's teacher, and even my teacher's teacher's teacher.

This time, we're definitely making the Grotesque Dancer taste defeat! Can someone lead us there one more time?
Agent.400103.3.cn: 我把老师，老师的老师，老师的老师的老师都叫上了。这次必定要让怪诞舞者尝到失败的滋味！谁能再帮我们带个路？

Agent.400201.3.en:
The Cursipots have been bullying Glopos a lot lately. I can't just stand by and watch.

I need a good partner to help me drive those steaming pots away, so our Glopos can finally have some peace.
Agent.400201.3.cn: 热腾罐最近总在欺负冻冻，我看不下去了。找个好帮手助我一起赶走那些大罐子小罐子，还给我们冻冻一个安宁的家。

Agent.400202.3.en:
I just broke the last pot... If my employer finds out, I'm definitely getting fired this time!

Please, I'm begging you—help me find a few sturdy pots. I' can offer this month's wages in return.
Agent.400202.3.cn: 我把家里最后一个罐子也打碎了……如果被主人发现的话，这次我一定会被解雇的！拜托了，请帮我找几个结实耐用的罐子，我愿意拿出这个月的工钱作为报酬。

Agent.400203.3.en: Oh glorious and mighty Count of the Duloos! To be but a trembling thistle at the corner of your castle walls would be far greater than to stand as a towering oak elsewhere—why will you not allow me to prostrate myself before your throne and inscribe my name upon your iron register! I only wish for a glimpse of your noble visage!
Agent.400203.3.cn: 煌煌威仪的热嘟噜噗男爵阁下！纵使做您城堡墙角一株颤抖的蓟草，也胜似在别处当参天巨木——为何不允我匍匐于座前，将名姓镌刻于您的铁册呢！我只想一睹您的尊容啊！

Agent.400203.4.en: A Fanatic Admirer of the Count

Agent.400301.3.en: The light at home has been broken for days. Could you help me find a new bulb to replace it?
Agent.400301.3.cn: 家里的灯坏好几天了，能帮我找个灯泡换上吗？

Agent.400302.3.en:
"The master said... The family's heirloom lamp ran away."

"That lamp has been the house's night watchman for over two hundred years, but now it's completely out of control."

"You must bring it back at any cost!"

"...Anyway, that's what the master said."
Agent.400302.3.cn:
“老爷说……家族祖传的灯，自己逃走了。”
“那盏灯……两百年前就是宅子的守夜者…现在彻底失控了。”
“一定要要不计一切代价把灯带回去！”
“……总之，老爷是这么说的。”

Agent.400303.3.en:
It's too bright, way too bright! It's keeping all of us from getting any sleep.

Someone, anyone, just go and turn that lamp off!
Agent.400303.3.cn: 太亮了，真的太亮了，晃得我们觉都睡不好。总之，来个谁把那盏灯关掉！

A squad made up of Ventus Trekkers.
Embrace an elegant, fast‑flowing combat style with a Ventus Squad.
AssistAttribute.1.1.cn:
全员都擅长风元素的旅人组成的配队

BreakOutLevel.301010111.2.en:
Welcome to Bouncing Bumper Bash! Let's dive into the tutorial to learn the basics:

1. Try moving the launcher to shoot or bounce marbles.

2. Use Trekker skills to destroy tiles.

3. Learn how to score and what it takes to win or lose.
BreakOutLevel.301010111.2.cn:
欢迎来到缭乱碎晶球，通过教学关了解基础玩法吧：
1.尝试移动发射台，发射弹珠或反弹弹珠。
2.发动角色技能，摧毁晶块。
3.了解如何得分，以及胜利失败机制。

BreakOutLevel.301010112.2.en:
Time for the advanced tutorial! In this stage:
1. Enemies move while they attack. Move the launcher to dodge their bullets.
2. Both marbles and character skills can deal damage to enemies.
3. Learn the functions of various dropped items.
BreakOutLevel.301010112.2.cn:
进阶教学！在此关中可了解以下内容：
1.敌人会攻击也会移动。需要移动发射台避免被子弹击中。
2.弹珠或角色技能都可以对敌人造成伤害。
3.了解各种掉落道具的功能。

BreakOutLevel.301010121.2.en:
The cunning enemies are hiding behind the tiles. Destroy the tiles first, then take them out!
Be cautious when picking up dropped items. They could be deadly bombs!
BreakOutLevel.301010121.2.cn:
狡猾的敌人躲藏在了晶块后，设法击破晶块后再消灭！
务必小心判断掉落道具，可能会是危险的炸弹！

BreakOutLevel.301010122.2.en:
These high-defense tiles take several hits to destroy.
Be cautious when picking up dropped items. Fireballs deal extra damage and can penetrate tiles.
BreakOutLevel.301010122.2.cn:
出现了高防御力晶块！多次攻击才能破坏。
务必小心判断掉落道具，火球会造成更多伤害并可穿透晶块。

BreakOutLevel.301010131.2.en:
The terrain has become more complex. Proceed with caution!
A new type of dropped item that may extend or shorten the launcher has appeared!
BreakOutLevel.301010131.2.cn:
任务地形变得更加复杂了，请小心应对！
似乎出现了新型掉落道具，可能会使发射台伸长或缩短！

BreakOutLevel.301010132.2.en:
You discovered a new device—the ejector pillar!
When a marble hits the ejector pillar, it gains a short burst of acceleration.
BreakOutLevel.301010132.2.cn:
发现了新型装置-弹射柱！
当弹珠撞击到弹射柱时，会获得短时间的加速。

BreakOutLevel.301010141.2.en:
Welcome to the challenge stage!
A black hole has appeared in this sector! The marble's trajectory will be altered by the black hole's gravitational pull.
BreakOutLevel.301010141.2.cn:
欢迎来到挑战关卡！
黑洞出现在了这片宙域！弹珠会被黑洞的力量牵引而改变轨迹！

BreakOutLevel.301010142.2.en:
Welcome to the challenge stage!
Confront the wrath of the cosmos. Prove yourself, cadet.
BreakOutLevel.301010142.2.cn:
欢迎来到挑战关卡！
直面来自宇宙的愤怒吧，好好表现，军校生！

BreakOutLevel.301020111.2.en:
Welcome to Bouncing Bumper Bash! Let's dive into the tutorial to learn the basics:
1. Try moving the launcher to shoot or bounce marbles.
2. Use Trekker skills to destroy Quartz.
3. Watch out for explosive devices inside the Quartz. Destroying them will clear nearby Quartz.
4. Use the speed-altering device to change the speed of marbles.
5. Learn how to score and what it takes to win or lose.
BreakOutLevel.301020111.2.cn:
欢迎来到缭乱碎晶球，通过教学关了解基础玩法吧：
1.尝试移动发射台，发射弹珠或反弹弹珠。
2.发动角色技能，摧毁晶块。
3.留意晶块中的爆炸装置，将其破坏后可以摧毁周围晶块。
4.利用场地中的变速机关可影响球的速度。
5.了解如何得分，以及胜利失败机制。

BreakOutLevel.301020112.2.en:
Time for the advanced tutorial! In this stage:
1. You're coming up against new moving enemies.
2. Marbles and character skills deal damage to enemies.
3. You'll learn about the effects of dropped items.
BreakOutLevel.301020112.2.cn:
进阶教学！在此关中可了解以下内容：
1.新增会移动的敌人。
2.弹珠或角色技能都可以对敌人造成伤害。
3.了解各种掉落道具的功能。

BreakOutLevel.301020121.2.en:
New enemies can move and attack, so keep the launcher moving to dodge incoming shots.
Look out for the dropped items and dodge when it turns out to be a bomb!
BreakOutLevel.301020121.2.cn:
新增会移动也会攻击的敌人，需要移动发射台避免被子弹击中。
注意判断掉落道具的种类，可能是危险的炸弹，请及时躲避！

BreakOutLevel.301020122.2.en:
High-defense Quartz are here and they take several hits to destroy.
Look out for the dropped items! Explosive Orbs trigger an AoE explosion when they hit enemies or Quartz.
BreakOutLevel.301020122.2.cn:
出现了高防御力晶块！需要多次攻击才能破坏。
注意判断掉落道具的种类，新增的爆炸球在撞到敌人或晶块时将产生范围爆炸！

BreakOutLevel.301020131.2.en:
The terrain has become more complex. Proceed with caution!
Look out for the dropped items. Fireballs deal extra damage and can penetrate Quartz. The Invincible Star speeds up the marbles and grants them damage immunity!
BreakOutLevel.301020131.2.cn:
任务地形变得更加复杂了，请小心应对！
注意判断掉落道具的种类，新增的火球会造成更多伤害并可穿透晶块；新增的无敌星会让弹珠速度变快，免疫所有伤害！

BreakOutLevel.301020132.2.en:
A new astronomical phenomenon discovered! Gravity Well either attracts or repels marbles, altering their motions.
Look out for the dropped items. Split balls can split a marble into three!
BreakOutLevel.301020132.2.cn:
发现全新天文现象——重力井！它会根据自身状态牵引或排斥弹珠，改变弹珠的移动轨迹。
注意判断掉落道具的种类，新增的分裂球会让弹珠一分为三！

BreakOutLevel.301020141.2.en:
Welcome to the challenge stage!
There will be 2 Gravity Wells in this zone!
BreakOutLevel.301020141.2.cn:
欢迎来到挑战关卡！
这片宙域中的重力井数量将增加为两个！

BreakOutLevel.301020142.2.en:
Welcome to the challenge stage!
Confront the wrath of the cosmos. Prove yourself, cadet.
BreakOutLevel.301020142.2.cn:
欢迎来到挑战关卡！
直面来自宇宙的愤怒吧，好好表现，军校生！

BreakOutLevel.301030111.2.en:
Welcome to Bouncing Bumper Bash! Let's dive into the tutorial to learn the basics:
1. Try moving the launcher to shoot or bounce marbles.
2. Use Trekker skills to destroy Quartz.
3. Use the portal device to teleport marbles into the space above.
4. Learn how to score and what it takes to win or lose.
BreakOutLevel.301030111.2.cn:
欢迎来到缭乱碎晶球，通过教学关了解基础玩法吧：
1.尝试移动发射台，发射弹珠或反弹弹珠。
2.发动角色技能，摧毁晶块。
3.利用传送门装置，将弹珠传送到上方空隙内。
4.了解如何得分，以及胜利失败机制。

BreakOutLevel.301030112.2.en:
Time for the advanced tutorial! In this stage:
1. You're coming up against new moving enemies.
2. Marbles and Trekker skills deal damage to enemies.
3. You'll learn about the effects of dropped items.
4. Use the portal device to teleport marbles into the space above to deal damage to enemies.
BreakOutLevel.301030112.2.cn:
进阶教学！在此关中可了解以下内容：
1.新增会移动的敌人。
2.弹珠或角色技能都可以对敌人造成伤害。
3.了解各种掉落道具的功能。
4.利用传送门装置，将弹珠传送到空隙内攻击敌人。

BreakOutLevel.301030121.2.en:
New enemies can attack, so keep the launcher moving to dodge incoming shots.
Look out for the dropped items. The new Gravity Button makes it much easier to use the portal.
Choose wisely between the gunpowder items and the portal to take down enemies more efficiently.
BreakOutLevel.301030121.2.cn:
新增会进行攻击的敌人，需要移动发射台避免被子弹击中。
注意判断掉落道具，新增的重力按钮可以更加简单地使用传送门。
合理选择场上的火药道具或是传送门，更高效地消灭敌人。

BreakOutLevel.301030122.2.en:
High-defense Quartz are here, and they take several hits to destroy.
The portal's position can be tricky—use your items wisely to make things easier!
Look out for the dropped items! The newly added fireballs deal more damage and can penetrate Quartz.
If you manage to send marbles to the area above, items will drop nonstop!
BreakOutLevel.301030122.2.cn:
出现了高防御力晶块！需要多次攻击才能破坏。
传送门的位置不易使用，利用好道具来降低难度吧！
注意判断掉落道具的种类，新增的火焰球可以造成更多伤害并可穿透晶块。
若成功将弹珠送至上半区域，便能获得源源不断的道具哦！

BreakOutLevel.301030131.2.en:
A new terrain has been added! The Orbital Bouncer moves in a circular path around the central pillar.
Look out for the dropped items! The new Split Ball can split a marble into three!
BreakOutLevel.301030131.2.cn:
新增加了地形——环绕弹射柱！它会围绕中间的柱体进行环形运动。
注意判断掉落道具的种类，新增的分裂球会让弹珠一分为三！

BreakOutLevel.301030132.2.en:
Both the Orbital Bouncer and the portal device will appear at the same time.
Use them wisely. Good luck!
BreakOutLevel.301030132.2.cn:
场上将同时出现环绕弹射柱和传送门装置。
谨慎判断并使用两种装置，祝您好运。

BreakOutLevel.301030141.2.en:
Welcome to the challenge stage!
Use what you've learned about each device to complete the challenge!
BreakOutLevel.301030141.2.cn:
欢迎来到挑战关卡！
回想先前使用不同装置时的策略，完成挑战吧！

BreakOutLevel.301030142.2.en:
Welcome to the challenge stage!
Put your skills to the test against the toughest enemies!
BreakOutLevel.301030142.2.cn:
欢迎来到挑战关卡！
利用你的才智迎击最强的敌人吧！

Chapter.1.2.en: After braving countless challenges, three Trekkers finally found the rare "Tyrant Chest" hidden in the Desert Monolith.
Chapter.1.2.cn: 三位旅人，历尽千辛万苦，在沙漠星塔里找到稀有的“魔王宝箱”。

Chapter.2.2.en: Our journey begins. To earn some much-needed funds, we head to Philae, a city known as the "City of Trekkers"...
Chapter.2.2.cn: 正式踏上旅途的我们，为了赚取经费，来到了被称为“旅人之城”的菲莱……

Chapter.3.2.en: A series of special chapters dedicated to the Trekkers.
Chapter.3.2.cn: 旅人们的专属剧情篇章。

CharGetLines.10301.1.en:
I'm Amber.
Iris wrote me a proper intro. I'll text it to you later.
CharGetLines.10301.1.cn:
我，琥珀。
……鸢尾替我写了一份自我介绍，我稍后发邮件给你。

CharGetLines.10302.1.en: We're already friends, so there's no need for a self intro, right?
CharGetLines.10302.1.cn: 我们已经这么熟了，所以……不用再自我介绍了吧？

CharGetLines.10304.1.en: Lemme give you a hug... Hm? I'm talking to the cat here.
CharGetLines.10304.1.cn: 来抱抱……啊，我说的是这只猫。

CharGetLines.10305.1.en:
Woven from flowing flames and adorned with golden clouds—a majestic spirit, fierce and free.
Rawr—
CharGetLines.10305.1.cn:
锦绣织就流火，金饰点缀祥云。不怒自威、顾盼神飞。
嘎呜——

CharGetLines.10306.1.en: Following the hot sea breeze, I steal a moment from the carnival to catch your eye. It was serene.
CharGetLines.10306.1.cn: 顺着炙热的海风，捉住那狂欢的隙间，悠悠然望向你的视线。

CharGetLines.10701.1.en:
I am Tilia, the Squire of Justice!
From now on, I shall bring righteousness to the people!
CharGetLines.10701.1.cn: 报告！我是代表正义的骑士侍从缇莉娅。来成为我的伙伴一起伸张正义吧！

CharGetLines.10702.1.en: We meet again, fellow seeker of justice!

CharGetLines.10703.1.en: Huh, the Lapis Eagle sounds different, somehow. What in the world?!
CharGetLines.10703.1.cn: 咦……骏鹰号的声音怎么有点不对劲……哇哇哇——！

CharGetLines.10704.1.en: I thank you, for bearing witness to my first steps in becoming a hero!
CharGetLines.10704.1.cn: 谢谢你，来见证我踏上英雄之路。

CharGetLines.10705.1.en:
Suit up, transform! My fighting spirit burns hotter than the sun!
Clad in the armor of justice, I'll defend every street like a knight—
This is my justice!
CharGetLines.10705.1.cn:
系紧腰带，利落变身，斗志如烈阳般炽热！
披上正义的战衣，以骑士之姿守护每一条街道——
此即吾之正义！

CharGetLines.10801.1.en: I'm Kasimira, commander of 3rd Squad, White Cat Troupe. Sign here on the dotted line, please.
CharGetLines.10801.1.cn: 白猫剧团第三小队队长，卡西米拉。这是我们的合作协议，请在上面签名吧。

CharGetLines.10802.1.en: I'm delighted that you'll be staying on with us.
CharGetLines.10802.1.cn: 你是个不错的雇主。能继续与你合作……我很高兴。

CharGetLines.10803.1.en: Here's the update to the contract. Make sure you read it.

CharGetLines.10804.1.en:
I did think about adding another condition to the contract.
I spent ages tried to figure out how to word it.
But now I know friendship isn't something that's built on paperwork.
CharGetLines.10804.1.cn: 我终于意识到，原来你才是我最灵验的幸运护符。

CharGetLines.11001.1.en:
I'm Firenze. Let me show you what I can do.
Just don't you dare disappoint me.
CharGetLines.11001.1.cn: 翡冷翠，你的盟友。我会向你展现我的价值，也请你不要令我失望。

CharGetLines.11002.1.en:
We know each other well enough. No need for formalities.
Tell me why you want me, and maybe I'll go along.
CharGetLines.11002.1.cn: 聪明人之间，就不必重复客套话了——说出你特地找我的理由吧，我都会奉陪。

CharGetLines.11003.1.en: Perhaps it's time to renegotiate our contract. Our partnership would benefit from it.
CharGetLines.11003.1.cn: ……是时候签个新契约了，让我们的合作……更进一步吧……！

CharGetLines.11004.1.en: Now that you've chosen to stay by my side, there's no escaping me.
CharGetLines.11004.1.cn: 既然选择了与我一起……就意味着，你已经逃不出我的掌心了喔……

CharGetLines.11101.1.en: Nice to meet you, I'm Iris. Uh... If there's anything I can improve on, please don't hesitate to tell me.
CharGetLines.11101.1.cn: 我叫鸢尾，那个……有什么做的不好的地方，请多多指教。

CharGetLines.11102.1.en: I'm back. Here, take this. Please treat my part-time earnings as the guild's emergency fund.
CharGetLines.11102.1.cn: 我回来了，==PLAYER_NAME==。这是打工的收入，请帮我存起来，作为旅团的风险准备金吧。

CharGetLines.11103.1.en: My bag is heavier than most would assume—that's because you should never underestimate the weight of knowledge!
CharGetLines.11103.1.cn: 我的手提包可是很沉的，别小看知识的重量！

CharGetLines.11104.1.en: Hey, you can't just give me cookies this amazing and then not give me some more, okay? You better promise!
CharGetLines.11104.1.cn: 谢谢你给我买的曲奇，很好吃……真是的，要是之后再也吃不到这么好吃的曲奇，我一定会难过的。你要负起责任来啊，约好了。

CharGetLines.11105.1.en: In the pale winter sunlight, you hold a warm drink as your breath creates a white mist. You, who see yourself as just ordinary, are the one who makes this day special.
CharGetLines.11105.1.cn: 冬日清冷阳光下的你，捧着热饮呼出白气的你，自诩平凡普通的你，却构成了这个日子全部的意义。

CharGetLines.11106.1.en:
Uh... I'll do my best to keep this inflatable steady, but please be careful getting on board.
—A-And of course, if you fall into the water, I'll definitely pull you back up!
CharGetLines.11106.1.cn:
那个……我会尽量稳住这个充气玩偶，但上来时还是请小心一些。
——当，当然，如果你不小心落水了，我肯定也会拉住你的！

CharGetLines.11201.1.en: Let's aim for a Monolith we've never seen before! Come on, Boss, time to move out!
CharGetLines.11201.1.cn: 我们走吧，魔王大人，有很多很多星塔在等着我们！

CharGetLines.11202.1.en: The first meeting is chance, the second is destiny...or something like that. Huh? That doesn't sound like me?
CharGetLines.11202.1.cn: 对旅人来说，相逢即是有缘，再遇便是命运……不像我说的话吗？

CharGetLines.11203.1.cn: 接下来的旅程，大家还要继续在一起！

CharGetLines.11204.1.en: Once Loxy's fixed, let's go see a Monolith... just the two of us.
CharGetLines.11204.1.cn:
等小绿修好之后，我可以带魔王大人去个很适合观赏星塔的地方哦。
就我们两个人。

CharGetLines.11205.1.en:
Sun, sand, and sea—time to slip into your swimsuit!
Feel the warm sun on your skin and the gentle kiss of the waves. Summer's calling, just don't forget your sunscreen!
CharGetLines.11205.1.cn:
来到大海，来到沙滩，当然得换上泳衣。
怀抱热情的太阳，享受海浪的轻拍——与夏天的亲密接触，得务必注意防晒！

CharGetLines.11301.1.en: Nice to meet you. I'm Shimiao from the Baize Bureau. From now on, I'll handle all all communications regarding our cooperation with your guild. I look forward to working with you.
CharGetLines.11301.1.cn: 我是白泽公署的师渺，今后由我来接手与贵旅团的相关合作事宜，还望合作愉快。

CharGetLines.11302.1.en: Boss! Been a bit, huh? I've got an urgent task for you—I'll fill you in on the way.
CharGetLines.11302.1.cn: 又见面了魔王。有个紧急委托需要你的帮助，具体内容我会在路上告知。

CharGetLines.11303.1.en: Water can take any shape it wants. Which means its potential is limitless!

CharGetLines.11304.1.en: Hot stew again?! I-I'm not complaining, but I think it's a bit unfair to assume that Loongs love stew ALL the time.
CharGetLines.11304.1.cn: 又、又是火锅吗？！没有不满，我只是想纠正一下大家对龙裔喜欢吃火锅的刻板印象。

CharGetLines.11305.1.en:
No chili pepper spirits allowed inside Cangwu!
T-To protect Cangwu's peace, I, Shimiao, the ma-magical girl of love and justice, demands that you transform back to your original form right now!
CharGetLines.11305.1.cn:
苍梧城内严禁辣椒成精！
为、为了守护苍梧的和平，坚、坚持爱与正义的魔法少女，师渺命令你！快点变回原来的样子！

CharGetLines.11401.1.en: So you're the legendary Tyrant? Since you possess the power of darkness, I shall answer your call. Ahem… Prepare yourself! I'll help you climb to the summit of darkness—only to defeat you at your peak! Nya-ha-ha-ha!
CharGetLines.11401.1.cn: 汝即是传说中的魔王？既然汝身怀黑暗之力，那吾便回应汝之召唤。咳……做好觉悟吧！我会助你走上黑暗的巅峰，再狠狠击溃你！喵哈哈哈哈！

CharGetLines.11402.1.en: Well, looks like our connection has grown stronger. No need to thank me—it's just your power of darkness echoing back at you! Nya-ha-ha-ha!
CharGetLines.11402.1.cn: 呼……看来我们之间的羁绊又加深了。不用急着道谢，这不过是汝之黑暗力量的必然回响！喵哈哈哈哈！

CharGetLines.11403.1.en: Power of darkness, blaze unsealed! Nya-ha-ha-ha!
CharGetLines.11403.1.cn: 黑暗之力，封印解除——！喵哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！

CharGetLines.11404.1.en: Flawless! Amazing, huh? That is the true power of the Dark Lord! Boss, come on, praise me!
CharGetLines.11404.1.cn: 完美！厉害吧~这就是黑暗之王的实力！魔王，快夸我快夸我~

CharGetLines.11501.1.en: Hm... Are you here to take me back to school? Oh, you're not? Then let's play together!
CharGetLines.11501.1.cn:
你也是来抓我回学院的吗？
……原来不是啊，那来陪火垂玩吧！

CharGetLines.11502.1.en: Play ... just a little longer? Then I'll go home, really.
CharGetLines.11502.1.cn: 能……再玩一会吗？我会跟你回去的。

CharGetLines.11503.1.en: I'm not just an ordinary kid. So I can protect Tyrant well.
CharGetLines.11503.1.cn: 魔王，我不是小孩子，我也是可以保护你的。

CharGetLines.11504.1.cn: 可以请你……跟我一起创造回忆吗？

CharGetLines.11601.1.en: Nice to meet you. I'm Ridge with United Harvest. Hm? Wanna come inside my greenhouse? Uh, well, uh...
CharGetLines.11601.1.cn: 我是联合种业的温室管理员岭川，初次见面，请、请多指教……

CharGetLines.11602.1.en: Hey, Boss! I grew these veggies in my greenhouse! Will you take them as a sign of our friendship?
CharGetLines.11602.1.cn: 这次……我给你带了一点礼物！是我种的蔬菜，刚从地里摘的，很新鲜很好吃哦。

CharGetLines.11603.1.en: I've always wanted my own piece of land. I'd grow so many crops and plants on it as I like!
CharGetLines.11603.1.cn: 总有一天，我会拥有属于自己的超大田地，想种什么种什么。

CharGetLines.11604.1.en: Wh-Wha?! Wow, this Ⅳy's out of control! Boss! Help me! I'm afraid I won't be able to run away!
CharGetLines.11604.1.cn: 呜呜……怎么会变成这样……魔王，快帮帮我……我一个人没办法……！

CharGetLines.11605.1.en: The best moment I can think of is having a nap in the cozy warmth of the afternoon. When you wake up, the sunlight dances along the windowsill, and the flowers welcome your awakening.
CharGetLines.11605.1.cn: 我能想到最幸福的时刻，就是在午后的温暖中小憩。醒来时阳光晒过窗脚，而花朵仍在等你。

CharGetLines.11701.1.en: Welcome! I'm Jinglin, the manager of Jing's Bistro! If you're ever hungry, drop on by!
CharGetLines.11701.1.cn: 魔王好！我是怀璟食府的璟麟，今后请多多照顾我们家的生意呀！

CharGetLines.11702.1.en: I've decided—I'll make a special dish just for you! ...No, it's cool. After all, you're one of our regulars!
CharGetLines.11702.1.cn: 我让后厨给魔王开个小灶吧。嘿嘿，不麻烦不麻烦，你可是我们家的熟客呀！

CharGetLines.11703.1.en:
Jinglin, making a cool debut!
Did you get the shot? Ugh, my legs are quivering.
CharGetLines.11703.1.cn:
璟麟，威风凛凛！
——拍好了吗？脚、脚有点酸了……

CharGetLines.11704.1.en: Scientific Mahjong is the path to victory! You agree, right? Hehe, I knew you were my mahjong buddy!
CharGetLines.11704.1.cn: 科学麻雀牌才是唯一出路！魔王，你也认同这一点吧？唔唔，不愧是我的牌搭子！

CharGetLines.11801.1.en: Are you the rumored Boss? Then I should conduct a full-body examination.
CharGetLines.11801.1.cn: 你就是魔王大人吗？久仰大名，请务必让我替你做个“全身检查”。

CharGetLines.11802.1.en: There seems to be some fated connection between us, so I'd love for you to stop by next time you're in the area.
CharGetLines.11802.1.cn: 看来我们还挺有缘的，要不来我诊所坐坐？

CharGetLines.11803.1.en: My scythe's purring... It seems we're all enjoying ourselves.
CharGetLines.11803.1.cn: 镰刀在低吟，它也很喜欢这份力量。

CharGetLines.11804.1.en: When I pet this little one, it gives me a strange sense of calm.
CharGetLines.11804.1.cn: 摸一摸它，我烦躁的内心就能平静下来……

CharGetLines.11901.1.en: I am Nanoha, one of the maids from Goodwind Homecare. I can help you with your everyday chores.
CharGetLines.11901.1.cn: 谷风家政，满足您日常生活的一切需求。初次见面，我是女仆花原，请多关照。

CharGetLines.11902.1.en: It's been a while. What would you have me do today?
CharGetLines.11902.1.cn: 很高兴又和您见面，这次需要哪些服务？

CharGetLines.11903.1.en: Let me stay by your side, always. Like a shadow, like a dream...

CharGetLines.11904.1.en: A special gift just for me? Why, I promise to treasure it forever. Hehe... ♪
CharGetLines.11904.1.cn: 这份特别的礼物……我会好好珍藏。

CharGetLines.11905.1.en: The wind sways the clouds as dust dances in sunlight. Only the flowers witness the moments we share.
CharGetLines.11905.1.cn: 风摇云影间，曦光舞沙尘。与君共度时，唯有花窥见。

CharGetLines.12001.1.en: Hello. My name is Canace, a professor at the Grace Light Academy. You must be the legendary boss I've read about. Hehe. I'm looking forward to spending time with you.
CharGetLines.12001.1.cn: 初次见面，我是星辉附属大学的老师，叫我卡娜丝就好，你就是传说中的魔王啊……呵呵，很期待与你接下来的合作。

CharGetLines.12002.1.en: It's a pleasure to meet you again. So... Did you make any new discoveries on your adventures?
CharGetLines.12002.1.cn: 又见面了！如何，旅途中有没有新的发现？

CharGetLines.12003.1.en: I guess I should get serious if I want to live up to your expectations.
CharGetLines.12003.1.cn: 看来我得拿出真正的实力来回应你了。

CharGetLines.12004.1.en: As a teacher, it's rare for me to learn from anyone. But it's different with you.
CharGetLines.12004.1.cn: 和你在一起能学到不少东西，当了老师之后，这样的感觉还是头一次。

CharGetLines.12005.1.en:
Meticulous thinking, precise calculations, and textbook movements.
Sprint, jump, spike—everything executed exactly as planned, but the body just can't keep up with the mind.
—Huh? What do you mean I'm number one on the popularity poll!?
CharGetLines.12005.1.cn:
思维缜密，计算严谨，动作标准。
冲刺，起跳，扣杀，一切都如计划执行，可身体却跟不上思考。
——嗯？人气榜第一又是什么意思啦！？

CharGetLines.12301.1.en: Bossy, I finally got to meet you! C'mon, take Ann on an awesome adventure!
CharGetLines.12301.1.cn: 魔魔王~杏子终于见到你啦，诶嘿，能带杏子一起去冒险吗~

CharGetLines.12302.1.en: Wahaha! You found me again! Now it's Ann's turn to be "it"!
CharGetLines.12302.1.cn: 哇~魔魔王又找到杏子啦~那下次轮到杏子来找你啦~

CharGetLines.12303.1.en: Ann, Coco, and Bubble have all gotten soooo strong! So, come on, Big Boss! Let's hurry up and get going! Let's beat up those baddies!
CharGetLines.12303.1.cn: 杏子和可可泡泡都变得更厉害啦~魔魔王快跟上，我们要去打坏人啦！

CharGetLines.12304.1.en: Zzz... Ann's gonna stay with everyone forever... Zzz...
CharGetLines.12304.1.cn: 呼……杏子，要和大家一起，永远都不要分开……

CharGetLines.12305.1.en: Little princess, who fell into a wonderland and got lost in a labyrinth of time, there's no need to hurry for the exit, for the best scenery lies hidden within those seemingly absurd dreams.
CharGetLines.12305.1.cn: 从古老的树洞跌入奇境，误入时间迷宫的小小公主啊，不必急于寻找出口，因为最棒的风景就藏在那些看似荒诞的梦里。

CharGetLines.12501.1.en: Pleased to make your acquaintance. It is an honor to become one of your allies.
CharGetLines.12501.1.cn: 很荣幸与您同行，请多指教。

CharGetLines.12502.1.en: Most people enjoy reunions... Do you?
CharGetLines.12502.1.cn: 人们都说“重逢令人欣喜”……魔王，您是怎么看的呢？

CharGetLines.12503.1.en: I shall eliminate any who stand in our way.
CharGetLines.12503.1.cn: 我将铲除妨碍您的一切。

CharGetLines.12504.1.en: Perhaps... I've learned to appreciate rainy days.
CharGetLines.12504.1.cn: 我好像……开始喜欢下雨天了。

CharGetLines.12505.1.en: The Snowish Festival she dreams of is a warm, cozy fire, a glass of sweet wine in hand, her best friends' laughter, and a unique gift just for her—from you.
CharGetLines.12505.1.cn: 她所期盼的雪愿节，是一炉温暖的火焰，一杯香甜的果酿，亲密好友的笑语，以及一份来自你的、独一无二的礼物。

CharGetLines.12601.1.en:
Hi there! I'm Flora the magician.
Heard of me, right?
Wanna know the real me?
Hehe, I could tell you... But in magic, does "real" even matter?
CharGetLines.12601.1.cn: 初次见面，我是魔术师紫槿，也许你曾听过有关我的各种传闻……呵呵，很在意？但对于魔术来说，是真是假，又有什么关系呢？

CharGetLines.12602.1.en: Normally, I would never do the same trick twice... Just this one time, okay?
CharGetLines.12602.1.cn: 同样的手法我不会演示两遍，这一次，请仔细看清楚了~

CharGetLines.12603.1.en: Behold—the stage of wonder begins! I'll show you things you'll never forget!
CharGetLines.12603.1.cn: 盛大的演出就要开始了，将这份奇迹牢记于心吧！

CharGetLines.12604.1.en: Okay, enough staring. The show's about to start, so how about some help?
CharGetLines.12604.1.cn: 看入迷了？好啦，快点来帮忙吧，演出就要开始了。

CharGetLines.12701.1.en: Whoa! There's a new delivery route here! I'm Teresa from Post Haste, by the way. Let me know if you want anything delivered.
CharGetLines.12701.1.cn:
喔~又发现一条新航道！
哼哼~我是万送屋的特丽莎，想寄信时，您和我说一声就行。

CharGetLines.12702.1.en: Long time no see, Boss! Are you getting the mail all right?
CharGetLines.12702.1.cn: 又见面了，魔王，万送屋的服务您还满意吗？

CharGetLines.12703.1.en: I might even be able to vanquish a legendary dragon now!
CharGetLines.12703.1.cn: 现在的我，说不定连传说中的龙也能打倒呢！

CharGetLines.12704.1.en: You really do see through everything, don't you?
CharGetLines.12704.1.cn: 真是的……好像什么都瞒不住你呢……

CharGetLines.12705.1.en: Grab the village's finest sword and set off on Teresa's epic quest! Huh? A shiny gold treasure chest? Let's open it—Whoa! What in the world is this?
CharGetLines.12705.1.cn: 拿起村里最好的宝剑，踏上勇者特丽莎的传奇冒险！欸~金光闪闪的宝箱？让我打开看看——呜哇——这是什么东西？！

CharGetLines.13001.1.en: Hello! I'm Donna from Post Haste! Rain or snow, I'll make sure your precious letters arrive safely! For reliable and secure deliveries, choose Post Haste!
CharGetLines.13001.1.cn:
初次见面，万送屋为您服务。
无论是雪山还是雨林，
你邮我寄，让信件平安传递！

CharGetLines.13002.1.en: Why am I here? I just followed Boss. I'm not lost or anything!
CharGetLines.13002.1.cn:
诶？又见面了？
啊哈哈，我才没有迷路！我是故意跟着你的。

CharGetLines.13003.1.en: Wait. Did I just get even cuter?
CharGetLines.13003.1.cn: 哇呜，我是不是变得更可爱了？

CharGetLines.13004.1.en: Ta-da! This is my super cute transformation!

CharGetLines.13201.1.en: You don't hafta worry about fightin' when you're with me. The Ashwind Clan's got your back.
CharGetLines.13201.1.cn: 魔王，第一次正式合作，灰风不会辜负你的期望。

CharGetLines.13202.1.en: Yo, it's been a while. Is it just me or has it gotten easier to chat recently?
CharGetLines.13202.1.cn: 魔王，又见面了，我们的默契又多了一些。

CharGetLines.13203.1.en: C'mon, let's go. I'm tellin' you we'll be fine. There's nothing to fear as long as we're together.
CharGetLines.13203.1.cn: 只要和伙伴在一起就没什么好怕的。魔王，我们一起前进吧。

CharGetLines.13204.1.en: S-Stop staring at me... If you're that curious, why don't you come over here and read with me?
CharGetLines.13204.1.cn: 别光看我啊……你也坐过来挑本漫画看吧。会很开心的。

CharGetLines.13205.1.en:
The coolness of the desk beneath my arms, the warmth of the sun on my back.
The scent of books enchants me, as I drift into a gentle daydream.
CharGetLines.13205.1.cn:
手臂传来课桌板的清凉，后背感知洒落阳光的温暖。
书本的芬芳令人陶醉——这是一场微醺的白日梦。

CharGetLines.13206.1.en: Having practiced a cold expression in the mirror for the hundred-and-first time, I saw you the moment I turned my head. And so, all my pretenses collapsed, leaving only shyness behind.
CharGetLines.13206.1.cn: 对着镜子练习第一百零一次的冷酷表情，却在转头瞬间看到了你。于是所有伪装都崩溃，只剩下羞意。

CharGetLines.13301.1.en: Hello, I'm Nazuka. I hope I can be of help to you in your journey ahead, and you can count on me. Let's do our best together!
CharGetLines.13301.1.cn: 你好，我是夏花。希望我能在未来的旅程中帮上你的忙，也希望你能给予我信赖，以后请多指教。

CharGetLines.13302.1.en:
Hey, how have you been?
... I'm happy to see you, really.
CharGetLines.13302.1.cn:
又见面了，感觉如何？
……呵呵，我还挺开心的。

CharGetLines.13304.1.en: Maybe we can hang out again next time?
CharGetLines.13304.1.cn: 下次有机会的话，我们再一起去哪里逛逛吧？

CharGetLines.13305.1.en: A light breeze, as flowers bloom in the summer air. A gentle touch, like the hand that held the pinwheel with yours.
CharGetLines.13305.1.cn: 一缕气息，初夏的花朵悄然绽放。一种触感，就像与你一同握住风车的那只手。

CharGetLines.13401.1.en:
Hello! I-I'm F-F-Fuyuka!
...Agh! I practiced so much, but I still messed up…
CharGetLines.13401.1.cn:
师父您好！我……我我、我是冬香！
……呜呜，怎么会这样，明明私下里练习了那么久，却还是咬到舌头了……

CharGetLines.13402.1.en: W-We meet again. I hope you rely on the Petal Darlings Guild and myself.
CharGetLines.13402.1.cn: 又、又见面了，如果您还需要我和花令旅团的力量，那就太好了……

CharGetLines.13403.1.en: I'll do my very best not to disappoint you!
CharGetLines.13403.1.cn: 为了回报您的信任，我一定会加倍努力！

CharGetLines.13404.1.en: Ahhh... P-Please don't stare at me like that!

CharGetLines.13405.1.en: Clock in on time? Check. Prep the materials? Check. Work hard, stay focused... Whoa there, how did I mess it up again?
CharGetLines.13405.1.cn: 按时打卡不迟到，材料认真准备好。勤勤恳恳，战战兢兢。哎呦喂——扑通，怎么还是搞砸了？

CharGetLines.13501.1.en: Found you! You're the infamous Boss everyone's been talking about, aren't you? I'm ingenious ace reporter, Mistique! Ready for an interview?
CharGetLines.13501.1.cn:
找到你了！最近很火的那位魔王大人!
我叫雾语……既是天才的魔女也是敏锐的记者！接受我的采访吧！

CharGetLines.13502.1.en: I'm back for more material! Say cheese! Awesome, love it! Now give me a different look for this next shot!
CharGetLines.13502.1.cn:
茄子！我又来拜访了！
诶~这是啥表情？让我多收集收集！

CharGetLines.13503.1.en: C'mon, Boss! Let's head out and uncover some new stories!
CharGetLines.13503.1.cn: 和魔女一起，窥探世界的秘密吧！

CharGetLines.13504.1.en: If I tell you my secrets, you have to tell me yours. Deal?
CharGetLines.13504.1.cn: 我的秘密，你已经尽收眼底了！你的秘密，也快点呈上来吧！

CharGetLines.13505.1.en: Indulge in the sweetness of cocoa as a broom zooms across the starlit sky. Leave your worries behind. This is an adventure meant just for you.
CharGetLines.13505.1.cn: 沉醉于可可的甜蜜，扫帚划过星空，将烦恼抛之脑后——这是只属于你们的浪漫冒险。

CharGetLines.13506.1.en:
Even a witch who feeds on truth deserves a little break once in a while.
Stretching out while enjoying the sunset—what could be more relaxing than this?
CharGetLines.13506.1.cn:
哪怕是以真相为食的魔女，也偶尔需要一段时间的悠闲假日。
伸着懒腰，看着夕阳，能有什么比这更悠闲的呢？

CharGetLines.14001.1.en: Welcome to Sparkla's mobile workshop... Whoa, cuteness overload! Get over here, Rabbit Pie and Super Action Pie—say hi to our new friend!
CharGetLines.14001.1.cn: 欢迎来到斯帕克拉的移动工坊……等等，这张脸可爱超标了……兔子派，超级行动派，快来打个招呼，之后这位就是我们的新朋友了~

CharGetLines.14002.1.en: So you're ... personally taking the Tyrant Pie's test? Hehe, great news for her inventor!
CharGetLines.14002.1.cn: 你是决定……亲自参与魔王派的测试了吗？呵呵，对魔王派的发明者来说，这可真是一个好消息!

CharGetLines.14003.1.en: Charge, Rabbit Pie! Our fairy tale adventure starts now!
CharGetLines.14003.1.cn: 兔子派，冲呀！我们的童话冒险，正式启程~

CharGetLines.14004.1.en:
Hehe, since this pose unlocked my inspiration last time, I realized...
Holding this posture boosts blood flow to the brain, sharpens focus, and fuels brainstorming. But if I get too absorbed, will I catch a cold...?
CharGetLines.14004.1.cn:
呵呵，自从上次用这样的姿势敲开了灵感的大门后，我就发现……
只要保持这样的姿势，就能促进大脑血液循环提高思考效率有助于我更好地进行头脑风暴。不过，要是太过专注的话，会不会感冒呢……？

CharGetLines.14101.1.en:
I am Chixia, a Xuan Shi of the Yunji Studio, and mistress of mysterious arts! And...
Well, other stuff that I forget! Here—take this powerful talisman!
If it doesn't work… I'll make it up to you!
CharGetLines.14101.1.cn: 我乃赤霞，云笈道场的正统玄师。初来乍到，愿以玄之法理……呃，这开场白好难背。总之，要给你画几张符吗？绝对灵验，不灵包售后。

CharGetLines.14102.1.en:
Ah, you're looking lively, Boss! Very good.
Care to buy another talisman while you're here?
CharGetLines.14102.1.cn: 又见面啦，看你气色不错，甚好甚好~怎么样，上次给你的符效果不错吧，要回购些不？

CharGetLines.14103.1.en: O fire talisman, reveal your power! Manifest the virtue of flame. Banish the evil spirits!
CharGetLines.14103.1.cn: 炎符天降，火德显彰。火符闪耀，赤焰昭昭。邪魅消散，万祸不殃。

CharGetLines.14104.1.en: P-Promise me! Right now! Say you'll stay with me forever, and you won't go anywhere!
CharGetLines.14104.1.cn: 那、那你现在就发誓，说你哪儿都不去，就呆在我旁边……动一下也不行！

CharGetLines.14105.1.en:
Who says the world in the mirror is mere illusion?
The moment she dons the queen's crown, hero and villain trade places. Madness becomes rule, and the spotlight turns her way.
Welcome to the Queen of Hearts' wonderland.
CharGetLines.14105.1.cn:
谁说镜中的世界就是虚幻？
当她戴上皇后的冠冕，主角与反派位置对调，荒诞成了律法，舞台中心向她转移。
——欢迎来到属于红皇后的奇境。

CharGetLines.14201.1.en: I'm Cosette, Nocturn Eterna's Disposer. And you are... Wait, Boss? Oops... You weren't supposed to see my face…
CharGetLines.14201.1.cn: 我是珂赛特，永夜的清道夫。你……欸？魔王？不好，竟然这么轻易就在魔王面前暴露长相了……

CharGetLines.14202.1.en: Uh, what? How did this happen again? I thought I was pretty well hidden…
CharGetLines.14202.1.cn: 啊哈哈……又、又见面啦？我明明藏得很好啊……

CharGetLines.14203.1.en: Underestimating Nocturn Eterna's Disposer can get you hurt.
CharGetLines.14203.1.cn: 再怎么说，我也是永夜的清道夫，可不要小瞧我啊！

CharGetLines.14204.1.en: Aw... Looks like the drink's stuck... Maybe if I give it a shake...?
CharGetLines.14204.1.cn: 饮料好像卡住了，拿不出来，怎么办？摇一摇有用吗？

CharGetLines.14205.1.en:
Summer by the sea is just sunshine, seawater, and sand. Nothing that special…
Wait, what?! You're saying there are icy cold drinks you can only get on the island?! Then I'm definitely going too!
CharGetLines.14205.1.cn:
夏日的海边不过是阳光海水和沙滩，也并没有什么特别的——
什么？！你说有海岛特供的清凉饮料？！那我也要去！

CharGetLines.14301.1.en: Wraith, we're partners today onwards. Just tell me the objective.
CharGetLines.14301.1.cn: 风影，即日起与你展开合作。目标是什么，直说就行。

CharGetLines.14302.1.en: Hey, good to see you again. We had great chemistry last time, and I'm excited to team up with you again.
CharGetLines.14302.1.cn: 又见面了，上次我们的合作得不错，之后也期待与你一起行动。

CharGetLines.14303.1.cn: 做好觉悟吧！你们无路可逃！

CharGetLines.14304.1.en:
I am no fool.
I only let my guard down around people I trust.
CharGetLines.14304.1.cn:
我可不是笨蛋。
只有在信赖的人面前，才会暴露出这副毫无防备的样子。

CharGetLines.14401.1.en: I am Chitose, a blade forged and tempered on the isle of Windhowl Island. I pledge myself to your service and protection.
CharGetLines.14401.1.cn: 妾身乃风息岛上精心锻造的利刃，名为千都世。为守护主公，妾身必将以至诚之心，竭力侍奉。

CharGetLines.14402.1.en: I have met you many times in my dreams, but nothing compares to the joy of seeing you here in person.
CharGetLines.14402.1.cn: “纵然梦里常幽会，怎比真如见一回。”主公，又见到您真是太好了。

CharGetLines.14403.1.en: It seems my blade was too blunt...

CharGetLines.14404.1.cn: 主公，让我一直为您所用，好吗？

CharGetLines.14405.1.en: A morning glory kept in water... How long before its color fades, before its scent drifts away?
CharGetLines.14405.1.cn: 养在水里的牵牛花——它的鲜亮和淡香，能保持多久呢？

CharGetLines.14501.1.en: I won't say I want you to trust me on our first meeting. For now, just try to remember my name—"Otoha."
CharGetLines.14501.1.cn: 让我想想，第一次见面，该用哪种身份才能让你更加信任我呢？不过首先，请你记住“乙叶”这个名字。

CharGetLines.14502.1.en: Nice to meet you for the first time. I am... Hehe, of course you remember. That was a joke to lighten the mood.
CharGetLines.14502.1.cn: 初次见面，请多关照……呵呵，我当然记得你，这只是个用来调节气氛的小玩笑。

CharGetLines.14503.1.en: Night is the perfect time to hide secrets—and for a thorough cleaning.
CharGetLines.14503.1.cn: 黑夜不仅适合掩藏秘密，也是清理垃圾的绝佳时刻。

CharGetLines.14504.1.en: A disguise with a few "flaws" actually looks more convincing.
CharGetLines.14504.1.cn: 即使是最完美的伪装，也需要一点“破绽”才显得真实。

CharGetLines.14701.1.en: Solo artist Caramel here, rocking to the beat of the Monolith! Enjoy the show!
CharGetLines.14701.1.cn: 自由贝斯手——焦糖！是名用琴弦连接星塔之音的乐手∼

CharGetLines.14702.1.en: Yay! You've come to hear me play again? Could it be that you've fallen in love with the bass? I'll play whatever you want, so make a request!
CharGetLines.14702.1.cn: 您又来听我演奏啦~难道说……制作人喜欢上我的贝斯了？！这次想听什么曲子呢？

CharGetLines.14703.1.en: Get ready for a bass tornado!

CharGetLines.14704.1.en: Are you feeling the rhythm? Are you feeling ME?
CharGetLines.14704.1.cn: 我的心声，有成功传达给你吗，制作人？

CharGetLines.14705.1.en:
Beep boop beep, make way! The show is about to begin!
Just listen—a dreamy, mellow, fluffy, thumpy bass dreamscape!
CharGetLines.14705.1.cn:
滴滴嘟滴嘟，让一让！演出马上就要开始啦——
请听——梦梦萌萌，软软咚咚，叮叮当当的贝斯梦境！

CharGetLines.14901.1.en: Nice to meet you. I'm Gerie of Grace Imperium. If you can quench my thirsty heart, I just might show you something "special." But don't make me wait too long!
CharGetLines.14901.1.cn: 我是恩赐意志的格芮，只要你能满足我心底的渴望，我就会为你展示更多“特别”的东西……呵呵，请不要让我等得太久哦。

CharGetLines.14902.1.en: The only one who can satisfy this desolate heart is... you. Give me all your sweet thrills!
CharGetLines.14902.1.cn: 魔王大人，只有您才能让我感受到满足……请给予我更多吧，我会把渴望与沉沦……全部奉献给您！

CharGetLines.14903.1.en: You won't hold Soul Color today? Aw, why're you being so mean?
CharGetLines.14903.1.cn: 你不打算牵住我的项圈吗？可是……我的灵魂已经忍耐不住震颤了……不要欺负人嘛……

CharGetLines.14904.1.en: Hehe... How does it feel to have a grip on someone's soul?
CharGetLines.14904.1.cn: 呵呵~握住别人的灵魂，感觉如何？

CharGetLines.14905.1.en: From bitter coffee to blooming roses, I want to share every new experience with you. Let's go on a date when the snow melts?
CharGetLines.14905.1.cn: 咖啡的酸涩，蔷薇的芳香，想将一切新奇的体验都与你分享。融雪后，来一场约会吧？

CharGetLines.15001.1.en:
I’m Laru from Grace Imperium. Pleasure to meet you.
Alright, formalities done—time to slack off—wait, boss call!
Hello? W-What? O-Of course I'm working…
CharGetLines.15001.1.cn:
感到荣幸吧！在你面前的可是恩赐意志的精英——菈露大人！等会……我先接个通话。
啊~老大！您讲，我在听。我……我现在正在出差，是是，那件事今天一定搞定，哪怕熬夜也会搞定。

CharGetLines.15002.1.en: Wussuuup! I'm back to slack off. Distract my boss if she comes looking for me.
CharGetLines.15002.1.cn: 哦，又见面了。有什么需求？先说说看吧。

CharGetLines.15003.1.en: Enough slacking off. Time to get serious.
CharGetLines.15003.1.cn: 休息得差不多了，下面就让你见识见识我的真本事吧。

CharGetLines.15004.1.en:
I'm so sorry. I'll never do it again. Please give me another chance!
Queen Laru's workplace survival techniques are pretty good, huh?
CharGetLines.15004.1.cn:
对不起嘛~下次绝不会再犯了，我保证~
——学会了吗？菈露大人的职场求生技。

CharGetLines.15501.1.en: Nice to meet you. I'm Shia. And from you, heh... I sense a scent that somehow calms my heart.
CharGetLines.15501.1.cn: 正式自我介绍一下，我是希娅。你的身上，有着可以信任的气味呢。

CharGetLines.15502.1.en: Ah, hello again! The bond between us must be stronger than a ship's mooring rope! ♪
CharGetLines.15502.1.cn: 又见面了~看来我们之间的缘分，比帆船的缆绳还要坚固呢。

CharGetLines.15503.1.en: I'll show you the joy of surfing!
CharGetLines.15503.1.cn: 一起来感受冲浪的魅力吧！

CharGetLines.15504.1.en: Ah, the night air, the moonlight sparkling on the waves... We'll never forget this moment, will we?
CharGetLines.15504.1.cn: 那一晚的月光与海浪，想必你也无法忘怀吧。

CharGetLines.15601.1.en: Yaawn... I'm Nazuna with Petal Bloom. I'm not great at working hard, but… I guess I can try a little as long as I'm with you, Boss.
CharGetLines.15601.1.cn: 我是花令旅团的小禾。说实话，我不太擅长努力啦……但是跟你在一起的话，稍稍努力一下也不是不行……

CharGetLines.15602.1.en:
Hello again, Boss.
Oh, no, no. Please don't worry about me.
Let's both just take it easy.
CharGetLines.15602.1.cn:
又见面啦……
你先忙着，不用在意我。
我们都放松一点就好啦。

CharGetLines.15603.1.en: Swish, swish, swish! Hoo, I feel a little stronger here.
CharGetLines.15603.1.cn: 咻咻咻！超绝厉害版小禾登场！

CharGetLines.15604.1.en: BOO! Hehe, did I scare ya?

CharGetLines.15605.1.en: Isn't this what life is all about? A slice of opera cake, a cup of black tea. Dreams swell and rise until the teapot starts to sing.
CharGetLines.15605.1.cn: 生活不过是如此吧：吃一块歌剧院，再沏一壶红茶。梦想正在膨胀，直至茶壶吐出蒸汽泡泡。

CharGetLines.15701.1.en: My name is Karin. Just so you know, I'm going to become a legendary seafaring Trekker one day! Don't you dare underestimate me just because I'm small!
CharGetLines.15701.1.cn: 我是花铃。先说好，我总有一天会成为名垂青史的航海旅人！不准因为我个子小就小看我哦！

CharGetLines.15702.1.en: You're here again? Well, at least you know who to come to... I suppose I can help you out—just this once more.
CharGetLines.15702.1.cn: 又来找我了？哼，算你还有眼光……我就再帮你一次吧。

CharGetLines.15703.1.en: I can hear the waves loud and clear!
CharGetLines.15703.1.cn: 浪潮的声音，我听得一清二楚！

CharGetLines.15704.1.en: Stop staring at me. Hurry up and eat! The smoothie is melting away.
CharGetLines.15704.1.cn: 别看我啦……赶紧吃吧，冰沙要化掉了哦。

CharGetLines.15801.1.en:
I'm Laru from Grace Imperium. Pleasure to meet you.
... Hey, what's with that look? This is just the standard uniform for the Grace Imperium's Snowish Festival!
CharGetLines.15801.1.cn:
感到荣幸吧！在你面前的可是恩赐意志的精英——菈露大人！
 ……你那是什么表情？这只是恩赐意志发的雪愿节制服！

CharGetLines.15802.1.en: We meet again. Hehe... You couldn't forget my treatment?
CharGetLines.15802.1.cn: 又见面啦，要跟我一起去发礼物吗？

CharGetLines.15803.1.en: Gifts raining from the sky... Now that's what I call a surprise!
CharGetLines.15803.1.cn: 礼物从天而降，这还不算惊喜吗？

CharGetLines.15804.1.en: Mmh... When did I doze off?

CharGetLines.15901.1.en: What an interesting coincidence to run into you while traveling. By the way... what do you think about this Loong-style outfit?
CharGetLines.15901.1.cn: 没想到会在这里相遇，看来我们缘分不浅。为了顺应节日氛围，我特意挑了这身装束，你觉得怎么样？

CharGetLines.15902.1.en: We meet again. You just can't get my special injections out of your mind, can you?
CharGetLines.15902.1.cn: 又见面了，看来你对我的针剂还是念念不忘。

CharGetLines.15903.1.en: Hehe... I'll make your feelings soar even higher.
CharGetLines.15903.1.cn: 你那颗躁动不安的心，就让我来让它鼓动得更加激烈吧。

CharGetLines.15904.1.en: Now it's your turn to heal me... Heh, don't stop your hands.
CharGetLines.15904.1.cn: 这次换你来诊疗我，感觉怎么样？呵呵，手别停啊……

CharGetLines.16001.1.en: I don't get to come to the beach with everyone much, so I hope we can make the most of it. Ah, but just so you know... If you do anything risky, you're getting a "gentle warning" from me!
CharGetLines.16001.1.cn: 能和你们一起来海边真的很难得，希望大家能度过一个开心的假日。啊，但如果做了危险的事，我会“温柔警告”的哦~

CharGetLines.16002.1.en: Looks like this beach still needs me around a little longer. Well then, I'll happily keep you all company!
CharGetLines.16002.1.cn: 看样子，这片海暂时还离不开我呢，那就让我继续陪着大家吧~

CharGetLines.16003.1.en: Alright, I'm done talking. Don't blame me when things get a little rough!
CharGetLines.16003.1.cn: 口头警告无效的话，就别怪我不客气了。

CharGetLines.16004.1.en:
It's about time we headed back... But...
The sunset is so beautiful. Let's stay a little longer.
CharGetLines.16004.1.cn:
已经到了该回去的时间了，不过……
夕阳真美啊，我们再多待一会儿吧。
