CharacterArchiveContent.10311.2.en:
On Amber's birthday,
she saved up enough money to treat herself to a cat cafe special in the Emor Ash District.

That night, Amber had a dream,
in which she turned into a cat.

As it turned out, through the eyes of a cat, humans were huge and terrifying creatures.
The black cat named Amber tried to control her clumsy limbs as she arched her back, trying to dodge the bustling crowd. Every encounter felt like a brush with death.
Stress made all the fur on her body stand on end. Even if someone did notice this black cat at their feet, they'd probably just mistake her for a stray cat's fur ball—tumbling around the dirty, muddy ground of the Ash District, blown by the winter wind.

"Chirr, meow. (Come here.)" 
Amber shook her left ear—after turning into a cat, her hearing had become exceptionally sharp. She pinpointed the cat's call as coming from a pile of abandoned cardboard boxes across the street.
All she needed to do was cross the street. Then, perhaps, she would be able to find a companion.
Despite this, Amber hesitated when she came to the edge of the street. Even though it was only a few human steps away, in the eyes of a cat, the distance seemed impossibly long, like an unbridgeable ravine.

Suddenly, something lifted her up by the scruff of her neck—before she could react, some creature had grabbed her from behind. The powerful gusts from the giants' legs as they walked brushed past her nose, making her whiskers tremble. Amber the cat, who had been flailing her limbs in panic, instantly stopped struggling.
"Meow. (Hah.)"
A cat's sound came from above, both mocking and comforting at once.
The cat who had picked Amber up deftly traversed the street that looked so intimidating to Amber.

"Meow, purr. (A newbie. Never seen her before.)"
Several round heads poked out from the shaking cardboard box.
"Purr, meow! (Nobody's gonna mess with you, not with us here.)"
The golden head at the bottom meowed twice before a paw pressed it down—a paw which belonged to a purple cat with a tuft of white fur on its forehead.
"Meow! Purr... (Don't talk so big, you runt.)"
The cat's words were aimed at her companion, but her narrow pupils were fixed directly on Amber.

"Meow, meow, purr. (Cat Two, Cat Three, be nice to the newbie.)"
The one who helped Amber finally spoke—she was much larger than the rest of them and seemed to be in charge.
"Meow, meow, purr. (I'm not the one in charge here.)"
As if she'd could read Amber's thoughts, the large cat flicked her tail and jumped up to the ruined staircase above the cardboard box.
...At that moment, Amber realized that even more cats were emerging from the shadows of the stairs, their glowing eyes all fixed on her.
CharacterArchiveContent.10311.2.cn:
琥珀生日那天，
她用积攒的零用钱，奖励了自己一份埃摩灰城区猫店的吸猫套餐。

当天夜里，琥珀做了一个梦，
梦见自己变成了一只猫。

原来在猫的眼里，人是这么巨大、可怕的生物。
名为琥珀的黑猫操纵着还不熟练的四肢，弓着背躲开熙攘的人群——每一次都像是与死神的擦身而过。
黑猫全身的毛因戒备炸开，即便有人注意到自己脚边这道黑色的身影，恐怕也只会以为是哪只流浪猫吐出的一团毛茸茸的废毛，在灰城区肮脏的泥土地上被这冬日的风吹得滚来滚去。

“咕呜，喵嗷。（到这儿来）”
琥珀抖抖左耳——变成猫之后，她的听觉变得越发灵敏，精准地在嘈杂的环境里捕捉到了从对角那堆废弃的纸箱附近传来的，猫的呼叫。
只要穿过面前的这段路，或许就能找到同伴。
这么想着的琥珀，却在街的这边犹豫了起来：明明只是几步之遥，可在黑猫的眼里无限拉长，变成一条无法横跨的沟壑。

蓦地，她的四肢悬空，后颈一紧——未等反应，自己就被身后的什么生物叼了起来。本在挣扎的猫，当鼻间被巨人们提脚带起的劲风堪堪扫过后，顿时安分。
“喵。（哼）”
头顶传来猫叫，像是嘲笑又好似安慰。
叼着琥珀的猫，就这样轻盈地穿过令琥珀望而却步的街道。

“呜喵，嗷。（新猫，没见过）”
晃动的纸箱里探出好几个圆滚滚的脑袋。
“咕呼呼，喵！（以后我们来罩你）”
被压在最下面的那颗金色脑袋喵了两声，就被头上的爪子摁倒——爪子的主人是一只通体深紫色的猫，额前有一簇白毛。
“喵嗷！咕……（小身板不要说大话）”
她像是在和同伴对话，可细长的瞳孔直直地盯着面前的琥珀。

“咪，咪喵，呜嗷。（猫二，猫三，对新猫友善点。）”
帮助了琥珀的猫此时才出声——她的身形比这里的几只猫要大得多，看样子是纸箱猫们的老大。
“喵，咪嗷，喵呜。（我可不是这儿的老大）”
像是看穿了琥珀内心的想法，大猫甩甩尾巴，一跃上了纸箱上方那段破败不堪的楼梯。
……此时，琥珀才发现，从楼梯的阴影处涌出了更多数量的猫，莹莹的目光皆专注在自己的身上。

CharacterArchiveContent.10312.2.en:
At the top of the staircase, a cat sauntered out.
"Meow, meow, purrr. (Newbie, the human world is full of danger. Join our Cat Kingdom Troupe, and we shall keep you safe.)"
She looked down at Amber from above. Her face and ears bore scars big and small from battles.

Troupe... Such a familiar word. Amber tilted her head but couldn't figure out why.
"Meow, meow, purr? (So...the long-haired blue cat who brought me here, is she also from the Cat Kingdom?)" Amber found herself asking in the same language.
"Purr, meow! Purr, meow! (Of course, she's the strongest warrior in our kingdom—Cat One!)"
Upon hearing her name, the large blue cat emerged from the group and cheerfully waved her paw at Amber.
"Meow. (Then, I'll join.)"
Amber answered without hesitation.
"Meow, meow meow. (Good. From now on, you can call me Boss Cat.)"
Around here, the Cat Kingdom Troupe is a vast underground organization of cats.
Cats Two and Three, who Amber had encountered earlier, were also strays picked up by Cat One and raised in the Cat Kingdom's sanctuary for kittens—that cardboard box in the corner, its official name being the "Cardboard Cat Castle."
Nobody had told Amber these strange details, but they came into her head all the same.

Amber shook her head, clearing away these thoughts, and focused on playing with a magical mouse puppet. This was a daily training routine for the warriors of the Cat Kingdom.
"Meow meow, meow. (Don't let your limbs grow rusty.)"
Boss Cat would remind her warriors daily:
"Purr...meow, meow! Meow! Meow meow! (Soon, we'll face a great battle. We shall liberate our brethren at the cafe!)"

That's right. The mission: Liberate the cats inside the cat cafe.
This was Amber's first mission after she joined the Cat Kingdom. It also served as a test given to her by Cat One the big blue cat after she applied to join her team.
Cat Two was already on the team, but Amber was determined to not fall behind Cat Three, who only ever thought about games. She swatted her paw against the mouse's tail and watched with satisfaction as her ranking rose above Cat Three's.
To her surprise, that single act seemed to change more than just the ranking.
The entire training ground began to shake. Above the field, a giant, featureless human face appeared.
"Purr! Meow meow, meow! Purr! (No! The humans from the cafe have acted first—we've been discovered!)"
Boss Cat's voice came to her from afar.

Amber's eyes flew open, her heart pounding as she glanced up at the sky—
No human face.
And she...was not a cat.
After all, Amber knew how cats communicate—with glances, scents, and body language instead of "talking" back and forth with meows.
Only humans spoke.

"The Cat Kingdom Troupe, the Cardboard Cat Castle, Cats One, Two, Three, and Boss Cat... Was it all just a dream?"
The starlight had no answer for Amber. She closed her eyes, hoping she'd find out the truth someday.
CharacterArchiveContent.10312.2.cn:
楼梯的最高一阶，一只猫踱步而出。
“嗷呜，喵嗷，咕噜。（新猫，人的世界危机四伏，加入我们猫之国剧团，保你平安）”
她自上而下看着琥珀——脸颊、耳朵都带着大面积的创伤，是斗争的痕迹。

剧团……好耳熟的名词。琥珀歪歪脑袋，却找不到这份感觉的源头。
“呜喵，咪，咪嗷。（那……带我来的那只蓝色长毛猫，也是你们猫之国的吗？）”她听见自己在同一种语言向她提问。
“咕喵！咕呼，呜嗷！（当然，她是我们猫之国最强的猫战士——猫大）”
听见自己的名字，蓝色的大猫从猫堆里钻出，笑眯眯地向琥珀挥了挥爪子。
“咪呜。（那，我加入）”
没有迟疑，琥珀选择了这个回答。
“呜喵，呜喵喵。（很好，那以后，你就叫我猫老大）”
在当地，猫之国剧团是一个很庞大的地下猫组织。
和琥珀打过照面的猫二猫三，也是被猫大捡来，养在猫之国照顾小猫的地方——即那个角落的纸箱——全名“纸箱猫猫院”。
这些奇怪的信息并没有猫告诉琥珀，却很自然地出现在她的脑海中。

琥珀摇摇脑袋，将这些杂念清空，专心玩起魔法布老鼠——这是猫之国战士们的日常训练之一。
“喵呜咪，嗷。（不要让自己的四肢生锈）”
猫老大每天都会如此告诫自己的战士：
“咕噜……呜嗷，喵！喵呜！咪嗷！（再过不久我们即将迎来一场恶战，那就是解放猫店的猫友们！）”

没错，解放猫咖的猫友们。
这是琥珀加入猫之国后的第一个任务，也是她申请加入猫大小队后，那只蓝色大猫给的测试。
先不谈早已入队的猫二，自己怎么可以输给满脑子只有游戏的猫三？琥珀一爪子拍在魔法布老鼠的尾巴上，满意地看着自己的成绩排名跳到了猫三的前面。
出乎意料的是，这一爪子似乎改变的不仅仅是排行。
猫之国整个训练场都动荡了起来。训练场的上空，浮起一张巨大的，没有五官的人脸。
“呜喵喵，喵啊！咕呜！（不好，猫咖的人抢先行动，我们被发现了！）”
远远的，她听见了猫老大的声音。

琥珀猛地睁开双眼，心有余悸地看向上方的天空——
没有人脸。
而自己，也并不是一只猫。
毕竟，琥珀熟悉猫和猫的交流，它们之间并不会叫来叫去地“说话”，而是更多地用眼神、味道和身体动作。
只有人类，才会“说话”。

“猫之国剧团，纸箱猫猫院，还有猫大猫二猫三……真的都只是梦吗？”
星光并没有给琥珀她想要的回答。她闭上眼，期许能在未来找到答案。

CharacterArchiveContent.10313.2.en:
Amber remembers the name of these guns: Cat Treat-1911.
However, she has no idea where they came from.

It seemed that one day, when she woke up, they were already there—spotlessly clean and neatly placed by her pillow.
"Cat Treat-1911," Amber read out the unfamiliar name as if she'd always known it.
Loading, aiming, pulling the trigger—it all felt so familiar, as if her muscles knew them better than her mind.

"I feel like I've forgotten how I came to have these pistols."
After the formation of the New Star Guild, Amber said this to her companions.
"Knowing they're yours is enough, isn't it?"
The blonde girl answered. Then she pulled Amber away to watch a rare sight—the Shrubshrew migration.

"It looks like they are made by NGO. Look, the bullets are actually filled with Neo Solution... Oh by the way, whatever you do, don't carry these guns openly in the cities. If someone from the Grace Imperium see them, you'll get fined."
The girl warned Amber repeatedly with a most grave expression on her face. She didn't stop until Amber promised not to take the guns out.

Later, a new member joined New Star Guild.
Clutching her pistols, Amber asked the same question to the newcomer.
The amnesiac newbie was surprisingly at home with the grip and aim of these guns. If not for the inability to use magic, they could undoubtedly become an excellent sharpshooter.
But even the "Boss," who was an expert on Artifacts, wasn't sure if this pair of guns was one of them.

Amber didn't let this get her down.
Because she'd already found a clue that will lead her to the truth—
On the day she met the newcomer, inside Emor City's Ash District market, she'd spotted a mark that resembled the bullet holes made by her Cat Treat-1911.
CharacterArchiveContent.10313.2.cn:
琥珀记得这对枪的名字：猫条-1911。
却对它们的来历一无所知。

好像，某天醒来时，它们就擦拭得一尘不染，整整齐齐地摆放在枕头边了。
“猫条-1911”，琥珀自然地念出这个陌生的名字。
上膛、瞄准、扣动扳机，一切都是那么熟练——肌肉比大脑更熟悉它们。

“我好像忘了……我是怎么拿到这对手枪的。”
空白旅团结成后，琥珀这样对同伴说。
“知道它们是你的，不就行了？”
金发少女回答完，便拉着琥珀去看房车旁，难得一见的树树鼠搬家的景象。

“看上去像柔光的制品，你瞧，子弹其实都是柔光溶液灌……对了！千万别正大光明地拿着这枪在城邦里晃，被恩赐意志的人看到就糟了，会被罚款的。”
一脸严肃的少女千叮咛万嘱咐，直到琥珀保证不把枪拿出来后，才停止了念叨。

后来，有新的成员加入了空白旅团。
琥珀抱着枪，向新成员询问了同样的问题。
那个严重失忆的旅人反倒很熟悉这种武器的握持和瞄准，如果不是用不了魔法，一定能成为出色的射手。
只是，这位对神器莫名熟悉的“魔王”，也不清楚这对枪到底是不是神器。

琥珀并不气馁。
因为她已经找到了真相的线头——
遇到新人的那天，她在埃摩灰城区的集市里，发现了一处和“猫条-1911”相似的弹痕。

CharacterArchiveContent.10702.2.en: I often need to undertake missions outside the cities, including occasionally ones involving Monoliths. Being a Trekker would make everything easier.

CharacterArchiveContent.10703.2.en:
Interests

Patrolling, helping people, polishing armor.
Collecting Masked Knights' helmets.
CharacterArchiveContent.10703.2.cn:
兴趣爱好

巡逻，助人，擦铠甲。
收集《蒙面骑士》的变身头盔。

获奖记录

CharacterArchiveContent.10705.2.en:
Code of the Imperial Guard:

Loyal to the Empire, Enforce the law impartially, Uphold justice, Protect the weak...
(These are only the beginning of a full five pages written by Tilia on this topic.—Iris)
CharacterArchiveContent.10705.2.cn:
卫队准则

忠于帝国，秉公行事，维护正义，保护弱者……
（这一项缇莉娅写了满满五页，只摘录前四句了。——鸢尾）

CharacterArchiveContent.10706.2.en:
Aspirations

Whether in novels, stage plays, or folklore, knights share one common trait—they help those in trouble.
I will do anything to become a knight.
CharacterArchiveContent.10706.2.cn:
憧憬的事物

不管是小说、舞台剧还是民间故事，骑士都有一个共同的特点——帮助陷入困境的人。
只要能成为正式的骑士，让我做什么都行。

CharacterArchiveContent.10707.2.en:
Imperial Guard Recruitment Test

Basic Written Exam: Passable
Interview: Average.
Physical Fitness Test: Excellent.
Adaptability Test: Excellent.

Comments:
The candidate barely passed the written exam and displayed an excessive sense of justice during the interview, which could potentially affect her performance as a guard.
The candidate demonstrated excellent weight-bearing ability, running three laps around the city while carrying 50 kilograms of equipment, with all vital signs remaining normal afterward.
During a simulated hostage scenario, the candidate decisively subdued the assailant and rescued the hostages. However, she used an unusual flying kick which resulted in a ligament sprain.
No record of family members becoming knights or Grace Imperium employees within the past five generations.
Taking all of the above into consideration, it is recommended to admit the candidate as a squire.
—Anonymous
CharacterArchiveContent.10707.2.cn:
卫队入职测试

基础笔试：及格。
面试评价：普通。
体能测试：优秀。
应变测试：优秀。

评语：
笔试勉强及格，面试时展现出了过多的正义心，有可能会影响今后的保卫工作。
负重能力好，携带五十公斤装备，绕城三周跑后，各项体征正常。
在模拟劫持事件中果断制伏歹徒，救下人质。但因为使用了奇怪的飞踢，导致韧带拉伤。
上追五代内没有家人成为骑士，或入职恩赐意志的记录。
综合考量，建议录用为侍从。
——佚名

CharacterArchiveContent.10708.2.en:
A very impressive knight.
Given the opportunity, I would love to have another discussion about vehicle driving with her.
—Noya

With the ranks of the Imperial Guard, no one embodies the ideals of knighthood better than Tilia does.
It is a great irony that she is only a "squire."
—Kaydoke
CharacterArchiveContent.10708.2.cn:
令人印象深刻的骑士小姐。
有机会的话，想和她再探讨一下驾驶技术啊。
——尘沙

哪怕将帝国卫队翻个底朝天，都找不到第二个比缇莉娅更骑士的骑士了。
讽刺的是，缇莉娅反倒一直是名“侍从”。
——凯多克

CharacterArchiveContent.10709.2.en:
Extremely accurate.<sprite name="acrchives_certified_richtext">
There is an unspoken understanding among Trekker teams: if you encounter danger in The Wilds and hear the sound of a scooter, you must call for help loudly. Before long, just like a page out of a classic novel, a knight will come to your aid.
This knight is none other than Miss Tilia. Although her position differs from us Trekkers, she treats us same as any other, and her chivalry is truly admirable.
—Willow
CharacterArchiveContent.10709.2.cn:
真实度极高。<sprite name="acrchives_certified_richtext">
旅人团队间流传着一个不成文的规定：倘若在野外遭遇不测时，听见了踏板车的声音，务必要大声呼救，不久就会有一位骑士对你伸出援手，就像是某部古典文学中的情节。
这位骑士便是缇莉娅小姐，虽然她与我们旅人的立场不同，但她仍会平等看待旅人和其他人，她的骑士精神令人敬佩。
——薇洛

CharacterArchiveContent.10710.2.en:
The Falcon—Tilia's ride.
Issued by the Imperial Guard and passed down to Tilia by a retiring knight, this vehicle is said to be 30 years old.
Thanks to Tilia's meticulous care, it looks as good as new, with absolutely no signs of wear and tear.
What's more, according to a Scarlet Sights Media exclusive, this Artifact vehicle has undergone "special" modifications at the hands of Tilia's close friend Kaydoke. Kaydoke claims that these changes have made the vehicle better suited to Tilia's style. We look forward to seeing it in full glory someday.
Also, our "When Will Tilia Be Knighted" lottery continues—interested readers, don't miss out!
—Scarlet Sights Media Exclusive
CharacterArchiveContent.10710.2.cn:
骏鹰号，缇莉娅的座驾。
帝国卫队下发，离职的骑士交给缇莉娅的载具，据说有三十年历史了。
在缇莉娅的精心呵护下，这辆车仿佛全新的一般，完全看不出岁月的痕迹。
另外，据绯瞳的独家消息，该神器载具在缇莉娅的好友凯多克的改造下，内部发生了“特殊”变化。凯多克称这样的改造让车辆更加贴合了缇莉娅的行事风格，期待有朝一日能看见它大显身手的样子。
另外，“缇莉娅何时受封骑士大乐透”持续进行中，有兴趣的读者不要错过。
——绯瞳传讯独家报道。

CharacterArchiveContent.10711.2.en:
"Even here, the sky doesn't look any different—when I look up, I see nothing but shoddy roofs and Monoliths in the horizon.
"This is Emor City's Ash District, after all. The view is nothing to write home about. But right now, you should be focusing on your recovery."
"Mind your own business. You're just a delivery girl. Whether I live or die, what's it to you?"
"You look better when you smile."

The moldy walls, a rickety bed ready to collapse, and the pungent smell of medicine in the air.
As a newly-appointed knight squire, Tilia's first job was delivering medicine.
The girl named Xenoria was not the friendly sort, but a knight's mission to help others wasn't dependent on the recipient's attitude.

"The doctor says you're almost fully recovered. Want to go for a ride?"
"Yeah, I can get out of bed and walk now, but that's none of your business—hey!"

Tilia, without waiting for an answer, grabbed Xenoria's hand and they mounted her beloved Lapis Eagle.
The two of them sped through fields and woods. Xenoria clutched her hoodie tightly and kept her head down, but she kept glancing at the scenery along the way.

"Isn't this view nice? I come here often when I have time off!"
"This is too extravagant for someone like me."
"Extravagant? It's just sightseeing. If you like it, we can come here all the time."
"Don't you have other work to do?"
"Don't worry. I'm not skipping work—that would go against the spirit of chivalry. Today's my day off."
"Getting too close to someone like me will only bring you bad luck..."
"What are you talking about? What you have is a physical injury, not some contagious disease. Besides, it's a knight's duty to help those in need."

Xenoria sighed and said no more.
This young squire would soon find out just how much bad luck she would bring.
CharacterArchiveContent.10711.2.cn:
“就算在这里，天空也没什么两样，抬头看见的不是破屋檐就是塔。”
“这里是埃摩的灰城区嘛，视野确实不太好。不过，你现在应该考虑的是——让自己快点好起来。”
“多管闲事，你只是个送药的，我的死活关你啥事？”
“你笑起来比较好看。”

发霉的墙壁，随时会塌的破床，浑浊刺鼻药味的空气。
刚成为骑士侍从的缇莉娅，第一份工作是给人送药。
名叫奚的少女对她并不友善，但身为骑士，并不会因为对方的态度，而改变助人的本心。

“医生说你恢复得差不多了，想不想兜风？”
“倒是能下床走路了，但这不是你该管的——喂！”

缇莉娅自顾自地拉起奚的手，骑上了她心爱的骏鹰号。
二人穿行在麦田林间，奚低头紧抓着兜帽，余光却始终瞥向沿途的风景。

“这里景色很不错吧！我休息的时候常来！”
“对于我来说，有些太奢侈……”
“奢侈？看风景而已，你喜欢我们可以常来。”
“你还有别的工作吧。”
“放心，我没有翘班，那不符合骑士精神。今天我休息。”
“和我这样的人挨得太近，会倒霉的......”
“说什么呢，你是外伤，又不是传染病。再说了，帮助弱者是骑士应该做的。”

奚叹了口气，没有再说下去。
很快，这位小小的骑士侍从就会知道，接近自己是多糟糕的一件事了。

CharacterArchiveContent.10712.2.en:
Inside the Ash District, rainwater dripped down from eaves.
Tilia stood alone on a deserted street with a small mountain of weapons piled at her feet.
Just moments ago, while delivering medicine to Xi, she was surrounded by the largest gang in the Ash District—the Ground Vipers.
After she disarmed dozens of gang members, they retreated, but Xi had also disappeared.

"Getting too close to someone like me will only bring you bad luck..."

Tilia recalled Xi's words from their ride together.
At the time, she hadn't given it much thought.
As a knight squire stationed inside the Ash District, Tilia often came across similar sentiments.
Inhabitants of the Ash District were, by definition, unlucky people—the lucky ones had long moved to the well-established Silver or Gold Districts.
But still...

"There are footprints."

Tilia followed the trail.
From deep inside an alley came faint groans of someone injured.

"Xi, where are you?"

She couldn't believe her eyes.
Several Ground Viper thugs lay unconscious on the ground. Xi sat among them, her head bandage stained with fresh blood.

"Yo. Looks like I've dragged you into this."

Xi greeted Tilia weakly.
There was a box of medicine by her side.

"These are meds earmarked for the sick children of the Ash District. Somehow the Ground Vipers heard about it."
"You safeguarded the medicine..."
"No, I'm not that noble."

Xi removed her head bandage, revealing a pair of sharp horns.

"During the scuffle, they noticed these."
"Xi... You're with the Nocturn Eterna..."

Xi shook her head.

"Our world is more than Nocturn Eterna, but there's no use explaining it.
Basically, they found me out. Seeing as my bounty fetches more than these meds, they attacked me instead."

Clang.
Tilia thrust her spear into the ground and raised her shield.

"Go ahead and capture me. Better that the bounty on my head goes to you than to those scums."

The shield came rushing toward Xi with a gust of wind. Xi closed her eyes.
But the hit never came.
The sound of metal clashing echoed behind her.
Xi opened her eyes.
More Ground Vipers had surrounded them, but Tilia's shield deflected the attacks raining down from above.

"To uphold justice and protect the weak. That's the code of the Imperial Guard."

She bashed her shield and sent the thugs flying.

"The code makes no distinction when it comes to race and affiliation."

Her solid armor deflected incoming sharp blades.

"You safeguarded the medicine and, during my time with you, committed no crime. You're not on the Guard's wanted list.
If I were to turn you in as a Nocturn Eterna for the bounty on your head, it would be dishonorable and against the spirit of chivalry."
"Tilia..."
"Just go. I'm simply fulfilling my duty of maintaining order, and you're just a passerby who did a good deed."
"I have nowhere to..."
"That's not true. Watch this move."

Tilia leapt high into the air, executing an aerial flying kick that completely defied human anatomy.
The sound of a loud crash exploded inside the alley before it quickly drowned out by the rain.

A month later...
Lying in a hospital bed with her leg in a cast, Tilia received an anonymous letter.

"Salutations,
I'm sorry I didn't see the end of your flying kick.
In the Masked Knight stories you told me, the hero always used this move when there was no other way out, and it would be the pivotal moment when everything turned.
Thank you for your encouragement. When you leapt, I turned and fled from the city.
Getting close to someone like me brings bad luck.
But you're an exception. Maybe it's because your light is so dazzling that it has cleansed me of my misfortune.
I'm heading north now. Along the way, I saw a golden little flower covered in star-like fuzz. I've sent it along with this letter. When we meet next time, I hope you will tell me its name.
Your truly
A Passerby Citizen"

Tilia smiled and tucked the letter under her pillow. One really shouldn't use that ultimate flying kick too often.Perhaps only the rain will remember her brief encounter with the girl who may or may not be a Nocturn Eterna.
CharacterArchiveContent.10712.2.cn:
雨滴，在灰城区的屋檐上拉出一道道水线。
缇莉娅独自站在无人的街道中，脚下的武器堆成了一座小山。
就在刚才，来给奚送药的她被灰城区最大的帮派——地蝰帮包围了。
缴了几十个人的武器后，帮派成员撤退了，但房间里的奚也不见了。

“和我这样的人挨得太近，会倒霉的......”

缇莉娅想起，两人一起去兜风的那天奚说的话。
当时，她并不觉得这句话有什么深意。
作为在灰城区执勤的骑士侍从，她经常听到类似的话。
还留在灰城区的人，当然都是倒霉的人，幸运的人早就去了更好的银城区和金城区了。
只是......

“有脚印。”

缇莉娅顺着脚印追去。
小巷的深处，隐隐传来伤者的呻吟声。

“奚，你在哪？”

眼前，是不可思议的光景。
几名地蝰帮的混混倒在地上不省人事，奚坐在他们中间，头上的纱布被鲜血染红。

“呦，连累你了。”

奚有气无力地和缇莉娅打着招呼。
她的身边，放着一箱药品。

“这是医生想发给灰城区生病的孩子的，不知怎么的，被地蝰帮知道了。”
“你保护了这些药......”
“不，我可没这么伟大。”

奚摘下头上的纱布，露出一对尖角。

“在抢药的过程中，他们发现了这个。”
“奚……你是永夜的人……”

奚摇了摇头。

“我们的世界里，不是只有永夜这一个组织。不过，这种辩解也没意义。
总之，他们发现了我，我的赏金比这些药还要更贵一点，就转而攻击我了。”

咣当。
缇莉娅将长矛插在了地上，双手举起盾牌。

“把我抓起来吧。这笔赏金与其让这帮坏蛋拿去，不如让给你。”

盾牌挟着风声向奚冲来，奚闭上了眼睛。
然而，想象中的冲击并没有到来。
金铁交击声在奚的耳后响起。
睁开眼。
更多的地蝰帮围了上来，缇莉娅的盾牌帮奚挡住了从天而降的攻击。

“维护正义，保护弱者。这是帝国卫队的准则。”

飞舞的盾牌击飞了冲上来的混混。

“这个准则里，并没有分种族，或者组织。”

坚硬的铠甲挡住了锋利的刀刃。

“你保护了药品，并且在我接触的时段里并没有做过任何坏事，也不在卫队的通缉令上。
如果我只是为了赏金，把你充作永夜，那是不荣誉的，违背骑士精神的。”
“缇莉娅......”
“走吧，我只是在执行维护治安的任务，你只是一个路过的，见义勇为的市民。”
“我无处可......”
“才不是这样，看这招。”

缇莉娅高高跃起，施展了一招完全违反人体结构的凌空飞踢。
小巷里传来一声巨响，然后，响声很快就被雨声盖过去了。

一个月后。
腿上裹着石膏，躺在病床上的缇莉娅收到了一封匿名信。

敬启：
很抱歉，你的那记飞踢我没看到最后。
在你讲的故事里，蒙面骑士在走投无路的时候，总是会用这一招，用了之后，故事就会柳暗花明。
谢谢你对我的鼓励，所以，看到你跃起后，我就头也不回地向城外逃了出去。
和我这样的人挨得太近，会倒霉的。
但你是个例外，或许是因为你的光芒过于耀眼，把我的霉运都清除掉了吧。
我正向着北方旅行，路上看见了一枝长满星状绒毛的金色小花。我把它一起寄了过来，希望下一次见面的时候，你能告诉我它的名字。
你忠实的 路过的市民

缇莉娅笑着把信放在枕头下面，那记飞踢，果然还是不能常用啊。
她与疑似永夜少女的短暂相遇，或许只有那场雨记得。

CharacterArchiveContent.10713.2.en:
A forge located inside Emor's Ash District.
An old blacksmith swung his hammer rhythmically, striking the truesteel on the anvil.
Sparks flew from the hammer and steel, landing on his body, but he paid them no heed. He fixed his eyes on the glowing red metal.

The beginning of this story can be traced back to several months earlier.
A grand exhibition was being held inside the Imperial Guard's castle.
The lance and shield of the legendary knight Brahmante were displayed in the center of the hall.
It was the first time in twenty years that these legendary Artifacts were on view.
However, the old blacksmith only shook his head in disappointment.
He could tell by a glance that these were counterfeits made barely a week ago—exceptionally crude ones, at that.

Just as the old blacksmith was about to leave this pointless exhibition,
a monster on display broke out of its shoddy iron cage and charged into the crowd.
The defenseless audience fled in all directions. The old blacksmith, caught in this surge of panic, was knocked down in front of the beast.
He thought he would end up inside the monster's stomach,
but an adolescent girl broke through the display case, grabbed Brahmante's supposed lance and shield, and charged toward the monster.

The crude counterfeits were, of course, no match for the beast. Nevertheless, the girl did not retreat. She tied herself with a rope and leapt from the second floor, delivering a "knight's flying kick" to the beast.
Maybe it was her perfect aim, or maybe the girl's courage stunned the beast. The monster fell to the floor. The chaos ended with only one person injured.

Months passed. The girl recovered and was duly discharged from the hospital. She polished her armor until it shone brightly and rode her beloved scooter to the old blacksmith's home.
She pushed the rustic door open and saw the blacksmith's final masterpiece: a pair of lance and shield made in Brahmante's style but fundamentally unique.

"Take these," the blacksmith said, "they are made specially for you. Only you are worthy to wield something made in this legendary design. These are not duplicates of Brahmante's—they are yours. Give them a new name."
"Thank you! Then... I will call them Freedom and Glory. Simple, but far from common!"

Tilia took the lance and shield with her and stepped out of the workshop. She held them high above her head.
From that moment on, Nova's new knight legend began to take shape.
CharacterArchiveContent.10713.2.cn:
埃摩灰城区，某个锻造室内。
一位老铁匠正挥动着铁锤，有节奏地敲击着铁砧上的秘钢，
他全然不顾铁锤和钢条迸射的火星溅到自己身上，眼睛死死地盯住赤红的秘钢。

一切的源头，还要从数月前说起。
一场盛大的展览，正在帝国卫队的城堡中举行。
传说骑士布拉坦曼特所用的枪和盾，被安放在大厅中央。
这是这对神器二十年来第一次展出。
然而，老铁匠却失望地摇了摇头。
他看得出来，这是上周刚做好的赝品，就算以赝品的标准评价，也是最粗糙的那一档。

就在老铁匠打算离开这无聊的展览会的时候。
一只用来展览的魔物咬开了劣质铁笼，冲了出来。
展览会的观众们手无寸铁，吓得四处奔逃，老铁匠被汹涌的人流撞倒，跌在魔物身前。
就在他以为，自己的一生要以“魔物的食物”收场的时候。
一位少女打破了放着枪盾的展示柜，拿起枪盾向魔物冲去。

劣质的赝品自然无法战胜魔物，但少女并没有退却，反而用绳子捆住自己，从二楼跳下来，给魔物来了一记“骑士飞踢”。
或许是这一脚踢得太准，或许是少女的勇气震慑住了魔物。魔物倒了下去，整场骚乱以只有一人受伤的代价结束了。

数月过去，康复出院的少女，将铠甲擦得锃光瓦亮，骑上心爱的踏板车，来到了老铁匠的住处。
推开古朴的大门，她看到了老铁匠的封炉之作——外形有布拉坦曼特的武器风格，实际上又截然不同的枪和盾。

“拿着，这是为你打造的装备，只有你，才有资格继承这传说中的样式。这不是布拉坦曼特的武器，而是你的武器，为它赋予新的名字吧。”
“谢谢！那……就叫自由和荣耀吧，简单，但不普通！”

缇莉娅接过枪盾， 走出工坊，将它高高举过头顶。
诺瓦新的骑士传奇，就此开幕。

CharacterArchiveContent.10801.2.en:
Name: Kasimira
Birthday: October 8th
Affiliation: White Cat Troupe
Skills: Firearm modification, close-quarters combat, origami
Address: Leave a message on the flagpole at the southern entrance of Mirage. I'll find you.
Experience: Extensive
Weapon: Catnip-1886
Rate: 12,000 Dorra per hour
CharacterArchiveContent.10801.2.cn:
姓名：卡西米拉
生日：10月8日
所属：白猫剧团
技能：枪械改装、近身格斗、折纸
地址：在米拉什南部入口的旗杆上留下信息，我能找到你
经验：丰富
武器：猫薄荷-1886
薪资：每小时一万两千朵拉

CharacterArchiveContent.10802.2.en:
I will hunt down the traitors and have them answer for my fallen comrades.
—The handwriting is sharp, bold, and handsome.
CharacterArchiveContent.10802.2.cn:
我会找到当年的背叛者，给死去的同伴一个交代。
——棱角分明、大气瑰丽的字迹。

CharacterArchiveContent.10803.2.en:
Rules of White Cat Troupe's Third Squad

1. Every squad member has the right to participate in major internal decisions and vote on them. Majority rules. In the event of a tie, the captain's vote counts as two.
2. Every squad member has the equal right to the spoils. Stealing from comrades or concealing loot is deemed as acts of betrayal.
3. The individual who contributes the most during a mission will be rewarded with one day of exclusive access to the game room.
4. White Cat members are prohibited from gambling. First-time offenders will be given an internal warning and will need to submit a statement of reflection. Repeat offenders will be expelled from the squad.
CharacterArchiveContent.10803.2.cn:
白猫剧团第三小队队规

其一，每名队员都有权参与队内重大事务的决策，投票表决，少数服从多数。如遇平票，队长视为两票。
其二，每名队员都有平等得到战利品的权利。偷窃同伴财物，隐瞒战利品的行为视为背叛。
其三，每次任务中做出最大贡献的人，奖励游戏房一日使用权。
其四，白猫成员禁止赌博，初犯给予队内警告并写检讨，再犯逐出小队。

CharacterArchiveContent.10804.2.en:
Services Provided

The White Cat Troupe provides services including mission escort, security, hostage rescue, wild monster extermination, and special Monolith investigations.
We take commission that range from half a day to three months, with fees ranging from 8,000 to hundreds of thousands of Dorra. For details, please consult the troupe's office.
The White Cat Troupe is dedicated to providing you with the highest level of service!
CharacterArchiveContent.10804.2.cn:
业务说明

白猫剧团可承揽护卫、安保、解救人质、野外魔物清缴、特别星塔调查等业务。
委托时长从半天到三月不等，委托金额从八千到几十万朵拉不等，详情请咨询剧团办事处。
白猫剧团竭诚为您服务。

CharacterArchiveContent.10805.2.en:
Off-Time Personal Interests

If you need to find me in a hurry, you can go to the bookstore in Mirage and try asking its owner.
Contact? No. It's just that I often buy fashion magazines there. The owner there knows me as a regular customer. If you're lucky and find me there in person, I can even give you a fortune reading for the day.
Tearing up magazines? No way. Well, in a way, I guess. We don't keep a lot of worldly possessions. It's pointless for me to have piles of old magazines around. So I use them to do origami to amuse everyone in between commissions. Would you like one?
—From a certain audio recording.
CharacterArchiveContent.10805.2.cn:
消遣与个人兴趣

如果你有急事需要找我，可以去米拉什的书店问问老板我的去向。
没什么，只是经常在那里买时尚杂志月刊，买的次数多了，跟老板混熟了而已。如果你运气好，直接在那找到我了，我还可以给你做做当日运势占卜。
撕杂志？没有的事。不，非要这么说也不算错吧。我们不会带太多的身外之物，收集厚厚一沓旧杂志对我来说没有意义。那还不如在任务间隙无聊的时候，折成折纸让大家开心。你要一件吗？
——来自某次对话的录音记录。

CharacterArchiveContent.10806.2.en:
The School of Close-Quarters Combat Techniques

We have noticed that Kasimira's close-quarters combat techniques seem to show traces of Loong martial arts influence.
However, according to herself, she has never crossed path with the Loong—at least, that's what she believes.
She says that she learned her close-quarters combat techniques from the former leader of the White Cat Troupe.
I speculate that, if we trace back far enough, there might be a link between the White Cat Troupe and a Loong. But as to the specifics, we remain in the dark.
—Willow
CharacterArchiveContent.10806.2.cn:
近身格斗术的师承渊源

我们注意到，卡西米拉的近身格斗术里，似乎有一些龙裔武术的影子。
但询问过本人后，发现卡西米拉的过往履历中，并未和龙裔有直接的交集，至少本人是这样认为的。
据其口述，她的近身格斗术师承于白猫剧团的前任团长。
我猜测，也许往上追溯，白猫过往的历史里也许和某位龙裔有所关联。但具体为何，就不得而知了。
——薇洛

CharacterArchiveContent.10807.2.en:
The Spare Controller

Everyone in the Third Squad loves playing games! Cool, right? Jealous, aren't you? Hah—
Wait, what? It's an open secret? Ugh, that's no fun.
Of course, Kasimira plays, too. She plays far less than Lanzia-chan and I do. She's always going on about how, as the captain, she must lead by example and not indulge too much. Ugh, it's so annoying. When we all play together, she really enjoys it, too. So why the pretense?
There's a secret I want to tell you—Kasimira has a spare controller that's gathering dust. It's in perfect working condition and looks great, but she will not use it. Every time I ask to borrow it, she turns me down. As far as I know, only Lanzia-chan has managed to ever borrow it, and it was just the once.
Ah, Boss, I have a thought—If you ask her for it, she might lend it to you. Why not give it a try?
—Chaton
CharacterArchiveContent.10807.2.cn:
落灰的手柄

我们第三小队的大家都喜欢打游戏！很酷吧！很羡慕吧！哼哼——
诶，什么，原来这是一个公开的秘密？可恶，没意思。
卡西米拉当然也打游戏，不过打得要比我和蓝锥锥少很多。说什么“身为队长要以身作则，不应该表现出放纵享乐的一面”，可恶，明明大家一起联机的时候打得很开心，装什么好领导嘛。
有个秘密我要告诉你——卡西米拉，她有一个落灰的手柄，明明功能啊外观啊看起来都是好的，就是不肯拿出来用。每次我跟她借，都被她拒绝了。在我的印象里，只有蓝锥锥借成功过，而且只成功过一次。
啊，只是我觉得，如果你去借的话，说不定能成功的样子。去试试嘛！
——猫眼

CharacterArchiveContent.10808.2.en:
Finally done!
I once made a vow that I would one day defeat Kasimira and become White Cat's paramount boss...and that day is today! It's my turn to assess her! gbuiweh;ofbaou;gdfo;acboa8wgdcwow Owowowowowow, my bad, Cap, don't smash my face into the keyboard!
—Chaton

In her professional capacity, Kasimira is a diligent and responsible captain. On the personal relationship front, she still owes me something. This is an entirely objective assessment.
—Lanzia
CharacterArchiveContent.10808.2.cn:
终于写完了！
曾经我发过誓，总有一天我要击败卡西米拉，成为白猫最强的王……不必等到有朝一日，已经轮到我来评价她了，那就是今天！gbuiweh;ofbaou;gdfo;acboa8wgdcwow呃呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜……我输了，别把我的脸按在键盘上。
——猫眼

于公而言，卡西米拉是个认真负责的队长；于私而言，她还有东西欠我。一码归一码，客观评价。
——蓝锥

CharacterArchiveContent.10809.2.en:
The White Cat Troupe is missing much of its records. In order to verify certain information, we visited a whole lot of places and interviewed a whole lot of people!
Now, the verdict is in:
EXTREMELY RELIABLE!<sprite name="acrchives_certified_richtext">
I can definitely verify Kasimira's resume, because everyone in the New Star Guild has received an origami creation from her!
—Noya
CharacterArchiveContent.10809.2.cn:
白猫剧团有很多资料丢失得厉害，为了查阅内容的真实性，我们可是跑了好多地方、问了好多人哦！
那么现在，宣布结果：
锵锵！真实度极高！<sprite name="acrchives_certified_richtext">
至少对我而言，卡西米拉的简历肯定是真实的。因为空白旅团的大家，都收到过卡西米拉的折纸！
——尘沙

CharacterArchiveContent.10810.2.en:
The game room inside the Monolith is an amazing place.
Those large arcade machines are not something that can be easily obtained through a single wish, even for trekkers. Only those who have the ability to survive in The Wilds and defeat the Stellaroid can enjoy themselves there.
Therefore, it's the ultimate hall of fame for gamers. Anyone who can manage to leave their name on the leaderboards there is among the best of the best.
I was lucky enough to hire a team of Trekkers to escort me there and leave my name on the leaderboard. However, my score was nothing compared to the record holder.
Also, the top score on most of the machines in that room belonged to the same name. That name must belong to the god who controls the Monolith's arcade machines.
—Statement by the president of the Gaming Club of Starlight Academy during an interview with Scarlet Sights Media
CharacterArchiveContent.10810.2.cn:
星塔里的游戏房间是个超棒的地方。
那些大型游戏机，旅人很难靠许愿得到，只有拥有在荒野中活下去的能力和击败星骸的实力，才能去那种房间里畅玩。
所以，那里是游戏玩家最高的殿堂，能在那里的游戏机的排行榜上留下名字的人，都是最厉害的游戏玩家。
我有幸花钱雇佣了一队旅人护送我，去里面留下过排名，只是，我的分数距离那里的头名还差很远。
还有，房间里大部分的游戏机的头名都是同一个名字，我认为，那个名字肯定是掌管星塔游戏机的神。
——星辉附属大学游戏部部长接受绯瞳采访时的发言

CharacterArchiveContent.10811.2.en:
Only the kids in the reserve force know that Kasimira is very skilled at origami.
Her members, who aren't as close with her, tend to describe this reserved squad captain as "repressed."
Even during the Troupe's social events, she is never to be found at the center of action, though one can always spot her standing somewhere not too far away, watching over everyone with a soft smile on her face.
But if you try to walk over and talk to her, she would quickly become flustered and tell you to go enjoy yourself.

"Kasimira... I think she really likes hearing all the gossip," said a Troupe member who was working as a makeup artist at the time. "Last time, Reiran and I were speculating if Nana was having yet another fight with her boyfriend. Captain happened to walk by us and, out of the blue, she said that this time they'd really called it quits. It was scary."
"All this time we thought she was the kind who didn't care about what went on around her, but she's been paying attention, hasn't she?"
"But for some reason, whenever we try to have a chat with her, she always finds an excuse to wiggle out of it. Kasi can be really sly when it comes to that."
"Oh, a cat needs to be 'released.' I gotta run. Let's continue this conversation another time."

The troupe is called "White Cat" for a reason, because we live alongside a great many cats. Despite a reputation as heartless creatures, after spending enough time with people, cats do learn who always brings them food and whose touch feels best.
Thus, if something happens and one of our member doesn't make it back, the first ones to be informed are their cats.
This process is called "release."
All White Cat Troupe members carry a special strap to communicate with their teammates during missions. If someone doesn't return, their teammates are responsible for recovering their weapon and strap, even if these items are no longer usable. Be it a piece of string or a scrap of cloth—they must be brought back.
Because the remnants can tell the living the name and identity of the deceased.

These recovered scraps and fragments are placed together, and the cats are brought nearby. Cats have a keen sense of smell and great intuition, thus they will pick up the strap carrying the scent familiar to their "cohabiters."
This tells everyone that someone who once shared a bond with that cat will never return.
Most of the time, even after confirming their human's death, the cats will return to their normal routines. But sometimes there are a few truly loyal ones who take the straps and run off. They will not return no matter how much they are called.
Maybe they've gone off to find the owner of that item. Who knows?

Can you imagine it? Someone who fed you just yesterday is now gone forever. You will never see them again.
Can you imagine it? Someone who was chatting and laughing with you just yesterday will never smile or joke again.

People instinctively avoid confronting the hard truths, as if pretending they never happened will make them disappear. Feigning ignorance is a valuable survival skill, and those who excel at it can avoid a lot of unnecessary pain.
But many people are not good at it, and Kasimira is one of them.
CharacterArchiveContent.10811.2.cn:
只有那些在预备役里的孩子们知道，卡西米拉很擅长折纸。
而不熟悉她的团员们对这个不苟言笑的小队长的评价是，含蓄。
就算剧团举行大型晚会，她也不会热络地参与其中。但你总能在不远不近的地方看见她站在那里，眉眼弯弯地望着大家。
可若你当真上去搭话了，她又会一下子手足无措起来，叫你去玩自己的就好。

“卡西米拉…… 我觉得她可喜欢听八卦了。”那时在剧团担任化妆师的某位后勤说，“上次我和铃兰猜小娜是不是又和男朋友吵架了，卡西路过的时候突然说，这回是直接分手了，吓了我们一跳。”
“我们本来以为她是不太关心别人事的那种人，这不是好好地把目光放在大家身上吗？”
“但不知道为什么，每次想找她闲聊，都会被她找理由逃掉。唯有在这种方面，卡西总是特别狡猾呢。”
“啊，有猫儿要被放生了，我不能再闲聊了。下回有时间再继续吧。”

之所以剧团名为“白猫”，就是因为她们真的和很多很多猫朝夕相伴。纵然许多人说猫都是没良心的生物，可与人相处久了，谁常给自己带罐头，谁摸自己摸得很舒服，它们还是知道一二的。
因此，如果有谁出事了，再也回不来了，大家首先要将讣告，知会给猫主子。
这个过程被大家称为“放生”。
白猫的成员，每个人都会携带一条特殊的系带，用其在任务中与队友沟通。如果一个人回不来了，她的队友便有义务回收武器和系带。哪怕这些东西再也无法使用，仅仅是一根弦，一块碎布，她们也得把它带回来。
因为只有这些东西，能让活着的人知道，殁亡者姓甚名谁。

这些破铜烂铁会被放在一处，然后人们会把猫儿们带到附近。猫的嗅觉很灵敏，又是有灵性的生物，只要这样做，它们就会跑到有熟悉味道的系带旁，叼起它们——
然后大家就会知道，某个曾与这只猫关系很好的家伙，再也回不来了。
大多数时候，即使确认了自己的某位饲主已经死亡，猫儿们还是会乖乖跑回来继续原先的生活。但总有一些重情重义的家伙，叼了系带就跑，怎么喊都喊不回。
许是它们去找这件物品的主人了，谁知道呢？

那么你能想象吗，昨天还在给自己投喂食物的家伙，今天就再也回不来，也再也见不到了。
那么你能想象吗，昨天还在和自己谈天说地的家伙，今天就再也不会笑，也再也不会闹了。

人们总是会下意识地回避自己无法接受的事实，好像如此做的话就可以当它从来没有发生过。装傻是一项优秀的生存技能，擅长它的人总是能避开生命里大多数不必要的痛苦。
但无疑很多人都不善于此。而卡西米拉也是其中之一。

CharacterArchiveContent.10812.2.en:
The children discovered Kasimira's secret after one of the release ceremonies.
Although the reserve kids are allowed to feed the Troupe's cats, they remain barred from attending the release ceremonies. This doesn't bother them, though, because around these irregularly held ceremonies, the adults cannot spare them the attention or the time.
This represents a rare chance for them to run wild and play freely.
Once, when they had planned to go on an adventure by the stream near the Troupe's base, they found Kasimira sitting by the water. She folded colorful square-shaped papers into beautiful little boats with just a few creases.
"If we share some of our candy with you, can we have one of your little boats?"
"You caught me at a bad time. I didn't bring extra paper with me. These boats are for my friends. Ask me next time."

Friends? Just where are her friends?
The children looked around but didn't see anyone else. Still, they accepted her explanation.
"Then next time, we'll come ask you for one! Promise?"

Kasimira simply smiled.
She placed the little boats into the water, watching as they floated away.
One, two, three, four, five.
It just so happened that five troupe members hadn't returned this time.

Kasimira is a woman of her word. The following afternoon, she brought a stack of paper to the kids. But this time, instead of folding boats, she made paper cranes.
"We don't want Paper cranes. Paper boats can float on water, but paper cranes can't fly!"
"How about this then?"
With a few deft movements, the paper transformed into a delicate paper airplane in her hands.
"What's this?"
"According to the Monolith's promotional flyer, an 'autonomous aerodynamic model.' But we usually just call it a paper airplane."
Kasimira blew gently on the paper airplane's tip and threw it. It wobbled into the air.
"Paper airplanes can fly! Paper airplanes are great!"
Each kid received a paper airplane and ran off with the loot. That afternoon, colorful paper airplanes soared under the bright blue sky by the stream.
But there was a clumsy one who threw her paper airplane into the river by mistake. She asked Kasimira for a replacement:
"Kasi, look, when a paper airplane falls into the river, it floats on the water, too.
So it's like, in that moment, it also became a paper boat."

"It's not the same thing," said Kasimira. "A paper boat is a paper boat. A paper airplane is a paper airplane. How can you mix them up?"
"Then what's the difference between them? Kasi, tell me!"
"A paper boat can only drift with the current to a place it doesn't know. Eventually it will sink at an unknown place, never to be remembered again.
The journeys of the living and the dead are fundamentally different. The journey of the dead ends in remembrance, closure, and eventually becoming forgotten.
Whereas paper airplanes—and really, you girls—are meant to soar.

Not to sink slowly into murky waters, but to soar far and high into the vast and clear blue sky."
"In that case, Kasi, can you fold us birds or butterflies? Those are things that can fly, too!"
This was the only thing Kasimira, as a Watcher, could do for them.
"Sure can. Promise me that you will fly far away, just like them."

"I need to do something," As she gazed at the brilliant sunset reflected in the water, her hands still folding the papers, Kasimira thought to herself.
"I'll talk to the other captains again and keep those reserve kids from going on missions just a bit longer."
CharacterArchiveContent.10812.2.cn:
孩子们发现卡西米拉的秘密就是在一次放生仪式后。
预备役的孩子虽然可以正常喂养剧团里的猫，却被禁止出席放生仪式。然而几乎没有孩子对此有什么怨言：在这不定期举行的放生仪式前后，几乎没有大人会来管她们。
这是她们为数不多，可以撒丫子疯玩的时候。
然后某一回，就在她们约好了要去剧团驻扎地附近的小河边冒险时，发现了坐在岸边的卡西米拉。彩色的方形纸在她手中对折几次，变成一艘艘美丽的纸船。
“姐姐，我们把糖分你几颗，可以给我们一艘你的小船吗？”
“你们来得不巧，我没有准备多的纸。这些船我要送给朋友，下一次吧。”

朋友？哪里有朋友？
小孩子左顾右盼一圈，没有发现除了卡西米拉外的任何人。但她们还是接受了这个说法。
“那下次有机会再来问你要吧！一言为定喔！”

卡西米拉只是微笑。
她将手中小船放进河里，目送着它们顺着水流，慢慢远去。
一艘、两艘、三艘、四艘、五艘。
恰好，这次没能回来的，也是五人。

卡西米拉是个守信用的人。第二天下午，她就带了一叠纸去找孩子们。然而这一回，纸却没有折成小舟，而是变成了一只只纸鹤。
“纸鹤不好。纸船可以漂在水上，可纸鹤却不会飞啊！”
“那这个怎样呢？”
手指移动，折纸翻转，一只精巧的纸飞机出现在她掌间。
“这是？”
“星塔里的宣传页称其为‘自主动力空气动力学物理模型’，我们呢，一般叫它：纸飞机。”
卡西米拉向纸飞机顶端呵了一口气，掷向远方，纸飞机便晃晃悠悠地向天空飞去。
“纸飞机可以飞，纸飞机好！”
孩子们人手一个纸飞机，抓着它跑远了。这一天下午的小河旁，有许多颜色不同的纸飞机翱翔在碧蓝的天际下。
然而也有冒失的家伙，不小心将纸飞机掷进了河里。她和卡西米拉讨要新的飞机时说：
“姐姐你看，纸飞机落在河里时，也会漂在水面上。”
“那我是不是可以说，这时候，它也变成了一艘纸船？”

“不一样。”卡西米拉说，“纸船是纸船，纸飞机是纸飞机，二者怎么能混为一谈呢？”
“哪里不一样？姐姐你说说看？”
“纸船只能随着水流漂到它也不知道的某个地方去，最后在不知什么地方沉没，再也不会有人想起。”
生者和死者的远行从来不同。死者远行的尽头是缅怀，是放下，是遗忘。
“纸飞机，不，你们是该飞行的。”

不是落在浑浊的水中慢慢沉没，而是高高的、飞向湛蓝广阔的天空。
“那样的话，姐姐给我们折小鸟、蝴蝶好不好？那些都是会飞的东西！”
这是作为一名“守望者”，卡西米拉唯一能为他们做的事。
“好呀。你们也要像它们一样，向远方飞去，好吗？”

“再努力一下吧。”望着映照灿烂夕阳的河面，卡西米拉一边折纸，一边想道。
“再去和其他几位队长谈谈，延迟预备役正式参与任务的事吧。”

CharacterArchiveContent.10813.2.en:
This happened...
back when Kasimira had just become an official member of White Cat Troupe.
People are prone to being forgetful. From misplacing important documents somewhere to leaving heavy weaponry in a random room inside the Monolith, these mistakes can happen with one simple slip-up.
The most absurd thing Kasimira had ever done was leaving her shotgun outside a magazine shop.

"Very Lucky." That's what the newspaper's daily fortune draw read. Surely something good was bound to happen today!
Thus did Kasimira make the mistake of equating "Very Lucky" with "today is a good day to take on a mission inside the Monolith." Until she reached the base of the Monolith, patted her waist, and realized "Wait a second—where's my shotgun?"
This is bad, this is so, so bad. Not only had she lost the tool of her trade, even more importantly, the shotgun—specially modified by the White Cat Troupe—was more important than her life itself! When veterans retired, their weapons were passed down to the new generation. These weapons carried the knowledge, memories, and skills of their previous owners. Any warrior who aspired to leave their mark treated their weapon with utmost care, hoping it would become part of their legacy, passed down forever.
"You're the most promising rookie of your class, so I'm entrusting my shotgun to you. It's called Catnip-1886. Remember its name and treat it well."
Although all the Troupe's weapons were named after cat-related things, Kasimira couldn't figure out why this particular shotgun was called Catnip.
But since her predecessor had made a point of this, the name remained.

And now, barely one week into her career as a warrior, the "most promising rookie" had no idea where she'd left her shotgun. What a disaster!
After thinking over where she might have left it, Kasimira came to an even more terrible realization:
The park, the shopping street, the magazine shop, the snack stall—all of them swarming with civilians.
Just when she thought things couldn't get any worse!
What if some clueless civilian innocently picked it up?

There was nothing for it. She had to retrace her steps from that morning and search for the weapon.
While nobody in Mirage would bother to report the White Cat Troupe's weapons as illegal items, inside this chaotic desert city, once something got lost, it stayed that way until you "buy it back."
Kasimira had already prepared for the worst scenario: If she couldn't recover the weapon, she would have to borrow a lot of money from her colleagues, get an advance for several months' worth of pay, and get a new shotgun made.

She hit the jackpot at the second place she visited.

"A strange-looking staff? Yeah, I saw it. I didn't put it away, it's on the bench outside."
On the bench outside? Kasimira replayed the scene outside in her mind. There were a lot of cats playing with each other near the door.
"Oh... I know what happened. Come with me."
Kasimira followed the owner outside and watched as he dug into the pile of cats, eventually pulling out a shotgun.
"You know how it is. Cats love playing with things they've never seen before. You left staff here, and for some reason, all the stray cats in the area came running. They really have a thing for it."

What's going on? Kasimira sat down inside the shop and disassembled the shotgun that was still new to her. She discovered that its magazine was loaded with not bullets but a bundle of slightly withered catnip leaves.
Ah, so that's why it's called "Catnip." Turns out it had this little trick mechanism.
It's impossible to know whether this was her predecessor's own preference or some sort of prank. As she sat on the bench, cats climbed all over her in search of the scent. Kasimira didn't know whether to laugh or cry.
A Very Lucky day, indeed.
CharacterArchiveContent.10813.2.cn:
那是——
卡西米拉刚刚成为白猫剧团正式队员时发生的事。
众所周知，人们丢三落四是不需要理由的。小到把重要证件顺手搁到了不知什么地方，大到将重型武器遗漏在星塔的某个房间里，只要人的注意力不是时刻保持在完美状态，总是没法避免这样的事。
卡西米拉做过最离谱的事，是将她的霰弹枪，落在了杂志店门口。

“大吉”因为杂志上的每日抽签运势是这么说的，所以今天肯定会有好事发生吧！
这样思考的卡西米拉，错误地将“大吉”和“今天适合在星塔里执行任务”画上了等号。直到来到星塔底下，某个倒霉蛋往腰上一摸，才意识到：等下，不对，我霰弹枪去哪儿了？
不得了，不得了，这可完蛋。往轻了说，这是吃饭的家伙不见了；往重了说，白猫剧团特别改制的枪械，可是比她们的命都重要啊！老一辈的战士离去，武器交给新一届的小朋友们，枪械上凝聚的，是她们的知识、记忆、技巧。但凡有志于在传说里留下属于自己浓墨重彩一笔的白猫战士，都会善待自己的武器，以期让武器成为自己传说的一部分，随着继承永远地让它流传下去。
“你是这一批队员里，我认为最有希望的新兵。我的霰弹枪就交给你了，猫薄荷-1886，要记住它的名字，好好对待它啊。”
虽然剧团里所有人的武器皆以和“猫”有关的事物命名，但为什么这把枪会叫猫薄荷，卡西米拉想不明白。
不过，既然决定隐退的大前辈如此叮嘱了，她也理当将这个名字继承下去。

然后，自己身为最被重视的新兵，第一周就不知道把枪丢在哪里了，真是活见鬼。
卡西米拉思考了一下可能遗落的地点，发现了一个更加糟糕的事实：
公园、商业街、杂志店、小吃摊，反正不在剧团这种只有“自己人”或是星塔这种只有“业内人”会出现的地方。
……这不是更完了吗！
万一被无知的路人捡走了怎么办啊！

还能怎么办，沿着早上过来的一路，找呗。
虽然，米拉什无人去检举白猫的武器是“非法造物”，但在鱼龙混杂的沙漠之城，拾金必昧还是很普遍的事情。
卡西米拉已经做好了最坏的打算：万一哪里都找不到它，她就只好去问同僚借一大笔钱，预支上自己几个月的收入，重新去做一杆新的。

幸好，刚刚跑到第二个地方——杂志店，卡西米拉就发现了武器的线索。

“一柄构造奇怪的法杖？在的在的。……我没收起来，就在门口的椅子上放着。”
门口的椅子上？卡西米拉回想自己进门时的情形，明明只有三四只猫围在门口打闹呀？
“喔……我知道怎么回事了。你跟我来。”
卡西米拉跟着老板走出去，看见老板在猫儿堆里掏了半天，摸出她的霰弹枪来。
“你知道的嘛，猫都喜欢玩没见过的新东西。你这根法杖落我这里，不知道为什么附近的流浪猫都跑来了，看来颇得它们欢心啊。”

怎么回事呢？她问老板借了个地方，拆卸起这把尚未随她一同上过战场的霰弹枪，结果发现本应装着子弹的弹夹处，塞了一打略微干瘪的猫薄荷叶。
原来如此，怪不得它叫“猫薄荷”，原来设置了这样的机巧啊。
究竟是前辈的恶趣味还是玩笑如今已经不得而知了。哭笑不得的卡西米拉坐在椅子上，身上爬满了循着味道过来的猫咪们。
今天，果然是“大吉”啊。

CharacterArchiveContent.11011.2.en:
"Can I skip wearing this corset? It's squeezing me so hard I'm about to throw up."
"Better not. Your violin teacher scolded you just yesterday."
"Can I ditch her class too? Do I really have to go?"
"Seriously, Firenze. Do you want that course certificate or not?"

Learning aristocratic etiquette was a popular trend in the Gold District.
Firenze didn't know when exactly this trend had begun, only that it had been en vogue for many years now.
In Nova, nobility titles were just for self-aggrandizement.
All the geezers in the United Harvest Senate called themselves nobles, each trying to trace their family trees back hundreds of years—
Even when they had been nothing more than street vendors before they got into the Senate.
Firenze didn't know whether her own family fell into that category, but if she wanted to move around in the Senate's social circle, these manners were something she had to learn.
The shared consensus of a group of pretentious jerks was still a consensus.

At first, Firenze didn't think this would be any trouble at all. The phrase "I can't" simply did not exist in her vocabulary.
Then she was harshly reprimanded.
"There is no aristocratic bearing in your playing! I will not let you pass my course!"
What aristocratic bearing actually was, Firenze had no idea.
If it came to emotion in performance, she certainly had it; as she played, she followed the music and recalled memories of running through the garden in her childhood.
But this kind of feeling was clearly not what the teacher wanted.

Perhaps considering the enormous tuition fee her family paid, the violin teacher softened her tone.
"As a child of the nobility with a distinguished name, you were simply born different from those commonplace girls of the Ash District. Your value far exceeds theirs.
So you must show correct bearing and let others know your exact value through the music."

Value... Firenze let out a sigh.
She understood how commodities were valued, but did people have price stickers, too?
For parents, how should a child be priced?
How should lovebirds price their other half?
For a ruler, what price is their underlings?
Or rather, how should she put a price on other people?

From the dark, dilapidated Ash District to the resplendent Gold District, Firenze had walked through them all.
From toddlers, youths, young adults, and the elderly to students, clerks, Trekkers, and managers, Firenze had seen them all.
Different individuals held different understandings of "price," and most people won't even think of calculating the price of human life.
Perhaps this was the difference between nobles and commoners?

Firenze came to the realization:
So-called aristocratic bearing meant treating everything in the world, including oneself, as a commodity, as goods that could be sold at any time.
The world of nobles was woven from threads of interest and profit.
The amount of the price did not matter; what mattered was that everything had a price tag.
There was no loyalty that could not be bought, only prices one could not afford.

By folding such feelings into her performance, she would meet the teacher's requirements, and she herself would become a noble.
Thinking this, Firenze picked up her bow.
CharacterArchiveContent.11011.2.cn:
“我可以不穿这件束腰吗？勒得我快吐了。”
“还是不要吧。小提琴老师昨天才骂过你。”
“她的课我能不能翘了啊，非上不可吗？”
“清醒点翡冷翠，你还想不想拿到贵族课程的结业书了？”

学习贵族礼仪，是金城区流行的风尚。
翡冷翠不知道这个风尚是什么时候开始流行的，只知道流行了很多年。
在诺瓦，贵族只是一个用来锦上添花的名号。
联合种业元老院里的那些家伙都自称贵族，还一个个地把自己的家谱追溯了几百年——
就算他们进元老院之前，只是在街边卖货的一个小商贩。
翡冷翠不知道自己家是不是这种情况，但只要想混元老院那个圈子，这些礼仪就必须学。
一帮附庸风雅的人的共识，也是共识。

一开始，翡冷翠并不觉得这有什么麻烦的。她的字典里不存在“做不到”这三个字。
然后，她就被狠狠地骂了。
“你的琴声里没有贵族气质！我是不会给你通过的！”
贵族气质是什么，翡冷翠并不知道。
如果说演奏时的感情，翡冷翠是有的，她配合着那首曲子，回忆起自己小时候在花园里奔跑的时光。
但是，这种感情显然不被老师认可。

或许是考虑到翡冷翠家里缴纳的巨额学费，小提琴老师放缓了语气。
 “你作为有着高贵姓氏的贵族子弟，从小就和那些灰城区的野丫头是不一样的。你的价值，要远远高于那些人。
所以，拿出你的气质来，你应该在曲子中体现出你的价格。”

价格......翡冷翠叹了口气。
她知道商品的价格，人也有价格吗？
对于父母来说，孩子要怎么定价？
对于恋人来说，另一半要怎么定价？
对于君主来说，部下要怎么定价？
或者说，对于自己来说，其他人要怎么定价？

从阴暗破败的灰城区到金碧辉煌的金城区，翡冷翠都走过。
从幼童、少年、青年、老者到学生、职员、旅人、老板，翡冷翠都见过。
不同的个体对“价格”有着不同的理解，其中大部分人，并不会去算人类的价格。
或许，这就是贵族和平民的区别？

翡冷翠明白了。
所谓的贵族气质，就是把包括自己在内的万事万物，当做一件商品，当做随时可以售出的货物。
贵族的世界，是由利益的丝线编织而成的。
定价多少并不重要，重要的是一切皆有价码。
没有买不到的忠诚，只有付不起的定价。

把这种情感融入到演奏中去，就能符合老师的要求了吧，自己就能成为一个贵族了吧。
翡冷翠这样想着，拿起了琴弓。

CharacterArchiveContent.11012.2.en:
The performance at the noble etiquette curriculum graduation ceremony was the only time Firenze ever messed up. But it was also her favorite performance.
Before that, Firenze, already fluent in "aristocratic bearing," had long won her teacher over.
Her icy gaze and decisive tones swept past the teacher like an actuary running calculations.
Although the final price was not entirely satisfactory, the teacher was ecstatic simply to be "priced" by a noble.
Next, as long as Firenze could earn the approval of company elders at the graduation ceremony, the teacher's price would naturally rise as well.
What the teacher failed to notice was that from that day on, Firenze never picked up the violin again.

On stage during the graduation ceremony, Firenze was not wearing the required formal dress or corset, nor was she holding a violin.
Dressed in a trench coat, she casually rested a cane across her shoulder, then lifted the bow in the posture of a performance.
"Firenze, what are you doing? Where is your violin?"
Her violin teacher's face twisted as she hissed low.
Firenze smiled faintly. She set the bow lightly against the cane, and began her performance.

"Mr. Obicci, the mercenaries you asked for have been arranged. One hundred seasoned veterans will arrive tomorrow."
"Didn't expect you to be so efficient. This favor won't be easy to repay. You're ... a Feltro?"
"I'm still continuing with my noble etiquette curriculum. I heard you'll also be attending the graduation ceremony?"
"Hah! I get it. The tedious violin performance they ask for, right? Don't worry. Even if you saw wood on stage, I'll still give you high marks."

"I got your photos back from those Scarlet Sights Witches. Be more careful next time, dear Giovanni."
"Thank you so much. If photos of me dining with employees of the Grace Imperium had leaked, it would have been a real catastrophe."
"Then, the graduation ceremony?"
"Of course, of course. My wife is on the judging panel. I'll speak to her."

"Firenze, you finally made it. What did Deepsea Finance say? If that loan can't be secured..."
"I negotiated the interest down by half. The manager over there also needed to meet their lending quota."
"I... I don't even know how to thank you. You really are a lifesaver."
"No thanks necessary, Lady Virginia. Just doing my duty. Please remember to attend my graduation ceremony."

Skill in performance is honed in everyday practice.
The same is true for putting a price tag on others.
The ceremony hall was silent. A bow and a cane could not possibly produce elegant music.
Yet the judges put on an air of focus, as though they were mesmerized by a beautiful melody.
Firenze bowed gracefully. The judges responded with enthusiastic applause, and even the audience joined in clapping.
To those who did not understand what was happening, Firenze had probably staged some kind of avant-garde mime.
She was so elegant, and the noble judges were surely professionals; if one heard nothing, it must simply be a lack of appreciation.
Above all, everything nobles did was right. After today, cane sales in Philae City would probably be way up for a while.

Firenze's teacher handed her the certificate of attendance. She casually slipped it into her pocket and walked out of the hall.
In her own way, she had completed her own valuing process. She had determined the price of everyone present, yet no one could see through her own.
Firenze did not dislike the way this circle played its game, hypocritical as it may be.
Because no matter what the rules were, she would always master them and emerge victorious.
CharacterArchiveContent.11012.2.cn:
贵族课程毕业典礼上的演奏，是翡冷翠唯一一次失败的演奏，也是她最喜欢的演奏。
在那之前，通晓“贵族气质”的翡冷翠早已征服了老师。
她那冷冽的目光，干脆的琴音，像是精算师一样刮过那位老师的长发、眼镜和裙摆。
虽然，最后的算出来的价格并不尽如人意，但老师却为自己能被一个贵族“定价”而欣喜若狂。
接下来，只要翡冷翠能在毕业典礼上得到各家公司元老的认可，那么自己这个老师的价格，自然也会水涨船高。
不过，老师没发现的是，从那天开始，翡冷翠就再也没有拿起过小提琴。

毕业典礼的舞台上，翡冷翠没有穿着规定的礼服和束腰，手里拿着的也不是小提琴。
一身风衣的她，用潇洒的动作把手杖架在肩膀上，然后照着演奏的姿势提起了琴弓。
“翡冷翠你在做什么，你的琴呢？”
翡冷翠的小提琴老师扭曲了面容，压低声音嘶吼着。
翡冷翠轻轻一笑，把琴弓虚架在手杖上，开始了她的表演。

“奥比奇先生，您需要的佣兵我已经安排好了，一百名战斗经验丰富的老兵明天就到。”
“想不到你做事这么利索，这个人情可不好还，你是......费尔特罗家族的？”
“我还在进行贵族课程的进修，听说您也会参加毕业典礼？”
“哈哈，我明白了，无聊的小提琴演奏是吧。放心，就算你在舞台上锯木头，我也会给你高分的。”

“你的照片我帮你从绯瞳手里追回来了，下次小心点，亲爱的乔万尼。”
“实在是太感谢了，我和恩赐意志的员工在一起吃饭的照片要是流出去，我死十次都不够。”
“那，毕业典礼？”
“明白，明白，我的妻子是评委，我会和她说的。”

“翡冷翠，你终于来了，渊海星融怎么说？如果贷不到那笔钱......”
“利息帮你谈了五折，正好那边的经理也要完成放贷的任务。”
“我......我不知道要如何感谢你，这实在是救了我的命。”
“无需感谢，薇吉妮亚夫人，这是我应该做的，请记得参加我的毕业典礼”

演奏的功夫需要下在平时。
定价的功夫也是一样。
毕业典礼的礼堂里寂静无声，琴弓和手杖自然无法演奏出优雅的音乐。
但是，评委席上的评委却认真专注，似乎陶醉在一曲美妙的音乐里。
翡冷翠优雅地鞠躬，评委报以热切的掌声，就连观众席上的观众们也跟着鼓起掌来。
在不明就里的人看来，翡冷翠上演的大概是一种新潮的哑剧吧。
她那么优雅，评委席上的贵族评委那么专业，自己没听到声音，只是自己不会欣赏。
贵族做的一切都是对的，相信今天之后，菲莱城的手杖应该会好卖一阵子了。

翡冷翠随意地把老师递过来的结业证明装进口袋里，走出了毕业典礼的大厅。
她用自己的方式，完成了自己的“定价”——她厘定了现场所有人的价格，却无人能看透她的价格。
虽然虚伪，但翡冷翠并不讨厌这个圈子的玩法。
因为，不管是什么规则，胜利者只会是她。

CharacterArchiveContent.11013.2.en:
Generally speaking, every young noble equips themselves with a weapon of refined elegance.
It serves as a symbol of status and position. All it needs is tasteful design and dazzling appearance; it does not need to be put into practice.
After all, in this day and age, there are tons of mercenaries who do dirty work for hire and packs of Trekkers who live rough on the road in need of commission fees. Why would a well-dressed, wealthy person still fight with weapons?
Dorra can buy you anything. When fighting is required, all it takes is money.

And yet, from a young age, Firenze dreamed of owning a sharp weapon.
Look at the Trekkers who wander between cities, the knights who move through streets and alleys. They all have their own weapons and, therefore, are masters of their own fate.
But Firenze never managed to find a weapon completely to her liking.
A dagger? She disliked sneaking around and assassinations.
A whip? She didn't care for weapons that could not subdue an enemy in a single decisive strike.
A cleaver? Too conspicuous, and far too heavy.
It was only much, much later that she found a cane at a secondhand market, perfectly balanced in length and weight.
"If you take a piece of wood like that home, won't your parents scold you?" Nyx asked. She had come along with Firenze.
"They won't," Firenze replied. "They'll just think I have good taste, and that I've finally reached the age where I know how to choose luxury goods."
Smiling, Firenze pulled off the head of the cane. Just as she expected, the blade concealed within was hard and razor-sharp, gleaming with an immaculate, flawless light.
She liked this weapon, liked the threat and killing intent hidden beneath its beautiful exterior.
She thought that perhaps she should use this sword to cut through things far more unyielding. Such as tradition, order, and rules.
Only when the moon goes dark can the stars burst forth with dazzling brilliance.
And she was like that star, waiting for the uncertain moment when it would finally be drawn from its sheath.
"I shall name this sword ... Starlight."
CharacterArchiveContent.11013.2.cn:
一般而言，每个贵族子弟，都会为自己配备一把雍容华贵的武器。
那是他们身份与地位的象征，只需品味高雅、光彩夺目，却不需要开锋伤人。
你想呀，这都什么年代了，除了替人执行一些脏活的雇佣兵，风餐露宿颠沛流离的旅人，哪还有衣着体面的富贵之人用武器来战斗的？
朵拉可以买到一切，需要战斗的时候，只要付钱就好了。

然而，翡冷翠从小就梦想着有一把锐利的武器。
你看，游荡于城市间的旅人，穿行在街巷里的骑士，他们都有自己的武器，他们的命运至少握在自己手里。
只不过，翡冷翠在市场上一直都没选到自己心仪的武器。
匕首？翡冷翠不喜欢偷偷摸摸的刺杀。
鞭子？翡冷翠不喜欢无法一击就把敌人制住的武器。
砍刀？这又太过显眼了，并且很沉。
直到很久很久之后，她才在旧货市场找到了一根长短轻重都合适的手杖。
“带这样的东西回去，伯父伯母不会斥责你吗？”一同前往的星雁问道。
“不会。”翡冷翠道，“他们只会觉得我带回来的手杖很有品位，我也终于到会挑奢侈品的年纪了。”
翡冷翠笑着拔开杖头，不出她所料，藏匿其中的锋刃坚硬而锐利，闪烁着绝无杂质的光芒。
她喜欢这把武器，喜欢包藏在美丽的外表下的威胁和杀意。
她想，她或许应该用这把剑斩断一些更坚硬的东西。比如......传统、秩序和法则。
只有月亮熄灭的时候，星星才能迸发出耀眼的光辉。
而她就像是那颗星星，等待着不知何时会来的，出鞘的机会。
“这把剑的名字……就叫“星芒”吧。”

CharacterArchiveContent.11111.2.en:
"Given a circle and its circumscribed square, both rotated around their common axis of symmetry, they form a cylinder containing a sphere. Prove that the sphere's volume is two-thirds of the cylinder's volume. Verify the relationship between the lateral surface area of the cylinder and the surface area of the sphere..."

The question wasn't all that difficult.
After reading it once, Iris already figured out what she needed to do and quickly started writing.
All was quiet inside the Lucky Oasis. Besides the occasional rustling of pages and the scratching of pen on paper, the rhythmic ticking of the clock was the only sound she could hear.
Iris liked it. It stood for precision, for rules, for something that would never disappoint.
An hour was sixty minutes, and sixty it would always remain.

That's why Iris also liked doing exam questions.
Every question had a definite answer. In other words, answering them always brought results.
If she got it right, the moment she saw the correct answer was a reward in itself.
If she got it wrong, the moment she learned something new was also a reward.
As long as one put in the effort, one could gain something in return. Could there be anything better or more equitable than that?

"Use vector methods to prove that if the diagonals of a quadrilateral bisect each other, then the quadrilateral is a parallelogram."

The next question was a bit harder.
Iris would take photos of books whenever she came across bookstores inside the Monoliths out of habit.
Of course, one may take nothing out from a Monolith—except for the Artifacts from the Wishing Box.
But the Trekkers' memories are not bound by such restrictions.
Naturally, these randomly collected questions differed wildly in difficulty.
Iris preferred complex questions to simple ones. To her, the process of racking her brain and finally emerging victorious gave her the kind of satisfaction that could not be put into words.

"An empty water tank takes eight hours to fill and ten hours to drain when full. If the tank is simultaneously being filled and drained, how many hours will it take to fill it?"

Of course, Iris didn't mind beginner-level questions like this one, either.
Noya found this one to be a head-scratcher:"Why would anyone fill and drain a tank at the same time? Isn't that just a waste of water?"
Iris didn't see it that way.
It made perfect sense if you think of water as New Star Guild's budget and the tank as their actual wallet size.
The only difference was that the guild's "tank" usually drained far faster.

The alarm clock rang, Iris put down her pen.
After finishing a worksheet pieced together from random photos, she felt calm again. She once more find the courage to face a world full of unanswered questions—or perhaps, questions with no correct answers at all.
CharacterArchiveContent.11111.2.cn:
“一个圆及其外切正方形绕同一对称轴旋转一周，可以形成一个圆柱体容纳一个球的立体图形。请证明，在这个图形中，球的体积是圆柱体积的三分之二，球的表面积也是圆柱表面积三分之二......”

面前的题目并不难。
鸢尾读过一遍后，就找到了解题的思路，刷刷地写了起来。
幸运绿洲号的车厢里很安静，除了偶尔翻动纸页的声音和笔尖划过纸张的声音，就只剩下时钟的滴答声。
鸢尾喜欢这种声音，它代表着准确，代表着规律，代表着不会背叛期待。
一小时是六十分钟，那就永远是六十分钟。

所以，鸢尾也喜欢做题。
题目是肯定有答案的，换言之，做题的付出是一定有结果的。
如果对了，看到答案的那一刻是一种奖励。
如果错了，学到新知识的那一刻也是一种奖励。
只要付出就有收获，世界上难道还有比这更好，更公平的事情吗？

“用向量方法证明，若一个平行四边形的对角线相交且互相平分，则该四边形为平行四边形。”

下一道题的难度要高一些。
这些题是鸢尾在攀登星塔时，在星塔里的书店顺手拍下来的。
虽然，星塔里的东西，除了许愿箱许愿出的神器之外，一件都无法带走。
但旅人们的回忆不在限制中。
随手收集的试题，难度当然参差不齐。
比起简单的题目，鸢尾更喜欢复杂的题目，那种绞尽脑汁和条件搏斗，最终战胜对方的爽快感是难以形容的。

“一个空蓄水池注满水需要八个小时，同一个蓄水池在满的情况下放空水需要十个小时，现在同时注水和放水，问多少个小时能注满水。”

当然，鸢尾也不排斥简单得像是给初学者做的题。
尘沙曾对着这种题挠头：“为什么会有人一边注水一边放水啊，这不是浪费水吗？”
鸢尾不这么觉得。
如果把水比作空白旅团的经费，蓄水池比作空白旅团的钱包，那么这道题不就成立了吗？
只不过，空白旅团的那个蓄水池，放水往往比注水快得多。

设定好的闹铃响了起来，鸢尾放下了笔。
在做了一张由随机照片拼起来的卷子后，她的心已经安静了下来，可以再次鼓起勇气，去面对她还没有找到答案......或是根本没有正确答案的世界。

CharacterArchiveContent.11112.2.en:
"Your job isn't to give practical advice; it's to give the customers a massage."
"M-massage? I thought I applied to be a fortune teller... I—I don't know how to give massages."
"I mean metaphorically, you know? Just say something that will make them feel better."
"Oh, that... Right, that was on the exams."
"Good, then the booth is yours. I'll come back to check on you tonight."
"Alright, I'll do my best."

This was a conversation from Iris' pre-Trekker days.
She paid a fortune to earn her "Fortune Teller Certificate" in the hopes of landing a part-time job.
Then she rented a dimly lit tent, sat there with a pointy hat on her head, and waited for customers to show up.

Of course, mind-reading magic is real in this world.
But no one needs to worry about being mind-read by a random fortune teller.
The Grace needed to read someone's mind would be astronomical. No fortune teller would spend the equvalent of a million Dorra just to earn a thousand.
What Iris had learned was a different kind of fortune-telling.
No need for cold reading or probing them with questions.
Just listen to the customer's troubles and offer a few comforting words is enough.
For example—
"The crystal ball shows that while a door has been closed, God of Grace will soon open a window for you."
"Your luck will improve next month, so don't be too discouraged."
Or something like—
"Your coworker's luck is gradually syncing with yours. Your work relationship will smooth out soon."
"This is the month when restaurants will prosper; all restaurants will see better business and you won't get laid off."
Most of the people who came to see her weren't looking for actual guidance. They just wanted a bit of comfort to get them through the tough times.
Just like how Iris, after surviving a month of eating nothing but Tawny Nightingale bread, would reward herself with a cookie.

Before long, Iris' little fortune-telling booth gained a small following.
This was partly because her gentle smile made people feel safe and at ease, and partly because her own life experiences resonated with her visitors, making their own struggles seem less daunting in comparison.

At one point, Iris thought she might just stick with this gig. "Iris the Fortune Teller" had a nice ring to it.
Until one day—

She was called upon to do real "fortune-telling," or rather, a "life consultation."
It was a rainy day when the child ran into her tent. She asked Iris if she should continue her studies or start working—and if it's the latter, what kind of job would suit her best.
For the first time, Iris could find no answer.
She felt like a student who'd been guessing the answers on an exam, able to give the correct response without truly understanding why.
The child met her eyes earnestly and carefully laid out a handful of coins as payment.
Iris found that she couldn't rely on her usual tricks to give the answer the customer wanted to hear.
She had no answer.
Thus "Iris the Fortune Teller" was no more.
Tricks for guessing answers are just that—tricks. To answer the question that is life, one must constantly be seeking from the paths ahead.
Of course, "Iris the Trekker" is a whole other story.
CharacterArchiveContent.11112.2.cn:
“你的工作并不是提出切实的建议，而是对顾客们进行按摩。”
“按......按摩？我以为我应聘的是占卜师......我，我不会按摩。”
“是心理按摩，你懂吧，就是说点对方听了之后能开心的。”
“啊，这个......考试的时候有考。”
“好，那摊位就交给你了，晚上我再过来看你。”
“嗯，我会好好做的。”

那是，鸢尾还没成为旅人时的对话。
她为了谋求一份打零工的工作，付出了昂贵的学费，考取了“占卜师资格证”。
然后，她就戴着尖尖的帽子，坐在别人租给她的阴暗帐篷里，等待着顾客上门。

这个世界上，当然有读取人心的魔法。
只不过，无需担心在街边占卜时会被读心。
因为读取人心的恩赐能量成本太高了，没有人会付出一百万朵拉的成本去收一千朵拉的占卜费。
鸢尾学习的是另一种“占卜”。
不需要冷读，不需要旁敲侧击。
只需要倾听占卜者的倾诉，然后给出一些温暖人心的建议就好了。
比如——
“水晶球显示，恩赐之神关上了你的门，但恩赐之神正在想办法为你打开一扇窗。”
“下个月你的运势就会回升，不要太沮丧了。”
又比如——
“你的同事和你的运势正在逐渐混合在一起，你们在工作上的争执很快就会减少。”
“本月是餐饮之月，餐厅的生意会变好，你不会被裁员的。”
来这里的顾客，大多需要的也不是明确的指引，而是艰难度日中的一点点慰藉。
就像，鸢尾在坚持吃一个月的“茶色夜莺”面包后，总是会吃上一块曲奇，奖励一下自己。

很快，鸢尾的占卜帐篷就在小范围出名了。
一方面是她温和的笑容让顾客感到安心和舒适。
另一方面也是她的人生经历，让顾客心有戚戚焉，大家纷纷觉得自己遇到的人生困境不算什么了。

鸢尾一度打算就这样做下去了，“占卜师鸢尾”听起来也不错。
直到——
她遇到了真的“占卜”，或者说“人生咨询”。
那是一个雨天，一个孩子跑进帐篷，请鸢尾给她占卜“自己应该继续读书，还是出去工作，如果工作，应该做什么工作好？”
鸢尾第一次无法回答顾客的疑问。
她就像一个一直在用技巧推测答案的学生，能够填下题目要求的正确答案，却不知道为什么是那个答案。
所以，当孩子向她投来认真的视线，以及把一枚枚硬币摆在桌上付占卜费的时候。
鸢尾无法再和以前那样，和顾客之间默契地说出那个对方心里想要的答案。
她解不出这道题。

“占卜师鸢尾”的工作结束了。
推测答案的技巧终归是技巧，想要解开“人生”这道题，还需要走过更多的路。
只不过，“旅人鸢尾”，就是另一个故事了。

CharacterArchiveContent.11113.1.cn: 武器轶事：二百八十六型魔法书

CharacterArchiveContent.11113.2.en:
Iris' first Monolith climb after becoming a Trekker was also the first climb for the New Star Guild since its formation. It went surprisingly well.
Before the climb, Iris did her due diligence.
She chose a Monolith close to the city border for the guild, which was perfect for testing the Lucky Oasis.
This Monolith had already been visited by many Trekkers, so the Trekker Association had detailed records and guides for it. Given these resources, even newbies could get a good sense of what to expect inside just by reading.
Last and not least, this Monolith was a good place to wish for Artifacts related to "office work," which were highly valued in the cities and could fetch a hefty price.

With a solid knowledge as the foundation, the climb proceeded smoothly.
The fledging guild proceeded with caution. Iris knew what types of Stellaroid might appear in each room and which corners enemies could be lurking. She devised a strict Soularia usage plan for Noya and Amber.
While other new guilds might throw magic spells at Stellaroid like they were free, Iris would calculate which spells would cost them the least amount of Grace Energy while still getting the job done. After all, they had to pay for these with Dorra at the Grace Imperium.
Thanks to her, the trio managed the feat of clearing three Boss rooms in one go. At the Wishing Box, Iris successfully wished for a valuable Artifact known as the External Brain.

As the name suggests, this Artifact acts like an extra brain for its user.
By typing some magical spells on the keyboard, the Artifact would assist the user in many tasks such as calculation and document filing.
Even high-level executives in the Gold District took pride in owning such a powerful Artifact.
Noya suggested keeping the External Brain for Iris to use and Amber agreed.
During the climb, Iris never stopped calculating. By end of the climb, she looking worn out.
As Noya put it,"You should keep it for yourself—if nothing else, your hairline would thank you."

In the end, Iris sold this Artifact.
Compared to the mental strain of calculation, the New Star Guild's budget posed a bigger threat to her hairline.
According to experienced Trekkers, a Trekker's first wish is always the best, because it carries all their desires or grudges from birth. Once wishing becomes as routine as eating or drinking, it becomes much harder to wish for something truly wonderful.
Iris had to consider what she would do if she couldn't successfully wish for an expensive Artifact next time.
As for calculations in battle, paper and pen work just as well. She would just have to work harder.

With the money from selling the External Brain, Iris returned to the Lucky Oasis to find a gift box waiting for her.
Both Noya and Amber had chipped in for this gift—a knockoff of the External Brain called 286 Series Magic Book.
Though its performance was clearly inferior and the special keys had been replaced with magic runes, the way to use it was the same: It needed to be used horizontally.
The night, Iris kept complaining about her guild mates' reckless spending.
Yet many years later, even after the Magic Book's performance had become severely outdated, she still treated it with care and used it daily.
CharacterArchiveContent.11113.2.cn:
鸢尾成为旅人后的第一次登塔，同时也是空白旅团组建以来的第一次登塔，出乎意料地顺利。
登塔前，鸢尾做了大量的功课。
她为旅团选定了一座距离城邦不远的星塔，很适合做幸运绿洲号的“试航”。
这座星塔有很多旅人去过，地理协会里有详细的资料和攻略，即使是新人，看这些资料也能把星塔内的情况了解得八九不离十。
最后，这座星塔很容易就能许愿出和“文书工作”有关的神器，这类神器在城邦里很受欢迎，一般都能卖上高价。

知识学得扎实，做题自然就快。
作为新人旅团，她们一路步步为营，鸢尾知道每个房间里可能出现的星骸类型，也知道有哪些转角可能藏着敌人，还为尘沙和琥珀制订了严格的心能使用计划。
其他新人旅团看到星骸就把魔法不要钱似的打出去。鸢尾看到星骸则会计算，怎么释放魔法才能少用点恩赐能量。毕竟，这些能量都是要去恩赐意志用朵拉换的。
于是，她们少见的一次就突破了三个魔王房间，许愿箱前，鸢尾一下子就许出了一台珍贵的“外脑神器”。

顾名思义，这种神器相当于给使用者提供了一个外接大脑。
只要在键盘上敲下一些魔法咒语，神器就能帮使用者做很多事情，比如计算，比如整理文档。
哪怕是住在金城区的公司高层，都以拥有一台性能强大的外脑神器为荣。
尘沙建议把这台外脑留下来给鸢尾用，琥珀也赞同。
鸢尾靠计算释放魔法，一次登塔下来，鸢尾的脸色明显变差了。
用尘沙的话说：“即使为了你的发际线考虑，也留下自己用吧。”

结果，鸢尾还是卖掉了这台神器。
比起释放魔法时的计算，空白旅团的预算对她的发际线威胁更大。
有经验的旅人都说：“旅人第一次许愿的运气是最好的，因为那承载着一个人自出生以来的愿望或者怨念。当许愿这件事变得和吃饭喝水一样平常的时候，就很难许出来好东西了。”
鸢尾必须考虑，下一次如果没许愿出好卖的神器要怎么办。
战斗中的计算......纸和笔不是也能用吗？自己更努力一点就是了。

鸢尾拿着卖掉神器的钱回到幸运绿洲号，迎接她的是一个方方正正的礼物盒。
这是尘沙和琥珀用光两人的存款买下的礼物——某家公司私下模仿外脑神器制作的，二百八十六型魔法书。
虽然性能低了很多，神器特有的按键也被替换成魔法符文，但至少使用的方式和神器是一样的，都是打开来横着用。
那天晚上，鸢尾一直在埋怨两人乱花钱，
不过，直到很多年后，就算这本魔法书的性能已经落伍了很多，她也一直小心地用着这本书。

当然是为了摘星啦！

薇洛注：看简历的人是不会相信这么虚无缥缈的理由的！下次请写：喜欢结交伙伴，一同在荒野体验自由的生活。

CharacterArchiveContent.11203.2.en:
The Lucky Oasis

"Nicknamed 'Loxy,' is an RV assembled, in its entirety, by Noya alone."
...That's what the Boss said I should write, but come on, that's not what happened!
Back then, Iris, Amber, and I pooled every last Dorra we had to get our hands on all the parts needed for 'Loxy.' So really, it was a team effort.
All I did was put the engine, steering wheel, seats, axles, chassis, and other scavenged parts together by following my instincts. Somehow, it worked! Hehe.
CharacterArchiveContent.11203.2.cn:
幸运绿洲号

“昵称小绿，完全依靠尘沙一人拼装而成的房车。”
……魔王建议这么来写，哎呀，可我觉得这样形容太过夸张啦！
当初，为了凑齐小绿所需要的零件，我和鸢尾、琥珀耗光了自己所有的积蓄。所以，小绿的诞生，是大家共同的力量。
我只不过是把淘来的动力机、方向盘、座椅、前后桥、车架什么的按照直觉拼在一起，没想到竟然成功了，嘿嘿。

CharacterArchiveContent.11204.2.en:
The Tamago Pet Scam

Statement from scam victim "N," from the Imperial Guard archives:
"The scammer set up a stall near the alley entrance—the third one on the left of the Stargate Inn, inside Emor's Ash District."
"Yeah, average height, dressed like a Trekker, with a very noticeable scar at the corner of his mouth."
"He said he was selling the rarest of the rare: a Sherlock Tamago. He said that if you raised the pet inside the egg to level 999, you'd be able to summon it outside the Monolith."
"Right, that's exactly what I did! I raised it to level 999! But Sherlock never showed up. So the guy was definitely a scammer."
CharacterArchiveContent.11204.2.cn:
宠物宝贝蛋骗局

记录在帝国卫队档案中的，受害者尘某的证词：
“我记得那个骗子在埃摩灰城区星门驿站旁左拐第三条小巷的巷子口摆摊。”
“对，中等身材、旅人装扮，嘴角有道很明显的伤疤。”
“卖的是传说中最珍贵的，夏洛克宠物宝贝蛋。他说，如果能把宠物蛋里的夏洛克养到999级，就能在星塔外召唤出它。”
“嗯，我养到了！但是，夏洛克根本没有出现。所以，他一定在骗人。”

CharacterArchiveContent.11205.2.en:
First Prize, 7th Wilderness Survival Competition

Note: Since Noya has no recollection of this event, this account is written by Willow.

Trekkers love having all sorts of contests, but the Wilderness Survival Competition, hosted by the Trekker Association, is by far the most prestigious of its kind.
Gifted with speed of the puma, strength of the bear, and eyes of the hawk, Noya outlasted all other participants in the Southern Lushwood Jungle, taking first prize. 
What's more, during the competition, Noya showcased her exceptional skills on the grill, to the point that the judge from Fenghuang Diner invited her to become an honorary chef.
CharacterArchiveContent.11205.2.cn:
第七届荒野生存大赛一等奖

注：由于尘沙失去了这部分的记忆，这部分的内容由薇洛代笔。

旅人间的比拼层出不穷，而作为由地理协会主办、最具权威性的旅人荒野大赛，其含金量远高于同类比赛。
在该届比赛中，尘沙凭借豹一般的速度，熊一般的力量，鹰一般的洞察力，一举夺魁，成为众多参赛旅人中，在南部雨林生存最久的那名。
另，尘沙在比赛中曾向大家展示了自己高超的烤肉水平，连凤凰炒蛋的评审都在赛后向她递出橄榄枝，希望她能成为凤凰炒蛋的荣誉厨师。

CharacterArchiveContent.11206.2.en:
BOGO

"Big sale at the Monolith convenience store! Buy a Potentials Juice and you have a chance to get another one for free!"

I still remember the day when I saw an ad at Portia's when we were climbing the Monolith.
Iris said we wouldn't be that lucky, but I opened my Pep Pep Juice from the Wishing Box to find a "BOGO" on its ring, even though we had no idea where to collect the second bottle.
That's why I made a point of taking the empty bottle with me when I left the Monolith. I've kept it by my side as a good luck charm~
CharacterArchiveContent.11206.2.cn:
再来一瓶

“星塔便利店大酬宾，购买‘潜能特饮’有机会免费获得‘潜能特饮’！”

直到现在，我都还记得那次爬塔时，在波西亚那里看到的广告词呢。
鸢尾说我们没这种好运，可是，那之后我们从许愿箱里许愿出来的“能量沛沛”的拉环上，有“再来一瓶”四个字。虽然完全不知道要找谁去换~
所以，我特意把喝完的空瓶带出星塔，将它当作好运符放在了身边~

CharacterArchiveContent.11207.2.en:
Treasure Map

This is the reward from a certain commission.
At first I thought I had been scammed with a useless piece of paper.
But it was thanks to this treasure map that we were able to find the Boss in the desert.
Such a historic moment is definitely going on my resume!
CharacterArchiveContent.11207.2.cn:
藏宝图

这是，某次委托的报酬。
本以为自己被骗了，被塞了张无用的纸。
但是，正是靠着这张藏宝图，我们才能在沙漠里找到魔王。
这历史性的一刻，值得记录在简历上！

CharacterArchiveContent.11208.2.en:
Oh my gosh, I had no idea Noya had received such a prestigious prize! In that case... It makes sense to increase our commission rate just a little bit, right?
—Iris

A veteran knight once told me about that Tamago Pet scam. This particular victim actually leveled up a fake tamago all the way to 999. With that kind of determination, they will succeed at anything they set their mind to.
—Tilia
CharacterArchiveContent.11208.2.cn:
天呐，原来尘沙曾经获得过这么高的荣誉？！那……稍稍抬高一下我们旅团的委托要价，也很合理吧？
——鸢尾

我听前辈骑士说起过一个宠物宝贝蛋骗局。那个受害人竟然真的把山寨宠物蛋养到了999级。有这种毅力的人，做什么事都会成功吧。
——缇莉娅

CharacterArchiveContent.11209.2.en:
Entirely accurate.<sprite name="acrchives_certified_richtext">
Anyone who can earn Willow's trust as a Trekker partner does not need to have their resume verified. This is not me slacking off. I have a finite amount of time and I'd rather spend it on more important things.
—Kinsa

完全属实。<sprite name="acrchives_certified_richtext">

CharacterArchiveContent.11210.2.en:

Title: Operation: Bearly Possible
Synopsis:
Five bears calling themselves the "Invincible Five" suddenly appear before the adventurer. The five bears are:
Captain Magic Bear Vanessa
Vice-Captain Hammer Bear Caris
Strategist Illusion Bear Bernadette
Knight Armor Bear Elsa
Vanguard Axe Bear Ursula
"Stop right there, Ku-ma! Not one more step into the dungeon!" Vanessa warns the adventurer.
"Stop, Ku-ku! Stop, Ku-ku!" Caris echoes the captain's words.
The adventurer looks down at the pink plushie bears that barely reach waist height even stacked up. Is this adventure really going to work out?
CharacterArchiveContent.11210.2.cn:
某天，魔王打扫幸运绿洲号时找到了一盒外壳斑驳的留影盒，看样子被原主人播放了很多遍。

影片名：《熊胆妙算》
影片介绍：
自称“不可能任务行动队”的四熊小队突然出现在勇者面前，她们分别是——
队长魔法熊瓦妮莎，
副队锤子熊卡莉斯，
军师魔术熊芭娜妲，
骑士盔甲熊艾尔莎，
