CharacterArchiveContent.11211.1.en: The Legend of the Twin Stars

CharacterArchiveContent.11211.2.en:
"The Legend of the Twin Stars" was a story written by an anonymous author published in Trekker Association's"Trekker's Story Collection: Year █, Iter Month Edition."
It's Noya's favorite story. Perhaps it's because one of the main characters' dreams truly spoke to her.

Here's an excerpt:

Flowers, applause, and dazzling flashes of light.
On the stage of the medal award ceremony, Galavera almost teared up from the constant flashes. She glanced at Daria, who was standing next to her, with admiration. Her partner was calmly reciting her speech without skipping a beat.

Daria knew this would happen, so she only assigned Galavera one simple task: stand to the side, keep your back straight, and smile.
"Of course, don't just stand there like a statue. Hmm, let me think... I'll leave the end of speech to you. You're great at doing mic drops."
Daria leaned down and smoothed the creases out their dresses, making final adjustments before they went on stage.

"Shouldn't I prepare a something in advance?" In her mind's eye, Galavera could see the audience at the ceremony—esteemed board members of the companies and organizations sitting in velvet chairs, potential big clients to the guild.
"What if I get carried away and end up saying something like I want to pluck the stars out from the sky up there again? I'm always told to not say far-fetched stuff like that because it makes us look unprofessional, then the big business in the Gold District will want nothing to do with us."
"But Galavera, this dream of yours sounds so romantic. I really like it." Her partner didn't see the problem. "If the captain asks, just say it was from my draft."
"I'm not gonna have you get blamed for something I said. Hehe, I already know what I'll say!"

Daria's speech was finally coming to its conclusion. The memory stopped.
"Of course, our goal doesn't stop here," Daria smiled as she passed the mic to her partner.
Galavera straightened her back even more. The flashes were on her again. She held back tears and said loudly, clearly, without the microphone. Even those sitting in the back row could hear her every word.
"We will be plucking the stars out from the sky next."

The awkward silence lasted a second before the applause broke out.
The company's directors made the gesture of clapping, if only to maintain their usual formal decorum.
The award ceremony came to an end.

Galavera let out a happy whistled. She'd be dealing with the captain's fury later, after they got off the stage.
Worst case scenario, she'd get fined again. No, actually, Daria would probably get fined this time, too.
CharacterArchiveContent.11211.2.cn:
《双子星的传奇》，出自地理协会的《旅人故事集█年旅月刊》，作者佚名。
它是尘沙最钟爱的一篇故事，或许，是其中一位主角的梦想，深深触动了她的内心。

以下为部分选段：

鲜花、掌声、还有耀眼的闪光灯。
授勋典礼的舞台上，格拉薇尔被高频的闪光刺激地差点落泪，她敬佩地瞧了一眼身旁的达利雅：搭档面不改色，正流利地背诵着此次授勋典礼的演讲稿。

——授勋典礼开始前，达利雅就已经预料到了这番景象，她分给格拉薇尔的任务十分简单：站在一旁，挺直腰板，保持微笑。
“当然，也别做木头人。唔，让我想想……最后的结语就交给格拉薇尔啦，你最擅长一语惊人，引爆热点。” 
达利雅低头，细心地抚平自己和搭档裙摆上的褶皱，为两人做上台前最后的准备。

“不需要提前准备份草稿吗？” 格拉薇尔想象着参加授勋典礼的观众——端坐在礼堂丝绒椅子上的公司元老们，那些可都是旅团潜在的大客户。
“万一我头脑发热，又在台上说什么类似‘我要摘星’的话？团长总警告我别动不动就提这种不着边际的传说，这样只会显得我们旅团的成员很不专业，以后很难接金城区的大业务。”
“可格拉薇尔的这个梦想好浪漫，我很喜欢。” 她的搭档对此不以为然，“要是团长问起来，就说是我写的草稿。”
“怎么可能把责任推到你的身上啦。嘿嘿，我已经想好要怎么说了！”

回忆结束，演讲终于来到了最后时刻。
“当然，我们的目标不止于此。” 达利雅微笑着将结语的机会抛给身旁的人。
格拉薇尔的背挺得更直了。
她强忍住眼里的泪水——还是被闪光灯刺激的——大声地，不依靠传声器，清晰地将这句话传递给了礼堂最后排的观众。

“摘星，接下来的目标当然是摘星。”

尴尬的沉默只持续了短短一秒，她的身边便响起了掌声。
随即，台下的公司元老们们似乎是为了保持一贯的礼仪风度，也象征性地拍了拍手。
授勋典礼至此结束。

格拉薇尔开心地吹了声口哨，至于事后该如何面对台下气急败坏的团长，那就是下台后再烦恼的事情了。
大不了就再被罚一份，不对，还要包括达利雅那份的薪水。

CharacterArchiveContent.11212.1.en: The Fall of the Twin Stars

CharacterArchiveContent.11212.2.en:
"The Fall of the Twin Stars" was published in the Trekker Association's"Trekker's Story Collection: Year █, Gelu Month Edition." It was written by an anonymous author.
It is the final installment of The Legend of the Twin Stars series as published by the Collection.
Noya stayed up all night finish reading it, then she asked Iris to write a letter to the editorial team to protest the ending that befell the two main characters.

Here is an excerpt:
Galavera licked her pale lips. The stones beneath her feet had caught her unaware; she staggered and had to use her sword to steady herself. Daria, who she was carrying on her back, wasn't so lucky. Galavera's stumble had made she slip a little.
Galavera paused to adjust her stance. She had to make sure that the unconscious Daria wouldn't get injured again.

She had no idea how long they'd been walking.
A seasoned Trekker would always try to minimize her presence inside the Monolith, avoiding unnecessary combat with the Stellaroid.
It was a race against time.
She realized the cloth on her back had grown increasingly wet and sticky, a mixture of her own sweat and Daria's blood.

She's still breathing. Don't panic.
Galavera forced herself to stay calm. She felt her partner's heartbeat—weak, slow, hanging on by a thin thread.
The wind inside the Monolith carried death's chill, swirling around the two Trekkers.

"Mm..."
A soft groan came from behind her. To Galavera's ears, it sounded like thunder! A sign of life!
"Go to the right... There's an Aqua Glopo... You must... stay hydrated..."
Even though she could barely string a whole sentence together, Daria was still dutifully guiding her partner's way.

"You know that no matter how badly I'm injured, I won't die from it! A few weeks of rest and I'll be fine!!"
Galavera heard a faint reply by her ear. Daria couldn't keep the pain out from her heavy breathing. "Mm, but sometimes the body just reacts by itself..."
"Daria, don't fall asleep. Talk to me."
"Your back is too stiff... No way I can fall asleep..."
"Daria... Daria!!"

Three days later, Galavera carried Daria out of the Monolith, but they had paid a heavy price.
Daria had lost one of her legs.

The Twin Stars shone but for a brief moment above Torina before they fell to earth.
CharacterArchiveContent.11212.2.cn:
《双子星的落幕》，出自地理协会的《旅人故事集█年霜月刊》，作者佚名。
它是《双子星的传奇》在故事集上的最后一部连载。
连夜读完的尘沙曾拜托鸢尾替自己向编辑部写信，抗议作者安排给两位故事主角的结局。

以下为部分选段：

格拉薇尔舔了舔泛白的嘴唇，没有注意到脚下的石块。她踉跄着用手中的剑稳住身形，可背上的达利雅却没有这样幸运，随着这个动作滑落了几分。
她停下脚步，调整好自己的姿势，才不至于让陷入昏迷的达利雅再次受到二度伤害。

不知道走了多久。
经验老到的旅人尽可能在星塔内部降低着自己的存在感，减少与星骸的战斗。
——为了和时间赛跑。
她意识到背上那块布料随着它的流逝愈发变得更加湿润黏腻：混杂着自己的汗，和达利雅的血。

她的呼吸还在，别慌。
格拉薇尔强制自己冷静下来，感受搭档的心跳：很轻、很缓、细若游丝。
星塔里的风带起死亡的寒意，盘旋在两名旅人的周围。

“唔……”
身后传来一声轻轻的呻吟，在此时却无异于一道惊天的巨雷，劈出生机。
“朝右边走……有水属性的冻冻……你必须……补水……”
话语断断续续，却依旧恪守使命，为她的搭档指引方向。

“你不是知道无论多严重的伤，对我来说都不致命，休养几周就能好吗！！”
格拉薇尔耳旁传来低低的回答，带着喘息、难掩痛苦，“唔，可有时候，身体的反应会快过意识……”
“达利雅，别睡着。和我说说话。”
“那么硬实的后背……我可……睡不着……”
“达利雅……达利雅！！”

三天后，进入星塔的旅人只余格拉薇尔一人，在付出的惨重的代价后，她背着达利雅找到出口。
惨痛的代价里，也包括了达利雅失去的一条腿。

“双子星”只短暂地在托利纳的上空闪耀了一瞬，便如流星般陨落。

CharacterArchiveContent.11213.2.en:
Legend has it that it was a long sword entirely in emerald green.
Someone picked this sword up and, with it, ushered in a new era. 
The actress walked out of the magical elevator and said to her companions waiting outside:
"At last, the mysterious box has been opened... I can tell, this marks the beginning of a new era! The gods have heard our wish."

The performance on stage was coming to its climax.
Out of the three girls in the audience, only two were still awake.
One girl reached out and touched Noya's sword.
"Noya's sword looks exactly like the one from the play. You don't think it could really be the legendary sword?"
"Noya bought it at a blacksmith's shop yesterday."
"So she just bought the same one. Come think of it, she still hasn't named this sword. Do you think naming it would bring good luck?"

"Noname."
"Huh Noya, you're awake?"
"No. She's talking in her sleep."
That's how this seemingly ordinary long sword got its name.
CharacterArchiveContent.11213.2.cn:
传说中，那是一柄通体翠绿的长剑。
拿起这柄长剑的人，开创了一个新的时代。
她从神奇的升降梯中走出，对外面的同伴说：
“神秘的盒子终于今日被打开……我预言，这将是一段新历史的开启！一定是神的恩赐，祂听到了我们的愿望。”

舞台上的故事，演到了最精彩的时刻。
舞台下的少女们，三个里只醒着两个。
一名少女伸出手指，摸了摸尘沙的长剑。 
“尘沙的剑和那个演员的是同款耶，不会真的是传说之剑吧。”
“昨天，尘沙在铁匠铺买的。”
“那就是和演员买了同款了，说起来，尘沙还没给这把剑起名字呢，起个名字是不是会有好运？”

“无铭。”
“嗯？尘沙你醒了吗？”
“没有，她，说梦话。”
总之，这把随处可见的长剑，拥有了自己的名字。

Shimiao is amazing at designing chalkboard bulletins. The neighorhood's public notice boards are all her handiwork.
However, she seems to think nothing of it.
Oh, and she always draws a cute little animal in the corners of the chalkboard bulletins.

师渺观察日记①

师渺非常擅长画黑板报，街道公告栏里的宣传栏都是她的杰作。
但本人似乎不觉得这是一件厉害的事情。

The Shimiao Logs ②

Shimiao likes to stock a wide variety of chili peppers and hot sauces.
Each jar is carefully labeled with production date, expiration date, place of origin, and some weird symbols that don't make sense.
In addition, she also keeps a ton of milk at home. When we ask her why does she buy so much milk, she always end up stammering something about how much she likes drinking milk.
—Colleague B at Baize Bureau
CharacterArchiveContent.11306.2.cn:
师渺观察日记②

师渺家里存着各种各样品种的辣椒和辣酱。
这些辣椒都贴上了统一的标签，细致地写出了生产日期，保质期，产地，和一些看上去意义不明的符号。
除此之外，她家里还屯了不少牛奶，但问起为什么要买这么多牛奶的时候，她每次支支吾吾地解释说，因为她喜欢喝牛奶。
——白泽公署的同僚乙

CharacterArchiveContent.11307.2.en:
The Shimiao Logs ③

Shimiao's multifunction storage box was given to her by a Xuan Shi. It has an interesting name: Shimiao's Miaovelous Sword.
Although Shimiao herself does not seem to approve of the name.
There is an even more interesting fact: if she utters the name out loud, she will come across a piece of luck that day. But at the same time, she will lose a certain amount of money; for example, her wallet might get lost or stolen. The amount of money lost seems to correlate with just how big is that piece of luck.
Because of this, in order to prevent unpredictable financial losses, Shimiao chooses to believe in the power of the box and avoids calling its name as much as possible.
—Colleague C at Baize Bureau
CharacterArchiveContent.11307.2.cn:
师渺观察日记③

师渺的多功能收纳盒似乎是一个玄师给的，有一个非常奇怪的名字，叫师渺妙妙剑。
关于收纳盒的名字，师渺本人并不认可。
但奇怪的是，如果师渺认真地念一遍这个名字，那一天就会有一件好事发生；但相反的，她可能会或多或少失去一点钱，或是钱包掉了，或是被人偷了，总之数额的大小和今天发生的好事的大小似乎有点关联。
鉴于这个原因，为了防止不可控的破财，师渺选择了相信玄学，能不念这个名字，就不念这个名字。
——白泽公署的同僚丙

CharacterArchiveContent.11311.2.en:
Messis Month, Fire Safety Routine Inspection Log
Inspector: Shimiao
Inspection Area: Second Danmu District Shopping Streets

1st St, Shop No. 3: Clogging the fire passage at the entrance and unauthorized construction. Requested removal within three days. Follow-up inspection is needed to ensure the fire exit remains clear.

1st St, Shop No. 26: The premise lacked fire extinguishers. When requested to equip the shop with an appropriate number based on floor size, the owner initially refused. After two hours of communication and safety education, the owner admitted to poor fire safety awareness and promised to implement rectification measures.

3rd St, Shop No. 93: Severe aging issues were found in Illegally installed lighting wiring. During the removal process, the aged lines ignited on their own, throwing off sparks. Fortunately, it was promptly managed without serious consequences.

4th St, Shop No. 48: The kitchen warehouse stored thirty bottles of liquefied gas. The owner claimed that they were for inflatable balloons but a further inspection revealed that the bottles were full of flammable gas. Due to lack of fire safety measures, the owner was mandatorily required to relocate the bottles.
Follow-up inspection is required to ensure safety hazards have been eliminated.

7th St, Shop No. 33: No fire safety hazards were detected, but the owner kept insisting something might be non-compliant and asked me to look around some more. Also offered drinks and fruits during the inspection.
We may have overlooked petty and trivial matters and a surprise inspection could be arranged in the future. But why did the shop owner keep staring at me?

7th St, Shop No. 61: During the inspection, a young man asked for help finding his lost child. After searching, the child was found asleep in the bamboo basket on the man's back, which he had forgotten about.

8th St, Shop No. 1: Due to a recent fire, the repair process was still on the way. Nearby shops, affected by the fire, actively cooperated with our inspection.

9th St, Shop No. 74: The owner dismantled fire safety equipment and the hydrant without authorization in order to expand the shopfront. We notified relevant authorities and the owner was arrested. The dismantled fire safety facilities will be restored within seven days.
Follow-up inspection is required.
CharacterArchiveContent.11311.2.cn:
谷月消防常规巡检日志
检查人：师渺
检查街区：丹木二区商业街

一街3号商铺，占用门口消防通道，违规搭建，要求3日内拆除，后续需要跟进检查，确保消防通道畅通。

一街26号商铺，店铺内未配备灭火器，要求店主按店铺面积配备对应数量灭火器的时候，遭到了店主的拒绝。后经过两小时的沟通和教育，店主承认自己消防意识薄弱，并承诺会配合工作。

三街93号商铺，违规拉照明线路，且线路老化严重，在拆除的过程中老化的线路自燃出现火星，好在及时处理，没有造成更大影响。

四街48号商铺，厨房仓库囤积了三十瓶液化气，店主声称这些都是用来打气球气体，但经检查，三十瓶全是可燃气体，且仓库没有任何消防安全措施，已强制要求店主全部运走。
之后需要跟进检查，确保安全隐患已经处理。

七街33号商铺，没有检查出任何安全消防安全隐患，但店主一直声称好像有什么不合格的地方，希望我在店铺里多看看，期间还拿出饮料和水果招待。
也许真的有什么安全隐患，可安排突击检查再复查一次。但店主为何一直盯着我看？

CharacterArchiveContent.11312.2.en:
Blood is always thicker than water, and you can never get away from your blood bound sister, especially a wonderful sister.
Even as a young girl, Shimiao had understood this.

All of the family's attention was always on her elder sister. For a long time, even Shimiao did the same.
Shimiao's sister was the joy and pride of the family. A model student with a bright personality, She was the embodiment of perfection. Whenever people talked about her parents' daughter, they were always referring to the older one.
Shimiao looked up to her sister, too.
She was Shimiao's role model, the kind of person she wanted to be.
She wanted to be just as exceptional as her sister.
A young Shimiao would follow her sister around, telling her about her dreams and goals.

But over time, Shimiao began to realize that her future wasn't what she had imagined it to be.
Her sister was always ahead of her, always climbing higher and faster. Always a relentless pursuer, one day she suddenly realized that she couldn't keep up.
Her hard-earned achievements seemed less impressive next to her sister's, and her efforts felt insignificant in comparison.
Even though she was always at the top of her class, which was naturally to be expected, because her sister got there first. Anything less felt like falling short and letting her family down.
The path she once thought of as a way to catch up with her sister had somehow become a mountain impossible to climb.
Her sister had become a source of pressure, a peak too high to climb.

But it wasn't her sister's fault. Deep in Shimiao's heart, she knew that.
The sisters were still very close, still could talk about everything and nothing.
But there were times, late at night when she was buried in schoolwork, when Shimiao would look out of the window. She would gaze at the moon and wonder what her sister had that she didn't.

"Well, the real problem lies with the people who keep comparing you two, doesn't it?"
One afternoon, the so-called "Boss" looked at Shimiao with a puzzled expression.
"You're who you are, and your sister is herself. You're two completely different people. Not to mention you're amazing, too."

Oh... That is what it is!
Blood had bound them together; they were alike in some ways, but they were never the same person.
Her sister is herself, and Shimiao is supposed to be no-one but Shimiao.
The cloud in Shimiao's heart had been dispersed, leaving her with a sunny afternoon sky—a scene that she'd never seen before.
CharacterArchiveContent.11312.2.cn:
姐姐，是血缘紧密的亲人，是无论如何都无法与之划清关系的存在。
师渺从很小的时候就已经清楚地明白这件事。

家人的目光总会聚焦在姐姐身上，最开始的时候，师渺也是这样。
姐姐是她们一家人的骄傲，无论是学业成绩，还是待人接物，都是无可挑剔的优秀。几乎所有人提起他们家的女儿，都会对姐姐赞不绝口。
师渺也不例外。
姐姐是她的榜样，是她所憧憬的未来。
她也要像姐姐一样优秀。
年幼的师渺总是这样跟在姐姐身后，诉说着自己的目标和理想。

但渐渐的，师渺发现未来并不是她所想象的那样。
她的姐姐走在前头，走得太高，走得太快；她追在姐姐身后，某一天忽然发现自己根本跟不上姐姐的脚步。
她的优秀在姐姐的对比下似乎变得没那么特别，她的努力在姐姐的衬托下也变得平平无奇。
一样是名列前茅的成绩，第一是应该的，因为她的姐姐也是第一；但如果不是第一，那就是拖后腿和丢人。
追逐着姐姐背影前行的道路，在不知不觉中变成了高不可攀的大山。
姐姐成了压力的来源，是她够不到的高峰。

那并不是姐姐的错，师渺心里很清楚这件事。
她们依然是关系很好的姐妹，她们依然可以无话不说。
但总有那么一些苦闷，在读书时期的无数个深夜，师渺从做不完的题和读不完的功课中抬起头，望向窗外的皓月，想不通自己到底输给姐姐什么。

“欸？可那不是将你们姐妹俩放在一起比较的人的问题吗？”
某个午后，这个被称为“魔王”的家伙一脸疑惑地看着师渺。
“你是你，你姐姐是你姐姐，你们是完全不一样的人，而且你明明也很优秀。”

是哦……原来是这样吗？
血缘将她们捆在一起，她们是相似的，但并不相同。
姐姐是姐姐，而师渺，也应该只是师渺。
午后的阳光明媚，萦绕师渺心头的阴霾似乎蓦地散开，露出了从未有的晴空。

CharacterArchiveContent.11313.2.en:
Why would a storage box bear such a strange name?
By the time Shimiao was asked this question for the 103rd time, she no longer had the patience to explain.
But one day it suddenly occurred to her that ever since she had received the thing, she herself had never asked why it bore her name—

It began with a strange figure who showed up on the streets. She was short in stature, with head of flaming red hair that stood out in the crowd. She carried an enormous calligraphy brush on her back and wandered from block to block. It sounded like she was hawking protection charms of some sort.
Shimiao had seen this oddball twice during her routine patrols. Once she was in front of an Artifacts shop, arguing with the shopkeeper that her painting skills were genius level. Another time, she was sitting at a breakfast stall, asking the owner about a kind of bun that was both savory and sweet.
Her voice was so loud that Shimiao could hear her every word even from the far end of the alley.

The third encounter was an accident.
The strange girl had set up a little table beneath a bridge, with a sheet of white paper scrawled on in ink brushstrokes laid out on top. She had her eyes closed as she muttered under her breath. Drawn by this unusual sight, Shimiao slowed down to look, and just then the girl opened her eyes, leapt up, and dashed straight toward her.
"It's you, Shimiao! I've been looking for you forever!!"
"Eh ... me?"
Before Shimiao could even react, the woman dug into her pack and pulled out a long, cloth-wrapped object. She shoved it into Shimiao's hands. Seeing that Shimiao was still bewildered, she pointed to herself: "What's with that look? It's me, Chixia! Don't you remember? We used to play together when we were kids!"
"Chixia? Ah...! You're that one from back then!"
"Yes, yes! But I don't have time right now, we'll catch up next time! This is Shimiao's Miaovelous Sword! My Master told me to give it to you! I don't know for sure if you're the right Shimiao... But since the name matches, let's say you are!"
She gave Shimiao no chance to speak. She just said it was a storage tool made by her Master, who had insisted it be given to the right person.
"Don't worry, everything my Master makes is great. It'll bring you luck! Bye!"
Before Shimiao could even refuse, Chixia had already packed up and ran off. Shimiao stood there with the sword-shaped storage box in her arms, and by the time she thought to chase after her, the red-haired figure was long gone.

Though it had been entrusted to her by a childhood playmate, Shimiao had no idea what it was for at first.
A month later, when a palm-sized cockroach appeared in her office, she instinctively grabbed the storage box and flung it at the terrifying creature. The box landed right on it. In that instant, she became convinced—
Shimiao's Miaovelous Sword really did bring her good luck.
CharacterArchiveContent.11313.2.cn:
为什么一个收纳盒要取一个这样的名字？
当师渺被第一百零三次问及这个问题的时候，她已经没有耐心向人解释。
但在某一天师渺忽然想起来，自己在收下这个东西之后，似乎也一直没问过，为什么它会用自己的名字命名——

最初是街头出现了一个怪人，她个子矮小，红发在人群里非常显眼，背着一支巨大的毛笔，在街区不同的地方闲逛吆喝，好像是在喊卖什么保命符。
师渺在例行巡街的时候见过那个怪人两次，一次是她在贩卖神器的商店门口和人理论她的绘画水平属于天才级别，还有一次是她坐在早点铺前，跟店长打听一种咸甜并存的肉包子。
她嗓门很大，站在街头说话的声音，师渺在巷尾就能听到。

第三次遇见是个意外。
那个怪人在桥下支了个小桌子，桌上摆着一张写了毛笔字的白纸，闭着眼嘴里念念有词。师渺路过时被她奇怪的举动吸引了注意，不过多看了两眼，这个怪人睁眼看见她，忽然跳起来三步并两步直奔她来。
“就是你啊师渺！找了你好久了！！”
“诶……我？”
还没等师渺反应过来，那个怪人从随身的行囊里翻出来一个被布包着的，长条形的东西，塞到师渺手里之后，又看她还是一脸迷茫的表情，怪人指着自己：“你那是什么表情？是我啊？赤霞！你忘了吗我们小时候一起玩的！”
“赤霞？啊……！你是以前那个！”
“对对，不过来不及了下次再叙旧吧！这个东西是师渺妙妙剑！我师父让我交给你的！虽然我也不知道是不是你……不过名字一样的话，就当是了！”
她完全不给师渺说话的机会，她说这是她师父做的一个收纳道具，她的师父说要把东西交给合适的人。
“别担心，我师父做的东西都是好东西，它会给你好运！我走啦！”
师渺甚至来不及拒绝，赤霞已经转身收拾起行囊，转身提起行囊，一溜烟跑了个没影，留师渺站在原地，抱着这个剑式收纳盒，等想起来要追上去时，已经找不到那个红色的人影。

虽然是儿时的玩伴交给自己的东西，但师渺对这个东西要怎么用，一开始并没有头绪。
一个月后，当师渺在办公室内遇到巴掌大的蟑虫、随手抓起这个收纳盒砸过去，正好砸中了那恐怖的生物时，她突然相信了——
师渺妙妙剑确实会带来好运。

CharacterArchiveContent.11411.2.en:
No one could pinpoint exactly when it started, but Chaton was rarely seen without a pair of headphones hanging around her neck.
Her playlist was a complete mystery, but her pre-mission ritual wasn't: the moment she set up for a sniper shot, those headphones went on.
Then, keeping time with the beat, she would squeeze the trigger—one rhythmic shot after another.

Deep in the historic district of Mirage, a dusty warehouse held stacks of wooden crates stamped with the White Cat Troupe's crest. Tucked away inside those boxes was the troupe's entire history.
Beside the crates lay a few threadbare wool blankets. For a very long time, this was where the troupe's "reserve members" actually lived.
But being cooped up in a dusty warehouse as a mere trainee bored the newly recruited Chaton out of her mind.
So, doing exactly what any curious kid her age would do, she started digging through the crates.
Eventually, at the very bottom of a box labeled "Musical Artifacts," she unearthed a strange little gadget.
It looked like a game controller, but it lacked the classic cross-shaped D-pad she'd seen on the ones the older members used.

Curiosity got the better of her, and she started fiddling with it. She quickly figured out that each colored button produced a different note, while the device played a backing melody. If she hit the right button at the exact right moment, it let out an incredibly crisp, satisfying chime.
Chaton stared at the toy, deep in thought, until a sudden realization hit her.
"Isn't this just like shooting?"
"You just need to pull the trigger at the perfect moment, right?!"

She mastered the game in no time, but a simple toy like that was never going to keep her entertained for long.
During her very first mission to the Monolith with the Third Squad, Chaton ditched her team and made a beeline straight for the arcade.
For a Trekker stepping into the Monolith for the first time, it was a wildly dangerous stunt.
But that didn't seem to bother Chaton in the slightest.
As Kasimira waited anxiously at the entrance, debating whether to charge back in after her, Chaton casually strolled out. Cradled in her arms was a pair of headphones she'd just wished for.

Kasimira gave her a blistering scolding, but the rest of the squad was absolutely floored by her raw talent.
On her first-ever trip inside, she had not only conquered several arcade machines entirely on her own...
But also casually stumbled upon a Wishing Box on her way out, using it to conjure up headphones pre-loaded with all her favorite tunes.
CharacterArchiveContent.11411.2.cn:
不知道从什么时候开始，猫眼的脖子上经常挂着一副耳机。
谁也不知道里面播放的是什么乐曲，但有一点所有人都见过：每当猫眼执行狙击任务时，她总会戴上那副耳机。
然后，随着音乐的节律，一下一下地扣动扳机。

在米拉什老城区的一间旧仓库里，堆放着许多印有白猫剧团徽记的木箱。那些箱子里装着的，是白猫剧团过去的历史。
而在箱子旁边，铺着几张简陋的羊毛毯。很长一段时间里，白猫剧团的“预备团员”都住在这里。
不过——布满灰尘的仓库、以及只能参加训练的预备团员身份，都让刚加入白猫剧团的猫眼感到无聊透顶。
于是，就像这个年龄的孩子都会做的那样——猫眼开始在仓库里翻箱倒柜。
直到某一天，她在一个装满“音乐神器”的箱子底部，发现了一件奇怪的装置。
那东西看起来有点像游戏手柄，但又和其他团员们玩的带有十字键游戏手柄有些不太一样。

好奇心驱使下，猫眼开始摆弄它。很快她就发现，手柄上印着不同颜色的按钮。每按下一颗按钮，都会发出不同的声音。装置还会播放一段音乐。而只要在正确的时机按下正确的按钮——声音就会变得更加清脆悦耳。
猫眼看着装置陷入了沉思，然后突然恍然大悟。
“这不就和射击一样吗？”
“只要在对的时机扣下扳机就行了，对吧！”

很快，猫眼就掌握了这种装置的玩法。不过……这种简单的游戏装置，显然无法满足猫眼的玩心。
在她第一次跟随第三小队前往星塔执行任务时——猫眼擅自脱离了队伍，然后一路跑去了星塔的游戏厅。
对于一个刚进入星塔的旅人来说，这种行为其实相当危险。
不过——这对猫眼来说似乎完全不是问题。
当卡西米拉焦急地守在星塔入口，正在犹豫要不要进去找人时，猫眼已经从星塔里走了出来，怀里还抱着一个刚刚许愿得到的——耳机。

虽然劈头盖脸地挨了卡西米拉一顿骂，但是大家都被猫眼的天赋所震惊。
第一次进入星塔，她不仅一个人打通了游戏厅里的几台游戏机。
甚至还在回来的路上，顺带发现了一个许愿箱。然后，许愿得到了一副可以播放猫眼喜欢的音乐的耳机。

CharacterArchiveContent.11412.1.en: The Origin of the Dark Power

CharacterArchiveContent.11412.2.en:
On that pitch-black night, Mirage was ablaze.
Gunfire and the clash of steel echoed endlessly through the streets.
Townspeople locked their doors or huddled in basements for safety. Back then, battles of this scale were just another night in Mirage.
But the flames and shouting soon drew monsters from the desert. Lured by the scent of blood, they swarmed the town, plunging the battlefield into absolute chaos.
As one mercenary band fell back, someone spotted a monster lunging at a child in a narrow alley.

A gunshot cracked through the night.
The bullet tore into the beast, shattering it into dust right before the child's eyes.
The child looked up at her rescuer. Raised among mercenaries, she knew only one rule: stick with the strong to survive.
Without a word, she grabbed the mercenary's sleeve.
But with the battlefield in total disarray, no one had the luxury of dragging a kid along. Desperate, the mercenary blurted out a line from a video game he'd played that morning:
"Once you unlock your dark power, you can become a sharpshooter and join us!"
CharacterArchiveContent.11412.2.cn:
那是一个漆黑的夜晚。
米拉什镇上火光四溅，枪声与刀剑碰撞声此起彼伏。
镇上的居民纷纷关紧门窗，或躲进地下室中避难。在那个年代，这样规模的战斗，早已成为米拉什的日常。
然而火光与呐喊很快引来了沙漠中的魔物，它们循着血腥味涌入镇子。伴随着魔物的加入，使本就混乱的战场彻底失去秩序。
就在其中一支佣兵团撤退时，有人无意间看见一只魔物，正朝着小巷里的孩子扑去。

枪声响起，子弹划过夜空。
魔物在孩子面前顷刻间被击碎，化作尘埃。
孩子抬起头，看见了救下自己的人。在被佣兵养大的孩子眼里，这个世界的规则只有一条——跟随强者，才能活下去。
于是她抓住了那名佣兵的衣袖。
但那时的战场混乱不堪，没有人有余力再带上一个孩子。情急之下，那名佣兵忽然想起了今天早上在游戏里看到的一句台词——
“等你觉醒了黑暗之力，就可以成为神枪手加入我们了！”

CharacterArchiveContent.11413.1.en: Weapon Anecdote: Cat Wand: Uncompleted Codex Entry MK Ⅰ
CharacterArchiveContent.11413.1.cn: 武器轶事：逗猫棒-魔典断章改

CharacterArchiveContent.11413.2.en:
Years of endless warfare had littered the desert around Mirage with broken weapons and discarded Artifacts.
Over time, local mercenaries turned this into a business: scavenging these lost weapons from the sands to sell back in town.
A young Chaton would often tail these squads.
After they finished sweeping an area and moved on, she'd sneak in to collect whatever weapons or spare parts they'd missed.

Once, while rummaging behind a dune, she startled a monster buried in the sand.
It lunged at her, scaring her so badly she ran for her life.
Over dunes, past rocks and shattered weapons—she dodged desperately through the wasteland.
But the hungry beast relentlessly gave chase.

Cornered, Chaton ducked into the shadow of a massive boulder.
As she paused to catch her breath, her hand brushed against something cold and metallic—a snow-white gun barrel.
Digging the sand away along the barrel, she soon unearthed a fully intact sniper rifle.
The moment her fingers wrapped around the grip, the dormant weapon stirred to life.
Deep within its chamber, purple energy began to pulse, as if forging a link with her very soul.
Right then, the monster tracked her scent to her hiding spot, its hulking frame looming over the rock.
In a panic, Chaton raised the rifle and pulled the trigger.
The shot blasted the monster, instantly disintegrating it into a cloud of dust.
It was almost the exact same scene from that fateful night years earlier.
The same crack of a gunshot. The same monster. The same fallen enemy.
Chaton stood completely frozen.
Then, she hugged the rifle tightly to her chest.
"Yes! I've finally unlocked my dark power!"
She cheered.
A brand-new chapter in Chaton's story had just begun, and she dubbed her new weapon the Uncompleted Codex Entry.
CharacterArchiveContent.11413.2.cn:
常年的战乱，使米拉什周边的沙漠里遍布着各种武器残骸与废弃神器。
久而久之，当地的佣兵们发展出了一项新的营生——前往沙漠回收这些遗落的武器，再带回镇上贩卖。
年幼的猫眼经常偷偷跟在佣兵队伍后面。
等他们搜寻完离开，她就悄悄去捡那些被遗漏的武器与零件。

某一次，她在沙丘后方翻找时，却惊动了一只埋伏在沙中的魔物。
魔物猛然跃出，把猫眼吓得转身就跑。
沙丘、岩石、残破的武器——她在荒凉的沙漠里拼命躲闪。
然而饥饿的魔物仍紧追不舍。

走投无路之下，猫眼躲进了一块巨石投下的阴影里。
她正想停下来喘口气，手却意外摸到了一根冰冷的金属物体，那是一截雪白色的枪管。
猫眼顺着枪管扒开沙子，很快一把完整的狙击枪从沙中显露出来。
当猫眼的手触碰到握把的那一刻——沉寂已久的武器仿佛再次被激活。
枪膛深处，紫色的能量开始缓缓涌动，像是与猫眼的灵魂建立了联系。
就在这时，那只一路追逐猫眼的魔物也循着气味找到了这里，并从岩石后探出身形。
猫眼在慌乱中举起狙击枪，随着扳机被扣下，子弹射出。
魔物在她眼前瞬间崩解，化作飞散的尘埃。
那一刻的景象，和许多年前那个夜晚几乎一模一样。
同样的枪声，同样的魔物，同样倒下的敌人。
猫眼愣在了原地。
随后，她猛地抱紧了怀中的狙击枪。
“太好了！我终于觉醒黑暗之力了！”
她兴奋地喊道。
从此属于猫眼的故事翻开了新的篇章，而这把武器也被猫眼命名为——魔典断章。

CharacterArchiveContent.11511.2.en:
"I heard that special-admit student lives here, Room 7 on the 27th floor... Huh? She's not here?"
"Forget it, let's go back. Sneaking up here like this feels kinda like breaking and entering. Besides, she's just a special-admit student, right? If we just wait, we can see her in class later."
"She's hard to catch during class. You haven't even seen the weapon she has behind her! Ah, looks like she's not here today. Weird, though. She used to be here every day..."
What the two of them never noticed was that the special-admit student they were talking about—Firefly—had just flown over their heads.


"Today is the weekly sneak-out day!"
Firefly did not dislike her daily life. The town had houses that kept her dry and warm, and there was hot food to eat. But it did not have any "friends" who would play with her. Aside from Canace, everyone turned and walked away the moment they saw her.
It was so boring...
She flew out past the city and over the river. The world below gradually turned green, and she picked a forest with a pretty shape and dropped down into it.
It was still a little way from the Monolith, but there were plenty of monsters along the way.
Maybe they would be willing to play hide-and-seek with her, Firefly thought.
When she landed, she stepped on something soft.
It was a stuffed toy caked in mud and dirty water. Beneath all that grime, it was a pink teddy bear.
Firefly picked it up and looked around, but there was no sign of any Trekker nearby.
"Did you get separated from your friend?"
Holding the grimy pink bear in her arms, Firefly went from one monster to the next, asking after its owner.
"Do you know who dropped this?"
"I'm not trying to play with you. I'm looking for the little bear's friend!"
"Have you seen... Ah, it ran away..."
...
By the time it started getting dark, the pink bear still had not found its owner.
"The sun's going down. Professor said I have to be back before dark."
Firefly crouched by the river and gave the pink bear a bath. Then she brought it back to the academy and set it by the window in her room to dry.
"Tomorrow, let's go to the Monolith and ask others."
"Tomorrow... How am I going to sneak out?"
"When will I make a friend who'll play with me?"
Clutching a penguin plushie in her arms, Firefly stared at the little bear's shadow on the windowsill and drifted off to sleep.
CharacterArchiveContent.11511.2.cn:
“我听说那个特招生就住在这，二十七层七室……咦，不在吗？”
“算了，我们回去吧，这样偷摸上来总感觉像做贼一样，再说了，不就是一个特招生吗？再特别不能等之后上课再看吗？”
“平时上课很难见到的，你都没见过她身后那个武器！哎，看来今天是跑空了，真奇怪，明明之前每天都在这……”
然而，聊天的两人并没注意到，他们谈论的那位特招生——火垂，刚刚从他们头顶飞过。

 
“今天，是一周一次的偷跑日！”
火垂并不讨厌现在的生活，城镇里有遮风避雨的房子，有热腾腾的食物；但城镇里没有能陪她玩的“朋友”，除了卡娜丝，所有人看到她都会转身就走。
太无聊了……
飞出城邦，越过河流，身下的世界逐渐染成了绿色，火垂选择了一处形状漂亮的森林，降了下去。
这里距离星塔还有一小段距离，但沿途有不少魔物。
火垂想：或许，它们会愿意陪自己玩捉迷藏。
落地的时候，火垂踩到了一个软软的东西。
那是一个沾满了泥水的毛绒玩偶，勉强能看出来原来是个粉色小熊。
火垂捡起它，四下寻找，却不见任何旅人的痕迹。
“你和朋友走散了吗？”
脏兮兮的粉色小熊被火垂捧在手里，她们一起向每个路边的魔物打听小熊主人的下落。
“你知道，这是谁掉的吗？”
“现在不是玩的时候，我在找小熊的朋友！”
“你有没有……啊跑掉了……”
……
天色逐渐暗下去，粉色小熊依然没有找到它的朋友。
“太阳要下山了，卡娜丝老师说，天黑前要回去。”
火垂蹲在河边，给粉色小熊洗了个澡，然后把它带回了学园，放在自己房间的窗户上吹干。
“明天，我们去星塔，问问其他人吧。”
“明天，怎么才能偷跑出去呢……”
“我什么时候能交到陪我玩的朋友呢……”
火垂怀里抱着企鹅玩偶，望着窗台上小熊的影子，进入了梦乡。

CharacterArchiveContent.11512.2.en:
Canace could never quite put her feelings for Firefly into words. She could not explain why she had chosen to get involved, or why she had fought so hard to save the girl.
Perhaps it was simply because she saw a reflection of her former self, who had once lost her freedom.

"This... Fly!"
Firefly had only just learned a few words. Sitting in the corner, she pointed at her remote cannons and then at Canace, gesturing with great seriousness as she tried to make herself understood.
"Up! High! Together!"
"You!"
Canace studied her earnest little face, trying to work out what she meant. Firefly kept gesturing for a while, then seemed to realize Canace still did not understand. She got to her feet, grabbed Canace's hand, and tried to lift her up into the air. But she was still too small to carry an adult. The cannons behind her bobbed up and down, unsteady in the air, like a firefly beating its wings as hard as it could.
So that was what she had meant. She wanted to take Canace flying with her.
Canace laughed and stroked her hair.
"You're still little, Firefly. You're not strong enough yet. Eat plenty, and one day you'll be able to carry me with you."
Firefly tilted her head, not looking as though she had fully understood. Long sentences were still difficult for her. But she could tell from Canace's voice that she was being gentle, and she nodded very seriously.
A few days later, screams started ringing out all over campus. By the time Canace arrived, Firefly was flying low over the training field like a hawk diving on prey, swooping down to snatch up the younger children.
Then she spotted Canace in the distance. Grabbing hold of a little girl, she flew straight over to her, her face bright with anticipation, plainly waiting to be praised: look, I can pick someone up and fly with them now!

It seemed she had gotten the wrong idea....
CharacterArchiveContent.11512.2.cn:
卡娜丝很难说清楚自己对火垂的感情——为什么要插手，为什么要拼尽全力地去拯救。
也许，只是因为在她的身上，卡娜丝看到了曾失去自由的自己。
 
“这个，飞！”
刚刚学会几个单词的火垂坐在角落里，努力地向卡娜丝，指了指她的浮游炮，很认真地比划了起来。
“上面，高！一起！”
“你！”
卡娜丝试图从火垂一脸认真的表情里，读懂她到底想表达什么；火垂比划了半天，意识到卡娜丝不能理解自己的意思。她站起来抓住卡娜丝的手，想把眼前的卡娜丝提起来飞。只可惜这时的她抓不住一个成年人的体重，浮游炮悬浮在她背后忽上忽下，就像萤火虫在努力扇动翅膀。
原来是要带她一起飞。
卡娜丝笑着摸了摸火垂的脑袋。
“火垂现在还小，力气不够。多吃点饭，就能带我一起飞了。”
火垂歪着头，似乎没有听明白，长句子对她来说还是有些难理解，但她知道读到了卡娜丝温柔的情绪，她认真地点了点头。
几天后，校园里接二连三地传来尖叫声，等卡娜丝赶到的时候，只见火垂低空飞行，像俯冲狩猎的鹰，在操场空地上抓那些年纪小的孩子。
她远远看见了卡娜丝，抓着一个小女孩飞到卡娜丝面前，一副期待表扬的神情——看，我能把这个人抓起来飞！

看来，她完全理解错了呢……

CharacterArchiveContent.11513.2.en:
That weapon looked cold and cruel to anyone who laid eyes on it. The price of wielding it was so immense that, no matter how many people tried, none could use it. Even the best-trained soldiers and the academy's finest elites buckled under its pressure.

Then the girl appeared. She reached out and laid a hand on it, nothing more than a curious touch. But the instant her palm made contact, the "device" lit up. It split into four parts, circled above her head a few times, then came to rest behind her. It was a gift she had been born with—more than that, it felt like fate.

"... New friend?"
The girl spun around where she stood, trying to face this sudden new "friend," but she was like a kitten chasing its own tail, never quite able to catch it.
After turning around a few times, she gave up. It felt pretty nice, really, having this friend stay behind her all the time.
"Well, let us play together from now on...!"
Her "friend" responded to that thought. The girl's feet slowly lifted from the ground until she was floating in the air.
Then the four pillar-like "wings" swung forward at once, unleashing a torrent of heat fierce enough to destroy anything in its path.
The girl laughed happily in mid-air.

"This is so fun!"
 She was still too young to understand what this weapon would one day bring her...
CharacterArchiveContent.11513.2.cn:
那件武器——任谁来看都是如此冰冷和残酷；而驾驭它所需要的代价，又是如此沉重，以至于寻遍众人，却无人能使用，无论是训练有素的战士，还是学院出身的精英，都难以抵抗它的压力。

直到那个女孩出现。她仅仅是好奇地将自己的手掌覆盖上去，而就在她触碰到的那一瞬间，“装置”发出亮光，分裂成四瓣，在女孩头顶转了几圈之后，盘踞在了女孩身后。这是与生俱来的天赋，更是冥冥之中的注定。

“难道是......新朋友？”
女孩原地打转，试图面向这个突如其来的“朋友”，但却像猫咪追着尾巴，永远也捉不到对方。
绕了几圈后，女孩放弃了，就让“朋友”一直站在自己身后也挺好的。
“那，以后就一起玩吧……！”
“朋友”对女孩的心思有了反应，女孩的双脚渐渐离开地面，浮在了空中。
而后，四个翅膀一样的“柱子”同时转向前方，迸发出能摧毁一切的热流。
女孩在半空中开心地笑着。

“好有趣！”
然而，年幼的她尚不知晓，这件武器会为她带来什么样的命运……

Digging, Hoarding, Breeding
During work breaks, Ridge plants her own fruits and vegetables in forgotten corners of the greenhouses, storing them away in the cellars she digs herself.
She pays little attention to anything else—but when it comes to "her living space" and "her food storage," she never yields an inch.
CharacterArchiveContent.11604.2.cn:
挖洞，屯粮，育种
在工作的间隙，岭川会在一些被遗忘的温室中种上自己培育的瓜果蔬菜等农作物，并存储在自己挖掘的地窖中。
除此之外岭川对其他事情并不在意，不过一旦关联到“自己的生活空间”和“食物储备”则没有丝毫退让的空间。

CharacterArchiveContent.11605.2.en:
Do Not Touch

A sign posted in the corner of the greenhouse—
"Please DO NOT TOUCH the plants without permission, or you'll be treated as a thief!"
(It comes with a simple line-drawn warning sign: a stick figure with a shovel about to drop on its head.)
CharacterArchiveContent.11605.2.cn:
请不要随意触摸

一块立在温室角落的告示牌——
请不要随意触摸植物，否则一律视为偷菜贼！
（一幅以简约线条绘制的警示图标：一个小人，头上有一把即将下落的铲子）

CharacterArchiveContent.11606.2.en:
A Secluded Sanctuary

It turned out Ridge didn't even know about what has been happening in the company, thought that might be a bad thing. She wasn't gossiping about me and Firenze like everyone else. Her little greenhouse is just so isolated from the rest of the world.
Come think of it, growing her own crops here is probably a violation of company policy... But then again, so is me napping here. Guess I'll keep her secret.
P.S. Her fruit tastes way better than the cafeteria's, and sometimes she even gives some to me to take home.
—Nyx, while talking about Ridge
CharacterArchiveContent.11606.2.cn:
遗世独立的温柔乡

没想到岭川居然不知道公司里最近发生的事情，不过这也不是什么坏事，她不会向其他人一样到处八卦我和翡冷翠的事情，还真是一座与世隔绝的温室呢。
说起来，她这样在温室里种植自己的作物应该是违规的吧，不过……好像我在这里睡觉也是违规的，我就替她保守这个秘密吧。
另：她种的水果比联合种业食堂里的好吃多了，有时候还会送我一些。
——星雁在谈到岭川时的留言

CharacterArchiveContent.11607.2.en:
Change? I don't know

Ridge hasn't noticed anything unusual in the company—same offices, same facilities, and the employees are still busy with work.
The only thing she finds strange is that ██████████████████████████, they've even started granting her research funding again. The last time she got funding was when she first joined.
CharacterArchiveContent.11607.2.cn:
改头换面

岭川并未察觉公司的异样——办公地点依旧，设施如常，员工们也还在为了工作忙碌。
唯一让她困惑的是，██████████████████████████，甚至开始批给她研究经费。而上一次岭川拿到经费，还是刚入职那会儿的事了。

CharacterArchiveContent.11608.2.en:
"It's getting hard to find fresh, tasty produce in Philae City's markets, and importing from other cities is just too expensive! If not for Ridge, I really don't know what we'd do."
—Jinglin

"Technically, taking company resources for personal farming is against the rules. But her crops ... they remind me of what United Harvest used to be. I'll let it slide."
—Firenze

"Napping in the greenhouse is super comfortable. Every morning I can clock in, then sneak back here for a nap without being late. Waking up to Ridge's fruit is a nice bonus... If only I can avoid running into those rampaging plants."
—Nyx
CharacterArchiveContent.11608.2.cn:
现在菲莱城的市场上已经很难再买到这么新鲜又好吃的蔬菜了，从其他城市运货成本又太高！多亏了又岭川，不然真的不知道该怎么办了。
——璟麟

从理论上来说，私自占用公司资源进行个人种植确实违反规定。但她的作物……让我想起了曾经的联合种业，就随她去吧。
——翡冷翠

温室里睡觉非常的舒服，每天早上可以在公司打了卡，再去睡一会，这样还不算迟到。睡醒了还能吃一点岭川种的水果……只是不要碰巧遇上植物暴走就好了。
——星雁

CharacterArchiveContent.11609.2.en:
Mostly accurate.<sprite name="acrchives_certified_richtext">
Although there are few people to verify her history, the intel collected so far supports Ridge's stated resume.
Her instinct for food storage and the crops she breeds through variety improvement will no doubt make her an invaluable force in logistics.
—Willow
CharacterArchiveContent.11609.2.cn:
基本属实。<sprite name="acrchives_certified_richtext">
虽然能够证明的人比较少，但是根据目前所收集的情报，岭川的履历基本属实。
岭川对于食物储备的意识以及通过品种改良出的作物，一定能够成为团队后勤的重要力量吧！
——薇洛

CharacterArchiveContent.11610.2.en:
Assessment of Greenhouse Operations

In light of current company finances, a review of non-core departments was conducted. Findings regarding several greenhouses are as follows:

Though many have lacked direct funding for a long time, they remain in good working order and have successfully bred several new varieties. Considering their potential commercial value and the minimal cost to maintain them, the Review Committee has decided as follows:
Some greenhouses will retain their current staffing and will not be dismantled at this time.

Effective immediately.
United Harvest Resource Optimization Committee

Year 994, █/█
CharacterArchiveContent.11610.2.cn:
关于部分温室的存续评估

鉴于当前公司财政状况，经对非核心部门进行综合评估后，现就部分温室事宜作出如下决议：

经查，部分温室虽长期未获得公司专项经费支持，但温室运转状况良好，并成功培育出多个新品种。考虑到其培育成果可能蕴含潜在商业价值，且维持温室运作所需成本极低，经评估委员会审议决定：
保留部分温室现有编制，暂不予裁撤。

本决议自即日起生效。
联合种业资源优化委员会

994年█月█日

CharacterArchiveContent.11611.1.en: Notes on Cultivation of New Varieties

CharacterArchiveContent.11611.2.en:
Sonus Month, 3rd——
Today I opened up a small new test plot to plant a batch of magically altered corn.

Clarus Month, 5th——
A whole month has passed, and Corn No. 8 still shows no signs of life...
Did the seed lose its vitality? Maybe I should dig it up tomorrow to check.
... Or maybe I'll just wait a few more days.

Clarus Month, 21st——
Last night I dreamed that Corn No. 8 sprouted. To my surprise, when I woke up this morning, it really had!
A month and a half has passed; I thought it had gone bad!
From today on, you're no longer Corn No. 8. I shall call you "Dream Corn!"

Floris Month, 13th——
The first batch of sprouted corn has already started to flower!
Dream Corn hasn't bloomed yet, but its growth is astonishing. It's already taller than the rest.

Floris Month, 29th——
The other corn has all finished pollinating one after another.
Why hasn't Dream Corn bloomed yet? I worry because the rain season will come next month.

Pluvia Month, 24th——
Dream Corn still hasn't bloomed.
I noticed cracks in the greenhouse roof and reported it to the company. I wonder if anyone will come fix it.
For now, I'll just reinforce it with some planks.

Pluvia Month, 26th——
The planks I fixed ended up giving way, and a lot of rainwater flooded in.
Corn 1 through 5 suffered badly and probably won't make it.
Numbers 6 and 7, as well as Dream Corn, look fine for now; I've set up drainage and rain shielding.

Pluvia Month, 27th——
I can't believe it! Dream Corn has finally bloomed! And it's producing more flowers than all the others!
Sadly, Corn 6 and 7 have died, too... Now Dream Corn is the only one left standing.

Calor Month, 4th——
Dream Corn is thriving and has already started producing ears.
But... can it really handle this much weight?

Messis Month, 8th——
Dream Corn's ears have grown ginormous, so heavy that the stalks are bending.
I hammered in three wooden posts around it, and they're just barely holding the whole thing up.

Messis Month, 22nd——
Dream Corn's ears are so massive that a single ear needs a whole wooden cart to carry it!

Messis Month, 3rd——
Today Shrubshrew and Boss came by, and Boss suggested we roast the corn.
But as soon as we held Dream Corn above the fire, it exploded!
Thankfully no one was hurt, but ... is Dream Corn actually Bomb Corn?
CharacterArchiveContent.11611.2.cn:
鸣月3日——
今天开辟了一小块新的试验田，用来种植一批被魔法改造过的玉米。

清月5日——
整整一个月了，8号玉米始终没有动静……
是种子失去活性了吗？明天挖出来检查吧。
……还是再观察几天好了。

清月21日——
昨天晚上梦见8号玉米发芽了，没想到早上起来之后真的发芽了！
一个半月了啊，我还以为已经坏了呢！
从今天开始你就不叫8号玉米了，叫你「美梦玉米」好了！

花月13日——
第一批发芽的玉米已经开花了呢！
「美梦玉米」虽然没有开花，但是长势惊人，已经比其他的玉米都要高了。

花月29日——
其他玉米都陆陆续续完成授粉了。
「美梦玉米」怎么还不开花啊，再不开花下个月就要下雨了。

雨月24日——
「美梦玉米」还没有开花。
温室的屋顶发现有裂痕，已经向公司做了报备了，不知道会不会有人来修。
姑且先拿木板加固一下吧。

雨月26日——
木板还是破了，不少雨水倒灌了进来。
1号至5号玉米受灾严重，估计没有成活的可能了。
6号和7号以及「美梦玉米」目前看上去没什么问题，已经做了隔水和防雨处理了。

雨月27日——
没想到「美梦玉米」居然开花了！而且比其他玉米开的都要多！
只可惜6号和7号玉米也被淹了……现在就剩下「美梦玉米」一颗独苗了。

热月4日——
「美梦玉米」长势良好，已经开始结穗了。
只不过……「美梦玉米」真的能扛住这么多玉米的重量吗？

谷月8日——
「美梦玉米」长出的玉米巨大无比，已经把茎秆压弯了。
我在周围钉了3根木桩，勉强才能把它支撑起来。

谷月22日——
「美梦玉米」长出的果实太大了，一颗玉米居然要一辆木制小推车才能装下！

猎月3日——
今天树树鼠和魔王来了，魔王提议做烤玉米吃。
刚把「美梦玉米」架在火上，玉米就直接炸开了！
还好没有人受伤，不过……「美梦玉米」居然是炸弹玉米吗？

CharacterArchiveContent.11612.2.en:
That summer, the rainstorms came with unusual fury. It was as if the sky above Philae City had been torn open. On the seventh day, the endless downpour burst through the levees, and the murky floodwaters devoured the fields on both sides of the river like a wild beast.
Then the saturated earth could no longer hold the weight of the mountains—mudslides carrying boulders and splintered trees buried the terraced fields near the highlands completely.

The disaster statistics for Philae City were cold and merciless: 83% of the plains' farmland wiped out, 62% of mountain fields destroyed, and the city's total grain output cut by 76% in a single season.

Hunger arrived faster than anyone expected.

The city quickly enacted an emergency food rationing system, but the scales of distribution were tipped from the start.
In the Gold District, tables were filled with soft white bread and aged wine still; 
in the Silver District, residents could received coarse black bread padded with bran, though in portions half the usual size; 
and in the Ash District, people clutched a handful ration slips, queuing outside United Harvest's grain storehouses for a daily allotment of 200 grams of moldy old rice.

"Please, just one more piece! My children haven't eaten in two days..."
"Want extra grain? Sure—twelve times the market price, cash only!"

United Harvest's storehouses held three years' worth of reserves, more than enough to see the entire city through the disaster. Yet instead of opening their storehouses for relief, they took the chance to buy up ruined farmland outside the city for pennies, and sell the reserves at staggering markups.

The gentlemen of the Gold District scoffed at the soaring prices, Silver District families tightened their belts, while those in the Ash District struggled on the edge of hunger and despair. If not for some farmers secretly sharing the food hidden in their cellars with their neighbors, the streets of Ash District would have been littered with countless frozen corpses that winter.

It was in those days that Ridge developed her fierce obsession with food. She would never forget that single memory: a creaking wooden cart slowly rolling in, piled high with golden, fluffy loaves of bread, steaming with the rich aroma of wheat under the noonday sun.
CharacterArchiveContent.11612.2.cn:
那年夏天的暴雨来得异常凶猛，菲莱城的天空仿佛被撕开了一道口子。连绵不绝的雨水在第七天冲垮了河堤，混浊的洪水像野兽般吞噬了两岸的麦田。
紧接着，饱和的土壤再也支撑不住山体的重量——泥石流裹挟着碎石与断木，将靠近山区的梯田彻底掩埋。

菲莱城的灾后统计冰冷而残酷：平原耕地83%绝收，山地农田62%损毁，全城粮食产量骤减76%。

饥饿来得比人们预想的更快。

菲莱城迅速启动了紧急粮食配给制度，但分配的天平早已倾斜。
金城区的餐桌上依旧摆着松软的白面包与窖藏红酒；
银城区的居民勉强能领到掺了麸皮的黑面包，只是分量比往日少了一半；
而灰城区的人们，只能攥着单薄的配给券，在联合种业的粮仓前排起长队，等待每日200克发霉的陈米。

“求您了，再给一块吧！孩子已经两天没吃东西了……”
“想要额外的粮食？行啊，市价的十二倍，现钱交易！”

联合种业的仓库里堆满了三年的储备粮，足够全城人熬过这场灾难。然而，他们非但没有开仓赈灾，反而趁机以极低的价格收购城外被毁的农田，再以惊人的溢价倒卖粮食。

金城区的老爷们对飞涨的粮价嗤之以鼻，银城区的家庭咬牙缩减开支，而灰城区的人，只能在饥饿与绝望中挣扎。若不是一些农户偷偷拿出自家地窖的存粮接济邻里，恐怕那个冬天，灰城区的街道上会多出无数具冻僵的尸体。

正是在这样的日子里，岭川对食物产生了极其强烈的执念。她永远记得：一辆吱呀作响的板车缓缓驶来，车上堆满金黄酥软的面包，在正午的阳光下蒸腾着诱人的麦香。

CharacterArchiveContent.11613.1.en: Weapon Anecdote: United Industrial - Prototype 205 Multifunction Shovel
CharacterArchiveContent.11613.1.cn: 武器轶事：联合工业-试制205型多功能铲

CharacterArchiveContent.11613.2.en:
Developed by "United Industrial," a subsidiary of United Harvest, the original goal was to create the "ultimate farming tool"—a single implement that combined digging, chopping, defense, and even cooking functions, gradually replacing traditional tools and ultimately monopolizing the agricultural equipment market.

However, during development, the engineers slowly strayed from that original vision...

The multi-purpose shovel Ridge holds is the 205th prototype, and the most outrageous one yet: built for high strength, wear resistance, corrosion resistance, and heat resistance. It can dig pits, chop wood, serve as a weapon, act as a shield, work as a frying pan, and even fire bombs... In short, there's nothing this shovel can't do.

Unfortunately, production of the 205 prototype was soon halted due to its excessive unit cost. Yet somehow, this particular shovel has remained in Ridge's hands.

Perhaps... It's simply because Ridge was too easily overlooked.
—After all, ever since the shovel was handed over to Ridge for test, apart from a few perfunctory "How's it working?" from developers in the first few days, no one ever followed up.
Not even a single feedback entry was updated in the project files.
CharacterArchiveContent.11613.2.cn:
由联合种业旗下“联合工业”部门开发，初衷是打造一款“终极农具”——通过整合挖掘、劈砍、防护甚至烹饪功能，逐步取代传统农具，最终实现农业工具市场的垄断。

然而，在开发过程中，工程师们逐渐偏离了原始目标……

岭川手上的这把多功能铲就是第205把试验品，也是功能最疯狂的一把——高强度、抗磨损、抗腐蚀、耐高温。可挖坑，可劈砍，可当武器，可当防具，可当煎锅，甚至可以发射炮弹……总之，没有这把铲子做不到的事。

只可惜没过多久试制205型多功能铲就因单件成本过高被叫停。但不知道为何，这把铲子却一直留在了岭川手中。

或许……是因为岭川的存在感实在太低了吧。
——毕竟，自从那把铲子交到她手里后，除了最初几天有开发人员例行公事般地问了几句“用着还行吗？”，之后就再也没人找过她了。
项目档案里甚至没更新过她的反馈记录。

CharacterArchiveContent.11702.2.cn: 寻找独特的食材，研制新菜品。

CharacterArchiveContent.11703.2.en:
Job Title

Manager at Huaijing Restaurant
Duties include reception, handling payment, waitressing, singing birthday songs for guests...
CharacterArchiveContent.11703.2.cn:
我的职位

怀璟食府店长
兼任大堂经理、收银员、服务员、生日祝福员……

CharacterArchiveContent.11704.2.en:
Career Highlights

After I became the manager, Huaijing Restaurant made it to Philae's "Top 10 Must-Try Restaurants" list and even won the "Outstanding Business of the Year" award.
That said, this success wouldn't have been possible without the whole team!
CharacterArchiveContent.11704.2.cn:
我的履历

我当上店长之后，怀璟食府入选了“菲莱城人气美食榜”前十名，还获得了“年度优秀商户”的称号。
不过，这不是我一个人的功劳，是大家共同努力的结果！

CharacterArchiveContent.11705.2.en:
Career Objectives

To make Huaijing Restaurant bigger and better, so everyone can enjoy great food and have a blast!
Also... I want to grow up and become a truly remarkable person!
CharacterArchiveContent.11705.2.cn:
我的目标

把怀璟食府做大做强，让大家吃得开心，玩得开心！
还有……成为一个了不起的大人！

CharacterArchiveContent.11706.2.en:
Hobbies

Playing Mahjong and chatting with customers.
CharacterArchiveContent.11706.2.cn:
我的爱好

打麻雀牌、和客人聊天。

CharacterArchiveContent.11707.2.en:
About Me

Taste the warmth of home, right here at Huaijing... Oops, I just quoted the restaurant's slogan!
Anyway, whether I'm managing the restaurant or working as a Trekker, you can count on me to deliver!
CharacterArchiveContent.11707.2.cn:
自荐语

食在怀璟，心归故乡……哎呀，一不小心说成店里的宣传语了。
总之，无论是当店长还是做旅人，我都不会令您失望的！

CharacterArchiveContent.11708.2.en:
While gathering feedback for "Cangwu Residents" Dining Experience Survey," I noticed many locals mentioned Jing's Bistro in Philae. I hope that Cangwu's restaurants will take a page from Huajing's playbook and focus on their food quality and customer service.
Despite her young age, Jinglin has already earned so much praise for her eatery. It must have taken a lot of effort on her part. I am very proud of her as a friend.
—Shimiao, Office Secretary, Baize Bureau
CharacterArchiveContent.11708.2.cn:
之前我负责收集“苍梧城餐厅满意度问卷”时，看到有居民提到开设在菲莱的“怀璟食府”，希望城内的餐厅能向它家学习，提升菜品的质量与服务水平。
年纪尚小就把食府做到如此高评价的璟麟，想必一定付出了很多努力。作为朋友，我也为她感到骄傲。
——白泽公署办公室秘书 师渺

CharacterArchiveContent.11709.2.en:
Fairly accurate.<sprite name="acrchives_certified_richtext">
Interestingly, Jinglin broke two of my stereotypes about Loong people: number one, they have an insatiable love for spicy food, and number two, they're all Mahjong pros... The sweet dishes at Huaijing are absolutely delicious, and playing Mahjong with Jinglin can be quite enjoyable.
After an eight-round losing streak, Jinglin tried her best to wear a smiling face, but her tail? It was twisted into a knot. Still a kid after all.
—Willow
CharacterArchiveContent.11709.2.cn:
基本属实。<sprite name="acrchives_certified_richtext">
说来有趣，璟麟打破了我对龙裔的两个刻板印象，一是“龙裔都嗜辣如命”，二是“龙裔都是麻雀牌达人”……怀璟食府的甜口菜真是好吃极了，和璟麟打麻雀牌也十分有趣。
连输了八场之后的璟麟，脸上还笑嘻嘻的，但尾巴早已扭成一团麻花了，果然还是小孩子啊。
——薇洛

CharacterArchiveContent.11710.2.en:
Great News! Jing's Bistro is celebrating its anniversary!!!
All customers will receive a complimentary seasonal dessert: Plum Rolls.
We invite both new and returning guests to join us for a delightful dining experience! We can't wait to see you.
—Jinglin, Manager of Jing's Bistro
CharacterArchiveContent.11710.2.cn:
好消息！怀璟食府店庆大酬宾活动开始了！
凡是到店消费的顾客，每位赠送当季甜品“莓莓毕罗”一份。 
欢迎新老朋友前来品尝，怀璟食府全体恭候您的光临。
——怀璟食府店长 璟麟

CharacterArchiveContent.11711.2.en:
Year 994 of the Monolith Calendar, Sonus Month, 2nd

Today is my first day as acting manager of Huaijing!
Mom gave me this beautiful new notebook, and from now on, I'm the one keeping the shift logs.
She told me, "The first step is always the hardest." and asked me to make the first page look extra neat...
Oops, I made a small mistake there. I hope it won't be a problem.
I'm sure we'll have plenty of customers today! Here's to a great start!


Year 994 of the Monolith Calendar, Sonus Month, 10th

Miaomiao left yesterday. She said she was heading home to care for her parents, but I know the real reason—she found a new job at the restaurant down the street.
I didn't want her to go, but business has been so slow lately, and I barely managed to scrape together enough to pay her wages for last month... I feel terrible about it.
There are several new chain restaurants opening around town, all under the "United Harvest" brand. I sneaked over to check them out, and the lines outside were huge! I saw Aunty Lan and her family there. I can't believe it! She's always been a fan of our sweet lotus root, but now she's heading to those places instead...

I can't tell Mom though, or she'll insist on leaving the hospital. The doctor says she needs to rest and recover.
The weather's great, but we're still not getting any customers...


Year 994 of the Monolith Calendar, Floris Month, 2nd

Customer Feedback for Today:
From two young women (Philae residents, never tried Loong cuisine before):
The Sweet and Sour Ribs are overdone and mushy.
The Braised Seitan has a strong soy sauce flavor.
The homemade yogurt is good—sweet and refreshing.

From a couple in their 50s (Philae residents, fans of Loong cuisine):
The Velvety Fish Broth is good, but has a slight fishy odor. Could use some improvement.
The dishes here are sweeter than what they're used to at other Loong restaurants.

The promotion events on the shopping street nearby drew quite a large crowd. I took the opportunity to invite some of the shoppers to stop by and share their thoughts on our food.
Now I see where we went wrong... Most people aren't used to traditional Loong flavors!
Looks like the Restaurant Survival Guide is spot on: gathering feedback really helps us improve our dishes.

Next up: convincing Grandpa Qin to tweak his recipes.
Ugh, just thinking about it gives me a headache. This is going to be harder than taking the toughest math worksheets...
I might need to talk to Mom first...
CharacterArchiveContent.11711.2.cn:
星塔994年 鸣月2日

今天是我当班的第一天，我正式成为代理店长啦！
妈妈特意送给我这个漂亮的新本子，以后店里的值班记录就由我来写了。 
妈妈还说“万事开头难”，让我把第一页的字写得好看一些……
哎呀，又涂了个黑方块，应该不要紧吧。
今天一定会来很多客人的！加油！


星塔994年 鸣月10日

苗苗姐昨天走了，她说要回老家照顾爸妈，但我知道，她是去后街那家餐馆了。
我不想让苗苗姐走，可店里生意一直不好，她上个月的工资我拖了好久才凑齐……真是对不起她。 
最近新开了好几家连锁餐厅，都挂着“联合种业”的牌子，我偷偷跑过去看了一眼，门口全是排队等位的人，连兰婶一家都去了，明明她最喜欢吃我们的冰糖莲藕了…… 

这些事不能让妈妈知道，不然她又要吵着出院，医生说她的病得慢慢调养。
天气这么好，大家怎么都不来吃饭呢……


星塔994年 花月2日

今日客户反馈：
两位年轻女生（菲莱本地人，没吃过龙裔菜）：
糖醋小排太软烂了，吃着糊嘴；
四喜烤麸酱油味太重，不喜欢；
唯一好评的是自酿酸奶，清甜爽口。

五十岁左右的叔叔阿姨（菲莱本地人，喜欢龙裔菜）
鲃肺汤不错，但略有鱼腥味，希望能改进；
整体味道比其他龙裔餐厅更甜，吃着不太适应。

隔壁商店街这几天搞活动，我趁机去拉了几位客人，还问了他们对菜品的意见。
这下终于知道问题出在哪里了……原来是大家不习惯传统的龙裔口味啊。
看来《饭店生存之道》这本书说得没错，“收集客户反馈”是提升菜品质量的重要途径。

接下来的任务就是去说服秦爷爷，让他改变一下做菜方式。 
啊，想想就头痛……比十套数学卷子更难啊……
还是找妈妈商量一下吧……

CharacterArchiveContent.11712.2.en:
Year 994 of the Monolith Calendar, Floris Month, 13th

As expected, Grandpa Qin was furious about my idea—he almost turned purple! He kept shouting, "These recipes have been passed down for generations; there's no need to change them!"
Mom says he's been a chef for decades, so it's hard for him to change his ways. We'll need to take a more subtle approach.

Sigh... Mom figured out. I promised her that the business would be back on track by the time she gets out of the hospital.
To help, I've been handing out flyers around the neighborhood to bring in a few customers. I'm also considering running a special promotion. I noticed that those "United Harvest" restaurants have membership cards. Maybe we could try something like that too...
Can't believe how fast time is flying by. Before I know it, it's already evening. But honestly, I don't mind the busyness at all.


Year 994 of the Monolith Calendar, Floris Month, 27th

Grandpa Qin finally agreed!
After a lot of persistence on my part, he reluctantly agreed to help me gather customer feedback and hear what they had to say in person.
Sometimes, he was really upset by the negative reviews—he nearly got into an argument with one of the customers! But when someone praised his cooking, he was so thrilled and wanted to share his secret recipes with everyone. Thankfully, Weiji stopped him before he could reveal too much.
Mom was right: Grandpa Qin is a chef who takes his work seriously. What he always wants is for every customer to have a satisfying meal.

Today, he came to me and said that he finally understood what the customers wanted and was ready to make some changes.
I can tell he really wants more people to enjoy his cooking and fall in love with Loong cuisine.
Once we close for the night, I'm going to share the good news with Mom! Business is picking up, and I know things are going to get better from here on out!


Year 994 of the Monolith Calendar, Pluvia Month, 1st

I'm too excited to sleep, so I thought I'd jot down a few thoughts to mark this moment.
As I was going through the previous shift logs, I realized it's already been over six months since I started.
This is supposed to be a notebook of "shift logs," but I turned it into a diary book with my bits and pieces.
Mom finally came home from the hospital last week, and I kept my promise! Now she can stop worrying about the restaurant and get her well-deserved rest.
I've also been busy with renovations. I put the money I'd saved to good use, getting a new signage and giving the dining hall a makeover. Plus, I even got Grandpa Qin the cooking tools he'd always wanted.
All our tables are booked for tomorrow, and we'll be welcoming customers with a fresh new look!
I'm so excited. I bet Mom felt the same way when she took over the restaurant.

Today has been great. Tomorrow will be even better. And the day after that? Even better still!
CharacterArchiveContent.11712.2.cn:
星塔994年 花月13日

果然，秦爷爷一听说要改菜谱，气得吹胡子瞪眼睛，嚷嚷着“祖辈传下来的菜谱不能变”。
妈妈说，他做了几十年厨师，肯定不愿意轻易低头，我们得想点别的办法软化他。

唉，妈妈还是猜到生意变差了。我向她保证，在她出院之前，店里一定能重新热闹起来。
这几天我在街上发传单，拉来了一些客人。晚上再想想能搞点什么优惠活动，联合种业那些饭店的充值会员卡好像不错，可以学一下……
最近总觉得时间过得好快，一眨眼就天黑了，这样忙碌的日子也不错呢。


星塔994年 花月27日

秦爷爷终于同意了！
前段时间，他经不住我的死缠烂打，答应和我一起收集用餐反馈，面对面听客人们的想法。
一开始收到负面评价时，他很生气，差点和客人吵起来。但客人们夸他时，他又特别开心，恨不得把自己的秘方都传授出去，得亏未济在旁边拦住了他。
妈妈说得对，秦爷爷是一个非常认真负责的厨师。他最大的心愿，就是看到客人们用餐后满足的表情。

今天他主动找上我，说大概了解客人们的口味了，可以试着调整一下。
我知道，他是想让更多人喜欢吃他做的菜，让大家都爱上我们龙裔的美味。
等打烊后我就去告诉妈妈这个好消息，这几天营业额也变高了，一切都会好起来的！


星塔994年 雨月1日

怎么样都睡不着，就来写点什么纪念一下吧！
翻了翻过去的记录，从第一天到现在，竟然已经过去大半年了。
说是“记录”，但我在写了太多零零碎碎的话，已经变成日记本了……
上周妈妈终于出院了，我也实现了当初的诺言！以后她可以少操心店里的事情，好好养身体了。 
这段时间忙着翻新店面，我把之前攒下来的钱拿去定做了新的招牌，简单装修了一下大堂，给秦爷爷的厨具也换成了他想要的那几款。
今天的预约号牌都发光了，天亮之后，我们就要以新的样子迎接客人了！
这种激动的感觉……妈妈当年接手这家饭店时，一定也经历过吧。

今天一定会很好，明天也是，后天也是！

CharacterArchiveContent.11713.2.en:
I had seen the little girl for three days in a row now.
As usual, she came during the hottest hours of the day, her patched-up crossbody bag swinging up and down as she bounced along.
She lied down under my shade, pulled out a picture book from her bag, and started flipping through it happily.

As a tree that had long stopped worrying the passing of time, I'd grown used to people spending time on their own beneath my branches.
When the little girl began sharing her tiny little concern, she sounded really like a chirping birdling.
"I really wish I could use spell now. Why can't I cast it?"
"Mom said I have it in me, I'm just too young for this."
"I just want to grow up already."
As an experienced listener, I had an urge to tell her that adulthood only brought bigger problems.
But from her furrowed brows, I could tell she was genuinely upset.

Sometimes, people treat me, a majestic tree, as a substitute for God.
They would come to me with their troubles or wishes, in exchange of a piece of comfort—we both know they are fooling themselves.
Unlike true gods, I couldn't grant wishes, but thankfully, no one ever got angry at me when their wishes went unfulfilled.
When this little girl laid out a bunch of colorful snacks at my roots and clasped her hands in prayer, I knew exactly what she was doing.
"Please, grant me the ability to cast spell!"
Boom!
A loud thunderclap echoed in response. She picked the worst possible time—the storm was about to break.
"Ah! Does that mean yes?"
Strangely, she didn't cover her ears or flinch like the others.
"I have to go! Mom's waiting for me at home! See you tomorrow!"
She waved me goodbye and ran into the rain, her bag held tightly against her chest.
I wanted to stop her, but I couldn't.

Boom!
A bolt of lightning struck right where she stood.
"Ahhh!!!"
If only I were a real god...
"Wh-what's going on?"
A golden beam of light descended from the sky, enveloping her. She wasn't hurt at all! Instead, the lightning spiraled around her like bees circling a flower.
I have never seen anything like it in my lifetime!
She raised her hand, a flash of lightning came from her fingertip, sending the startled birds away.
"My wish...came true!"
"I can't wait to tell Mom about this!"
I watched her, crackling with thunder energy, disappearing into the rain.

A year later, I saw her again.
She seems to live in a very, very distant place, and her time here each year is only a brief couple of weeks.
She still came to me sharing her worries, though the topics had changed.
"I can't control my power. I keep shattering the lightbulbs at the restaurant."
"My friends are avoiding me. Even the stray dogs on the street keep their distance. Everyone's scared of being zapped."
Her brow was still furrowed, and her tail flicked nervously, crackling with tiny sparks.

"With these gloves, I can control the lightning!"
She held up a pair of black gloves that looked surprisingly ordinary.
"Mom had them made by a skilled Xuan Shi. They're amazing, like a switch that lets me control the lightning."
"I can make it stronger...or weaker..."
"And they have this super cool name: 'Thunder God's Grasp.' The Xuan Shi came up with it himself!"
...
She went on explaining the details, but I couldn't quite follow. I just swayed my leaves in response.
For once, I believe I truly played the role of a god.
CharacterArchiveContent.11713.2.cn:
这是我连续第三天看到她了。
和往常一样，她背着一个带有补丁的斜挎包，在日光最为强烈的时刻，蹦蹦跳跳朝我走来。
而后，她从包里掏出一本图画书，躺在我投下的阴影里，愉快地翻阅起来。

作为一棵不被时间所困的树，我早已习惯不同的人在我庇护的范围内停留。
当她开始向我讲述那些微不足道的烦恼时，我只觉得她像一只叽叽喳喳的幼鸟。
她说，好羡慕那些会法术的人，为什么我做不到呢？
她说，妈妈说我不是没有天赋，只是年纪还小。
她说，我好想快点长大啊。
作为一个经验丰富的倾听者，我很想告诉她，大人的烦恼才更可怕。
但从她皱成一团的眉头来看，她的确也在认真烦恼着。

作为一棵身形高大的树，我偶尔也会代替一下神明的工作。
人们向我倾诉，而后许愿，从中获取自欺欺人的慰藉。
与神明不同的是，我无法提供任何帮助，好在并没有人因为愿望未达成而迁怒于我。
因此，当她在我的脚下摆出一堆花花绿绿的零食，并虔诚地双手合十时，我立刻明白了她的意图。
“拜托您，让我学会法术吧！”
轰隆——
回答她的是一串雷鸣，她挑选了错误的时间，暴雨就要来了。
“啊！您答应我了，对吗？”
奇怪，她竟然不像那些人一样，害怕得捂住耳朵，紧紧躲在我的身后。
“我要回去了，妈妈还等着我回家吃饭呢，明天见！”
她朝我挥挥手，将书包抱在怀里，向雨中冲去。
我想要阻拦她，却无能为力。

轰隆——
一道炸雷不偏不倚劈在她的身上。
“啊——！！！”
我想，如果我是真正的神明就好了。
“咦？这是……怎么回事？”
从天而降的金色光柱笼罩着她，雷电并没有伤害她的身体，而是如同花朵旁的蜜蜂一样，紧紧环绕在她的身侧。
即便是我，也从未见过如此奇异的场景。
她抬起手，一道电光自指尖喷薄而出，林间受惊的群鸟纷纷飞向天空。 
“我的愿望……实现了！”
“我要告诉妈妈这个好消息！”
她闪烁的背影逐渐远去，淹没在雨中。

一年后，我又见到了她。
她似乎住在很远很远的地方，每年回到这里的时间不过短短十几天。
她还是会向我倾诉烦恼，只不过话题有所改变。
她说，她控制不好雷电的力量，店里的灯泡都被炸碎了。
她说，朋友们不愿意靠近她，路边的小狗也绕着她走，大家都害怕被电到。
她的眉头依旧拧成一团，甩动的尾巴尖隐约冒出火光。

“有了它，我就能自由操控雷电了！”
她举起双手，向我展示她手上戴着的，一副看上去再普通不过的黑色手套。
“这是妈妈托人让一位厉害的玄师帮我做的，太神奇了，就像安上了开关一样。”
“可以增强……可以减弱……”
“它还有一个特别帅气的名字，叫‘雷帝招来’，是那位玄师亲自取的。”
……
她向我娓娓道来当中的奥妙，我听不懂，只能摇摇叶子回应她。
我想，这一次，我也终于扮演好了一个神明。

Address: Philae City

CharacterArchiveContent.11801.2.cn:

所属：自由旅人
技能：治疗，解剖，科研
地址：菲莱

CharacterArchiveContent.11802.2.en: There are some fascinating medical instruments and rare medicines among the Monolith Artifacts. Unfortunately, most Trekkers can't even recognize them, let alone make the right wish. So, I have no choice but to get them myself.
CharacterArchiveContent.11802.2.cn: 神器里有医疗器具，也有一些从未见过的药品，但绝大多数旅人都不擅长医术，没办法许愿出合适的东西。所以只能亲自去了。

CharacterArchiveContent.11803.2.en:
Hobbies

Preparing specimens, collecting pharmaceutical materials, and gathering abnormal biological tissue
CharacterArchiveContent.11803.2.cn:
兴趣爱好

制作标本，收集药材，收集病变的生物组织。

CharacterArchiveContent.11804.2.en:
Specialty

There's no illness I can't cure, as long as you're willing to pay the price~
CharacterArchiveContent.11804.2.cn:
主治方向

在我这里，没有治不好的病，只要你能付出相应的代价~

CharacterArchiveContent.11805.2.en:
Success Cases

Built a custom Neo Solution-powered exoskeleton for a completely paralyzed patient, helping him stand and walk again.
Rescued a Trekker suffering from heart failure by using Artifacts with magic.
Gave my own eye an upgrade. (※: This part is for Boss' eyes only.)
CharacterArchiveContent.11805.2.cn:
过往案例

为全身瘫痪的患者装上了特制的柔光外骨骼，让高位截瘫的人站起来。
配合魔法使用神器，拯救了心脏衰竭的旅人。
改造了自己的眼睛。（※：此条仅魔王可见）

CharacterArchiveContent.11806.2.en:
Potion Development Journal

I recently brewed a potion to improve one's sleep. It works wonders, as long as the dosage is strictly controlled.
A few merchants caught wind of it and came offering a high price for the formula. I rejected them politely with my Charon in hand.
For overdose prevention, patients will have to come by my clinic for a freshly mixed dose.
CharacterArchiveContent.11806.2.cn:
药剂开发日记

近期调制出了能治疗入睡困难的药剂，但用量需要严格控制。
有听到风声的商人上门，开出高价希望能收购药剂配方，我已经拎着卡戎拒绝了他们的好意。
在不能确保用量安全的情况下，还是让有需要的人到诊所里现配现喝比较安全。

CharacterArchiveContent.11807.2.en:
Volunteers Needed

Seeking daring individuals for my head transplant research. Survival is not guaranteed, but if you've ever wanted a new body, come knock on my door!
CharacterArchiveContent.11807.2.cn:
志愿者招募

现有更换头颅的研究招募志愿者，不能保证生命安全。欢迎想换个身体的人上门咨询。

CharacterArchiveContent.11808.2.en:
She's the Devil in White! Absolutely terrifying! Don't ask me how I know—you're better off not knowing!
—Noya

She's actually really kind. She gave me these cute medical patches, and they made all the pain go away!
—Firefly
CharacterArchiveContent.11808.2.cn:
超恐怖的白衣死神！！！不要问我怎么知道的！！
——尘沙

是好人……会给我，可爱的贴纸，贴上就不痛了。
——火垂

CharacterArchiveContent.11809.2.en:
Pretty accurate.<sprite name="acrchives_certified_richtext">
She does have a habit of saying some nerve-wracking things, but if you're dealing with a tough-to-treat condition, she's absolutely the one to go to.
—Willow
CharacterArchiveContent.11809.2.cn:
部分属实。<sprite name="acrchives_certified_richtext">
不过……虽然这家伙嘴里说不出什么好话，但如果真的遇到了什么棘手的病症，我还是推荐你们去找她。
——薇洛

CharacterArchiveContent.11810.2.en:

...

Coronis dropped this record on Lucky Oasis. The remaining pages are completely blacked out. Boss, you should drop in and return this to her.
—Iris
CharacterArchiveContent.11810.2.cn:
███号治疗记录

姓名：████ 
年龄：██
█月█日，伤口缝合第二天，已经有明显愈合的迹象，病人的体质强悍得有点离奇，是值得研究的个体。
█月█日，病人身体上的创伤已经基本自愈，但各方面体征依然虚弱，建议卧床休息一段时间。

这页病例是科洛妮丝不小心掉在幸运绿洲号上的，后面的纸页被全部涂黑了。魔王找个机会还给她吧。
——鸢尾

CharacterArchiveContent.11811.2.en:
"How did I go over budget again last month? Why? I've been charging patients properly, haven't I?"
Coronis sighs in distress.
"Maybe Boss was right... I really should start keeping track of everything. Ugh, fine. I'll give it a try next week."

Monday

CharacterArchiveContent.11812.2.en:
Coronis isn't human!
In the neighborhood where Coronis often makes house calls, her true identity is a popular topic among the town kids.
They like to sneakily follow her, whispering wild speculations about who—or what—she really is, each trying to back up their claims with "a valid proof."

"She's the Grim Reaper!"
The only kid who's ever stepped foot inside Coronis' clinic swears there's a mysterious little room filled with strange animal specimens and even human bones. And hanging on the wall is a huge scythe. "That must be the Grim Reaper's weapon!"

"She's a homunculus!"
One kid who received her treatment insists, "I had a close look at it while she was checking me out! One of her eyes is totally mechanical. It glows blue light! And sometimes, instead of saying she's eating, she says she's recharging. That's what a robot would say!"

"She's a monster that eats human meat!"
One kid who once followed Coronis out of curiosity says, "I saw her talking to this really sick guy, and she told him she'd waive his treatment fee if he gave her his leg!"
"Later, I saw that same leg in her clinic—in a jar! She's totally pickling it to eat later!"

"She's the grim reaper, and a possible grave robber!"
A new girl, who overhears the conversation, chimes in. She says she's heard the adults around town call Coronis the Devil in White." What if she's some kind of legendary figure, like a subordinate of the Tyrant in fairy tales?
But then...
She remembers the adults talking about Coronis' huge scythe, which isn't just any regular weapon—they say she dug it up from underground. If it came from six feet under... Maybe she's robbing graves! That would make sense, right?

The kids argue with each other passionately, completely oblivious to the white figure approaching them.
"If you're that curious, why not come to my clinic and find out?"
Coronis speaks up suddenly, watching as the kids freeze and then scatter like startled birds, shrieking in unison.
CharacterArchiveContent.11812.2.cn:
科洛妮丝好像不是人类。
在科洛妮丝经常上门看诊的小镇里，总又小孩喜欢小心翼翼地跟在她身后，嘀嘀咕咕着说着天马行空的猜测。
他们的想法五花八门，有时候为了论证自己猜测的准确性，都在努力向其他人举证——

“科洛妮丝是死神的化身！”
唯一去过科洛妮丝诊所的小孩说，诊所里有个神秘的小房间，房间里都是奇怪的生物标本，还有一些人体的骸骨，诊所里甚至还有一把巨大的镰刀，那一定是死神的武器。

“科洛妮丝是人偶！”
被科洛妮丝治疗过的小孩说，他在科洛妮丝为他检查身体的时候，近距离偷偷瞄到过，科洛妮丝有一个眼睛是个义眼，散发着蓝色的微光。结合她日常还会将吃饭说成摄入能量，说不定，那就是对人类的拙劣模范……！

“科洛妮丝其实是吃人的魔鬼！”
虽然不是科洛妮丝的患者，但因为好奇跟踪过科洛妮丝的小孩说，他见过科洛妮丝和重病的村明商量，只要村民把他腿切下来送给她，就可以免去他的治疗费用。
那条腿最后被科洛妮丝带回了诊所，装在一个玻璃瓶里泡着，那一定是食人魔在腌制食材！

“科洛妮丝是死神？还是……盗墓贼？”
路过看热闹的小女孩加入他们的话题，她说，听镇子里的大人们都把科洛妮丝称为“白衣死神”，说不定科洛妮丝就是传说中的人物，比如童话书里魔王的部下？
不过……
她又记得那些从冒险回来的大人们说，科洛妮丝的大镰刀不是什么寻常的武器，那个好像是从地底里带上来的。地底是哪里呢？地下吗？地下有东西的话，那岂不是挖了别人的坟墓？！科洛妮丝说不定还是个盗墓贼……！

孩子们争论不休，全然没有发现身后靠近的人。
“真的这么好奇的话，不如来我诊所看看？”
科洛妮丝突兀地出声，看着这群小孩像受惊的麻雀，尖叫着四散而逃。

CharacterArchiveContent.11813.2.en:
People with horns sometimes appear in Nova. They are from Nocturn Eterna, a notorious group bent on destroying the Monolith.
She had once been caught up in an incident caused by Nocturn Eterna, experiencing firsthand the devastation they brought; and yet, she had also received the kindness of one of its members—the kind that had changed her entire life.
Now, the very girl who had once saved her collapsed at her feet. Coronis looked down at the horned girl lying before her:
The wound in her abdomen was deep, her organs seemed to be spilling out, the blood loss already critical—she was close to death.
So Coronis, with considerable effort, dragged the heavily injured Nocturn Eterna girl back to her home. Out of the faintest sense of repaying a debt, she treated and bandaged the girl's wounds.

The girl stubbornly clung to life and, after several days in a coma, escaped death's grasp. When Coronis was changing her bandages, the girl lay in bed gazing up at her in pure admiration.
"You're incredible! I was split clean in two, and you still managed to patch me back together!"
"You flatter me. Honestly, I didn't think I could." Coronis pressed a vial of strangely colored medicine into her hand. "Since you refused to die, then do your best to live."

The girl remained in Coronis's clinic for over a month before finally recovering enough to leave.
They bonded almost instantly, as if they had known each other for ages. The horned girl spoke freely about her past—her life in Nocturn Eterna and the stories of her adventures. Coronis listened with quiet interest. She did not judge, she was simply intrigued by the unknown.
When she left, the girl said that the gift of life could never truly be repaid, but if circumstances allowed, she would one day send Coronis a gift worthy of that grace.
Coronis thought little of it. What she had done was already a fair exchange. Yet fifteen months after the girl's departure, an anonymous package arrived at the clinic. Inside was a pitch-black scythe and a single strange line:
"Without a proper weapon, how can a healer wrest lives from the Death?"
—The girl had sent her thank-you present, after all.
CharacterArchiveContent.11813.2.cn:
诺瓦大陆上偶尔会出现长角的人，那些人来自一个叫做“永夜”的组织，是一群企图破坏星塔的恶徒。
她曾被卷入永夜引发的事件中，切身体会了这群人带来的恶果；却也接受过永夜成员的恩惠，甚至改变了她的整个人生。
如今，那名曾经救过自己的少女出现在她的面前。她低头凝视这位倒在自己脚边，头上长角的少女：
腹部的伤口很深，内脏好像流出来了，失血量已经到了危机生命的程度，快死了。
于是，科洛妮丝费了不小的功夫，把这个重伤的永夜成员拖回了自己的住所，用仅剩的一点报恩的情绪，给她做了治疗和包扎。
 
那个少女凭着强悍的生命力，在昏迷了几天之后，从死神手里逃脱，科洛妮丝给她换药时，她躺在床上，一脸崇拜的表情看着她：
“你好厉害啊，我都断成两截了，你居然还能把我接起来。”
“过誉了，我其实也没想到。”科洛妮丝把颜色诡异的药剂塞到少女手里，“既然死不掉，那就加油活着吧。”
 
那个少女在科洛妮丝的诊所里住了一个多月才痊愈出院。
她们很快熟络了起来，仿佛相识许久的朋友，少女不避讳地讲起了她的过往，讲永夜们的生活，讲她冒险时遇到的见闻；而科洛妮丝是个不错的倾听者，她不会评判什么，她只是对未知感兴趣，她听得津津有味。
临别时，少女说救命之恩无以为报，如果未来有缘，一定会给科洛妮丝一份对得起这份恩情的谢礼。
这不过是等价交换而已，科洛妮丝并没放在心上，却不想，在少女离开之后的一年又三个月，诊所收到了一个匿名派送的包裹。包裹拆开，里面是一柄通体漆黑的镰刀，和一句没头没尾的话：
“如果没有一柄称手的武器，医者要怎么跟死神抢人呢？”
——是那位少女送来的谢礼。
