CharacterArchiveContent.15511.2.en:
"Shia, aren't you going home?"
"Not yet, I'll stay a little longer. You guys go on ahead~"

After her friends left for dinner, the moon rose high, and Shia still lingered by the shore, savoring the empty beach. 
She filled a bucket with tiny crabs, built a sandcastle, and lined up every seashell she had found... Yet even after all this, she still didn't want to go home. 
She knew it was late, but what was the point of going home? The house was small, but it was always so empty. All week her grandmother had been leaving at dawn and returning late. Right after preparing Shia's meals for the day, she would rush out the door. 
Everyone said her grandmother was the greatest seafaring Trekker in town, but Shia sometimes could find little comfort in that. All the other kids had family doting on them; she only had the sea for a companion. 
"Anyway, even if I go home late, Grandma won't notice. No matter how late I am, she won't get in until even later."
A defiant Shia decided she wouldn't return until her grandmother came to find her by the shore. She was both eager and uneasy, excited but afraid—would Grandma scold her? Would she be grounded for days? Whatever it was, it had to be better than the silence. 

The night wind stung her eyelids and drowsiness washed over her like the tide. She wandered for a while, then plopped down beneath a giant coconut tree. 
When she woke again, dawn was breaking. She rubbed her eyes—she had slept there all night. 
But Grandma hadn't come home? Before she could get properly angry, she detected the delicious smell of grilled fish. Not far away, someone had set up a small fire and grill; following the scent, Shia saw that familiar figure. 
"You're up? Go back and wash up. We'll be having breakfast here, by the sea."
Shia ate with a knot in her chest. Grandma never asked why she had stayed out, and Shia had no idea when she had found her.
But in the week that followed, Grandma didn't set out to sea again. She stayed home every day and did handcraft. 
Shia's wish had come true, but it left her rattled.
CharacterArchiveContent.15511.2.cn:
“希娅，你还不回家吗？”
“不回了，我再呆一会儿，你们先走吧~”
 
送走了回家吃晚饭的同伴们，月亮爬上了天际，希娅依旧在海边徘徊，享受着空无一人的沙滩。
抓了一桶小螃蟹，堆了一栋沙堡，捡来的贝壳全部分类排好……做完这一切后，希娅还是不愿意回家。
她知道已经很晚了，但是回家又能做什么呢？房子不大，却总是空荡荡的。这一周奶奶常常早出晚归，清晨离家前给她做好一天的饭菜，便急匆匆出门了。
虽然大家都说，希娅的奶奶是镇上最厉害的航海旅人，但希娅并不总是开心的——别的小孩子都有家人陪着，她却只能和大海相伴。
“反正，就算我回去的再晚，奶奶也不会发现的吧，她只会更晚回家。”
抱着赌气的心情，希娅决定今晚不回家，直到奶奶来海边找她。她既期待又紧张，既兴奋又害怕——奶奶会骂她吗？会罚她好几天不准出去玩吗？不管怎么样，都比现在这样，一天说不到三句话要好。
 
夜晚的海风吹得她眼皮发烫，困倦如潮水般袭来，她转了半天，躺在了一棵巨大的椰子树下。
再次醒来时，天光已经发白，她揉了揉眼睛——自己居然还躺在椰子树下。
奶奶竟然一夜都没回来？希娅的愤怒还未点燃，就闻到了喷香的烤鱼味。不远处有人架起了烤架，顺着气味，她看见了一个再熟悉不过的身影。
“醒了？回去洗漱一下，今天的早饭就在海边吃吧。”
这顿饭她吃得无比忐忑，奶奶并没有问她为什么在这里，她也不知道奶奶什么时候来的。
但是，接下来的一周，奶奶没有再出海，而是每天呆在家里做些手工活。
希娅的愿望实现了，她却十分不安。

CharacterArchiveContent.15512.2.en:
"If you ask me, your grandma's definitely mad. She's waiting for you to apologize first."
"Yeah, if it were my mom, I'd have been licked already. Your grandma is so nice and patient."
"She's not patient—she just..." Shia's voice caught, irritation rising. "She barely talks to me anyway. I think she just can't be bothered with me, that's why she said nothing."
She would rather be yelled at, even punished. At least that would mean her grandma cared. Instead, her grandma treated her the same as always and even bought her a new surfboard.
More than once, Shia stared at her grandmother's back, wanting to ask what was she really thinking. But it felt like some stubborn contest, and whoever spoke first would lose.

"But my mom said that your grandma was fixing ships last week. There were some stuff only she could do."
"You mean the ships that are sailing tomorrow? Our inn's packed with out-of-town Trekkers."
"My sister's going, too. I don't want her to leave... We're all going to see her off."
"Take me with you..."
So it was because of the ship repairs? Shia's resentment suddenly evaporated. Come think of it, around this time of the year, the harbor was always at its busiest, of course Grandma would be overwhelmed with work.
She regretted it. She shouldn't have picked a fight. But now, what could she do?

The next morning, Grandma left at dawn again. She was leading the send-off prayers before the ships set sail—the biggest event of the year in town.
Shia followed her in secret. The docks were packed, ships lined in rows, sailors holding their families tight, tears glittering as they said goodbye. Shia's chest tightened.
She suddenly realized she had never once really hugged her grandmother. If she couldn't say it out loud, then she would show it. 

When Grandma finally returned home that night, Shia heard the door creak open. She bolted forward and threw her arms around her grandmother. 
"I'm sorry, Grandma... I shouldn't have sulked."
She spilled everything in one breath. And just as she braced for silence, a drop fell onto her hand. 
She recognized the smell—it was the scent of tears. 
"Grandma..."
The reply came in an embrace, fierce and wordless, stronger than anything words could hold.
CharacterArchiveContent.15512.2.cn:
“要我说，你奶奶肯定是生气了，等着你主动认错呢。”
“对啊，这要是换成我妈，早给我打一顿了。希娅的奶奶果然脾气很好。”
“她才不是脾气好，而是……”希娅顿住了，一种奇怪的懊恼油然而生，“她平时就不怎么说话，我看她根本是懒得管我，才什么都不说。”
她宁可被打被骂，那意味着奶奶在乎她。奶奶却像往常一样对待她，甚至还给她买了新的冲浪板。
好几次她望着奶奶的背影，都想问问她究竟是怎么想的，但这仿佛是一场较劲的游戏，谁先开口谁就输了。
 
“不过，我听我妈说，希娅的奶奶上周去帮忙修船了，最难的地方只有她能搞定呢。”
“就是明天要出海的那批船吗？最近我家的小旅馆都住满了，全是外面来的航海旅人。”
“这次我姐姐也要去，真舍不得她啊。明天我们要去送送她。”
“带我一个……”
原来是因为修船吗？希娅积攒已久的怨气一下子消失了。仔细一想，每年的这个季节都是出海旺季，奶奶的确会比平时忙碌许多。
她后悔了，她不应该跟奶奶赌气，但事到如今，她又能做些什么呢？
 
第二天清晨，奶奶早早出了门，按照惯例，她会去主持出海前的祈祷仪式，这是镇上一年一度最热闹的时候。
希娅偷偷跟着奶奶溜了出去，码头上热闹非凡，整齐的船只一字排开。即将远行的人们与家人紧紧拥抱在一起，别过头时眼含着泪花，希娅也看得鼻子一酸。
她突然想到，自己从来没有认真抱过奶奶。既然不知道该如何开口，那就用行动来表示吧。
 
出海仪式结束后，奶奶很晚才回到家中。听到奶奶开门的声音，希娅一个箭步冲了过去，抱住了她。
“对不起，奶奶……我不应该跟你赌气……”
希娅一口气说出了所有心里话，就在她以为奶奶又要沉默地应对时，一滴水落在了她的手背上。
她闻到了，那是眼泪的气味。
“奶奶……”
回应她的，是比任何语言都要浓烈的拥抱。

CharacterArchiveContent.15513.2.en:
People always assume their daily life will go on forever, like the tides that return each day or the sea breeze that never goes away.
A week after her grandmother passed, Shia found herself restless and nothing could fill the emptiness inside her. She accepted a commission to salvage a long-sunken boat.
The client rattled on about the details, but Shia wasn't paying much attention. She just wanted something to do. Diving, sailing, keeping herself busy... Maybe that would wash away the loneliness that clung to her.

At least the ocean still felt familiar to her. In the dim light beneath the waves, she groped around and searched.
The Artifacts granted by wishing at the Monolith came in all shapes and forms, and Shia couldn't even be sure which ones were actually Artifacts, and which were just garbage. She simply kept hauling up whatever she could find, piling it onto her boat until it was filled to the brim. When she returned to port, the client showered her with praises and handed over a generous payment.
To cap it all off, she was told that she could keep one Artifact from the dripping wet heap. Shia looked them over and picked a smooth white metal ball.

Would seawater ruin an Artifact?
She wasn't sure. She brought it to the Trekker Association headquarters and handed it to Nuz, a tiny girl known for tinkering with strange Artifacts. Nuz's eyes lit up—she'd never seen anything like it—and vanished into her workshop. When Shia finally saw her again, a week had passed. 
The ball had been polished clean. The moment Shia placed her hand on it, the ball unfolded, like a small rabbit stretching its limbs, floating in the air beside her. Then it began to vibrate.
"Eh? Don't tell me I fixed it wrong—"
Nuz was cut off when something crashed through the glass window. A black rabbit-shaped Artifact shot across the room and landed at Shia's side.
"This Artifact... It comes as a pair?" Shia murmured, staring at the two rabbits. "This is perfect. This way, they won't get lonely."
"... Hmm?"
"How much do you charge for repairing this Artifact? I'll also pay for you to replace the window class."
"Uh—r-right, I'll get you the invoice..."
Nuz thought the girl in front of her was strange. She'd just been hit with an extra expense, so why did she look so happy?
"One white, one black... I'll call you Snow Rabbit and Night Rabbit."
CharacterArchiveContent.15513.2.cn:
人总是下意识地以为，眼下的日常会一直存在，就像日复一日的潮汐和永不消逝的海风。
奶奶离世后的一周，无论做什么都觉得空落落的希娅，接受了新的委托，出海去打捞一艘沉没多年的小船。
委托人说了很多，但希娅并没有听进去，她只是想找个事情，潜入海里也好，在海上作业也罢，也许让自己忙碌一点，就能将那萦绕不散的落寞冲淡。

大海依然是她熟悉的大海，她在昏暗的海底摸索。
星塔许愿得到的神器各式各样，希娅也不确定到底哪些东西是神器，只是一味地将能摸到的东西往船上搬，直到把希娅的帆船堆满，她掌舵返航，得到了委托人滔滔不绝的称赞和一笔丰厚的酬劳。
最后，委托人大方地说，希娅可以从这些湿淋淋的神器中选择一个；希娅看了一圈，选中了一个白色的金属球。

神器会被海水泡坏吗？
希娅不确定，她把这个金属球带到地理协会的总部，交给了擅长捣鼓各种神器的纳茨；那个个子小小的少女兴奋地说从没见过这种神器，抱着金属球跑进了她的工作间，等希娅再次见到她的时候已经是一周以后。
那个金属球已经被擦拭干净，当希娅把手放在神器上，下一秒，金属球展开，像只舒展的小兔子，悬空漂浮在希娅身旁，然后神器开始震动。
“欸？难道是我没修好……”
少女的话还没说完，有什么东西“砰”地一声撞碎了窗户玻璃，飞速地蹿到希娅身边——是另一个黑色的兔子神器。
“这个神器，竟然是成对的吗？”希娅看着两个神器，喃喃自语，“太好了，有两个的话，就不会孤单。”
“嗯？什么？”
“修复这个神器要多少钱？还有更换玻璃的价格，一并算给我吧。”
“哦、哦……那我去给你拿账单。”
纳茨觉得眼前的少女有些古怪——明明多出了一笔钱，为什么她反而更开心了呢？
“一白一黑……就叫‘雪兔’和‘夜兔’好了。”

CharacterArchiveContent.15602.2.cn: 和伙伴们一起过上混吃等死的生活。

CharacterArchiveContent.15603.2.en:
Things She Claims to be Good at & Her Daydreams

It's got to be claw machines, of course. You've probably heard of my title already, but my next goal is to make the name "Lord of the Prize Claw" known all across Philae, then host the very first Philae Claw Machine Tournament in my honor.
After that, I'll take it to all of Nova...
CharacterArchiveContent.15603.2.cn:
自称擅长的事物与白日梦

果然还是抓娃娃吧？虽然你们大概都听说过我的名号，下一步是将“娃娃机仙人”的名号推广到菲莱，以我的名义举办第一届菲莱抓娃娃大赛。
再下一步，是整个诺瓦……

CharacterArchiveContent.15604.2.en:
Once the "Star of Trekkers"

Before the Trekker Association withdrew from Philae, Nazuna once earned the title of "Star of Trekkers." Newspapers back in the day carried a photo of her alongside Nazuka, Kaede, and others.
CharacterArchiveContent.15604.2.cn:
曾经的“旅人之星”

在地理协会未撤出菲莱之前，小禾曾夺得过“旅人之星”的荣誉，过去的报纸上依然能看到她与夏花、枫等人的合影。

CharacterArchiveContent.15605.2.en:
Combat Skills

When training new recruits, Nazuna often stressed that survival and using the environment to outmaneuver enemies should always come first. Beyond that, what left the deepest impression were the "people skills" she passed on to them.
CharacterArchiveContent.15605.2.cn:
战斗技巧

小禾本人在教育其他新人时，常常以保全自身和借助环境与敌人周旋为第一要务；而除此之外，还得是她传授给新人那些“对人技巧”更让人印象深刻。

CharacterArchiveContent.15606.2.en:
Troublemaker Reformed

Fuyuka is the Petal Bloom's nominal leader, but everyone knows that Kaede is the one keeping things running. To Kaede's eternal headache, she has to deal with a certain someone who is both a slacker and a prankster.
Lately, though, that troublemaker seemed to have reformed herself, perhaps thanks to the influence of their new friend.
CharacterArchiveContent.15606.2.cn:
改变

花令旅团名义上的团长是冬香，但了解的人都清楚，这个旅团真正的大管家是枫，而她最头疼的人，就是喜欢偷懒又喜欢恶作剧的某人——
不过最近，这位麻烦人物的个性似乎有所改变，大概是托了她们那位新朋友的福。

CharacterArchiveContent.15607.2.en:
Inside Intel

Only recently have people come to realize that during what looked like Nazuna's wasted years after the Trekkers' House pulled out of Philae, she had in fact been secretly gathering intelligence on █████.
The information she provided was a great help in ███, though she herself seemed far from satisfied with the results.
CharacterArchiveContent.15607.2.cn:
内幕

最近人们才意识到，小禾在协会之家撤出菲莱后看似堕落的岁月里，其实一直有在暗中调查█████。
她提供的情报为███起到了很大的帮助，但她本人似乎对成果很不满意。

CharacterArchiveContent.15607.3.en:
Inside Intel

Only recently have people come to realize that during what looked like Nazuna's wasted years after the Trekkers' House pulled out of Philae, she had in fact been secretly gathering intelligence on monsters.
The information she provided was a great help to the monster-hunting operations, though she herself seemed far from satisfied with the results.
CharacterArchiveContent.15607.3.cn:
内幕

最近人们才意识到，小禾在协会之家撤出菲莱后看似堕落的岁月里，其实一直有在暗中调查魔物的踪迹。
她提供的情报为讨伐行动起到了很大的帮助，但她本人似乎对成果很不满意。

CharacterArchiveContent.15608.2.en:
"Nazuna may look lazy, but she's actually amazing... When she decides to get serious...!"
—Fuyuka

Am I really supposed to be writing this? Won't people think I'm being biased? It's fine? ... Alright then... I only have one thing to say: if you can get her to respect you as a person, she'll be the most reliable partner you could ask for.
—Nazuka
CharacterArchiveContent.15608.2.cn:
前辈只是看着懒，其实很厉害的，只要她愿意拿出真功夫的话……！
——冬香

我来写这个吗？会不会有被人认为徇私的风险？没关系？……好吧，我想说的话只有一句：如果你能成为她认可的人，那她就是你最可靠的伙伴。
——夏花

CharacterArchiveContent.15609.2.en:
Basically accurate.<sprite name="acrchives_certified_richtext">
Though she comes off as lazy most of the time, every now and then she reveals a hidden sharpness... That's in line with the "Prize Lord" image she cultivates.
If there's one thing Nazuna excels at, it's being supportive to her allies in battle. She has a keen sense of perception and quick judgment.
—Willow
CharacterArchiveContent.15609.2.cn:
基本属实。<sprite name="acrchives_certified_richtext">
虽然整个人的印象懒洋洋的，但偶尔会展现出深藏不露的一面……这点还挺有她本人口中的“仙人”风范的。
要说小禾最擅长的，其实是在战场上为队友提供帮助，她有着敏锐的洞察力和及时的判断力。
——薇洛

CharacterArchiveContent.15610.2.en:
Why aren't there claw machines in the arcade? Yes, of course customers have asked that very question. But all of us old hands know the answer.
It's because of her, that weird girl with the green hair...
"Lord of the Prize Claw." To you it might sound like a joke, but to us it was truly a living nightmare...
—From an interview with a shopping mall manager in Philae
CharacterArchiveContent.15610.2.cn:
为什么娱乐设施里没有娃娃机？是的，当然有顾客问过相同的问题。但我们这些老资历都很清楚答案。
当然是因为那个人，那个奇怪的绿头发小姑娘……
“娃娃机仙人”这个名号，对你们来说可能是个笑话，但对于我们来讲，就是货真价实的噩梦……
——来自某菲莱城内商场经理的采访

CharacterArchiveContent.15611.2.en:
With the road leading to the Monolith reopens, Trekkers resume their profession and gradually gather once more. The Petal Bloom Guild also gains renown, becoming a model in the hearts of other Trekkers.
To help the newcomer Trekkers adapt, the members of Petal Bloom spring into action:
Fuyuka begins leading hunts on the front line; Nazuka teaches theories on facing monsters and sudden emergencies; Kaede helps the Trekkers refine their plans for logistics and material allocation.
… But Nazuna still spends all her time idling around.

"Didn't someone claim to have even won an award for being the 'most outstanding Trekker'?"
"Waahh—Nazuka senpai, you aren't mad, are you?"
"Hmph. Meddling isn't my style… If anything, those rookies will never be ready for the field if you all keep over-protecting them like this."
"Oh dear… We've been so busy for a while, just let Nazuna rest! The rest of us are more than enough to help out."

Though Nazuna is full of complaints, she eventually finds something she excels at teaching—
…
"Listen up! The most important thing for a Trekker is to stay alive. Don't ever think running away is a shameful thing to do! Failure still counts as important experience!"
"And remember, your enemies aren't just the monsters of the Wilds or the Stellaroids inside the Monoliths. Some of you hold illusions about this world or your own kind, but those with bad intentions and hidden motives can become your enemies, too. So, learning how to deal with people is essential!"
"Hah? You think that's dishonorable? Don't be ridiculous! It's survival tactics! Stop whining and get it through your head!"
...
Her training might sound unconventional, but the results speak for themselves. Injury rates among the Trekkers who participated in Nazuna's courses are always the lowest, and many people are beginning to see an unexpected side of this girl.
Of course, for Nazuna herself, this isn't necessarily a good thing.
"What? Another guild invited me to be their instructor? No way, absolutely not! Not even for money! I'm already swamped!"
CharacterArchiveContent.15611.2.cn:
随着通向星塔的道路恢复，重操旧业的旅人逐渐又聚集了起来。花令旅团也声名鹊起，成为了旅人们心中的榜样。
为了带领新人们适应，花令旅团的众人也行动了起来——
冬香本人开始在第一线带领探索，夏花则传授起了面对魔物和突发状况时的理论，枫则帮助旅人们完善了后勤与物资调配的方案。
……而小禾，却还是整天游手好闲、优哉游哉——

“某人不是说，自己曾经还荣获什么最优秀旅人的奖状吗？”
“呜——夏花前辈，你没生气吧……？”
“哼——多管闲事可不是我的风格……不如说，都像你们这样一个个过度保护的话，这些菜鸟可没法出师！”
“啊啦啊啦……前一阵这么忙碌，就让小禾好好休息一阵吧！我们几个也足够帮上忙了！”

虽然小禾满嘴不乐意，但她最后还是找到了自己擅长的事——
……
“听好了！旅人最重要的是活下去，所以不要觉得逃跑很丢脸！失败的经历一样会成为宝贵的经验！”
“旅人的敌人不止是自然界中的魔物和塔里的星骸，虽然有人可能对这个世界和自己的同类抱有幻想，但居心叵测的家伙同样可能成为敌人，所以掌握对人技巧是有必要的！”
“啊？你觉得卑鄙？开什么玩笑，这是生存策略！别给我撒娇，好好记在脑子里！”
……
虽然她教授的内容听上去有些奇怪，但特训的成果却很快体现出来：参与过小禾培训的新人，伤损率总是最低的。这让很多人看到了这位少女出人意料的一面。

当然，对她本人而言，这未必是件好事。
“啥？你说有别的旅团邀请我去当教官……不行，绝对不行！给钱也没用啦，我的工作量已经饱和了！”

CharacterArchiveContent.15612.1.en: The Return of the Lord of the Prize Claw
CharacterArchiveContent.15612.1.cn: 娃娃机仙人之再战江湖

CharacterArchiveContent.15612.2.en:
"You're here."
"You shouldn't have come."
"But I came anyway."
"I knew you wouldn't miss this chance—this chance to prove yourself."
"Your token. Where is it?"
"Right here, right in my hand."
"Then why not use it?"
"I am waiting for someone."
"For whom?"
"I am waiting for the true Lord of the Prize Claw to appear."
"Standing right in front of you."
"... Hmph, such arrogance."
...
The night was dark, and the arcade shrouded in shadow. Two silhouettes stood facing each other, the air drawn tight to the point of suffocation.
Neither moved first, both keeping a cautious watch on the other's hands and eyes, like seasoned hunters sizing up their prey.
Then, from somewhere, a cat's cry rang out, shattering the silence of the night—and with it, the tense deadlock.

"I'm going in! Lord of the Prize Claw, this time I won't lose! I'll take your title for myself!"
"That cat's cry just reminded me: there's always someone stronger, always another mountain taller than the one in front of you. If you keep seeing me as the summit, then your vision has already been clouded by prejudice. You'll never find the reach 'supreme state' of playing."
"W-what?! You mean there's someone even stronger than you...? Who?"
"Come on then. Beat me, and I'll tell you."
CharacterArchiveContent.15612.2.cn:
“你来了。”
“你不该来。”
“但我还是来了。”
“我知道你不会错过这个机会——这个证明你自己的机会。”
“你的硬币呢？”
“就在这里，就在我的手中。”
“为何不用？”
“我在等一个人。”
“等什么？”
“等真正的娃娃机仙人出现。”
“她不就在你的眼前？”
“……哼，大言不惭。”
……
漆黑的夜，被朦胧阴影覆盖的游戏厅，只有两个对峙的人影，气氛却紧绷到令人窒息。
谁都没有第一时间动作，谨慎地盯着彼此的手和眼，好似老练的猎手在挑选猎物。
不知从哪里传来的一声猫叫，打破了夜的寂静，更打破了对峙的僵局。

“我要上了！娃娃机仙人，这一次，我不会输，我还要夺走你的名号！”
“听到这声猫叫我才想起来，人外有人、山外有山，如果你一直将我看作那个顶点，那你就已经被偏见蒙蔽了心，永远找不到抓娃娃的‘至高境界’。”
“什、什么？！你是说有人比你还强……是谁？”
“来吧，打赢我，我就告诉你。”

CharacterArchiveContent.15613.2.en:
Nazuna's usual weapon of choice is the small crossbow she hides beneath her clothes.
Like its master, this weapon has no legendary backstory, no mark of a master craftsman. It's just an ordinary crossbow, modified by her own hands and always carefully kept in top condition.
Nazuna wipes it down with a dry cloth and coats it with light oil, cleans the groove with cotton swabs to clear residue and prevent scratches, and treats the wooden stock with beeswax to keep it from cracking—
A process she repeats day after day.
For a girl so notoriously lazy, it is the one thing she never neglects. Rain or shine, whether out on duty or at home, she always insists on doing this task herself. 
She is always prepared.

This crossbow is, after all, the weapon that suits her best after much trial and error.
Lacking wrist strength, she relies on mechanisms to compensate; without fast speed, she hones the art of concealment and evasive movement; she has no gift for advanced magic, nor is she naturally strong, so she chooses the path of ranged combat.
To safeguard her own life, to hold her ground against fierce enemies...
And to be of use to her companions.
Any survival strategy is valid, so long as it keeps them all alive together.

Even the most ordinary person can one day shine, letting loose that one arrow at the decisive moment. With that thought, she waits... And keeps waiting...
CharacterArchiveContent.15613.2.cn:
小禾最常用的武器，是那把能藏在她衣服中的手弩，
就和她本人一样，没有传奇的背景故事，没有经过神匠巧匠的锻造，只是一把经过她本人改装，平日里一直有在精心维护包养的的普通手弩。
干布擦拭后涂抹轻油；用棉签清理弩道上的残留物，避免金属划伤表面；定期用蜂蜡保养木制部分，防止开裂——
日复一日地重复着这个过程。
对于性格懒散的少女而言，这是她唯一会每天坚持做的事。无论刮风下雨，无论出勤还是在家，只有这份工作她放不下，一定要亲手去做。
她时刻准备着。

这把手弩，亦是经过反复挑选后，最适合她的武器。
腕力不足，就用机关去弥补；脚力不强，就想办法去锻炼躲藏的技巧；没有学习高深魔法的天分，又没有天生强壮的力气，于是她选择了远程射击这条道路。
为了保证生命安全，为了与凶猛的敌人抗衡……
为了能帮上她的伙伴。
无论选用哪种生存策略都是合理的，只要让大家一起活下去。

即使再平凡的人都能有朝一日绽放光辉，在关键时刻射出那一箭，怀着这个想法，不断，不断地等待着……

CharacterArchiveContent.15711.2.en:
Shortly after Shia's grandmother passed away, Karin showed up, saying she wanted to learn how to sail. Shia, however, wasn't thrilled about the idea. Sailing with someone new brought back too many painful memories of her grandmother. So, while she treated Karin kindly, she'd always steer the conversation away from actually going out to sea.

Karin didn't give up. If she couldn't get on a boat, she'd just write down everything Shia mentioned about sailing or her grandmother. She'd go over them again and again to soak up every bit of experience she could.

As the days turned to weeks, the two fell into a comfortable rhythm.
Seeing that Karin was fast becoming someone with perfect textbook knowledge but zero practical experience, Shia finally caved, though she only took her on a quick, almost symbolic trip to fish in the shallows.
"Maybe I'm the one who's still stuck in the past," Shia thought. But then she caught the look on Karin's face—a look of pure wonder.
"This is amazing! So this is how it works?! I followed the steps in my notebook, but doing it for real feels totally different!"
Watching the small girl, Shia couldn't help but see a reflection of her younger self. It dawned on her then: since losing her grandmother, her world had been gray. But because of Karin, the color was finally seeping back in.

The weather on the coast can turn on a dime.
One day, the two returned to port after a routine trip. Late that night, Karin realized she'd left her notebook on the boat. Terrified it would get ruined in the rain, she rushed back out into the brewing storm alone to grab it.
With only a flickering candle inside the dark cabin, Karin listened to the howling wind violently rattle the ship's hull. In that moment, she finally understood what Shia always meant: the sea wasn't just beautiful; it could be terrifying. Pushing her fear aside, she squinted in the dim light, desperate to find the notebook and leave.
A flash of lightning revealed a monstrous wave crashing toward the harbor. Karin had just found her notebook and turned to go when a violent jolt sent her slamming into the wall, knocking her out cold.
The massive impact snapped the boat's mooring lines. Adrift on the churning water, the ship was swept out into the raging storm, heading straight for the unknown...

Hours later, a loud thud jolted Karin awake. She opened her eyes to find herself surrounded by completely unfamiliar waters.
The thudding against the hull kept going. She scrambled onto the deck to see what it was, just as a marlin the size of an Artifact vehicle burst from the water. Its massive body blocked out the sun, casting a deadly shadow over the bow. It was the biggest, most terrifying fish Karin had ever seen.
CharacterArchiveContent.15711.2.cn:
希娅的奶奶离世后不久，花铃以拜访和学习那个人为由来到了希娅身边。或许是因为与另一个人出海会联想起奶奶，起初希娅并没有完全认可花铃想要学习的想法，尽管她表现得很温柔，却总是岔开出海的话题。

花铃则不同，即便希娅不愿带她出海，她也会在日常与希娅的交谈中，将一切与航海，与那个人有关的话题记录下来，她将那些话视为珍宝，一点点复习咀嚼其中的经验。

日月流转，潮起潮落，两人生活的步调也逐渐统一。
眼看花铃就要朝着“理论满分，实践零分”的方向发展，希娅还是动了心，带着她上了自己的船，但也只是象征性地开到了浅海区捕鱼。
“也许是我自己还没走出来吧……”希娅这样想着，但她却看见花铃露出了从未有过的表情。
“好厉害！原来是这么驱动的吗！？明明是按笔记上的步骤，但真的动起来感觉完全不一样！”
那个娇小的身影渐渐与记忆中的自己重叠在一起。希娅逐渐意识到，自奶奶离世后的生活，因这个女孩的加入而重新找回了色彩。

然而海边的天气总是说变就变，某天花铃与希娅在一次简单的出海后回到港口。
深夜，当花铃发现自己的笔记还落在船上的时候，担心笔记被淋湿的她，独自冒着风雨回到了船上。
雨夜中摇晃的烛光，船外呼啸的狂风，被震得船体吱吱作响，花铃突然理解希娅一直提及的——大海除美丽以外也有恐怖一面的事实。现在，她只想赶紧借着微弱的光源找到那本笔记。
一阵雷光映出巨浪的影子，向着港口席卷而来。花铃终于找到了笔记正准备返回，一阵剧烈的晃动令她撞上船体，摔晕过去。
而就在刚才的撞击下，船体脱离了固定，在巨浪翻涌的海面上，朝着未知的方向飘去……

数小时后，当花铃被一阵撞击声惊醒，她睁开眼，面前是一片陌生的海域。
撞击声持续着，她想跑上甲板观察，一只神器车大小的真枪鱼猛地跃出水面，它巨大的身形遮住太阳，在船头留下弧形的阴影——那是花铃迄今为止见过的最大最凶猛的鱼类。

CharacterArchiveContent.15712.2.en:
Lost in uncharted waters far from Port Sailstead, Karin found herself locked in a grueling, hour-long standoff with the monster.
Hours earlier, the giant predator had decided Shia's boat was trespassing and launched a relentless attack. Drawing on nothing but the theory she'd memorized, Karin frantically steered the ship, doing her best to dodge the marlin's strikes.

"I was in such a rush to get away, I don't even know where I am now..."
"The compass is busted, I don't have a map, and food... I'm almost out."
The ocean was eerily calm after the storm. Drifting alone on the empty sea, Karin felt completely abandoned by the world. Tears streamed down her face—not because she was scared for herself, but because she felt she had failed to protect the ship that meant everything to Shia and her grandmother. If she could, she would gladly stay at sea just to get the boat back to Shia.

A sudden splashing sound came from below deck. Panicking that the hull had a leak, Karin stumbled to the railing, only to see a school of small, dark blue fish swimming alongside the boat. She noticed that the earlier hits had ripped open her bag of fishcakes. Crumbs were floating on the surface, drawing the curious little scavengers.
"Why do fish even like this stuff?! Sorry guys, but this is literally my last meal!"
As Karin bent down to clean up the mess, she spotted a terrifyingly familiar fin slicing through the water toward them.
"That stupid fish! Why is it back?! Eek!"
Chasing the small fish, the giant marlin slammed into the hull once again. The impact knocked the last of the fishcakes right out of Karin's hands and into the sea.
"Dang it! I have to... I have to at least save the ship!"
Karin scrambled back to the helm. She pictured Shia in her head, asking herself what her mentor would do in a crisis like this.
"If I can't shake it, I'll just keep sailing until it tires out!"
Feeling for the wind, Karin hoisted the sail, locking herself into a bitter battle of endurance with the stubborn sea monster.

Finally, enraged by its elusive prey, the marlin launched itself into the air, aiming a lethal dive at the ship from Karin's blind spot. By the time she saw it coming, it was too late to turn. But just before the fish could skewer the hull, an impossibly massive creature breached the surface and bit the marlin clean in half. The leviathan cast a quick glance at Karin's torn fishcake bag, then sank back into the depths, taking its school of tiny blue fish with it.

The battle was over. A gentle drizzle began to fall over the quiet sea, and Karin collapsed flat onto the deck, too exhausted to even wipe the rain from her face.
She hadn't actually beaten the marlin herself, but she had done what mattered: she kept Shia's most treasured ship safe.
Just as she was about to black out, she heard the distant shouts of fishermen. Cutting through the noise was a gentle, unmistakable voice. She felt the heavy thud of boots on the deck and knew exactly who had come aboard. A second later, a pair of warm arms pulled her into a tight embrace.
CharacterArchiveContent.15712.2.cn:
远离塞尔斯泰港口的未知海域上，花铃与真枪鱼的搏斗持续了近一个小时。
数小时前，这只巨大的海洋掠食者将希娅的船视为入侵者，不由分说地对其发起了猛攻，花铃只好用上平日里积攒的经验，紧急将船驶离真枪鱼的攻击范围。

“急着逃跑，现在更不知道开到哪了……”
“指南针撞坏了，航线图也没有，食物……只剩一点了。”
风暴过后的海域异常平静，花铃与这艘船孤独地航行着，如同被世界抛弃，她不住地落下眼泪，不是因自己的现状，而是没能守护好这艘承载希娅和她奶奶的船，如若可以，她甚至希望将自己留下，换这艘船回到希娅的身边。

甲板下方发出阵阵水花声，担心漏水的花铃踉跄跑到甲板上，却望见一群深蓝色的小鱼游荡在船底边缘。花铃注意到，刚才的撞击下，装着鱼饼的袋子漏了出来，一点点碎屑就这么飘在了海面上，引来了这群陌生的小鱼。
“怎么会有鱼喜欢吃这个！？不好意思，这是我最后的食物了！”
花铃正要收拾，却看见不远处跟着它们来的，是刚才熟悉的身影。
“那只臭鱼！为什么又过来了！咿呀——！”
追逐小鱼而来的真枪鱼向船体又一次发动了攻击，仅剩一点的鱼饼也脱手掉进了海里。
“可恶！至少……至少这艘船要保下来！”
花铃回到船头重新掌舵，她一遍遍在脑海中复现希娅的身影，想象如果是那个人遇到这种情况会怎么做。
“既然甩不掉，那就一直开，直到耗尽它的体力！”
花铃感受着风的方向，扬起风帆，与这只同样倔强的海洋怪兽展开了持续的耐力比拼。

最终，似乎因没捕获猎物感到恼怒，真枪鱼一跃而起，在花铃视线的死角向船体发起突刺，当花铃意识的那一刻，她已经来不及转向。而在对方将要刺向船体的最后一刻，一只体型更为巨大的鱼类生物跃出水面，将真枪鱼拦腰咬断。那只巨鱼看向花铃装着鱼饼的袋子，随后带着跟在身后的那些蓝色小鱼一同潜入了海底。

这场人与鱼的较量结束了，平静的海面泛起了小雨，花铃瘫软躺在甲板上任由雨水打湿她的脸庞。
她并没有真正战胜那只真枪鱼，但她守住了这艘对希娅而言最重要的船。
在意识将要消散的那一刻，她听见了海民的呼声，那之中有一个温柔熟悉的声音。地板传来的震动，她知道那个人跳上了甲板。随后，一双温暖的手将她紧紧拥在了怀里。

CharacterArchiveContent.15713.2.en:
Karin had finally gotten her wish to sail with Shia. But weeks into their voyage, she still seemed down in the dumps.
"What's eating you, Karin? Not a fan of today's lunch?"
"No way! Anyone who knocks your cooking must have busted taste buds!"
"Shee? Ish weally good, mmph..."
"Hehe, glad you like it. But maybe swallow your food before you talk."
"Mm... It's just... I'm a little bummed out."
Karin gazed out the window at the ocean, and Shia instantly knew what was on her mind.
A few hours earlier, they'd spotted a ridiculously expensive fish out on the water. Word was they used to serve it exclusively to royalty, and even now, you'd only ever catch it on a noble's dining table.
"Still moping over that fish? It's a bummer we missed it, sure, but it's not like we're scraping the bottom of the barrel for our next meal."
"If only I had a decent weapon on me, maybe we..."
"See? It's much easier when you're honest about what you want. Come on, I know just the place."

Down at the bustling port of Sailstead, Shia led a hesitant Karin up to the Trekker Association counter. A petite girl, busy tinkering with an Artifact, hopped off a high stool to greet them.
"Nuz, we're back. How's the tuning on Snow Rabbit and Night Rabbit going?"
"Artifacts this delicate take time. Anyway, how'd your browsing go? Find anything useful in the warehouse?"
"Karin, tell her what you think."
Karin just shyly held up the gun-shaped Artifact she'd been clutching to her chest.
"Ah, that one. Nothing wrong with it, but it's pretty unforgiving. You'd need killer reflexes and dead-on accuracy to actually use it."
"If you don't like it, don't be shy. Shia and I go way back, so you're welcome to pick out another—whoa!"

Before Nuz could even finish, the Snow Rabbit and Night Rabbit shot out of her hands. They smashed right through a window and started zipping around the room like crazy.
"Crap! I forgot the safety lock! Someone stop those things!"
Karin reacted in a flash. Kicking off the table, she launched herself into the air and fired two quick shots, knocking both rogue Artifacts right out of the sky.
The Trekkers in the hall erupted into applause at the sudden "show." Realizing everyone was staring, Karin turned beet red and ducked behind Shia.
"Sorry, Shia... I think I busted your Artifacts..."
"As long as you're okay. That was some incredible shooting, by the way."
"Sorry about the mess, Nuz. Just put the repair costs for the Artifacts and the window on my tab."
"Why am I getting major déjà vu right now? Haven't we done this before...?"
"Nah, my bad this time. I'll tally up the damages for the Artifacts later."
Shia nodded and led Karin out of the hall. Nuz watched them leave, then turned back to the shattered glass on the floor with a heavy sigh.
"Maybe I should ask Willow to spring for bulletproof glass..."
CharacterArchiveContent.15713.2.cn:
自花铃和希娅一同出海已经过去了一段时间，了却一桩心愿的花铃却并没有开心起来。
“怎么了小花铃？今天的饭菜不合口味吗？”
“没有的事！说希娅做饭不好吃的人，肯定是舌头有问题！”
“你康，曾德哼厚次的，唔唔……”
“呵呵~好吃就行，不过还是先把饭咽下去再说话哦~”
“唔……我，我只是有点不甘心……”
花铃看向窗外大海的方向，希娅立刻读懂了她的想法。
数小时前，她们在航行的过程中发现了一条价值不菲的鱼，据说在过去它只出现在皇室宫宴上，如今虽然降级，但仍然只活跃于贵族的餐桌上。
“还在为没抓到那条鱼懊恼吗？虽然是有点可惜，但我们也没有拮据到为此揭不开锅的地步哦。”
“要是我也能有个趁手的武器说不定……”
“诚实地说出口不就好了嘛~走吧，我带你去一个地方~”

塞尔斯泰热闹的港口，希娅带着紧贴在身后的花铃来到地理协会的柜台前。一个捣鼓着神器的小个子少女从高台跳了下来。
“纳茨，我们回来了。雪兔和夜兔的调试怎么样？”
“这么精密的神器得要一会呢。话说回来你们挑的怎么样了，仓库里那些神器有用得顺手的吗？”
“小花铃，说一下反馈吧。”
花铃不语，只是害羞地将抱在怀里的枪型神器展示给纳茨。
“那件啊，倒是没什么问题。不过使用起来容错率很低，需要很厉害的反应力和准度哦。”
“不好意思说也别太拘谨，希娅和我是老熟人，再选一件也可，哎哟——！”

纳茨还未说完，手中正在调试的雪兔和夜兔突然飞向空中，撞碎了窗户，正暴走般地四处乱窜。
“糟了！忘记开锁定了！来个人，把那玩意停下！”
花铃反应迅速，踩上桌板用力一蹬跳到了空中，两次连射将失控的双生神器击落。
大厅内的旅人们无不为刚才的“表演”拍手叫好，反应过来的花铃只好红着脸躲到希娅身后。
“抱歉希娅，把你的神器打坏了……”
“花铃没事就好，刚才的表现很厉害哦。”
“不好意思纳茨，修复神器和窗户的账单也一起给我吧。”
“这样的对话怎么有股既视感啊……以前是不是也发生过一次……”
“这次是我的失误，回去我算算神器的那笔账就行了。”
希娅点头表示意会，带着花铃离开了大厅。纳茨目送两人离开，回头又看向地板上的玻璃碎片，叹了口气。
“要不还是和薇洛提议加装防弹的玻璃好了……”

CharacterArchiveContent.15802.2.en:
This has been a tradition for only a decade or so.
People say it started one year ago when someone casually suggested, on the eve of the Snowish Festival, that everyone should put on special outfits to make the day feel more festive. A bigshot happened to overhear the idea, and to everyone's surprise, it was put into action and kept over the years. It grew into the Grace Imperium's Snowish Festival custom we have today.
CharacterArchiveContent.15802.2.cn:
是近十几年才形成的习俗。
追溯起来是在某一年，有个人在雪愿节前夕突发奇想，提议大家可以在雪愿节当天换上特殊服装增添节日气氛，然后被正好路过的某位大人听见，结果没想到这个提议真的被执行并保留下来，演变成了如今恩赐意志在雪愿节的特色习俗。

CharacterArchiveContent.15803.2.en:
When Laru was little, she couldn't control her light magic, and whenever it got out of hand, her body would glow at the most inconvenient times. Sometimes it was her hands, sometimes her hair, sometimes...
It's a part of her childhood she'd rather not think about.
CharacterArchiveContent.15803.2.cn:
小时候的菈露并不能自由地控制自己的光魔法，失控的魔法总会不合时宜地令她的身体发光，有时候是手，有时候是头发，有时候是……
那是菈露不愿意回忆的悲惨过去。

CharacterArchiveContent.15804.2.en:
"The story goes that the Snowish Tree Spirit grants children's wishes because she has to grant a hundred of them within a set time, or she'll turn into a nutcracker toy..."
The first time Laru heard this, she laughed so hard that she actually spat out her fries.
CharacterArchiveContent.15804.2.cn:
“传说雪愿树精灵之所以会回应孩子们的愿望，是因为她需要在规定时间内，实现一百个孩子的愿望，否则，她将会变成胡桃夹子玩具……”
菈露第一次听到这个说法的时候，笑得连薯条都喷了出来。

CharacterArchiveContent.15805.2.en:
Kids in the Ash District once asked Laru if she'd ever seen the Snowish Tree Spirit when she was little. Laru gave them an animated retelling of the Spirit taking her flying through the night sky, but none of the kids believed her.
"The ones who fly on brooms are witches! No way that was the Snowish Tree Spirit!"
CharacterArchiveContent.15805.2.cn:
灰城区的小孩问菈露，她小时候是否见过雪愿树精灵，菈露声情并茂地向他们讲述了雪愿树精灵带她在夜空中飞的故事，结果没有一人相信她的话。
“会骑着扫把飞的是魔女！怎么可能是雪愿树精灵呢！”

CharacterArchiveContent.15806.2.en: Some say they once saw the Snowish Tree Spirit appear at the Port, her magic drawing in a school of glowing fish through the darkness—a scene almost impossibly dreamlike.
CharacterArchiveContent.15806.2.cn: 有人说，见过雪愿树精灵出现在港口，在一片黑暗中，她的魔法招来同样发光的鱼群——那是一个梦幻至极的场景。

CharacterArchiveContent.15807.2.en:
"Maybe the Snowish Tree Spirit likes fries, too?"
Every child who claims to have seen her says the same thing: Before the Spirit left, she told them she was heading to the Port to get some fries.
CharacterArchiveContent.15807.2.cn:
“也许，雪愿树精灵也喜欢薯条？”
每一个见过雪愿树精灵的孩子们都说：精灵离开之前，说她要去港口整点薯条。

CharacterArchiveContent.15808.2.en:
The little girl in that old photo... That was actually Laru, wasn't it?
—Freesia

When we got short-staffed and asked her to help hand out gifts, I was actually worried that she might play hooky like usual. The fact that she could actually be diligent in her work caught me by surprise.—Angie
CharacterArchiveContent.15808.2.cn:
那张老照片上的小女孩，其实是菈露吧？
——苍兰
最开始因为人手不足让她去帮忙发礼物时，还担心过她会不会像平时那样偷懒开溜，没想到她也有认真工作的一面。
——安琪

CharacterArchiveContent.15809.2.en:

—Willow

CharacterArchiveContent.15810.2.en:
The Gift-Delivery Machine

After plenty of trial and error, Laru eventually realized that, given the current level of Novian technology, building a truly practical "gift-delivery machine" just wasn't possible.
So during a Monolith expedition, she made a wish at the Wishing Box, hoping the Monolith's Artifacts would make up for what science couldn't. But at the very moment she made the wish, her mind perhaps drifted back to that "cannon" she had tested earlier. So, a burst of brilliant light followed ... and she ended up with another one exactly like the old model...
CharacterArchiveContent.15810.2.cn:
礼物派送机

在几经折腾之后，菈露意识到，按照诺瓦当前的技术水平，是制造不出真正实用的“礼物派送机”的。
于是在一次星塔冒险中，菈露向许愿箱许愿，将希望寄托在星塔的神器上，但或许是因为她在许愿的那一瞬间想到了之前测试的那个“大炮”，于是在一道强光之后，菈露又得到了个一模一样的东西……

CharacterArchiveContent.15811.2.en:
As the midnight bells rang, the festival's liveliness faded with them. The Snowish Festival was over for another year, and deep winter had settled over the continent.
After a long day, Laru lay down on her bed and let out a slow breath.
"This year's Snowish Festival was especially busy..."
She spoke to herself as the day's moments drifted through her mind—the gifts she handed out, the children's bright smiles, and the way their eyes lit up when they saw the "Snowish Tree Spirit."
All of it made the work feel worthwhile.

Even so, there was a small gap in her satisfaction.
In the rush of handing out presents, she had ended up being the only one who didn't receive any...
Her eyes fell on the doll sitting on her desk. She turned over, let that faint disappointment slip away, and nudged herself toward sleep. The holiday was over; tomorrow was another work day.

The next morning, as Laru yawned and got ready to head out, she opened her door—and a small mountain's worth of gifts toppled forward and scattered at her feet. A slip of paper floated down along with the gifts.
She picked it up. The handwriting belonged to a colleague she knew well:
"After we finished the deliveries last night and went back to the warehouse, we realized there were a bunch of gifts labeled for you. In the chaos before the festival, they got mixed in with the kids' presents. So we brought them over for you overnight!"
Laru looked at the gifts filling her doorway. They came from her Grace Imperium colleagues, Boss, Willow, the Post Haste trio, and her fishing buddies...
Boxes of all shapes and sizes, each carrying someone's well-wishes.

The last little gap was finally filled.
"This really was a wonderful Snowish Festival..."
CharacterArchiveContent.15811.2.cn:
随着午夜钟声响起，节日的热闹也跟着远去，一年一度的雪愿节已经结束，宣告着这片大陆进入了寒风凛冽的深冬。
忙碌了一天的菈露躺在床上，长长地出了一口气。
“今年的雪愿节似乎格外忙呢……”
她自言自语道，脑海里还在回想这一天发生的种种事情——她递出去的礼物，孩子们灿烂的笑容，以及孩子们见到“雪愿树精灵”时开心得闪闪发光的眼睛。
她的忙碌是值得的。

不过，这份满足里似乎还有那么一块小小的缺憾。
在雪愿节派送礼物的自己，似乎最后成了唯一一个没有收到他人礼物的人……
菈露的视线落在桌上的玩偶，最后翻了个身，略过这无关紧要的失落情绪，哄着自己快点入睡，毕竟节日过去，明天又是一个要工作的日子。

隔天一早，当菈露打着哈欠收拾整齐准备出门时，她拉开门，堆得像小山一样的礼物轰然坍塌，散落在她脚边。与此同时，还有一张飘落的纸条。
菈露捡起来一看，是一个相熟的同僚的字迹：
“昨晚大家派送完礼物之后，才发现仓库里有好多礼物是标明要送给你的，可能节日前太混乱了，被当成了要给孩子们的礼物一起放到仓库里，所以我们连夜给你送过来了！”
菈露看着堆满门口的礼物，有来自恩赐意志的同僚们，也有魔王、薇洛、万送屋的三位以及她平时钓鱼认识的钓友送来的……
大大小小的礼物盒，都是远道而来的心意。

最后的缺憾被填补了。
“今年真是个圆满的雪愿节啊……”

CharacterArchiveContent.15812.2.en:
This ... must be a dream, right?

Laru looked down at her hands. They had no fingers, just smooth wooden shapes like a doll's. Her dress was stiff, her hair a solid carved block.
Oh, and she couldn't even speak!

She turned her rigid neck. She was basically a wooden toy now. Her joints made a rough clicking sound whenever she moved, like stop-motion animation that kept dropping frames.
"Dame, do you have any other orders? Our queen will be arriving soon."
Laru stared in confusion. She tried to ask what was going on, but she still couldn't make a sound. She could only watch as the puppet in front of her tilted its head. Like an NPC whose script had just been triggered, the puppet dutifully launched into an explanation of the game rules.
"This is the Kingdom of Fries. The hateful Shrubshrews have taken over our fry fields, and now, we're preparing to drive them out."
"By the way, Dame, you have a gun on your back. You'll surely be stronger than us footmen carrying swords, so please step up to the front line."
Laru had no way of saying no. She waved her hands in a panic, but the stiff joints moved too slowly, and the soldiers ended up pushing her to the very front.
Just then, the ground trembled. Before Laru could react, gigantic Shrubshrews charged toward them like runaway trucks.
Her eyes flew wide. All she wanted was to run.
No—no no no no...!!!

Morning light spilled across the window. Laru clutched her blanket tight, her brow furrowed, mumbling under her breath:
"Stop it... Don't chew my head... Stupid Shrubshrew... Go away..."
CharacterArchiveContent.15812.2.cn:
这……应该是一场梦吧？

菈露低头看着自己的手，像人偶一样没有手指，裙子也是硬邦邦的，连头发都变成僵硬的一片木头。
哦，她甚至还无法开口说话！

菈露转动她僵硬的脖子，她现在简直就是一个木头玩具，拧动关节发出生涩的“咔咔”声，行动像卡帧的定格动画。
“爵士还有什么吩咐吗？我们的女王很快就会到。”
菈露满脸写着疑惑，她试图开口询问，但她依然发不出声音，只能眼睁睁地看着木偶在她面前歪了歪脑袋，像被触发了固定任务，尽职地开始介绍游戏规则。
“这里是薯条之国，可恨的树树鼠侵占了我们的薯条田，现在，我们正在准备迎击那些老鼠。”
“对了，爵士，您背上有枪，一定会比我们这些拿着剑的士兵更厉害，请您站到前排去。”
菈露无法开口拒绝，她只能慌乱地挥手，但僵硬的关节动作缓慢，最终被这群士兵推到了阵线的最前方。
就在那时，地面发出震颤，还没等菈露反应过来，巨大的树树鼠像大卡车一样发狂地朝他们奔来。
菈露瞪大了双眼，只想赶紧逃离。
不！不要啊啊啊啊……！！！

清晨的日光撒在窗前，睡梦中的菈露抱紧了被子，眉头紧皱，嘴里喃喃自语：
“讨厌……不要啃我的脑袋……树树鼠……讨厌！”

CharacterArchiveContent.15813.2.en:
"Cracking a whip is basically like casting a fishing rod. You're great at fishing, so you'll definitely be able to learn the whip."

A month before the Snowish Festival, Albedo handed Laru a long whip, along with the order to master it as quickly as possible.
Albedo explained that the directive came from upper leadership and that Laru had to complete it no matter what. As for why it was so sudden, and why it had to be Laru, no one bothered to tell her.
Laru took it in stride. After all, baffling instructions from the management were nothing new. She patted her heart, promised she'd get it done, and accepted the whip with exaggerated solemnity. Then she walked out of the office, turned a corner ... and slipped out to go fishing.

But as the days passed, Laru suddenly realized that in her rush to go fishing that day, she hadn't found out what exactly counted as "knowing how to use" the whip.
"I mean... I could just use it for fishing, right? If I tie on a float and a hook, it's a little short for regular casting... But it'd be perfect for catching fish in deep wells!"
Laru held the whip and started trying to guess what the real purpose of the assignment had been.
Maybe the next Monolith expedition needed someone who could fight with a whip? But the deadline was the Snowish Festival—did they want a performance?
After thinking it over, her well-honed workplace instincts pointed her to the optimal answer: the whip had to work as a weapon while also looking good for show.
She's got it!

But as the Snowish Festival approached, nothing else was mentioned about the whip. Laru went to check with Albedo, who clearly had forgotten the whole thing.
"Oh, right, I forgot to tell you. Some Senator saw a Snowish Festival-like event in a storybook from the Monolith and wanted to copy it. The idea was to have a few beasts pull a cart and have staff act as coachmen delivering gifts. But they later decided it was way too inefficient, so the plan got dropped."
Laru took three seconds to process this. Then she stared at Albedo blankly. "... Huh?"
"Anyway, the whip they gave you also came from the Monolith. You can keep it."

Oh, well.
Laru told herself.
Every employee runs into assignments that appear out of nowhere and disappear just as mysteriously.
CharacterArchiveContent.15813.2.cn:
“甩鞭子就像甩鱼竿，你那么擅长钓鱼，一定也能学会使用长鞭吧？”

雪愿节前的一个月，菈露从奥尔贝德那拿到了一条长鞭，并要求她要在最快的时间内学会使用这根长鞭。
她说，这是顶层领导安排下来的任务，让菈露无论如何都要完成。至于为什么这么突然，又为什么偏偏是菈露，领导们都没有说明。
菈露表示理解，作为一个合格的打工人，应付领导莫名其妙的任务她擅长得很。于是她拍着胸脯，承诺自己一定按时完成任务，随后郑重地拿走那条鞭子，走出办公室，拐了个弯，溜号出去钓鱼了。

但随着日子一天一天过去，菈露突然意识到，自己那天着急去钓鱼，似乎忘了问到底要怎么样才能算“学会使用”这个鞭子。
“就这样拿来钓鱼好像也可以？绑上浮漂和鱼钩的话，虽然杆子短了点……不过用来钓深井的鱼就正好合适！”
菈露拿着鞭子，开始琢磨这个任务背后的目的。
也许是下一次星塔冒险需要使用鞭子当武器的人？但任务要求在雪愿节前学会使用，难道是想在雪愿节时搞个相关的表演？
菈露仔细琢磨了一番，多年打工人的经验让她迅速找到了最优解——这个鞭子自然是既要能当武器用，又要有观赏性。
她已经完全理解了！

转眼来到雪愿节的前几天，关于鞭子的事情却迟迟没有下文。菈露找到了奥尔贝德，对方显然也是一副忙忘了的表情。
“那个啊……忘记告诉你了，原本是元老院的某位大人从星塔里的故事书里看到了类似雪愿节的节日，想模仿书里的说法，找几只野兽来拉车，让员工去当车夫派送礼物，但后面他们又觉得这样太没效率了，所以就搁置了。”
菈露消化了三秒，露出了不解的表情：“……哈？”
“不过给你的那个鞭子也是从星塔里拿出来的，你可以留着。”

算了。
菈露安慰自己。
打工人，总会遇到这样莫名其妙开始又莫名其妙消失的任务。

CharacterArchiveContent.15903.2.en:
My field observations indicate that prior to the Springseek Festival, the population enters a frenzy of accumulation. They call it "stocking up," which involves procuring food, lanterns, and fresh clothing.
The specific targets vary by individual subject. Chixia, for example, hoards nuts. Shimiao gravitates toward confectionery. Jinglin, meanwhile, focuses on biomass for the Springseek feast...
CharacterArchiveContent.15903.2.cn:
根据这几日的观察，龙裔春节之前，人们都会前往商店购物，大家把这个行为命名为“置办年货”，意思是采购春节需要用上的东西，包括食物、灯笼、添置新衣等等。
但具体到会买什么，又会因为每个人的喜好不同而不同，比如赤霞会买大量的坚果类零食，而师渺更倾向于糖果，璟麟会考虑年夜饭要用的食材……

CharacterArchiveContent.15904.2.en:
Loongs are obsessed with fine food.
Their first instinct when they come upon new raw materials is to determine their edibility. Even if a specimen is toxic, if the flavor profile is desirable, they will invent ways to remove the poison just to eat it.
CharacterArchiveContent.15904.2.cn:
龙裔爱好美食。
无论是什么样的原材料，龙裔都会第一时间研究一下这个东西能不能吃。所以就算是有毒的材料，只要味道好吃，他们也会想方设法取出食材的毒性，然后将其做成美食。

CharacterArchiveContent.15905.2.en:
I scavenged some fascinating items in the market. Today's find was a doll with a surprisingly complete internal anatomy.
The vendor mentioned a local Xuan Shi who specializes in crafting these. I looked into it—turns out it's Chixia's senior.
If I were to pay a house call, what would be an appropriate offering? Sugar-roasted chestnuts, perhaps?
CharacterArchiveContent.15905.2.cn:
在苍梧的集市里淘到了不少有趣的东西，今天买到的是一个内部结构完整的人偶。
摆摊的小贩还告诉我，龙裔还有个擅长做人偶的玄师。我打听过了，原来是赤霞的那位师姐。
如果想登门拜访的话，带什么礼物比较好呢……糖炒栗子可以吗？

CharacterArchiveContent.15906.2.en: This region really does host some peculiar lifeforms. If my schedule permits, they're worth a thorough investigation.
CharacterArchiveContent.15906.2.cn: 这个地区确实有些特别的生物，如果有时间的话，还是很值得仔细研究考察的。

CharacterArchiveContent.15907.2.en:
I was briefed on the Five Great Mysteries of Cangwu before arriving here. Yet, I haven't encountered any supernatural phenomena. Perhaps the festivities drove them into hiding?
Though, I did spot a flaming Loong in the night sky once. I wonder if that qualifies?
CharacterArchiveContent.15907.2.cn:
来之前就听说了苍梧城有五大怪谈，但也许是因为春节期间节日氛围喜庆祥和，所以那些怪力乱神也去过节了？
不过有天晚上，我在夜空中看见一条火龙，或许这也是怪谈之一？

CharacterArchiveContent.15908.2.en:
Dr. Coronis's diet plan for my mom really worked! She has been glowing lately, and I was only ever charged the initial fee of 500 Dorra. Dr. Coronis is a saint!
—Jinglin
She really is a caring person. If you feel unwell, she's always eager to treat. Though ... the children seem terrified of her. I suspect it's that giant syringe she carries.
—Shimiao
CharacterArchiveContent.15908.2.cn:
科洛妮丝给我妈妈开的食疗药方真的有用！最近感觉妈妈的气色都变好了很多！而且这么多次了，她只在最开始收了我五百朵拉作为出诊费，她是大好人！
——璟麟
是个很热心肠的姐姐呢。有什么不舒服的地方去找她，她都很乐意帮我们治疗，但好像小孩子们都挺怕她的，可能是因为那个注射器？
——师渺

CharacterArchiveContent.15909.2.en:
Verified.<sprite name="acrchives_certified_richtext">
Although, I have to admit, the idea of Coronis taking a vacation without some ulterior motive is surprising.
—Willow
CharacterArchiveContent.15909.2.cn:
基本属实。<sprite name="acrchives_certified_richtext">
不过没想到科洛妮丝也会目的单纯地去度假，有点出乎我意料了。        
——薇洛

CharacterArchiveContent.15910.2.en:
[Addendum: The Cave Totem]
Legend speaks of a lost Loong totem hidden in a nearby cave.
I located the totem, yet I can't seem to describe its form or sketch it in my notes. Staring at those murals on the rock face, I thought I saw...
Hmm?
What did I see?
CharacterArchiveContent.15910.2.cn:
【档案附文——洞穴里的图腾】
传说这附近的洞穴里有龙裔祖先失落的图腾。
我找到了那个图腾，但我无法用语言描述它，也没办法将它绘制下来，当我凝视那些岩壁上的壁画，我仿佛看见了……
嗯？
我看见了什么？

CharacterArchiveContent.15911.2.en:
According to Jinglin, this Springseek custom was simple: cut designs into red paper and paste them on the window.

Coronis eyed the stack of red paper, perplexed. "What is the requisite shape for these cutouts?"
Jinglin dug a book out from the shelf. "I've got diagrams and tutorials right here if you want them. Usually, people pick symbols of good luck. But honestly? If you're doing it yourself, cut whatever you want."
"Anything is okay?"
"Mhm! Traditional stuff is still popular, but lots of people just freehand whatever they like now. Is there a pattern you are fond of, Coronis?"
Pattern I am fond of.
It seemed Coronis had never processed such a variable before.
"I ... do not know."
"Then just start snipping! Maybe inspiration will hit once your fingers get moving."
Jinglin thrust the paper and scissors into Coronis's hands. Coronis didn't object. Following Jinglin's lead, she folded the paper and made her first tentative cut.
The crisp rasp of scissors on paper seemed to trigger something. As she sheared away the empty space, a clear image formed in her head—just as Jinglin predicted.

"Done! Look, Coronis, I made a bunny for this year!"
"It is cute."
"What about you?"
"Me?"
Coronis unfolded her paper. Resting within the square lattice was a perfectly anatomical human skeleton.
"I found myself missing the specimens in my clinic. So, I cut this."
"... You are really consistent, Coronis. Haha."
CharacterArchiveContent.15911.2.cn:
璟麟说，所谓春节贴窗花，就是在红色的纸上剪出图案，然后贴在窗户上。

科洛妮丝看着眼前这一打红色的纸，有些疑惑地问道：“这个窗花，要剪成什么样子的？”
璟麟闻言，从书柜里翻出来一本书：“图案的话，这里有图纸和教程，一般来说都是一些美好寓意的事物啦。不过，自己剪的话，其实什么图案都可以哦。”
“剪什么都行吗？”
“嗯嗯，虽然传统的图案依然流行，但现在大家也会剪一些自己喜欢的图案，科洛妮丝有什么喜欢的图案吗？”
喜欢的图案。
科洛妮丝似乎从没思考过这样的问题。
“我不知道……”
“那就先随便剪剪吧！说不定动手的过程中就会有想法了！”
璟麟将红纸和剪刀塞到了科洛妮丝手里。科洛妮丝没有拒绝，于是她学着璟麟的样子，将红纸折叠，开始尝试剪出图形。
当裁纸的声音在耳边响起，剪刀闭合剪去纸张的某一部分时，就像璟麟所说的，科洛妮丝有了自己的想法。

“我弄完了！科洛妮丝你看，我今年剪了小兔子！”
“很可爱呢。”
“科洛妮丝剪了什么？”
“我吗？”
科洛妮丝展开红纸，四方形的镂空窗花里，是一具标准的人体骨骼。
“有点怀念我诊所里的标本了，所以剪了这个。”
“……科洛妮丝还是老样子，哈哈。”

CharacterArchiveContent.15912.2.en:
Touring the Yunji Retreat, Coronis spotted Chixia just outside the training grounds. The girl was sprawled on the floor, writing something.
"Catching up on homework?"
Coronis stepped closer, but the question died on her lips. Chixia was surrounded by a chaotic sea of paper, every sheet covered in wild, sweeping glyphs. Definitely not homework.
"It's a new talisman design! This genius idea just came to me..." Chixia looked up, sporting an ink smudge on her cheek. "Oh, hey! Perfect timing. Wanna see how a spell is created?"
Coronis raised an eyebrow. "Is this standard procedure for developing Xuan Shi arts?"
"Sort of? My Master said something about... Uh, I forget the exact words. But the point is: if I tweak existing talisman and arrays, I might accidentally invent a new move!"
"Sounds like pharmacology. You take an established formula, introduce a new variable, and hope for a breakthrough compound?"
Chixia nodded furiously. "Exactly! You get it!"
"Then by all means. Show me this new move."
"You got it. Just one last stroke here... O Heaven and Earth, Thunder and Fire, heed my command!"
Chixia slapped the talisman between her palms. Silence followed.
"Huh? Weird. I definitely did the hand seal right..."
She tried again. Instantly, the clear blue sky betrayed her. A miniature storm cloud manifested directly overhead, dumping a deluge of rain exclusively on Chixia within a tight one-meter circle.
Safe in the dry zone just a step away, Coronis studied the phenomenon with genuine surprise. "... Potent."
"Gah! No! It's a bust!"
Coronis chuckled at the dripping wet figure before her. "It seems you've synthesized an anomaly instead. Just like medical research, indeed."
CharacterArchiveContent.15912.2.cn:
科洛妮丝在参观云笈道场的时候，发现了坐在训练场外趴在地上，正在奋笔疾书的赤霞。
“你这是在做课后作业吗？”
她好奇地走近，话刚问出口，就发现赤霞正趴在满地的纸上，笔迹潇洒地画着什么——怎么看都不像是在做功课的样子。
“这是新的符纸设计，我有刚刚想到个天才的点子……”赤霞脸上还沾着墨水，她抬起头看见科洛妮丝，“原来是你啊，来得正好，要看看新的玄术被创造出来的瞬间吗？”
科洛妮丝来了兴趣：“嗯……玄师的玄术，就是这样创造出来的吗？”
“大概吧，我师父说了，呃……前面忘了，总之就是，对已有的符纸和阵法进行改造，说不定可以创造出新的招式！”
“听上去和医学研究也很像，从已有的药方和治疗手段里提取经验和灵感，然后加入一些新的尝试，就会得出全新的药剂？”
赤霞连连点头，“没错没错！就是这样！”
“那我就期待一下你今天的新招式吧。”
“没问题，等等啊，只要在这里再来一笔……天圆地方，好咧，雷火召来！”
赤霞说着，将她新画的符纸夹在掌心，等了半天，却什么事都没有发生。
“嗯？奇怪，应该就是这样合掌的……”
于是她又试了一次。下一秒晴空万里的天空突然局部暴雨，以赤霞为中心一米的范围，把她淋了个透心凉。
站在赤霞一米外的科洛妮丝看着那仅限一米范围的诡异降雨，有些惊讶，“……这么厉害？”
“啊啊，不对不对，失败了啊！”
她狼狈的样子把科洛妮丝逗笑了，“看来也是不小心做出了更奇怪的东西，还真是跟医学研究很像呢。”

CharacterArchiveContent.15913.2.en: What should you do with a potion surplus? Staring at the cauldron bubbling before her, Coronis faced a new logistical headache: where to store her "spoils." It all began with a foraging trip. The forest was a treasure trove of ingredients. Armed with The Grand Compendium of Herbs, Coronis harvested from dawn till dusk, returning to the inn with a basket bursting with herbs. The inn wasn't a clinic, and she lacked her usual equipment—hardly a trouble for Coronis. After a quick word with Shimiao, she raided a local store for kitchenware and rigged up a makeshift extraction system. The plan was routine: process the herbs, and extract the compounds. Unfortunately, she severely miscalculated the yield. By the time she realized her mistake, that single basket of raw herbs had refined into a cauldron brimming with solution. Coronis stared at the cauldron. She was technically on vacation, and the few travel vials she had packed were laughably insufficient for this volume. She needed a vessel. Something that could double as storage and a tool for immediate application... Her eyes wandered to the desk, landing on a syringe. A syringe? A thought struck her. If the syringe were simply bigger, it could hold the entire batch for easy access. It was logical. Efficient. The next morning, she asked Jinglin for a referral and tracked down an elderly artisan. Amused by her bizarre request, the artisan sketched a blueprint on the spot. "Come back in three days," he told her. Three days later, Coronis returned with a gift of fruit. The moment the door swung open, it was impossible to miss: a massive syringe dominating the parlor. "A fascinating commission," the old man said. "Take it. It's yours." "Payment? I have no use for money. To craft something this unique at my age is reward enough." "It needs a name, though. Call it an old man's habit, but a creation feels incomplete without one. I leave that honor to you. So what is it?" Coronis studied the artisan. His white hair framed a face glowing with pride, his eyes reflecting a pure, singular devotion to his craft. In his expression, she saw a mirror of her own younger self—back when she decided to devote her life to medicine. The answer came instinctively. "The Healer's Heart."
CharacterArchiveContent.15913.2.cn:
如果调配的药剂做多了，那要怎么办？
看着眼前这一锅调配好的药剂，科洛妮丝不得不开始考虑如何保存自己的“战利品”。

事情还得从科洛妮丝决定进山采药说起。
富饶的森林里几乎全是宝藏，科洛妮丝对照着她买来的《草药大全》，从早上忙活到天黑，背着满满一箩筐草药回到了旅馆。
但这里并不是她的诊所，她没有任何加工草药的工具——显然，这样的小问题难不倒科洛妮丝，在询问过师渺之后，科洛妮丝来到商店，买下了一些锅碗瓢盆，自己组装出了一个简易的萃取装置。
那么接下来，只要按照正常流程，将这些草药处理好，将想要的成分萃取出来……但她低估了自己采集到的草药数量，也低估了这些草药的药用成分含量，等她发现不对劲时，一箩筐的草药在经过提纯调配之后，变成了一大锅药剂。
科洛妮丝站在这一锅药剂前犯了难。
她是来度假的，虽然随身有一些能装药剂的瓶瓶罐罐，但储存一整锅药剂明显不可能。
得有个合适的容器才行……
这个容器最好在可以存放药剂的同时，又能方便她使用……
科洛妮丝思考着，视线落在了她桌面的那个注射器上。
注射器？
她灵机一动，如果这个注射器大到足以装下所有药剂，那岂不是随用随取？科洛妮丝立刻被自己的想法说服了，隔天一早，她向璟麟打听是否有会做注射器的工匠；最终，在璟麟的帮助下，找到了一个年迈的手艺人。
老者对科洛妮丝这个奇思妙想很感兴趣，很快为科洛妮丝画好了设计图，并约定在三天之后前来取货。

三天之后，当科洛妮丝带着水果和礼物登门拜访，打开门的一刻，她就看见了会客厅里放着一个大号的注射器。
“真是个有趣的订单，拿去吧孩子，它以后是你的了”
“钱？我不需要钱，这么大年纪还能做这么有趣的东西，我已经很满足了。”
“不过这个注射器它得有一个名字，别在意，我喜欢给我的作品起名，但现在，这个起名的权利交给你了，你觉得它应该叫什么呢？”
科洛妮丝看着眼前这个白发苍苍却又容光焕发的老者——老人眼中似乎有着某种对自己作品的执着。
那一刻，科洛妮丝似乎看见了自己初学医术时的自己。
她下意识地说出了这个注射器的名字，她说：
“它叫医者之心。”

生日：12月14日
所属：地理协会

地址：埃摩

CharacterArchiveContent.16002.2.en: Active Trekker or not, Willow is a core part of the Trekker Association. Coordinating support from behind a desk? That's just a different kind of front line to her.
CharacterArchiveContent.16002.2.cn: 无论她当不当旅人，去不去探索星塔，薇洛都是地理协会的一员，像现在这样给大家提供帮助，某种程度上也算是“留在一线”吧？

CharacterArchiveContent.16003.2.en:
Hobbies

Diving.
Back in Sailstead, Willow was actually a bit of a local swimming star.
CharacterArchiveContent.16003.2.cn:
兴趣爱好

喜欢潜水。
早年还在塞尔斯泰的时候，薇洛也是当地小有名气的游泳好手。

CharacterArchiveContent.16004.2.en:
Workaholic

Willow is a natural-born workaholic who simply can't pull herself away from a task once she starts. It's only gotten worse since she took over Emor's Trekkers' House, leaving her coworkers constantly terrified she'll work herself to death.
Yet, against all odds, she manages her stamina perfectly. She's never let exhaustion get in the way of a job.
CharacterArchiveContent.16004.2.cn:
工作狂

性格使然，对工作非常认真，以至于一投入到工作中就很难自拔，在埃摩的协会之家就任之后，这个情况更是变本加厉，连同僚都没少担心她会不会因为过劳倒下。
但至今为止，薇洛对自己的疲劳把控非常成功，从未出现过任何因为过度疲劳而搞砸事情的情况。

CharacterArchiveContent.16005.2.en:
About the Prosthetic

Nosy Trekkers constantly ask Willow how she lost her arm, but her story changes every time. Her latest pitch?
She claims she's a bionic android trying to pass as human, but her budget ran dry before she could buy synthetic skin for this final arm. Once she saves up enough Dorra, her human disguise will be complete!
The adults always laugh it off, but the kids usually buy it hook, line, and sinker.
CharacterArchiveContent.16005.2.cn:
关于机械手

总有好奇的旅人向薇洛打听她的胳膊是怎么没的，但薇洛每次给出的版本都不太一样。最近一次她讲述的故事是——
她是一个仿生机器人，虽然很想把自己彻底伪装成人类，但因为经费不足，剩下这只机械手的皮肤还没有购买，等她攒够了朵拉，就能彻底伪装成人类了！
探听八卦的旅人对这套说辞一笑而过，但跟在他身边的小孩似乎信了这个说法。

CharacterArchiveContent.16006.2.en:
"Don't Piss Willow Off"

Generally speaking, Willow is a picture of gentle, easygoing elegance.
But everyone knows the nicest people are the scariest when they snap. Cross her, and you're in for a ruthless scolding you won't soon forget.
Laru still shudders just thinking about it.
CharacterArchiveContent.16006.2.cn:
“不要惹薇洛生气”

薇洛是一个温柔、大方得体、脾气谦和的人。
但众所周知，好脾气的人一旦生气都是很恐怖的，若是惹好脾气的薇洛生气，那就要做好被狠狠训斥惩罚的准备。
菈露每次提起这件事都心有余悸。

CharacterArchiveContent.16007.2.en:
Phantom Pain

The human brain is a funny thing. Even though Willow made her peace with losing an arm long ago, her mind still occasionally "forgets," sending sharp bursts of pain down a limb that isn't there.
But the physical ache is nothing compared to the sudden flashbacks that come with it.
CharacterArchiveContent.16007.2.cn:
幻痛

人的大脑是个奇妙的器官，即便薇洛已经接受了自己失去了一条胳膊，她的大脑还是会在某些时刻，短暂地“忘记”了这件事，带来没有实体的疼痛。
但比起疼痛本身，疼痛带来的记忆回闪，似乎更让人难受。

CharacterArchiveContent.16008.2.en:
Who in the world actually enjoys working?! I don't get it, but hey, respect.
—Laru

Willow's the most reliable person I know! Whatever your problem is, she'll always sort you out with the best solution.
—Noya
CharacterArchiveContent.16008.2.cn:
这世界上怎么会有喜欢工作的人啊？！不理解但尊重。
——菈露

薇洛可是超级无敌可靠的人啊！不管是什么问题，只要你找她，她都能帮你找到最好的解决方法。
——尘沙

CharacterArchiveContent.16009.2.en:
Verified.<sprite name="acrchives_certified_richtext">

Willow's a great kid, but she seriously doesn't know when to clock out. We all wish she'd take a little more time for herself.
—Horizon
CharacterArchiveContent.16009.2.cn:
基本属实。<sprite name="acrchives_certified_richtext">

薇洛是个不错的孩子哦，就是工作起来就不知节制这点不太好，大家都希望她能多点自己的时间。
——彼岸

CharacterArchiveContent.16010.2.en:
Assistance Denied.

Regarding Trekker ███'s request for Association backing on their "Solo Monolith Climbing Livestream": Given the extreme risks and utter lack of safety protocols, the consequences of an accident would be catastrophic. The Trekker Association absolutely refuses to sponsor this project and urges all parties to stop encouraging stunts that blatantly disregard personal safety.
—Willow
CharacterArchiveContent.16010.2.cn:
援助驳回

关于来自旅人███申请的，希望得到地理协会支援的“单人爬塔挑战直播企划”，鉴于其风险性过高，安全预案完全缺失，一旦出现危险后果不堪设想，地理协会绝不支持此类企划，且呼吁各方不要鼓励这种不顾人身安全的活动。
——薇洛

CharacterArchiveContent.16011.2.en:
A small fry trinket once sat on Willow's desk.

No bigger than a palm, it occupied the top right corner and completely clashed with the rest of her tidy setup.
Yet Willow never bothered to move it. It just stayed there, eventually gathering a thin layer of dust.
Naturally, this sparked some office gossip. Did the trinket have a secret backstory? Was it a special gift, or a memento from an unforgettable day? The fry theme even led to rumors about a certain girl from Grace Imperium who regularly sneaked in through Willow's window, always bringing fresh fries with her.
Could this little knickknack be a token of their unique friendship—

"Willow! Willow! Terrible news! I lost that little fry souvenir I won in the raffle!!"
Her voice reached the office before she did. Willow looked up, finding Laru perched on the windowsill, looking absolutely crushed.
"I tore my house apart yesterday and spent all day searching my office today, but no sign of it at all!"
Willow looked at her, then glanced at the dusty trinket on the corner of her desk.
"You mean this one?"
"Huh?" Laru followed Willow's gaze and immediately hopped down from the window. "Whoa! I left it here?! You should've told me! I've been looking for it for two whole days!"

And just like that, the fry trinket vanished from Willow's desk. But a few days later, a miniature fishing rod toy appeared in that exact spot—and stayed there for the next six months.
Only this time, no one bothered to guess why it was there.
CharacterArchiveContent.16011.2.cn:
薇洛的办公桌上有一个薯条摆件。

那是一个只有巴掌大的摆件，占据在她办公桌的右上角，和整个桌子的风格都不搭。
但她似乎没有要拿走的意思，那个摆件就在那，时间久了甚至有点落灰。
于是大家开始猜测，这个摆件是否有什么不为人知的故事？难道是谁送的礼物？又或者代表着某一次值得纪念的时光？如果说是薯条，似乎有个恩赐意志的女孩经常翻窗来找她，她每次都会带薯条给薇洛。
难道这个摆件会是她们之间友谊的代表——

“薇洛！薇洛！我要跟你说个噩耗！我之前抽奖中的那个薯条纪念摆件它被我弄丢了！！”
声音比人先一步进到薇洛的办公室里。薇洛抬起头，就看到菈露一脸沮丧地坐在窗台上。
“我昨天在家里找了一天，今天又在办公室里找了一天，都没有找到！”
薇洛看着她，又看向她桌角那个落灰的摆件。
“你是说这个吗？”
“嗯？”菈露顺着薇洛的视线看去，立刻从窗台边跳了下来，“哇啊！！原来落在你这啊！！你早说嘛，我找了整整两天！”

于是，那个薯条摆件从薇洛的办公桌上消失了。但在几天后，原本放着摆件的那个位置上，出现了一个微缩钓竿玩具——之后过去整整半年，那个玩具都还在那。
但这一次，已经不会有人去猜这个玩具为何在这了。

CharacterArchiveContent.16012.2.en:
Willow and Iris locked eyes at the entrance to the crowded market, both radiating the exact same fierce resolve.
"We are not going a single cent over budget today."
"And we're scoring the absolute best deals!"
They bumped fists and plunged into the bustling market, dead set on walking away victorious.

But let's rewind...
A few days ago, after finalizing the new quarter's shopping list, the Trekkers' House staff realized with horror that the bare essentials alone would blow their entire budget out of the water.
The finance team spent all night crunching numbers and pulling their hair out until it finally hit them: Horizon had recently advanced internal funds for a shipbuilding project. They had an investor lined up, sure, but the Dorra hadn't actually cleared yet.
"Willow, what are we gonna do?! The Trekkers' House is practically out of toilet paper!"
The frantic staffer burst in right as Willow and Iris were chatting about the weekend beach market. After getting up to speed, Iris grabbed the list, gave it a quick once-over, and said, genuinely puzzled:
"But covering all this with your current budget is a total piece of cake! Leave it to me—stretching a Dorra is my superpower."

By evening, the two returned, arms practically overflowing with bags.
Tallying up the receipts, Willow shook her head in awe. "Incredible. We actually have money to spare. I seriously need you to teach me how to haggle like that."
"No way! The only reason we scored such crazy deals today was all thanks to you!"
"But I don't remember contributing?"
"Didn't you notice? You're always looking out for these vendors! The second you asked for a lower price, they were thrilled to give us a discount. That was all you!"
"Now that you mention it..."
Picturing their little market "battles" and recalling the eager, friendly voices of the vendors, Willow broke into a heartfelt smile.
"I guess I never imagined I'd be on the receiving end of everyone's kindness for a change..."

Maybe all the hard work she put in would quietly find its way back to her in different forms.
CharacterArchiveContent.16012.2.cn:
人头攒动的集市入口，薇洛和鸢尾一碰面，都从双方眼中看到了坚定的觉悟。
“今天，一定要在预算范围内。”
“买到最实惠好用的商品！”
双方伸手碰拳，抱着必胜的信念，走入这个热闹的集市。

事情还要从几天前说起。
协会之家新一季度的采购清单完成之后，工作人员震惊地发现，单是必需品的采购金额，就已经远远超过了这一季度的预算。
负责财务的工作人员算了一晚上账单，挠秃了头才想起来，前阵子彼岸推动造船计划，内部预支了一笔资金，而这笔资金虽然已经找到了投资方，但对方的汇款暂时还没有到账。
“怎么办啊薇洛！协会之家的厕所里都快没有厕纸了！”
年轻的工作人员闯进办公室时，薇洛正和鸢尾在讨论周末的沙滩集市。在听完来龙去脉之后，鸢尾接过清单扫了一眼，不解地问到：
“这个预算要买到这些东西那不是轻轻松松的事情吗？包在我身上吧，精打细算可是我的强项！”

傍晚，薇洛和鸢尾满载而归。
薇洛计算着今天的账单，忍不住感慨：“太厉害了，甚至还剩下了不少预算，砍价这件事我是要跟你学习。”
“不不不，我觉得今天砍价这么顺利，完全是因为你！”
“可是我什么都没做？”
“但这里的摊主们平时都受了你的照顾，你没发现吗？只要你问能不能便宜一点，大家都非常乐意地给了折扣价。这都是你的功劳！”
“你这么一说……”
回想起今天在集市里“战斗”的场面，想起那些摊主们热情亲切的声音，薇洛忽然由衷地笑了。
“真没想到也会有一天反过来被大家照顾了啊……”

她平日里所做的努力，或许都会在某个时刻，得到这样无声的回报。

CharacterArchiveContent.16013.2.en:
The package from Sparkla held more than just a mechanical arm. She had also slipped in a white megaphone.

Sparkla was notorious for her oddball inventions, so Willow didn't bat an eye. But when she gave the megaphone a try, its sheer volume genuinely impressed her. She figured it would be perfect for the beach—loud enough to shock reckless Trekkers out of diving into dangerous waters.
But Willow should have known better. Sparkla wasn't the type to hand over a standard-issue megaphone.
The gadget's first trick was gushing out a sea of bubbles, convincing Willow it was just a glorified toy. That is, until she fumbled a button one day. The bubbles instantly turned into explosive cannonballs, narrowly avoiding a complete catastrophe.

"Bloc! Don't you ever send me something this dangerous again!"
"Huh? But you said you were at the beach and needed a megaphone!"
"But this isn't a normal megaphone, is it? Why didn't you warn me it doubles as a weapon?!"
"Alright, alright, take it easy. I was afraid you wouldn't figure it out, so I had Sparkla put together a manual for it."
"... You had a manual this whole time, and you're only telling me now?"
"Well, you never asked, so it slipped my mind!"
Willow took a deep breath, actively fighting the urge to strangle the shady merchant. In the end, she gave Bloc a "warning smile" of her own and sent her packing.
CharacterArchiveContent.16013.2.cn:
斯帕克拉送来机械手的包裹里，还附赠了一个白色的喇叭。

那个科学怪人向来喜欢做一些奇奇怪怪的东西，薇洛并不觉得奇怪，只是在尝试使用那个喇叭时，发现是个扩音效果不错的喇叭，用在沙滩上警告不听话贸然下海的旅人，能打到一个音量震慑的效果。
但薇洛早该想到，斯帕克拉是不可能做一个普通的喇叭给她的。
在经历了这个喇叭使用时突然发射出海量的泡泡，令她以为这是个泡泡机之后，又在某一天，薇洛误触了一个按钮，喇叭发射出来的泡泡竟然变成了炮弹，差点酿成事故。

“布洛可！下次这么危险的东西就不要送过来了！”
“咿呀？你当时不是说你在海边，正好缺个扩音喇叭吗？”
“这又不是普通的扩音喇叭！你怎么没提醒我它还能攻击！”
“好嘛好嘛，你消消气，当时怕你用不明白，我还让斯帕克拉给你做了个使用说明书。”
“……有使用说明书你到现在才拿出来？”
“那不是你没问，我忘了嘛！”
薇洛深呼吸，薇洛告诉自己不要跟这个奸商生气，最终，布洛可被“微笑警告”着送出了办公室。
