CharacterCG.15901.1.cn: 科洛妮丝（新春）-回忆特写

CharacterDes.103.10.en: An AoE build that enhances skills, allowing them to be cast consecutively.
CharacterDes.103.10.cn: 增强技能，使其可连续释放的群伤流派。

CharacterDes.103.11.en: A sustained DPS build that extends skill duration and generates Shadows.
CharacterDes.103.11.cn: 延长技能时间并追加残影的持续输出流派。

CharacterDes.103.12.en: A burst DPS build that allows skills to quickly deal DMG multiple times.
CharacterDes.103.12.cn: 技能可快速造成多次伤害的爆发输出流派。

CharacterDes.103.3.en: The agile dual pistols allow Amber to sashay across the battlefield. Enemies who try to get close to her will turn into ashes long before they can reach her perimeter.
CharacterDes.103.3.cn: 灵活的双枪让琥珀自由地奔驰在战场上，试图接近琥珀的敌人，会在琥珀的十步之外化为灰烬。

CharacterDes.103.9.en: An AoE build that reloads additional ammo after casting a skill, enhancing Auto Attack DMG.
CharacterDes.103.9.cn: 施放技能后额外装弹，增强普攻的群伤流派。

CharacterDes.107.10.en: A build that continuously weakens enemies, deals DMG, and enhances the shield-raising duration.
CharacterDes.107.10.cn: 不断削弱敌人并造成伤害，强化举盾持续期间的流派。

CharacterDes.107.11.en: A build that hurls shields, continuously applying Marks to targets hit.
CharacterDes.107.11.cn: 投掷飞盾，持续对命中的目标施加印记的流派。

CharacterDes.107.12.en: A build that hurls shields at all nearby enemies and the main Trekker.
CharacterDes.107.12.cn: 对周围所有敌人以及主控角色掷出飞盾的流派。

CharacterDes.107.3.en: Tilia will always be charging at the forefront, using her shield to protect everyone. Guess only another Imperial Knight might break through her defense.
CharacterDes.107.3.cn: 缇莉娅永远会冲在最前线，用她的盾牌保护大家。只有帝国骑士的矛，才能击破帝国骑士的盾。

CharacterDes.107.9.en: A build that grants powerful shields through enhanced counterattacks and enhances the moment of shield-raising.
CharacterDes.107.9.cn: 强化反击获得强力护盾，强化举盾瞬间的流派。

CharacterDes.108.10.en: A build that loads flame bullets to deal DMG over time.
CharacterDes.108.10.cn: 装填火焰子弹后，可持续造成伤害的流派。

CharacterDes.108.11.en: A build that calls in bombardments to create sustained DMG zones.
CharacterDes.108.11.cn: 呼叫火力轰炸，制造持续伤害区域的流派。

CharacterDes.108.12.en: A build that calls in multiple rounds of precision bombardments.
CharacterDes.108.12.cn: 呼叫多轮精准火力轰炸的流派。

CharacterDes.108.3.en: Kasimira wields a brutal shotgun. She often puts herself in the line of fire in order to get a hit on her enemies. No matter what, her enemy will fall first.
CharacterDes.108.3.cn: 卡西米拉握持着可以发射霰弹的凶暴武器，她习惯以伤换伤，不论如何，敌人都会比她更早倒下。

CharacterDes.108.9.en: A build that loads flame bullets to deal massive single-target DMG.
CharacterDes.108.9.cn: 装填火焰子弹后，可造成巨大单次伤害的流派。

CharacterDes.110.10.en: A summoner build that enhances clone capabilities and attack synergy.
CharacterDes.110.10.cn: 增强分身能力与协同攻击的召唤流派。

CharacterDes.110.11.en: A build that amplifies skill activation effects and boosts sustained DPS at the target's location.
CharacterDes.110.11.cn: 增强技能发动特效，提升原地持续输出能力的流派。

CharacterDes.110.12.en: A build that empowers clones summoned via skills, increasing their numbers and duration.
CharacterDes.110.12.cn: 增强技能召唤出的分身，提升分身数量与持续时间的流派。

CharacterDes.110.3.en: Firenze can summon doppelgangers to fight for her on the battlefield. Rumor has it that she does the same in her office, which is how she always manages to stay so graceful.
CharacterDes.110.3.cn: 战场上，翡冷翠可以释放分身进行战斗。有传闻说，她在工作中也是如此，所以才能时刻保持优雅。

CharacterDes.110.9.en: A build that enhances combat mobility and skill activation frequency.
CharacterDes.110.9.cn: 提升战斗灵活性与技能发动频率的打击流派。

CharacterDes.111.10.en: A build that empowers the second phase of skills to deal massive DMG over time.
CharacterDes.111.10.cn: 强化技能二段，持续造成大量伤害的流派。

CharacterDes.111.11.en: A build that summons ice pillars to draw enemies and deal DMG over time.
CharacterDes.111.11.cn: 召唤冰柱吸引敌人并造成持续伤害的流派。

CharacterDes.111.12.en: A build that summons ice pillars, dealing DMG upon their creation and shattering.
CharacterDes.111.12.cn: 召唤冰柱，在冰柱出现与破碎时造成伤害的流派。

CharacterDes.111.3.en: Iris' notebook is filled with magical formulas. Little-trained in close combat, she prefers to use ice to wear down the enemy from a safe distance.
CharacterDes.111.3.cn: 鸢尾的笔记本里装满了魔法公式。缺乏锻炼的她不擅长近身战。保持安全距离，用寒冰消耗敌人吧。

CharacterDes.111.9.en: A build that enhances skills to summon ice walls that freeze enemies.
CharacterDes.111.9.cn: 强化技能，可发动冰墙冻结敌人的流派。

CharacterDes.112.10.en: A ranged control build that enables ranged Auto Attacks after casting a skill.
CharacterDes.112.10.cn: 施放技能后，可发动远程普攻的远程牵制流派。

CharacterDes.112.11.en: An AoE build that boosts the range and DMG of sword auras.
CharacterDes.112.11.cn: 剑气范围更大，伤害更高的群伤流派。

CharacterDes.112.12.en: A focused build that increases the number of sword auras and allows them to split.
CharacterDes.112.12.cn: 剑气数量提升，并可分裂攻击的集中型流派。

CharacterDes.112.3.en: Noya uses techniques no one has ever seen, learned from an unknown source. Even skill-casting does not interrupt her long sword's movements.
CharacterDes.112.3.cn: 尘沙使用着不知从何处学来的，从未有人见过的招式。即使释放技能，也不会中断她长剑的轨迹。

CharacterDes.112.9.en: An AoE build that transforms skills into multi-phase attacks with slashes.
CharacterDes.112.9.cn: 技能变为多段、穿插斩击的群伤流派。

CharacterDes.113.10.en: A build that adds water ripples to skills, boosting melee DMG.
CharacterDes.113.10.cn: 技能追加水波纹，提升近距离伤害的流派。

CharacterDes.113.11.en: A build that increases the number and speed of water blades, enabling sustained high single-target DPS.
CharacterDes.113.11.cn: 提升水剑数量与速度，持续定点高速输出的流派。

CharacterDes.113.12.en: A versatile DPS build that extends the duration and allows water blades to penetrate targets with enhanced single-target DMG.
CharacterDes.113.12.cn: 延长在场的时间，水剑可穿透并提升单发伤害的灵活输出流派。

CharacterDes.113.3.en: In addition to offering long-term on-site support to her companions, Shimiao is also skilled at handling problems herself. Perhaps this is why she embodies the perfect secretary.
CharacterDes.113.3.cn: 除了善于辅助他人，提供长时间现场支援，师渺同样擅长亲自解决问题。或许，这便是身为秘书的本色吧。

CharacterDes.113.9.en: A ranged AoE build that grants Super Armor upon skill activation and increases the attack range.
CharacterDes.113.9.cn: 技能追加霸体并提升攻击距离的远距群伤流派。

CharacterDes.114.10.en: A build that marks targets with a laser to deal continuous DMG to them.
CharacterDes.114.10.cn: 通过激光标记目标，使目标持续受到伤害的流派。

CharacterDes.114.11.en: A build that deals massive DMG over time to a single target.
CharacterDes.114.11.cn: 对单个目标持续造成高额伤害的流派。

CharacterDes.114.12.en: A build that deals AoE DMG to multiple targets.
CharacterDes.114.12.cn: 对群体目标造成范围伤害的流派。

CharacterDes.114.3.en: Chaton is the sniper of White Cat Troupe. Though fond of close combat, in the end she chose a customized weapon as tall as herself, one that can only be used from a distance.
CharacterDes.114.3.cn: 猫眼是白猫剧团的狙击手，喜欢近战的她，最终拿起了长度堪比身高，只能在远处等待的特殊武器。

CharacterDes.114.9.en: A build that throw Bouncing Bombs to attack multiple targets.
CharacterDes.114.9.cn: 通过丢出「弹球炸弹」，攻击多个目标的流派。

CharacterDes.115.10.en: A DPS build that spreads Avalanche: Floating Cannons' firepower and excels at attacking multiple targets.
CharacterDes.115.10.cn: 「雪崩·浮游炮」分散火力，擅长打击复数目标的输出流派。

CharacterDes.115.11.en: A DPS build that enhances Avalanche: Flying Blade, specializing in striking a target with high-frequency attacks.
CharacterDes.115.11.cn: 强化「雪崩·飞刃」高频攻击目标的输出流派。

CharacterDes.115.12.en: A DPS build that enhances Avalanche: Giant Sword, continuously striking the target with heavy blows.
CharacterDes.115.12.cn: 强化「雪崩·巨剑」持续重击目标的输出流派。

CharacterDes.115.3.en: Firefly, who controls transformable armament, is said to be a super weapon secretly developed by Grace Imperium. The firefly-like glow, when gathered in multitude, can become a cannon capable of extreme destruction.
CharacterDes.115.3.cn: 操纵着可变形兵装的火垂，据说是恩赐意志秘密研发的超级武器。萤火般的微光，聚集起来也能毁天灭地。

CharacterDes.115.9.en: A DPS build that concentrates Avalanche: Floating Cannons' energy and focuses on a single target.
CharacterDes.115.9.cn: 「雪崩·浮游炮」汇聚能量，专注单目标的输出流派。

CharacterDes.116.10.en: A build that boosts ATK SPD and frequently triggers bullet effects upon skill activation.
CharacterDes.116.10.cn: 发动技能后提升攻速，并高频触发子弹效果的流派。

CharacterDes.116.11.en: A DPS build that boosts the DMG and hit count of skills.
CharacterDes.116.11.cn: 提升技能伤害与次数的直伤流派。

CharacterDes.116.12.en: A build that delays skill spread to trigger Mark DMG.
CharacterDes.116.12.cn: 使技能可延迟传播，触发印记伤害的流派。

CharacterDes.116.3.en: Ridge is a United Harvest Forester with a habit of stockpiling food. She has a shovel that can fire energy blasts, and she fights alongside the seed plants she scatters on the field.
CharacterDes.116.3.cn: 岭川是一个喜欢囤积食物的护林员，她的铲子能够发射能量炮弹，并配合她投下的种子植物共同作战。

CharacterDes.116.9.en: A build that summons plants to attack nearby targets upon skill activation.
CharacterDes.116.9.cn: 发动技能可召唤植物群攻击附近目标的流派。

CharacterDes.117.10.en: A build that casts chain lightning after unleashing a thunderbolt.
CharacterDes.117.10.cn: 释放雷击后，可释放连锁闪电的流派。

CharacterDes.117.11.en: A build that summons a Thunder Domain to deal AoE high-frequency DMG.
CharacterDes.117.11.cn: 召唤雷电领域，并造成大范围高频伤害的流派。

CharacterDes.117.12.en: A build that summons a Thunder Domain to control enemies and deal burst DMG.
CharacterDes.117.12.cn: 召唤雷电领域，并造成控制与爆发伤害的的流派。

CharacterDes.117.3.en: Jinglin can summon lightning and fill the area around her with golden strikes. Though there is no consensus on the origin of this power, Jinglin herself believes that it was granted to her by the Divine Tree in Cang Wu city.
CharacterDes.117.3.cn: 璟麟能召唤雷电，让身边布满金色的落雷。虽然众说纷纭，但璟麟认为，这是苍梧神树赐予她的力量。

CharacterDes.117.9.en: A build that progressively enhances single-target thunderbolt DMG.
CharacterDes.117.9.cn: 可持续提升单体雷击伤害的流派。

CharacterDes.118.10.en: A DPS build that accumulates and consumes Energy to launch Shadow Scythe to slice targets.
CharacterDes.118.10.cn: 持续积攒、消耗能量发射「镰影」切割目标，集中伤害型的流派。

CharacterDes.118.11.en: A build that launches Shadow Scythe with skills, capable of performing multiple horizontal sweeps against a single target.
CharacterDes.118.11.cn: 随技能可发射「镰影」，并可对单体发动多次横斩的流派。

CharacterDes.118.12.en: A support build that pulls powerful enemies and drops Potent Potions that enhance the main Trekker.
CharacterDes.118.12.cn: 可牵引强敌，并掉落增强主控的「改造药水」的辅助流派。

CharacterDes.118.3.en: A doctor obsessed with researching strange malady. She wields a scythe, dispenses deadly poisons, and moves through the battlefield with grace.
CharacterDes.118.3.cn: 沉迷研究疑难杂症的医者，她挥动镰刀，操控剧毒，飘然穿梭于战场。

CharacterDes.118.9.en: A build that increases the number of skill attack hits and progressively expands their range.
CharacterDes.118.9.cn: 提升技能攻击段数，并逐次提升范围的流派。

CharacterDes.119.10.en: A build that enhances dart attack range and enables multi-hit DMG, ideal for fighting large targets.
CharacterDes.119.10.cn: 提升飞镖伤害范围并可多段伤害，适合对付大型目标的流派。

CharacterDes.119.11.en: An AoE build that triggers Ventus Marks when hitting multiple targets, reducing cooldown greatly.
CharacterDes.119.11.cn: 命中多目标触发风印记，即可大幅缩短冷却并再次发动的群伤型流派。

CharacterDes.119.12.en: A single-target build that continuously tracks and pursues targets, gradually increasing detonation DMG.
CharacterDes.119.12.cn: 持续跟踪追击目标，并逐渐提升引爆伤害的单体型流派。

CharacterDes.119.3.en: Nanoha is a maid working at Goodwind who is also skilled in "Flower" Ninjutsu. She takes pride in her Sunflower Shuriken, which can hit its target while moving at high speed.
CharacterDes.119.3.cn: 花原是谷风的女仆，擅长以“花”为名的忍术。她引以为傲的葵花飞镖，能在高速移动中命中目标。

CharacterDes.119.9.en: A build that increases ATK SPD and dart count, with consecutive hits triggering additional AoE DMG.
CharacterDes.119.9.cn: 提升攻速与飞镖数量，多次命中还可造成额外群伤的流派。

CharacterDes.120.10.en: A single-target build that enhances Auto Attacks after casting a skill, with a chance to fire additional bullets.
CharacterDes.120.10.cn: 施放技能后强化普攻，并有概率射出额外子弹的单体流派。

CharacterDes.120.11.en: A melee AoE build that increases the range of Laurel Wreaths and shortens the Attack Interval.
CharacterDes.120.11.cn: 花环范围更大，伤害间隔缩短的近战群伤流派。

CharacterDes.120.12.en: A ranged AoE build that increases the rotation speed of Laurel Wreaths and adds extra DMG per orbit.
CharacterDes.120.12.cn: 花环环绕速度更快，每次环绕造成额外伤害的远程群伤流派。

CharacterDes.120.3.en: The legendary "Devil Teacher" as the students called. Her mysterious laurel bracelet can unleashes unexpected effects in battle.
CharacterDes.120.3.cn: 传闻中的魔鬼教师，她使用的神秘桂冠，会在战斗中发挥令人意想不到的效果。

CharacterDes.120.9.en: An AoE build that increases the number and rotation speed of Flying Leaves, continuously attacking multiple targets along their path.
CharacterDes.120.9.cn: 飞叶数量和环绕速度提升，持续打击飞行路径上不同目标的群伤流派。

CharacterDes.123.10.en: A build that fires laser beams, dealing penetration DMG, and support Trekkers can activate additional laser beams by triggering marks.
CharacterDes.123.10.cn: 喷射激光贯通伤害，且援护角色通过触发印记也可发动激光的流派。

CharacterDes.123.11.en: A build that increases the number of walls of wind and applies shields to them, improving the squad's survivability.
CharacterDes.123.11.cn: 提升风墙数量并附加护盾，提升队伍生存能力的流派。

CharacterDes.123.12.en: A build that allows walls of wind to deal DMG over time and enhances friendly projectiles that pass through them, ideal for pairing with a ranged main Trekker.
CharacterDes.123.12.cn: 风墙持续造成伤害并增强穿越的友方飞弹，适合与远程主控搭配的流派。

CharacterDes.123.3.en: Coco the Firefang is Ann's best friend. Wind is also Ann's friend. With help from these friends, Ann is the fastest Trekker around.
CharacterDes.123.3.cn: 火狼可可是杏子的朋友，风也是杏子的朋友。在朋友的帮助下，杏子是本地跑得最快的旅人。

CharacterDes.123.9.en: A build with a higher chance to trigger Wind Bursts, knocking back enemies and making them take increased DMG.
CharacterDes.123.9.cn: 更高概率产生「风爆」，击飞并使敌人受到更多伤害的流派。

CharacterDes.125.10.en: A build that deals DMG through continuous spinning slashes.
CharacterDes.125.10.cn: 通过持续旋转斩击输出的流派。

CharacterDes.125.11.en: A build that generates numerous Ice Blossoms, ideal for fighting large enemies.
CharacterDes.125.11.cn: 生成大量冰花，适合对付大体型敌人的流派。

CharacterDes.125.12.en: A build that continuously generates Ice Blossoms to attack enemies while Berserk.
CharacterDes.125.12.cn: 狂化时持续产生冰花攻击敌人的流派。

CharacterDes.125.3.en: The ancient "Frenzy" magic fuels Freesia to keep fighting until utter exhaustion. This is the dark side of the usually graceful girl—one that should be kept from others.
CharacterDes.125.3.cn: 远古传承的“狂化”魔法让苍兰不停地战斗，直到体力耗尽。这是不宜被人看到的，优雅少女的暗面。

CharacterDes.125.9.en: A DPS build that combines multiple spinning slashes with Auto Attacks.
CharacterDes.125.9.cn: 可多次旋转斩击，配合普攻输出的流派。

CharacterDes.126.10.en: A penetration build that creates clones, causing Auto Attacks to split and continuously inflict marks.
CharacterDes.126.10.cn: 产生分身，使普攻分裂并持续附加印记的穿透型流派。

CharacterDes.126.11.en: A mark infliction build that increases the number of Soulflare Butterflies, allowing them to split continuously.
CharacterDes.126.11.cn: 炎蝶数量提升，炎蝶可持续分裂的印记附加流派。

CharacterDes.126.12.en: A Crit build that increases the number of Mindflare Butterflies, increasing the main Trekker's DMG.
CharacterDes.126.12.cn: 沐蝶数量提升，提升主控伤害的暴击流派。

CharacterDes.126.3.en: Flora goes on tour in Nova to perform her original magic performance. Her fiery butterflies may seem fragile, but they are perfect fire starters that can burn her enemies into ashes.
CharacterDes.126.3.cn: 紫槿在诺瓦巡回表演她独创的魔术，她释放出的火蝶看似弱小，实则会成为引火的佳物，燃尽敌人。

CharacterDes.126.9.en: A sustained AoE build that increases the number of Top Hats and allows them to be recycled.
CharacterDes.126.9.cn: 提升魔术帽数量并使其可回收的持续群伤型流派。

CharacterDes.127.10.en: A survival build that grants shields after casting a skill and randomly restores squadmates' Energy.
CharacterDes.127.10.cn: 施放技能后获得护盾，并随机提升队友能量的生存型流派。

CharacterDes.127.11.en: A build that grants a shield, with attacks from the shielded main Trekker generating water ripples, ideal for a melee main Trekker.
CharacterDes.127.11.cn: 获得护盾，护盾中的主控角色的攻击会生成水波纹，适合近战主控的流派。

CharacterDes.127.12.en: A build that creates a Tidal Domain to knock back enemies and boost the main Trekker's DMG within the area, ideal for a ranged main Trekker.
CharacterDes.127.12.cn: 生成可击退目标的浪域，提升浪域中的主控角色伤害，适合远程主控的流派。

CharacterDes.127.3.en: Teresa has extensive experience in wilderness exploration and understands the importance of conserving stamina.
CharacterDes.127.3.cn: 特丽莎有着丰富的野外探险经验，深知保存体力的重要性。

CharacterDes.127.9.en: A build that increases skill hits and generates additional water ripples, boosting DMG and mark infliction.
CharacterDes.127.9.cn: 技能段数提升并额外生成水波纹，提升伤害与印记能力的流派。

CharacterDes.130.10.en: A build that synergizes with doll attacks, improving ATK and skill synergy.
CharacterDes.130.10.cn: 配合人偶的输出，提升攻击与技能联动的流派。

CharacterDes.130.11.en: A build that concentrates attacks on targets in front.
CharacterDes.130.11.cn: 集中攻击前方目标的强攻流派。

CharacterDes.130.12.en: A volley build that randomly attacks nearby targets.
CharacterDes.130.12.cn: 随机攻击周围目标的散射流派。

CharacterDes.130.3.en: Donna, brimming with energy and optimism, is the heart and leader of Post Haste. Her arrows make short work of anything standing in the mail's way.
CharacterDes.130.3.cn: 多娜是万送屋的领袖与纽带，活力满满，自信而乐观；她的利箭会突破一切试图阻挡邮路的存在。

CharacterDes.130.9.en: A build that fires more and stronger arrows, significantly enhancing Auto Attacks.
CharacterDes.130.9.cn: 发射更多更强的箭矢，提升普攻能力的流派

CharacterDes.132.10.en: A build that enhances the two-phase attacks of skills, enabling consecutive skill casting for sustained DPS.
CharacterDes.132.10.cn: 强化技能的两段打击，连续释放技能输出的流派。

CharacterDes.132.11.en: A build that scatters stars that attach to targets, dealing DMG over time.
CharacterDes.132.11.cn: 挥洒可附着目标的星星，持续造成伤害的流派。

CharacterDes.132.12.en: A build that scatters stars that attach and weaken enemies, granting a shield to the main Trekker.
CharacterDes.132.12.cn: 挥洒可附着并削弱目标的星星，并为主控施加护盾的流派。

CharacterDes.132.3.en: As the leader of the Ashwind Clan, Minova rarely operates alone. Her greatest asset in battle is not her skateboard or baseball bat, but her companions.
CharacterDes.132.3.cn: 作为灰风俱乐部的领导者，密涅瓦很少单独行动。战斗中，她最大的依仗绝非滑板和球棒，而是伙伴。

CharacterDes.132.9.en: A build that adds a 3rd attack to skills, synergizing Auto Attacks and skill combos for optimal DMG.
CharacterDes.132.9.cn: 技能追加第三段打击，普攻与技能配合输出的流派。

CharacterDes.133.10.en: A burst DPS build that allows the wind to pull monsters together and penetrate targets.
CharacterDes.133.10.cn: 吹风追加聚怪效果并可贯穿攻击的爆发伤害流派。

CharacterDes.133.11.en: A single-target build that consecutively generates petals that relentlessly track and attack targets.
CharacterDes.133.11.cn: 连续生成持续追踪目标的花瓣的单体流派。

CharacterDes.133.12.en: An AoE build that creates a Flower Formation, synergizing with Ventus DMG.
CharacterDes.133.12.cn: 生成花海，并可协同风系伤害的群伤流派。

CharacterDes.133.3.en: A powerful trekker who wields Ventus magic, her exceptional judgment is an innate gift that makes her a natural leader.
CharacterDes.133.3.cn: 操控风之魔法的强大旅人，优秀的判断力是身为领导者的她与生俱来的天赋。

CharacterDes.133.9.en: A DPS build that significantly increases the duration and range of the wind.
CharacterDes.133.9.cn: 大幅提升吹风时长和范围的持续伤害流派。

CharacterDes.134.10.en: A build that instantly dumps Ammo, dealing massive DMG with high-frequency Auto Attacks.
CharacterDes.134.10.cn: 倾泻弹药，然后使用基础普攻高频输出的流派。

CharacterDes.134.11.en: A build that gathers power to deal massive single-target DMG.
CharacterDes.134.11.cn: 汇聚力量，发动单次巨量伤害的流派。

CharacterDes.134.12.en: A build that deals rapid, multi-hit DMG to targets over time.
CharacterDes.134.12.cn: 持续对目标造成高频多段伤害的流派。

CharacterDes.134.3.en: Though somewhat shy, she has formidable strength. It's hard to imagine that her heavy gauntlets are in fact "restraints" for her natural immense power.
CharacterDes.134.3.cn: 性格有些怕生，却实力高强的旅人。很难想象，这副沉重的手甲其实是她天生怪力的限制器。

CharacterDes.134.9.en: A build that increases Magazine Capacity and strikes enemies with enhanced Auto Attacks.
CharacterDes.134.9.cn: 提升弹匣上限，使用强化普攻猛击敌人的流派。

CharacterDes.135.10.en: A build that enhances the control and sustain of phantoms, ideal for fighting elite targets.
CharacterDes.135.10.cn: 增强影灵的控制能力与持续作战能力，适合对付精英目标的流派。

CharacterDes.135.11.en: A build that extends skill duration and continuously boosts phantoms' DMG on the battlefield.
CharacterDes.135.11.cn: 延长技能时长，持续增强场上影灵伤害的流派。

CharacterDes.135.12.en: A build that allows skills to pull enemies and boosts the Explosion DMG of phantoms, ideal for the melee main Trekker.
CharacterDes.135.12.cn: 使技能可牵引敌人并增强影灵的自爆攻击，适合近战主控的流派。

CharacterDes.135.3.en: Mistique is the witch of Scarlet Sights Media. She has two summons that help her strike down her enemies in exchange for their "sustenance": Real news and truth.
CharacterDes.135.3.cn: 雾语是绯瞳传讯的魔女，擅长驱使召唤灵，以真相为食的召唤灵会帮助雾语清扫敌人，换取食物。

CharacterDes.135.9.en: An AoE build that increases skill range and DMG, causing phantoms to deal Explosion DMG to enemies upon disappearance.
CharacterDes.135.9.cn: 提升技能范围与伤害、影灵消失后可爆破敌人的群伤流派。

CharacterDes.140.10.en: A Rabbit Pie build that switches modes and unleashes charged bursts, specializing in clearing out groups of enemies.
CharacterDes.140.10.cn: 兔子派切换模式，蓄力后打出爆发，擅长消灭群体目标的流派。

CharacterDes.140.11.en: A Super Action Pie build focused on enhanced burst power, dealing massive damage in a short window.
CharacterDes.140.11.cn: 超级行动派爆发力加强，短时间内造成大量伤害的流派。

CharacterDes.140.12.en: A Super Action Pie build focused on endurance, allowing you to coordinate with squadmates for a relentless assault on enemies.
CharacterDes.140.12.cn: 超级行动派持续力加强，配合队友持续打击敌人的流派。

CharacterDes.140.3.en: Sparkla's Super Action Pie and Rabbit Pie builds can shift into different modes to counter enemies depending on battlefield conditions.
CharacterDes.140.3.cn: 斯帕克拉的超级行动派和兔子派可以根据不同的战场环境，变形为不同的模式针对敌人。

CharacterDes.140.9.en: A Rabbit Pie build that switches modes to unleash sustained firepower, specializing in taking down single targets.
CharacterDes.140.9.cn: 兔子派切换模式，持续倾泻火力，擅长消灭单个目标的流派。

CharacterDes.141.10.en: A DPS build that boosts the burst DMG of flames.
CharacterDes.141.10.cn: 提升喷火的爆发伤害，追求集中火力输出的流派。

CharacterDes.141.11.en: A build that allows skills to summon multiple Crimson Dragons for ranged attacks.
CharacterDes.141.11.cn: 技能可召唤多个赤龙，发动远程攻击的流派。

CharacterDes.141.12.en: A build that allows skills to summon a Tiger of the East for melee attacks.
CharacterDes.141.12.cn: 技能可召唤一个寅虎，发动近战攻击的流派。

CharacterDes.141.3.en: Nobody would expect a Xuan Shi to be so timid. Her giant writing brush is a modified flamethrower and also her instrument in drawing powerful talismans.
CharacterDes.141.3.cn: 明明身为玄师却意外的胆小，巨大的毛笔是改造过的喷火器，也是她绘制最强符纸的伙伴。

CharacterDes.141.9.en: A build that extends the duration of flames and enhances Auto Attacks when there is enough heat.
CharacterDes.141.9.cn: 提升喷火的持续时间，并在热量足够时强化普攻的流派。

CharacterDes.142.10.en: A single-target combat build that allows skills to enhance Auto Attacks and inflicts marks.
CharacterDes.142.10.cn: 技能可强化普攻并附加印记，单体作战型流派。

CharacterDes.142.11.en: A build that enhances claw strike range and pulls targets, synergizing with the main Trekker's attacks.
CharacterDes.142.11.cn: 增强爪击范围并牵引目标，配合主控攻击的流派。

CharacterDes.142.12.en: A build that increases the number of claw strikes and boosts the squad's DPS.
CharacterDes.142.12.cn: 提升爪击次数并强化队伍伤害，支援全队输出的流派。

CharacterDes.142.3.en: Whether the steel claws she'd scavenged or the left hand imbued with special magic, Cosette uses her weapons to break the chains of fate.
CharacterDes.142.3.cn: 无论是捡来的武器钢爪，还是寄宿了特殊魔法的左手，都是珂赛特撕破命运锁链的武器。

CharacterDes.142.9.en: A build that allows support Trekkers' attacks to increase the activation frequency of Main Skills.
CharacterDes.142.9.cn: 援护角色的攻击可提升主控技能发动频度，协同型流派。

CharacterDes.143.10.en: A build that enhances the ranged DMG of skills and Auto Attacks, significantly boosting ranged DPS.
CharacterDes.143.10.cn: 强化技能和普攻的远程攻击，提升火力，远程输出的流派。

CharacterDes.143.11.en: A build that allows skills to generate ground fissures and Whirlwinds, boosting sustained DPS.
CharacterDes.143.11.cn: 技能产生地裂与旋风，提升持续输出能力的流派。

CharacterDes.143.12.en: A build that enhances skill range and DMG, boosting burst DMG potential.
CharacterDes.143.12.cn: 强化技能范围与伤害，提升瞬时输出能力的流派。

CharacterDes.143.3.en: Hailing from the frozen land of Norstheim, she is an elite warrior of the Sentinel of Dawn. A master of all weapons, she pays extra attention to cases involving Nocturn Eterna.
CharacterDes.143.3.cn: 自极寒北境而来，黎明近卫的精锐战士。她精通各种武器，对有关永夜的案件总是格外上心。

CharacterDes.143.9.en: A melee build that generates Whirlwinds to destroy projectiles when activating a skill or Auto Attack.
CharacterDes.143.9.cn: 发动技能和普攻时，产生旋风摧毁飞弹，近战输出的流派。

CharacterDes.144.10.en: A skill build that allows skills to enhance Coiling Serpents and create Mirror Images.
CharacterDes.144.10.cn: 技能可强化腾蛇并生成镜影的技能流派。

CharacterDes.144.11.en: A Crit build that increases skill activation count and DMG upon Crit Hits.
CharacterDes.144.11.cn: 在技能暴击时，提升技能次数与伤害的暴击流派。

CharacterDes.144.12.en: A sustained DPS build that allows skills to consecutively generate Mirror Images and inflict Blade Mark, dealing DMG multiple times.
CharacterDes.144.12.cn: 技能可连续生成镜影并附加刀光，造成多次伤害的持续输出流派。

CharacterDes.144.3.en: Chitose is a formidable warrior who sees herself as the blade, with a presence as sharp as steel. Her blade can summon flowing currents, shaping them into water serpents that crash through enemy lines.
CharacterDes.144.3.cn: 千都世是以刀为自我，身披锐气的强大武者。她的刀法可聚集水流，化作水蛇之势摧毁敌阵。

CharacterDes.144.9.en: An Auto Attack build that generates Coiling Serpents and Mirror Images upon skill activation.
CharacterDes.144.9.cn: 发动技能后，普攻可生成腾蛇与镜影的普攻流派。

CharacterDes.145.10.en: A build that increases stack count and hit frequency to boost Skill DMG.
CharacterDes.145.10.cn: 提升技能叠加层数与命中次数，强化技能输出的流派。

CharacterDes.145.11.en: A build that combines sustained Support DMG with frequent Ultimate use.
CharacterDes.145.11.cn: 兼具援护的持续伤害与高频绝招释放能力的流派。

CharacterDes.145.12.en: A Skill-focused build centered on high burst DMG and concentrated attacks.
CharacterDes.145.12.cn: 主打高爆发伤害、聚焦小范围攻击的技能强化流派。

CharacterDes.145.3.en: A mysterious ninja who walks the night, wielding a long umbrella—its ribs as blades, its sleeves concealing deadly edges.
CharacterDes.145.3.cn: 行于暗夜的神秘忍者，执一柄长伞，伞骨为刃，袖里藏锋。

CharacterDes.145.9.en: A build that reduces Ultimate cooldown, enabling frequent Ultimate use.
CharacterDes.145.9.cn: 减少绝招冷却时间，高频释放绝招的流派。

CharacterDes.147.10.en: A positional warfare build that enhances the attack range and increases the attack frequency of Boomboxes summoned by skills.
CharacterDes.147.10.cn: 强化技能召唤的音响的伤害范围与攻击次数的阵地战流派。

CharacterDes.147.11.en: A build that enhances the number and DMG of sweep attacks, ideal for fighting large groups of enemies.
CharacterDes.147.11.cn: 强化横扫攻击的次数与伤害，适合对付大群敌人的流派。

CharacterDes.147.12.en: A single-target build that increases the number of Musical Notes and enhances their ricochet effect.
CharacterDes.147.12.cn: 强化音符数量与弹射效果，适合对付单体目标的流派。

CharacterDes.147.3.en: Enchanted by the music in the Monolith, the virtuoso bassist dazzles her audience with ease. Not even Stellaroids or monsters can withstand the shockwaves she creates.
CharacterDes.147.3.cn: 沉醉于“星塔之音”，技巧精湛的贝斯乐手。即使是星骸和魔物也难以招架她演奏的震撼。

CharacterDes.147.9.en: A flexible build that interacts with Boomboxes summoned by skills and allows enhanced Auto Attacks to trigger marks.
CharacterDes.147.9.cn: 与技能召唤的音响交互，强化普攻触发印记的灵活型流派。

CharacterDes.149.10.en: A skill build that increases the number of targets linked by skills and creates chain reactions with Trekkers.
CharacterDes.149.10.cn: 提升技能链接目标数，并与角色产生连锁反应的技能流派。

CharacterDes.149.11.en: A burst build that increases the number of chain shovels and allows chain shovel dragging to deal additional DMG.
CharacterDes.149.11.cn: 提升链铲数量，并可拖拽链铲额外造成伤害的爆发流派。

CharacterDes.149.12.en: A build that allows the Trekker to continuously generate shockwaves to deal DMG over time.
CharacterDes.149.12.cn: 角色持续存在并产生震荡的持续伤害流派。

CharacterDes.149.3.en: Gerie brandishes her chain-shovel "Mercy" with reckless abandon on the battlefield, crushing swathes of foes. She sows terror into her opponent's soul before delivering judgment.
CharacterDes.149.3.cn: 格芮在战场上肆意地挥舞链铲“宽恕”，拖拽、压制大片的敌人，播撒直抵灵魂的恐惧并完成制裁。

CharacterDes.149.9.en: An Auto Attack build that increases Movement SPD, attack range, and DMG after casting a skill.
CharacterDes.149.9.cn: 施放技能后，提升移速、攻击范围和伤害的普攻流派。

CharacterDes.150.10.en: A build that increases the number of skill hits and deals DMG multiple times.
CharacterDes.150.10.cn: 提升技能攻击段数，并造成多次伤害的流派。

CharacterDes.150.11.en: A build that generates a large number of continuously erupting light pillars.
CharacterDes.150.11.cn: 生成持续喷发的大量光柱的流派。

CharacterDes.150.12.en: A build that allows light pillars to strike enemies with greater precision.
CharacterDes.150.12.cn: 使光柱更精准打击敌人的流派。

CharacterDes.150.3.en: Cutting through her enemies with her spear of thunder, Laru is a flash darting across the battlefield. Here, her free spirit is out in full force.
CharacterDes.150.3.cn: 挥舞雷霆的长枪横扫一切，化作闪光肆意穿梭，在战场上，菈露总算是有机会挥洒她那自由的灵魂了。

CharacterDes.150.9.en: A build that generates multiple types of lightning to deal DMG over time after casting a skill.
CharacterDes.150.9.cn: 施放技能后，生成多种雷电造成持续伤害的流派。

CharacterDes.155.10.en: A build that enhances the Night Rabbit drone, ideal for fighting multiple targets.
CharacterDes.155.10.cn: 强化「夜兔」无人机，适合对抗群体目标的流派。

CharacterDes.155.11.en: A support build that summons multiple drones after the skill ends to deal continuous DMG.
CharacterDes.155.11.cn: 在技能结束后召唤多台无人机持续进行打击的援护流派。

CharacterDes.155.12.en: A support build that deals burst DMG by triggering more surfing attacks when the skill is active.
CharacterDes.155.12.cn: 在技能持续期间发动更多次的冲浪攻击造成爆发伤害的援护流派。

CharacterDes.155.3.en: Shia is the definition of agility. Riding her surfboard alongside Snow Rabbit and Night Rabbit, she unleashes a tidal onslaught that crashes through everything in its path.
CharacterDes.155.3.cn: 希娅的行动十分灵敏。她身踏冲浪板，与麾下的“雪兔”和“夜兔”一起，组成势不可挡的巨浪攻势。

CharacterDes.155.9.en: A build that enhances the Snow Rabbit drone, ideal for fighting a single target.
CharacterDes.155.9.cn: 强化「雪兔」无人机，适合对抗单体目标的流派。

CharacterDes.156.10.en: A build that increases reload speed, allowing for more frequent activation of Whirlwind Shot.
CharacterDes.156.10.cn: 提升换弹频率，更高频发动旋风射击的流派。

CharacterDes.156.11.en: A build that increases the probability of drawing a "penguin," throwing penguin statues and increases the main Trekker's DPS.
CharacterDes.156.11.cn: 提升抽奖结果中“企鹅”的概率，抛掷企鹅雕像，提升主控输出能力的流派。

CharacterDes.156.12.en: A build that increases the probability of drawing a "heart," shoots heart arrows and enhances the main character's survivability.
CharacterDes.156.12.cn: 提升抽奖结果中“爱心”的概率，射出爱心箭矢，提升主控生存能力的流派。

CharacterDes.156.3.en: Nazuna fights with her trusty hand crossbow and her puppet companions at her side. Her out-of-the-box ideas and uncanny luck always bring pleasant surprises to the squad.
CharacterDes.156.3.cn: 小禾使用手弩与她心爱的娃娃一同作战，她的奇思妙想与幸运值，总能为团队提供意料之外的惊喜。

CharacterDes.156.9.en: A build that increases doll DMG and adds recovery, improving sustained combat capability.
CharacterDes.156.9.cn: 提升玩偶伤害并追加回复，提升持续作战能力的流派。

CharacterDes.157.10.en: A build that boosts the effects of Hunting Energy & Hunter's Mark and enhances Auto Attacks.
CharacterDes.157.10.cn: 提升狩能与猎标的效果，强化普攻的流派。

CharacterDes.157.11.en: A build that allows Boss Shark to deal DMG in a larger area and apply special effects.
CharacterDes.157.11.cn: 鲨老大造成更大范围伤害与附加特殊效果的流派。

CharacterDes.157.12.en: A build that increases hit count and triggers bonus explosions.
CharacterDes.157.12.cn: 提升攻击段数，并附加额外爆炸效果的集中伤害流派。

CharacterDes.157.3.en: Karin carries her fishing harpoon and charges in alongside the fierce Boss Shark. Together, they'll raise havoc on the battlefield!
CharacterDes.157.3.cn: 花铃扛起捕鱼枪，与那位凶猛的鲨老大一同登场，一人一鱼的合作将为战场掀起滔天巨浪。

CharacterDes.157.9.en: A build focused on coordinated hunting with Boss Shark, boosting its DMG.
CharacterDes.157.9.cn: 与鲨老大协同狩猎，强化其伤害的流派。

CharacterDes.158.10.en: A build that enhances her own skills to perform multiple AoE attacks, ideal for fighting multiple targets.
CharacterDes.158.10.cn: 强化自身技能，发动多段范围攻击，适合对抗群体敌人的流派。

CharacterDes.158.11.en: A Support build that enhances the cannon and deals massive damage.
CharacterDes.158.11.cn: 强化大炮，爆发式输出的援护流派。

CharacterDes.158.12.en: A Support build that enhances the toy and deals continuous damage.
CharacterDes.158.12.cn: 强化玩具，持续输出的援护流派。

CharacterDes.158.3.en: Laru, dressed as the Holy Night Messenger, is on a special mission for the Snow Wish Festival. In the chiming bells at midnight, tin soldiers and saluting cannons will bear witness to a shimmering miracle.
CharacterDes.158.3.cn: 打扮成圣夜使者的菈露，正进行雪愿节特派。在圣夜凌晨的钟声里，锡兵与礼炮将见证一场闪烁的奇迹。

CharacterDes.158.9.en: A build that enhances the toy army for cooperation, ideal for fighting a single enemy.
CharacterDes.158.9.cn: 强化玩具大军，协同自身作战，适合对抗单体敌人的流派。

CharacterDes.159.10.en: A build that deals AoE skill damage and triggers combos with Auto Attacks.
CharacterDes.159.10.cn: 技能范围造成伤害的同时，与普攻有联动伤害的流派。

CharacterDes.159.11.en: A Support build that instantly detonates Rose Vials, dealing massive damage.
CharacterDes.159.11.cn: 玫瑰药剂变为瞬爆，造成高额伤害的援护流派。

CharacterDes.159.12.en: A Support build that generates extra Wither Vials to enhance sustained damage.
CharacterDes.159.12.cn: 生成更多枯萎药剂，加强持续输出能力的援护流派。

CharacterDes.159.3.en: Clad in traditional Loong attire, Coronis is enjoying her vacation in Cangwu. Her carefully brewed potions are a testament to her intense "affection."
CharacterDes.159.3.cn: 科洛妮丝身穿龙裔的传统服饰，正在苍梧享受她的假期。精心调配的药剂，是她浓烈的“爱意”。

CharacterDes.159.9.en: A build that enhances Auspice to deal rapid damage to single targets.
CharacterDes.159.9.cn: 强化瑞兆，高频率对抗单体敌人的流派。

CharacterDes.160.10.en: A build centered on rapid bounces from the Bubble Frog to unleash Echoing Soundwave.
CharacterDes.160.10.cn: 通过泡泡蛙高频弹跳，扩散声波回响的流派。

CharacterDes.160.11.en: A build that fires piercing water jets to strike enemies while inflicting powerful debuffs on targets.
CharacterDes.160.11.cn: 以水柱射线发动攻击，同时给目标附加减益的流派。

CharacterDes.160.12.en: A build rapidly unleashes piercing soundwaves while granting stats buffs to the squad.
CharacterDes.160.12.cn: 能够高速释放穿透音浪，同时提升全队属性的流派。

CharacterDes.160.3.en: Rocking a swimsuit chosen by everyone, Willow is finally learning how to kick back and enjoy a work-free vacation.
CharacterDes.160.3.cn: 薇洛穿上了大家为她挑选的泳装，学着享受完全没有工作的假期。

CharacterDes.160.9.en: A build centered on enlarging the Bubble Frog to deal massive AoE damage.
CharacterDes.160.9.cn: 泡泡蛙持续增大，造成大范围伤害的流派。

CharacterSkin.10303.2.en:
Woven from flowing flames and adorned with golden clouds—a majestic spirit, fierce and free.
Rawr—
CharacterSkin.10303.2.cn:
锦绣织就流火，金饰点缀祥云。不怒自威、顾盼神飞。
嘎呜——

CharacterSkin.10304.2.en: Following the hot sea breeze, I steal a moment from the carnival to catch your eye. It was serene.
CharacterSkin.10304.2.cn: 顺着炙热的海风，捉住那狂欢的隙间，悠悠然望向你的视线。

CharacterSkin.10703.2.en:
Suit up, transform! My fighting spirit burns hotter than the sun!
Clad in the armor of justice, I'll defend every street like a knight—
This is my justice!
CharacterSkin.10703.2.cn:
系紧腰带，利落变身，斗志如烈阳般炽热！
披上正义的战衣，以骑士之姿守护每一条街道——
此即吾之正义！

CharacterSkin.11103.2.en: In the pale winter sunlight, you hold a warm drink as your breath creates a white mist. You, who see yourself as just ordinary, are the one who makes this day special.
CharacterSkin.11103.2.cn: 冬日清冷阳光下的你，捧着热饮呼出白气的你，自诩平凡普通的你，却构成了这个日子全部的意义。

CharacterSkin.11104.2.en:
Uh... I'll do my best to keep this inflatable steady, but please be careful getting on board.
—A-And of course, if you fall into the water, I'll definitely pull you back up!
CharacterSkin.11104.2.cn:
那个……我会尽量稳住这个充气玩偶，但上来时还是请小心一些。
——当，当然，如果你不小心落水了，我肯定也会拉住你的！

CharacterSkin.11203.2.en:
Sun, sand, and sea—time to slip into your swimsuit!
Feel the warm sun on your skin and the gentle kiss of the waves. Summer's calling, just don't forget your sunscreen!
CharacterSkin.11203.2.cn:
来到大海，来到沙滩，当然得换上泳衣。
怀抱热情的太阳，享受海浪的轻拍——与夏天的亲密接触，得务必注意防晒！

CharacterSkin.11303.2.en:
No chili pepper spirits allowed inside Cangwu!
T-To protect Cangwu's peace, I, Shimiao, the ma-magical girl of love and justice, demands that you transform back to your original form right now!
CharacterSkin.11303.2.cn:
苍梧城内严禁辣椒成精！
为、为了守护苍梧的和平，坚、坚持爱与正义的魔法少女，师渺命令你！快点变回原来的样子！

CharacterSkin.11603.2.en: The best moment I can think of is having a nap in the cozy warmth of the afternoon. When you wake up, the sunlight dances along the windowsill, and the flowers welcome your awakening.
CharacterSkin.11603.2.cn: 我能想到最幸福的时刻，就是在午后的温暖中小憩。醒来时阳光晒过窗脚，而花朵仍在等你。

CharacterSkin.11903.2.en: The wind sways the clouds as dust dances in sunlight. Only the flowers witness the moments we share.
CharacterSkin.11903.2.cn: 风摇云影间，曦光舞沙尘。与君共度时，唯有花窥见。

CharacterSkin.12003.2.en:
Meticulous thinking, precise calculations, and textbook movements.
Sprint, jump, spike—everything executed exactly as planned, but the body just can't keep up with the mind.
—Huh? What do you mean I'm number one on the popularity poll!?
CharacterSkin.12003.2.cn:
思维缜密，计算严谨，动作标准。
冲刺，起跳，扣杀，一切都如计划执行，可身体却跟不上思考。
——嗯？人气榜第一又是什么意思啦！？

CharacterSkin.12303.2.en: Little princess, who fell into a wonderland and got lost in a labyrinth of time, there's no need to hurry for the exit, for the best scenery lies hidden within those seemingly absurd dreams.
CharacterSkin.12303.2.cn: 从古老的树洞跌入奇境，误入时间迷宫的小小公主啊，不必急于寻找出口，因为最棒的风景就藏在那些看似荒诞的梦里。

CharacterSkin.12503.2.en: The Snowish Festival she dreams of is a warm, cozy fire, a glass of sweet wine in hand, her best friends' laughter, and a unique gift just for her—from you.
CharacterSkin.12503.2.cn: 她所期盼的雪愿节，是一炉温暖的火焰，一杯香甜的果酿，亲密好友的笑语，以及一份来自你的、独一无二的礼物。

CharacterSkin.12703.2.en: Grab the village's finest sword and set off on Teresa's epic quest! Huh? A shiny gold treasure chest? Let's open it—Whoa! What in the world is this?
CharacterSkin.12703.2.cn: 拿起村里最好的宝剑，踏上勇者特丽莎的传奇冒险！欸~金光闪闪的宝箱？让我打开看看——呜哇——这是什么东西？！

CharacterSkin.13203.2.en:
The coolness of the desk beneath my arms, the warmth of the sun on my back.
The scent of books enchants me, as I drift into a gentle daydream.
CharacterSkin.13203.2.cn:
手臂传来课桌板的清凉，后背感知洒落阳光的温暖。
书本的芬芳令人陶醉——这是一场微醺的白日梦。

CharacterSkin.13204.1.en: Rippling Void of the Darkest Heartbreak

CharacterSkin.13204.2.en: Having practiced a cold expression for the hundred-and-first time, I saw you the moment I turned my head. And so, all my pretenses collapsed, leaving only shyness behind.
CharacterSkin.13204.2.cn: 对着镜子练习第一百零一次的冷酷表情，却在转头瞬间看到了你。于是所有伪装都崩溃，只剩下羞意。

CharacterSkin.13303.2.en: A light breeze, as flowers bloom in the summer air. A gentle touch, like the hand that held the pinwheel with yours.
CharacterSkin.13303.2.cn: 一缕气息，初夏的花朵悄然绽放。一种触感，就像与你一同握住风车的那只手。

CharacterSkin.13403.2.en: Clock in on time? Check. Prep the materials? Check. Work hard, stay focused... Whoa there, how did I mess it up again?
CharacterSkin.13403.2.cn: 按时打卡不迟到，材料认真准备好。勤勤恳恳，战战兢兢。哎呦喂——扑通，怎么还是搞砸了？

CharacterSkin.13503.2.en: Indulge in the sweetness of cocoa as a broom zooms across the starlit sky. Leave your worries behind. This is an adventure meant just for you.
CharacterSkin.13503.2.cn: 沉醉于可可的甜蜜，扫帚划过星空，将烦恼抛之脑后——这是只属于你们的浪漫冒险。

CharacterSkin.13504.2.en:
Even a witch who feeds on truth deserves a little break once in a while.
Stretching out while enjoying the sunset—what could be more relaxing than this?
CharacterSkin.13504.2.cn:
哪怕是以真相为食的魔女，也偶尔需要一段时间的悠闲假日。
伸着懒腰，看着夕阳，能有什么比这更悠闲的呢？

CharacterSkin.14103.1.en: Crimson Reflection of Queen of Hearts

CharacterSkin.14103.2.en:
Who says the world in the mirror is mere illusion?
The moment she dons the queen's crown, hero and villain trade places. Madness becomes rule, and the spotlight turns her way.
—Welcome to the Queen of Hearts' wonderland.
CharacterSkin.14103.2.cn:
谁说镜中的世界就是虚幻？
当她戴上皇后的冠冕，主角与反派位置对调，荒诞成了律法，舞台中心向她转移。
——欢迎来到属于红皇后的奇境。

CharacterSkin.14203.1.en: A Taste of Summer All to Herself

CharacterSkin.14203.2.en:
Summer by the sea is just sunshine, seawater, and sand. Nothing that special…
Wait, what?! You're saying there are icy cold drinks you can only get on the island?! Then I'm definitely going too!
CharacterSkin.14203.2.cn:
夏日的海边不过是阳光海水和沙滩，也并没有什么特别的——
什么？！你说有海岛特供的清凉饮料？！那我也要去！

CharacterSkin.14403.1.en: When Morning Glories Bloom, Her Eyes Open

CharacterSkin.14403.2.en: A morning glory kept in water... How long before its color fades, before its scent drifts away?
CharacterSkin.14403.2.cn: 养在水里的牵牛花——它的鲜亮和淡香，能保持多久呢？

CharacterSkin.14703.2.en:
Beep boop beep, make way! The show is about to begin!
Just listen—a dreamy, mellow, fluffy, thumpy bass dreamscape!
CharacterSkin.14703.2.cn:
滴滴嘟滴嘟，让一让！演出马上就要开始啦——
请听——梦梦萌萌，软软咚咚，叮叮当当的贝斯梦境！

CharacterSkin.14903.2.en: From bitter coffee to blooming roses, I want to share every new experience with you. Let's go on a date when the snow melts?
CharacterSkin.14903.2.cn: 咖啡的酸涩，蔷薇的芳香，想将一切新奇的体验都与你分享。融雪后，来一场约会吧？

CharacterSkin.15603.2.en: Isn't this what life is all about? A slice of opera cake, a cup of black tea. Dreams swell and rise until the teapot starts to sing.
CharacterSkin.15603.2.cn: 生活不过是如此吧：吃一块歌剧院，再沏一壶红茶。梦想正在膨胀，直至茶壶吐出蒸汽泡泡。

CharacterSkin.15901.1.cn: 科洛妮丝（新春）-基础形象

CharacterSkin.15902.1.cn: 科洛妮丝（新春）-觉醒形象

CookieLevel.1001.2.en: Assemble cookie gift boxes following the given pattern!
CookieLevel.1001.2.cn: 按照图样指示装配曲奇礼盒，按部就班完成工作！

CookieLevel.1002.2.en:
Assemble cookie gift boxes following the given pattern!
Bigger gift boxes may appear!
CookieLevel.1002.2.cn:

DatingCharacterEvent.103301.1.en:
Suddenly, you and Amber hear a cat meowing.

Amber dashes off to search for the source of the sound and quickly finds a kitten.
DatingCharacterEvent.103301.1.cn:
突然，你和琥珀都听到了猫的叫声。
琥珀立刻动身，在黑暗中闪转腾挪，很快循着声音发现了一只小猫。

DatingCharacterEvent.103301.2.en: You are amazed by her magical "cat-attracting aura." Gasping for breath, you tell her that you can't keep up with her pace.
DatingCharacterEvent.103301.2.cn: 你惊讶于她神奇的“吸猫体质”，并气喘吁吁的表示，你跟不上她的节奏。

DatingCharacterEvent.103301.3.en:
Amber holds the cat in her arms, a hint of reluctance on her face—she knows the New Star Guild isn't in a position to take it in.

So, the two of you choose to fully enjoy this moment of tranquility... with the kitten.
DatingCharacterEvent.103301.3.cn:
抱起了猫的琥珀，露出了有些恋恋不舍的表情——她知道，现在的空白旅团，大概没有收养它的条件。
于是，你们肆意地享受起了这段安宁的时间。

DatingCharacterEvent.103301.6.cn: 在港口的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.103301.7.en:
You and Amber came across a lost kitten at the Port. It was attracted by the fish smell.

Although you weren't in a position to adopt it, the two of you enjoyed your time spent with the kitten.
DatingCharacterEvent.103301.7.cn:
和琥珀在港口遇到了被鱼腥味吸引的小猫。
虽然没有收养的条件，但你们和小猫在一起度过了一段愉快的时光。

DatingCharacterEvent.103303.1.en: You and Amber walk into the student cafeteria, look around and finally find a counter that doesn't require a student card to pay. You both point across the counter at the dishes you want, but the way the cafeteria auntie swings her ladle gives you a bad feeling.
DatingCharacterEvent.103303.1.cn: 你和琥珀走进了学生食堂，一番寻找下，终于瞧见个无须使用学生卡付款的档口。你们隔空指着想吃的菜品，但当食堂阿姨的大勺挥舞起来时，你感到一丝丝不妙。

DatingCharacterEvent.103303.2.en: At first, she scoops up five meatballs at once, and you and Amber gasp quietly. With a flick of her wrist, one rolls away. Another shake, another meatball slips out. By the time she serves the dish, she kept another meatball in the ladle.
DatingCharacterEvent.103303.2.cn: 起初，阿姨一勺子捞起来五个丸子，你和琥珀轻声惊呼。随后，阿姨手腕轻轻一抖，一颗丸子便从勺子中飞走了。紧接着又是一次摇晃，又有一颗滑落了。最后阿姨将菜盛进盘子时，甚至还剩下一颗留在勺子里。

DatingCharacterEvent.103303.3.en: The two of you stare miserably at the plate. One meatball for each of you, but what about the rest? You exchange helpless glances at the impossible pile of green leaves. Sigh—maybe you'll take Amber somewhere else to eat after this.
DatingCharacterEvent.103303.3.cn: 你和琥珀苦恼地看着盘中仅剩的两颗丸子与大量菜叶。丸子一人一颗，那剩下的部分呢？你们面面相觑，长久地望着盘中的绿色地狱。哎——待会再带琥珀去其他地方吃点吧。

DatingCharacterEvent.103303.6.cn: 在学院的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.103303.7.en:
At the student cafeteria, you and Amber experienced the infamous "ladle technique". Your heartbeats rushed with each swing of the ladle.

Why is it that even in the cafeteria, what you see is never what you get?
DatingCharacterEvent.103303.7.cn: 与琥珀在学院食堂感受到了学生间盛传的打菜技法，你们的心也随着翻飞的勺子起伏不定。为什么连在食堂打菜也做不到所见即所得呢？

DatingCharacterEvent.107301.1.en:
The shop employee eagerly points to a poster, explaining a promotion.

Unexpectedly, Tilia leans in to scrutinize the fine print.
DatingCharacterEvent.107301.1.cn:
店员指着店内的海报热情地介绍起了活动。
令人意外的是，缇莉娅端详起了活动的细节。

DatingCharacterEvent.107301.2.en:
"Hmm, as far as I can tell from the description here, there doesn't seem to be any rule violations."

She sighs and returns to her seat.
DatingCharacterEvent.107301.2.cn:
“嗯，至少从活动来看，没有什么违规之处。”
她叹了口气，又回到了座位上。

DatingCharacterEvent.107301.3.en:
"Hmph, I guess I might be a little too obsessed with Imperial Guard's work," she says, scratching her head in embarrassment.

Still, you can't help but feel that she's radiating the aura of a "champion of justice."
DatingCharacterEvent.107301.3.cn:
“啊哈，好像我有点太沉迷工作了。”她有些不好意思的摸摸自己的头。
不过你却觉得，此刻的她，确实有几分“正义使者”的光辉在闪烁。

DatingCharacterEvent.107301.6.en: Visit the Dessert Shop to unlock
DatingCharacterEvent.107301.6.cn: 在甜品屋的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.107301.7.en:
You and Tilia came across a raffle event at the dessert shop.

Her first instinct, however, was to check if the event was complying with all regulations.

What a diligent and justice-minded will-be knight she is... If only all Imperial Guard Knights were as dedicated as her.
DatingCharacterEvent.107301.7.cn:
和缇莉娅在甜品屋遇到了抽奖活动。
她的第一反应却是检查活动有没有违规的地方。
真是努力而有正义感的骑士啊……要是所有的卫队骑士都能像她一样认真就好了。

DatingCharacterEvent.107302.1.en: A furtive-looking man pushes past you and walks away briskly, nearly causing you to lose your balance.
DatingCharacterEvent.107302.1.cn: 一个鬼鬼祟祟的人挤开你快步走过，你险些没站稳。

DatingCharacterEvent.107302.2.en:
In the distance, the shout of "Stop, thief!" rings out, and Tilia immediately springs into action, chasing after the commotion.

She quickly intercepts the suspect, shows him her credentials, and begins to question him. The case is solved on the spot.
DatingCharacterEvent.107302.2.cn:
远处传来了“抓小偷”的声音，缇莉娅立刻反应过来，追上前去。
很快，她拦下可疑人士，并拿出证件盘问了起来。一场盗窃案就这样被当场解决了。

DatingCharacterEvent.107302.3.en:
"Sorry, please give me a moment to make a call... Hmph, wasting my time—it's supposed to be my day off!"

The on-duty knights soon arrive at the scene, allowing the two of you to resume your day of leisure. You notice that Tilia's smile seems just a little brighter than before.
DatingCharacterEvent.107302.3.cn:
“不好意思，稍等我联络一下……哼，耽误我时间，今天我可是在放假呢！”
其他在岗的骑士们很快到达了现场，你们放心地继续今天的逛吃之旅——你发现，缇莉娅脸上的笑容更开朗了一分。

DatingCharacterEvent.107302.6.cn: 在集市的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.107302.7.en:
While strolling through the market with Tilia, the two of you encountered a thief.

Even though it was her day off, Tilia swiftly apprehended the criminal. Although it cost her a bit of free time, her smile grew even brighter after justice was upheld.
DatingCharacterEvent.107302.7.cn:
和缇莉娅逛集市时，遇上了小偷。
虽然缇莉娅在放假，但她还是二话不说抓住了犯罪者——虽然耽误了一小会时间，但惩恶扬善后，缇莉娅的笑容显然绽放的更灿烂了。

DatingCharacterEvent.108301.1.en:
You and Kasimira reach a cliff.

"There's a shortcut this way," she says.

She extends her hand out to you.
DatingCharacterEvent.108301.1.cn:
你和卡西米拉来到了一处断崖。
“从这里走，路比较近。”
说完，她伸出了手。

DatingCharacterEvent.108301.2.en:
Just as you're wondering what Kasimira has planned, she grabs your arm, effortlessly lifts you up, and in a few swift, powerful jumps, lands on the other side of the broken bridge.

Before you can even wrap your head around what just happened, she gently sets you down—her agility and strength leave you thoroughly impressed.
DatingCharacterEvent.108301.2.cn:
正当你疑惑她要如何行动时，她抓起了你的臂膀，轻松地托起了你，几下迅猛的跳跃，就抵达了断崖的对面。
还没等你搞清状况，就已被轻轻放在了地上——她的矫健身姿给你留下了深刻的印象。

DatingCharacterEvent.108301.3.en:
"It's nothing. This is nowhere near as dangerous as the battlefield."

Even though her words are confident, you're certain you saw a flash of nervousness on her face just now.

You wonder—What could have caused her to falter, even for a single moment?
DatingCharacterEvent.108301.3.cn:
“没事，这种程度，远不及战场危险。”
她自信的话语很好地掩盖住了刚刚那一刻的小慌乱。
你不禁有些好奇，是什么让她小小地动摇了一下。

DatingCharacterEvent.108301.6.cn: 在洞窟的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.108301.7.en:
While exploring the cave with Kasimira, you came across a broken bridge.

She escorted you across the gap in just a few swift leaps. As she soars with you in her arms, you finally understand why they are called the White Cat Troupe.
DatingCharacterEvent.108301.7.cn:
和卡西米拉探索洞窟时，遇到了一处断崖。
她护送着你几步就跃过了障碍。当她抱着你飞跃在空中时，你突然体会到白猫剧团这几个字的具象化表现

DatingCharacterEvent.108302.1.en:
You decide to try your luck at the market's game area because every participant gets a chance at a raffle.

At the dart booth, Kasimira grabs 20 darts without any hesitation.
DatingCharacterEvent.108302.1.cn:
你们决定去集市的游戏区试试手气，听说每位参与的顾客都可以抽奖。
在飞镖的摊位前，卡西米拉大手一挥，直接拿了20枚。

DatingCharacterEvent.108302.2.en:
Bullseye, bullseye, bullseye...

By the time Kasimira throws her tenth dart, the center of the target is already running out of space.

The booth owner awkwardly suggests, "Maybe you can take a break and just claim the grand prize already."
DatingCharacterEvent.108302.2.cn:
正中圆心，正中圆心，正中圆心……
在扎到第十个飞镖时，靶子的中间已经快扎不下更多的飞镖了。
店主有些尴尬的说，要不就歇歇，直接先把大奖领走吧？

DatingCharacterEvent.108302.3.en:
"The prize doesn't really matter. I just think this is pretty fun."

Thus you quietly stand to the side, watching her darts hitting bullseye after bullseye.

It's time for her to fully enjoy herself.
DatingCharacterEvent.108302.3.cn:
“奖品其实没关系。我只是觉得这还挺好玩的。”
于是，你在一旁安静地看着她的飞镖继续正中着圆心。
这回就让她好好过一把瘾。

DatingCharacterEvent.108302.6.cn: 在集市的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.108302.7.en:
Kasimira, with her gunfighting skills, made the dart game look effortless.

You thought she was aiming for the grand prize, but it turned out she was genuinely enjoying the thrill of hitting every bullseye.
DatingCharacterEvent.108302.7.cn:
用枪战斗的卡西米拉，对飞镖游戏也是信手拈来。
原以为她是想干净利落地扫荡大奖，没想到她是真的很享受百发百中的感觉。

DatingCharacterEvent.108303.1.en:
You and Kasimira had just changed into yukatas for a relaxing soak when she abruptly blocked your path, her expression turning dead serious.
"Something suspicious just darted past," she warned. "Stay behind me, just in case."
DatingCharacterEvent.108303.1.cn:
你与卡西米拉换好浴衣，正准备好好享受一场放松的温泉泡汤时，卡西米拉却突然严肃地拦住了你。
“刚刚有个可疑的黑影一闪而过。以防万一，请待在我的身后。”

DatingCharacterEvent.108303.2.en:
Before you could say a word, Kasimira bolted into the room after the intruder.
A brief scuffle broke out, followed by dead silence.
"Kasimira, are you okay?"
When she didn't answer, you threw back the curtain, only to find her cradling a baby monkey.
DatingCharacterEvent.108303.2.cn:
未等你多做提醒，卡西米拉便灵巧地窜入房间，试图抓住那个黑影。
一阵动静过后，房间里安静了下来。
“卡西米拉，你没事吧？”
没有等到回答的你匆匆掀开帘子，只见卡西米拉怀里抱着一只小猴子。

DatingCharacterEvent.108303.3.en:
"We picked a great spot!" she beamed. "They say running into a monkey at the hot springs brings good luck."
Whether or not it brought you two any luck, the monkey certainly hit the jackpot—it walked away with Kasimira's entire snack stash.
DatingCharacterEvent.108303.3.cn:
“我们真是找到了一个好地方！听说泡汤的时候遇到小猴子，会有幸运的事情发生。”
虽然现在的你们尚不知幸运是否会降临，但对那只小猴子来说，它获得了卡西米拉所有的零食，真是一件幸运的事情啊。

DatingCharacterEvent.108303.6.en: Visit Hot Spring Resort to unlock
DatingCharacterEvent.108303.6.cn: 在温泉度假村的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.108303.7.en: Just as you and Kasimira were about to hit the hot springs, you found a baby monkey had beaten you to the water. Deeming it a lucky charm, Kasimira gladly handed over all her snacks to the little guy.
DatingCharacterEvent.108303.7.cn: 你与卡西米拉正准备泡汤，发现有一只小猴子抢先你们一步。卡西米拉告诉你这可是幸运的象征，毫不犹豫地将自己的零食贡献了出来。

DatingCharacterEvent.110301.1.en:
"Honestly, I'm pretty surprised," says Firenze, with amused curiosity.
"By what?"
"The place you picked. I thought you'd go for something like the library... Do you see me more as a foodie than a good student?"
DatingCharacterEvent.110301.1.cn:
“说实话，我觉得挺惊讶的。”翡冷翠饶有兴致地说。
“什么？”
“在选择地点这件事上。我以为你会觉得图书馆之类的地方会更适合我……难道你眼中的我，比起热爱学习的好学生，更有可能是一个吃货？”

DatingCharacterEvent.110301.2.en:
"No, come on!" you reply. "It's just because I can totally tell that you were an excellent student, and I want to know the other parts of your life."
"So you're curious about my favorite food and stuff? Heh, you're pretty nosy."
DatingCharacterEvent.110301.2.cn:
“当然不是！”你回答道，“只不过，你是个优等生这件事是完全可以预见的，而我更好奇生活中的你。”
“也就是想知道我喜欢吃什么，用什么吗……呵呵，真是个好事的人啊。”

DatingCharacterEvent.110301.3.en:
Firenze is teasing you, but she seems to be actually very pleased.
She happily shows you around the cafeteria and buys you a student meal. She shares some nostalgic memories as the food takes her back to her school days.
DatingCharacterEvent.110301.3.cn:
尽管嘴上这么说，但你的话似乎深得翡冷翠的心。
她面露微笑，带着你在食堂里闲逛，请你吃了一顿学生套餐；她用怀念的口吻讲述过去，以食物的味道勾连起那些年的校园时光。

DatingCharacterEvent.110301.6.cn: 在学院的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.110301.7.en:
Firenze is surprised by your choice.

You may want a little something to eat, yes, but you also sincerely want to learn more about her mysterious past.

Firenze accepts your suggestion and shares with you her school days.
DatingCharacterEvent.110301.7.cn:
翡冷翠对你的选择感到惊讶。
或许你只是觉得饿了，但你确实很关心她的过去，和那些不曾表露出来的细节。
翡冷翠欣然接受，向你倾诉了那些青葱岁月。

DatingCharacterEvent.110302.1.en:
You've spent the whole day exploring the port with Firenze. As dusk falls, she asks if you want to go fishing. That surprises you.
"Yeah, I know. Fishing is for those with a lot of time on their hands, and I'm always busy," she says, smiling. "But I hear that it builds character. Since we're here, I'd like to try it."
DatingCharacterEvent.110302.1.cn:
你和翡冷翠逛了一天的港口，到了夜幕降临时分，她邀请你去钓鱼，你有些惊讶。
“我明白。只有那些很闲的人才会有这种爱好，而我简直是这类人的反面。”她微笑着回答，“不过，听说这类活动能陶冶情操，机会难得，我想尝试一下。”

DatingCharacterEvent.110302.2.en:
Like Firenze said, she's not fishing to catch some fish, so she stays calm and relaxed even when no fish takes the bait for quite some time...
Until her competitive side takes over.
"How dare you ignore me, fish?" She also hates to fail.
DatingCharacterEvent.110302.2.cn:
如翡冷翠所言，她的目的从来不是为了钓上几条鱼，所以就算很长一段时间里水面上都没有半点动静，她依旧心平气和……
本该如此，但可不要忘了，她是个好胜心强烈、讨厌失败的人。
“竟敢不上我的钩？”

DatingCharacterEvent.110302.3.en:
Firenze scatters some United Harvest's special bait onto the water. Soon, lots of fish start to swarm around you.
"Yeah, that feels good."
She's pleased with her bountiful catch, but you can only manage a wry smile.
DatingCharacterEvent.110302.3.cn:
翡冷翠拿出了联合种业出品的特制饵料，朝水面大量撒去，很快就有鱼群蜂拥而来。
“啊，心情愉快。”
满载而归的她心满意足，而你则唯有苦笑。

DatingCharacterEvent.110302.6.cn: 在港口的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.110302.7.en:
Firenze suddenly becomes interested in fishing, saying that it builds character, and asks you to go night fishing.

However, after not catching any fish for a while, she loses her patience and uses some special bait. She's no quitter.

And you, naturally, join her endeavor.
DatingCharacterEvent.110302.7.cn:
大忙人翡冷翠意外对“钓鱼”这项活动产生了兴趣，声称能陶冶心情，于是拉着你一起去夜钓。
然而，当她发现鱼儿们无论如何都不愿意上钩时，顿时被激发了好胜心，拿出饵料，不钓到鱼不罢休。
而你，自然要奉陪到底。

DatingCharacterEvent.111301.1.en:
The tension eases, and Iris starts to relax a little.

She begins to talk about her recent troubles.
DatingCharacterEvent.111301.1.cn:
鸢尾放松身体，
有些释然地开始说起自己最近的烦恼。

DatingCharacterEvent.111301.2.en:
The guild's budget, the challenges of working as a Trekker, fluctuating market prices, restrictions imposed by the Cities... She goes through the laundry list.

You listen attentively, occasionally reminding her to take a bite of her dessert.
DatingCharacterEvent.111301.2.cn:
旅团的预算，旅人工作的困难，物价的波动，城邦的限制……她一件件地诉说着这些困扰她的难题。
你倾听着，不时地提醒她，别忘了吃一口甜点。

DatingCharacterEvent.111301.3.en:
After pouring out all her worries, she seems to feel much better.

"Do you think I'm being a burden?" she asks, lowering her head with a hint of guilt. "I shouldn't be talking about all this on a rare day off..."

But you know it's only because she's the most caring and gentle soul.

You decide to order her the sweetest special drink of the day.
DatingCharacterEvent.111301.3.cn:
苦水倒完，她的心情似乎好了许多。
“你会觉得我很麻烦吗？”她有些自责地低下了头，“难得出来休息，不应该说这些……”
你知道，这都是因为她是最关心大家的人，这正是鸢尾的温柔之处。
你当即决定，给她点一份今天最甜的特饮。

DatingCharacterEvent.111301.6.en: Visit the Dessert Shop to unlock
DatingCharacterEvent.111301.6.cn: 在甜品屋的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.111301.7.en:
You shared desserts with Iris at the shop.

She opened up about her worries and troubles. Luckily, the tasty sweets and your supportive company seemed to lift her spirits.

You've got this, Iris!
DatingCharacterEvent.111301.7.cn:
和鸢尾在店里享用甜点。
她袒露了许多心事和烦恼。还好，美味的甜点和信任之人的倾听、陪伴让她重新振作了起来。
加油吧，鸢尾！

DatingCharacterEvent.111303.1.en: Entering the library, you notice Iris's steps have become lighter. After so long in the Wilds, she needs the refuge of civilization.
DatingCharacterEvent.111303.1.cn: 进入图书馆后，你感到鸢尾的脚步都变得轻盈了。在荒野中航行久了，鸢尾需要缩回文明之所喘息一会儿。

DatingCharacterEvent.111303.2.en:
You know she once dreamed of joining a large company.

So you talk about big corporations as well as those "small and beautiful" ones. Then about what "small" and "beautiful" even mean.
DatingCharacterEvent.111303.2.cn:
你知道的，鸢尾曾有一颗进大公司的心。
于是你们聊起了大公司，又聊到了“小而美”的公司，以及关于“小”，还有“美”的定义。

DatingCharacterEvent.111303.3.en:
Eventually you agree that big companies are like walled cities: outsiders want in and insiders want out.

But aside from all that, safety in the Wilds matter most for the guild. To avoid being swallowed by storms, reefs, and quicksand, the guild needs an actuary. And here she is, beside you, gathering knowledge.
DatingCharacterEvent.111303.3.cn:
你们最后觉得大公司是一座围城，外面的人想进去，里面的人想出来。
不过相比这些，在荒野里安全航行才是关键。想要不被其吞没，要计算所有可能出现在航线上的风暴，当然也包括来自暗礁与流沙的意外。旅团需要一位精算师，而这位精算师现在就站在你身边搜集知识。

DatingCharacterEvent.111303.6.cn: 在学院的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.111303.7.en: You and Iris went to the library. For her, it must be a place of relaxation. The life she once dreamed of lies hidden just behind that bookshelf. The shelf is large and sturdy, but it also blocks the sunlight streaming in from the window.
DatingCharacterEvent.111303.7.cn: 你和鸢尾去了图书馆，这对她来说一定是个放松的好地方。她曾经理想中的人生，就潜藏在这一方书柜后。书柜很大很稳固，但也遮住了窗外照进来的阳光。

DatingCharacterEvent.112301.1.en:
You spot a beautiful mushroom and are just about to take a bite when Noya stops you.
"Eating this raw will make you hallucinate."

She then examines the mushroom with a mischievous look.
DatingCharacterEvent.112301.1.cn:
你发现了一只很漂亮的蘑菇，正想下嘴，尘沙阻止了你的动作。
“这个生吃的话，是会出幻觉的哦。”
她意味深长地端详起了蘑菇。

DatingCharacterEvent.112301.2.en:
"But if you cook it, it's perfectly fine."

She expertly gathers some dry branches and leaves, stacks up a small stone stove, pulls out a firestarter, and builds a fire.

"Just a quick roast... Mmm, smell amazing, doesn't it?"
DatingCharacterEvent.112301.2.cn:
“不过，如果弄熟了就不会有问题了。”
她熟练地捡了些残枝枯叶，磊起了石台，拿出引火机，生起了火堆。
“烤一下……嗯，是不是很香？”

DatingCharacterEvent.112301.3.en:
The two of you gather the nearby mushrooms and feast on them together.

Delicious as they are, you are starting to feel dizzy.
"Don't worry. If it comes to it, I'll carry you." After a short break, Noya helps you up and the two of you continue on your journey.
DatingCharacterEvent.112301.3.cn:
你们收集起附近的蘑菇，大快朵颐了一番。
美味之余，你感觉有些晕眩。
“没关系，大不了我背你走。”休息片刻后，她拉起你继续旅程。

DatingCharacterEvent.112301.6.cn: 在洞窟的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.112301.7.en:
With Noya's help, you learned about yet another type of dangerous mushroom and how to safely prepare it.

It was unexpectedly delicious treat when roasted—though it did make you feel a bit dizzy.
Maybe Noya's knowledge is not quite complete?
DatingCharacterEvent.112301.7.cn:
在尘沙的帮助下又认识了一种危险的蘑菇，以及它的食用方法。
原来这又是一种烤熟之后的意外美味——尽管餐后仍然感受到了一丝晕眩。
或许尘沙的知识也有些遗漏的部分？

DatingCharacterEvent.112302.1.en:
Suddenly, a burst of excitement erupts from the crowd in a distance.

A street performance has begun.

It's a exhibition match of swordsmanship.

Watching the action, Noya looks like she's itching to give it a try herself.
DatingCharacterEvent.112302.1.cn:
忽然，远处的人群里爆发出一阵惊呼。
街头演出开始了。
这是一场点到为止的剑术表演。
看到尽兴处，尘沙似乎也跃跃欲试。

DatingCharacterEvent.112302.2.en:
She asks for your opinion, and with her bright, eager eyes staring at you, there's no way you can say no.

She steps onto the stage, grips the sword, and looks absolutely badass.
DatingCharacterEvent.112302.2.cn:
她向你征求意见，看到她闪亮又期待的眼神，你实在回绝不了。
她站上舞台握住剑柄的一刻，你觉得她简直帅呆了。

DatingCharacterEvent.112302.3.en:
Noya's movements are lightning-fast, striking several scoring points in quick succession. The match ends swiftly in a one-sided victory.

After the match has ended, you both overhear the opponent grumbling, "How are us performers supposed to go head-to-head with a real Trekker?"

Noya scratches her head sticks her tongue out at you with a sheepish grin.
DatingCharacterEvent.112302.3.cn:
尘沙的动作极快，接连戳中了好几处得分点。比试很快以一边倒的胜利结束。
散场后，你和尘沙都听到了对手的抱怨：“我们这些玩花架子的，怎么可能和旅人真的硬碰硬嘛！”
尘沙不好意思地挠了挠头，向你吐了吐舌头。

DatingCharacterEvent.112302.6.cn: 在集市的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.112302.7.en: You watched Noya as she partook in a swordplay match and clinched victory. In the roaring cheers of the crowd, you wonder: Are all Trekkers this skilled in combat?
DatingCharacterEvent.112302.7.cn: 与尘沙参与了街头的剑术表演赛，见证了她的得胜时刻。在热烈的欢呼声中，你思考着：旅人的武艺都是如此高强的存在吗？

DatingCharacterEvent.113301.1.en:
The small table is covered with an array of cakes and drinks.

Shimiao stares at them hesitatingly.
DatingCharacterEvent.113301.1.cn:
琳琅满目的蛋糕与饮料摆满了整张小桌。
师渺有些犹豫地盯着桌上的餐点。

DatingCharacterEvent.113301.2.en:
"Just one meal shouldn't make me gain weight."

She mutters to herself.

Noticing her hesitation, you grab your fork and dig in, letting Shimiao know through your actions that she doesn't need to stress about it.
DatingCharacterEvent.113301.2.cn:
“只吃一顿，应该不会增加体重。”
她似乎在自言自语些什么。
感知到这份压力，你率先动起了刀叉——用行动告诉师渺，不必介意这些。

DatingCharacterEvent.113301.3.en:
She hesitates for a moment before finally digging in.

"Oh well," she seems to be talking to herself, "I guess, worst case scenario, we'll gain weight together."
DatingCharacterEvent.113301.3.cn:
她有些害羞地也开始了品尝。
“大不了就和你一起变胖吧。”她喃喃自语道。

DatingCharacterEvent.113301.6.en: Visit the Dessert Shop to unlock
DatingCharacterEvent.113301.6.cn: 在甜品屋的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.113301.7.en:
You had a great time with Shimiao at the Dessert Shop. 

At first, she seemed worried about the sweets making her gain weight, but eventually she gave in to her cravings and the allure of the delicious treats.
DatingCharacterEvent.113301.7.cn:
和师渺在甜品屋度过了愉快的时光。
她起初似乎担心甜品会导致体重飙升，但后来也顺从了自己的内心与美味的诱惑。

DatingCharacterEvent.113302.1.en:
You decide to try your luck at the market's game area because every participant gets a chance at a raffle.

What you didn't expect was that Shimiao got hooked on the whack-a-mole game booth. She ends up buying game tokens for several rounds.
DatingCharacterEvent.113302.1.cn:
你们决定去集市的游戏区试试手气，听说每位参与的顾客都可以抽奖。
你没想到的是，师渺被打地鼠的小摊吸引，挪不动步。她一连买了好几局的游戏币。

DatingCharacterEvent.113302.2.en:
"Bang—bang—"

Again and again, Shimiao brings her mallet down on the moles with both precision and force.

You begin to worry she's going break the machine—and whether she's been under too much stress at work.
DatingCharacterEvent.113302.2.cn:
“砰——砰——”
一下又一下，师渺的大锤精准而猛力地击打在地鼠玩偶上。
你担心起机器是否会被她砸坏——以及，她是不是平时工作压力过大了。

DatingCharacterEvent.113302.3.en:
"That felt so good!" She exclaims as the game finally comes to an end.

After this brief moment of relaxation, she adjusts her glasses and, once again, becomes the model secretary.

"Let's go, Boss, next stand."

Watching her walk confidently, you feel a little less worried.
DatingCharacterEvent.113302.3.cn:
“好舒畅啊！” 游戏终于结束，她感慨道。
只松懈那么一瞬后，她就抬了抬眼镜，回到了那个模范生的样子。
“走吧，下一个地点。”
看着她自信的脚步，你也放心了一些。

DatingCharacterEvent.113302.6.cn: 在集市的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.113302.7.en:
While you were at the market with Shimiao, you visited the whack-a-mole game booth.

Though she wasn't particularly good at it, the sheer force of her hits made you worry about her mental well-being.

Fortunately, after letting off some steam, she seemed to have found a sense of inner peace.
DatingCharacterEvent.113302.7.cn:
和师渺游玩集市时，光临了打地鼠的游戏铺子。
她技术虽并不算高超，但这股击打的巨大力道让人担心她的精神状况。
还好，释放完毕后，她似乎也与自己和解了。

DatingCharacterEvent.113303.1.en:
"My recent spicy food training has been a massive success," Shimiao declared, proudly pushing up her glasses. "So, I'm treating myself to a hot spring trip on my day off."
To celebrate her milestone, the two of you decided to change things up and soak for an extra hour.
DatingCharacterEvent.113303.1.cn:
“最近的吃辣特训卓有成效。”师渺自豪地抬了抬眼镜，“奖励自己休息日来泡次温泉。”
听闻这一喜讯后，你们两人便决定区别于往常，增加一小时的时间以资奖励。

DatingCharacterEvent.113303.2.en: "Phew..." Shimiao let out a long, contented sigh, her recent work stress finally melting away. You leaned back as well, savoring the rare peace and quiet.
DatingCharacterEvent.113303.2.cn: “呼……呼……”师渺舒服的气音传来，想必最近的工作压力都能得以释放了吧。你也放松地享受着这来之不易的静谧时光。

DatingCharacterEvent.113303.3.en:
"Since we're treating ourselves, how about we grab hot pot after this?" you suggested. Silence.
"Shimiao? Shimiao?!" Realizing something was wrong, you rushed to get the proprietress, only to find Shimiao passed out in the water from the heat.
When she finally came to, a thoroughly disappointed Shimiao decided to add "heat acclimation" to her training regimen.
DatingCharacterEvent.113303.3.cn:
“择日不如撞日，泡完温泉，我们不如一起再去吃顿火锅吧？”你向师渺发出邀请，却没得到回答。
“师渺？师渺？！”察觉到有所不对的你立刻找到老板娘，这才发现师渺热晕在了池子中。
苏醒后的师渺十分沮丧，决定给自己新增加一项耐热特训。

DatingCharacterEvent.113303.6.en: Visit Hot Spring Resort to unlock
DatingCharacterEvent.113303.6.cn: 在温泉度假村的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.113303.7.en:
You and Shimiao visited the hot spring town to unwind on your day off. Unfortunately, Shimiao overestimated how much heat she can withstand. You had to frantically flag down the proprietress to help drag her out of the water.
Afterward, Shimiao promptly added "hot spring endurance" to her training plan.
DatingCharacterEvent.113303.7.cn:
你和师渺趁着假日来到温泉度假村泡汤放松。然而师渺错估了自己的忍耐力。你慌忙喊上老板娘搭手，两人协力将她拉出浴池。
事后，师渺将泡汤也加入了特训计划中。

DatingCharacterEvent.114301.1.en: You order more desserts. Chaton devours them in quick bites—one, two, three—gone. You wonder how it is that she doesn't find them too sweet.
DatingCharacterEvent.114301.1.cn: 你们又点了一些甜品，猫眼吃得飞快，一口、两口、三口——整块消失。你不禁感到好奇：她难道不会感觉太甜了吗？

DatingCharacterEvent.114301.2.en: You try to keep up, not wanting to let her wolf them down alone, but your throat protests.
DatingCharacterEvent.114301.2.cn: 你很想跟上她的节奏，毕竟让美少女只身一人对着甜食大快朵颐是不礼貌的。但你的喉咙正在抗议。

DatingCharacterEvent.114301.3.en: She notices and pushes you a glass of water. "Having trouble keeping up with me, huh? Keep practicing. Tolerating this much sugar is a crucial step in awakening the Tyrant's true power!"
DatingCharacterEvent.114301.3.cn: 猫眼注意到了你的窘迫，“你好像不太行啊。”她将水杯推向你，“好好练习哦，这也是唤醒魔王真正力量所必须经历的过程之一~”

DatingCharacterEvent.114301.6.en: Visit the Dessert Shop to unlock
DatingCharacterEvent.114301.6.cn: 在甜品屋的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.114301.7.en: You ate heaps of cake with Chaton. Uh oh, your weekly sugar intake is probably maxed out.
DatingCharacterEvent.114301.7.cn: 和猫眼在甜品屋吃了很多很多小蛋糕。糟糕，本周的糖分摄入似乎超标了。

DatingCharacterEvent.114302.1.en: At the balloon-shooting booth, Chaton is excited. "Behold, as the great Chaton grants these balloons a merciful release!"
DatingCharacterEvent.114302.1.cn: 游戏区有一间用玩具枪打气球的铺子，猫眼兴致勃勃地对你说：“就让你见识见识猫眼大人给予气球的致命解脱吧！”

DatingCharacterEvent.114302.2.en:
First shot—miss. "This trigger's too light."
Second shot—miss. "This gun's off balance."
Third shot—miss. "The sights must be off."
DatingCharacterEvent.114302.2.cn:
第一枪，脱靶。“这扳机太轻了。”
第二枪，脱靶。“这枪手感不好。”
第三枪，脱靶。“这瞄具没校准过吧。”

DatingCharacterEvent.114302.3.en: "No way!" She reaches for the real weapon on her back. You quickly stop her—please don't pull that monstrosity out in public!
DatingCharacterEvent.114302.3.cn: “怎么可能！”你发现猫眼想要把背上的真家伙取下来。你连忙把把她拉走，请不要在公共场合亮出这种巨大兵器啊！

DatingCharacterEvent.114302.6.cn: 在集市的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.114302.7.en: You and Chaton played the balloon-shooting game at the Market, but today she wasn't feeling it and her aim was off.
DatingCharacterEvent.114302.7.cn: 和猫眼在集市游玩了打气球的游戏，可惜猫眼今天不在状态，手感不佳。

DatingCharacterEvent.115301.1.en: Firefly knows the library well. She weaves between shelves, even crawling under tables where a corridor is right there. Is that really necessary?
DatingCharacterEvent.115301.1.cn: 火垂非常熟悉这里，她领着你在书架间穿梭。但其行动路线并不寻常，甚至包括从桌子下面钻过去。明明旁边就有路，这真的有必要吗？

DatingCharacterEvent.115301.2.en: Suddenly, she vanishes. You search everywhere and eventually spot her hair sticking up from behind a stack of books, beckoning you closer.
DatingCharacterEvent.115301.2.cn: 一转眼，火垂消失了。你四处寻找，发现在一个角落的书堆后面，有一撮跃动的呆毛，它在邀请你。

DatingCharacterEvent.115301.3.en: You find Firefly behind the pile of books. She's lying there with a comic book by her side—one she picked out just for you.
DatingCharacterEvent.115301.3.cn: 你在这堆书后面找到了火垂，她趴在书堆后面，身旁还放着一本漫画书——这是她为你准备的。

DatingCharacterEvent.115301.6.cn: 在学院的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.115301.7.en: Firefly showed you her secret reading nook in the library. You spent a quiet time reading with her among the shelves.
DatingCharacterEvent.115301.7.cn: 火垂把你带到了她在图书馆藏身的地方，和她一起度过了恬静的阅读时光。

DatingCharacterEvent.115302.1.en:
Suddenly, a burst of excitement erupts from the crowd in a distance.

A street magic performance has begun.
DatingCharacterEvent.115302.1.cn:
忽然，远处的人群里爆发出一阵惊呼。
街头魔术演出开始了。

DatingCharacterEvent.115302.2.en:
You and Firefly watch the magic show in the crowd, but she's too short and her view is blocked.
She jumps anxiously, her stray hair sticking straight up. If only that counted toward her height, maybe she'd be tall enough... Alas, she can't see through her hair.
DatingCharacterEvent.115302.2.cn:
你和火垂在人群中观赏魔术，但她个子太矮被挡住了视线。
火垂焦急地蹦跳，呆毛都捋直了。如果算上这一撮，兴许她就够高了，但可惜呆毛并不能代替眼睛。

DatingCharacterEvent.115302.3.en:
You gently hold Firefly and let her sit on your shoulders.
As the performance goes on, Firefly waves her arms as well. Did she see shows when she was little? You don't know, but clearly she's enjoying the show now.
DatingCharacterEvent.115302.3.cn:
你轻轻抱住火垂，让她坐在你的肩膀上。
随着表演的进行，火垂也舞动着手臂。她小时候看过表演吗？不知道，但她显然希望有个剧团能修饰当下。

DatingCharacterEvent.115302.6.cn: 在集市的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.115302.7.en: You and Firefly watched a magic performance at the market. Since she's too short, you let her sit on your shoulders to enjoy it.
DatingCharacterEvent.115302.7.cn: 你和火垂在集市上观看魔术表演，由于她个子太矮，你干脆让她坐在你的肩膀上欣赏。

DatingCharacterEvent.116301.1.en: You rest against the rock wall. Suddenly, Ridge seems to smell something, and she starts digging at the soil with her shovel.
DatingCharacterEvent.116301.1.cn: 你们靠着岩壁休息。突然，岭川好似嗅到了什么，她开始用铲子发掘脚下的土层。

DatingCharacterEvent.116301.2.en:
Ridge uncovers some dirt and gravel, and finally digs out a huge white mushroom.

"This kind of mushroom must be eaten fresh," she explains excitedly.
DatingCharacterEvent.116301.2.cn:
岭川翻出一些泥土与碎石，最终挖出一颗巨大的白色蘑菇。
“这种蘑菇一定要趁新鲜吃哦。”岭川兴奋地向你介绍道。

DatingCharacterEvent.116301.3.en:
After a simple roast, the mushroom gives off a tempting fragrance. As you share it, you discuss how she found it.

Maybe in the near future, Ridge's farm will also cultivate this delicious mushroom.
DatingCharacterEvent.116301.3.cn:
经过简单的炙烤，蘑菇便散发出迷人的香气。你们一边分享，一边探讨她是怎么发现的。
也许在不久的将来，岭川的农场里也能培育这种美味的蘑菇。

DatingCharacterEvent.116301.6.cn: 在洞窟的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.116301.7.en: You and Ridge discovered a delicious giant mushroom deep inside the cave. Could this delicacy be cultivated on a farm? It may require very exact conditions, but you would trust United Harvest's technology.
DatingCharacterEvent.116301.7.cn: 岭川和你在洞窟深处发现了一颗巨大而美味的蘑菇。这种珍馐能不能人工培育呢？它可能需要苛刻的环境需求，但你选择相信种业公司的技术。

DatingCharacterEvent.116302.1.en: You order many more desserts. Ridge doesn't seem to come to the Dessert Shop often, so let her enjoy this chance.
DatingCharacterEvent.116302.1.cn: 你们又点了很多甜品。岭川似乎没怎么来过甜品屋，趁着这个机会多多享受吧。

DatingCharacterEvent.116302.2.en: So satisfying, but you really ordered too much. As you wipe the crumbs from your mouth, you notice Ridge seems like she wants to say something—probably that she wants to pack the rest and take it home.
DatingCharacterEvent.116302.2.cn: 好满足，但是真的点多了。你擦拭着嘴角的残渣，发现岭川似乎想说什么，应该是想打包带回家吧。

DatingCharacterEvent.116302.3.en:
You call the waiter to pack the leftovers.

Then you give most of it to Ridge, reminding her to eat quickly because cake doesn't keep for long.
DatingCharacterEvent.116302.3.cn:
你呼唤服务员帮忙把剩下的甜品打包。
而后你把大部分都塞给了岭川，并叮嘱她要快些吃完，蛋糕不能久放。

DatingCharacterEvent.116302.6.en: Visit the Dessert Shop to unlock
DatingCharacterEvent.116302.6.cn: 在甜品屋的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.116302.7.en: Together with Ridge, you ordered way too much at the Dessert Shop. You give her most of the extra. Cakes may be tasty, but they don't last long. Ridge, who loves stockpiling food, probably doesn't eat it often.
DatingCharacterEvent.116302.7.cn: 和岭川在甜品屋点了过量的餐品，你把打包后的大部分甜点都交给了她。蛋糕这种东西虽然好吃，但却不能久放。热衷囤积食物的岭川，也许很少吃吧。

DatingCharacterEvent.116303.1.en:
"I heard the local hot spring food is incredible!" Ridge exclaimed, excitedly dragging you toward a specialty stall.
"Our bestsellers are the hot spring eggs and the steamed buns," the vendor greeted. "What can I get for you?"
DatingCharacterEvent.116303.1.cn:
“听说这里有当地特色的温泉食品很有名！”岭川说着，便拉着你兴奋地朝特选店走去。
“这里最受欢迎的食物分别是温泉蛋和温泉馒头，请问客人需要哪个呢？”

DatingCharacterEvent.116303.2.en:
"I'll take the signature! It looks amazing!"
Ridge bought a jumbo hot spring bun, carefully broke it in half, and handed you a piece.
The bun had a soft, thin skin and a sweet, fluffy filling. You happily devoured it, reaching over to wipe a smudge off the corner of Ridge's lips.
DatingCharacterEvent.116303.2.cn:
“我要那个看起来很好吃的招牌！”
岭川买了个大号温泉馒头，小心翼翼地掰开来，送给你一半。
点心外皮薄软，馅料松软甜糯，你吃得很香，还替岭川擦去了嘴边的馅料。

DatingCharacterEvent.116303.3.en:
"It totally lives up to the hype..." she murmured. "Maybe it's the hot spring water in the dough? It's seriously good."
But right after praising it, Ridge clenched her fists, a competitive fire sparking in her eyes.
"But the crops I grow won't lose to this!"
You smiled and cheered her on, hoping her farming skills would soon gain the fame they deserved.
DatingCharacterEvent.116303.3.cn:
“名不虚传……是因为加入了当地温泉水调和面团的缘故吗？果然很好吃。”
真心实意的赞美过后，岭川握紧拳头，眼中燃起了斗志。
“不过我种出来的食物，味道不会输！”
你鼓励了她，祝愿她早日打响名声。

DatingCharacterEvent.116303.6.en: Visit Hot Spring Resort to unlock
DatingCharacterEvent.116303.6.cn: 在温泉度假村的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.116303.7.en:
Drawn in by rumors of amazing local treats, Ridge dragged you over to share a hot spring bun.
The delicious snack ended up awakening her competitive farming spirit. You smiled and cheered her on.
DatingCharacterEvent.116303.7.cn:
岭川打听到温泉度假村的特色食品很好吃，她拉着你买了温泉馒头，和你一起分享。
在品尝过美味后，岭川却反倒是被激起了斗志，你笑着鼓励了她。

DatingCharacterEvent.117301.1.en: While waiting for food, Jinglin runs to the kitchen's display window, peeking inside out of curiosity.
DatingCharacterEvent.117301.1.cn:
等餐的时候，
璟麟跑到工作间的展示玻璃外，好奇地往里张望。

DatingCharacterEvent.117301.2.en:
You come up behind her and tap lightly on her shoulder.

Jinglin is a bit startled and turns around to greet you.

"B-Boss, I was just curious about how they make their desserts here!"
DatingCharacterEvent.117301.2.cn:
你来到她的背后，轻轻拍了拍她。
璟麟有些被吓到，转身向你问好。
“我只是好奇这家甜品的制作方法！”她解释道。

DatingCharacterEvent.117301.3.en: "I see, then let's watch together." Before your food is served, you and Jinglin observe the chef's exquisite skills.
DatingCharacterEvent.117301.3.cn: “原来是这样，我们一起看吧。”你和璟麟在上餐前观摩了甜点师傅的高超手艺。

DatingCharacterEvent.117301.6.en: Visit the Dessert Shop to unlock
DatingCharacterEvent.117301.6.cn: 在甜品屋的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.117301.7.en:
When you met up with Jinglin at the dessert shop, she was standing outside the work area glass, observing the dessert preparation process.

Her curiosity about food was admirable.
DatingCharacterEvent.117301.7.cn:
和璟麟在甜品屋相遇时，她正站在工作间的玻璃外，观察着甜品的制作方法。
她对美食制作的好奇值得尊敬。

DatingCharacterEvent.117302.1.en:
You and Jinglin stumble upon an area full of mushrooms.

Her eyes widen with excitement as she starts to examine the different shapes and varieties.
DatingCharacterEvent.117302.1.cn:
你和璟麟发现了一片长着许多蘑菇的区域。
她兴奋的瞪大了眼睛，观察起这些形态各异的品种。

DatingCharacterEvent.117302.2.en:
"This one is probably poisonous."

As she picks through the mushrooms, Jinglin keeps talking to herself.

"This one's edible... This one can be eaten once cooked."

You also pick a few, trying to identify the mushrooms that look similar, but soon realize it's a tricky task.
DatingCharacterEvent.117302.2.cn:
“这个，应该有毒。”
她挑拣着蘑菇，念念有词地说，
“这个，可以吃……这个，煮过了可以吃。”
你也摘下几朵，想要分辨这些样貌类似的蘑菇，却发现这是一道难题。

DatingCharacterEvent.117302.3.en:
"What a haul! I'll try out a new recipe when we get back!"

Jinglin happily leaves with a whole lot of mushrooms.

"Don't try this at home, though. I do this because I know what I'm doing!"
DatingCharacterEvent.117302.3.cn:
“大丰收！回去之后试试新菜谱吧！”
璟麟心满意足的带走了许多蘑菇，
“请勿模仿哦，我可是有知识储备的！”

DatingCharacterEvent.117302.6.cn: 在洞窟的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.117302.7.en:
You and Jinglin discovered a great variety of mushrooms inside the cave.

With her extensive knowledge, she quickly identified all the edible mushrooms and packed them up to go... She was elated.
DatingCharacterEvent.117302.7.cn:
和璟麟在洞窟发现了许多种类的蘑菇。
她凭借丰富的知识储备很快的辨识出了所有可以食用的蘑菇并打包带走了……她非常高兴。

DatingCharacterEvent.117303.1.en: Yukatas on, you and Jinglin bypassed the hot springs. Today's real mission? Cooking your own hot spring eggs.
DatingCharacterEvent.117303.1.cn: 你和璟麟换好浴衣，却并没有向汤池走去。原来，你们今天另有目标——那便是自己动手煮温泉蛋。

DatingCharacterEvent.117303.2.en: "One each for you, me, Mom, Grandpa Qin, Noya, Iris, Amber..." Soon, Jinglin had gathered a whole basket of eggs.
DatingCharacterEvent.117303.2.cn: “你一个，我一个。妈妈一个，秦爷爷一个。尘沙一个，鸢尾一个，琥珀一个……”不知不觉，璟麟挑了整整一筐的鸡蛋拿在手上。

DatingCharacterEvent.117303.3.en:
You eagerly lowered the eggs into the water. After a long wait, they were finally done!
"Hot, hot!" you huffed, peeling the steaming shells as both your faces lit up with joy.
DatingCharacterEvent.117303.3.cn:
你们兴冲冲地将挑选好的鸡蛋放进了温泉池。等啊等啊，终于到了蛋熟时刻！
“呼呼！”烫烫的温泉蛋被剥开了壳，你们两人都露出了幸福的表情。

DatingCharacterEvent.117303.6.en: Visit Hot Spring Resort to unlock
DatingCharacterEvent.117303.6.cn: 在温泉度假村的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.117303.7.en: Jinglin cared far more about boiling eggs than taking a bath. She dragged you along to prep them, and you both spent half an hour glued to that basket.
DatingCharacterEvent.117303.7.cn: 比起泡汤，璟麟似乎对“温泉蛋”这个小吃更感兴趣。她拉着你一起挑蛋、煮蛋，你们目不转睛地盯着那筐鸡蛋看了半个小时。

DatingCharacterEvent.118301.1.en:
Suddenly, it feels like you've stepped on something hard.

You look down and realize that underneath the vegetation, there lies a skeleton covered in layers of mud and dirt.

Like a predator smelling prey, Coronis immediately moves closer.
DatingCharacterEvent.118301.1.cn:
突然，你似乎踩到了什么硬物。
低头看去，杂草遮掩之下，居然是一具蒙满了泥灰的骨头。
就像闻到猎物的味道，科洛妮丝立刻凑了上来。

DatingCharacterEvent.118301.2.en:
"Could it be that you're interested in this, too?"

She teases you.

Before you can answer, she pulls out a specimen box and excavation tools. You wisely step aside, making room for her to work.
DatingCharacterEvent.118301.2.cn:
“莫非，你也对这个感兴趣？”
她有些调侃地问。
在你做出回答前，她就掏出了标本盒和采掘道具，你知趣地为她让出了一片空地。

DatingCharacterEvent.118301.3.en:
Now that her work has happily concluded, Coronis is in high spirits. She seems to float rather than walk.

"Life is intriguing," you can't help but think to yourself.
DatingCharacterEvent.118301.3.cn:
愉快的采集结束，科洛妮丝非常高兴，步伐都飘然了起来。
生命，真奇妙啊。你不禁感慨。

DatingCharacterEvent.118301.6.cn: 在洞窟的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.118301.7.en:
You and Coronis discovered the remains of an unknown creature in the cave.

Driven by her passion for science and medicine, she dug up some specimens and kept them. Death is not the end. It carries infinite hope.
DatingCharacterEvent.118301.7.cn:
和科洛妮丝在洞窟发现了新的生物遗骸。
出于对科学、医学的狂热，她顺手发掘了一些标本并保管了起来。死亡并非完结，而是暗含着无限的希望。

DatingCharacterEvent.118303.1.en: You walk into the library with Coronis. She glances at the map and heads straight for the medical section.
DatingCharacterEvent.118303.1.cn: 你与科洛妮丝走进图书馆，她看了眼导航图，便径直向医学区走去。

DatingCharacterEvent.118303.2.en: Seeing your puzzled look, she explains, "Though people call me a country doctor, I actually have a proper degree."
DatingCharacterEvent.118303.2.cn: 看着你疑惑的神色，科洛妮丝解释道：“虽然大家总说我是乡野医生，但其实我有正经学位。”

DatingCharacterEvent.118303.3.en: Coronis flips through the latest journals: "New academic findings sometimes help my research." Then she looks at you with burning eyes. You shrink your neck in unease. She smiles lightly, "Don't worry, today you're perfectly healthy."
DatingCharacterEvent.118303.3.cn: 科洛妮丝翻阅着最新几期期刊，说道：“学界最新的成果有时会对我的研究有帮助。”随后，她炽热的目光又投向你，你不禁缩起脖子。科洛妮丝轻轻一笑，“别担心，今天的你非常健康。”

DatingCharacterEvent.118303.6.cn: 在学院的话，或许会发现些什么……
