DatingCharacterEvent.118303.7.en: With Coronis, you read medical journals in the library. Though she's been away from academia for a long time, she keeps up with the latest theories. Theory and practice are like two legs of progress—sometimes one leads, sometimes the other.
DatingCharacterEvent.118303.7.cn: 和科洛妮丝在图书馆里阅读医学期刊。虽然她已经离开学界很久，但仍然保持着阅读前沿理论的习惯。理论与实践是进步的两条腿，有时一条腿在前面，有时另一条腿在前面。

DatingCharacterEvent.119301.1.en:
The small table is covered with an array of cakes and drinks.

Once the staff brings out the final dessert, Nanoha looks at you with a cheerful smile.

"Actually... I have a surprise prepared just for you."
DatingCharacterEvent.119301.1.cn:
琳琅满目的蛋糕与饮料摆满了整张小桌。
待店员端上最后一款甜品后，花原笑眯眯地看着你:
“其实……花原给您准备了一个惊喜。”

DatingCharacterEvent.119301.2.en:
"One of these little cakes is made just for you, with all your favorite flavors mixed in. Would you care to guess which one?"

Excited by the fun challenge, you dive in and start tasting them one by one.
DatingCharacterEvent.119301.2.cn:
“这些小蛋糕里，有一款是我为您特别定制的，综合了您平时喜欢的口味。您要不要猜一猜是哪个？”
你欣然接受了这份甜蜜的挑战，开始轮流品尝这些蛋糕。

DatingCharacterEvent.119301.3.en:
The moment that perfect flavor hits your taste buds, you know exactly which one it is.

"That is a relief! Looks like I do know you to some degree..."

Under Nanoha's eager gaze, you quickly devour the one-of-a-kind little cake made just for you.
DatingCharacterEvent.119301.3.cn:
果然，击中内心的味道一入口，你便立刻确定了目标。
“太好了，看来花原还算了解您呢……”
在花原热切的目光下，你飞快吃完了这块只属于你的、独一无二的小蛋糕。

DatingCharacterEvent.119301.6.en: Visit the Dessert Shop to unlock
DatingCharacterEvent.119301.6.cn: 在甜品屋的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.119301.7.en:
Nanoha invited you to the dessert shop. Everything felt so familiar, even the staff knew you by sight.

However, this time there was a special surprise waiting for you—she prepared something unique and sweet just for you.
DatingCharacterEvent.119301.7.cn:
花原约你来了甜品店，一切都是那样熟悉，连店员都是你们的老相识了。
不过，这次有新的惊喜等待着你——她为你制作了一份特别的甜蜜礼物。

DatingCharacterEvent.119302.1.en:
You decide to try your luck at the market's game area because every participant gets a chance at a raffle.

The dart booth catches your eye. Seeing this, Nanoha suggests giving it a try.
DatingCharacterEvent.119302.1.cn:
你们决定去集市的游戏区试试手气，听说每位参与的顾客都可以抽奖。
你被投飞镖的小摊吸引了注意力，花原见状，便提议你们去试试看。

DatingCharacterEvent.119302.2.en:
You go first and dispatch five darts. Unfortunately, none of them hit the spot exactly, leaving you a little frustrated.

"Please, allow Nanoha to win this for you," Amidst the noisy crowd, Nanoha whispers softly into your ear.
DatingCharacterEvent.119302.2.cn:
你先投了五枚飞镖，可惜位置都差了一点，你不免有些懊恼。
“交给我吧，我会为您赢下来的。”一片喧闹中，花原轻轻在你耳边说道。

DatingCharacterEvent.119302.3.en:
"Whoosh, whoosh—"

Before you can even react, Nanoha swiftly throws all her darts, each landing perfectly in the bullseye.

The crowd goes silent for a few seconds before erupting in astonished exclamations, with everyone asking Nanoha to share her secret.

Nanoha looks flustered. You know she's not used to scenes like this so you quickly lead her away from the booth.
DatingCharacterEvent.119302.3.cn:
“咻咻——”
你还没来得及看清楚，花原便迅速投出了手中所有飞镖，全部正中靶心。
围观的人群安静了几秒，继而爆发出不可置信的惊呼，大家纷纷让花原传授经验。
花原有些手足无措，你知道她不太擅长应付这种局面，拉着她快步离开了。

DatingCharacterEvent.119302.6.cn: 在集市的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.119302.7.en:
Nanoha had no mission to attend to for once, so she invited you to explore the Market with her.

At the dart-throwing booth, you saw a different side of her—calm, confident, and remarkably skilled.
DatingCharacterEvent.119302.7.cn:
花原难得没有任务在身，约你一起逛集市。
在投掷飞镖的小摊前，你见到了与平日不同的花原。那份自信与从容下隐藏的深不可测的实力，令人刮目相看。

DatingCharacterEvent.119303.1.en: Inside the cafeteria, you and Nanoha noticed that today's cooking elective was in session, so the two of you grabbed a pair of seats by the window and sat down.
DatingCharacterEvent.119303.1.cn: 来到食堂内，你和花原发现了今日开设的烹饪选修课，并找了一对靠窗的座位坐了下来。

DatingCharacterEvent.119303.2.en:
Because of Nanoha's maid outfit, the two of you became the center of attention the moment you walked in.

And since she stayed quietly at your side the whole time, people around the class started whispering to each other, wondering if you might come from some prominent family.
DatingCharacterEvent.119303.2.cn: 由于花原的装扮，你们一进来就成了全班的焦点。加之她始终安静地跟在你身后，引得班上的人都在窃窃私语的讨论，你是不是来自某个显赫的大户人家。

DatingCharacterEvent.119303.3.en:
Nanoha didn't seem to mind any of it. She brought you a cup of hot tea and carefully organized the lecture notes. During the hands-on portion, she even baked a tray of fragrant cookies herself and set them in front of you.

After class, the two of you tidied up the kitchenware together and left the cafeteria side by side under the envious gazes of your classmates.
DatingCharacterEvent.119303.3.cn:
花原倒并不在意这些，她为你端来一杯热茶，细心地将课堂笔记整理好。在实践里，她更是亲手制作了一盘香气四溢的饼干递到你面前。
课后，你们一同收拾好厨具，在全班同学羡慕的目光中并肩离开了食堂。

DatingCharacterEvent.119303.6.cn: 在学院的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.119303.7.en:
During the cooking class, Nanoha took a tray of freshly baked cookies out of the oven Artifact.

As the rich aroma spread through the air, other people began casting envious glances your way.
DatingCharacterEvent.119303.7.cn: 在烹饪课上，花原从烘烤神器中取出了一盘香喷喷的饼干，随着香味在空气中的飘散，周围的同学纷纷投来羡慕的眼光。

DatingCharacterEvent.120301.1.en:
Carrying torches, you make your way deeper into the cave.

Suddenly, out of the corner of your eye, you catch sight of a wall painting. Excited, you call out to Canace.
DatingCharacterEvent.120301.1.cn:
你们举着火把向洞穴深处走去，
突然，你余光瞥见一副壁画，你兴奋得叫上了卡娜丝。

DatingCharacterEvent.120301.2.en:
Canace comes over, unhurried, and points out that the wall painting shows signs of modern craftsmanship, clearly not what you're searching for.

She gently pats your shoulder and suggests calling it a day.
DatingCharacterEvent.120301.2.cn:
卡娜丝不紧不慢地走到你身边，告诉你壁画有现代人工的痕迹，很显然并不是你们寻找的目标。
她轻拍你的肩膀，表示今天就到此为止吧。

DatingCharacterEvent.120301.3.en:
When you return to the cave entrance, you realize it's raining hard outside.

Canace notices your disappointment. She gets a fire going and pats the ground, motioning for you to sit beside her.

"You know," she begins, "our ancestors once did the same thing—sitting at the edge of caves during the rainy season, resting, reproducing, and perhaps even beginning to think."

You gaze into the flickering flames, listening as she recounts stories from a time before time.
DatingCharacterEvent.120301.3.cn:
回到洞窟入口，外面却下着大雨。
卡娜丝看出了你的失望，随即升起火堆，拍拍地板示意你坐在她的身边。
“你知道吗，我们的祖先也曾像这样，雨季之时，坐在洞穴边上，休憩，繁衍，甚至开始了思考。”
你凝视着摇曳火焰，听她讲述那些时间之外的往事。

DatingCharacterEvent.120301.6.cn: 在洞窟的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.120301.7.en: You ventured into a cave with Canace in search of clues about an ancient civilization. Your hope for a new discovery, however, was dashed. When you tried to leave the cave, it started to rain. Canace comforted you and shared stories from a time before time.
DatingCharacterEvent.120301.7.cn: 同卡娜丝一起到某个洞窟内寻找古文明的线索，本以为有新的发现，结果是空欢喜一场，离开时又恰逢下雨。卡娜丝一遍安慰你，一边讲述那些遥远的故事。

DatingCharacterEvent.120303.1.en: "Getting hungry? Let me take you to the staff cafeteria." Canace notices you're starving.
DatingCharacterEvent.120303.1.cn: “有点饿了吗？我带你去职工食堂吃点吧。”卡娜丝看出了你的饥饿感。

DatingCharacterEvent.120303.2.en:
The staff cafeteria is upstairs from the student one. Canace leads you inside. "We get better food here. Order whatever you want."

You order a simple meal, but Canace adds more.
DatingCharacterEvent.120303.2.cn:
职工食堂位于学生食堂的楼上，卡娜丝把你领了进去。“这是我们开小灶的地方，想吃什么随便点。”
你随便点了一些餐品，卡娜丝似乎觉得不够，又追加了一点。

DatingCharacterEvent.120303.3.en:
The food really does taste better than what's served downstairs.

You notice Canace hardly eats any of it. Why did she order so much?

Leaning lazily in her chair, her gaze drifts toward your plate now and then. You realize she just wanted you to eat more—maybe, unconsciously, she's already treating you like her student.
DatingCharacterEvent.120303.3.cn:
这里餐品的口味确实比楼下要好上一些。
你注意到卡娜丝并没有吃多少，那她为什么会点这么多。
她慵懒地靠在椅子上，目光时不时游离到你的盘子里。你意识到卡娜丝只是想让你多吃点，也许她已经下意识把你当作自己的学生了。

DatingCharacterEvent.120303.6.cn: 在学院的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.120303.7.en: Taken by Canace to the faculty cafeteria, you discovered the food there is markedly better than the students' meals. You enjoyed your meal and realized that even the so-called "Devil Teacher" had a caring side.
DatingCharacterEvent.120303.7.cn: 被卡娜丝带去了教职工食堂，这里的确比学生食堂好上一些，借机开个小灶吧。你发现即便是传说中的“魔鬼教师”，也有关心体贴的一面。

DatingCharacterEvent.120304.1.en: The market stalls were overflowing, yet your gaze stayed fixed on Canace. What would someone like her even buy here?
DatingCharacterEvent.120304.1.cn: 集市的商品有很多，但你的目光却放在了卡娜丝身上。你心想，像卡娜丝这样的人会在集市里买什么呢？

DatingCharacterEvent.120304.2.en:
While you were lost in thought, Canace slipped away. You eventually found her staring blankly into a mirror, clutching something in her hand.
"Find something you like, Canace?"
She started at your voice, quickly wearing the item...
DatingCharacterEvent.120304.2.cn:
思考间，你发现卡娜丝已经脱离了你的视线。再次找到她时，她却对着一面镜子发呆，手里正攥着什么东西。
“卡娜丝？有相中什么吗？”
听到你的声音后，她颤了一下，然后将手里的那个东西戴在了脸上……

DatingCharacterEvent.120304.3.en:
"Do these make me look ... more approachable...?"
She had picked out a pair of red glasses.
You chuckled.
"Say no more. I have my answer,"
she said, quickly turning away to play it cool.
But one glance at the mirror proved she couldn't hide her joy.
DatingCharacterEvent.120304.3.cn:
“这样看上去……会不会有亲和力一点……？”
原来她选了一副红色的眼镜。
看着她的样子，你不禁笑了一下。
“你不用说了，我有答案了。”
她连忙转过身低着头冷静说道。
你望向镜子，看来，她的喜悦还是没能藏住。

DatingCharacterEvent.120304.6.cn: 在集市的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.120304.7.en: At the market, Canace found a cute pair of red glasses. She kept checking her reflection, but when she caught you smiling, she turned her back with a cool reply. The blush in the mirror told you everything.
DatingCharacterEvent.120304.7.cn: 卡娜丝在集市里淘到了一副可爱的红色眼镜，在镜子面前反复确认是否合适，当见到你的笑容，她又转过身冷静回复，你看着镜子里她脸红的样子，一切不言自明。

DatingCharacterEvent.123301.1.en: Ann suddenly comes running. She grabs your hand and pulls you forward, saying she's discovered some mysterious treasure inside a cave.
DatingCharacterEvent.123301.1.cn: 杏子突然跑来拽着你的手就往深处跑去，说她在洞窟里发现了神秘宝藏。

DatingCharacterEvent.123301.2.en: As you venture deeper into the cave, a beautiful, melodic tune drifts out. Moving closer, you find it's a music box left behind by someone.
DatingCharacterEvent.123301.2.cn: 你走进洞窟深处，听见里面传来悠扬动听的歌声，走近一看，原来是不知被谁遗弃的八音盒。

DatingCharacterEvent.123301.3.en:
"This must be a gift from the mountain god for you, Ann. Let me show you how to use it."

Seeing Ann's anticipation, you offer a reasonable explanation, and she looks overjoyed.
DatingCharacterEvent.123301.3.cn:
“这是山神大人赐予杏子的礼物，我来教杏子怎么用吧。”
你望着杏子期待的眼神，给出了合理的解释，她看起来高兴坏了。

DatingCharacterEvent.123301.6.cn: 在洞窟的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.123301.7.en: You and Ann discovered an abandoned music box inside the cave. She's never seen such a thing before. Ann was eager to know how to make the little box sing again, fiddling with it nonstop until you finally taught her how to wind it.
DatingCharacterEvent.123301.7.cn: 和杏子在洞窟内发现了被人遗弃的八音盒，她没见过这种玩意儿。杏子很想知道怎么让这个小盒子再次歌唱，她不停地摆弄着，直到你教会她如何旋紧发条。

DatingCharacterEvent.123302.1.en:
The two of you decide to explore the game area and see what fun activities it has to offer.

Suddenly, Ann is entranced by a ring toss game.
DatingCharacterEvent.123302.1.cn:
你们决定在游戏区找找有什么好玩的抽奖项目。
突然，杏子的目光锁定在了一个套环的小游戏上。

DatingCharacterEvent.123302.2.en:
The grand prize is a beautifully decorated watering can. 

Ann says she wants to win it, but after a few tries, she hasn't had any luck. You're tempted to step in and win it for her, but you don't want to overstep.
DatingCharacterEvent.123302.2.cn:
游戏的大奖是一个装饰精美的浇水壶。
杏子表示她想赢下来，但试过几次都没能成功，你很想替她套中，但又怕影响她的参与感。

DatingCharacterEvent.123302.3.en:
Before she tosses the next ring, you lift her up.

"I'm as tall as you now, Bossy!"

Excited, she tosses the final ring and clinches the grand prize.

"Thank you, Bossy! I'll treasure it forever!"

You smile and pat her on the head, tell her that you're sure she will use it well.
DatingCharacterEvent.123302.3.cn:
在扔下一个环之前，你将她抱了起来，
“杏子变得和魔魔王一样高啦！”
她兴奋地扔出了最后一环，成功套中了大奖。
“谢谢魔魔王！杏子会一直珍藏的！”
你笑着摸了摸她的头，表示拿到了就要好好使用。

DatingCharacterEvent.123302.6.cn: 在集市的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.123302.7.en:
While exploring the market with Ann, you noticed her eyeing a watering can at the ring toss game.

After a few failed attempts, you lifted her up carefully, giving her a higher vantage point. She nailed it on her next try.
DatingCharacterEvent.123302.7.cn:
和杏子在集市上玩耍，注意到她很中意套环游戏中的一个浇水壶。
但尝试过几次后，杏子都没能成功，你小心将她抱了起来，视角变得更高的杏子一下就成功了。

DatingCharacterEvent.123303.1.en:
"Ann wants to read that one!"
She stood on her tiptoes, pointing to a botany book high up on the shelf.
DatingCharacterEvent.123303.1.cn:
“杏子想看那本书！”
杏子垫起脚，指着书架高处的一本植物学相关的书籍。

DatingCharacterEvent.123303.2.en:
You grabbed it for her, and she happily trotted over to a seat to dive in.
"Be a good girl now, Little Ann."
Leaving her to it, you went off to find your own book. A few minutes passed before you heard murmurs coming from her direction.
DatingCharacterEvent.123303.2.cn:
你帮杏子取下了书籍，她高兴地小跑到旁边的座位上专心看书。
“要乖哦小杏子。”
嘱咐完，你也打算找一本书陪她一起打发时间，这一挑，就是好几分钟，直到你听见杏子的座位那边传来窸窸窣窣的人声。

DatingCharacterEvent.123303.3.en:
"This is Soul Waker. You can brew its seeds into tea."
"Ann knows you can brew Honeysuckle too!"
"You sure know a lot, kiddo!"
"Bossy taught Ann everything!"
A small crowd of students had gathered around Ann, patiently teaching her from the book.
You sat quietly across from them, taking in the heartwarming scene.
DatingCharacterEvent.123303.3.cn:
“这个叫醒神草哦，它的草籽可以泡水喝。”
“杏子知道金藤花也可以泡水喝！”
“小朋友你懂得好多呀~”
“都是魔魔王教杏子的！”
不知不觉，杏子身边聚集了一些学生，他们耐心地教杏子书上的知识。
你静静地坐到她的对面，看着这幅温馨的画面。

DatingCharacterEvent.123303.6.cn: 在学院的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.123303.7.en: At the academy's open day, you took Ann to check out the library. As she settled down with a book, some students noticed and patiently walked her through the material. Your heart warmed as you quietly watched.
DatingCharacterEvent.123303.7.cn: 趁着学院开放日，你带着杏子来到学院的图书馆内转转，当杏子拿下一本书坐回位子上时，有不少学生注意到了她，并耐心地指导她书上的知识，你看着这幅温馨的画面，不再出声。

DatingCharacterEvent.125301.1.en:
You spot mushrooms growing in cracks along the rock wall.

"These must be top-notch ingredients," you say, handing one to Freesia.

Inside the dim cave, the brightly colored mushroom looks very appetizing.
DatingCharacterEvent.125301.1.cn:
你看到了生长在岩壁缝隙处的蘑菇。
“这一定是上好的食材。”你摘下蘑菇，递给苍兰看。
晦暗的洞窟中，这株色彩鲜艳的蘑菇令你食欲大开。

DatingCharacterEvent.125301.2.en:
You quickly pop the mushroom into your mouth. The flavor is somewhat bland but the texture is excellent.

Freesia grabs your shoulder nervously. You don't understand why she's overreacting so much—or, for that matter, what she's saying.

In your eyes, Freesia suddenly grows a pair of wings, her hair flowing freely as if she's an angel. Then her figure begins spinning and twisting rapidly, shrinking until she becomes nothing more than a tiny dot...
DatingCharacterEvent.125301.2.cn:
你迅速将蘑菇塞进嘴里，味道有些寡淡，但口感极佳。
苍兰紧张地抓住了你的肩膀，你不明白为什么她的反应如此激烈，你听不到她在说什么。
苍兰在你眼中长出了翅膀，头发披散下来，仿佛一个神圣的天使。紧接着，她的身影飞速旋转、扭曲，直到化作一个小点……

DatingCharacterEvent.125301.3.en:
"Ugh—!"

A bright beam of light cuts through the strange world in your mind, pulling you back to reality. You find yourself wrapped in Freesia's warm jacket.

"Phew... You're finally awake," Freesia sighs with relief and puts down her hand lamp. "The book's method for breaking hallucinations actually worked."

"You were completely entranced. Could it have some kind of special magic?"

Freesia looks thoughtful.
DatingCharacterEvent.125301.3.cn:
“呃啊——”
一道强烈的光线撕开了你脑海中的奇幻世界。你回到了现实，发现自己身上盖着苍兰温暖的外套。
“呼……您终于醒了。”苍兰长舒了一口气，放下照明灯，“书上说的解除幻觉的方法是有效的。”
“您刚刚像是被那个蘑菇蛊惑了一样，难道它有什么特殊的魔法吗？”
苍兰陷入了沉思。

DatingCharacterEvent.125301.6.cn: 在洞窟的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.125301.7.en:
While exploring the cave with Freesia, you fell victim to the mysterious "mushroom magic"!

The Freesia in your hallucination was an untouchable divine phantom. Thankfully, in reality, she stayed by your side throughout.
DatingCharacterEvent.125301.7.cn:
和苍兰在洞窟中探险，却遭遇了神秘的“蘑菇魔法”？！
幻觉中的苍兰，是无法触碰的神圣幻影。幸好，现实里她一直守候在你的身边。

DatingCharacterEvent.125302.1.en:
The sweet seems to lift Freesia's spirits, and you notice her starting to relax.
"I knew it... I always feel happy when I'm with you."
DatingCharacterEvent.125302.1.cn:
甜蜜的滋味冲淡了苍兰的愁绪，你察觉到她逐渐放松了下来。
“果然……只要和您呆在一起，心情就会慢慢变好。”

DatingCharacterEvent.125302.2.en:
Freesia, who's not one to open up easily, tells you about her dilemma: During one of her deliveries, she helped an elderly woman. Since then, every time she visits to deliver mail, the old lady warmly invites her to stay for a meal.

Freesia doesn't want to trouble her but isn't sure how to politely decline without hurting her feelings.
DatingCharacterEvent.125302.2.cn:
一贯不喜欢倾诉的苍兰，向你讲述她的烦恼：原来，在某次送信的途中，苍兰帮了一位老奶奶的忙。自那之后，每次她去送信，奶奶都热情地留她在家吃饭。
苍兰不想麻烦奶奶，又不知该如何推辞才能不伤她的心。

DatingCharacterEvent.125302.3.en:
You tell Freesia to share how she truly feels, the old lady is sure to understand.

Freesia nods, a look of realization on her face. You've helped her resolve something that's been bothering her for a while.
DatingCharacterEvent.125302.3.cn:
你告诉苍兰，只要坦诚地说出自己的真实想法，对方一定能感受到你的心意。
苍兰恍然大悟地点点头，你帮她解决了一直以来的困扰。

DatingCharacterEvent.125302.6.en: Visit the Dessert Shop to unlock
DatingCharacterEvent.125302.6.cn: 在甜品屋的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.125302.7.en:
Freesia invited you to meet at the Dessert Shop, but you noticed she seemed a bit down.

After hearing her story, your advice helped Freesia resolving the issue. Interpersonal relationships are often not as complicated as we imagine.
DatingCharacterEvent.125302.7.cn:
苍兰约你在甜品屋见面，你发现了她有些闷闷不乐。
了解原委后，你的建议令苍兰解开了心结。人与人之间的相处，往往没有想象中那样复杂。

DatingCharacterEvent.125303.1.en: In the Market, Freesia lingered in front of a stall for a long time.
DatingCharacterEvent.125303.1.cn: 集市里，苍兰站在一个摊位前久久没有挪步。

DatingCharacterEvent.125303.2.en:
You noticed that Freesia is staring blankly at the Monolith chips, seemingly torn over whether to buy them.

"If you want some, just get them."
you suggested.
"I've already bought a lot of snacks this month. If I buy more, Donna will nag at me."

Freesia gave the bag of chips one last look, then decided to give it up.
DatingCharacterEvent.125303.2.cn:
你发现苍兰正盯着摊位上的星塔薯片出神，看上去似乎正在纠结要不要买。
“想吃的话就买吧？”
你向她提议。
“这个月已经买了很多零食了，再买的话会被多娜说的。”
苍兰最后看了一眼那袋薯片，决定还是算了。

DatingCharacterEvent.125303.3.en:
Before Freesia could react, you bought the bag of chips and handed it to her.

"It's not like this is a big bag. If we finish it now, Donna won't know."

Thus persuaded, the two of you shared the bag of chips together.
DatingCharacterEvent.125303.3.cn:
在苍兰反应过来之前，你买下了那包薯片并送给了她。
“看上去分量也不大，现在就吃完的话，多娜不会发现的。”
最终，苍兰被你说服了，你们一起分享了这袋薯片。

DatingCharacterEvent.125303.6.cn: 在集市的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.125303.7.en: At the Market, Freesia spotted the chips being sold at a stall and couldn't tear herself away, so you bought the snack and gave it to her. You realized that Freesia really liked snacks.
DatingCharacterEvent.125303.7.cn: 集市上，苍兰在发现了摊位上贩卖的薯片之后就挪不动步了，于是你将零食买下来送给了她，你发现了苍兰真的很喜欢零食。

DatingCharacterEvent.126301.1.en: Flora tells you there's an even better dessert shop nearby, so you hop over. This one feels fancier, and while scanning the menu you notice they are selling celeb collaboration items.
DatingCharacterEvent.126301.1.cn: 紫槿表示附近有一家更美味的店家，于是你们决定转场。这家甜品屋似乎更加高档，快速过目了菜单，你发现这家店似乎还卖明星联动的商品。

DatingCharacterEvent.126301.2.en:
You carefully read the menu again, determined not to miss a single detail, and finally spot the one you want in the menu's corner.

Meanwhile, Flora has already finished her black tea. She wonders why your order hasn't arrived yet.
DatingCharacterEvent.126301.2.cn:
你再一次详细扫过了菜单，不肯放过任何一处细节，终于在角落里找到了你想要的“那个”。
与此同时，紫槿的红茶已经喝完了，她疑惑你点的甜品怎么还没有上。

DatingCharacterEvent.126301.3.en:
The waitress brings over a mousse cake and a cup of black tea that comes with your special celebrity collaboration merchandise.

"I didn't ... I didn't know they'd still have any left..."

Flora picks up her empty teacup to pretend she's sipping the tea, but you notice the faint blush spreading across her cheeks.
DatingCharacterEvent.126301.3.cn:
服务员送来了一个慕斯蛋糕，和附带了某个明星联动礼品的红茶。
“没，没想到居然还有存货啊……”
紫槿端起空的红茶杯，但你注意到，她的脸已经微微泛红了。

DatingCharacterEvent.126301.6.en: Visit the Dessert Shop to unlock
DatingCharacterEvent.126301.6.cn: 在甜品屋的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.126301.7.en: Flora treated you to a dessert shop. You saw that they sell celebrity collaboration goods, so you ordered one tied to the star you were most familiar with. But the real person sitting across from you had more charm.
DatingCharacterEvent.126301.7.cn: 紫槿请客带你去了一家甜品屋，你注意到这家店似乎有卖明星联动的周边，于是你点了那杯你最熟悉的明星。你把茶杯端起来同坐在你对面的人比较，还是真人更加魅力四射。

DatingCharacterEvent.126302.1.en:
Suddenly, a burst of excitement erupts from the crowd in a distance.

A street magic performance has begun.
DatingCharacterEvent.126302.1.cn:
忽然，远处的人群里爆发出一阵惊呼。
街头魔术演出开始了。

DatingCharacterEvent.126302.2.en:
The impromptu magic performance draws gasps of amazement from the crowd.

However, it seems the performer is nervous. You notice that she's missing a card from her deck.
DatingCharacterEvent.126302.2.cn:
这场临时的杂技演出，让观众们爆发出连连的惊叹声。
但似乎表演者有些紧张了，你注意到她的卡牌组里漏了一张。

DatingCharacterEvent.126302.3.en:
Suddenly, you notice a playing card streaking through the crowd like a swift falcon, filling the gap in the performer's routine before anyone can notice it.

You turn to see Flora smiling, giving you a playful wink.
DatingCharacterEvent.126302.3.cn:
突然，你注意到一张扑克牌像只游隼般急速穿越人群，以大家都没有注意到的速度，补上了那个表演的空缺。
转过头，紫槿笑着对你眨了眨眼。

DatingCharacterEvent.126302.6.cn: 在集市的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.126302.7.en: You and Flora watched a street magic performance together. You were lucky to witness this master magician giving aid to the young performer.
DatingCharacterEvent.126302.7.cn: 和紫槿一起欣赏了街头魔术表演，但节目似乎出现了意外。但是没有关系，这位魔术界的大前辈对后辈的场外援助马上就到。

DatingCharacterEvent.126303.1.en:
Flora scanned the empty library plaza, then suddenly pulled you into a corner. She picked up a fallen branch and carefully whittled it down.
Before long, it actually looked like a pretty convincing wand.
DatingCharacterEvent.126303.1.cn:
看着空旷的图书馆广场，紫槿突然把你拉到了一个角落，随后捡起地上的树枝，小心翼翼地削去了多余的部分。
没过一会，树枝已经变成了一根有模有样的“法杖”。

DatingCharacterEvent.126303.2.en:
Flora handed you the wand, then stepped back and pointed her own weapon at you.
Catching on to her serious look, you played along, raising your "wand" and aiming it right back...
DatingCharacterEvent.126303.2.cn:
紫槿将法杖交给你，然后走到你的对面，举起自己的武器对准了你。
看着她突然认真的表情，你好像意识到了什么，于是你也举起“法杖”对准了她……

DatingCharacterEvent.126303.3.en:
"Disarm!"
"Vanquish!"
You shouted together, then crumpled to the ground like an evil lord defeated by the hero.
A camera shutter clicked. You jumped up and high-fived Flora, celebrating your perfectly timed improv.
That's when you realized the click came from a group of students watching nearby. Blushing at their applause, the two of you took a quick bow and hurried away.
DatingCharacterEvent.126303.3.cn:
“缴械咒！”
“索命咒！”
齐声过后，你像个被救世主打败的魔王一样倒在了地上。
随着“咔”的一声，你又站了起来，和赶来的紫槿拍着手，庆祝你们又一次对上了彼此的暗号，即兴表演了一出好戏。
然后你们才意识到，刚才的“咔”声来自一旁看戏的学生们，在众人的掌声下，你们只好红着脸一起鞠躬，然后小跑离开了。

DatingCharacterEvent.126303.6.cn: 在学院的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.126303.7.en: During a quiet moment on campus, you and Flora spontaneously reenacted a classic wand duel from a Stella Drama in a plaza corner. Judging by the applause from a few passing students, you completely nailed it.
DatingCharacterEvent.126303.7.cn: 你与紫槿趁着学校人少的时间，在广场的角落，即兴表演了一出经典影戏中的魔杖对决桥段，从偶然路过的观众反应来看，你们演得确实不错。

DatingCharacterEvent.127301.1.en: You carefully make your way through jagged stalagmites, but one stumble and you end up scraping your knee.
DatingCharacterEvent.127301.1.cn: 你小心地穿越钟乳石构成的崎岖地形，但一个踉跄跌在地上，膝盖被碎石划破。

DatingCharacterEvent.127301.2.en:
You instinctively reach for some gauze for a quick bandaging, but Teresa stops you.

"If you get hurt in an unknown environment, you need to disinfect the wound first."
DatingCharacterEvent.127301.2.cn:
你下意识想拿出纱布随便应付，却被特丽莎制止了。
“在未知洞穴里受伤的话，得先消毒。”

DatingCharacterEvent.127301.3.en: She carefully cleans your wound, as if she's done this countless times before. It pains you to think how much experience she must have had to become this skilled.
DatingCharacterEvent.127301.3.cn: 她细心地帮你清理了伤口，似乎她已经亲身体验过很多次了，你只感觉这一切熟练得让人心疼。

DatingCharacterEvent.127301.6.cn: 在洞窟的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.127301.7.en:
While exploring the cave with Teresa, you got cut by some gravel. Teresa immediately tended to your wound.

What should have been a painful experience turned out surprisingly gentle thanks to her practiced care.
DatingCharacterEvent.127301.7.cn: 和特丽莎一起在洞窟里探险时，被碎石割伤，特丽莎立刻为你处理伤口，本以为消毒会十分疼痛，但她的专业手法比想象中温和许多。

DatingCharacterEvent.127302.1.en: After exploring the market, Teresa takes out a beautifully wrapped gift. She had secretly picked it out earlier at the market.
DatingCharacterEvent.127302.1.cn: 你们逛完了集市，特丽莎拿出了一个包装精美的礼物。这是她偷偷在集市上提前相中的。

DatingCharacterEvent.127302.2.en:
You look at the gift you've prepared for her.

"I can guess what you're going to give me, so I've got the same gift ready for you in return."
DatingCharacterEvent.127302.2.cn:
你看着自己也准备送她的礼物，说道：
“我能猜到你要送我什么，所以我也准备了同样的回礼。”

DatingCharacterEvent.127302.3.en: You swap gifts. Sure enough, they're both band-aids, each with a unique design. Teresa jumps up with joy and then carefully puts the gift you gave her into her backpack.
DatingCharacterEvent.127302.3.cn: 你们互换了礼物，果然都是创可贴，而且印花各不相同。特丽莎高兴地一蹦一跳，小心翼翼地把你送的礼物装进了背包里。

DatingCharacterEvent.127302.6.cn: 在集市的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.127302.7.en:
After exploring the market with Teresa, you exchanged gifts. As you had expected, you both ended up getting band-aids for each other.

Life is full of bumps and scrapes, but thankfully we can bandage each and every one of them.
DatingCharacterEvent.127302.7.cn: 和特丽莎逛完了集市后互相交换了礼物，如你所想，果然都为对方买了创可贴。生活总是磕磕绊绊，所幸，我们还有创可贴。

DatingCharacterEvent.127303.1.en:
After finishing the tour, you both headed to the academy cafeteria for lunch.
Good thing you got there early. A massive line snaked around the hall shortly after.
DatingCharacterEvent.127303.1.cn:
逛得差不多了，你们来到学院食堂准备享用午餐。
你们很庆幸来得早，因为不久后这里便排起了长队。

DatingCharacterEvent.127303.2.en: Suddenly, a loud buzz cut through the cafeteria. You traced it to the food-serving Artifact, which had broken down, meaning the students in line were going to go hungry.
DatingCharacterEvent.127303.2.cn: 突然间，食堂内传来尖锐爆鸣，你们循声望去，原来是餐食神器出了问题，这意味着后来排队的学生们可能要饿肚子了。

DatingCharacterEvent.127303.3.en:
You were starting to feel sorry for the students when you noticed Teresa had already slipped over to the broken machine. She rolled up her sleeves and started tinkering.
Within moments, the Artifact hummed back to life. The crowd burst into applause, and Teresa, like a tiny hero, slid back into her seat beside you and dug straight into her food.
You saw the tips of her ears turning bright red.
DatingCharacterEvent.127303.3.cn:
正当你为学生们感到遗憾时，转过头，特丽莎却不知什么时候已经溜到故障的神器旁，并撸起袖子捣鼓起来。
没几下的功夫，神器竟然重新运行起来了，人群爆发出激烈的掌声，特丽莎像个小英雄般，在众人的欢呼中坐回了你的旁边，闷头干起饭来。
你注意到她的耳朵根已经红得不行了。

DatingCharacterEvent.127303.6.cn: 在学院的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.127303.7.en: While grabbing lunch after your academy tour, the food-serving artifact suddenly broke down. Teresa instinctively rushed over to fix it. Caught in a wave of applause, she bashfully hurried back to your side and focused entirely on her meal.
DatingCharacterEvent.127303.7.cn: 你和特丽莎参观了学院并在食堂用饭，突然出餐神器出了故障，特丽莎本能地跑去把它修好，回过神来她已经淹没在众人的掌声下，只能害羞地坐回你的旁边，闷头干饭。

DatingCharacterEvent.130301.1.en:
As you passed the game stalls at the market, you noticed one of the prizes on display: a cute little teddy bear.

Just then, Donna suddenly leaned closer and asked, "Hey Boss, do you like that one? If you do, I can win it for you!"

Before you could say no, Donna had already picked up the bow and arrows from the stall.

"Just watch. Archery is my specialty!"
DatingCharacterEvent.130301.1.cn:
你们路过集市的游戏区时，你注意到了游戏摊位上有一个奖品，那是一只可爱的小熊。
就在这时，多娜突然凑近问你：“喜欢那个吗？喜欢的话我帮你拿下吧！”
不等你拒绝，多娜已经拿起小摊上的弓箭。
“看着吧，弓箭可是我的强项！”

DatingCharacterEvent.130301.2.en:
Something strange happened. No matter how many times Donna's arrows hit the teddy bear, it remained firmly seated on the wooden board. You began to suspect something was wrong.

"Is that bear ... fixed to the board?"

"So this is just a scam?!"

The stall owner's eyes darted away, but he still insisted that Donna had only failed because her archery wasn't good enough.
DatingCharacterEvent.130301.2.cn:
奇怪的事情发生了，无论多娜的箭射中小熊多少次，那只小熊都稳稳地坐在木板上。你意识到了不对。
“这个熊是不是，被摊主固定在板子上了？”
“那不是诈骗吗？！”
小摊老板闻言，眼神躲闪，但依然坚称是多娜的箭术不精才失败了。

DatingCharacterEvent.130301.3.en:
You were about to speak up for Donna when she drew the bow again, pulling the string taut. This time she didn't aim at the teddy bear but at the pillar beside it. The arrow struck the pillar, ricocheted, and hit the bear from the side, knocking it over.

As it fell, the back plate fixing it in place came into view.

In the end, the stall owner was taken away by the Trekker Association for operating in violation of regulations. You walked away with a plush teddy bear and Donna's triumphant grin.
DatingCharacterEvent.130301.3.cn:
你正想替多娜反驳，只见多娜再次将弓拉满。这一次，她瞄准的不是小熊，而是旁边的柱子，箭在击中柱子之后反弹，从侧面将小熊击倒。
倒下的小熊露出了背后固定的挡板。
最终，地理协会的人带走了这个违规的小摊老板，而你得到了一只毛绒小熊和多娜得意的笑容。

DatingCharacterEvent.130301.6.cn: 在集市的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.130301.7.en:
You took the teddy bear.

But you didn't tell Donna that the real reason you looked twice was that it looked a little like her.
DatingCharacterEvent.130301.7.cn:
你收下了那只小熊。
但你没有告诉多娜，你其实是因为这只小熊长得很像她，所以才多看了两眼。

DatingCharacterEvent.130302.1.en:
Beside the library front desk sits a basket stuffed with uncollected letters.

As you two walk by, Donna sighs: "Some of these may never reach the people they were meant for."
DatingCharacterEvent.130302.1.cn:
图书馆前台旁有个篮子，里面装着厚厚一沓未取走的信件。
你们走了过去，“唉。”多娜叹了口气，“有些信可能永远也到不了收信人手里了。”

DatingCharacterEvent.130302.2.en:
"This one, and this one." She picks up two letters from the top. "I delivered these."

She flips further down—the postmarks show they're years old. "Their recipients must have graduated by now."
DatingCharacterEvent.130302.2.cn:
“这个，还有这个。”多娜拿起两封摆在上面的信，“它们是我送的。”
继续向下翻去，信封上的邮戳显示它们已经有些年头了。“这些收信人，应该已经毕业了吧。”

DatingCharacterEvent.130302.3.en:
At the very bottom, one envelope doesn't even have a postmark. Its faded handwriting on yellowed paper looks like a love letter, nearly impossible to read.
Donna murmurs, "Some words... You have to say them before they fade away."
DatingCharacterEvent.130302.3.cn:
被压在最底部的一份信件甚至连邮戳都没有，近乎褪色的圆体字迹写在发黄破损的信封上，只能依稀辨认出是一封情书。
多娜喃喃道：“一些想说的话，一定要在褪色之前讲出来哦。”

DatingCharacterEvent.130302.6.cn: 在学院的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.130302.7.en: You and Donna found a pile of forgotten letters in the library. Messages left behind and buried by time.
DatingCharacterEvent.130302.7.cn: 你和多娜在图书馆里发现了未被领走的旧信堆。往日，堆积成山。

DatingCharacterEvent.132301.1.en:
You lead Minova deeper into the cave. A faint light starts to glow ahead.

A vast expanse of bioluminescent plants appears before you, transforming the dim cave into a dazzling river of stars.
DatingCharacterEvent.132301.1.cn:
你领着密涅瓦神走入了更深处的位置，前方传来微弱的光源。
一大片荧光植物出现在了你们面前，原本昏暗的洞穴顿时化作夜晚璀璨的星河。

DatingCharacterEvent.132301.2.en:
Minova gazes at the scene in awe.

"Look, if you collect the sap from the plants like this..."

You cut a leaf, and a fluorescent sap drips into the container.
DatingCharacterEvent.132301.2.cn:
密涅瓦望着这一切，满是惊叹。
“你看，像这样把植物的汁水收集起来……”
你切下植叶，某种荧光色的汁水滴落在容器里。

DatingCharacterEvent.132301.3.en:
When you pull out the unpainted skateboard you've been carrying, Minova's eyes light up. "This is awesome!"

Looks like she's finally got what you meant.
DatingCharacterEvent.132301.3.cn:
你掏出随身携带的未上色的滑板的那一刻，密涅瓦眼神闪亮地惊呼：“这也太拉风了！”
看来她终于领会了你的意思。

DatingCharacterEvent.132301.6.cn: 在洞窟的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.132301.7.en:
Together with Minova, you discovered glowing plants in the cave.

You carefully gathered up their sap, and she quickly caught on, marveling at your idea.
DatingCharacterEvent.132301.7.cn:
与密涅瓦一起在洞窟内发现了带有荧光效果的植物。
你小心地将汁水收集起来，密涅瓦很快领会了你的意图，并为之惊叹。

DatingCharacterEvent.132303.1.en:
Minova leads you into the library, saying she knows where the books you'd like are.

She wanders the shelves with ease, as if she were at home.
DatingCharacterEvent.132303.1.cn:
密涅瓦带着你走进了图书馆，她表示知道哪里有你感兴趣的书籍。
她熟练地在书架间漫步、搜寻，就好像回到了自己家一样。

DatingCharacterEvent.132303.2.en:
"Look!" She pulls out "An Introduction to Artifact Appraisal." "Read this and you won't get scammed by shady merchants."

She hands it to you with an awkward smile. "Hope it helps on your journey."
DatingCharacterEvent.132303.2.cn:
“你看！”密涅瓦从书架里抽出一本《神器鉴定概论》。“读了这个，你们就不会被奸商骗了。”
她把书递到我的手里，“希望这对你们的旅途有帮助”，密涅瓦不好意思地笑了笑。

DatingCharacterEvent.132303.3.en:
Using her student card, Minova checks the book out for you. Beneath it, you notice another book—perhaps a shoujo manga.

She seems to notice your glance and stammers, "Just remember to return it on time, okay?"
DatingCharacterEvent.132303.3.cn:
密涅瓦用自己的学生卡办理了借阅流程。你发现那本概论下面似乎还压着什么，也许是一本少女漫画吧。
她好像注意到了你的目光，连忙搪塞道“要记得按时还书哦！”

DatingCharacterEvent.132303.6.cn: 在学院的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.132303.7.en:
You explored the library with Minova and she checked out a useful book for you.

And though she tried to hide it, you noticed that she slipped a shoujo manga in there, too.
DatingCharacterEvent.132303.7.cn:
和密涅瓦逛图书馆的时候，她用自己的卡帮你借了一本有用的书。
在办理流程中，你还发现她也偷偷借了一本少女漫画。

DatingCharacterEvent.132304.1.en: You and Minova stepped into the resort's specialty souvenir shop. The small shop had taken on a hazy glow from the failing light.
DatingCharacterEvent.132304.1.cn: 你和密涅瓦走入了度假村的特选纪念品店，黄昏迫近，小店里也被染上一层暧昧的颜色。

DatingCharacterEvent.132304.2.en:
Unlike the other shops, this one offered all kinds of bowls, plates, and other food items, many of them rare pieces specially made for the resort or released as collaboration items. Minova, however, was clearly not interested in those. She wanted something more modern feel.

Then the two of you spotted a strangely shaped lollipop, which immediately caught Minova's eye.
DatingCharacterEvent.132304.2.cn:
与其他地方不同，这里卖着各式碗碟和其他食品，并且多是度假村特制或者联名的稀罕物。但是密涅瓦明显对这些不感兴趣，她需要一些更加具有现代性的玩意儿。
你们突然发现了一种造型奇特的棒棒糖，立刻吸引了密涅瓦的目光。

DatingCharacterEvent.132304.3.en:
The lollipop in front of you was nothing like the usual marble-sized ones. It was enormous, almost as big as Minova's bat. Drawn by your shared love of lollipops and out of pure curiosity, you decided to buy one on the spot.

But when you unwrapped it, you were surprised to find that the giant "lollipop" was actually made up of countless normal-sized lollipops tightly packed together inside a spherical shell.
DatingCharacterEvent.132304.3.cn:
眼前的棒棒糖与普通弹珠大小的截然不同，它硕大无比，几乎和密涅瓦的球棒一般大小。出于对棒棒糖的喜爱与强烈的好奇，你们当即决定买下一个。
然而，当你们拆开包装纸后，却惊讶地发现：这个巨大的“棒棒糖”其实是由无数个普通大小的小棒棒糖，紧密地封装在一个球形外壳里组成的。

DatingCharacterEvent.132304.6.en: Visit Hot Spring Resort to unlock
DatingCharacterEvent.132304.6.cn: 在温泉度假村的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.132304.7.en:
Minova and you spotted an enormous lollipop in the specialty souvenir shop. It was almost as big as Minova's bat. Drawn by your love of lollipops and pure curiosity, the two of you decided to buy one on the spot.

However, when you unwrapped it, you were surprised to find that the giant "lollipop" was actually made up of countless normal-sized lollipops tightly packed together inside a spherical shell.
DatingCharacterEvent.132304.7.cn: 你和密涅瓦在特选店里发现了一个几乎和密涅瓦的球棒一样大的棒棒糖。出于对棒棒糖的喜爱和好奇心，你们当即买下了一个。然而，当拆开包装之后，却发现里面并非是预想中的一颗完整的巨型糖果，而是由无数个普通大小的棒棒糖紧密包裹而成的球形集合体。

DatingCharacterEvent.133301.1.en:
You and Nazuka were strolling through the Market when you noticed a shady-looking merchant in a dim corner. He was wrapped all in black, and his stall was also covered with a dark cloth.

"He's giving off a very suspicious vibe," Nazuka remarked.
DatingCharacterEvent.133301.1.cn:
你和夏花二人在集市里继续闲逛，突然注意到在某个不引人注目的角落，有某个浑身笼罩在黑衣里的商贩，他面前的摊位上同样罩着一层黑布……
“浑身散发着可疑的气味呢。”夏花评价道。

DatingCharacterEvent.133301.2.en:
Anyone else might have thought "better not get involved" and walked away, but Nazuka clearly wasn't the type.

Before approaching, she glanced at you, a hint of hesitation in her eyes.

"I'll go with you," you said firmly.

Together, you stepped up to the stall and lifted the cloth...
Beneath it gleamed rows of cold, sharp weapons.
DatingCharacterEvent.133301.2.cn:
如果换成别人，可能会觉得“多一事不如少一事”，当作没看见，但夏花显然不是这种人。
在靠近对方之前，她看向你，露出迟疑的表情。
“我和你一起。”你坚定地说。
你们走到摊位前，一把掀开了黑布。映入眼帘的……
是寒光闪闪的大量兵器。

DatingCharacterEvent.133301.3.en:
You got a scare, but Nazuka remained calm.

"These are ... replicas. They are safe." She crouched down, examining each one before reaching her conclusion.

"Y-Yes, just toys," the merchant complained, "but they look so real that no one wants to buy them... I had to set up here in the corner to avoid drawing attention."

A false alarm, thankfully.
DatingCharacterEvent.133301.3.cn:
你吓了一跳，但夏花的反应却很冷静。
“这是……无害的仿制品。”她蹲下来，全部检查一遍后才得出结论。
“是、是的，只是玩具，但因为太过逼真，反而卖不出去……”店主抱怨道，“我为了尽量不引起别人注意，才在角落里摆摊。”
……真是虚惊一场。

DatingCharacterEvent.133301.6.cn: 在集市的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.133301.7.en:
You and Nazuka explored the Market and spotted a shady merchant.

When you both checked his stall and lifted the cover, you found piles of weapons...

However, after closer inspection, they turned out to be nothing more than realistic toys.
DatingCharacterEvent.133301.7.cn:
和夏花一起去集市里逛街，注意到了可疑的摊贩。
夏花和你上前检查，掀开罩布，居然看到了大量冷兵器……
不过，经过检查，你们意识到，这只不过是些逼真的玩具罢了。

DatingCharacterEvent.133302.1.en:
You and Nazuka sat together in a small boat, drifting across the water.
"Look, over there!"
A smile appeared on Nazuka's face as she pointed behind you.
You turned to see a waterwheel turning steadily along the riverbank.
DatingCharacterEvent.133302.1.cn:
你和夏花坐在船上，任由小舟在水面上飘荡。
“快看那里。”
突然，夏花的面庞上浮现笑容，她伸手指向后方。
你顺着那个方向看去，发现是一座矗立岸边的水车。

DatingCharacterEvent.133302.2.en:
Driven by the flow, the waterwheel creaked and spun.
Nazuka's voice was soft and nostalgic. "Back in Philae, this was my favorite thing to look at."
Windmills and waterwheels, she mused, were alike—turning endlessly, like the passage of time. Her smile was serene.
DatingCharacterEvent.133302.2.cn:
水车在水流的带动下“吱呀”转动。
夏花用怀念的语气，轻声说道：“在菲莱，我最喜欢的风景就是它。”
风车与水车，有着相似之处。它们都流转不停，好似岁月……她这么说着，笑容恬静。

DatingCharacterEvent.133302.3.en:
"But ... it's not quite the same anymore."
"Oh?"
"Now that you're here with me, even the most familiar view feels different."
So you both fell quiet, taking in the scene together.
DatingCharacterEvent.133302.3.cn:
“不过，和以前还是不一样了。”
“是吗？”
“现在的我，有你陪在身边，连司空见惯的风景，都有了不一样的寓意。”
于是你静下心来，和夏花一起欣赏风景。

DatingCharacterEvent.133302.6.cn: 在港口的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.133302.7.en:
You and Nazuka took a small boat out on the water. She noticed a waterwheel turning on the distant shore.

She said it was always her favorite sight, but now it held new meaning because you were next to her.

You understood what she meant, and the two of you watched the waterwheel in peaceful silence.
DatingCharacterEvent.133302.7.cn:
和夏花一起泛舟，她却留意到远方岸边，转个不停的水车。
她说那是她最喜欢的风景，如今则因为有了你的陪伴而有所不同。
你若有所悟，与她一起静静欣赏。

DatingCharacterEvent.134301.1.en: You and Fuyuka bumped into the shopkeeper. "Well, if it isn't Lady Fuyuka! Don't tell me you're on a secret date?" Fuyuka was so flustered she nearly fainted.
DatingCharacterEvent.134301.1.cn: 你和冬香被店长抓住了。“哇，这不是冬香大人吗！难道是在偷偷约会？”冬香害羞到快要晕过去了。

DatingCharacterEvent.134301.2.en:
With your help, she finally managed to fend off the questioning, but things didn't end there...

"Lady Fuyuka, how about being our Manager for a Day? I bet the shop would be packed!"

The shopkeeper's eager sincerity left Fuyuka with no way to turn the invitation down.
DatingCharacterEvent.134301.2.cn:
在你的帮助下，好不容易挣脱了追问，事情却没有到此告一段落……
“冬香大人，要不要来试着当次‘一日店长’？以你的人气，想必会吸引一大票顾客！”
对方的诚恳与热情，让冬香难以拒绝。

DatingCharacterEvent.134301.3.en:
Just as the shopkeeper predicted, Fuyuka's popularity drew in a huge crowd. As thanks, the shopkeeper not only doubled the payment but also personally prepared freshly baked cakes for you and Fuyuka.

"The cake is good. It's all thanks to you, Fuyuka."

"Heh... Hehe, it's only because of your encouragement, Master..."
DatingCharacterEvent.134301.3.cn:
正如店长所言，冬香的人气吸引了大量顾客。作为感谢，店长不但加倍支付了报酬，还亲自为你和冬香准备了新鲜出炉的美味蛋糕。
“托了你的福，冬香。”
“嘿……嘿嘿，都是靠师父的鼓励……”

DatingCharacterEvent.134301.6.en: Visit the Dessert Shop to unlock
DatingCharacterEvent.134301.6.cn: 在甜品屋的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.134301.7.en:
You went to the dessert shop with Fuyuka, and the shopkeeper noticed her, so she got roped into being the Manager for a Day.

The two of you walked away with generous pay and delicious cakes. It was tiring, but sweet in every sense.
DatingCharacterEvent.134301.7.cn:
和冬香一起去甜品屋，结果冬香被店长看中，当了回“一日店长”。
你们因此得到了丰厚的报酬与美味的甜品。虽然辛苦，却也甜蜜。

DatingCharacterEvent.134302.1.en:
The cave was growing darker. You could sense Fuyuka's hesitation, so you decided to stop for a while.

"I... I'm not scared..."

"It's fine even if you are," you said with a smile.
DatingCharacterEvent.134302.1.cn:
洞窟内的光线越来越暗，你感受到了冬香的踌躇不前，于是决定在此地驻足。
“我……我没有在害怕……”
“就算害怕也没什么啦。”你笑着安慰道。

DatingCharacterEvent.134302.2.en:
Even with your comfort, a trace of unease still lingered on Fuyuka's face.

"Master... Are there things you're afraid of too?"

"Of course," you said. "But being afraid doesn't mean being cowardly. You're just worried about the dangers ahead, that's why you hesitate, right? Caution is a good thing."
DatingCharacterEvent.134302.2.cn:
虽然有你在安慰，但冬香的表情中还是能看出些许失落。
“难道师父也会有害怕的东西吗？”
“当然有。”你说，“但害怕不意味着胆小，你是担心前方有危险，所以才不愿意继续向前的，对吧？谨慎是好事。”

DatingCharacterEvent.134302.3.en:
"In the end, a hero isn't someone without fear, it's someone who can still step forward to face it when it matters the most."

"T-Then ... if we really run into danger, I'll protect you, Master!"

"I know you will."

Fuyuka finally relaxed, a bright smile spreading across her face.
DatingCharacterEvent.134302.3.cn:
“总之，勇者并非真的无所畏惧，而是能在关键时刻，选择挺身而出。”
“那，那个……要是真的遇到危险，我一定会保护师父的！”
“我相信你。”
冬香终于放下心来，露出开朗的微笑。

DatingCharacterEvent.134302.6.cn: 在洞窟的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.134302.7.en:
You and Fuyuka ventured into The Cave together. Partway through, she sensed danger ahead and decided to stall for a bit.

Worried that you might think her a coward, she grew uneasy. You saw through it, reassured her, and taught her what courage truly means.

Your words brought her relief and your bond grew a little stronger.
DatingCharacterEvent.134302.7.cn:
和冬香一起去洞窟探险，中途她感受到了前方的危险，于是决定在原地休息。
她因担心被你认为是胆小鬼而不安。你看出了这一点，安慰了她，教导她何为勇敢。
冬香放下心来，师徒二人的关系因此更进一步。

DatingCharacterEvent.135301.1.en: In the innermost part of the cave, Mistique discovers a massive shrine, inside which is a giant projector artifact.
DatingCharacterEvent.135301.1.cn: 洞窟的最深处，雾语发现了一个巨大的神龛——里面，放着一只巨大的显影神器。

DatingCharacterEvent.135301.2.en:
Judging by the nearby wall paintings, it seems that those who worshiped here believed the image revealed by the artifact was that of a deity's.

Mistique excitedly grabs her camera and starts clicking.

"What a rare find! An actual archaeological discovery!"
DatingCharacterEvent.135301.2.cn:
从周围的壁画推断，在此祭拜的人，似乎认为显影神器里出现的是神的身影。
雾语兴奋地拿起了自己的留影机咔咔地拍起了照片。
“真是难得的题材，居然有考古新闻！”

DatingCharacterEvent.135301.3.en:
"Aren't you going to take it?" you ask.

"News is not only about front page, but to preserve the site and truth."

Looks like the Witch sticks to her principles.

You smile at each other and carry on with your journey.
DatingCharacterEvent.135301.3.cn:
“不拿走吗？”你发出了自己的疑问。
“既然是新闻，就要保护现场。”
看来，魔女也恪守自己的原则。
你们相视而笑，继续着旅途。

DatingCharacterEvent.135301.6.cn: 在洞窟的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.135301.7.en:
While exploring the cave with Mistique, you discovered the remains of an ancient shrine dedicated to a powerful Artifact.

Mistique documented and preserved the site, noting that this was in keeping with the professional ethics of a great Witch.
DatingCharacterEvent.135301.7.cn:
和雾语在洞窟的深处发现了古代人供奉神器的遗迹。
雾语记录并保护了现场，并表示，这体现了一个伟大而专业的魔女的高尚职业操守。

DatingCharacterEvent.135302.1.en:
Time flies by. It seems you've visited every section you are interested in.

Mistique says there's something she wants to read on her own.

So you part ways for a little while. With your legs feeling sore, you find a chair to rest on. Before you know it, you've drifted off to sleep.
DatingCharacterEvent.135302.1.cn:
时光飞逝，能逛的书区，似乎都已看了一圈。
雾语说，还有些想要自己看看的东西。
于是你们暂时分别，有些腿酸的你，在一旁椅子上歇息下来，没成想居然睡了过去。

DatingCharacterEvent.135302.2.en:
Time flies by. You wake up from your nap to the sound of a camera clicking.

Mistique has returned and she's taking pictures of your sleeping face.
DatingCharacterEvent.135302.2.cn:
时光流逝，小憩后的你， 听到了快门响起的声音。
原来雾语早已返回，在偷偷地拍你的睡颜。

DatingCharacterEvent.135302.3.en:
"This is a nice memento."

She chuckles softly and carefully puts the camera away.

"This is a successful material gathering today."
DatingCharacterEvent.135302.3.cn:
“留下了不错的纪念呢。”
她轻声笑道，郑重地收好了显影机。
“收获满满啊，这次取材。”

DatingCharacterEvent.135302.6.cn: 在学院的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.135302.7.en:
After strolling the library with Mistique, you were exhausted and fell asleep in a chair.

Mistique seized this opportunity to snap a photo of your sleeping face.

Despite all your protests, it seemed unlikely she will ever hand this photo over to you.
DatingCharacterEvent.135302.7.cn:
和雾语游览图书馆后，疲惫的你在椅子上不小心睡着了。
雾语抓住机会拍下了你的睡脸。
不论你如何强烈要求，这张照片大概是拿不回来了。

DatingCharacterEvent.135303.1.en: The Market was holding a time trial race today: no matter what kind of transportation you used, as long as you followed the route through the streets and alleys, the first person to reach the finish line in the Ash District could take any item from the market worth up to 100,000 Dorra for free.
DatingCharacterEvent.135303.1.cn: 集市今天正举办一场竞速赛：无论你使用何种交通工具，只要按路线穿越街巷，第一个抵达灰城区的终点，就能免费带走集市上任选的价值十万朵拉的商品。

DatingCharacterEvent.135303.2.en:
Curious, you asked the organizers whether Mistique would be allowed to enter the race while riding her broom. In keeping with the rule that "any form of transportation is allowed," the organizers readily agreed, adding only one condition: the broom's flying height had to be limited.

Just then, a beautifully made sketchbook set at a nearby stall caught Mistique's eye, so she decided to sign up for the race right on the spot.
DatingCharacterEvent.135303.2.cn:
你好奇地向举办方询问，是否允许雾语骑着她的扫帚参赛。本着“交通工具不限”的原则，举办方爽快地同意了，只是附加了一条规则：扫帚的飞行高度必须受到限制。
就在这时，雾语的目光也正好被一旁摊位上的一套精美速写本套装牢牢吸引住了。于是，雾语当即决定报名参加这场竞速赛。

DatingCharacterEvent.135303.3.en:
Even with the broom restricted to flying close to the ground, its speed still gave her an almost unfair advantage. However, the Ash District's maze of tangled alleyways quickly left Mistique disoriented.

Fortunately, you had a map of the district on your phone. By staying in contact with Mistique, you guided her with precise directions. Thanks to your flawless teamwork, she left her competitors in the dust and crossed the finish line first.
DatingCharacterEvent.135303.3.cn:
尽管扫帚被限制为贴地飞行，其速度依然带来了作弊级的优势。然而，灰城区错综复杂的胡同很快让雾语迷失了方向。
幸好，你的手机里存有灰城区的地图。你一边与雾语保持通讯，一边为她精准导航。凭借这天衣无缝的配合，雾语毫无悬念地第一个冲过了终点线。

DatingCharacterEvent.135303.6.cn: 在集市的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.135303.7.en: You and Mistique signed up for a time trial race at the Market where any and all forms of transportation were allowed. Although you couldn't ride the broom and compete alongside her, you used the map saved on your phone to guide her instead. In the end, with your flawless groundwork, the two of you easily won the race.
DatingCharacterEvent.135303.7.cn: 你和雾语报名参加了集市上的一场“不限制交通工具”的竞速赛，虽然不能坐在扫帚上和雾语一同参赛，但你却利用手机里保存的地图为雾语做起了领航员。最终，凭借这天衣无缝的地面与空中配合，你们轻松赢得了冠军。

DatingCharacterEvent.140301.1.en:
A massive crowd is swarming the game booth today. The grand prize is a phonograph the owner dug up from who-knows-where.
"An Artifact that plays records. This one's actually pretty cute, and the colors match your outfit." Sparkla eyes the device with intense interest.
Catching your confused look, she nods calmly. "I already have one in my workshop."
DatingCharacterEvent.140301.1.cn:
今天的游戏摊位前集结了不少人——头等奖区域放着一台摊主不知道从哪里淘来的留声机。
“是能播放唱片的神器，不过这台的外形还挺可爱的，配色像你。”斯帕克拉似乎对这台神器非常感兴趣。
看出你的疑问，她淡定点头：“因为我的工坊里已经有一台。”

DatingCharacterEvent.140301.2.en:
"I just don't own many records, so mine mostly gather dust. But Trekkers like you travel everywhere, so you must have plenty, right? Let's win this thing and set it up on Lucky Oasis."
You two are on the exact same wavelength. Teaming up, you step up to win the grand prize."
DatingCharacterEvent.140301.2.cn:
“只是我收集的唱片并不多，留声机基本都是闲置状态。但是像你们旅团这样的旅人就不一定了吧？不如我们把这台赢下来，放在绿洲号上。”
你与斯帕克拉一拍即合，两人组队，发起对头等奖的挑战。

DatingCharacterEvent.140301.3.en:
A whole day flies by. The audience watching your attempts rotates out several times, yet the phonograph sits untouched on its pedestal. Meanwhile, the booth owner happily counts the piles of Dorra he's milked from you two.
"You know, this phonograph isn't even that nice. Let's just wish for a brand-new one at the Monolith." Agreeing once again, you and Sparkla beat a hasty retreat.
DatingCharacterEvent.140301.3.cn:
只见一天过去，围观你们挑战的人换了一批又一批，留声机依旧稳稳地被摆在头等奖区域，摊主乐得在旁边数着今天从你们两人身上赚到的朵拉。
“这个留声机也没什么好的，还是去星塔许愿一个全新的吧。”你与斯帕克拉再次达成一致，逃离了游戏摊位。

DatingCharacterEvent.140301.6.cn: 在集市的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.140301.7.en: You and Sparkla spend all day trying to win the grand prize at a market game booth. Walking away empty-handed, you console each other and vow to get your revenge at the Monolith.
DatingCharacterEvent.140301.7.cn: 你和斯帕克拉在集市上一起挑战游戏头等奖。然而一天过去，颗粒无收的你们只得互相安慰，要去星塔找回场子。

DatingCharacterEvent.140302.1.en:
"You've got guts, sneaking someone from the NGO into a Grace Imperium library." Sparkla shoots you a covert thumbs-up.
"Well, your wanted poster is literally just a drawing of a rabbit. Nobody's going to recognize you." You nod right back at her.
"It's just a shame Rabbit Pie has to wait outside."
DatingCharacterEvent.140302.1.cn:
“你的胆子真大，竟然敢带着柔光会社的人溜进恩赐意志的图书馆。”斯帕克拉偷偷竖起一根大拇指。
“毕竟你的悬赏令上画着一只兔子，没有人认得出你。”你也对斯帕克拉的机智予以了肯定。
“只是要委屈兔子派留在外面了。”

DatingCharacterEvent.140302.2.en:
Once in the stacks, Sparkla is right at home. She hauls a massive pile of books to a reading desk. You peek over her shoulder, fully expecting dense formulas and abstract theories—only to find pages packed with cute illustrations.
"They have such a great collection of fairy tales here. I approve." Sparkla turns the page, looking as intensely focused as if she were in the middle of a high-stakes experiment.
DatingCharacterEvent.140302.2.cn:
进入馆藏区的斯帕克拉如鱼得水，抱着厚厚的一堆书坐到了阅览室中。你探头去看，以为会看到些什么看不懂的公式和理论，却不料书页上都是一幅幅可爱的插画。
“这里的童话书真多，我很满意。”斯帕克拉翻开下一页，专注的样子仿佛是在进行实验的最关键阶段。

DatingCharacterEvent.140302.3.en:
Sparkla stretches.
Before you know it, you've spent an entire day in the library. Reluctantly, Sparkla slides the books she hadn't finished back onto the shelves.
"You..."
"I..."
You both speak up at the exact same time, then share a knowing smile.
"You were totally going to say we should come back, weren't you?"
DatingCharacterEvent.140302.3.cn:
斯帕克拉伸了一个懒腰。
不知不觉你们已经在图书馆度过了一整天。斯帕克拉恋恋不舍地将还没有看完的书放回原位。
“你……”
“我……”
你们同时心照不宣地开口，随即相视一笑。
“你一定是想说，下次还要再来，对吧？”

DatingCharacterEvent.140302.6.cn: 在学院的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.140302.7.en:
You sneak Sparkla into the Grace Imperium's library. She gets completely absorbed in their fairy tale collection, making for a surprisingly fulfilling day.
Afterward, you promise each other to return and read every single story on those shelves together.
DatingCharacterEvent.140302.7.cn:
你带着斯帕克拉悄悄溜进恩赐意志的图书馆。斯帕克拉被馆藏的童话书所吸引，度过了充实的一天。
而后，你们便互相约定，下次也要一起，读完这里所有的童话。

DatingCharacterEvent.141301.1.en: In the innermost part of the cave, you find the walls covered in murals.
DatingCharacterEvent.141301.1.cn: 洞窟的最深处，你们发现洞壁上画满了壁画。

DatingCharacterEvent.141301.2.en:
These murals are wildly abstract, much like the careless scribbles of a three-year-old. They look strange indeed inside the damp, dim cave.

And then you notice that Chixia isn't scared of the dark anymore. In fact, she's so excited that sparks are flying from her tail.
DatingCharacterEvent.141301.2.cn:
这些壁画非常抽象，看上去像三岁稚儿随手的幼稚涂鸦，在昏暗潮湿的环境里显得极其怪诞。
就在这时，你发现赤霞不仅没有了怕黑的样子，甚至兴奋得尾巴蹿出火花。

DatingCharacterEvent.141301.3.en:
"What kind of genius made this?!" Chixia practically presses herself against the wall. "Look! This Loong looks so real! This is amazing! And look at this phoenix—it feels like it's about to fly right off the wall!"

That's when it hits you—the style of these murals is almost identical to the way Chixia draws.
DatingCharacterEvent.141301.3.cn:
“这是什么天才杰作？！”赤霞几乎要趴在壁画上，“你看！这条龙画得栩栩如生！这样太厉害了吧！还有这只凤凰，感觉随时都要飞出来了！”
你突然意识到，眼前的壁画风格，简直和赤霞日常画画的风格如出一辙。

DatingCharacterEvent.141301.6.cn: 在洞窟的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.141301.7.en:
After marveling at the "masterpiece murals" inside the cave, Chixia begins to dream about one day becoming a mural master.

She promises that when that day comes, she'll gift you with a masterpiece, signed personally by her.
DatingCharacterEvent.141301.7.cn:
赤霞在洞窟里欣赏过那些“惊世壁画”后，畅想着自己终有一天也能成为这样的壁画大师。
她许诺到那一天，一定会送给你一副杰作，让你拥有她亲笔签名作。

DatingCharacterEvent.141302.1.en:
Chixia suddenly spots a strange little cake sitting in the dessert shop's display case.

Its lopsided frosting is piled on top, like a crooked pagoda about to collapse at any moment.
DatingCharacterEvent.141302.1.cn:
赤霞突然注意到了甜品屋的橱柜里，放着一个奇怪的小蛋糕——
歪歪扭扭的奶油盖在蛋糕胚上，像是随时都要倒塌的宝塔。

DatingCharacterEvent.141302.2.en:
"I want that one!"

Chixia's eyes light up as she points at the small cake, excitedly placing her order. However, she is told it's actually a failed practice attempt made by one of the shop's new apprentices.

Seeing her stunned by the words "failed," you step in quickly, have a quiet word with the staff, and manage to buy the strange little cake at a discount.
DatingCharacterEvent.141302.2.cn:
“我想要这个！”
赤霞眼睛放光，指着那个小蛋糕，兴奋地向店员点餐，却被告知那个其实是店里的新人练手做的失败品。
眼看赤霞被“失败品”三个字冲击到发蒙，你迅速和店员沟通，最后以一个便宜的价格买下了这个特殊的小蛋糕。

DatingCharacterEvent.141302.3.en:
"How can they say this is a failed attempt? Look at that perfect curve, that artistic line—they just don't know how to appreciate true beauty!"

Chixia, clearly feeling words aren't enough, pulls out brush and paper on the spot and draws a picture of the little cake right then and there.

It's surprisingly realistic, but she looks truly happy while doing it.
DatingCharacterEvent.141302.3.cn:
“凭什么这是失败品？这个完美的弧度，这个艺术的曲线，他们根本不懂欣赏！”
赤霞仿佛觉得只是这种程度的称赞还不够，翻出了自己的笔和纸，现场就为这个小蛋糕画了一张画。
虽然画得很写实，但她画得很开心。

DatingCharacterEvent.141302.6.en: Visit the Dessert Shop to unlock
DatingCharacterEvent.141302.6.cn: 在甜品屋的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.141302.7.en:
In the end, Chixia shared the crooked little cake with you, savoring each bite while lamenting that the world now had one less piece of edible art.

Her cake drawing somehow ended up inside your backpack. You have no idea when she slipped it in.
DatingCharacterEvent.141302.7.cn:
赤霞最后依依不舍地和你分享了那个歪歪扭扭的小蛋糕，边吃边感慨着这世界上自此少了一个艺术小蛋糕。
而她为小蛋糕画的那幅画，最后出现在了你的背包里，你根本不知道赤霞是什么时候放进去的。

DatingCharacterEvent.141303.1.en:
"Hot springs? Why would a whole bunch of people sit in the water together? And without wearing anything? That's way too weird!"

Chixia clung to the doorway with all her might, refusing to take even a single step into the hot spring town's changing room.
DatingCharacterEvent.141303.1.cn:
“泡温泉？为什么要一大群人泡在水里啊？而且还什么都不穿，也太奇怪了吧！？”
赤霞手脚并用地扒在门口，一步也不愿意踏进温泉度假村的更衣室。

DatingCharacterEvent.141303.2.en:
You were surprised to learn that there actually were people who didn't like hot spring soaks.

"The water will make the scales on my tail wet. And it will make my fire spells go wonky. Anyway, there's no way I'm getting in there!"

"But when you take a bath, your tail gets wet, too..."

Before you could finish, you saw the guilty look on her face. Could it be...?

"Hey, you're afraid of baths?! What are you, a cat?"
DatingCharacterEvent.141303.2.cn:
你很意外，这个世界上竟然还有不喜欢泡温泉的人。
“水会弄湿尾巴的鳞片，而且，水会让火玄术失灵，总而言之，我才不要再去水里泡着！”
“那你平时洗澡的时候，不也会弄湿尾巴……”
你的话还没说完，就看到赤霞一脸心虚的表情，这个场景简直就像——
“你是怕洗澡的猫吗？！”

DatingCharacterEvent.141303.3.en:
In the end, after a lot of coaxing from you, Chixia reluctantly agreed to try the hot springs. Still, she refused to bathe with everyone else and insisted on a private bath instead...

You watched her walk in by herself. Just as you were about to leave, you suddenly heard her calling your name from inside.

"Why is this place so big and there's not a single person here...? Y-you—you... Stay outside! Don't leave me! You can't go!!! Waaaah, I think there's something in the water!!! There's a shadow or something!!!"
Before the shouting faded, Chixia came bolting out at top speed, wrapped in a bath towel...
DatingCharacterEvent.141303.3.cn:
最后，在你的百般劝说下，赤霞勉为其难地同意去泡温泉，但她拒绝跟所有人一起洗澡，这一次，她坚定地选择了私汤……
你看着她单独一个人走进去，刚准备离开，就听见赤霞在里面喊你的名字。
“这个地方怎么这么大却连一个人都没有啊……你、你你你……你站在外面！不准走！不许走啊！！！哇啊水里好像有个什么影子啊啊啊！！”
话音未落，赤霞裹着浴巾光速冲了出来……

DatingCharacterEvent.141303.6.en: Visit Hot Spring Resort to unlock
DatingCharacterEvent.141303.6.cn: 在温泉度假村的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.141303.7.en:
You and Chixia arrived at the hot spring town, only to discover that Chixia, much like a cat, hated soaking in water. Although she eventually agreed to give the hot springs a try, the empty private bath—with nothing but the sound of running water and the echo of the room—somehow unsettled her even more.
In the end, at Chixia's insistence, you had no choice but to go into the private bath with her to "investigate." It turned out that the frightening shadow in the water was nothing more than her own reflection.
DatingCharacterEvent.141303.7.cn:
你和赤霞来到了温泉度假村，却意外地发现赤霞像猫一样讨厌泡水，虽然最后她同意了体验一下温泉，但空无一人的私汤除了潺潺的流水声和回音，似乎显得更恐怖了。
结果，你在赤霞的强烈要求下，只能陪她一起进入私汤调查。最终发现，那令人惊恐的水中影子——不过是赤霞自己的倒影。

DatingCharacterEvent.1414.1.en: Feeling a bit hungry, you and ==DATING_CHARACTER== decide to grab some food from the cafeteria.
DatingCharacterEvent.1414.1.cn: 有些饿了呢，你和==DATING_CHARACTER==决定去食堂觅食。

DatingCharacterEvent.1414.2.en: The menu is packed with choices and you don't know where to start. After some indecision, you end up ordering the same thing as ==DATING_CHARACTER==.
DatingCharacterEvent.1414.2.cn: 可选的餐点琳琅满目，你不知道从何下手。纠结了一阵后，你决定和==DATING_CHARACTER==点一样的。

DatingCharacterEvent.1414.3.en: The academy food isn't exactly gourmet, but it's not as bad as you imagined. You finish a simple meal together.
DatingCharacterEvent.1414.3.cn: 学院的饭菜虽说不上美味，但也没有想象中不堪。你们一起吃完了简单的一餐。

DatingCharacterEvent.1415.1.en: Feeling a bit hungry, you and ==DATING_CHARACTER== decide to grab some food from the cafeteria.
DatingCharacterEvent.1415.1.cn: 感到有些饿了，你和==DATING_CHARACTER==决定去食堂找点吃的。

DatingCharacterEvent.1415.2.en: As you sit down with your orders, a couple at the next table leans in close. Please, not in public...!
DatingCharacterEvent.1415.2.cn: 当你们打好餐品准备享用时，你发现邻桌来了一对情侣，他们的面部正在互相靠近。请不要在公共场合做出如此悲哀的事情！

DatingCharacterEvent.1415.3.en: But your prayer goes unheard. They kiss anyway. ==DATING_CHARACTER== notices too. She blushes, glances at you, then quickly looks away.
DatingCharacterEvent.1415.3.cn: 但是你的祈求无效，他们还是啃在了一起。==DATING_CHARACTER==也注意到了他们，她有些脸红，目光看向你，旋即又挪开了。

DatingCharacterEvent.1416.1.en: You and ==DATING_CHARACTER== head to the Academy library. Perhaps you'll find something interesting here?
DatingCharacterEvent.1416.1.cn: 你和==DATING_CHARACTER==来到了学院图书馆，里面会不会发现什么好东西呢？

DatingCharacterEvent.1416.2.en: Almost immediately, the comic book section draws your attention. Each of you grabs one.
DatingCharacterEvent.1416.2.cn: 但你们立刻被漫画书区吸引了，你们一人拿了一本阅读起来。

DatingCharacterEvent.1416.3.en: The stories are hilarious, but you struggle not to laugh out loud in the quiet library. Sharing stifled giggles, you nearly run out of breath.
DatingCharacterEvent.1416.3.cn: 书中内容很好笑，但是你们并不想在图书馆笑出声。你们面面相觑地憋了好久，差点要背过气去。

DatingCharacterEvent.1417.1.en: You and ==DATING_CHARACTER== head to the Academy library. Perhaps you'll find something interesting here?
DatingCharacterEvent.1417.1.cn: 你和==DATING_CHARACTER==来到了学院图书馆，里面会不会发现什么好东西呢？

DatingCharacterEvent.1417.2.en: You discover an old manuscript recording Stellaroid sightings. Holding one side each, you read together.
DatingCharacterEvent.1417.2.cn: 发现了一本年代有些久远的星骸记录抄本，你们一人捧着一边仔细阅读起来。

DatingCharacterEvent.1417.3.en: The two of you quietly discuss unknown Stellaroids and ancient variants. You are fascinated by what you learn.
DatingCharacterEvent.1417.3.cn: 你们小声讨论着那些没见过的星骸，以及一些古代星骸的变种，收获颇丰。

DatingCharacterEvent.142301.1.en:
You order a slice of durian cake, and when it arrives,

Cosette hesitates, staring at it nervously.

Unfamiliar foods still make her uneasy.
DatingCharacterEvent.142301.1.cn:
你点了一份榴莲蛋糕，当它被端上桌的时候，
珂赛特有些犹豫地盯着桌上的餐点。
似乎面对这些不寻常的食物，她还有些生怯。

DatingCharacterEvent.142301.2.en:
"Is it Okay for me to eat these?"

She seems to be murmuring to herself.

Sensing her hesitation, you pick up your knife and fork—using your actions to show Cosette that it's perfectly fine to dig in.
DatingCharacterEvent.142301.2.cn:
“这些，可以吃吗。”
她似乎在自言自语些什么。
感知到这份压力，你率先动起了刀叉——用行动告诉珂赛特，先吃为敬。

DatingCharacterEvent.142301.3.en:
She picks up her utensils a little awkwardly.

With each bite in silence, her movements grow faster.

Now her plate is empty, but her face is full of satisfaction and pleasurable surprise.

"How about we order some more?"

She nods shyly in agreement.
DatingCharacterEvent.142301.3.cn:
她有些不熟练地也拿起了餐具。
咽下一口又一口，随着沉默，她的动作也越来越快。
扫尽，她的脸上只剩下满足和惊喜的余韵。
“要不，再点一些？”
她害羞地点了点头。

DatingCharacterEvent.142301.6.en: Visit the Dessert Shop to unlock
DatingCharacterEvent.142301.6.cn: 在甜品屋的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.142301.7.en:
You and Cosette were enjoying desserts at the dessert shop.

She had never seen such unusual delicacies before.

With your encouragement, she mustered the courage to give them a try.

Judging by her reaction, it was clear she's a fan of sweets.
DatingCharacterEvent.142301.7.cn:
和珂赛特在甜品屋里品尝甜点。
她还没怎么见过如此别致的食物。
在你的带领下，她鼓起了尝试的勇气。
从结果而言，她显然是甜党。

DatingCharacterEvent.142302.1.en:
The array of goods is dazzling to the eye, and there are some Artifacts that you have never seen before.

Cosette stops in front of a small stall.
DatingCharacterEvent.142302.1.cn:
各色各样的商品看得你眼花缭乱，其中不乏一些从没见过的神器。
珂赛特在一个小摊前停下了脚步。

DatingCharacterEvent.142302.2.en:
The stall owner, noticing potential customers, eagerly begins showcasing their goods.

Cosette's eyes land on a small trinket.

She says nothing but lightly tugs at your sleeve, glancing at you with uncertainty in her eyes.
DatingCharacterEvent.142302.2.cn:
摊主一见来了生意，向你们热情介绍。
珂赛特看中了一个小小的挂饰。
她没有说话，只是拉着你的衣角。有些不确定地看向你。

DatingCharacterEvent.142302.3.en:
You know the prices here are inflated, but the hopeful look in her eyes doesn't leave you the room to hesitate.

"A gift for you," you say.

She beams with joy and nods at you.

"I want to ... see more..."
DatingCharacterEvent.142302.3.cn:
你知道，这儿的价格是有些虚高的。不过看她期待的眼神，你没有犹豫。
“送给你。”
她露出了欣喜的笑容，向你点头。
“还想看，更多的东西。”

DatingCharacterEvent.142302.6.cn: 在集市的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.142302.7.en:
You explored the bustling market with Cosette. It was an unfamiliar environment for her.

She fell in love with a trinket at a stall.

Even though it was a bit overpriced, you bought it for her as a gift.
DatingCharacterEvent.142302.7.cn:
和珂赛特游览集市，热闹的此情此景对她来说还有点陌生。
她一眼喜欢上了小摊上的挂饰。
尽管有溢价，但你还是给她买来当礼物。

DatingCharacterEvent.143301.1.en:
The streets are overflowing with merchandise, yet nothing seems to stop her in her tracks.
Then you spot a modest sign tucked in an obscure corner: Vintage Shop — Soft Opening.
Figuring it's worth a shot, you drag her along to see what treasures you can dig up.
DatingCharacterEvent.143301.1.cn:
街上的商品琳琅满目，但似乎没有一件能令她为此驻足。
你发现了一处不起眼的地方放着一个牌子：“中古店新开张，试营业中”。
抱着试一试的心态，你决定拉着她去淘淘宝贝。

DatingCharacterEvent.143301.2.en:
After winding through a maze of alleys, you finally reach the shop.

It's a trove of oddities. Just as you're about to dive into the clutter, a rare, sharp gasp comes from behind you.

"No way... It's real!"

Wraith is holding up a seemingly ordinary pair of nippers, but the blades catch the light with a blinding, razor-sharp glint.
DatingCharacterEvent.143301.2.cn:
穿过弯弯绕绕的小道，你们总算来到了牌子所说的中古店内。
这里确实有不少稀奇的东西，你正打算一头扎进杂乱的货物里翻箱倒柜的时候，身后的风影居然罕见地传出了惊呼声。
“这……这是！居然真的存在！”
你见她举起了一把看似普普通通的小剪钳，但那刃尖在灯光的照射下竟反射着刺眼的锋芒。

DatingCharacterEvent.143301.3.en:
"It's the legendary Godly Hand! The nippers that leave absolutely no stress marks on plastic models!"

You have no idea what that means, but she's clearly struck gold.

Seeing her this excited—a rare sight indeed—makes the whole trip worth it.
DatingCharacterEvent.143301.3.cn:
“这可是传说中剪模型不会留任何痕迹的'神之剪'！”
虽然听不太懂，但风影似乎是淘到了意料之外的好宝贝。
看到她难得兴致高涨的样子，你觉得这一趟算是来对地方了。

DatingCharacterEvent.143301.6.cn: 在集市的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.143301.7.en:
The market goods were plentiful but uninteresting. So you suggested checking out a new vintage shop instead.

The real fun of these places lies in the thrill of the hunt. Judging by the results, you both scored big time.
DatingCharacterEvent.143301.7.cn:
集市的商品虽然丰富，但都难以勾起你们的兴趣，于是在你的推荐下，你们来到一家新开的中古店。
在未知的地方搜寻有价值的好物正是逛中古店的乐趣之一。而从结果上来看，这次“狩猎”，你和她都有了不错的收获。

DatingCharacterEvent.143302.1.en:
Wraith is usually pretty direct, but today she's acting all mysterious as she drags you into a cavern.

The deeper you go, the chillier it gets, until the sound of running water fills the cave.
DatingCharacterEvent.143302.1.cn:
一向直率的风影这次却神秘兮兮得拉着你来到某个洞窟内部。
随着深入探索，你愈发感觉周围变得凉快起来，并听见了伴有泉水流动的声音。

DatingCharacterEvent.143302.2.en:
You thought you hit a dead end at a stone wall, but Wraith flips a hidden switch, and the rock grinds open.

Before you can react, a natural bathhouse is revealed.

"I put a lot of work into fixing this place up."

"But seeing that look on your face? Totally worth it."

"Hop in. Don't worry, the water's pristine."

She disappears behind a screen to wash up. Not wanting to be rude, you decide to give this outdoor bath a try. However...
DatingCharacterEvent.143302.2.cn:
来到一处石墙前，当你以为走投无路时，风影却转动一旁隐藏的机关，石墙被缓缓打开。
还未等你惊叹，一处天然浴池赫然出现在了你的眼前。
“我可是花了很大功夫才把这里改造成这样的。”
“不过，看见你的反应，一切都值得了。”
“下来泡吧，放心，这里的泉水很干净。”
风影自顾自地走到屏风的另一边开始沐浴，面对她的热情，你也打算体验一下户外浴池，然而——

DatingCharacterEvent.143302.3.en:
"IT'S FREEZING—!!!"

Your fingers go numb the second they touch the water. Then it hits you: Wraith loves the cold. That's why she built a private bath here instead of going to the hot springs.

"So? Pretty nice, right?"

"Brr-b-b... Yeah! It's ... g-great!"

Fighting the bone-deep chill, you splash around to fake some enthusiasm.
DatingCharacterEvent.143302.3.cn:
“好冰——！！！”
仅仅是触摸就让你觉得指尖近乎失去直觉，你终于意识到风影有着一个特殊的体质，也想起来她为何不惜在此搭建一个天然浴池，也不去温泉乡泡澡的原因。
“怎么样，体验还不错吧~”
“呃呜呜……嗯！还——还行！”
忍着刺骨的寒意，你试图拨弄水花制造点动静蒙混过去。

DatingCharacterEvent.143302.6.cn: 在洞窟的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.143302.7.en:
Wraith led you deep into a cavern to show off a private bathhouse she built herself.

Just as you were getting ready to relax, you realized the water temperature was ... nothing like the hot springs you were expecting.
DatingCharacterEvent.143302.7.cn: 和风影一起来到了某个天然洞窟，在她的带领下，你被引导到洞窟深处，并在这里发现了她在此建造的天然浴场。正当你打算好好享受的时候，才发现池里的水温与你想象中的温泉简直天差地别。

DatingCharacterEvent.144301.1.en: Chitose stands silently at the bow, moonlight spilling over her hair. Does the night coast make her homesick?
DatingCharacterEvent.144301.1.cn: 千都世默默地站立在船头，清冷的月光照在她的秀发上。夜晚的海岸让她想家了吗？

DatingCharacterEvent.144301.2.en:
"Do you ever think of returning to Goodwind?"

"I shan't return until I become a true blade."

You chat idly for a long while.
DatingCharacterEvent.144301.2.cn:
“你有回谷风的想法吗？”
“妾身在成为一把真正的刀之前，是不会回去的。”
你们有一搭没一搭地聊了许久。

DatingCharacterEvent.144301.3.en: The past always catches up, and changes the upcoming future. But before then, you need to help her to find herself as a person.
DatingCharacterEvent.144301.3.cn: 过去的一些东西总会追上你，未来以此发生。但在那之前，你需要帮她以人之姿站立。

DatingCharacterEvent.144301.6.cn: 在港口的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.144301.7.en:
Talking with Chitose on a small boat near the coast, you realized you still had a long way to go before becoming a true wielder.

The jade-like blade by her side accompanied her travels, always reflecting back to her a sky veiled in shadows.
DatingCharacterEvent.144301.7.cn: 和千都世在近海的小船上谈心，若要成为合格的持刀人，还需要漫长的路要走。美玉般的刀身伴随着她的游历，也始终向她映照出一片阴翳遍布的天空。

DatingCharacterEvent.144302.1.en: Chitose probably hasn't eaten many desserts like this, so you take the chance to order more.
DatingCharacterEvent.144302.1.cn: 千都世应该没怎么吃过这种甜点，趁着这个机会多点一些吧。

DatingCharacterEvent.144302.2.en:
When the next round of sweets arrives, she looks excited but doesn't dig in.

Is she afraid of gaining weight? Unlikely. That's not something she'd care about.
DatingCharacterEvent.144302.2.cn:
看着桌上新一轮的甜品，千都世显得有些兴奋，但是她怎么不吃呢？
莫非是害怕发胖？不太可能，千都世不会想这些事情。

DatingCharacterEvent.144302.3.en:
You suddenly understand and say a little more seriously, "Even a blade needs to be cared for." You slide a piece of cake toward her.

"If it's kept under constant strain, even the finest sword will eventually grow weary, even break."

At last, Chitose sets aside her concern and enjoys the treat together with you.
DatingCharacterEvent.144302.3.cn:
你突然明白了，略显严肃地说道：“就算是刀，也是要悉心保养的。”你将一块蛋糕推向她。
“如果时时保持紧绷的状态，就算是名刀，也会逐渐疲劳甚至断裂。”
千都世终于打消了疑虑，和你一同享受美味。

DatingCharacterEvent.144302.6.en: Visit the Dessert Shop to unlock
DatingCharacterEvent.144302.6.cn: 在甜品屋的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.144302.7.en:
At the dessert shop with Chitose, she said she didn't deserve such fine treatment, but you got her to see it differently.

"I do not care for such indulgence," she said—yet all afternoon, she had been smiling.
DatingCharacterEvent.144302.7.cn:
与千都世在甜品屋享用美食时，她认为自己并不需要这么好的待遇，但你纠正了她的错误想法。
“妾身不喜欢这种待遇”，尽管今天下午她一直在笑。

DatingCharacterEvent.145301.1.en:
"Hm? They look exactly the same, but the taste ... seems a little different from before." Otoha tried them one by one, frowning even harder.

"Have you been to this shop before?" you asked, curious.
DatingCharacterEvent.145301.1.cn:
“嗯？虽然外表一模一样，但味道……似乎和从前有些微妙的不同呢。”乙叶轮流尝了一遍，微微皱起眉头。
“乙叶之前也来过这家店吗？”你不禁好奇了起来。

DatingCharacterEvent.145301.2.en:
For once, you caught a hint of nostalgia on Otoha's face.

"Back when it first started, this place was just a little roadside stall. Their strawberry cake was the go-to item. I used to buy a slice every time I came home."

"Until... She figured it out."
DatingCharacterEvent.145301.2.cn:
罕见地，你在乙叶的脸上看到了一丝怀念的神情。
“最早的时候，这家店还只是个路边小摊，那时她们最出名的就是草莓蛋糕。我每次回家的时候都会买一块。”
“直到有一次……被那孩子发现了。”

DatingCharacterEvent.145301.3.en:
"After that, she developed a sweet tooth as well. But I kept her on a tight leash. A ninja can't afford obvious likes or dislikes—they become weak spots."

You couldn't help but grin. "But you clearly like them, too."

Otoha gently set her teacup back on the saucer with a soft clink, as if covering for her embarrassment. "That's why, from then on, I could only eat them in secrecy."

Then that familiar, sly smile returned to her face. "Which is exactly why... Today I plan to enjoy them properly."
DatingCharacterEvent.145301.3.cn:
“从那以后，她也喜欢上了甜品。可我却对她严加管教。忍者不可以有明显的喜好——会变成破绽。”
你忍不住笑了：“可是你明明也很喜欢啊。”
乙叶将茶杯轻轻放回碟子，发出细微的磕碰声，仿佛在掩饰心虚：“所以，在那之后，我也只能偷偷吃了。”
随后，她又露出了那抹熟悉的、狡黠的微笑：“正因如此……今天我才要好好享用一番。”

DatingCharacterEvent.145301.6.en: Visit the Dessert Shop to unlock
DatingCharacterEvent.145301.6.cn: 在甜品屋的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.145301.7.en:
A ninja's discipline and a master's stern authority quietly softened in the face of fluffy cream and warm jam.

Their similar tastes and careful pretense eventually became an unspoken understanding.

Someday, they'll be able to sit across from each other and share the sweetness they love most.
DatingCharacterEvent.145301.7.cn:
忍者的戒律、师父的威严，在松软的奶油与温热的果酱中悄然融化。
相似的口味、小心翼翼的掩饰，最终化作心照不宣的默契。
总有一天，她们能面对面坐着，一同分享那份最钟爱的甜蜜。

DatingCharacterEvent.145302.1.en:
You stood by the railing with Otoha, the sea breeze brushing your face. When you turned your head, you saw her gazing out past the coastline into the distance.

You were about to say something, but at the last moment you decided to let the silence flow on with the sea.
DatingCharacterEvent.145302.1.cn:
你和乙叶并肩站在船边，海风拂过你的面颊。你侧过头，看到她正凝望着海岸线之外的远方。
你想开口说些什么，话到嘴边的一瞬间，你决定还是让这份沉默与海水一起静静流淌。

DatingCharacterEvent.145302.2.en:
"What did it feel like the first time you saw the sea, Boss?"
After a long while, Otoha asked softly.

"Honestly... Nothing special. I just remember how vast it was. It made me wonder ... what might lie on the other side of the ocean."

"I used to think the same way," Otoha said, her voice drifting into a distant memory. "Until I actually crossed the sea and saw a world I had never imagined."
DatingCharacterEvent.145302.2.cn:
“魔王第一次看到大海的时候，是什么感觉呢？”
良久，乙叶的声音轻轻落在你的耳畔。
“好像……也没什么特别的感觉。只觉得它太广阔了，忍不住想，海的另一边会是什么样子。”
“我曾经也是这样想的。“乙叶似乎沉浸在了遥远的回忆中。“直到我真的来到海的另一边，见到了从未想象过的世界。”

DatingCharacterEvent.145302.3.en:
You thought of Nishishima where Otoha came from—Windhowl Island, her homeland, how she had crossed the sea to get here, and how she had worn different masks in this unfamiliar world, taking on different roles.
"Still, the sea is beautiful, no matter where you are." As if sensing your mood, Otoha gently rested a hand on your back.
"Thank you for inviting me, Boss. Today's weather is perfect for looking out at the sea."
DatingCharacterEvent.145302.3.cn:
你想起乙叶出身的风息岛，想到她的家乡，想到她如何远渡而来，又如何在陌生的世界里戴上不同的面具，扮演不同的身份。
“不过，大海在哪里都是一样美丽呢。”似乎是察觉到了你的情绪，乙叶的手轻轻抚在你的背上。
“谢谢魔王的邀请，像今天这样好的天气，最适合看海了。”

DatingCharacterEvent.145302.6.cn: 在港口的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.145302.7.en:
Perhaps one day she will cross the sea again and return to her homeland.

But neither of you knows whether that day will ever come.
Until then, the best you can do is keep going.
DatingCharacterEvent.145302.7.cn:
或许有一日，她会重新跨过海洋，回到属于她的故乡。
但你们谁都不知道那一日是否会来临。
在那天到来之前，还是努力生存下去吧。

DatingCharacterEvent.147301.1.en: On the wide bay, Caramel sees a perfect "stage."
DatingCharacterEvent.147301.1.cn: 在宽阔的海湾上，焦糖觉得这是一个不错的“舞台”。

DatingCharacterEvent.147301.2.en: She begins to play an enchanting melody, and you are captivated by the ethereal echoes resonating above the waves.
DatingCharacterEvent.147301.2.cn: 她弹奏起了美妙的乐曲，你陶醉于在海面上荡漾的空灵声响。

DatingCharacterEvent.147301.3.en: Having finished her performance, she bows to you with heartfelt satisfaction.
DatingCharacterEvent.147301.3.cn: 完成了演奏的她，心满意足地向你致意。

DatingCharacterEvent.147301.6.cn: 在港口的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.147301.7.en:
Together with Caramel, you discovered a spot at sea that was perfect for a stage.

For once, you enjoyed a complete, uninterrupted concert—one meant just for you. You couldn't help but look forward to the next time...
DatingCharacterEvent.147301.7.cn:
和焦糖在海上发现了一个很适合作为舞台的地方。
难得地，你完整、不受打扰地享受了这场，独属于你的演奏会。你不由得期待起下次……

DatingCharacterEvent.147302.1.en:
The array of goods is dazzling to the eye, and there are some Artifacts that you have never seen before.

Caramel stops in front of a small stall.
DatingCharacterEvent.147302.1.cn:
各色各样的商品看得你眼花缭乱，其中不乏一些从没见过的神器。
焦糖在一个小摊前停下了脚步。

DatingCharacterEvent.147302.2.en:
The stall owner, noticing potential customers, eagerly begins showcasing their goods.

Caramel's eyes land on a rare and exquisite effects pedal—an Artifact that can transform the sound of a bass guitar.

Yes, she's already drooling all over it.
DatingCharacterEvent.147302.2.cn:
摊主一见来了生意，向你们热情介绍。
焦糖发现了一块精美而少见的效果器——这是一种可以给贝斯的声音带来奇妙变化的神器。
是的，她已经馋的几乎要流口水了。

DatingCharacterEvent.147302.3.en:
She reaches into her pockets—surprise surprise, she is out of money again. You pay it for her with a resigned chuckle.

"I can pay you back with a free performance, producer!"

She seems determined to repay the favor with her talent.
DatingCharacterEvent.147302.3.cn:
她掏了掏口袋——果然，又没有钱了。你苦笑一声，为她买了单。
“我可以用无偿演出来换的，制作人！”
她似乎打算用才艺还这份人情。

DatingCharacterEvent.147302.6.cn: 在集市的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.147302.7.en:
Strolling the market with Caramel, she came across a rare find—an Artifact that functioned as effects pedal.

As she was short on coin, you paid for it, and she promised to repay the favor with a free performance.

You knew she would be willing to play for you whenever, wherever.
DatingCharacterEvent.147302.7.cn:
和焦糖游览集市，她发现了难得一见的神器——效果器。
你为囊中羞涩的她买了单，她承诺用一场无偿演出还这份人情。
你知道，她一直、随时都愿意为你演奏。

DatingCharacterEvent.147303.1.en: To celebrate your recent successful performance, you and Caramel decided to grab another treat. But with so many tempting options on the menu, you had no idea what to pick.
DatingCharacterEvent.147303.1.cn: 为了庆祝前几日成功的演出，你和焦糖决定再来一份。但面对琳琅满目的菜单，你却犯了难。

DatingCharacterEvent.147303.2.en:
"A celebration calls for a parfait!"
She was right, but your combined cash only covered one more parfait, so you decided to share.
When the server brought it over, however, your jaws dropped. The portion was massive enough to feed both of you all day.
DatingCharacterEvent.147303.2.cn:
“庆功宴当然要吃芭菲啊！”
虽然话是这么说，但你们两口袋里的钱加起来也只能再额外购买一份，于是你们决定两个人一起吃一份芭菲。
然而，当服务员将芭菲端上桌时，你们目瞪口呆地发现，这份芭菲的量怕是两个人吃一天都吃不完。

DatingCharacterEvent.147303.3.en:
You asked a server and learned about the shop's daily promotion: couples got a free upgrade to the Jumbo Parfait.
To the owner, sharing a parfait was absolute proof you were dating.
You glanced at Caramel, whose face was flushed bright red. Not wanting to waste food, you accepted the misunderstanding, grabbed a spoon, and dug in.
DatingCharacterEvent.147303.3.cn:
经过询问后才得知，原来今天甜品屋办活动，情侣光临即可获得“巨无霸芭菲”升级券。
而你们两个人同吃一份芭菲的行为，在店主看来无疑是情侣的证明。
你看着满脸通红的焦糖，为了不浪费食物，你也只好接受了这个误会，拿起勺子，率先吃了起来。

DatingCharacterEvent.147303.6.en: Visit the Dessert Shop to unlock
DatingCharacterEvent.147303.6.cn: 在甜品屋的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.147303.7.en: Short on cash, you and Caramel shared a single parfait. The shop owner immediately assumed you were a couple, upgrading your order to a super jumbo parfait as part of today's promotion.
DatingCharacterEvent.147303.7.cn: 由于囊中羞涩，你和焦糖只好同吃一份芭菲。但这样的行为却被店主误认为是情侣，按照今天甜品屋的活动，将你们点的芭菲升级为了超级巨无霸芭菲。

DatingCharacterEvent.149301.1.en: At the far end of the cave, you stumble upon an old abandoned camp. Before you can look closer, Gerie gently covers your eyes.
DatingCharacterEvent.149301.1.cn: 在洞穴的最深处，是一片废弃许久的营地。未等你仔细观察，格芮便用手遮住了你的眼睛。

DatingCharacterEvent.149301.2.en: "Boss, there are long-lost remains here. Please turn away, so you won't be frightened." She turns you around with her other hand. "Please wait a moment and let me grant the unfortunate their final peace."
DatingCharacterEvent.149301.2.cn: “魔王，这里有遇难已久的人，还请背过身去，免得被吓到。”格芮用另一只手将你转过去，“请等待片刻，让我给予不幸者最后的安宁。”

DatingCharacterEvent.149301.3.en: You hear the sound of a shovel against stone, then silence. After a long while, Gerie softly takes your hand and leads you away from the cave's depths.
DatingCharacterEvent.149301.3.cn: 你听到铲子翻动的声音，随后归于沉寂。过了许久，格芮轻轻牵起你的手，与你一起离开了最深处的洞穴。

DatingCharacterEvent.149301.6.cn: 在洞窟的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.149301.7.en:
You and Gerie discovered the long-forgotten remains of dead adventurers inside the cave.

She laid them to rest with reverence. In the stillness, you felt her quiet faith.
DatingCharacterEvent.149301.7.cn:
和格芮在洞窟的最深处发现了遇难者流落已久的骸骨。格芮仁慈地给予它以安宁。
在这寂静中，你感受到了在她心底某处的虔诚。

DatingCharacterEvent.149302.1.en: A small boat drifts over the dark coastal waters. "Actually, I often come out here alone." Gerie kneels inside the boat. The moonlight drapes her robe in a sacred glow that outshines the stars.
DatingCharacterEvent.149302.1.cn: 小舟在黑漆漆的浅海上飘荡。“其实，我经常独自来到海上。”格芮半跪在舟中，月光在她的袍子蒙上一层圣洁的辉光，令群星失色。

DatingCharacterEvent.149302.2.en: "It's vast and calm here." She takes your hands. "Please share this stillness with me and use it to measure your own nature."
DatingCharacterEvent.149302.2.cn: “这里辽阔、宁静。”她握住你的双手，“请与我一同分享这份平静，并以此丈量自身天性。”

DatingCharacterEvent.149302.3.en:
Her eyes lower; you can almost feel her breath. Her gentle touch at your fingertips quiets you.

It feels as though your senses drift far above the sea, watching two hearts beat in rhythm with the tide.
DatingCharacterEvent.149302.3.cn:
她眼眸低垂，你几乎能感受到她的呼吸。借由指尖传来的温柔触感，你也逐渐沉静下来。
你的感官似乎越飘越远，以至于能俯瞰到海上的小舟，其间有两颗心在黑暗中随着海潮跳动。

DatingCharacterEvent.149302.6.cn: 在港口的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.149302.7.en:
While sightseeing on a small boat near the coast with Gerie, you shared a quiet moment underneath the moonlight, breathing in each other's presence.

You exchanged heartfelt prayers; though the waves rolled restlessly in the night, your hearts remained calm.
DatingCharacterEvent.149302.7.cn:
和格芮在近海的小舟上观光时，与其分享了月光下的宁静，感受着彼此的气息。
你们真诚的互相祝祷，尽管夜幕中的浪花不安地翻卷着，但你们的内心却很沉静。
