DatingCharacterEvent.149303.1.en: Night had fallen, but it was still too early to turn in. You decided to wander around and pass the time, and as you walked past a shop where people could try on yukata, Gerie suddenly stopped in her tracks.
DatingCharacterEvent.149303.1.cn: 夜色落幕，但离入睡还早，你们决定去别的地方转转打发时间，就在经过一家浴衣试穿店时，格芮突然停下了脚步。

DatingCharacterEvent.149303.2.en:
"Just a moment, Boss~"

With that, she walked straight into the shop. Before long, she came back out wearing a yukata.

"What do I look? Pretty scary, right?~"

"Scary? I think it looks great."

"Huh...? Isn't this the look from that Goodwind horror story...?"
DatingCharacterEvent.149303.2.cn:
“请稍等一下，魔王~”
说罢她径直走向店内，没过一会便换上一身浴衣走了出来。
“怎么样，是不是很吓人~”
“吓人？我觉得很好看啊。”
“诶……？难道谷风的恐怖故事里讲的不是这样吗……？”

DatingCharacterEvent.149303.3.en:
From what Gerie said, you figured that she was trying to dress up as some kind of snow spirit from the legends of Goodwind village.

"Mom, look, that lady is so pretty!"

"Such an elegant vibe... Is she an actress from Flavio?"

Before you could even respond, several passersby nearby were already gossiping about the yukata-clad Gerie.

"Um... This isn't the reaction I was going for...!"
Gerie's confused look made you burst out into laughter.
DatingCharacterEvent.149303.3.cn:
联想格芮的话，你大概猜到她想扮演的是谷风传说里，某种和雪有关的妖怪。
“妈妈你看，好漂亮的姐姐！”
“气质真好……是弗拉维奥的明星吗？”
还没等你发话，一旁经过的几位路人对身穿浴衣的格芮赞不绝口。
“那个……我想要的不是这个结果啦……！”
面对陷入混乱的格芮，你忍不住笑了起来。

DatingCharacterEvent.149303.6.en: Visit Hot Spring Resort to unlock
DatingCharacterEvent.149303.6.cn: 在温泉度假村的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.149303.7.en:
You went to the hot spring town with Gerie. When you two passed by a yukata shop, she suddenly went in and changed into a different outfit. You could tell she was trying to dress up as a spirit from the legend of Goodwind village, but things didn't go the way she expected. Instead of feeling terrified, other people on the scene kept complimenting her on her elegant looks.
You found the whole scene pretty funny and just stood there smiling as she spiraled into confusion.
DatingCharacterEvent.149303.7.cn:
和格芮一起去了温泉度假村，路过一家浴衣店时，她却突然换了一身造型，你看出她是想扮演谷风传说里的妖怪，但事与愿违，她得到的却是路人对她气质的赞美。
你觉得这一幕十分有趣，只是笑着看她陷入混乱的样子。

DatingCharacterEvent.150301.1.en: Laru's captivated by the cake in front of her, standing still and deep in thought.
DatingCharacterEvent.150301.1.cn: 菈露看着眼前的蛋糕，整个人一动不动，陷入了沉思。

DatingCharacterEvent.150301.2.en:
"Have you ever wondered why there's no fry-flavored cake yet?"

Looking at the beautifully made cake, she thinks out loud.

"If a cake tasted like fries, or even just looked like fries, think how many curious customers they'd get!"

You try picturing a fry cake, but all you can think of is regular mashed potatoes.
DatingCharacterEvent.150301.2.cn:
“我在想啊，为什么蛋糕没有薯条味呢？”
她对着这块精致的蛋糕开始点评。
“如果它是薯条味的，或者做成薯条的形状，一定能吸引到不少感兴趣的顾客吧？”
你思考了一下薯条味的蛋糕，总觉得那就是一坨土豆泥。

DatingCharacterEvent.150301.3.en:
"Or maybe cake-flavored fries? Who says fries have to be salty, anyway?"

Laru dashes off to find a store employee.

Looks like she's serious about getting this fry-flavored cake for you... or maybe cake-flavored fries?
DatingCharacterEvent.150301.3.cn:
“又或者，也可以是蛋糕味的薯条？也没有人规定薯条一定是咸的对吧？”
菈露说着，就跑去找店员交涉。
她似乎真的准备给你做一个薯条味的蛋糕，或者是蛋糕味的薯条？

DatingCharacterEvent.150301.6.en: Visit the Dessert Shop to unlock
DatingCharacterEvent.150301.6.cn: 在甜品屋的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.150301.7.en:
Laru tried to create a french-fries-flavored cake at the dessert shop, but the staff suspected the two of you were just making trouble, and in the end you were both thrown out.

Still, Laru insisted that a fries-flavored cake—or a cake-flavored fries—was a brilliant idea. She was determined to make it for you to try.
DatingCharacterEvent.150301.7.cn:
菈露在甜品店试图创造薯条味的蛋糕，但店员怀疑你们是不是故意找茬的，最后双双被赶了出去。
但菈露还是觉得薯条味的蛋糕，或是蛋糕味的薯条非常有创意，势必要做出来给你尝尝。

DatingCharacterEvent.150303.1.en:
You sit with Laru on a pier at the port. She casts her hook and says, "You know, the port's actually the best place to fish."

No way! "Tell me more," you listen to her attentively.
DatingCharacterEvent.150303.1.cn:
你和菈露坐在板桩码头上，她刚把鱼钩抛下去就说到：“你知道吗？码头其实是钓鱼是绝佳去处。”
居然还有这种说法，“愿闻其详！”你洗耳恭听。

DatingCharacterEvent.150303.2.en: "First, the waves in the port are calmer. Plus, with the townsfolk dumping household scraps into the port, the water becomes richer in nutrients, attracting aquatic life." Laru points toward a small fishing boat. "See that? Boats returning to the port carry a strong fishy scent, which draws carnivorous fish near."
DatingCharacterEvent.150303.2.cn: “首先，港口内风浪较小，加之港民向海中倾倒生活垃圾，会令这里的水质拥有更多营养，吸引水生生物光顾。”菈露指向一艘小渔船。“看那里，回港的渔船由于积累了深厚的腥气，也会吸引食肉鱼类靠近。”

DatingCharacterEvent.150303.3.en: "In the port, net fishing isn't allowed, which keeps the fish population steady. The fish here are also used to all kinds of sounds coming from the dock, so they won't be easily scared off." Laru explains confidently, and under her personal guidance, you end up with quite a bountiful catch.
DatingCharacterEvent.150303.3.cn: “港内不准拉网，保证了鱼群的数量。这里的鱼也习惯了来自码头上各种声响，不会被轻易吓跑。”菈露说得头头是道，最终在她的亲自教学下，收获颇丰。

DatingCharacterEvent.150303.6.cn: 在港口的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.150303.7.en:
Fishing with Laru at the port, she shared her rich knowledge about the port's unique ecology and her brilliant hooking techniques.

With her guidance, the two of you enjoyed a plentiful catch.
DatingCharacterEvent.150303.7.cn:
和菈露一起在港口钓鱼，经验丰富的她介绍了港口与众不同的生态，以及绝妙的上钩技巧。
在她的指导下，你们俩收获满满。

DatingCharacterEvent.155301.1.en: You sit side by side with Shia in the stern of a small boat. Her hair, light as the breeze, drifts across your neck, sending a soft shiver through you. You catch a faint, subtle fragrance.
DatingCharacterEvent.155301.1.cn: 你和希娅并肩坐在小舟船尾，她的发丝被风吹到你的脖子上。你感到颈间痒痒的，还能闻见一丝若隐若现的馨香。

DatingCharacterEvent.155301.2.en: The sea reflects scattered starlight. Shia dips her legs into the gentle rise and fall of the tide, and you follow, letting your feet sink into the cool embrace. Shia wraps her arm around yours —a silent promise that you will not fall.
DatingCharacterEvent.155301.2.cn: 海中反射着点点星光，希娅将腿半浸在起伏的海潮里，你也学着她的样子将脚伸入水中。希娅挽住你的胳膊，可别不小心滑下去了。

DatingCharacterEvent.155301.3.en: Amid the gentle rocking of the waves, you feel an unusual sense of calm. The starlight dances in Shia’s eyes. She blinks, then looks at you. For the first time, you see how clear and bright her gaze is—as if reflecting the sea and sky.
DatingCharacterEvent.155301.3.cn: 在波浪的摇曳中，你感到一种异乎寻常的平静感。星辉在希娅的眼睛中流转，她眨眨眼，又看向你。你第一次注意到这双被大海与天空洗涤过的眼眸是如此清澈明亮。

DatingCharacterEvent.155301.6.cn: 在港口的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.155301.7.en:
You enjoy a calming, gentle time with Shia, sightseeing by boat at the port. Your legs dangle in the water, the waves lapping gently at your skin.

You seem to have finally caught a glimpse of what the "scent" she often talks about is—it is a complex sensation, slowly unfolding over the sea, much like the touch of her skin around your arm.
DatingCharacterEvent.155301.7.cn:
和希娅一起在港口乘船观光。你们将腿浸泡在波光粼粼的海水中，度过了一段平静温柔的时光。
你好像有点体会到她常说的“气味”了，那是一种复合的感觉，在海面上缓缓绽放，就像挽在你胳膊上的那只手。

DatingCharacterEvent.155302.1.en: After some exploration, you discover a shallow underground river. Shia thinks for a moment, then says, "I know where it flows." And so, you decide to take a drift.
DatingCharacterEvent.155302.1.cn: 一番深入后，你们发现了一条浅浅的地下河。希娅思考片刻，对你说：“我知道它会流向哪里。”你们决定来一次地下河漂流。

DatingCharacterEvent.155302.2.en: The current is not strong, but the icy cold water makes you hesitant. Shia holds your hand tightly; she looks very excited. Guided by the drone's light, you drift slowly forward.
DatingCharacterEvent.155302.2.cn: 地下河水流并不湍急，但冰冷的水温使你畏手畏脚。希娅紧紧拉住你的手，她看上去十分兴奋。在无人机的探照下，你们徐徐向前漂流。

DatingCharacterEvent.155302.3.en: The water becomes wider and shallower, so you and Shia stop and decide to take a rest on the bank. She smiles, "The feeling of the underground river is very different from the sea!"
DatingCharacterEvent.155302.3.cn: 水域变得宽阔起来，水深也越来越浅，于是你们停了下来。你和希娅坐在岸边休息，她笑着对你说：“地下河与大海的感觉非常不一样！”

DatingCharacterEvent.155302.6.cn: 在洞窟的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.155302.7.en:
You share a thrilling journey with Shia as you drift through the cave.

Though it may seem dangerous, you realize that for Shia, any flowing water is easy to handle. You both have a lot of fun.
DatingCharacterEvent.155302.7.cn:
和希娅在洞窟中上演了一场刺激的地下河漂流。
尽管听上去很危险，但你发现，在希娅眼中，只要是流水，她都可以轻松驾驭，你们玩得十分尽兴。

DatingCharacterEvent.156301.1.en: As soon as you reach the game stalls, Nazuna spots a row of claw machines. Before you've even located them, she challenges you to a competition.
DatingCharacterEvent.156301.1.cn: 刚刚走到游戏区，小禾就发现了一排抓娃娃机。当你还在定位机器在哪的时候，她已经要和你比赛抓娃娃了。

DatingCharacterEvent.156301.2.en:
She plays like a pro: coin in, prize out, smooth as can be.

Now it's your turn against the machine, and she's watching.
DatingCharacterEvent.156301.2.cn:
小禾不愧为抓娃娃的老手。硬币投下去，娃娃抓上来，一切都行云流水。
她正饶有兴致地看着你和抓娃娃机较劲。

DatingCharacterEvent.156301.3.en:
You seize the right moment and smack the button with a snap.

"Got it!" Nazuna slaps the claw machine at the same time, and the claw—thrown off by the interference—fails to catch anything, of course.

Nazuna doubles over with laughter, but she gives you all the prizes she won.
DatingCharacterEvent.156301.3.cn:
你看准时机，啪得一声拍下按钮。
“我戳！”小禾乘机拍了一下抓娃娃机，受干扰的抓手果然没有抓中任何娃娃。
小禾笑得前仰后合，但是她把自己抓上来的娃娃都送给了你。

DatingCharacterEvent.156301.6.cn: 在集市的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.156301.7.en:
At the market you compete with Nazuna at the claw machines. She finishes first and mischievously sabotages you, securing an easy victory.

Even so, she gives you all the prizes she's won. It seems you've earned the recognition of the "Lord of the Prize Claw."
DatingCharacterEvent.156301.7.cn:
与小禾在集市比赛抓娃娃时，完赛的小禾调皮地对你下了黑手，因而大获全胜。
不过，小禾还是把她抓到的娃娃都送给了你。看来你已经获得了“娃娃机仙人”的认可。

DatingCharacterEvent.156302.1.en: You thought Nazuna would say no to your idea, but she agrees.
DatingCharacterEvent.156302.1.cn: 当你以为小禾会拒绝这个提议时，她却答应下来。

DatingCharacterEvent.156302.2.en: "You know, fishing's kind of like claw machines," she says. "Except with fishing, you wait more."
DatingCharacterEvent.156302.2.cn: “你知道吗？钓鱼和抓娃娃其实有相似的地方。”小禾说道，“只不过，钓鱼更加被动一点。”

DatingCharacterEvent.156302.3.en:
She sits motionless, so much that you wonder if she's fallen asleep.

Suddenly the float bobs hard. She pulls fast—a small fish wriggles on the line.

"Hehehe~" She waves it in your face. Meanwhile, you haven't caught a thing.
DatingCharacterEvent.156302.3.cn:
小禾一动不动地坐在旁边，有几次你甚至怀疑她睡着了。
浮标忽然猛烈地向下一沉，小禾用力一提，一条小鱼上钩了。
“哼哼哼~”小禾拎着鱼在你面前炫耀。可恶，你自己怎么就钓不上来。

DatingCharacterEvent.156302.6.cn: 在港口的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.156302.7.en:
While fishing with Nazuna at the port, she said that fishing and claw machines share the same trick. Soon enough, she caught something.

You can't help but wonder: could fishing, like claw machines, also have some kind of hidden "mechanical technique"?
DatingCharacterEvent.156302.7.cn:
与小禾在港口钓鱼时，她表示钓鱼和抓娃娃有异曲同工之妙，并很快就有了收获。
你不禁怀疑，难道钓鱼也像抓娃娃一样，有什么特殊的“机关技巧”？

DatingCharacterEvent.156303.1.en:
"Heh heh, finally—the main course of the day!"

Just as you suspected. There was no way someone like Nazuna would come to a dessert shop just for a simple bite.

Nazuna was looking excited and full of anticipation.
DatingCharacterEvent.156303.1.cn:
“哼哼，终于到重头戏了！”
果然，你想道，以小禾的性格，会来甜品店，想必不止是为了一口吃的。
只见小禾摩拳擦掌，一副踌躇满志的兴奋模样。

DatingCharacterEvent.156303.2.en:
"This raffle is giving away plushie dolls that were wished from the Monolith. They're super rare and super limited. I have to get one!"

She sounded confident enough, but when the clerk walked over with the raffle box, Nazuna suddenly hesitated and looked at you with a pitiful expression.

"You want me to draw for you?"
DatingCharacterEvent.156303.2.cn:
“这次抽奖活动送的是星塔里许愿出来的玩偶，非常珍贵，限量供应，我必须将它拿下！”
虽然嘴上很自信，但当店员拿着抽奖盒走过来的时候，小禾却还是露出犹豫的表情，可怜巴巴地望向你。
“你的意思是让我帮你抽？”

DatingCharacterEvent.156303.3.en:
"Alright, alright. But if I don't get it, don't blame me..."

"Yay! I trust your amazing luck, Boss!"
Fortunately, you didn't disappoint Nazuna. Watching her lift the plushie up in delight, you couldn't help but smile as well.
DatingCharacterEvent.156303.3.cn:
“行吧行吧，但抽不出来可不要怪我……”
“好耶！我相信魔王大人的强运！”
幸运的是，你并没有让小禾失望。看着举起玩偶兴高采烈的她，你也情不自禁地露出微笑。

DatingCharacterEvent.156303.6.en: Visit the Dessert Shop to unlock
DatingCharacterEvent.156303.6.cn: 在甜品屋的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.156303.7.en:
Nazuna went with you to the Dessert Shop only for the raffle prize plushie.
But when the moment came, she hesitated and asked you to draw for her.
Fortunately, you didn't let her down. For Nazuna, it turned out to be a perfect day.
DatingCharacterEvent.156303.7.cn:
小禾为了抽奖活动送的玩偶，和你一起去了甜品店。
临到关头她却犹豫了，小禾拜托你帮她抽。
好在你没有让她失望。对小禾而言，今天是完美的一天。

DatingCharacterEvent.157301.1.en:
The weather is perfect, so you and Karin take a small boat out of the harbor and head to a nearby stretch of sea to fish.
Before you set off, Karin confidently promises that she'll make sure the trip is worth your while.
DatingCharacterEvent.157301.1.cn:
天气正好，你和花铃乘着小船驶离港口，到不远处海域进行垂钓。
出发前，花铃信誓旦旦地向你保证一定会让你不虚此行。

DatingCharacterEvent.157301.2.en:
According to Karin, she prepared a special kind of bait that can catch a very special big fish.
Sure enough, after you wait for a while, the fishing line suddenly jerks. Karin springs to her feet and pours all her strength into battling the enormous fish.
Just as it looks like she's about to run out of stamina, you quickly step in behind her and grab the fishing rod with her.
DatingCharacterEvent.157301.2.cn:
据花铃说，她准备了特别的鱼饵，能钓上特别的大鱼。
果不其然，你们在等待了一段时间后，鱼线突然抽动，花铃站起身使足力气和大鱼展开了对决。
眼看花铃将要耗尽体力，你赶紧站在她身后一起抓住鱼竿，分摊她消耗的体力。

DatingCharacterEvent.157301.3.en:
The great fish suddenly leaps out of the water, giving you a fleeting glimpse of its massive body.
Karin seems to realize something. She drops the fishing rod, runs to the stern, and grabs her parasol, shielding you from the towering wave that crashes up as the giant fish falls back into the sea.
"Are you okay!? Did you get wet!?"
"Not at all. Thank you, Karin~"
"Hmph~ You really should thank me. I only brought this parasol because you didn't put on sunscreen."
"Yes, yes~ We didn't catch the fish, but dinner's on me tonight."
DatingCharacterEvent.157301.3.cn:
大鱼突然跃出水面，你们只有一瞬看见其巨大的身姿。
花铃意识到什么，果断丢下钓竿，跑到船尾拿起太阳伞为你挡下巨鱼落入水中溅起的滔天巨浪。
“没事吧！有没有被淋到！？”
“完全没有呢，谢谢花铃了~”
“唔哼~你确实应该多感谢我，为了照顾你没涂防晒霜才带了这把伞~”
“是是~虽然没钓上鱼，不过今天的晚饭就由我来请吧。”

DatingCharacterEvent.157301.6.cn: 在港口的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.157301.7.en:
You and Karin encountered a huge fish while out fishing. To protect you from the enormous splash it made, she abandoned the fishing rod and opened the parasol she had brought with her.
Such precise foresight! Was it a spur-of-the-moment decision? Or had she planned for it all along?
DatingCharacterEvent.157301.7.cn:
你和花铃在垂钓时遇到了大鱼。为了保护你免受其溅起的巨大水花，她抛下鱼竿撑开了随身携带的太阳伞。
如此精准得预判，究竟是临时起意还是早有预料的小心思呢？

DatingCharacterEvent.157302.1.en:
"What's the difference between soaking in a hot spring and just soaking in water?"
As the two of you make your way to the hot spring town, Karin asks.
"Oh, there's definitely a difference. But you'll have to experience firsthand to really understand."
After hearing your answer, she grows even more curious. She fastens her pace.
DatingCharacterEvent.157302.1.cn:
“泡温泉和泡在水里有什么不一样吗？”
走在去温泉乡的路上，花铃向你发出了疑问。
“那当然不一样了，不过具体得你亲自体验才知道”
听完你说的，她愈发感到好奇，脚步也变得轻快起来。

DatingCharacterEvent.157302.2.en:
"Whew... It really is different."
Once you've each settled into your own private bath, you hear Karin voicing her approval of this new experience.
"It feels nice, but don't stay in too long, okay? You might get dizzy."
"And it's cold outside right now, so remember to dry yourself off properly afterward. Otherwise you'll catch a cold."
"Yeah, yeah, I know, I know~"
DatingCharacterEvent.157302.2.cn:
“呼……果然很不一样。”
来到各自的私汤，你听见隔壁的花铃对这次新奇的体验表示认可。
“虽然很舒服，但也不要泡太久哦，容易晕过去的。”
“现在外面气温低，等会也要记得擦干净身体哦，不然会感冒的。”
“嗨呀嗨呀，知道啦知道啦~”

DatingCharacterEvent.157302.3.en:
You finish bathing first and wait in the lounge for a while before Karin returns as well.
"Mmm~ It really is different from being in the ocean~"
"Welcome ba—hm? Your hair is still kinda wet."
"Huh~? Where?"
Karin suddenly flicks her ears, as if by instinct. When she reaches up to check, however, she finds no wet hair.
"No, still not dry."
The little movement just now was so cute that you want to see it again, but unfortunately, Karin sees right through your plan.
"I know I've dried it properly! I'm going back to my room!"
DatingCharacterEvent.157302.3.cn:
你先一步泡完，在休息室等了一会后花铃也回来了。
“嗯~确实和在大海里不一样呢~”
“回来……嗯？头上好像还有水珠没擦干净哦。”
“诶~？哪里？”
花铃突然甩了下耳朵，似乎是下意识的动作，以至于她用手去摸的时候发现没有水珠。
“嗯，还没弄干净。”
刚才的动作有些可爱，你希望再看一遍，可惜花铃识破了你的计谋。
“明明就是没有嘛！我回房间去了！”

DatingCharacterEvent.157302.6.en: Visit Hot Spring Resort to unlock
DatingCharacterEvent.157302.6.cn: 在温泉度假村的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.157302.7.en: You took Karin to experience a hot spring for the first time, and she seemed to like it quite a lot. Afterward, you discovered that whenever the top of her head gets wet, her instinctive response is to flick her ears. You found it both funny and adorable, and when you tried to make her do it a few more times, Karin saw right through your little scheme.
DatingCharacterEvent.157302.7.cn: 你带花铃第一次体验了泡温泉的感觉，她似乎很是喜欢。结束后你发现她应对头顶被打湿的情况居然是下意识地甩耳朵，这让你感觉既有趣又可爱，你想再多看几次的时候，花铃还是识破了你的“计谋”。

DatingCharacterEvent.158301.1.en:
You suddenly realize that Laru is in her Snowish Festival outfit, so you ask,

"Isn't your outfit supposed to be exclusive for Snowish Festival? You're also wearing it now?"

Instead of giving you an explanation, Laru asks playfully,

"Why? Do you not like it?"
DatingCharacterEvent.158301.1.cn:
你突然意识到菈露正身着雪愿节的装束，不禁疑惑地问道：
“这身衣服不应该是雪愿节的限定服装吗？现在连逛街也要穿吗？”
菈露没有回答，只是调皮地反问了你一句。
“怎么了？你不喜欢我这个造型吗？”

DatingCharacterEvent.158301.2.en:
The market is bustling as always, still brimming with the festive atmosphere of Snowish Festival as decorations hang everywhere.

Out of nowhere, Laru finds a reindeer headband identical to hers.

She looks at you expectantly, until you finally give in and put it on.
DatingCharacterEvent.158301.2.cn:
集市一如既往的热闹，雪愿节的氛围还没有过去，到处都挂满了节日氛围的饰品。
你一个转头的功夫，菈露不知道从哪找来了一个和她同款的鹿角头箍。
她满眼期待地看着你，直到你认命地接过这个头箍戴上。

DatingCharacterEvent.158301.3.en:
"You know what? We were so busy on Snowish Festival we didn't even take a photo together."

Laru suddenly says.

"Why don't we do it now?"
DatingCharacterEvent.158301.3.cn:
“说起来，雪愿节那会我们忙得脚不沾地，到最后都没想起来要拍张合照？”
菈露突然说道。
“要不就趁现在，我们拍个照留念吧~”

DatingCharacterEvent.158301.6.cn: 在集市的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.158301.7.en:
The bustling market is full of fun little items.

Laru says that she forgot to take a photo with you on the Snowish Festival, so she wants to make it up this time.
DatingCharacterEvent.158301.7.cn:
热闹的集市贩卖着各种有趣的小物件。
菈露说，因为雪愿节的时候忘记和你留下合影，所以这一次，她想与你补拍一张属于雪愿节的照片。

DatingCharacterEvent.158302.1.en:
In the dark winter night, the port feels like a wide mouth of the sea.
But Laru takes you by your arm excitedly, urging you to move faster while reminding you to watch your steps through the snow.
Laru seems eager to see something out there in the water.
DatingCharacterEvent.158302.1.cn:
冬天夜晚的港口像大海在陆地张开的巨口。
但菈露兴奋地拉着你，催着你走快点，又让你小心脚下的积雪。
前方漆黑的海面上，似乎有什么正吸引着菈露过去。

DatingCharacterEvent.158302.2.en:
Laru takes you to a platform where ships dock. Under the dim lights, she proudly and confidently tells you something.

"I had someone in the Trekker Association work it out for me that luminous fish will be riding the current and passing by here tonight. This time, I'll make sure you see fish that actually glow!"

As she speaks, she takes out her timekeeping artifact, counting down.
DatingCharacterEvent.158302.2.cn:
菈露把你带到港口驳船的平台，昏暗的灯光下，她满脸自信地告诉你。
“我找地理协会的人计算过了，今天晚上会有发光的鱼群顺着洋流从这里经过，这一次，我一定会让你看到真正会发光的鱼！”
说着，她拿出计时的神器，开始等待那个时间的到来。

DatingCharacterEvent.158302.3.en:
You've been standing in the freezing wind for an hour, yet not a single luminous fish has shown up.

Laru frowns, looking a little bit embarrassed.

"I don't understand. I definitely got the time right ... but where are the fish...?"
DatingCharacterEvent.158302.3.cn:
你们在港口吹了一个多小时冷风，结果依然什么都没看到。
菈露皱着眉，有点尴尬。
“不对啊，我应该没记错，就是晚上的这个时间……怎么没有鱼呢……”

DatingCharacterEvent.158302.6.cn: 在港口的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.158302.7.en:
Laru still wants to show you real luminous fish.

She brings you to the port excitedly after having someone in the Trekker Association work out for her the exact time luminous fish will pass by.

However, she forgot to ask about the exact date...
DatingCharacterEvent.158302.7.cn:
菈露依然惦记着要让你看到真正会发光的鱼。
她请教了地理协会的学者，问到了鱼群有可能经过港口的时间，并兴致勃勃地带你去看，却忘记了问鱼群出现的日期……

DatingCharacterEvent.159301.1.en:
You and Coronis venture deeper into the cave. She looks around, as if searching for something. "Looking for something?" you have to ask.

Her eyes light up, "Legend says a lost totem of the Loong ancestors is hidden here."
DatingCharacterEvent.159301.1.cn:
你与科洛妮丝继续向洞穴内深入。她不时打量着四周，似乎在寻找什么东西。你忍不住问道：“你在找什么吗？”
她眼神一亮，回答道：“传说这附近的洞穴里有龙裔祖先失落的图腾。”

DatingCharacterEvent.159301.2.en:
"Loong culture is fascinating," she muses. "Even their totems defy our standard classifications."
"Is that what we're investigating?"
She doesn't answer. Instead, she beckons you deeper inside.
"You'll see soon enough."
DatingCharacterEvent.159301.2.cn:
“龙裔的文化很有意思，就连图腾都和我们熟知的不一样。”
“所以你是来调查的？”
科洛妮丝没有回答，示意你赶紧跟上。
“你一会就知道了。”

DatingCharacterEvent.159301.3.en:
You trail her through the cave for a while, seeing nothing remotely like a totem.
Just as you open your mouth to ask, she halts.
"Get over here. I can't move this by myself. I need you to help transport it."
You look where she's pointing: a corpse of a boar, completely overgrown with mushrooms.
DatingCharacterEvent.159301.3.cn:
你跟在科洛妮丝身后，在洞穴里走了好一阵，都没有看到所谓的图腾。
就在你准备询问时，科洛妮丝停下了脚步。
“来吧，这个东西我搬不动，你帮我一起带回去吧。”
你顺着她指的方向，看到了一只长满蘑菇的野猪尸体。

DatingCharacterEvent.159301.6.cn: 在洞窟的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.159301.7.en: Coronis seemed so fascinated by Loong culture that you assumed she was studying their totems ... or so you thought. Standing before that dead boar, you realize the good doctor will always care more about pathology than anthropology.
DatingCharacterEvent.159301.7.cn: 科洛妮丝最近似乎对龙裔的文化很感兴趣，以至于她开始调查龙裔的图腾……你本是这么以为的，直到你站在那只野猪面前，你才意识到，这位医者始终是对病症更感兴趣……

DatingCharacterEvent.159302.1.en:
The Loong market has a vibe all its own. You're happily squatting by a stall, admiring some intricate wooden dolls, when Coronis whispers right into your ear.
"The anatomy of this doll... Doesn't it seem incorrect?"
DatingCharacterEvent.159302.1.cn:
龙裔的集市也其他地方的略有不同，你正兴致勃勃地蹲在小摊前看一些雕刻精致的木偶，突然，科洛妮丝的声音贴着你的耳边响起。
“这个人偶的结构，似乎有哪里不太对？”

DatingCharacterEvent.159302.2.en:
Startled by her voice, you turn to see she's crouched right next to you, scrutinizing the figure in her hand.
"Given these proportions, a human subject would be missing two ribs on either side."
DatingCharacterEvent.159302.2.cn:
你被科洛妮丝的声音吓了一跳，转头发现她也在你身边蹲下，拿起木偶仔细端详。
“如果按照这个比例，那么，这个人偶实际上是比一般人左右各少了两根肋骨。”

DatingCharacterEvent.159302.3.en:
You worry her critique might offend the stall owner, but the middle-aged man's eyes light up with excitement.
"You have a sharp eye! I bet you'll appreciate this one."
He produces a more elaborate doll and pops open its chest, revealing a complete set of internal organs and bones.
Coronis stares at you, eyes burning with desire. Mesmerized by her gaze, you find yourself paying for the doll without a second thought.
DatingCharacterEvent.159302.3.cn:
就在你担心科洛妮丝的发言会让小摊的老板不满时，这个中年男人突然两眼放光地看向你们。
“客人真是好眼力，我猜你们会对它感兴趣？”
老板拿出了一个更加精致的人偶，当着我们的面打开了人偶的外壳，露出了里面结构完整的内脏和骨骼。
你转头看见科洛妮丝热切地盯着你。你在她期待的目光里，像被蛊惑一般，把这个人偶买了下来。

DatingCharacterEvent.159302.6.cn: 在集市的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.159302.7.en: Neither of you expected to find a stall owner at the Loong market who shared such an obsession with human anatomy. The doll is a bit creepy, sure, but Coronis clearly loves it—so you'll count today as a win.
DatingCharacterEvent.159302.7.cn: 科洛妮丝和你都没想到会在龙裔的集市上，遇到同样对人体结构着迷的小摊老板。虽然那个人偶看上去有点诡异，但科洛妮丝显然非常喜欢，那么今天也算是大有收获吧。

DatingCharacterEvent.160301.1.en:
Deep inside the cavern, you stumbled upon a dark, unmapped opening with water steadily dripping from the ceiling.
"An uncharted tunnel... For everyone's safety, we'd better go in and check whether the entrance needs to be sealed off."
Willow struck a torch and walked right in.
The cave was overgrown with algae. All kinds of shelled creatures clung to the surfaces of the rocks, and the air was thick with the briny smell of the sea.
DatingCharacterEvent.160301.1.cn:
在洞窟深处，你们发现了一个黑漆漆的洞口，它并没有被记录在地图中，洞顶淅淅沥沥地滴着水。
“未记录在案的支洞啊，为了大家的安全，还是进去确认一下是否有封锁入口的必要吧。”
薇洛点燃火把，就这么走了进去。
洞窟里长满了藻类，岩石表面附着着各种各样的壳类生物，空气里弥漫着潮湿的海腥味。

DatingCharacterEvent.160301.2.en:
You and Willow made a circuit of the cave and discovered that it was a dead end, nothing special.
"Looks like there isn't anything dangerous..."
Before you could finish, Willow shook her head.
"No, there is still danger here."
You looked in the direction Willow was pointing, but couldn't make out anything dangerous in the darkness.
Willow walked over, crouched down, and began prying at the stones on the ground. A moment later, you saw her pry up one of the "stones"—upon closer inspection, it turned out to be an enormous black-and-gold abalone.
DatingCharacterEvent.160301.2.cn:
你和薇洛在洞窟里转了一圈，发现这是一个“死胡同”，并没有什么特殊之处。
“好像也没什么危险的……”
不等你说完，薇洛摇了摇头。
“不，危险还是存在的。”
你顺着薇洛指的方向看过去，并没有看出那黑漆漆的一片里有什么危险。
薇洛走过去，蹲下去开始抠地上的石头。不一会，你看到她把一块“石头”抠了下来——你定睛一看，竟然是一个块头硕大的黑金鲍鱼。

DatingCharacterEvent.160301.3.en:
"There are too many abalones growing here. If the Trekkers find out, some of them will definitely come here at low tide to dig them up. And if they lose track of when the tide comes in, since this place only has one way out, there would be trouble."
"I see. Then we need someone to guard this entrance."
"But before that..." Willow smiled at you. "We can solve part of the problem at the source. Let's dig up some abalones and take them back. We're going to eat well tonight!"
DatingCharacterEvent.160301.3.cn:
“这里长了太多鲍鱼了，如果让旅人们知道，一定会有人趁退潮过来挖鲍鱼。到时候万一忽视了涨潮时间，这里又是个单行道，那就出事了。”
“原来如此，那还是需要有人看守好这个入口。”
“在这一步之前，还有更重要的一步。”薇洛冲你笑了笑，“我们可以从根源上解决一点，挖点鲍鱼回去吧，今晚可以加餐！”

DatingCharacterEvent.160301.6.cn: 在洞窟的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.160301.7.en:
You and Willow found some tools and dug up quite a few enormous abalones before the tide came in.
How should you cook these abalones?
You're already starting to look forward to tonight's dinner.
DatingCharacterEvent.160301.7.cn:
你和薇洛找来工具，在涨潮之前，从洞穴里挖出了不少个头巨大的鲍鱼。
要如何烹饪这些鲍鱼呢？
你们已经开始期待今天的晚餐了。

DatingCharacterEvent.160302.1.en:
You had planned to take a walk around the area together, and there was supposed to be a fireworks festival that evening. But after Willow returned to her room to change, she didn't come out. You went to check on her.
You knocked on the door several times, but there was no response. Beginning to worry that something might have happened, you called out:
"Willow? Are you in there? I'm coming in."
DatingCharacterEvent.160302.1.cn:
你们约好了要去附近逛逛散步，今晚似乎还有一个烟花大会。可薇洛回房间更换衣服之后就不见踪影，于是你来到房间找她。
你连着敲了几次门都没有回应，你开始担心她是否遇到了什么事情。
“薇洛？你在屋里吗？我进来了？”

DatingCharacterEvent.160302.2.en:
Inside the inn room, you found Willow still wearing the clothes she had worn earlier. She was sitting at the desk, completely absorbed in the documents spread out before her. Only then did she notice you. "Ah... What brings you here?"
"I waited for ages and started to think something had happened to you," you said and sighed. "Weren't you supposed to be changing clothes so we could go watch the fireworks?"
"Ah... Sorry, sorry. I ran into a Trekker I know on the way back, and he asked me to deliver some documents to the Association. Before I knew it, I slipped right back into work mode..."
DatingCharacterEvent.160302.2.cn:
旅店的房间内，你发现薇洛身上还是之前去戏水时的着装，她坐在桌边，全神贯注地看着眼前摊开的文件。她终于发现了你，“啊……你怎么过来了？”
“等了你半天还以为你出什么事了，”你无奈地看着她，“不是说换衣服去看烟花大会吗？”
“啊……抱歉抱歉，回来路上遇到了认识的旅人，他托我带份文件到地理协会，一不小心又进入了工作模式……”

DatingCharacterEvent.160302.3.en:
Realizing there was not much time left before the fireworks festival began, Willow immediately put the documents down.
"Let's go! Work can wait until after my vacation is over."
"But weren't you going to change clothes? It might get a little chilly out there..."
"It's fine, come on! We're gonna miss it!"
DatingCharacterEvent.160302.3.cn:
但距离烟花大会开始已经没多少时间了，意识到的薇洛立刻放下了文件。
“先走吧！工作的事情还是等休假结束之后再看好了。”
你忍不住提醒她，“但你不是要换衣服吗？夜里可能会有点凉……”
“没事没事，快走吧！不然就真的来不及了！”

DatingCharacterEvent.160302.6.en: Visit Hot Spring Resort to unlock
DatingCharacterEvent.160302.6.cn: 在温泉度假村的话，或许会发现些什么……

DatingCharacterEvent.160302.7.en: In the end, you made it to the fireworks festival in time. As the two of you stood side by side beneath the sky filled with brilliant bursts of light, you stole a glance at Willow—only to discover that she was already looking at you. This might be the most unforgettable moment of the entire trip.
DatingCharacterEvent.160302.7.cn: 最终，你们赶上了烟花大会，并肩站在一起欣赏着漫天的烟花时，你侧头偷偷看了薇洛一眼，却发现她也正在看你，你心想，这或许会是这次旅行最难忘的一幕。

DatingCharacterEvent.1714.1.en:
Before sunset, you and ==DATING_CHARACTER== quicken your pace toward the outdoor hot spring you booked.
 It sits on a hillside, with a small stream below, and a view of the surrounding forest stretching into the distance.
DatingCharacterEvent.1714.1.cn:
趁日落之前，你和==DATING_CHARACTER==加快脚步前往预定好的露天温泉。
这处温泉位于一处山坡上，其下就有一条小溪，抬眼便可望见山林的景色。

DatingCharacterEvent.1714.2.en:
Sitting in the hot spring, you realize it feels even better than you imagined. You can’t find a reason to get out—part of you wants to stay like this forever.
Across from you, ==DATING_CHARACTER== seems a little warm, gently fanning herself with her hand.
DatingCharacterEvent.1714.2.cn:
你坐在温泉当中，发现浸泡在里面比想象中更加舒服，你似乎找不到什么理由浮出水面，好想永远就这么泡下去。
==DATING_CHARACTER==坐在你对面，她似乎有些热，正用手慢慢朝自己扇风。

DatingCharacterEvent.1714.3.en:
With the sunset behind her, her skin glimmers with fine, pearl-like droplets. Suddenly, ==DATING_CHARACTER== flicks a splash of water onto your face. "What are you staring at?"
 "The sunset."
DatingCharacterEvent.1714.3.cn:
她背靠着夕阳，肌肤上似有似无的汗毛，沾上了一层细珍珠般的水滴。==DATING_CHARACTER==突然将水轻轻撩在你的脸上，“在看什么呢？”
“在看太阳落山。”

DatingCharacterEvent.1715.1.en: You arrive at an indoor hot spring. As soon as you step onto the stone path, a faint scent of sulfur greets you. Once you sink into the water, tiny bubbles cling softly to your skin.
DatingCharacterEvent.1715.1.cn: 你们来到一处室内的温泉。刚走上石踏，就能闻到一股淡淡的硫磺味。将身子浸入水中，有些细密的气泡附着在你的皮肤上。

DatingCharacterEvent.1715.2.en: "They say hot springs with bubbles like this are good for your body," ==DATING_CHARACTER== says. You feel like you’re soaking in warmed Pep Pep Juice. After a while, you start to feel thirsty… and really crave a drink of it.
DatingCharacterEvent.1715.2.cn:
“据说这种会冒泡泡的温泉对身体有好处哦。”==DATING_CHARACTER==说道。
你感觉自己像泡在煨热过的能量沛沛里一样。又过了一会，你感到有些口渴，并且非常想喝能量沛沛。

DatingCharacterEvent.1715.3.en:
==DATING_CHARACTER== hands you a bottle of milk. "You need to stay hydrated when you’re in a hot spring." 
How thoughtful. It’s not soda, but it does the job. Still… is there a milk-flavored Pep Pep Juice?
DatingCharacterEvent.1715.3.cn:
==DATING_CHARACTER==伸手递给你一瓶牛奶。“泡温泉时要及时补充水分。”
好贴心，虽然不是汽水，但也能够解渴。话说，有没有牛奶味的能量沛沛？

DatingCharacterEvent.1716.1.en: "Let’s see who’s better!" you tell ==DATING_CHARACTER==. You take your stance, tossing the ball lightly with your left hand and swinging your paddle with your right.
DatingCharacterEvent.1716.1.cn: “来分个高下吧！”你对==DATING_CHARACTER==说。你拉开架势，左手将小球轻轻一掷，右手随即挥拍。

DatingCharacterEvent.1716.2.en: Wait… what do you mean "right away"? Did you swing too early? Sure enough, there’s no contact. The ball hits the table, then rolls off to the floor, the sound fading into the distance.
DatingCharacterEvent.1716.2.cn: 等下，“随即”是什么情况，是不是挥早了？果然，拍子上没有传来小球的碰撞感。弹弹球落在球台上，又弹到地上，发出渐行渐远的滚动声。

DatingCharacterEvent.1716.3.en: "Hahaha!" ==DATING_CHARACTER== bursts out laughing. You suddenly feel like your decline has begun… yeah, you really need to work out more.
DatingCharacterEvent.1716.3.cn: “哈哈哈哈。”==DATING_CHARACTER==发出笑声。你似乎感觉自己衰老的时刻已悄然降临，需要加强锻炼了！

DatingCharacterEvent.1717.1.en: ==DATING_CHARACTER== takes her position across from you and serves with perfect form. Even though it’s been a while since you last played, you manage to return the ball by instinct.
DatingCharacterEvent.1717.1.cn: ==DATING_CHARACTER==在你对面站定，非常标准地向你发了一球。虽然你好久没有打过弹弹球了，但还是能凭着感觉把球打回去。

DatingCharacterEvent.1717.2.en: The rally goes back and forth, and you even start to feel a bit proud of your skills. But then it hits you—this isn’t a competition. It’s just the two of you playing. What matters isn’t smashing the ball past her, but keeping the game going.
DatingCharacterEvent.1717.2.cn: 你们打得有来有回，你甚至出现了一种自己球技不错的自豪感。但你又转念一想，这是一场双人游戏，而不是什么竞技比赛。重要的点是如何把这场游戏持续下去，而非想办法将对面扣杀。

DatingCharacterEvent.1717.3.en: Sure, games are about winning… but what does "winning" really mean? If both of you can keep the game going, enjoying every moment together— that, too, is a kind of victory.
DatingCharacterEvent.1717.3.cn: 虽说玩游戏就是要胜利，但所谓胜利也没有明确的定义。让这场游戏平稳地维护下去，两方各有所乐，甚至于尽兴，自然也是一种胜利。

DatingCharacterEvent.1718.1.en: You wander into a study—might as well take a look inside. A desk sits tucked into one corner, and the walls there are lined entirely with windows. Beyond them stretches a valley bathed in the fading glow of sunset.
DatingCharacterEvent.1718.1.cn: 你们游荡到一间书斋，进去看看吧。这里的书桌被布置在房间一角，角落的墙面也均由窗子组成。窗外则是落日余晖下的山谷。

DatingCharacterEvent.1718.2.en: A bit tired from walking, you both sit by the desk and pick out a few books to read. The collection is old—paint on the covers carries a sense of age, and the pages have begun to yellow slightly.
DatingCharacterEvent.1718.2.cn: 恰好有些走累了，你们坐到桌边，抽了几本书开始阅读。这里的藏书都上了年纪，封面的油彩有一种独特的年代感，其纸张也有些微微发黄。

DatingCharacterEvent.1718.3.en: The books tell the story of how this hot spring resort rose from obscurity to modest fame. They speak of the hardships and frustrations of its early days, along with the strange and curious tales that unfolded here over time.
DatingCharacterEvent.1718.3.cn: 书中介绍了这家温泉度假村如何从名不见经传到小有名气。其中既有创业时的艰辛与不甘，也包含了度假村里发生过的奇闻轶事。

DatingCharacterEvent.1719.1.en: You stroll aimlessly along a stone path under the setting sun. The glass windows of boutique shops reflect fiery hues of dusk, and even the posters on display seem to glow as if they’ve caught flame.
DatingCharacterEvent.1719.1.cn: 你们就在夕阳下的石板路上漫无目的地走着。路旁特选店的玻璃反射着火红的霞光，其上张贴着的海报也宛如着了火一般。

DatingCharacterEvent.1719.2.en: The rich fragrance of wildflowers drifts down from the hillside, carried by the evening breeze before sunset. "It’s so beautiful… it feels like a dream," ==DATING_CHARACTER== murmurs.
DatingCharacterEvent.1719.2.cn: 山丘上野花的馥郁芬芳，被日落前的晚风送到你们身旁。“这里好美，简直像在梦里一样。”==DATING_CHARACTER==感慨道。

DatingCharacterEvent.1719.3.en: Night falls, and the streets gradually darken. The roads take on a quieter, more solemn air, while only a trace of light lingers on the distant hills. You find yourself recalling fragments of the day… almost as if it had all been a dream.
DatingCharacterEvent.1719.3.cn: 夜色落幕，街上渐渐黑了，道路也显得更加庄重，唯有远方的山丘上还留着一抹余晖。你不禁回忆起今天白天里的零碎细节，好像真的有一种做梦的虚幻感。

DatingCharacterEvent.515.1.en: In the innermost part of the cave, ==DATING_CHARACTER== discovers a massive shrine.
DatingCharacterEvent.515.1.cn: 洞窟的最深处，==DATING_CHARACTER==发现了一个巨大的神龛。

DatingCharacterEvent.515.2.en: In the very center of the shrine sits a massive projector artifact.
DatingCharacterEvent.515.2.cn: 神龛的正中央，放着一只巨大的显影神器。

DatingCharacterEvent.515.3.en: Judging by the nearby wall paintings, it seems that those who worshiped here believed the image revealed by the artifact was that of a deity's.
DatingCharacterEvent.515.3.cn: 从周围的壁画推断，在此祭拜的人，似乎认为显影神器里出现的是神的身影。

DatingCharacterEvent.516.1.en: In the innermost part of the cave lies a massive abyss. It's circular in shape and seems bottomless.
DatingCharacterEvent.516.1.cn: 洞窟的最深处，是一个巨大的，深不见底的圆形深渊。

DatingCharacterEvent.516.2.en: You and ==DATING_CHARACTER== stand side by side at the edge of the abyss, holding each other's hand tightly.
DatingCharacterEvent.516.2.cn: 你和==DATING_CHARACTER==并肩站在深渊旁，紧紧握着对方的手。

DatingCharacterEvent.516.3.en: Something at the bottom of the abyss seems to be staring at you, but you have no fear.
DatingCharacterEvent.516.3.cn: 深渊的底部似乎有什么正窥视着此处，但你们并不害怕。

DatingCharacterEvent.517.1.en: You find a beautiful mushroom and pop it into your mouth. Then hallucinations overtake you. You feel lost in a forest and start running wildly in every direction.
DatingCharacterEvent.517.1.cn: 你发现了一只很漂亮的蘑菇，放入口中。你产生了幻觉，感觉自己迷失在森林中，开始四处狂奔。

DatingCharacterEvent.517.2.en: A fluffy bear cub hugs you tightly and doesn't let go until you come to your senses.
DatingCharacterEvent.517.2.cn: 一只毛茸茸的小熊紧紧抱住你，直到你清醒过来。

DatingCharacterEvent.518.1.en: You find an ordinary-looking mushroom. After tasting it, you find it delicious. Together, you sprinkle on some seasoning and roast it over the fire.
DatingCharacterEvent.518.1.cn: 你发现了一只很普通的蘑菇。放入口中，味道很好，你们一起把蘑菇撒上调料，在火上烤了一下。

DatingCharacterEvent.518.2.en: The aroma of the roasted mushroom attracts a giant earth dragon, and that's how you end up with a new ingredient for your meal.
DatingCharacterEvent.518.2.cn: 烤蘑菇的香味引出了一只巨大的地龙，你们获得了新的食材。

DatingCharacterEvent.519.1.en: You find an ugly-looking mushroom. It's incredibly bitter but also keeps you wide awake.
DatingCharacterEvent.519.1.cn: 你发现了一只很丑陋的蘑菇。吃起来很苦，但很提神，让人根本睡不着。

DatingCharacterEvent.519.2.en: And so, when the next rest comes, it's your turn to stand watch.
DatingCharacterEvent.519.2.cn: 于是，下一次休息轮到你看守了。

DatingCharacterEvent.615.1.en: "Excuse me, would you two like to participate in our raffle?" The enthusiastic shop assistant asks.
DatingCharacterEvent.615.1.cn:
“请问，二位要参加我们的抽奖活动吗？”
店员热情地说道。

DatingCharacterEvent.615.2.en: You and ==DATING_CHARACTER== take a raffle ticket each.
DatingCharacterEvent.615.2.cn: 你和==DATING_CHARACTER==一人抽了一张奖券。

DatingCharacterEvent.615.3.en: ==DATING_CHARACTER== scores a BOGO coupon. She gets double portion for everything she orders.
DatingCharacterEvent.615.3.cn: ==DATING_CHARACTER==幸运地抽中了买一送一的优惠券，所有食物都会额外赠送一份。

DatingCharacterEvent.616.1.en: "Excuse me, would you two like to participate in our raffle?" The enthusiastic shop assistant asks.
DatingCharacterEvent.616.1.cn:
“请问，二位要参加我们的抽奖活动吗？”
店员热情地说道。

DatingCharacterEvent.616.2.en: You and ==DATING_CHARACTER== take a raffle ticket each.
DatingCharacterEvent.616.2.cn: 你和==DATING_CHARACTER==一人抽了一张奖券。

DatingCharacterEvent.616.3.en: Unlucky this time. Nothing useful. Better luck next time.
DatingCharacterEvent.616.3.cn: 运气不好，没抽到有用的东西，下次再试试吧。

DatingCharacterEvent.617.1.en: The desserts are delicious, leaving you wanting more.
DatingCharacterEvent.617.1.cn: 甜品非常可口，有些意犹未尽。

DatingCharacterEvent.617.2.en: Why not order some more? Make today a cheat day.
DatingCharacterEvent.617.2.cn: 干脆再点一些吧，就当今天是欺骗日。

DatingCharacterEvent.618.1.en: Though the plates are empty, your conversation hasn't run out.
DatingCharacterEvent.618.1.cn: 虽然餐点都吃完了，但是你们的话茬尚未结束。

DatingCharacterEvent.618.2.en: The two of you chat about nothing in particular, the topic turn from Northern Isles to Lushwood Jungle...
DatingCharacterEvent.618.2.cn: 你们有一搭没一搭的聊着，要从北岛聊到雨林……

DatingCharacterEvent.714.1.en:
A furtive-looking man pushes past you and walks away briskly, nearly causing you to lose your balance.

==DATING_CHARACTER== quickly grabs you, asking if you're hurt.
DatingCharacterEvent.714.1.cn:
一个鬼鬼祟祟的人挤开你快步走过，你险些没站稳。
==DATING_CHARACTER==眼疾手快拉住了你，询问你有没有受伤。

DatingCharacterEvent.714.2.en:
You have a gut feeling that something's off about that person.

Then, a shout of "Stop, thief!" rings out nearby, confirming your instincts.
DatingCharacterEvent.714.2.cn:
你觉得那个人很可疑。
身旁传来一声“抓小偷”的呼喊，你可以确定自己的猜测了。

DatingCharacterEvent.714.3.en:
You and ==DATING_CHARACTER== split up. Despite the huge crowd, you two manage to catch the thief.

The bystanders cheer your brave act.
DatingCharacterEvent.714.3.cn:
你和==DATING_CHARACTER==兵分两路，尽管人潮汹涌，你们还是顺利抓住了小偷。
围观的市民们，向你们的英勇致敬。

DatingCharacterEvent.715.1.en:
A furtive-looking man pushes past you and walks away briskly, nearly causing you to lose your balance.

You quickly grab him by his arm because you sense something is off.
DatingCharacterEvent.715.1.cn:
一个鬼鬼祟祟的人挤开你快步走过，你险些没站稳。
你眼疾手快拉住了他，你觉得那个人很可疑。

DatingCharacterEvent.715.2.en:
A shout of "Stop, thief!" rings out nearby and you two react immediately.

==DATING_CHARACTER== and you subdue the thief.
DatingCharacterEvent.715.2.cn:
身旁传来一声“抓小偷”的呼喊，你和她立刻反应了过来。
==DATING_CHARACTER==和你一起合力制服了小偷。

DatingCharacterEvent.715.3.en:
After the commotion, ==DATING_CHARACTER== sighs and says that she hopes you won't risk yourself like that next time.

She adds that in situations like this, it should be her protecting you.
DatingCharacterEvent.715.3.cn:
插曲过后，==DATING_CHARACTER==叹了口气，并希望你下次不要以身犯险。
她说，这种时候，应该她来保护你。

DatingCharacterEvent.716.1.en:
You decide to try your luck at the market's game area because every participant gets a chance at a raffle.

At the dart booth, you and ==DATING_CHARACTER== each grab five darts.
DatingCharacterEvent.716.1.cn:
你们决定去集市的游戏区试试手气，听说每位参与的顾客都可以抽奖。
在投飞镖的摊位前，你和==DATING_CHARACTER==一人拿了五枚飞镖。

DatingCharacterEvent.716.2.en:
The first four darts almost hit the bullseye. You can't help but feel a bit nervous as you get ready to throw the last one.

==DATING_CHARACTER== leans in and whispers softly, "Good luck."
DatingCharacterEvent.716.2.cn:
前四枚都差点正中靶心，投最后一枚前，你不禁有些紧张。
==DATING_CHARACTER==悄悄在你耳边说：“加油。”

DatingCharacterEvent.716.3.en: With a bag full of prizes in hand, the two of you continue exploring the market happily.
DatingCharacterEvent.716.3.cn: 你们拎着满满一袋的奖品，心满意足地继续逛着。

DatingCharacterEvent.717.1.en:
You decide to try your luck at the market's game area because every participant gets a chance at a raffle.

At the ring toss booth, you and ==DATING_CHARACTER== each grab five rings.
DatingCharacterEvent.717.1.cn:
你们决定去集市的游戏区试试手气，听说每位参与的顾客都可以抽奖。
套圈的小摊前围了许多人，你和==DATING_CHARACTER==一人拿了五个软圈。

DatingCharacterEvent.717.2.en:
You are on fire and bag four prizes.

==DATING_CHARACTER== stands next to you and applauds.
DatingCharacterEvent.717.2.cn:
你手感绝佳，套中了四个奖品。
==DATING_CHARACTER==在一旁为你鼓掌。

DatingCharacterEvent.717.3.en: With a bag full of prizes in hand, the two of you continue exploring the market happily.
DatingCharacterEvent.717.3.cn: 你们拎着满满一袋的奖品，心满意足地继续逛着。

DatingCharacterEvent.718.1.en:
You decide to try your luck at the market's game area because every participant gets a chance at a raffle.

The whack-a-mole stall is packed with people; you and ==DATING_CHARACTER== each buy enough tokens for two rounds of the game.
DatingCharacterEvent.718.1.cn:
你们决定去集市的游戏区试试手气，听说每位参与的顾客都可以抽奖。
打地鼠的小摊前围了许多人，你和==DATING_CHARACTER==买了两局的游戏币。

DatingCharacterEvent.718.2.en:
You lift the mallet and manage to hit almost every mole that pops up.

After the game ends, ==DATING_CHARACTER== gently massages your sore arm.
DatingCharacterEvent.718.2.cn:
你举起木槌，几乎砸中了每个冒头的地鼠。
游戏结束后，==DATING_CHARACTER==帮你揉了揉有些酸痛的手臂。

DatingCharacterEvent.718.3.en: With a bag full of prizes in hand, the two of you continue exploring the market happily.
DatingCharacterEvent.718.3.cn: 你们拎着满满一袋的奖品，心满意足地继续逛着。

DatingCharacterEvent.719.1.en:
Suddenly, a burst of excitement erupts from the crowd in a distance.

A street performance has begun.
DatingCharacterEvent.719.1.cn:
忽然，远处的人群里爆发出一阵惊呼。
街头演出开始了。

DatingCharacterEvent.719.2.en: The impromptu acrobatics performance draws gasps of amazement from the crowd. Both of you feel that you definitely came to the right place today.
DatingCharacterEvent.719.2.cn: 这场临时的杂技演出，让观众们爆发出连连的惊叹声。你们感慨，今天真是来对了地方。

DatingCharacterEvent.719.3.en:
The show ends to roaring applause.

You look over at ==DATING_CHARACTER==; she's smiling just like you, a smile that comes from the heart.
DatingCharacterEvent.719.3.cn:
表演结束，掌声雷动。
你看向==DATING_CHARACTER==，她和你一样，同样洋溢着发自内心的笑容。

DatingCharacterEvent.720.1.en:
Suddenly, a burst of excitement erupts from the crowd in a distance, followed by the sound of lively music.

A street performance has begun.
DatingCharacterEvent.720.1.cn:
忽然，远处的人群里爆发出一阵惊呼，随之而来的是欢快的音乐声。
街头演出开始了。

DatingCharacterEvent.720.2.en:
Even though the stage is a makeshift one, the idols from Scarlet Sights Media give their all. Their dance moves and vocals are full of energy.

==DATING_CHARACTER==, caught up in the mood and rhythm, starts swaying her hand to the beat without even realizing it.
DatingCharacterEvent.720.2.cn:
尽管是临时搭建的舞台，绯曈传讯的偶像们却丝毫没有懈怠，舞姿和歌声都富有活力。
==DATING_CHARACTER==也跟着气氛和节拍，情不自禁地甩起了手。

DatingCharacterEvent.720.3.en:
Even after the final song ends, ==DATING_CHARACTER== still seems to want more.

The two of you exchange a cheerful smile.
DatingCharacterEvent.720.3.cn:
直到最后一首歌曲结束，==DATING_CHARACTER==依然意犹未尽。
你和她畅快地相视而笑。

DatingCharacterEvent.721.1.en:
Suddenly, a burst of excitement erupts from the crowd in a distance, followed by music.

A street performance has begun.
DatingCharacterEvent.721.1.cn:
忽然，远处的人群里爆发出一阵惊呼，随之而来的是音乐声。
街头演出开始了。

DatingCharacterEvent.721.2.en:
The spotlight is on an unknown singer.

Song after song, the energy in the crowd builds. Everyone is amazed by that incredible voice.
DatingCharacterEvent.721.2.cn:
目光的焦点是一位名不见经传的歌手。
歌曲一首接一首，现场的氛围逐渐炒热。大家都惊叹于艺人的歌喉。

DatingCharacterEvent.721.3.en:
You stay to the very end.

==DATING_CHARACTER== slips you some Dorra, nudging you to give the singer a tip.
DatingCharacterEvent.721.3.cn:
你们认真地听到了曲终人散。
==DATING_CHARACTER==给了你一些朵拉，悄悄地托你一起交给艺人打个赏。

DatingCharacterEvent.722.1.en: At the edge of the market, there's a shop selling stylish trinkets.
DatingCharacterEvent.722.1.cn: 集市的边缘有一家买时尚小玩意的店面。

DatingCharacterEvent.722.2.en: ==DATING_CHARACTER== has her eyes on the glowing ink, and the invisible kind that only shows up when it's touched with water.
DatingCharacterEvent.722.2.cn: ==DATING_CHARACTER==盯上了会发光的墨水，还有沾水才能看见的隐形墨水。

DatingCharacterEvent.722.3.en: In the end, she buys a small bottle of gradient-colored ink.
DatingCharacterEvent.722.3.cn: 最终她买了一小瓶渐变的彩色墨水。

DatingCharacterEvent.723.1.en: In one corner of the market, there is a pickled food stall.
DatingCharacterEvent.723.1.cn: 集市的角落有一家腌货铺。

DatingCharacterEvent.723.2.en: A massive salted fish hangs at the entrance of the shop. No one knows how long it has been there or when it was cured.
DatingCharacterEvent.723.2.cn: 铺子的门口挂着一条硕大的咸鱼，不知道它在这里挂了多久，更不知道它是在什么时候被腌制的。

DatingCharacterEvent.723.3.en: Regardless, nothing can spoil it, not even the most virtuous souls.
DatingCharacterEvent.723.3.cn: 无论如何，似乎没有什么东西能使它变质，连最为道德高尚的人也望尘莫及。

DatingCharacterEvent.814.1.en: You sit together at the docks and lower fishing lines into the sea.
DatingCharacterEvent.814.1.cn: 你们坐在码头上，将鱼线垂进海水里。

DatingCharacterEvent.814.2.en: You chat idly as you wait. The tide rises, but no fish bite. You wait anyway, until there's nothing left to wait for.
DatingCharacterEvent.814.2.cn: 你们一边聊天，一边等待。随着潮水涨起，还是没有鱼上钩，你们接着等待，直到没什么可等的了。

DatingCharacterEvent.814.3.en: Not a single catch, but the time spent talking is more than enough. Fishing is less about the catch, and more about the waiting.
DatingCharacterEvent.814.3.cn: 虽然一条鱼也没钓到，但是仅仅闲聊就很开心。钓鱼重要的不是鱼，而是等待的过程。

DatingCharacterEvent.815.1.en: You sit together at the docks and lower fishing lines into the sea.
DatingCharacterEvent.815.1.cn: 你们坐在码头上，将鱼线垂进海水里。

DatingCharacterEvent.815.2.en: As you chat idly, suddenly the line jerks hard, pulling at the rod. The force feels immense and you scramble to reel it in.
DatingCharacterEvent.815.2.cn: 你们一边聊天，一边等待。突然，鱼线拽着钓竿下沉，力道好像很大，你们慌乱地开始溜鱼。

DatingCharacterEvent.815.3.en:
When the fight eases, the two of you haul it up together. It's gigantic!

But you don't know what to do with it, so you take a photo and let it go.
DatingCharacterEvent.815.3.cn:
直到水下动静变小，你们合力提杆，好大一条！
但你们不知道该如何处理它，于是拍照留念后又将它丢回海里。

DatingCharacterEvent.816.1.en: The two of you lie back on the rocking boat, gazing at the Divine Window, trading stories of the day.
DatingCharacterEvent.816.1.cn: 你们仰面躺在摇曳的小舟上，望着北四角星，聊着今天的趣事。

DatingCharacterEvent.816.2.en: ==DATING_CHARACTER=='s words grow fragmented, her breathing steady—she's fallen asleep.
DatingCharacterEvent.816.2.cn: ==DATING_CHARACTER==的话语开始变得破碎，呼吸逐渐沉稳——她睡着了。

DatingCharacterEvent.816.3.en: When the boat docks, you wake her gently and help her ashore.
DatingCharacterEvent.816.3.cn: 小舟靠岸后，你叫醒了她，并轻轻地搀扶她上岸。

DatingCharacterEvent.817.1.en: You sit together on the boat as moonlight shimmers across the bay.
DatingCharacterEvent.817.1.cn: 你们坐在小舟上，海湾在月光的照映下泛起粼粼波光。

DatingCharacterEvent.817.2.en: Swept up by the moment, ==DATING_CHARACTER== begins to sing softly.
DatingCharacterEvent.817.2.cn: 似乎是被气氛感染，==DATING_CHARACTER==轻声唱起歌来。

DatingCharacterEvent.817.3.en:
You listen in silence. In the boat, surrounded by the darkness, every sound feels amplified. You can hear the waves become her accompaniment, and distant whales seem to join in.

A breeze rises, carrying strands of her hair across your cheek.
DatingCharacterEvent.817.3.cn:
你静静地听着。在黑漆漆的小舟上，你的听觉被极度放大，你能听到潮起潮落为她伴奏，似乎还有远方鲸群的呜鸣。
又起风了，她的发丝飘到你的脸颊上。

DatingLandmark.14.2.en: A place to gain knowledge and skills. Go relive your student days together.
DatingLandmark.14.2.cn: 习得知识与技能的好地方。一起去回忆下学生时代吧。

DatingLandmark.17.2.en: Let your lightened spirit drift away in the clear, warm waters.
DatingLandmark.17.2.cn: 在清澈的热水里将轻盈的心灵漂向远方吧。

DatingLandmark.5.2.en: A famous site for exploration not too far from the city. Perhaps it's good for a trip?
DatingLandmark.5.2.cn: 城外不远处的有名探险地。或许是个游玩的好去处？

DatingLandmark.6.2.en: A chain store known for its delicious creations. They always seem to have something new when you visit.
DatingLandmark.6.2.cn: 以美味闻名的连锁好店，每次光顾都可能有新品推出。

DatingLandmark.7.2.en: The lively market is the perfect place for finding both deals and entertainment.
DatingLandmark.7.2.cn: 充满了生活气息的热闹集市，是捡漏、娱乐的良选。

DatingLandmark.8.2.en: Goods change hands here, but it's also a perfect spot for a stroll and getting some fresh air.
DatingLandmark.8.2.cn: 货物在此流转，但也是散步、吹风的绝佳地方。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1401.1.en: The carriage turns east into the Academy, the buildings drift past overhead. "Whoa—" You lean against the front gate.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1401.1.cn: 马车向东转进学院区域，建筑在头顶上缓缓后移。"吁——"，你倚靠在学院大门旁。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1401.2.en: You hear ==DATING_CHARACTER=='s heels clicking on the pavement. She stands by the signpost, one hand on the rail.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1401.2.cn: 你听见==DATING_CHARACTER==的鞋跟踏响在路面上。她站在路牌下，扶着栏杆。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1401.3.en: As the carriage rolls away, a breeze stirs and she waves to you.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1401.3.cn: 马车起步离开，一阵风，她在向你招手。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1402.1.en: It's just after class. The entrance of the teaching building is bustling with students coming and going.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1402.1.cn: 正值下课时间，教学楼门口人来人往。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1402.2.en: You and ==DATING_CHARACTER== slip in with the crowd and enter the building.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1402.2.cn: 你和==DATING_CHARACTER==混在学生当中，随着人流进了教学楼。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1402.3.en: "A good school has no walls," you think to yourself.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1402.3.cn: “好的学校，没有围墙。”你这样想着。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1403.1.en: The timing is bad. Everyone's in class, and the doorway is empty. You and ==DATING_CHARACTER== decide to bluff your way in, posing as students.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1403.1.cn: 时候不巧，大家都在上课，教学楼门口空无一人。你和==DATING_CHARACTER==准备装作学生大模大样走进去。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1403.2.en: The guard sizes you both up. Are you really students? Luckily, he doesn't stop you.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1403.2.cn: 门卫仔细地打量着你俩，你们真的是学生吗？还好，他并没有拦住你们。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1403.3.en: ==DATING_CHARACTER== says you still look student-ish enough to pass.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1403.3.cn: ==DATING_CHARACTER==觉得你还是有一股书生气的。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1404.1.en: Somehow, you and ==DATING_CHARACTER== end up sneaking into a classroom.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1404.1.cn: 不知怎的，你和==DATING_CHARACTER==竟混进一间教室听课。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1404.2.en: It's a dense, technical lecture, the kind you can't make sense of at all. The professor's words blur, the writing on the board looks like another language, and your mind starts to wander...
DatingLandmarkEvent.1404.2.cn: 这好像是一门很硬核的专业课，你完全不知道那些概念是什么。黑板上的字迹如同天书一般，教授的声音也似乎渐行渐远，你的世界正在逐渐下沉……

DatingLandmarkEvent.1404.3.en: "Ding..." The bell rings—you wake with a start. Turning head, you find ==DATING_CHARACTER== beside you, stifling a laugh.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1404.3.cn: “叮……”下课了，你也醒了。转头一看，你发现==DATING_CHARACTER==正坐在你身旁偷笑。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1405.1.en: You sneak into a math lecture. The professor drones on, and ==DATING_CHARACTER== looks a bit tense.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1405.1.cn: 你们混进一节数学课里听讲，教授滔滔不绝，==DATING_CHARACTER==有些神色紧张。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1405.2.en: You notice the professor's methods seem outdated. As you mull it over, your eyes meet. The professor calls on you to summarize the lesson. You offer a more general explanation.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1405.2.cn: 你觉得教授说的方法有些古朴，你在沉思中与教授的目光相撞。教授请你总结一下内容，你提出了更一般的推广解释。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1405.3.en: The professor nods approvingly, and ==DATING_CHARACTER== looks at you with admiration.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1405.3.cn: 教授很满意你的推论，==DATING_CHARACTER==投来了崇拜的目光。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1406.1.en: You and ==DATING_CHARACTER== climb the stairs of a tall building, heading straight for the top floor. On a whim, you decide to check out the rooftop.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1406.1.cn: 你和==DATING_CHARACTER==在一栋楼里拾级而上直至顶层。你们突发奇想要去天台上看看。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1406.2.en: You climb through the window, grab ==DATING_CHARACTER=='s hand, and pull her up onto the rooftop. The view stretches wide. Far off, the outline of the Monolith shimmers faintly; below, people scurry between buildings like ants.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1406.2.cn: 你翻过窗户，拽着==DATING_CHARACTER==的手，把她拉上天台。这里视野开阔，远处星塔的轮廓若隐若现，低处蚂蚁般的人们在楼宇间穿梭。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1406.3.en: The sky is a brilliant blue. ==DATING_CHARACTER=='s grip on your hand hurts a little. From up here, everything else feels small.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1406.3.cn: 天空湛蓝，你的手被==DATING_CHARACTER==握疼。天台高耸，周围的一切都显得无足轻重。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1407.1.en: You and ==DATING_CHARACTER== climb to the top floor. The setting sun pours through the rooftop windows, and you decide to climb up.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1407.1.cn: 你和==DATING_CHARACTER==在一栋楼里拾级而上直至顶层。落日的余晖透过天台的窗子照进来，你们决定去天台看看。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1407.2.en: You climb through the window, grab ==DATING_CHARACTER=='s hand, and pull her up onto the rooftop. Daylight fades across the horizon, the glow expands, your shadows stretching long.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1407.2.cn: 你翻过窗户，拽着==DATING_CHARACTER==的手，把她拉上天台。白天一点点消失在天际线下，光在膨胀，你们的影子正被拉长。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1407.3.en: Your breathing melts into the warm twilight air. No words are needed because they feel clumsy in this moment.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1407.3.cn: 你们的呼吸融化在黄昏温热的空气中。你们不需要说话，语言在你们之间已经变得牵强附会。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1408.1.en: You and ==DATING_CHARACTER== are drawn to a display board in the square.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1408.1.cn: 你和==DATING_CHARACTER==被广场上的展板吸引了目光。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1408.2.en: It lists the newest academic achievements and projects.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1408.2.cn: 展板上写着一些最新的学术成就与落地项目。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1408.3.en: You don't really understand it, but you're sure both you and ==DATING_CHARACTER== are a little more "educated" than you were yesterday.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1408.3.cn: 虽然没怎么看懂，但你确信自己和==DATING_CHARACTER==更加「学术」了一点——至少比昨天更「学术」。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1409.1.en: In the plaza stands a small flower arch, and ==DATING_CHARACTER== pulls you over to it.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1409.1.cn: 广场上有一座小花廊，==DATING_CHARACTER==把你拽了过去。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1409.2.en: She's so happy her steps are almost a skip. "Boss, take a picture of me!"==DATING_CHARACTER== calls out as she leans back against the flowers.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1409.2.cn: 她很开心，步伐近乎要跳起来。“魔王，给我拍张照吧！”，==DATING_CHARACTER==背靠花丛，向你发出邀请。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1409.3.en: Sunlight filters through branches, dappling ==DATING_CHARACTER=='s face. The air is thick with the scent of blossoms. Her smile freezes forever in your phone.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1409.3.cn: 午后的阳光透过树杈，斑驳地洒在==DATING_CHARACTER==脸上。空气中充满鲜花气息，她的笑容定格在你的手机里。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1410.1.en: "Excuse me, you two." A student stops you and ==DATING_CHARACTER==. "Would you be interested in joining the debate club?"
DatingLandmarkEvent.1410.1.cn: “两位同学打扰一下。”一位学生拦住了你和==DATING_CHARACTER==，“请问两位有意愿加入辩论社吗？”

DatingLandmarkEvent.1410.2.en: You think you have the eloquence for it. But sadly, you're not a student here. Regretfully, you decline.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1410.2.cn: 你觉得自己具备雄辩的气质与能力，但可惜自己并不是本院学生。你略感遗憾地婉拒了那位同学。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1411.1.en: A sharply dressed young man approaches you. "Good afternoon, I'm with the student council." He hands you both flyers. "We're recruiting. Would you like to learn more?"
DatingLandmarkEvent.1411.1.cn: 一位衣着考究的人向你们走来，“同学好，我是学生会的干事。”他递给你们两张传单，“学生会正在纳新，有兴趣了解一下吗？”

DatingLandmarkEvent.1411.2.en: Endless paperwork and busywork ominously flash through your mind.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1411.2.cn: 值班，还有无尽且无意义的文书工作，一些不妙的想法涌进你的大脑。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1411.3.en: "No thanks," you wave him off, ending the talk.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1411.3.cn: “免了。”你摆摆手，终止了这场交谈。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1412.1.en: You and ==DATING_CHARACTER== spot a group of students gathered on the lawn. Curiosity draws you closer.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1412.1.cn: 你和==DATING_CHARACTER==发现一群学生围坐在草坪上，好奇心驱使你们加入其中。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1412.2.en: It's a small jam session. Some students are strumming instruments to accompany a singer.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1412.2.cn: 原来是一场小型歌会，学生们抱着乐器，为正在歌唱的人伴奏。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1412.3.en: Though the singer and the band seem a bit unpolished, everyone performs with such energy. Maybe that's just the urge to express that comes with youth.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1412.3.cn: 虽然主唱和乐手都显得生疏，但大家仍然兴致高昂地表演，可能这就是独属于青春的表达欲。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1413.1.en: You and ==DATING_CHARACTER== spot a group of students gathered on the lawn. Curiosity draws you closer.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1413.1.cn: 你和==DATING_CHARACTER==发现一群学生围坐在草坪上，好奇心驱使你们加入其中。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1413.2.en: It's a small jam session. The students look at you. "Want to sing something? Anything's fine." One invites you. Caught up in the mood, you decide to sing a few lines.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1413.2.cn: 原来是一场小型歌会，学生们望着你。“来唱一首吗？什么都行。”其中一位向你发出邀请。受到氛围感染，你决定唱上几句。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1413.3.en: Even if your tune is otherworldly, the musicians still manage to uphold its avant-garde spirit. Sitting beside you, ==DATING_CHARACTER== hums softly along with the song.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1413.3.cn: 纵然你的小曲十分超凡脱俗，但乐手们仍凭着自己的理解捍卫了你的先锋性。==DATING_CHARACTER==坐在你身旁，轻轻地伴随歌声哼唱。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1418.1.en: Inside the Academy shop, you find souvenirs for sale. Why not buy something?
DatingLandmarkEvent.1418.1.cn: 你们在学院商店里发现了有纪念品在售，买点什么吧。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1418.2.en: ==DATING_CHARACTER== chooses a fountain pen with the school crest and you settle on a folder with a campus scene.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1418.2.cn: ==DATING_CHARACTER==挑选了一只印有院徽的钢笔，而你买了印有学院景色的文件夹。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1418.3.en: Both of these are practical purchases. You'll think of this afternoon whenever you do paperwork.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1418.3.cn: 你们购买了具有实用价值的玩意儿，以后处理文书工作的时候也会想起今天下午吧。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1419.1.en: Inside the Academy shop, you find souvenirs for sale. Why not buy something?
DatingLandmarkEvent.1419.1.cn: 你们在学院商店里发现了有纪念品在售，买点什么吧。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1419.2.en: ==DATING_CHARACTER== chooses a school crest and you settle on a cap with the same emblem.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1419.2.cn: ==DATING_CHARACTER==挑选了一枚院徽，而你买了一顶印有院徽的帽子。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1419.3.en: After leaving the shop, you exchange them, making the mementos even more meaningful.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1419.3.cn: 离开商店后，你们交换了纪念品，它们更具纪念意义了。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1420.1.en: You choose to take an alley less traveled to reach the academy.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1420.1.cn: 你选了条不常走的小巷前往学院。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1420.2.en:
What kind of scenery will you find around the corner?
"Hey—!" you yell out, without thinking.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1420.2.cn:
小巷的转角后会有什么样的风景呢？
“喂——”你没来由地大喊一声。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1420.3.en: ==DATING_CHARACTER== pokes her head out from around the corner. Could such a coincidence really be happening?
DatingLandmarkEvent.1420.3.cn: ==DATING_CHARACTER==竟从转角后探出头来，竟然有这么巧的事情吗？

DatingLandmarkEvent.1701.1.en: You and ==DATING_CHARACTER== met up at the hot spring town without a hitch. She seemed to be in high spirits. They say soaking in hot springs is good for your health and even has some miraculous benefits. It made you wonder whether ==DATING_CHARACTER== had ever experienced a hot spring before.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1701.1.cn: 你和==DATING_CHARACTER==在温泉度假村中顺利碰面，她看起来兴致盎然。据说泡温泉有益身体健康，甚至还有一些神奇的功效。不知道==DATING_CHARACTER==有没有体验过温泉呢？

DatingLandmarkEvent.1701.2.en: While checking in at the resort, the front desk staff brought you a welcome dessert. The matcha pudding was served in a glass cup: the top layer was a pale green milk custard, while the bottom layer was darker in color and richer in taste, with a mousse-like flavor that was slightly bitter.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1701.2.cn: 在办理度假村手续时，前台工作人员为你们端上了欢迎点心。抹茶布丁被盛在玻璃杯子里，上层是浅绿色的奶冻；下层颜色更深、口感也更为浓郁，尝起来像是略苦的慕斯。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1701.3.en: Once the check-in was done, you received the room key. The wonderful hot spring getaway was finally about to begin.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1701.3.cn: 手续办理结束后，你们拿到了房间钥匙。温泉疗愈的美妙旅程终于要正式开始了。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1702.1.en: While checking in, you could already glimpse a corner of the courtyard through the window. A faint floral scent drifted through the garden, mingling with birdsong. The atmosphere felt strangely familiar, like something you had experienced before—like the air that slowly drifts in from outside the window on a fresh morning when you wake up unexpectedly.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1702.1.cn: 办理手续时，你们透过窗子就能瞧见庭院里的一方景色。庭院中有一股微微的花香，这种混合着鸟鸣的氛围你好像在哪里感受过。像是在某个突然醒来的清晨，从窗外缓缓飘进来的幽静气息一样。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1702.2.en: You strolled through the meticulously designed garden. The entire courtyard had been built along the natural slope, lush and green, with unnamed small white flowers blooming among the stones and moss.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1702.2.cn: 你们漫步在这座精心设计的回游式庭院里。整个院落依着斜坡顺势而建，庭院里一片葱绿，石头与青苔间开出不知名的白色花朵。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1702.3.en: You and ==DATING_CHARACTER== paused by the edge of a pond, where the koi in the water quickly gathered around you. Only then did you notice how large carp could grow, and how many different colors their patterns came in. Their mouths opened and closed as if begging for food, but you had nothing to give, so you could only watch the fish drifting back and forth with a slightly bewildered look.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1702.3.cn: 你和==DATING_CHARACTER==在一个池塘边驻足，水里的锦鲤飞快地朝你们聚集过来。你这才注意到原来鲤鱼可以长这么大，其花色也如此繁多。它们嘴巴一张一阖，似乎在向你们讨食，可惜你们什么也没有，只能目光茫然地追逐这些游弋的鱼儿。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1703.1.en: Just as you were about to step into the garden, a light rain began to fall. With a quiet sigh, you watched the scene outside through the glass. Life is like that: small moments of joy existing side by side with small stings of disappointment. Our moods are always nudged by these little things like drifting clouds, sudden rain, or flowers that would always bloom in spring.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1703.1.cn: 刚想踏入庭院，天空竟下起小雨，你无奈地透过玻璃看着窗外景色。生活就是这样：有微小的欢欣，也会有微小的痛楚。人的情绪总是被这些琐细左右，像云，像骤雨，也像春天注定盛开的花。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1703.2.en: She pressed her face close to the window. A single eye was reflected in the glass. ==DATING_CHARACTER== wiped the glass with her fingertip and tried to cheer you up: "Hey, did you know? Many gardens look their best after the rain." You had indeed heard something like that before—some tea gardens even sprinkle water over the grounds on sunny days, just to recreate that atmosphere for their visitors.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1703.2.cn: 她把脸贴近窗户，玻璃上映出一只眼睛。==DATING_CHARACTER==用指尖揩了揩玻璃，安慰道：“你知道吗？许多园子在雨后才是最美的。”你确实听过这么一个故事——有的茶园会在晴天给院内洒水，以便更好地接待旅客。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1703.3.en: The rain gradually stopped. The two of you stepped into the garden and found that the after-rain landscape truly had a charm of its own. The way the grass and leaves bowed low under the weight of the rainwater was mesmerizing. You looked toward the horizon and saw that the retreating rain clouds were edged with pale gold. A breeze passed through the trees, and the patches of blue sky between the branches opened and narrowed by turns, shaking loose a few lingering raindrops onto you two's shoulders.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1703.3.cn: 雨渐渐停了。你们走入庭院，发现雨后的景色的确别有一番审美情趣。草木因雨水而低低垂下的姿态着实令人心醉。看向天边，已经飘远的雨云染着淡金色的边。一阵风穿过树叶，枝桠间的蓝天时而局促时而广阔，又把雨滴洒向你们的肩膀。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1704.1.en: "Listen—" ==DATING_CHARACTER== stopped you. "Sounds like some kind of unusual insect." You listened carefully. Faint noise you hadn't noticed before came into focus: a soft chirping coming from a clump of grass. But when you tried to pinpoint the source, it disappeared again into the sea of green.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1704.1.cn: “你听——”==DATING_CHARACTER==叫住了你，“好像有什么特别的小虫在叫。”被她一问，你认真地听起来。一些不曾被注意的细小响动被你捕捉，似乎在某团草里传来了轻轻的虫鸣。可当你想确定它的位置时，却又被淹没在一片绿意里了。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1704.2.en: You listened so hard you were almost starting to sweat, yet the faint sound kept drifting. "Over here..." she said, taking your hand and leading you to a corner. She crouched down and deftly caught the little insect, and its chirping suddenly grew more frantic. The two of you leaned in to take a look, your foreheads nearly touching.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1704.2.cn: 你听得都有些沁汗了，那隐约的声响依然忽近忽远。“在这里……”她拉起你的手，把你引向一处角落。她俯下身子，灵巧地捉住小虫，那虫声也变得急躁起来。你们凑近了去瞧，额头几乎贴在一起。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1704.3.en: The little insect struggled hard, its golden wings fluttering rapidly. As soon as ==DATING_CHARACTER== let go, it darted away. The chirping grew faint again, dissolving into the garden's other small, scattered sounds.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1704.3.cn: 小虫奋力地挣扎，金色的翅膀不断扇动着。==DATING_CHARACTER==手指一松，它飞似的逃走了。那虫鸣又变得飘渺起来，淹没在庭院其他琐碎的声音之中。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1705.1.en: "Look—" ==DATING_CHARACTER== called out to you, then tossed a handful of petals straight at your face. ==DATING_CHARACTER== stepped back a few paces and began to laugh softly. The sudden shower of petals caught you completely off guard, and one of the drifting petals even landed in your mouth.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1705.1.cn: “你看——”==DATING_CHARACTER==叫住了你，她伸出手，将握在手里的花瓣撒了你一脸。==DATING_CHARACTER==后退了几步，轻轻地笑了起来。扑面而来的花瓣令你有些不知所措，纷飞的花瓣竟有一片落进了你的嘴里。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1705.2.en: Feeling that spitting it out would be undignified, you swallowed it instead. Unfortunately, the petal got stuck in your throat, and no matter how many times you swallowed or tried to work it loose with your tongue, it would not come down. ==DATING_CHARACTER== fed you a few sips of water and gently patted your back until the sensation of the petal finally disappeared.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1705.2.cn: 你觉得吐出来似乎有失风度，便把它咽了下去。不料那片花瓣却卡在了嗓子眼，即使反复吞咽，或者用舌头也不能把它扣下来。==DATING_CHARACTER==喂了你几口水，她轻轻替你顺气，直到你感觉不到那片花瓣的存在。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1705.3.en: After that little prank, the two of you kept wandering through the garden. Whenever you thought about that episode, you would unconsciously try to feel the back of your tongue. Did petals have a taste? If they did, why hadn't you noticed it? You started to scratch your cheek even though there was no itch.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1705.3.cn: 小小恶作剧之后，你们继续在庭院里游荡。当你想起这件事时，又会不自觉地用舌尖舔舔喉咙，花瓣会有味道么？如果有，那你怎么没尝出来呢？你明明不觉得痒，却挠起了自己的脸颊。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1706.1.en: The daylight gradually faded and dusk spread beneath the slanting sun. You stood beneath a camellia tree together while the sunset clouds flickered between its branches. You noticed that the camellia blossoms here fell petal by petal; some dropped beneath the tree, while others drifted onto the pond, glowing in the evening light.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1706.1.cn: 日色逐渐暗淡，黄昏从庭院中的斜阳下弥漫开来。你们站在一棵山茶花树下，树梢间飘忽着晚霞。你注意到这里的山茶花居然是一瓣一瓣凋落的，它们有的落在树下，有的则飘到夕色的池塘里。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1706.2.en: In the cool dusk, birds occasionally flew past. A few stars began to glimmer behind the trees.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1706.2.cn: 微凉暮色里，天空中偶有飞鸟划过。几颗星星在树丛后微微地闪烁起来。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1706.3.en: The small lamps along the garden path lit up one by one. They were set in just the right places to cast the garden in a different mood.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1706.3.cn: 庭院里路旁的小灯亮了起来。它们摆放在特定的位置，以便给这座庭院染上另一种气氛。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1707.1.en: It was getting late, and the garden in the evening light began to feel almost dreamlike. Puddles reflected the fading glow, their surfaces stirring slightly in the rose-tinted breeze. At this hour, green was no longer the garden's main color, only the last trace of the day.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1707.1.cn: 时间不早了，庭院在夕照下变得如梦似幻起来。庭院里积水的地方反射出光亮，蔷薇色的晚风使其微微泛起涟漪。在这个时刻，葱绿不再是庭院的主题色，而是白日气息中最后一抹残留。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1707.2.en: You and ==DATING_CHARACTER== sat side by side on a bench. In the soft dusk of the garden, everything seemed to grow quiet. She looked as though she wanted to say something, paused for a moment, but no word came.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1707.2.cn: 你和==DATING_CHARACTER==并肩坐在长椅上。在这座暮色温柔的院落里，一切都好像安静下来，她似乎想说些什么，停了半晌，却又是一片沉默。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1707.3.en: In the dusk, she turned to look your way, her drifting gaze hard to read. Was she looking at you, or at the garden behind you?
DatingLandmarkEvent.1707.3.cn: 黄昏中，她转头朝向你，那飘忽的视线真叫人捉摸不透。是在看你呢，还是在看你背后的庭院呢？

DatingLandmarkEvent.1708.1.en: Beside the resort's main gate stood a small building venting white steam. Upon closer inspection, you saw that it was a hot spring tower, used to cool the too-high-temperature spring water and distribute it by gravity to the different baths.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1708.1.cn: 度假村大门旁有座冒着白汽的小楼。你们走近了看，是一座温泉塔，能令高温的泉水降温，并利用重力把温泉分配到不同浴场。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1708.2.en: The sign for the hot spring tower was half hidden in the mist formed by the steam. It said the tower erupted once every two hours during the day. "Is this the famous geyser?" you asked.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1708.2.cn: 温泉塔的告示牌半隐在水汽形成的薄雾里，上面写着白天每隔两小时喷发一次。“这就是传说中的间歇泉吗？”你不禁问道。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1708.3.en: "No." ==DATING_CHARACTER== glanced at the resort brochure in her hand. "It says maintenance is every Tuesday, so it won't erupt." What a pity. So it still needed human maintenance. Not entirely natural, after all.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1708.3.cn: “不是。”==DATING_CHARACTER==拿着度假村宣传单回答，“这上面说每周二进行维护，不会喷发。”可惜了，也就是说它仍然需要人工的干预，并非完全纯天然的温泉。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1709.1.en: You came to the yukata area, where the robes were sorted by size and neatly stacked on the counter. Their colors were brighter than ordinary clothing, decorated with intricate patterns that showed careful craftsmanship.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1709.1.cn: 你们来到挑选浴衣的地方，它们被按照尺码分类，整齐的叠放于柜台上。浴衣的用色往往比寻常衣服更鲜艳，其上装点着繁复的花纹，看起来都凝聚着匠心。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1709.2.en:
She picked out a yukata she liked and went to try it on. But when she came out of the changing room, she didn't look very pleased.

"The sash doesn't seem to match the color of the yukata... What do you think?"

"Maybe a darker one would look better?"

"Then I'll try this one!"
DatingLandmarkEvent.1709.2.cn:
她挑选了喜欢的浴衣，先行去试衣服了，但等她从更衣室出来，脸上并没有那种开心的表情。
“浴衣带和浴衣的颜色好像不太协调……你觉得呢？”
“也许配个更深的颜色会更好？”
“那我换这个试试！”

DatingLandmarkEvent.1709.3.en:
Before long, ==DATING_CHARACTER== came out in a different yukata. "How does it look? Does it suit me?" she asked.
"Yeah! It's like you've unlocked a new look!"

"That's all you've got to say? I guess that's just like you, Boss..." she smiled. "One tip for a successful date with a girl is to compliment what she's wearing."

"What are the others?"

"Another one is to take her somewhere with good food. So let's go~"
DatingLandmarkEvent.1709.3.cn:
不一会，==DATING_CHARACTER==又换上新一套浴衣从更衣室里出来了。“怎么样，合身吗？”她问你。
“嗯！就像解锁了新形象一样！”
“就只有这点评价嘛，果然还是你啊。”她笑起来，“和女孩顺利约会的方法里，其中一条就是夸奖她穿的衣服哦？”
“还有哪几条？”
“还有尽量带她吃好吃的，我们现在就出发吧~”

DatingLandmarkEvent.1710.1.en: The resort restaurant was tastefully decorated, and the flower arrangements in the display case were said to be the handiwork of a renowned horticultural master. You took a table by the window, overlooking the carefully designed garden outside. Petals drifted in the afternoon breeze, a few even landed on your table.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1710.1.cn: 度假村餐厅的装潢十分考究，橱窗里还有插花，据说出自某位园艺大师。你们找了张靠窗的桌子坐下，窗外就能望见同样设计考究的庭院，有花瓣在午后的微风中柔软地翻飞，甚至飘到了你们的桌子上。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1710.2.en: First came a bowl of steamed egg custard, with what seemed to be sea urchin mixed in. When you dug down to the bottom with a small spoon, you were surprised to find a layer of orange jelly beneath it, cool and lightly sweet-sour. Then came grilled meat with grated radish, followed by a simmered seafood soup, though you had no idea what kind of fish it contained.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1710.2.cn: 先是一份蛋羹，里面似乎还加了一些海胆。当用小勺挖到底部时，你们惊奇地发现蛋羹底部还有一层橘子果冻，微凉的酸甜感十分爽口。而后是烤肉配萝卜泥，还有炖煮的海鲜汤，虽然你并不清楚碗里躺着的究竟是什么鱼。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1710.3.en: In the dessert, you noticed a strange sight: a few simmered broad beans. Two black sesame seeds had been placed on them, making them look like simply-drawn little frogs. If the season were right, you might even be able to hear real frogs calling from the garden.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1710.3.cn: 在收尾的甜品中，你发现了几粒不太寻常的煮蚕豆。它们被点上了两粒黑芝麻，看上去像是简笔画里的青蛙。如果时节合适，兴许真得能够听见庭院里的蛙鸣吧。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1711.1.en: As you talked, you found yourselves at the refreshment bar. There were all kinds of drinks you couldn't quite name, and in the fridge were fruits and chilled jelly desserts. Most importantly, you spotted ice cream in the freezer, each one stamped with the United Harvest logo. You realized United Harvest even had a line of frozen treats, though you had no idea what they might taste like.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1711.1.cn: 说着说着，你们走到了水吧。柜台中有许多你说不上名字的饮料，冷柜里有些水果与凉粉。最重要的是，你在冰箱里找到了冰淇淋，它们还印着联合种业的商标。你第一次知道种业公司居然还有这么一条冻品产线，就是不知道味道如何。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1711.2.en: Just as you were thinking that, ==DATING_CHARACTER== suddenly leaned close and whispered in your ear, "Want the adult experience?" You jumped. Did she mean doing taxes or something? ==DATING_CHARACTER== held up a bottle of malt special she had just fished out of the ice bucket. "Want some?" she asked.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1711.2.cn: 你正想着，==DATING_CHARACTER==突然凑到你耳边低声说：“要不要体验一下当大人的感觉？”你吓得一哆嗦。难道是报税之类的？==DATING_CHARACTER==捧着一瓶从冰桶里捞出来的麦芽特饮，“要不要来一点？”

DatingLandmarkEvent.1711.3.en: You decided against it in the end. Instead, the two of you each grabbed a chilled soda. You took a big gulp, and the icy bubbles burst in your throat like fireworks. Cool and refreshing, the fizzy happiness seemed to linger in the air around you.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1711.3.cn: 还是算了吧。你们最终各自挑了一瓶冰镇汽水。你猛灌一口，冰冷的气泡如烟花一样在喉咙里绽开。凉凉的，好舒服，汽水泡沫般的幸福感也随之渗入你四周的空气里。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1712.1.en: Before you knew it, you had wandered over to the foot bath hot spring. Beneath a small wooden pavilion, there was a long marble-lined pool. It seemed like a good chance to try it—after all, one didn't have to worry about drowning in a shallow pool like this.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1712.1.cn: 不知不觉间，你们走到足汤温泉处，木制的小亭子下有用大理石砌成的长条形温泉池。趁此机会试一下吧，毕竟在这种浅浅的小池子里应该不存在溺水的风险。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1712.2.en:
You and ==DATING_CHARACTER== took off your shoes and socks and slipped your feet into the hot water. It felt wonderful, especially after walking for so long. As your body relaxed, drowsiness crept in. Your spine seemed unable to hold your weight any longer, and you slowly slumped back.

In a hazy moment, you saw a stretch of white snow. It covered the rooftops of the resort. Would there even be snow in this season? You didn't know; and right now, you didn't want to know. Until...
DatingLandmarkEvent.1712.2.cn:
你和==DATING_CHARACTER==脱去了鞋袜，将脚伸入热水里。好舒服，毕竟已经走了这么久。随着你放松神经，困意也涌了上来。你的脊椎似乎再也撑不住身体的重量，渐渐瘫软下去。
恍然间，你看到了一片茫茫白雪。它们覆盖在度假村的屋顶上，这个季节会有雪吗？你不知道，你现在也不想知道。直至……

DatingLandmarkEvent.1712.3.en:
Something caught you before you accidently slip into the hot spring pool. ==DATING_CHARACTER== gently shook you awake.
You blinked sleepily as the snowy scene dissolved into the rising steam. You realized it must have been a dream. Still, it didn't feel like such a distant one, and you found yourself looking forward to a future trip to a snowy hot spring with ==DATING_CHARACTER==.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1712.3.cn:
有什么东西扶住了你，避免你滑进温泉池。==DATING_CHARACTER==把你轻轻地晃醒；
你睡眼惺忪，雪景在腾腾热气中化开。你意识到那或许是一个梦，不过，这并不是一个遥不可及的梦，你开始期待未来和==DATING_CHARACTER==的雪中温泉之旅。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1713.1.en: It was getting late, time to head back and check out your rooms. As it happened, you and ==DATING_CHARACTER== were staying next door to each other. The guestrooms had a classic style, with calligraphy and paintings on the walls that you couldn't quite make sense of. There was a hot spring bath built onto the balcony, overlooking the garden. You pressed down on the mattress again—so soft! This resort felt like a home away from home.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1713.1.cn: 天色不早了，还是先回各自房间看看吧，正巧你和==DATING_CHARACTER==就住在隔壁。这的客房装修古典，墙上挂着你看不懂的字画。阳台上也修建了温泉池，泡温泉时可以望见庭院的景色。你又按了按床垫，好软！这个度假村简直是你素未谋面的故乡。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1713.2.en:
While you were standing on the balcony, enjoying the slightly cool breeze, ==DATING_CHARACTER=='s voice suddenly came from next door. "Is this a window on the bamboo panel? I can't get it to open."

"Try pushing a little harder," you called back.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1713.2.cn:
你站在阳台上感受着略带凉意的微风时，隔壁突然传来==DATING_CHARACTER==的声音，“这竹板上是小窗吗？我怎么打不开？”
“你用点劲试试。”你朝着隔壁喊道。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1713.3.en:
With a loud crack, the bamboo divider between the balconies split open into a person-sized gap. "So it wasn't a window after all..." ==DATING_CHARACTER== poked her head through awkwardly. "Huh? Why does your balcony look bigger than mine? And the view's better, too."
She stepped right over. "Can I stay here tonight?"

You found yourself distracted by the change of subject, though really, shouldn't you deal with the broken panel first?
DatingLandmarkEvent.1713.3.cn:
砰的一声，阳台之间的隔断竹板裂开了一人高的口子。“原来这不是什么窗子……”==DATING_CHARACTER==尴尬地把头探进来，“欸？我怎么觉得你的阳台比我的大一些，景色也更好一些。”
她直接跨了进来，“我晚上可以呆在这吗？”
你被转移话题了，但现在不应该优先处理断开的竹板吗？

DatingLandmarkEvent.1720.1.en: The evening's activities had ended, and it was time to turn in. These nights can be beautiful in a way that also feels a little melancholy. With insects chirping all around, the two of you walked slowly back toward the guestrooms.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1720.1.cn: 活动散场，也到了该就寝的时间。旅程里的夜晚越是美丽，越会让人感到伤感。虫鸣阵阵，你们缓缓走在回客房的路上。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1720.2.en:
She grabs your arm. "Hold still—let me spray some repellent." She gives you a few quick sprays, and the cool scent instantly pulls you back to a summer from your childhood. Something stirs in your dry, brittle memories… 

You try to follow that feeling upstream, but everything around you dissolves into static, like drifting snow. Then—at the end of that fading thread—you feel someone's fingers.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1720.2.cn:
她拽住了你，“来喷点驱蚊水。”她上上下下给你喷了几揿，你嗅到驱蚊水那清凉香气的瞬间，仿佛被拽回了年幼时的那个夏天。你枯枝般的记忆似乎想起了什么。
你想顺着那股思绪逆流而上，但周遭充斥着雪花噪点般的虚无，直到你顺着思绪摸到了谁的手指。

DatingLandmarkEvent.1720.3.en:
"How come you spaced out?" ==DATING_CHARACTER== asked as she held your hand.

She watched the small shifts in your expression, trying to read the feeling hidden in the shadow on your face, but eventually gave up. "Don't want to leave yet? Let's come back here again sometime, okay?" You gladly agreed. After a full day of wandering, you were both tired—it was time to get some rest.
DatingLandmarkEvent.1720.3.cn:
“你怎么呆住了？”==DATING_CHARACTER==握着你的手问道。
她观察着你表情的微小起伏，试图揣度着你脸上阴影里藏着的神秘情绪，但最终她放弃了。“有点不舍？下次我们还来这里玩，好吗？”你欣然同意，一天的游玩使你们劳累，快去休息一晚吧。

DatingLandmarkEvent.501.1.en: The entrance of the cave is covered in moss. It looks like nobody has visited here for a long time.
DatingLandmarkEvent.501.1.cn: 洞窟的入口布满了青苔，看起来很久无人到访了。

DatingLandmarkEvent.501.2.en: "What are we going to find today?" The two of you continue to explore while chatting along the way.
DatingLandmarkEvent.501.2.cn: “今天会发现些什么呢？” 一边聊着，一边继续探险。

DatingLandmarkEvent.502.1.en: You discover an ancient statue wedged in a crack in the stone wall. It seems like someone deliberately hid it here.
DatingLandmarkEvent.502.1.cn: 你们在石壁的缝隙中发现了一座古老的雕像。好像是什么人故意藏在这里的。

DatingLandmarkEvent.502.2.en: ==DATING_CHARACTER== thinks the stone statue's face looks a bit like yours.
DatingLandmarkEvent.502.2.cn: ==DATING_CHARACTER==认为这座石像的脸和你有点像。

DatingLandmarkEvent.503.1.en: A bottomless chasm cuts off your path. A smooth, natural ice bridge spans across the gap.
DatingLandmarkEvent.503.1.cn: 深不见底的地裂截断了去路。一座光滑的天然冰桥横跨地裂。

DatingLandmarkEvent.503.2.en: Hand in hand, you and ==DATING_CHARACTER== make it safely across the bridge.
