DatingLandmarkEvent.503.2.cn: 你和==DATING_CHARACTER==手牵着手，安全地通过了这座桥。

DatingLandmarkEvent.504.1.en: Deep in the cave, a mysterious glow flickers. It's coming from flowers that hang from the stone walls like lanterns.
DatingLandmarkEvent.504.1.cn: 洞穴的深处闪烁着奇妙的光芒。那是，如灯笼般从石壁上悬垂下的花朵。

DatingLandmarkEvent.504.2.en: ==DATING_CHARACTER== gets on your shoulder and carefully reaches up to pluck a flower.
DatingLandmarkEvent.504.2.cn: 你和==DATING_CHARACTER==搭成人梯，小心地摘下了一朵。

DatingLandmarkEvent.505.1.en: An underground river quietly flows across the path. In the darkness of the cave, you can't make out the width of the river.
DatingLandmarkEvent.505.1.cn: 一条横穿道路的地下河静静流淌。在黑暗的洞窟中，你们看不到河的宽度。

DatingLandmarkEvent.505.2.en: You discover eyeless fish in the river.
DatingLandmarkEvent.505.2.cn: 在河水中，你们发现了没有眼睛的鱼。

DatingLandmarkEvent.506.1.en: You discover a spacious stone chamber. Faint murals can be seen on the walls, suggesting it was once a place for some sort of ritual long ago.
DatingLandmarkEvent.506.1.cn: 你们发现了一间空旷的石室。墙上能看到模糊的壁画，似乎是很久以前举行某种仪式的地方。

DatingLandmarkEvent.506.2.en: ==DATING_CHARACTER== lights a campfire, and the two of you rest together against each other's shoulder for a while.
DatingLandmarkEvent.506.2.cn: ==DATING_CHARACTER==升起篝火，你们依偎着休息了一会。

DatingLandmarkEvent.507.1.en: You find a high ground that is dry, lay out a blanket, and decide to take a good rest.
DatingLandmarkEvent.507.1.cn: 你们找到了一处干燥的台地，铺好毯子，决定好好休息一下。

DatingLandmarkEvent.507.2.en: The two of you are tired and quickly fall asleep.
DatingLandmarkEvent.507.2.cn: 很快，疲惫的你们就进入梦乡。

DatingLandmarkEvent.507.3.en: When you open your eyes, you're met with ==DATING_CHARACTER=='s adorable sleeping face.
DatingLandmarkEvent.507.3.cn: 再度睁开眼睛的时候，你的面前是==DATING_CHARACTER==可爱的睡脸。

DatingLandmarkEvent.508.1.en: The air grows hotter. The constant stream of sweat drains what little energy you have left.
DatingLandmarkEvent.508.1.cn: 空气越来越热，不断涌出的汗水消耗着本就不多的体力。

DatingLandmarkEvent.508.2.en: The heat is coming from a secret hot spring.
DatingLandmarkEvent.508.2.cn: 热源是一处隐秘的温泉。

DatingLandmarkEvent.508.3.en:
You decide to kick off your shoes and soak your legs in the water.

The moment your legs sink into the warm water, all your fatigue vanishes.
DatingLandmarkEvent.508.3.cn:
你们决定就地脱鞋，伸腿泡一泡。
浸入热水的一刻，感觉疲惫瞬间飞走了。

DatingLandmarkEvent.509.1.en: In the depth of the cave, there are gigantic black boulders everywhere. They are covered in thick, sturdy vines.
DatingLandmarkEvent.509.1.cn: 黑色的巨岩遍布洞窟深处，上面布满了结实的藤蔓。

DatingLandmarkEvent.509.2.en: Supporting each other, you climb the vines and make it to the top of the giant rock.
DatingLandmarkEvent.509.2.cn: 你们相互扶持着，借着藤蔓爬上了巨岩顶端。

DatingLandmarkEvent.509.3.en: There, stuck into the rock, is a rusted, broken sword.
DatingLandmarkEvent.509.3.cn: 那里，插着一把锈迹斑斑的，断掉的剑。

DatingLandmarkEvent.510.1.en: You step into a cave. Its arched ceiling is studded with sparkling gemstones. From their arrangement, it looks like they're meant to mimic the constellations in the sky.
DatingLandmarkEvent.510.1.cn: 你们走进了一座拱形的洞窟。洞窟的顶端镶嵌着闪亮的宝石，从排列上推断，应是在模仿天上的星座。

DatingLandmarkEvent.510.2.en: The thing is... You have never seen these constellations before.
DatingLandmarkEvent.510.2.cn: 只是......那些星座你们从未见过。

DatingLandmarkEvent.511.1.en: Gleaming specks on the rock wall catch your attention. You and ==DATING_CHARACTER== move closer.
DatingLandmarkEvent.511.1.cn: 岩壁上有一些亮晶晶的东西，你和==DATING_CHARACTER==凑了过去。

DatingLandmarkEvent.511.2.en: They're veins of ore, glowing faintly. But without proper tools, you can't pry them out.
DatingLandmarkEvent.511.2.cn: 是一条条矿脉，它们散发着金属的辉光。但可惜没有合适工具把它们抠出来。

DatingLandmarkEvent.512.1.en: Gleaming specks on the rock wall catch your attention. You and ==DATING_CHARACTER== move closer.
DatingLandmarkEvent.512.1.cn: 岩壁上有一些亮晶晶的东西，你和==DATING_CHARACTER==凑了过去。

DatingLandmarkEvent.512.2.en: They're glowing lichens. You can pluck a few and tuck them into your hair as ornaments.
DatingLandmarkEvent.512.2.cn: 是一片发着荧光的地衣，可以采下来几片别在头上。

DatingLandmarkEvent.513.1.en: ==DATING_CHARACTER== squeezes through a narrow crack in the rock, with you right behind her.
DatingLandmarkEvent.513.1.cn: ==DATING_CHARACTER==和你一前一后穿过一条岩壁间的缝隙。

DatingLandmarkEvent.513.2.en: It really is tight! "Push me!" ==DATING_CHARACTER== calls out. You awkwardly give her a shove.
DatingLandmarkEvent.513.2.cn: 真的好窄！“推我一下！”==DATING_CHARACTER==叫道，你以别扭地姿势推了一把。

DatingLandmarkEvent.513.3.en: Once ==DATING_CHARACTER== squeezes through, she pulls you out too.
DatingLandmarkEvent.513.3.cn: ==DATING_CHARACTER==挤出缝隙后，又把你拽了出来。

DatingLandmarkEvent.514.1.en: You take a rest in a small cliff crevice that's just big enough for the two of you.
DatingLandmarkEvent.514.1.cn: 你们坐在只容两人的峭壁缝隙中休息。

DatingLandmarkEvent.514.2.en: In order to relax better, you and ==DATING_CHARACTER== decide to take turns resting your head in each other's lap.
DatingLandmarkEvent.514.2.cn: 为了能更好地舒缓身体。你和==DATING_CHARACTER==决定轮换着枕在对方的腿上。

DatingLandmarkEvent.514.3.en: It actually feels quite nice to have somebody's head in your lap.
DatingLandmarkEvent.514.3.cn: 原来，给别人膝枕也挺舒服的。

DatingLandmarkEvent.520.1.en: Gradually, you feel a draft of cool air coming from the depth.
DatingLandmarkEvent.520.1.cn: 逐渐地，你们感受到一股来自深处的微风。

DatingLandmarkEvent.520.2.en: Following it, you find a faintly glowing exit.
DatingLandmarkEvent.520.2.cn: 顺着风向找过去，是一个泛着微光的出口。

DatingLandmarkEvent.520.3.en: You emerge from the cave through another opening. The adventure has come to its conclusion.
DatingLandmarkEvent.520.3.cn: 你们从洞窟的另一个洞口冒了出来。探窟冒险就此结束。

DatingLandmarkEvent.521.1.en: After wandering in circles, you realize you've returned to the very first chamber.
DatingLandmarkEvent.521.1.cn: 经过一阵探索，你们惊奇地发现又回到了最初的洞穴。

DatingLandmarkEvent.521.2.en: So you end up leaving the cave from the entrance.
DatingLandmarkEvent.521.2.cn: 于是你们直接从入口处出来了。

DatingLandmarkEvent.601.1.en:
You gently push the door open, and the familiar chime of wind bells rings in your ears.

Today, though, the dessert shop feels a little different from usual.
DatingLandmarkEvent.601.1.cn:
轻轻推开门，耳边响起熟悉的的风铃声。
今天的甜品店，似乎和往日有一些不同。

DatingLandmarkEvent.601.2.en: Like always, ==DATING_CHARACTER== is sitting by the window and waiting for you.
DatingLandmarkEvent.601.2.cn: ==DATING_CHARACTER==依旧坐在窗边的位置，等待着你的到来。

DatingLandmarkEvent.601.3.en: She sees you and waves at you, smiling.
DatingLandmarkEvent.601.3.cn: 留意到你的身影，她微笑着朝你挥了挥手。

DatingLandmarkEvent.602.1.en:
You gently push the door open, and the familiar chime of wind bells rings in your ears.

Today, though, the dessert shop feels a little different from usual.
DatingLandmarkEvent.602.1.cn:
轻轻推开门，耳边响起熟悉的的风铃声。
今天的甜品店，似乎和往日有一些不同。

DatingLandmarkEvent.602.3.en: She spots you and immediately walks over with a light, eager step. She looks very excited.
DatingLandmarkEvent.602.3.cn: 发现了你的她，立刻迈着轻快的步子走了过来，看上去十分期待。

DatingLandmarkEvent.603.1.en: The brownie you ordered arrives at the table, rich with cocoa aroma.
DatingLandmarkEvent.603.1.cn: 刚刚点单的布朗尼蛋糕被端上小桌，好浓郁的可可味。

DatingLandmarkEvent.603.3.en: It's both bitter and sweet. Is this the taste of the South?
DatingLandmarkEvent.603.3.cn: 苦涩，甜蜜，这就是来自南方的甜点吗？

DatingLandmarkEvent.604.1.en: The Opéra cake arrives. You count the layers one by one. There are seven.
DatingLandmarkEvent.604.1.cn: 刚刚点单的歌剧院蛋糕被端上小桌。你数了数，足足分了七层。

DatingLandmarkEvent.604.3.en: This cake is both delicate and airy, very much refined.
DatingLandmarkEvent.604.3.cn: 细腻，轻盈，好上流的糕点。

DatingLandmarkEvent.605.1.en: You realize that ==DATING_CHARACTER== is looking at you curiously. She's wondering what's on your mind.
DatingLandmarkEvent.605.1.cn: 你发现==DATING_CHARACTER==向你投来探询的目光，她好奇你在想些什么。

DatingLandmarkEvent.605.2.en:
"It's a secret," you say with a teasing smile, shaking your head.

This only makes ==DATING_CHARACTER== even more curious, and she offers to trade one of her secrets for yours.
DatingLandmarkEvent.605.2.cn:
“这是一个秘密。”你故作高深地摇了摇头。
这引起了==DATING_CHARACTER==的兴趣，她愿意用自己的一个秘密和你交换。

DatingLandmarkEvent.605.3.en:
It turns out that while she was waiting for you, she was also reminiscing about the same memory.

Which is why she specifically ordered the cake she had during your first meeting.
DatingLandmarkEvent.605.3.cn:
原来她在等你的时候，也回想起了同样的事情。
因此，她特意点了第一次来甜品屋时吃的蛋糕。

DatingLandmarkEvent.606.1.en: You realize that ==DATING_CHARACTER== is looking at you curiously. She's wondering what's on your mind.
DatingLandmarkEvent.606.1.cn: 你发现==DATING_CHARACTER==向你投来探询的目光，她好奇你在想些什么。

DatingLandmarkEvent.606.2.en:
You shake your head teasingly and point to her face.

Only then does ==DATING_CHARACTER== realize that a bit of dessert is stuck at the corner of her mouth.
DatingLandmarkEvent.606.2.cn:
你故作高深地摇了摇头，指了指她的脸。
==DATING_CHARACTER==这才意识到，原来她嘴边不小心沾上了一块甜品。

DatingLandmarkEvent.606.3.en: You hand her a napkin with a smile. She takes it, looking a little shy.
DatingLandmarkEvent.606.3.cn: 你笑着递给她纸巾，她有些害羞的接下了。

DatingLandmarkEvent.607.1.en: A little girl from the next table runs past you two. She stumbles and almost falls.
DatingLandmarkEvent.607.1.cn: 隔壁桌的小朋友踉踉跄跄地从你们身边跑过，身子一歪，几乎要摔倒。

DatingLandmarkEvent.607.2.en: ==DATING_CHARACTER== quickly crouches down to catch the child but brings the tablecloth down in the process... Unfortunately, the drink ends up splashing all over ==DATING_CHARACTER=='s back.
DatingLandmarkEvent.607.2.cn: ==DATING_CHARACTER==连忙蹲下扶住了她，却不小心扯到了桌布…… 泼洒的甜点不幸地沾到了==DATING_CHARACTER==的后背上。

DatingLandmarkEvent.607.3.en: You quickly grab a towel and some cleaner, helping ==DATING_CHARACTER== by carefully wiping down her clothes. She looks a little embarrassed but thanks you sincerely.
DatingLandmarkEvent.607.3.cn: 你立刻找来了毛巾和清洁剂，并帮==DATING_CHARACTER==仔细擦拭了衣服。她有些不好意思，并向你表示感谢。

DatingLandmarkEvent.608.1.en: A little girl from the next table runs past you two. She stumbles and almost falls.
DatingLandmarkEvent.608.1.cn: 隔壁桌的小朋友踉踉跄跄地从你们身边跑过，身子一歪，几乎要摔倒。

DatingLandmarkEvent.608.2.en:
You react quickly, stepping in to prevent an accident.

==DATING_CHARACTER== gives you an approving look.
DatingLandmarkEvent.608.2.cn:
你眼疾手快地拉了一把，避免了一场事故。
==DATING_CHARACTER==向你投来了赞许的目光。

DatingLandmarkEvent.608.3.en:
The parents rush over and apologize to you both.

It was a close call, but there's no harm done. Both of you breathe a sigh of relief.
DatingLandmarkEvent.608.3.cn:
小朋友的家长赶到，并向你们道歉。
真是有惊无险，你们长舒了一口气。

DatingLandmarkEvent.609.1.en: The waitress brings two mugs of hot chocolate topped with a swirl of cream.
DatingLandmarkEvent.609.1.cn: 服务员端上两杯热巧克力，顶上还有一抹奶油。

DatingLandmarkEvent.609.2.en: It's smooth, silky, not too sweet. You could easily order another.
DatingLandmarkEvent.609.2.cn: 口感丝滑，也没有过分甜腻。还想再来一杯。

DatingLandmarkEvent.610.1.en: The waitress brings two glasses of iced tea with bits of fruit floating inside.
DatingLandmarkEvent.610.1.cn: 服务员端上两杯冰茶，还有一些果粒漂浮其中。

DatingLandmarkEvent.610.2.en: Floral and fruity notes bloom on your tongue.
DatingLandmarkEvent.610.2.cn: 花香，还有水果的芬芳在舌尖绽放。

DatingLandmarkEvent.611.1.cn: “我可以尝尝你那一杯吗？”==DATING_CHARACTER==突然问道。

DatingLandmarkEvent.611.2.en: ==DATING_CHARACTER== leans over and takes a sip through the straw.

DatingLandmarkEvent.612.1.en: Gentle music flows through the sweet-scented air.
DatingLandmarkEvent.612.1.cn: 舒缓悠扬的音乐在充满香甜的空间里缓缓流动。

DatingLandmarkEvent.612.2.en: As you chat, your spoons occasionally tap against the side of the cup, creating a crisp, melodic sound.
DatingLandmarkEvent.612.2.cn: 聊天之间，手中的勺子偶尔碰撞在杯壁上，发出清脆的声响。

DatingLandmarkEvent.613.1.en: The tension eases and ==DATING_CHARACTER== starts to relax a little.
DatingLandmarkEvent.613.1.cn: 气氛逐渐缓和，==DATING_CHARACTER==不像一开始那样紧绷了。

DatingLandmarkEvent.613.2.en: ==DATING_CHARACTER== tells you that she's ran into some trouble recently. You listen patiently as ==DATING_CHARACTER== shares her story in detail.
DatingLandmarkEvent.613.2.cn: ==DATING_CHARACTER==告诉你，她最近遇到了一点麻烦。 你耐心地听着==DATING_CHARACTER==娓娓道来。

DatingLandmarkEvent.613.3.en: After getting the full story, you give her your thoughts on the matter. ==DATING_CHARACTER== looks thoughtful.
DatingLandmarkEvent.613.3.cn: 了解了事情的原委后，你给出了自己的意见，==DATING_CHARACTER==若有所思。

DatingLandmarkEvent.614.1.en: The tension eases and ==DATING_CHARACTER== starts to relax a little.
DatingLandmarkEvent.614.1.cn: 气氛逐渐缓和，==DATING_CHARACTER==不像一开始那样紧绷了。

DatingLandmarkEvent.614.2.en: ==DATING_CHARACTER== tells you that she's ran into some trouble recently. You listen patiently as ==DATING_CHARACTER== shares her story in detail.
DatingLandmarkEvent.614.2.cn: ==DATING_CHARACTER==告诉你，她最近遇到了一点麻烦。 你耐心地听着==DATING_CHARACTER==娓娓道来。

DatingLandmarkEvent.614.3.en:
Halfway into her story, you suggest getting some food first. "You won't work that out on an empty stomach."

==DATING_CHARACTER== grins with relief.
DatingLandmarkEvent.614.3.cn:
听着听着，你提议，不如现在先多吃点，才有力气面对困难。
==DATING_CHARACTER==有些释然的笑了。

DatingLandmarkEvent.619.1.en: As a thank-you for your hospitality today, ==DATING_CHARACTER== says next time it will be her treat.
DatingLandmarkEvent.619.1.cn: 为了表示对今天招待的感谢，==DATING_CHARACTER==提出，下次轮到她来请客。

DatingLandmarkEvent.619.2.en: So, with great excitement, the two of you start discussing which restaurant to go to...
DatingLandmarkEvent.619.2.cn: 于是你们兴致勃勃地讨论起，要去哪一家餐厅……

DatingLandmarkEvent.620.1.en: As a thank-you for your treat today, ==DATING_CHARACTER== offers to treat you to another meal later today.
DatingLandmarkEvent.620.1.cn: 为了表示对今天招待的感谢，==DATING_CHARACTER==提出，待会可以请你再吃一点其他的。

DatingLandmarkEvent.620.2.en: You decide to take a rain check on that. After all, you're plenty full today!
DatingLandmarkEvent.620.2.cn: 你决定留到下次，毕竟，今天已经够饱了！

DatingLandmarkEvent.701.1.en: Word has it that today's market is the biggest one in a while.
DatingLandmarkEvent.701.1.cn: 据说，今天这场集市是近期规模最大的一场。

DatingLandmarkEvent.701.2.en: You agreed to meet at the alleyway's entrance, and you spot ==DATING_CHARACTER== right away.
DatingLandmarkEvent.701.2.cn: 你们约定在小巷的路口见面，你一眼就看到了==DATING_CHARACTER==的身影。

DatingLandmarkEvent.702.1.en: You and ==DATING_CHARACTER== are surrounded by a hundred voices all hawking their wares.
DatingLandmarkEvent.702.1.cn: 你和==DATING_CHARACTER==淹没在一片热火朝天的叫卖声中。

DatingLandmarkEvent.702.2.en: A booming pastry vendor cuts through the noise. You wander over. She's selling pineapple cakes.
DatingLandmarkEvent.702.2.cn: 一位大嗓门的糕点商贩声音力压众人。你们凑了过去，她在卖菠萝酥。

DatingLandmarkEvent.702.3.en: After tasting one, you can't resist buying a small bag to share.
DatingLandmarkEvent.702.3.cn: 你们尝了一块，口感甚佳，便买了一小袋。

DatingLandmarkEvent.703.1.en: You and ==DATING_CHARACTER== are surrounded by a hundred voices all hawking their wares.
DatingLandmarkEvent.703.1.cn: 你和==DATING_CHARACTER==淹没在一片热火朝天的叫卖声中。

DatingLandmarkEvent.703.2.en: You follow a faint sweet scent through the crowd. It leads you to a stall selling sugar cakes.
DatingLandmarkEvent.703.2.cn: 你们嗅见一股若隐若现的甜味儿。循着气息，你们找到一个糖饼摊。

DatingLandmarkEvent.703.3.en: The smell is coming from condensed milk cakes. You buy a bag without hesitation.
DatingLandmarkEvent.703.3.cn: 气味来自于炼乳饼，你们果断买下一小袋。

DatingLandmarkEvent.704.1.en: Next to it, a flute player is selling "honey that makes love eternal." You are intrigued.
DatingLandmarkEvent.704.1.cn: 旁边的吹笛人在兜售一种可以使爱情永驻的蜜糖，你们好奇地要一探究竟。

DatingLandmarkEvent.704.2.en: It turns out to be nothing but ordinary syrup, both in quality and in price.
DatingLandmarkEvent.704.2.cn: 无论是质地上还是价格上，它就是稀松平常的一罐糖浆。

DatingLandmarkEvent.704.3.en: "Let's just buy one to try," ==DATING_CHARACTER== says and takes a jar.
DatingLandmarkEvent.704.3.cn: “买一罐尝尝鲜呗。”==DATING_CHARACTER==还是买了下来。

DatingLandmarkEvent.705.1.en: You arrive at a spice stall, its sharp exotic scents forcing their way into your nose, beckoning you closer.
DatingLandmarkEvent.705.1.cn: 你们走到香料铺子前，强行闯入鼻腔的异邦气味吸引你们上前。

DatingLandmarkEvent.705.2.en: ==DATING_CHARACTER== crushes a leaf in her hands just to take in the smell.
DatingLandmarkEvent.705.2.cn: ==DATING_CHARACTER==用双手揉碎了某种叶子，纯粹是为了闻一闻味道。

DatingLandmarkEvent.705.3.en: In the end, you buy a jar of blackcurrants soaked in liquor.
DatingLandmarkEvent.705.3.cn: 最终，你们还是买下了一罐酒浸黑醋栗。

DatingLandmarkEvent.706.1.en: You continue to browse the market.
DatingLandmarkEvent.706.1.cn: 你们继续在集市里逛着。

DatingLandmarkEvent.706.2.en: To your surprise, you realize that even in the crowded chaos, she still slips through with ease, never bumping into anyone.
DatingLandmarkEvent.706.2.cn: 你惊讶地发现，虽然人潮拥挤，但她在混乱中穿梭自如，不曾与任何人相撞。

DatingLandmarkEvent.706.3.en: You, on the other hand, stumble and dodge, your bags constantly brushing against others.
DatingLandmarkEvent.706.3.cn: 而你就比较狼狈了，需要一路跑跑停停，手里的袋子也刮擦不断。

DatingLandmarkEvent.707.1.en: While shopping, ==DATING_CHARACTER== bargains with the merchants.
DatingLandmarkEvent.707.1.cn: 在你们消费的时候，==DATING_CHARACTER==也会讨价还价。

DatingLandmarkEvent.707.2.en: She wins a few discounts gracefully.
DatingLandmarkEvent.707.2.cn: 她优雅地同商人议价，而后赢到一些优惠。

DatingLandmarkEvent.707.3.en: She's not just buying for herself—she buys for you, too.
DatingLandmarkEvent.707.3.cn: 她不光在为自己买，也是在为你买。

DatingLandmarkEvent.708.1.en:
The array of goods is dazzling to the eye, and there are some Artifacts that you have never seen before.

==DATING_CHARACTER== stops in front of a small stall.
DatingLandmarkEvent.708.1.cn:
各色各样的商品看得你眼花缭乱，其中不乏一些从没见过的神器。
==DATING_CHARACTER==在一个小摊前停下了脚步。

DatingLandmarkEvent.708.2.en:
The stall owner, noticing potential customers, eagerly begins showcasing their goods.
==DATING_CHARACTER== sets her sights on a small, elegant pocket watch.

She pulls you aside and asks for your opinion in a whisper.
DatingLandmarkEvent.708.2.cn:
摊主一见来了生意，向你们热情介绍。
==DATING_CHARACTER==看中了一个小巧的怀表。
她把你拉到一边，小声询问你的意见。

DatingLandmarkEvent.708.3.en:
You gasp inwardly upon hearing the price.

You tell ==DATING_CHARACTER== that you've seen similar designs elsewhere and that this one might be a bit overpriced.

She trusts your judgment.
DatingLandmarkEvent.708.3.cn:
听到价格后，你在内心倒吸了一口冷气。
你告诉==DATING_CHARACTER==，你见过这样的款式——而这里，或许有些溢价。
她十分相信你的判断。

DatingLandmarkEvent.709.1.en:
The array of goods is dazzling to the eye, and there are some Artifacts that you have never seen before.

==DATING_CHARACTER== stops in front of a small stall.
DatingLandmarkEvent.709.1.cn:
各色各样的商品看得你眼花缭乱，其中不乏一些从没见过的神器。
==DATING_CHARACTER==在一个小摊前停下了脚步。

DatingLandmarkEvent.709.2.en:
The stall owner, noticing potential customers, eagerly begins showcasing their goods.

==DATING_CHARACTER== sets her sights on a pretty trinket.
She pulls you aside and asks for your opinion in a whisper.
DatingLandmarkEvent.709.2.cn:
摊主一见来了生意，向你们热情介绍。
==DATING_CHARACTER==看中了一个漂亮的小首饰。
她把你拉到一边，小声询问你的意见。

DatingLandmarkEvent.709.3.en:
You buy it for her without a second thought. She is overjoyed.

You can tell that she really does love it.
DatingLandmarkEvent.709.3.cn:
你并没有犹豫，直接买下送给了她，她非常高兴。
你看的出来，她确实很喜欢。

DatingLandmarkEvent.710.2.en: Here they're selling the perfume that's all the rage in Flavio. The vendor gives ==DATING_CHARACTER== a spritz behind her ear.
DatingLandmarkEvent.710.2.cn: 这里有弗拉维奥正流行的香水。商贩向==DATING_CHARACTER==耳后喷了一揿。

DatingLandmarkEvent.710.3.en: She says the scent makes her feel like she doesn't even recognize herself.
DatingLandmarkEvent.710.3.cn: 她表示这种味道令她认不出自己了。

DatingLandmarkEvent.711.1.en: You pass a flower shop, its mysterious fragrance luring you in.
DatingLandmarkEvent.711.1.cn: 你们路过了一家花店，溢出的神秘芬芳吸引着你们进入。

DatingLandmarkEvent.711.2.en: In the shop, the floral scent grows stronger, blooming in your mind. You decide to buy a bouquet.
DatingLandmarkEvent.711.2.cn: 花香变得愈发强烈，在你的脑海里绽放。你决定买下一束花。

DatingLandmarkEvent.711.3.en:
"You're like a freshly blossomed flower."

"Thank you. I really like it."
DatingLandmarkEvent.711.3.cn:
“你就像一朵初开的鲜花。”
“谢谢你，我很喜欢。”

DatingLandmarkEvent.712.1.en:
Time flies, and it feels like you two have visited every single stall.

==DATING_CHARACTER== says there are still a few things she wants to check out on her own.
DatingLandmarkEvent.712.1.cn:
时光飞逝，能逛的店铺，似乎都已看了一圈。
==DATING_CHARACTER==说，还有些想要自己看看的东西。

DatingLandmarkEvent.712.2.en: So, you part ways for a little while. With your legs feeling sore, you find a bench to rest on. Before you know it, you've drifted off to sleep.
DatingLandmarkEvent.712.2.cn: 于是你们暂时分别，有些腿酸的你，找到了一个长椅歇息下来，没成想居然睡了过去。

DatingLandmarkEvent.712.3.en:
When you wake, you find ==DATING_CHARACTER== watching your sleeping face intently.

She laughs brightly and hands you the snacks she has bought.
DatingLandmarkEvent.712.3.cn:
醒来的你发现，==DATING_CHARACTER==认真地观察你的睡颜。
她爽朗的笑笑，并递给你买来的零食小点。

DatingLandmarkEvent.713.1.en:
Time flies, and it feels like you two have visited every single stall.

==DATING_CHARACTER== says there are still a few things she wants to check out on her own.
DatingLandmarkEvent.713.1.cn:
时光飞逝，能逛的店铺，似乎都已看了一圈。
==DATING_CHARACTER==说，还有些想要自己看看的东西。

DatingLandmarkEvent.713.2.en:
So, you part ways for a little while. With your legs feeling sore, you find a bench to rest on.

Soon she's back, carrying two servings of mouthwatering snacks.
DatingLandmarkEvent.713.2.cn:
于是你们暂时分别，有些腿酸的你，找到了一个长椅歇息下来。
没过多久，她回到了此处，带上了两份香味扑鼻的小吃。

DatingLandmarkEvent.713.3.en: You happily share a meal of street food together.
DatingLandmarkEvent.713.3.cn: 你们开心的分享了一顿街头美食。

DatingLandmarkEvent.724.1.en: ==DATING_CHARACTER== takes out a beautifully wrapped gift. She had secretly picked it out earlier at the market.
DatingLandmarkEvent.724.1.cn: ==DATING_CHARACTER==拿出了一个包装精美的礼物。这是她偷偷在集市上提前相中的。

DatingLandmarkEvent.724.2.en: ==DATING_CHARACTER== looks a bit nervous, but you pull out the gift you have just prepared for her.
DatingLandmarkEvent.724.2.cn: ==DATING_CHARACTER==显然有些紧张，而你却掏出了自己刚准备好送她的礼物。

DatingLandmarkEvent.724.3.en: Caring minds think alike! You are both a little embarrassed but happily exchange your gifts.
DatingLandmarkEvent.724.3.cn: 你们为这份默契感到有些不好意思，并开心地交换了礼物。

DatingLandmarkEvent.725.1.en: ==DATING_CHARACTER== takes out a beautifully wrapped gift. She had secretly picked it out earlier at the market.
DatingLandmarkEvent.725.1.cn: ==DATING_CHARACTER==拿出了一个包装精美的礼物。这是她偷偷在集市上提前相中的。

DatingLandmarkEvent.725.2.en:
You open the surprise right then and there. It's a little something you'd mentioned to her a long time ago.

You thank ==DATING_CHARACTER== so profusely that she looks very embarrassed.
DatingLandmarkEvent.725.2.cn:
你高兴地当面拆开了这个惊喜，居然是你好久之前，向她提及过的小玩意儿。
你有些激动的致谢，让==DATING_CHARACTER==很不好意思。

DatingLandmarkEvent.725.3.en: You almost wish you could rent out the whole street just to walk it with her again—though of course, you know it'll take a lot more work to make that dream real.
DatingLandmarkEvent.725.3.cn: 你恨不得把整条街都承包下来，再陪她多逛上一圈——当然你明白，要达到这个目标，还得付出更多的努力。

DatingLandmarkEvent.726.1.en: ==DATING_CHARACTER== takes out a beautifully wrapped gift. She had secretly picked it out earlier at the market.
DatingLandmarkEvent.726.1.cn: ==DATING_CHARACTER==拿出了一个包装精美的礼物。这是她偷偷在集市上提前相中的。

DatingLandmarkEvent.726.2.en: With an air of mystery, ==DATING_CHARACTER== tells you that you cannot open this present until you get home.
DatingLandmarkEvent.726.2.cn: ==DATING_CHARACTER==有些神秘地叮嘱你，到家之前不准打开。

DatingLandmarkEvent.726.3.en: You stick to the agreement and decide to save this surprise for the very end.
DatingLandmarkEvent.726.3.cn: 你遵守约定，并决定将这份惊喜保留到最后。

DatingLandmarkEvent.801.1.en: As you draw closer to the Port, you can already feel the warm, humid air.
DatingLandmarkEvent.801.1.cn: 刚刚靠近港口，你就感受到了那股温暖而又潮湿的气息。

DatingLandmarkEvent.801.2.en: The waves crash against the breakwater as you stand below, looking up.
DatingLandmarkEvent.801.2.cn: 海浪拍打着防波提，你站在下面向上张望。

DatingLandmarkEvent.801.3.en: You spot ==DATING_CHARACTER==, her face turned toward the sun, a wide stretch of blue sky behind her, a calm serenity enveloping her.
DatingLandmarkEvent.801.3.cn: 你看见了==DATING_CHARACTER==，她面朝着阳光，背后一片蔚蓝，一股风平浪静的安详笼罩着她。

DatingLandmarkEvent.802.1.en: You and ==DATING_CHARACTER== walk side by side along the creaking pier.
DatingLandmarkEvent.802.1.cn: 你和==DATING_CHARACTER==并肩走在咯吱作响的码头上。

DatingLandmarkEvent.802.2.en: Inside the Port, some boats bob gently along with the tide.
DatingLandmarkEvent.802.2.cn: 一些船停靠在码头里，随着海潮摇摇晃晃。

DatingLandmarkEvent.802.3.en: You can't help but wonder: if the chance came, would you set out to sea, too?
DatingLandmarkEvent.802.3.cn: 你不禁遐想到：如果机会合适，自己也会出海吗？

DatingLandmarkEvent.803.1.en: You and ==DATING_CHARACTER== walk side by side along the creaking pier.
DatingLandmarkEvent.803.1.cn: 你和==DATING_CHARACTER==并肩走在咯吱作响的码头上。

DatingLandmarkEvent.803.2.en: A tall ship is entering the port, its sails furled as haulers slowly pull it forward.
DatingLandmarkEvent.803.2.cn: 一艘高大的船正在入港，一些纤夫拖着收了帆的船缓缓前行。

DatingLandmarkEvent.803.3.en: The sailors on deck keep a sharp eye on the distance between ship and posts, shouting loudly from time to time.
DatingLandmarkEvent.803.3.cn: 船舷上的水手紧盯着船与板桩之间的距离，时不时大声呼喊。

DatingLandmarkEvent.804.1.en: Vendors on the pier call out, selling fresh catches of the day. You both wander over to have a look.
DatingLandmarkEvent.804.1.cn: 一些小贩在码头上叫卖新鲜的渔获，你们凑过去看看有什么。

DatingLandmarkEvent.804.2.en: The seafood is certainly fresh, but it's not convenient for you to prepare it.
DatingLandmarkEvent.804.2.cn: 这些刚刚捕捞上来的海产确实新鲜，但你们并不方便处理这些海鲜。

DatingLandmarkEvent.804.3.en: Luckily, they also have oysters. You buy a few, pry them open with a small knife, and squeeze lime juice over them. Both of you eat them as you walk.
DatingLandmarkEvent.804.3.cn: 幸运的是，这里也有生蚝。你们买下了几个，用小刀撬开后再挤些酸橙汁。你们边走边分享了这一美味。

DatingLandmarkEvent.805.1.en: A merchant ship is unloading, and a trader eagerly invites you to see the goods he's retailing.
DatingLandmarkEvent.805.1.cn: 一艘商船正在卸货，商人热情地邀请你们看看他零售的好货。

DatingLandmarkEvent.805.2.en: There are all kinds of spices and bolts of silk, but neither of you are interested.
DatingLandmarkEvent.805.2.cn: 这里有各种类型的香料，还有样式繁多的绸子，但你们对这些并不感兴趣。

DatingLandmarkEvent.805.3.en: Instead, ==DATING_CHARACTER== spots a few bags of candy. You taste one and find it to be the rare soft and chewy kind. In the end, you each buy a bag.
DatingLandmarkEvent.805.3.cn: ==DATING_CHARACTER==发现了几袋糖果。你尝了一颗，嚼起来软软的，是少见的类型。最终你们一人买了一袋。

DatingLandmarkEvent.806.1.en: Tired from walking, you sit down to rest. Just then, the sun begins to sink slowly into the sea.
DatingLandmarkEvent.806.1.cn: 你们走得有些累了，便坐下来歇息。恰逢日落，太阳一点点落入海面。

DatingLandmarkEvent.806.2.en: The water looks as though it's about to boil. The whole world starts to turn gold and the glow spreads across her face. The evening breeze tugs at her clothes. With the rhythm of the tide, you feel happiness welling up inside you.
DatingLandmarkEvent.806.2.cn: 海水似乎要沸腾起来，整个世界一片金黄。霞光洒在她的脸庞上，晚风拂动她的衣裳。伴随阵阵潮水，你感到自己的幸福指数正快速上升。

DatingLandmarkEvent.806.3.en: You and ==DATING_CHARACTER== stay there together until night falls and the faint lights of fishing boats begin flickering across the water.
DatingLandmarkEvent.806.3.cn: 你和==DATING_CHARACTER==就这么坐着，直至夜晚来临，零星的渔灯在海中亮起。

DatingLandmarkEvent.807.1.en: A large ship is preparing to leave port. You can make out silhouettes moving on its deck.
DatingLandmarkEvent.807.1.cn: 一艘大船正要离港，你们能看见甲板上活动的人影。

DatingLandmarkEvent.807.2.en: The ropes are pulled up, the main sail rises. The huge triangular canvas spreads wide, shining in the sunlight like a white torch.
DatingLandmarkEvent.807.2.cn: 大船收卷揽绳，升起主帆。它展开巨大的三角帆，在阳光照射下如同白花花的火炬。

DatingLandmarkEvent.807.3.en: You and ==DATING_CHARACTER== stand quietly on the pier posts, watching as the great ship slowly departs.
DatingLandmarkEvent.807.3.cn: 你和==DATING_CHARACTER==静静地站在板桩码头上，看着大船慢慢离开。

DatingLandmarkEvent.808.1.en: There is an exhibition ship inside the Port. It's essentially a floating museum, so it must hold some interesting displays.
DatingLandmarkEvent.808.1.cn: 港口里停泊着一艘展览船，其实就是船型博物馆，里面应该会陈列有意思的东西吧。

DatingLandmarkEvent.808.2.en: You cross the narrow gangplank to board. The wooden plank shifts under the tide, making it feel like you could topple into the water at any moment!
DatingLandmarkEvent.808.2.cn: 你们颤颤巍巍地从艞板上登船。这块窄木板在潮水的推挤中上下晃动，感觉随时可能跌到海里！

DatingLandmarkEvent.808.3.en: You and ==DATING_CHARACTER== clutch each other tightly and make it aboard safely.
DatingLandmarkEvent.808.3.cn: 你和==DATING_CHARACTER==紧紧抓住对方，有惊无险地走上船。

DatingLandmarkEvent.809.1.en: There is an exhibition ship inside the Port. It's essentially a floating museum, so it must hold some interesting displays.
DatingLandmarkEvent.809.1.cn: 港口里停泊着一艘展览船，其实就是船型博物馆，里面应该会陈列有意思的东西吧。

DatingLandmarkEvent.809.2.en: This time you climb up the rope netting at the ship's side. The climb is hard, gravity weighing you down. You can't help wondering if too much time spent lying around in the Monolith has left your body out of shape.
DatingLandmarkEvent.809.2.cn: 你们从船侧的攀爬网上登船。你感到有些吃力，尤其是这种直接对抗重力的活动。你不禁在想：是不是自己在星塔里躺了太久，以至于运动能力都萎缩了呢？

DatingLandmarkEvent.809.3.en: Luckily, being a seasoned Trekker, ==DATING_CHARACTER== reaches the deck and finally hauls you up as well. The two of you sit on the deck catching your breath. You really do need more exercise.
DatingLandmarkEvent.809.3.cn: 还好身为旅人的==DATING_CHARACTER==已经率先登上甲板，最后她把你硬拉了上来。你们坐在甲板上喘气，看来真要多锻炼了。

DatingLandmarkEvent.810.1.en: One cabin displays a giant sea chart, but the symbols on it are impossible to read, so you turn your attention to the land instead, studying the locations of various Cities.
DatingLandmarkEvent.810.1.cn: 一间舱室里展览着巨大的海图。但你着实看不懂上面的各种符号，于是你把目光从海洋挪向陆地，观摩着各个城邦的位置。

DatingLandmarkEvent.810.2.en: "Boss, are you planning the business expansion map of your 'Accord'?" ==DATING_CHARACTER== steps up beside you, joining you in surveying this fledgling business empire.
DatingLandmarkEvent.810.2.cn: “魔王在研究「协议」的商业扩张版图吗？”==DATING_CHARACTER==站到你身旁，和你一起打量这个尚在襁褓中的寡头商业帝国。

DatingLandmarkEvent.810.3.en:
As a fast-growing player-focused vertical startup on the soul domain, it has to identify core pain points, ensure cross-functional alignment, and drive an end-to-end product-development cycle...

Stop right there! Don't let all that jargon get in the way of your time with ==DATING_CHARACTER==.
DatingLandmarkEvent.810.3.cn:
作为一个新兴的，在灵魂领域深耕的垂类企业，一定要挖掘用户痛点，对齐各部需求，实现产研闭环……
就此打住！不要让这些概念打搅你和==DATING_CHARACTER==的美好时光。

DatingLandmarkEvent.811.1.en: Another cabin is filled with intricate ship models. If not for the glass display, you'd want to hold them in your hands.
DatingLandmarkEvent.811.1.cn: 一间舱室里展览着许多仿真船模型，做工精致。要不是被玻璃柜隔着，真想端在手里细细观赏。

DatingLandmarkEvent.811.2.en: "Look, look—that ship's design is so strange!" ==DATING_CHARACTER== points to a longship in the case.
DatingLandmarkEvent.811.2.cn: “你看你看，造型好怪的船喔。”==DATING_CHARACTER==指着展柜里的长船说道。

DatingLandmarkEvent.811.3.en: You recall seeing even stranger ships in the Monolith. Maybe next time you could wish for a little model of your own?
DatingLandmarkEvent.811.3.cn: 你想起曾在星塔里见过一些更加奇特的船只，下次能不能许愿个小模型出来呢？

DatingLandmarkEvent.812.1.en: The crew's cateen offers a "sailor's meal" experience. You and ==DATING_CHARACTER== decide to try it.
DatingLandmarkEvent.812.1.cn: 船员餐厅里有海员餐体验，你和==DATING_CHARACTER==决定体验一番。

DatingLandmarkEvent.812.2.en: The waiter serves you a combo of hard bread and salted meat, explaining: "On ships sailing beyond the Sunken Sea, with no ports for resupply, sailors eventually had nothing to eat but food like this."
DatingLandmarkEvent.812.2.cn: 服务员为你们端上一份硬饼干与咸肉的组合，并解释道：“在沉寂海之外的航船，由于缺乏港口补给，海员们在后期只能吃到这种食物。”

DatingLandmarkEvent.812.3.en:
Impossible to chew! The hard bread pummels your teeth, while the salted meat turns it into a full-on beating. Together they leave your mouth parched, and you gulp down water to recover.

This meal is truly no joke, but at least the cost was already included in the ticket.
DatingLandmarkEvent.812.3.cn:
难以咀嚼！硬饼干在殴打你的牙齿，而咸肉使其成为一场围殴。它们的组合技还令你口干舌燥，你急忙喝水缓解。
这顿餐食确实很硬核，还好其费用已被包括进门票中。

DatingLandmarkEvent.813.1.en: The crew's cateen offers a "sailor's meal" experience. You and ==DATING_CHARACTER== decide to try it.
DatingLandmarkEvent.813.1.cn: 船员餐厅里有海员餐体验，你和==DATING_CHARACTER==决定体验一番。

DatingLandmarkEvent.813.2.en: "Congratulations! You two are this week's lucky guests. Please enjoy an admiral's feast." The server brings out a full platter.
DatingLandmarkEvent.813.2.cn: “恭喜，二位是本周的幸运顾客，请尽情享用提督待遇的餐点吧。”服务员为你们端上满满一盘。

DatingLandmarkEvent.813.3.en: Fresh fish, ham, peas, bread, and cheese, served with lime and sugared tea. You and ==DATING_CHARACTER== dig in with delight.
DatingLandmarkEvent.813.3.cn: 鲜鱼、火腿、青豆，还有面包与干酪，再配上酸橙与加糖茶。你和==DATING_CHARACTER==大快朵颐。

DatingLandmarkEvent.818.1.en: You wander into a specialty shop by the outer docks, curious about its seaside goods.
DatingLandmarkEvent.818.1.cn: 你们走进了一家港口外围的特选店，看看里面有没有什么海边好货。

DatingLandmarkEvent.818.2.en:
The smell of dried fish hits you as soon as you step in.

You buy some little dried fish as snacks.
DatingLandmarkEvent.818.2.cn:
刚进入店里，海货的咸香就涌入了你的鼻腔。
你们买了些小鱼干当零食吃。

DatingLandmarkEvent.818.3.en: But you can't linger too long; otherwise the smell will cling to your clothes and hair.
DatingLandmarkEvent.818.3.cn: 可不能在这里呆久了，海货的气息会渗进衣服与头发的。

DatingLandmarkEvent.819.1.en: Strolling along the breakwater, ==DATING_CHARACTER== walks a little ahead of you, arms slightly raised.
DatingLandmarkEvent.819.1.cn: 你们漫步在防波提上，==DATING_CHARACTER==走在你前面，稍稍张起手臂。

DatingLandmarkEvent.819.2.en: She sways as she goes. The trees whisper in the wind. She turns back, leaning toward you.
DatingLandmarkEvent.819.2.cn: 她一摇一摆的向前走着。树梢被风吹得沙沙作响。她转过来，微微俯下身子。

DatingLandmarkEvent.819.3.en: "Today was so much fun." In the dim light, you can't quite see her face, but you know she must be smiling.
DatingLandmarkEvent.819.3.cn: “今天过得很开心。”昏暗的天光下，你并不能看清她的表情，但想必一定在笑吧。

DatingStartEndEvent.103101.1.en: On a whim, you used your phone to invite ==DATING_CHARACTER== to hang out with you.
DatingStartEndEvent.103101.1.cn: 一时兴起，你用手机向==DATING_CHARACTER==发出了同游的邀请。

DatingStartEndEvent.103101.2.en: The two of you will be spending some time together. What will happen?
DatingStartEndEvent.103101.2.cn: 接下来的这段时间，就要和她一起行动了，会发生什么事呢？

DatingStartEndEvent.103102.1.en: Before you realize it, time has flown by.

DatingStartEndEvent.103102.2.en: You have made some great memories with ==DATING_CHARACTER==, and now...
DatingStartEndEvent.103102.2.cn: 确实和==DATING_CHARACTER==度过了一段难忘的时光，接下来……

DatingStartEndEvent.107101.1.en: On a whim, you used your phone to invite ==DATING_CHARACTER== to hang out with you.
DatingStartEndEvent.107101.1.cn: 一时兴起，你用手机向==DATING_CHARACTER==发出了同游的邀请。
