DictionaryDiagram.10010101.2.en: Trekkers possess unique Elements</color> and combat styles</color>. Encounter more Trekkers and strategically deploy them to tackle diverse challenges.
DictionaryDiagram.10010101.2.cn: 旅人们有着各自擅长的元素属性</color>与战斗风格</color>，与更多的旅人相遇，灵活搭配队伍应对不同的挑战。

DictionaryDiagram.10020101.2.en: Using EXP items cam raise Trekker Level</color>, significantly boosting all base stats.
DictionaryDiagram.10020101.2.cn: 使用经验值道具即可提升旅人等级</color>，大幅提高旅人的各项基础属性。

DictionaryDiagram.10020102.2.en:
Each Trekker reaches a level cap every 10</color> levels.
By consuming specific advancement materials to complete Tier-up</color>, you can boost their stats and increase the level cap</color>.
DictionaryDiagram.10020102.2.cn:
旅人每提升10</color>级就会达到等级上限。
消耗进阶素材进行进阶</color>，为旅人提升属性并解锁等级上限</color>。

DictionaryDiagram.10020103.2.en: Upon reaching Tier 3</color>, Trekkers can unlock their Awakened Appearance</color>, which can be set on the home screen.
DictionaryDiagram.10020103.2.cn: 当旅人进阶到3阶</color>时，可解锁全新的觉醒形象</color>，并可设置于首页。

DictionaryDiagram.10030101.2.en:
Each Trekker has different skills that can be categorized as: 
Auto Attack, Active Skill, Support Skill, and Ultimate.
DictionaryDiagram.10030101.2.cn:
每个旅人拥有不同的技能，技能类型分为：
普攻、主动技能、援护技能、绝招。

DictionaryDiagram.10030102.2.en: By consuming skill upgrade materials, you can level up skills to enhance their effectiveness.
DictionaryDiagram.10030102.2.cn: 消耗技能升级材料，提升技能等级，可以强化技能的效果。

DictionaryDiagram.10040102.2.en: Emblems come with random Affix(es) and their corresponding Trekker tags. Upgrading the emblem to a specific level will unlock the bonus for the Affixes.
DictionaryDiagram.10040102.2.cn: 获得徽章时确认随机词条数量及对应的旅人标签，升级徽章至特定等级会解锁随机词条的属性类型。

DictionaryDiagram.10040103.2.en: When the emblem's Affixes align with the Trekker's Elements, the bonus provided by the Affixes gain additional boosts.
DictionaryDiagram.10040103.2.cn: 徽章中随机词条标签和旅人标签形成对应时，词条提供的属性将会额外增幅。

DictionaryDiagram.10050101.2.en: Each Trekker has unique Potentials for both Main and Support roles. Participate in Ascension to unlock them. Different Potential combinations for the same Trekker form distinct combat builds.
DictionaryDiagram.10050101.2.cn:
每个旅人在主控、援护位置都有各自专属的潜能。进行“星塔探索”即可抽取并激活潜能。
同一位旅人不同的潜能搭配，可视为几种不同的“战斗流派”。

DictionaryDiagram.10060101.2.en:
Recruiting duplicate Trekkers grants Trekker Soul Keys</color>.
These keys allow you to activate Talents</color>, boosting the Trekker's Elements, and unlock visual effects. In addition to recruitment, Soul Keys can also be obtained through other methods.
DictionaryDiagram.10060101.2.cn:
招募同一位旅人会获得旅人心链</color>。
消耗心链可激活天赋</color>，提升属性，并解锁视觉效果；心链除了招募外，也可能通过其他渠道获得。

DictionaryDiagram.10060102.2.en:
Activating Talents</color> allows Trekkers to gain various Element bonuses.
When all Talents in the same tier are activated, additional abilities will be unlocked, and the next tier will become available to activate.
DictionaryDiagram.10060102.2.cn:
激活天赋</color>，旅人可获得各类属性提升。
激活同一层的所有天赋时，将额外解锁能力并开放下一层的激活。

DictionaryDiagram.10070101.2.en: Trekkers gain Affinity</color> over time. Raising Affinity unlocks extra archive entries, voice lines, and personal stories. Completing a storyline grants exclusive Memory Snapshots</color>. Affinity also provides minor Element boosts.
DictionaryDiagram.10070101.2.cn:
旅人可逐步累积默契值</color>，随着默契等级提升，可解锁旅人更多的档案信息、语音、以及个人剧情。阅读全篇后可解锁回忆特写</color>。
默契等级提升时，还会提升旅人的少量属性。

DictionaryDiagram.10070102.2.en: Each Trekker has unique Affinity Tasks</color>. Completing them grants Affinity. You can also raise Affinity through invitations and gifts</color>, in addition to combat.
DictionaryDiagram.10070102.2.cn:
每名旅人都有不同的伙伴目标</color>。达成伙伴目标可以获得默契值。
除了战斗与完成伙伴目标外，还可以通过邀约、赠礼</color>等手段提升默契值。

DictionaryDiagram.10080101.2.en: Each Trekker has 3 emblem slots, which unlock at different levels. Once unlocked, emblems can be equipped to enhance the character's abilities.
DictionaryDiagram.10080101.2.cn: 每名旅人拥有三个纹章槽位，分别在不同等级开启，开启后可以装备纹章提升自身能力。

DictionaryDiagram.10080102.2.en:
Once an Emblem slot is activated, specific materials are required for forging. 
These materials can be obtained through Emblem Trials.
DictionaryDiagram.10080102.2.cn:
纹章槽位激活后，需要消耗特定种类的素材进行铸造。
这些素材可通过“纹章试炼”获取。

DictionaryDiagram.10080103.2.en: The types and unlocking order of emblem slots for each Trekker do not follow a fixed pattern.
DictionaryDiagram.10080103.2.cn: 每名旅人配置的纹章类型与开启顺序没有固定规律。

DictionaryDiagram.10080104.2.en:
Forging an Emblem grants random affixes. 
Mid-tier Emblems (unlocked at Trekker Lv. 80) may grant Skill Level bonuses, while high-tier Emblems (unlocked at Trekker Lv. 90) may grant Potential Level bonuses.
DictionaryDiagram.10080104.2.cn:
纹章铸造时将会得到随机词条。
中阶纹章（旅人80级解锁）有可能出现技能等级提升的词条，高阶纹章（旅人90级解锁）有可能出现潜能等级提升的词条。

DictionaryDiagram.10080105.2.en: Consume specific materials to Reforge an Emblem, generating a new set of random affixes.
DictionaryDiagram.10080105.2.cn: 消耗特定素材可对纹章进行重铸，可重新生成一组随机词条。

DictionaryDiagram.10080106.2.en: During Reforging, Lock items can be used to preserve selected affixes. Locked affixes are guaranteed to remain in the next roll. Up to 2 affixes can be locked during Reforge.
DictionaryDiagram.10080106.2.cn: 重铸过程中可以使用锁定道具，在词条锁定状态下进行重铸，下次生成的随机词条中必定保留已锁定的词条。重铸时，最多锁定2条现有属性词条。

DictionaryDiagram.10080107.2.en: Use Drop of Purity to Temper an Emblem, enhancing specific affixes. Each Emblem can be Tempered up to 2 times. If Tempered affixes are not locked during Reforge, the Emblem will revert. Consumed Drop of Purity will not be refunded.
DictionaryDiagram.10080107.2.cn: 使用“圣洁之滴”进行纹章跃升，即可强化纹章上的特定词条；每枚纹章至多可跃升两次。重新铸造纹章时，若未锁定跃升后的词条，则该纹章将被“回退”。回退时，不会返还已消耗的圣洁之滴。

DictionaryDiagram.20010101.2.en: Spending Vigor to complete battles allows you to level up your Authorization Level and receive generous supplies!
DictionaryDiagram.20010101.2.cn: 消耗干劲完成战斗，即可提升权限等级，获得丰厚补给品！

DictionaryDiagram.20020101.2.en: Upon completing the Ascension, you can save "Records" and use them to challenge other levels.
DictionaryDiagram.20020101.2.cn: 完成星塔探索后，可保存“纪录”，并使用“纪录”进行其它类型的关卡挑战。

DictionaryDiagram.20020102.2.en: During Ascension</color>, you can select and collect Potentials</color> to enhance Trekkers' abilities. Acquired Potentials will also be saved in your "Records."
DictionaryDiagram.20020102.2.cn: 在星塔探索</color>的过程中，选择并收集强化旅人的潜能</color>，已获得的潜能会在“纪录”中保存。

DictionaryDiagram.20020103.2.en:
During Ascension</color>, you can collect Musical Notes</color> to gain various Element Bonuses.
The Musical Notes will also be saved in your records and can be used for challenges in other game modes.
DictionaryDiagram.20020103.2.cn:
在星塔探索</color>的过程中还可以获得音符</color>来得到各类属性的加成。
音符同样会被保存进纪录，用于其他玩法的挑战。

DictionaryDiagram.20020104.2.en: Collected Musical Notes can be used to activate the Harmony Skills</color> of equipped Discs, providing buffs for the squad. And the activated Harmony Skills will also be saved in your records and can be used for challenges in other game modes.
DictionaryDiagram.20020104.2.cn:
获得音符还可以激活秘纹的协奏技能</color>，为全队提供增益效果。
激活的协奏技能同样会被保存进纪录，用于其他玩法的挑战。

DictionaryDiagram.20020105.2.en: During Ascension</color>, you will encounter random events that offer different reward options once completed.
DictionaryDiagram.20020105.2.cn: 在星塔探索</color>遭遇的随机事件，可根据选项获得不同的奖励。

DictionaryDiagram.20020107.2.en:
You can save records of your adventure after completing the Ascension</color>, which will grant you access for various other activities.
Each record includes the composition of Trekkers, their Potentials, and Musical Notes.
DictionaryDiagram.20020107.2.cn:
完成星塔探索</color>可保存纪录，可用于各类其它玩法。
纪录包含本次星塔探索的队伍成员、潜能与音符。

DictionaryDiagram.20020201.2.en:
Completing Ascension</color> or finishing Research Plans</color> grants materials for Monolith Research.
Invest materials on Research Nodes</color> to earn various bonuses for Ascensions.
DictionaryDiagram.20020201.2.cn:
进行星塔探索</color>或完成研究计划</color>可以获得星塔研究素材。
消耗素材可以激活研究节点</color>，为后续的星塔探索提供各种加成。

DictionaryDiagram.20020202.2.en: Monolith Research consists of 3 layers</color>. You must complete all the researches</color> of the previous layer before you can proceed to the next layer.
DictionaryDiagram.20020202.2.cn: 星塔研究共有3个层级</color>，需要完成前一层级的所有研究</color>后，才可以继续深入研究后续层级。

DictionaryDiagram.20020203.2.en: You need to unlock the current research layer and complete the research of prerequisite nodes</color> before you can begin the corresponding research.
DictionaryDiagram.20020203.2.cn: 需要开启当前研究层级，同时完成所有前置节点的研究</color>，才能进行对应节点的研究。

DictionaryDiagram.20030101.2.en: Upon completing Ascension, you can save a record, which includes the composition of Trekkers and their Runic Discs. You can load a record at any time to sync the stored information of Trekkers and Discs.
DictionaryDiagram.20030101.2.cn:
星塔探索结束后可保存纪录，其中保存参与本次探索的旅人和秘纹。
在使用纪录时，旅人与秘纹的养成信息会被实时同步。

DictionaryDiagram.20030102.2.en:
Your records will also preserve activated Trekker Potentials and Musical Notes during Ascension.
Once saved, they will no longer change.
DictionaryDiagram.20030102.2.cn:
纪录也会保存星塔探索中激活的旅人潜能与音符。
旅人潜能与音符被保存后，不再发生变更。

DictionaryDiagram.20030201.2.en: Creates Potential Presets in Trekker Selection.
DictionaryDiagram.20030201.2.cn: 旅人选择界面可进行潜能预设的设置！

DictionaryDiagram.20030202.2.en: In the Potential Preset menu, you can choose a saved preset or create a new one.
DictionaryDiagram.20030202.2.cn: 潜能预设界面下可选择已保存的记录预设或新建预设！

DictionaryDiagram.20030203.2.en: The Potentials and levels selected in a preset will be marked during Ascension.
DictionaryDiagram.20030203.2.cn: 潜能预设中选择的潜能与等级，会在星塔探索中标记

DictionaryDiagram.20030204.2.en: You can share and import Preset Codes.
DictionaryDiagram.20030204.2.cn: 魔王可自由分享与导入潜能预设代码！

DictionaryDiagram.20040101.2.cn: 测试留空，等待功能完成填写

DictionaryDiagram.20050101.2.cn: 测试留空，等待功能完成填写

DictionaryDiagram.20060101.2.cn: 测试留空，等待功能完成填写

DictionaryDiagram.20070101.2.cn: 测试留空，等待功能完成填写

DictionaryDiagram.20080103.2.en:
In Summit Show, you can manually select Affixes to increase the difficulty.
Pick your Affix and challenge higher-difficulty stages!
DictionaryDiagram.20080103.2.cn:
巅峰秀场中，可以手动选择难度词条提高难度。
选择词条挑战更高难度吧！

DictionaryDiagram.20080201.2.en:
Select Start Show to begin the Summit Show.
You can select modifiers to adjust the difficulty.
DictionaryDiagram.20080201.2.cn:
点击开始对决即可开始巅峰挑战
可以自由选择词条调整难度！

DictionaryDiagram.20080202.2.en: After completing a successful show, rewards will accumulate based on the highest difficulty completed, for up to 48 hours.
DictionaryDiagram.20080202.2.cn:
通过挑战后，根据已通过难度，可以累积奖励
最多可累积48小时的奖励

DictionaryDiagram.20080203.2.en: The three items obtained from accumulated rewards can be used for ranking boost, increasing Fan Contribution and Lilibea's stream popularity!
DictionaryDiagram.20080203.2.cn:
累积奖励获得的三种道具可用于打榜！
提高粉丝贡献与莉莉贝尔直播间的热度值！

DictionaryDiagram.20080204.2.en:
During the event, popularity battles will take place in time.
At daily settlement, if your popularity exceeds the opponent's, you'll earn rewards. Come support her to win!
DictionaryDiagram.20080204.2.cn:
活动期间会发起热度对决！
每日结算时热度超过对方即获得奖励，快来支持莉莉贝尔吧！

DictionaryDiagram.20090101.2.en: Carrying a Disc into the Monolith will provide your squad with stat bonuses corresponding to the Disc.
DictionaryDiagram.20090101.2.cn: 进入星塔时携带秘纹将会为队伍中所有旅人提供秘纹对应的属性增益。

DictionaryDiagram.20090102.2.en: When equipped in the main slot, the Disc automatically activates its Melody Skill upon entering the Monolith. This powerful skill greatly enhances your Trekkers' combat capabilities. Its level scales with the Disc's Crescendo Stars — the higher the stars, the stronger the skill.
DictionaryDiagram.20090102.2.cn: 若秘纹配置于主位：进入星塔时，自动激活主旋律技能。主旋律技能效果强大，能够极大提高旅人的作战能力。其技能等级与秘纹突破星数同步，突破星数越高技能等级越高。

DictionaryDiagram.20090103.2.en: If the Disc is equipped in the main slot: The Harmony Skill requires collecting specific types and quantities of Element Musical Notes during Ascension to activate.
DictionaryDiagram.20090103.2.cn: 若秘纹配置于主位：需要在星塔探索过程中，收集特定种类及数量的属性音符来激活其协奏技能。

DictionaryDiagram.20090104.2.en: If the Disc is equipped in the support slot: When you enter the Monolith, the Musical Notes corresponding to that specific Disc will be added as initial Musical Notes. These Musical Notes can also be used to activate the Harmony Skill in the main slot.
DictionaryDiagram.20090104.2.cn: 若秘纹配置于辅位：进入星塔时，直接获得该秘纹特定的对应音符加入初始音符，这些音符同样可用于激活主位秘纹的协奏技能。

DictionaryDiagram.20100101.2.en: The Trekkers you meet and recruit during your journey will be added to your cellphone's Heartlink contact list. Chat sessions will automatically trigger after a certain period or through specific in-game events.
DictionaryDiagram.20100101.2.cn: 您在旅行中相遇及招募的旅人将会作为联系人添加进心链通讯列表之中，每隔一段时间自动触发或由游戏内特定事件触发聊天会话。

DictionaryDiagram.20100102.2.en: During the chat sessions you can choose different responses, which will trigger a variety of replies.
DictionaryDiagram.20100102.2.cn: 聊天会话中，可以选择不同的选项进行应答，触发不同的回复内容。

DictionaryDiagram.20100103.2.en: For each contact, all triggered chat sessions are recorded in the list. You can switch between completed and ongoing conversations from here.
DictionaryDiagram.20100103.2.cn: 单个联系人所有已触发的聊天会话均在列表中记录，已完成及其他正在进行的会话可在此处切换显示。

DictionaryDiagram.20110101.2.en:
Certain activities in the world, such as Bounty Trials and certain event levels, consume Vigor.
You can spend Vigor to increase your Authorization Level.
DictionaryDiagram.20110101.2.cn:
在世界中进行 悬赏试炼 和 部分活动关卡时需要消耗干劲。
消耗干劲时可以提升权限等级。

DictionaryDiagram.20110102.2.en: Vigor naturally regenerates by 1 every 6 minutes. You can also restore it by using Stellanite Dust or recovery items like Energy Drinks.
DictionaryDiagram.20110102.2.cn: 干劲每6分钟随时间自然恢复1点，也可通过消耗星之砂进行兑换，或使用能量饮料等物品进行恢复。

DictionaryDiagram.20110103.2.en: When Vigor is full, 1 Vigor will be stored in the Vigor Reserve every X minutes, up to a maximum of XX. Reserved Vigor can be withdrawn and used at any time.
DictionaryDiagram.20110103.2.cn: 当干劲已满时，每X分钟储存1点至干劲储备，最多储存XX点，储备的干劲可随时提取使用。

DictionaryDiagram.20120101.2.en:
The Arena features different difficulties and elements, requiring Trekkers to start from the lowest level arena.
Completing Arena challenges grants abundant rewards.
DictionaryDiagram.20120101.2.cn:
擂台分为不同难度与属性，旅人需要从最低级的擂台逐步挑战。
完成擂台挑战可获得丰厚的奖励。

DictionaryDiagram.20120102.2.en:
Arenas with varying elements and difficulties may have specific rulesets.
Adapt your battle strategy and Trekker selection accordingly!
DictionaryDiagram.20120102.2.cn:
不同属性与难度的擂台往往存在不同的擂台规则限制。
擂台规则可能影响战斗策略甚至旅人选择，根据规则调整挑战的思路吧！

DictionaryDiagram.20130101.2.en: Cataclysm Survivor has stages with multiple difficulty levels. You can choose which one to challenge.
DictionaryDiagram.20130101.2.cn: 灾变防线中设置多个难度的关卡可自行选择进行挑战。

DictionaryDiagram.20130102.2.en: Cataclysm Survivor requires two separate squads to take on a challenge. Trekkers cannot be shared between the squads!
DictionaryDiagram.20130102.2.cn: 灾变防线中需要两个纪录才可进行挑战，两个纪录中不可具有相同的旅人！

DictionaryDiagram.20130103.2.en: In Cataclysm Survivor, you earn points during combat based on the number of enemies defeated. Reach the seasonal score milestones to claim rewards.
DictionaryDiagram.20130103.2.cn: 灾变防线中作战时，根据击败目标的数量可累计分数，当每个赛季分数达到目标时即可领取奖励。

DictionaryDiagram.20130104.2.en:
Collecting Destiny Cards earns you Cataclysm Survivor Talent Points. These points can be used to unlock nodes in the Cataclysm Survivor Talent Tree.
The Talent Tree provides various bonuses for your future Cataclysm Survivor challenges.
DictionaryDiagram.20130104.2.cn:
累计收集命运卡即可获得灾变防线天赋点数，天赋点可用于激活灾变防线天赋树。
天赋树可为后续灾变防线挑战提供各种加成。

DictionaryDiagram.20130201.2.en: In Cataclysm Survivor battles, earn EXP to level up your Trekkers. Each level grants a random Destiny Card that boosts attributes for that run. Destiny Card effects carry over between the first and second halves of the battle.
DictionaryDiagram.20130201.2.cn:
灾变防线战斗中可收集经验提升等级！等级提升后可获得随机命运卡提升局内属性。
命运卡可在灾变防线上下半场中继承时间与效果！

DictionaryDiagram.20130202.2.en: After Cataclysm Talents are activated, you will receive a powerful Special Destiny Card once you've collected a certain number of cards from the same pack!
DictionaryDiagram.20130202.2.cn: 灾变天赋激活后，战斗中单一卡包收集达到指定数量即可获得强力的特殊命运卡！

DictionaryDiagram.20130203.2.en: An unknown force is affecting this battle! Pressing and holding Dodge will not activate Dash in Cataclysm Survivor.
DictionaryDiagram.20130203.2.cn: 灾变防线战斗中受到不明力量的影响，长按闪避不会进入疾跑状态！

DictionaryDiagram.20140101.2.en: Proving Grounds features multiple bosses for players to challenge weekly, and each boss can be challenged 3 times per week. Challenge attempts are replenished every Monday. You will not earn rewards for taking down bosses if you are out of challenge attempts.
DictionaryDiagram.20140101.2.cn: 真格挑战模式共有多个首领供您进行每周挑战，每周共有3次挑战次数，每周一自然日刷新时补充挑战次数。次数耗尽后挑战首领无法获得常规奖励。

DictionaryDiagram.20140102.2.en: Each boss drops its own unique materials. As different Trekkers have different development needs, you need to challenge specific bosses to obtain the required development materials.
DictionaryDiagram.20140102.2.cn: 每名首领产出自身对应的特殊素材，每名旅人的养成需求有所不同，需要挑战特定首领进行养成素材的获取。

DictionaryDiagram.20150101.2.en: Boss Blitz is a periodically refreshed event. Each cycle features two special Blitz missions with unique rules for Trekkers to conquer.
DictionaryDiagram.20150101.2.cn: 联合讨伐为周期刷新的玩法，每个玩法周期内指定2项带有特殊规则的讨伐任务，供旅人小队进行战斗讨伐。

DictionaryDiagram.20150102.2.en: Each special Blitz mission tracks its own Star count. Your total Stars for the cycle is the sum of the Stars achieved in both missions.
DictionaryDiagram.20150102.2.cn: 每项特殊讨伐任务分别纪录自身星数，两项星数相加为您本期获得总星数。

DictionaryDiagram.20150103.2.en: You can claim Stellante Dusts based on the total Stars you earned in the cycle.
DictionaryDiagram.20150103.2.cn: 您可根据本期获得的总星数领取钻石奖励。

DictionaryDiagram.20150104.2.en: Deal DMG within the time limit to earn DMG Score proportional to DMG dealt. Execute actions matching the bosses' mechanics to earn Technique Score per successful attempt.
DictionaryDiagram.20150104.2.cn: 您需要在规定时间内打出尽可能多的伤害，造成的伤害会按一定比例转化为分数。对应当期首领机制做出操作可按次数获得技巧得分。

DictionaryDiagram.20150105.2.en: Earn Stars by reaching specific score thresholds. Your highest Star count per mission is recorded.
DictionaryDiagram.20150105.2.cn: 分数达到特定节点后获取对应星数并被保存在本次讨伐记录中。

DictionaryDiagram.20150106.2.en: When a Blitz mission is complete and your score is recorded, the Trekkers used in this mission will be locked. Using locked Trekkers in another Blitz mission and recording a new score will clear your score and stars for the previous mission.
DictionaryDiagram.20150106.2.cn: 当您完成讨伐并上传分数后，所使用旅人将会被锁定于此讨伐任务中。若在其他讨伐任务中使用已锁定的旅人并提交分数，将会清空此处的分数并且不保留所获得的星数。

DictionaryDiagram.20160101.2.en:
Challenging a boss requires Showdown Decree</color>.
This item will be restored to maximum quantity daily during the event.
DictionaryDiagram.20160101.2.cn:
挑战首领需要消耗决战号令</color>
此道具在活动期间每天都会补齐到最大值。

DictionaryDiagram.20160102.2.en:
Select a boss of any difficulty</color> and begin the challenge.
You can engage in practice battles with bosses without consuming Challenge Tickets via Simulation</color>.
DictionaryDiagram.20160102.2.cn:
选择任意难度</color>的首领并开始挑战
通过模拟战</color>可不消耗挑战券与首领进行战斗演习。

DictionaryDiagram.20160201.2.en:
Even if you fail to defeat the boss in battle, you can dispatch a follow-up squad to challenge again.
In subsequent battles, the selected records must not include Trekkers who have been deployed before.
DictionaryDiagram.20160201.2.cn:
即便在战斗中没能击败首领，也可以再度派遣后续行动队进行挑战。
后续的战斗中，所选取的纪录不能包含之前已经出战过的旅人。

DictionaryDiagram.20170101.2.en:
The Operation: Shadow Siege is a new operation system initiated by Iori of the Trekker Association.
Track down and hunt each period's target to earn Hunter Medals—a proof of contribution issued by the Association.
DictionaryDiagram.20170101.2.cn:
猎影合围 是由地理协会的 伊织发起的全新作战机制。
通过追捕每一期的围猎目标可获得由协会颁发的 贡献凭证——追猎者奖章

DictionaryDiagram.20170102.2.en: The Trekker Association issues Tracking Permits and Siege Licenses based on each Trekker Guild's Activity level (Ⅴigor consumption). The former is used for tracking requests to gather clues. The latter allows cooperation with other Guilds to complete hunts.
DictionaryDiagram.20170102.2.cn: 地理协会将视各个旅人团体的活跃程度（干劲消耗）颁发 追踪委托书/围猎许可证。前者用于委托追踪获取线索。后者则用于协助其它旅团共同完成围猎

DictionaryDiagram.20170103.2.en:
Consume Tracking Permits to begin tracking that will trigger different outcomes.
When tracking progress is full, you can launch a hunt against the target.
DictionaryDiagram.20170103.2.cn:
消耗 追踪委托书 进行追踪，追踪将会触发不同结果。
追踪进度达到满值时，即可对目标展开讨伐行动。

DictionaryDiagram.20170104.2.en:
Earn points in Hunts to secure a star rating at settlement.
The Hunt concludes once the star limit is reached. A single Siege target requires multiple Hunts to defeat, meaning cooperation between different Guilds is the key to victory!
DictionaryDiagram.20170104.2.cn:
讨伐战中可获得积分，结算时基于积分获得星级评价。
星级达到上限时本次讨伐中止。单个围猎目标需要多次讨伐才能完成围猎，因此需要多个旅团互相协助。

DictionaryDiagram.20170105.2.en:
Join the Siege to boost your seasonal Siege Level and unlock powerful buffs.
Your Siege Level resets when a new bounty season begins.
DictionaryDiagram.20170105.2.cn:
参与围猎可提升赛季围猎等级，并解锁各种加成效果。
悬赏更新时，围猎等级将会重置。

DictionaryDiagram.30010101.2.en:
Trekkers automatically attack enemies within their range.
Select the Skill</color> button to cast skills.
Once your Ultimate is charged, select the Ultimate</color> button to cast it.
DictionaryDiagram.30010101.2.cn:
旅人会自动攻击范围内的敌人。
点击技能</color>按钮可以施放技能。
绝招充能完毕后，点击绝招</color>按钮可以施放绝招。

DictionaryDiagram.30010501.2.en: The Trekker will perform Auto Attacks when a target enters their Attack Range.
DictionaryDiagram.30010501.2.cn: 目标进入攻击范围时，角色会自动进行普通攻击。

DictionaryDiagram.30010601.2.en: Select the Main Skill button to cast the Main Skill.
DictionaryDiagram.30010601.2.cn: 点按主控技能按钮施放主控技能。

DictionaryDiagram.30010701.2.en: Any of the Main Trekker's</color> Auto Attacks and Skills against enemies charges the Ultimate cumulatively.
DictionaryDiagram.30010701.2.cn: 主控角色</color>对敌人发起的任意普通攻击与技能都可以积累绝招充能。

DictionaryDiagram.30010801.2.en: Select the Dodge button to dodge monsters's attacks. Invulnerable while dodging.
DictionaryDiagram.30010801.2.cn: 点按闪避按钮闪避怪物的攻击，闪避期间无敌。

DictionaryDiagram.30010901.2.en: Hold the Dodge button to dash. The Trekker will not auto attack during while moving.
DictionaryDiagram.30010901.2.cn: 长按闪避按钮进入疾跑状态，移动期间角色不会自动发起攻击。

DictionaryDiagram.30011001.1.cn: 战斗操作-援护角色技能

DictionaryDiagram.30011001.2.en: Select the Support Skill button to cast the Support Skill.
DictionaryDiagram.30011001.2.cn: 点按援护角色的技能按钮施放援护技能。

DictionaryDiagram.30011101.1.cn: 战斗操作-援护角色绝招

DictionaryDiagram.30011101.2.en: Select the support Trekker's Ultimate button to cast the Ultimate.
DictionaryDiagram.30011101.2.cn: 点按援护角色的绝招按钮施放绝招。

DictionaryDiagram.30011201.2.en:
Characters can inflict marks on targets or trigger existing marks for various additional effects.
Each character can trigger up to one mark per second for the same target.
DictionaryDiagram.30011201.2.cn:
角色可以对目标附加印记或触发已附加的印记，造成各种额外效果。
每个角色对同一目标每秒最多触发1次印记。

DictionaryDiagram.30011202.2.en:
As support characters, Support and Versatile characters apply Marks of their element.
A main character who is a Vanguard of the same element can then trigger this Mark.
DictionaryDiagram.30011202.2.cn:
辅助与均衡类角色作为援护角色时，可以附加对应元素属性的印记。
相同元素属性的先锋类角色作为主控角色时，可以触发该印记。

DictionaryDiagram.30011301.2.en: When a Trekker attacks a monster, the DMG dealt will vary based on the monster's elemental vulnerability or resistance.
DictionaryDiagram.30011301.2.cn: 角色在攻击怪物时，会根据怪物的元素弱点或元素抵抗产生不同伤害。

DictionaryDiagram.30011302.2.en: When a Trekker attacks a monster, the DMG dealt will vary based on the monster's elemental vulnerability or resistance.
DictionaryDiagram.30011302.2.cn: 角色在攻击怪物时，会根据怪物的元素弱点或元素抵抗产生不同伤害。

DictionaryDiagram.30011401.2.en: When challenging a level, pay attention to the level's recommended elements!
DictionaryDiagram.30011401.2.cn: 攻略关卡时，请注意关卡的推荐属性！

DictionaryDiagram.30011501.2.en: When a target has Resilience, its actions cannot be interrupted by external forces. When the target takes DMG, its Resilience is reduced.
DictionaryDiagram.30011501.2.cn: 目标拥有韧性时，行为不会被外界打断。目标受到伤害时，韧性会被削减。

DictionaryDiagram.30011601.2.en: A target with Broken Resilience will be immobilized for a prolonged period and takes additional DMG from Trekkers.
DictionaryDiagram.30011601.2.cn: 目标被破韧后将进入长时间硬直，角色可对其造成额外伤害。

DictionaryDiagram.30011701.2.en: If a target has been inflicted with a mark, try attacking it with a skill of the same element that can trigger the mark!
DictionaryDiagram.30011701.2.cn: 目标已经被附加印记，尝试使用可触发印记的同属性技能攻击目标！

DictionaryDiagram.30011801.2.en: You will receive Musical Notes by completing battle, making purchases in the shop, and encountering random events in the Monolith Walkthrough.
DictionaryDiagram.30011801.2.cn: 在星塔攻略中，通过完成星塔战斗、商店购买、随机事件等途径，可以获取音符。

DictionaryDiagram.40010101.2.en: Areas buried with rare treasures await Trekkers. Explore these areas to uncover these treasures, accumulate points, and earn generous rewards.
DictionaryDiagram.40010101.2.cn: 埋藏着宝藏的区域等待着旅人们的探寻，在区域中寻找宝藏累计积分，获取丰厚奖励。

DictionaryDiagram.40010102.2.en: During the event, every 20 Stamina consumed grants 1 Treasure Shovel. A certain number of shovels will be sent to your backpack upon daily log-in.
DictionaryDiagram.40010102.2.cn: 活动开启期间，每消耗20体力即可获取1把寻宝铲子。活动期间每日累计一定数量的铲子，登录时发放至背包。

DictionaryDiagram.40010103.2.en: Select a tile to hit it with the Treasure Shovel and reduce its Durability. The tile downgrades with durability loss until it is destroyed. Fragile tiles are an exception: they cannot be created by downgrading, and they are destroyed automatically when adjacent tiles are destroyed.
DictionaryDiagram.40010103.2.cn: 点击地块即可使用寻宝铲子对地块进行削弱，区域中的地块拥有不同的初始耐久度，耐久度被铲子削减后自动降级为次一级的地块，耐久度降至最低后消解。脆弱地块不可由更高级的地块降级生成，其在周围地块被消解时自动消解。

DictionaryDiagram.40010104.2.en: Buried treasures come in four shapes (see above) and occupy multiple tiles. Pay attention to the parts revealed in the destroyed tiles to collect treasures more efficiently.
DictionaryDiagram.40010104.2.cn: 埋藏在地块中的宝藏共计上图中四种形状，占据多个地块格子，留意消解的格子中露出的部分可以更有效率的获取宝藏。

DictionaryDiagram.40010105.2.en: Collected treasures are automatically converted into points. Accumulate points to complete event tasks and claim rewards.
DictionaryDiagram.40010105.2.cn: 宝藏获取后自动转化为价值积分，累计价值积分可完成活动任务，获取任务奖励。

DictionaryDiagram.40010106.2.en: Each floor contains 3 randomly placed treasures. You will progress to the next floor upon collecting all of them. When you progress to a new floor, 2 random Trekkers will spawn and provide Support Skills. Use these skills wisely to obtain treasures more efficiently.
DictionaryDiagram.40010106.2.cn: 每层共计随机出现3个宝藏，全部获取后自动进入下一层，进入下层时，随机出现两名旅人提供支援技能，合理使用支援技能能够更有效率的获取宝藏。

DictionaryDiagram.40020101.2.en: Upon entering a match, you will start with a few random Trekker pieces from your preset squad, then gradually obtain the remaining ones over the following waves of monsters. All Trekkers in this mode have redesigned stats, independent of your own roster.
DictionaryDiagram.40020101.2.cn: 进入棋局时，您会随机获取预编队中的数个“游棋”角色，并在后续的怪物波次中，逐个获取其他编队中的角色。“游棋”角色是本模式特有的内容，与您的旅人获取情况无关；其技能数值也与纪录、养成等其他系统无关。

DictionaryDiagram.40020102.2.en: Monsters advance along a fixed path. Place characters on the slots to defeat them before they reach the finish line. Keep an eye on your defense durability — it represents the maximum number of monsters the end zone can withstand.
DictionaryDiagram.40020102.2.cn:
怪物会沿着既定路线向终点移动，玩家需要在部署位上布置角色，在它到达终点前击败它。
注意防线的耐久值，这里代表了终点最多承受的怪物数。

DictionaryDiagram.40020103.2.en: Characters will perform Auto Attacks. When the Skill Charge bar is full and the time is right, characters will cast skills automatically.
DictionaryDiagram.40020103.2.cn: 角色会自动进行普通攻击。在技能充能条蓄满并且时机合适时，会自动释放技能。

DictionaryDiagram.40020201.2.en:
Defeat monsters or wait to gain EXP over time. Once your EXP bar fills up, it's converted into an Upgrade Point.
Each stage has its own limit on how many Upgrade Points you can earn.
DictionaryDiagram.40020201.2.cn:
击败怪物或随着时间流逝，可以积累经验，经验到达上限时消耗所有经验并获取1点升级点数。
不同关卡内最多可获取的升级点数各不相同。

DictionaryDiagram.40020202.2.en: Tap the character's Upgrade button once you've collected enough Upgrade Points to level her up and enhance her abilities.
DictionaryDiagram.40020202.2.cn: 当拥有足够的升级点数时，点击角色并点击升级按钮，可以消耗升级点数为其升级，提升能力。

DictionaryDiagram.40020203.2.en: Activate a character's powerful Potentials at Level 4 and Level 6.
DictionaryDiagram.40020203.2.cn: 当升到4级与6级时可以选择激活强力潜能。

DictionaryDiagram.40020301.2.en: In some matches, you'll have access to special items you've prepared beforehand, each with unique effects in battle. Your item this match is Crunchy Shaved Ice. Use it to freeze monsters in a large area once and slow them down for a prolonged period.
DictionaryDiagram.40020301.2.cn: 部分棋局可使用预先准备好的特别道具，对战场起到不同的影响。本次提供道具为【酷脆刨冰】，可以对大范围内的怪物造成一次冰冻与长时间的减速效果。

DictionaryDiagram.40020401.2.en: Teresa creates a water field that gives buffs to nearby friendly units.
DictionaryDiagram.40020401.2.cn: 特丽莎释放的水域会为周围友方角色提供增益。

DictionaryDiagram.40020402.2.en: Fuyuka deals massive DMG to close-by targets over time.
DictionaryDiagram.40020402.2.cn: 冬香可以对近距离造成高额持续的输出。

DictionaryDiagram.40020403.2.en: Nazuna's penguin plushie follows the target and then explodes, dealing various debuffs to the target.
DictionaryDiagram.40020403.2.cn: 小禾的企鹅玩偶会追踪目标进行自爆，为目标施加各种减益效果

DictionaryDiagram.40020501.2.en: Incoming enemies are instantly defeated if they fall into the water!
DictionaryDiagram.40020501.2.cn: 来袭的敌人如果落入水域，即可直接将其消灭！

DictionaryDiagram.40020502.2.en:
Coronis' skill covers a wider area, indicated by a blue circle.
She can also drag enemies toward her. Deploy her now to see how it works!
DictionaryDiagram.40020502.2.cn:
科洛妮丝的技能拥有更大的索敌范围，以蓝色圆圈表示。
不仅如此，她还可以将敌人向她身旁拖拽，部署并尝试一下她的效果吧！

DictionaryDiagram.40020601.2.en: Coronis can drag enemies into the water, while Nazuka can push them in. Deploy both to try out this strategy!
DictionaryDiagram.40020601.2.cn: 科洛妮丝可以通过拖拽使敌人落入水域，而夏花可以推动敌人达成这个效果，部署并尝试一下吧！

DictionaryDiagram.40020701.2.en:
Watch out for Elite enemies! They have higher Weight and cannot be dragged or pushed far.
However, attacks from Ann's summons reduce their Weight, allowing you to move them.
DictionaryDiagram.40020701.2.cn:
留意精英级敌人，它们具有更多的“重量”，无法被拖拽或推远。
但杏子的召唤物攻击可以使精英级敌人的“重量”降低，使其可以被拉拽或推动。

DictionaryDiagram.40020801.2.en: The special item for this Chess Defense is Large Pep Pep Juice. Use it to instantly recharge the skills of all Trekker pieces within a small radius.
DictionaryDiagram.40020801.2.cn: 本次“游棋保卫战”活动的道具是“大瓶装能量沛沛”，可立即使小范围的所有游棋角色的技能立即完成充能。

DictionaryDiagram.40020901.2.en: Firenze summons Shadow Clones to aid in battle.
DictionaryDiagram.40020901.2.cn: 翡冷翠可以放出分身暗影协助战斗。

DictionaryDiagram.40021001.2.en: Boss enemies have even higher Weight than Elites. You'll need to find additional ways to reduce their Weight if you want to drag or push them!
DictionaryDiagram.40021001.2.cn: 首领敌人的“重量”比精英敌人更高。如果想拖拽或推动这类敌人，需要探索额外的“减重”措施！

DictionaryDiagram.40021101.2.en: Watch out for Bush on the board. Enemy units hidden in Bush are immune to damage.
DictionaryDiagram.40021101.2.cn: 留意棋局场地上的「草丛」，位于「草丛」中的敌方单位免疫伤害。

DictionaryDiagram.40021102.2.en: Use a Growth Inhibitor to clear Bush from the battlefield.
DictionaryDiagram.40021102.2.cn: 使用「杂草抑制剂」即可清除场地上的「草丛」。

DictionaryDiagram.40021201.1.cn: 游棋保卫战-注意草丛法术

DictionaryDiagram.40021201.2.en: Elite enemies are here! They can cast spells to spawn new patches of Bush!
DictionaryDiagram.40021201.2.cn: 精英级敌人出现！它们可以对场地施法，生成新的「草丛」！

DictionaryDiagram.40021301.1.cn: 游棋保卫战-注意大规模草丛法术

DictionaryDiagram.40021301.2.en: Boss enemies cast stronger spells than Elites, spawning Bush over massive areas!
DictionaryDiagram.40021301.2.cn: 首领级敌人可以施展比精英级敌人更强的法术，使大片范围场地生成「草丛」！

DictionaryDiagram.40022001.2.en: An idle character continuously accumulates Heat. At max Heat, the character becomes Heatstroke and cannot attack or use skills for a short duration.
DictionaryDiagram.40022001.2.cn: 角色放置后会持续累积「炎热值」，升满后进入「中暑」状态，短时间内无法攻击和释放技能。

DictionaryDiagram.40022101.2.en: Using Canned Stormcloud creates rainfall over an area, significantly reducing the Heat of a character.
DictionaryDiagram.40022101.2.cn: 使用道具「罐装乌云」在一定范围内生成降雨，可以显著降低角色「炎热值」。

DictionaryDiagram.40022102.1.cn: 游棋保卫战-注意精英怪物

DictionaryDiagram.40022102.2.en: An elite enemy appears! If a character stands inside the heated zone around it, Heat will build up faster.
DictionaryDiagram.40022102.2.cn: 精英级敌人出现！角色一旦位于其周围的炎热领域内，「炎热值」会加速累积！

DictionaryDiagram.40022201.2.en: Characters on Ablaze deployment slots build up Heat faster. Use Canned Stormcloud to extinguish the fire.
DictionaryDiagram.40022201.2.cn: 位于「着火」部署位上的角色「炎热值」上升更快。使用道具「罐装乌云」可扑灭火焰。

DictionaryDiagram.40022202.1.cn: 游棋保卫战-注意精英怪物

DictionaryDiagram.40022202.2.en: An elite enemy appears! It shoots fireballs that set deployment slots Ablaze and increase the Heat of characters on those slots.
DictionaryDiagram.40022202.2.cn: 精英级敌人出现！其会发射火球，命中部署位后使该格「着火」，并增加其上角色的「炎热值」。

DictionaryDiagram.40022301.1.cn: 游棋保卫战-注意首领怪物

DictionaryDiagram.40022301.2.en: A boss enemy appears! It summons full‑screen flame waves and calls down heavenly fire to set deployment slots Ablaze. Be prepared!
DictionaryDiagram.40022301.2.cn: 首领级敌人出现！其会召唤全屏焰浪提升所有角色「炎热值」，还会降下天火使部署位「着火」。注意应对！

DictionaryDiagram.40030101.2.en:
Select Start Packing to start the game!
Pack as many cookies correctly as possible in a limited time!
DictionaryDiagram.40030101.2.cn:
点击“开始装盒”后，游戏就正式开始！
在时限内尽可能快速地装入正确的饼干吧！

DictionaryDiagram.40030201.2.en:
In the Basic Cartoning stage, tap the corresponding cookies below based on the cookie pattern shown on the plate, then place them inside the box. Correct placement earns points and builds progress.
Completing each box yields additional points. Reach the target progress within the time limit to clear the challenge.
DictionaryDiagram.40030201.2.cn:
在“基础图纸”关卡中，根据盘中的饼干图案，点按选择下方的对应饼干就可放入盒中。正确放置即可得分并积累进度。
每次完整的装盒都会获得更多得分。在时限内达成进度即可完成挑战。

DictionaryDiagram.40030301.2.en: In the Intricate Cartoning stage, the placement order of cookies changes. Every new gift box may present with a completely different sequence!
DictionaryDiagram.40030301.2.cn: 在“精密蓝图”关卡中，放置饼干的路线顺序会发生变化。每个新的礼盒都可能是不同的放置顺序！

DictionaryDiagram.40030401.2.en: In the Flash of Genius stage, you need to place cookies at just the right time. Perfect timing awards higher points.
DictionaryDiagram.40030401.2.cn: 在“天才创想”关卡中，需要在恰当的时机放入饼干。准确的时机可获得更高的得分。

DictionaryDiagram.40030501.2.en:
In the Loose Creative Mode, you must both follow the placement sequence when placing cookies AND pay attention to the timing.
Multiple incorrect cookie placements or missing the beat can lead to challenge failure!
DictionaryDiagram.40030501.2.cn:
在“暴走”模式中，既要按照路线顺序放入饼干，还需要留意准确时机。
多次错误放置饼干、或是错过节拍都可能导致挑战失败！

DictionaryDiagram.40040101.2.en:
Select the launch button to fire the marble, which will damage any tiles it hits.
Move the launch pad to catch the marble. Each time the marble falls and is destroyed, one life point will be deducted. If all life points are lost, you'll fail the stage.
DictionaryDiagram.40040101.2.cn:
按发球键发射弹珠，弹珠会摧毁撞击的晶块。
移动发射台接住弹珠，避免弹珠落地被摧毁。
每当弹珠落地被摧毁，角色会损失一点生命。注意当前的生命，如果全部损失则关卡失败。

DictionaryDiagram.40040102.2.en: Trekker skills automatically recharge. Once fully charged, you can unleash the skill to destroy tiles.
DictionaryDiagram.40040102.2.cn: 角色技能会自动充能，充能满后，玩家可以释放技能来摧毁晶块。

DictionaryDiagram.40040103.2.en: Destroying tiles earns you stage points. When your points reach the target score, you win.
DictionaryDiagram.40040103.2.cn: 摧毁晶块可以获得关卡积分，当积分达到目标得分时即可获得胜利。

DictionaryDiagram.40040104.2.en: Some stages feature field devices. The speed-altering device can change the motions of energy balls that pass through them: The blue devices speed them up; the red devices slow them down. When an explosive device is destroyed by the player's skill or an energy ball, it detonates and destroys nearby destructible objects.
DictionaryDiagram.40040104.2.cn: 部分关卡中会出现场地机关。变速机关会根据自身状态改变途经能量球的移动速度：蓝色机关为加速，红色机关为减速。爆炸装置被玩家技能或能量球击破后，会引爆并摧毁周围的可破坏物。

DictionaryDiagram.40040201.2.en:
Destroying tiles has a chance to drop various items.
Move the launch pad to catch and collect these items.
Items can be either Buffs or Debuffs. Aim for the best, and dodge the rest!
DictionaryDiagram.40040201.2.cn:
摧毁晶块后，有概率掉落不同种类的道具。
移动发射台接住道具可以拾取道具。
道具有增益道具也有减益道具，努力拾取增益道具，并避免拾取减益道具。

DictionaryDiagram.40040301.2.en: Some stages contain monsters that will launch bombs at you. Be sure to dodge them! Direct hits to your launch pad will reduce life points.
DictionaryDiagram.40040301.2.cn: 部分关卡存在怪物，怪物会对玩家发出炸弹，注意躲避。如果炸弹命中发射台会扣除生命。

DictionaryDiagram.40040401.2.en: Some stages feature ejector pillars that will repel and accelerate any marbles that strike them. There may also be black holes that warp the trajectory of any marbles passing nearby.
DictionaryDiagram.40040401.2.cn: 部分关卡内存在场地机关，弹射柱机关会将撞击它的弹珠加速弹开。黑洞机关则会改变经过它的弹珠的移动轨迹。

DictionaryDiagram.40040402.2.en: Some stages feature field devices. The Gravity Well alters the motions of energy balls passing through them: The blue devices attract them; the red devices repel them.
DictionaryDiagram.40040402.2.cn: 部分关卡中会出现场地机关。重力井机关会根据自身状态改变途经能量球的运动轨迹：蓝色机关为牵引，红色机关为排斥。

DictionaryDiagram.40040501.2.en: When an energy ball enters the portal, it is instantly transported to the other end.
DictionaryDiagram.40040501.2.cn: 能量球进入传送门后，会立刻被传送到另一端。

DictionaryDiagram.40040601.2.en: After you pick up the Gravity Button, the portal will actively draw in nearby energy balls for a period of time.
DictionaryDiagram.40040601.2.cn: 拾取重力按钮后，传送门在一段时间内会主动吸取附近的能量球。

DictionaryDiagram.40050101.2.en: Follow the instructions of Bernina and Virigia to dive into the fun world of Fatebound Stellar Deck!
DictionaryDiagram.40050101.2.cn: 顺着珀尔娜和维嘉尔的指引，来一场有趣的命运星牌局吧！

DictionaryDiagram.40050102.2.en:
Flip the Elemental Cards to make specific hands and win Fate Coins.
Achieve the Fate Coin collection goal before your remaining turns run out to win the match!
DictionaryDiagram.40050102.2.cn:
翻开元素牌，构成特定的牌型，赢取命运币。
在剩余回合耗尽前达成命运币收集目标，即可赢下牌局！

DictionaryDiagram.40050103.2.en: You can obtain Fatebound Stellar Cards before each turn starts. Each card grants an additional buff, giving you more advantages.
DictionaryDiagram.40050103.2.cn: 回合开始前可获取星命牌，每张星命牌都可以带来额外的加成，为你带来更多优势。

DictionaryDiagram.40050104.2.en:
You must choose and sign a contract during the match.
Fulfilling it grants bonuses, but failing to fulfill a contract 3 times will end the match.
DictionaryDiagram.40050104.2.cn:
对局过程中需要选择任一合约签署
履约成功时可获取加成，未能履约达到3次后牌局结束。

DictionaryDiagram.40060101.2.en:
In Arc of Abundance, you control a soda cannon to launch Sherlocks into the shopping basket.
Hold and pull the cannon back to adjust the launch speed and angle. Release to launch Sherlock—use the aiming line to guide your shot.
DictionaryDiagram.40060101.2.cn:
豪礼抛物线的基本游戏内容是操作汽水炮台发射夏洛克，令其准确落入购物篮。
长按汽水炮台，向后拖拽即可改变发射时的速度和角度，可观察引导线判断路径。调整合适后松手，即可发射夏洛克。

DictionaryDiagram.40060102.2.en: If Sherlock lands in a shopping basket matching the color of his scarf, you will earn more points.
DictionaryDiagram.40060102.2.cn: 根据当前发射的夏洛克围巾的颜色，如果成功投进了对应颜色的购物篮可以获得更高分数。

DictionaryDiagram.40060201.2.en: When a Sherlock lands in a shopping basket marked with a special icon, you get a chance to select an item.
DictionaryDiagram.40060201.2.cn: 当夏洛克落入具有特殊标识的购物篮时，即可获得一次选择道具的机会。

DictionaryDiagram.40060202.2.en: Pick your preferred item and clear the stage!
DictionaryDiagram.40060202.2.cn: 选择心仪的道具，助力通关吧！

DictionaryDiagram.40060203.2.en: You can store up to 2 items each game. Each new item acquired will replace the earliest acquired one. If you find a stage challenging, use the items to gain an advantage!
DictionaryDiagram.40060203.2.cn: 在单局游戏过程中，最多可储存2个道具。获得新道具时，会替换最先获得的道具。如果过关有困难，先尝试使用道具破局吧！

DictionaryDiagram.40060301.2.en: A new mechanism appears—Blower! Use the power of Ventus to blow Sherlock into the shopping basket!
DictionaryDiagram.40060301.2.cn: 关卡内出现新的机关——鼓风机！请借助风的力量，将夏洛克吹入购物篮中吧！

DictionaryDiagram.40060401.2.en: A new mechanism appears—Teleport Basin! Use its power to move Sherlock swiftly through shortcuts!
DictionaryDiagram.40060401.2.cn: 关卡内出现新的机关——传送盆！请借助传送盆的力量，让夏洛克通过捷径灵活移动吧！

DictionaryDiagram.40060501.1.cn: 豪礼抛物线-弹射夏洛克

DictionaryDiagram.40060501.2.en: Sherlock will bounce between obstacles! Use the stage layout wisely and calculate trajectories to launch Sherlock into the shopping basket!
DictionaryDiagram.40060501.2.cn: 夏洛克会在障碍物之间弹来弹去！请合理利用关卡布局，计算运动轨迹，将夏洛克弹入购物篮中吧！

DictionaryDiagram.40060701.1.en: Arc of Abundance: Perfect Blind Toss

DictionaryDiagram.40060701.2.en: Welcome to Perfect Blind Toss mode! The shopping basket is initially invisible. Launch a Sherlock to scout the path, then adjust the launch angle and speed based on the trail left behind to achieve a perfect Blind Toss!
DictionaryDiagram.40060701.2.cn: 欢迎来到精准盲投模式！购物篮初始处于不可见状态，先发射夏洛克探探路，再根据留下的痕迹调整发射角度和速度，达成“盲投”的目标吧！

DictionaryDiagram.40070101.2.en: Swing the grapple to grab treasures from the room. Reach the target score before time runs out to complete the challenge.
DictionaryDiagram.40070101.2.cn: 摇摆的钩爪能把房间里的宝物一件件带回，在规定时间内累计达到目标积分，即可完成挑战。

DictionaryDiagram.40070102.2.en: Different supplies vary in points and weight. Remember, the shiny ones are usually more valuable.
DictionaryDiagram.40070102.2.cn: 不同物资重量各异，对应的积分也不同，记住，闪闪发光的宝物往往价值更高。

DictionaryDiagram.40070103.2.en:
Low-value but heavy briefcases will slow you down. When necessary, use the Explosive Skill to destroy them.
Note: Explosive Skill has limited uses, so time it well!
DictionaryDiagram.40070103.2.cn:
价值不高却十分沉重的公文包会拖慢进度，如有需要，可使用爆破技能将其炸毁。
注意：爆破次数有限，请务必留到关键时刻使用。

DictionaryDiagram.40070201.2.en: This operation spans two rooms. You must reach the target score in the current room to unlock the next.
DictionaryDiagram.40070201.2.cn: 本次行动分为两个房间进行，只有在当前房间累计达到目标积分，才能解锁并进入下一个房间。

DictionaryDiagram.40070202.2.en: Watch out for these bomb traps! They may not only destroy nearby supplies but also potentially trigger chain explosions.
DictionaryDiagram.40070202.2.cn: 小心这些一碰即炸的炸弹陷阱！它们不仅会摧毁周围的物资，严重时还可能引发连锁爆炸。

DictionaryDiagram.40070301.2.en: Mechanical devices roam the room. Sweepers' allegiance is unclear, but drones are dangerous sentries—stay away from them.
DictionaryDiagram.40070301.2.cn: 房间内有来回移动的机械装置。扫地机属性不明，但无人机是危险的守卫，请务必小心避开。

DictionaryDiagram.40070302.2.en: Watch out for patrolling drones! If they detect you, they'll trigger an alarm and drastically reduce your remaining time.
DictionaryDiagram.40070302.2.cn: 小心巡逻的无人机！一旦被其发现，将触发警报，大幅缩短行动时间。

DictionaryDiagram.40070303.2.en:
Sweepers' behavior are unpredictable. They can be friend or foe.
They often snatch items before you do, but if you catch them, the points still count as yours.
Caution: Sweepers may bump into other objects while moving and slow down your progress.
DictionaryDiagram.40070303.2.cn:
扫地机的运行状态并不固定，有时会成为阻碍，也可能带来帮助。
它们经常会先一步吸走场景中的物资，但只要抓到扫地机，其中的物资积分依然会归你所有。
需要注意的是，扫地机在移动过程中也可能碰到其他物体，扰乱局面影响进度。

DictionaryDiagram.40070304.2.en: The Freeze Field can temporarily immobilize all moving devices in the scene. Timing it right will give you more time to act.
DictionaryDiagram.40070304.2.cn: 冻结力场可使场景中的移动装置暂时停摆，把握好时机，能让你的行动更加从容。

DictionaryDiagram.40070401.2.en:
Watch out for these Detection Artifacts. If they detect you, they'll trigger an alarm and reduce your remaining time.
Note: Detection Artifact cannot be grabbed.
DictionaryDiagram.40070401.2.cn:
小心这些探测神器，一旦被探测到即会触发警报，从而缩短行动时间。
注意，探测神器无法抓取。

DictionaryDiagram.40070402.2.en: Freeze the rotating Detection Artifacts, and your mission will be much easier.
DictionaryDiagram.40070402.2.cn: 冻结旋转的探测神器，或许能让你的行动更加顺利。

DictionaryDiagram.40070501.2.en: Mysterious supplies and Special Intel missions that appear during the mission may help you score higher.
DictionaryDiagram.40070501.2.cn: 行动期间会出现神秘物资和特派情报任务，它们或许能帮助你获取更高积分。

DictionaryDiagram.40070502.2.en:
Grab the supplies on the Special Mission and earn bonus points.
Different missions demand different quantities which yield different bonus points, though single-item missions are often more efficient.
DictionaryDiagram.40070502.2.cn:
根据特派清单上的要求，抓获指定的物资即可获得额外积分。
不同任务需要的物资数量不同，对应获得的额外积分也不同。通常来说，单个物资的任务性价比更高。

DictionaryDiagram.40070503.2.en: Mysterious supplies offer powerful effects. Stack and combine their effects, and even a heavy, low-value briefcase can turn into valuable loot.
DictionaryDiagram.40070503.2.cn: 神秘物资会带来各种特殊效果，这些效果相互叠加、组合后，即便是又重又廉价的公文包，也可能变成宝贝。

DictionaryDiagram.40080101.1.en: Welcome to the Cooling Supply Station

DictionaryDiagram.40080101.2.en:
Welcome to the Cooling Supply Station! The summer bash is in full swing, and you'll be running this refreshing little shop, whipping up custom ice cream for every customer.
But keep in mind, a customer's patience melts away as fast as ice cream—don't keep them waiting!
DictionaryDiagram.40080101.2.cn:
欢迎来到沁凉补给站！酷暑派对正酣，您将执掌这方清凉小铺，为到访的每一位顾客制作专属口味的冰淇淋。
不过请切记，顾客的耐心就像正在融化的冰淇淋一样转瞬即逝——别让客人们等太久！

DictionaryDiagram.40080102.2.en:
Once you open for business, check the order bubbles next to the customers to see what they want.
Tap the toppings to select the right ice cream scoops for their order!
DictionaryDiagram.40080102.2.cn:
开始营业后，通过观察顾客身旁的需求气泡即可得知订单内容。
点击配料，选择符合口味的冰淇淋球吧！

DictionaryDiagram.40080103.2.en: After picking your ice cream scoops, don't forget the crucial final step: adding the toppings! You need to get both the flavor and the toppings right to successfully complete an order!
DictionaryDiagram.40080103.2.cn:
搭配完冰淇淋球，别忘了最后的关键一步——撒上配料。
口味和配料都选择正确，才算正确完成订单！

DictionaryDiagram.40080104.2.en:
If you get the flavor or toppings wrong, the customer won't be happy!
But don't panic! Just tap the trash can to toss the mistake, then quickly whip up a fresh one!
DictionaryDiagram.40080104.2.cn:
无论冰淇淋的口味或是配料挑选错误，客人都不会满意！
别慌乱，点按回收桶即可丢弃，然后赶紧为客人重新制作一份吧！

DictionaryDiagram.40080201.2.en:
Is that special customer ... Sherlock?!
Complete its order to earn various Summer Drinks, which you can use to gain powerful boosts!
DictionaryDiagram.40080201.2.cn:
咦?这位特殊顾客是……夏洛克？！
完成夏洛克的订单可获得各种“夏日酷饮”，使用后便可获得强力的饮品效果！

DictionaryDiagram.40080202.2.en: Open your bag to view Summer Drinks details.
DictionaryDiagram.40080202.2.cn: 打开背包，可查看夏日酷饮详情

DictionaryDiagram.40080301.2.en:
Serve the correct ice cream to fill the progress bar, build combos, and activate Fever Mode. Your score will skyrocket during this time!
Be careful, though—running out of time or messing up an order will break your combo.
DictionaryDiagram.40080301.2.cn:
制作出正确的冰淇淋即可积攒进度条，达成连击成就，进入“欢乐时光”！
此时您的分数将会迅速攀升！
需要注意，超时或制作错误的冰淇淋将中断连击。

DictionaryDiagram.40080401.2.en:
The summer fun never ends! In Endless Challenge mode, running out of time will cost you HP.
Make smart use of your Summer Drinks, rack up massive combos, and aim for the highest score possible!
DictionaryDiagram.40080401.2.cn:
夏日漫无止境！在无限挑战模式中，超时将扣除生命值。
合理利用各种酷饮效果，积攒更多的连击，尽可能赚取更高的分数吧！

DictionaryDiagram.40090101.2.en:
In Through Hostile Depths, you will match your wits against a mysterious sage, leading the Trekkers under your command—along with powerful allies and former foes—as Chess Pieces to play out the match!
Use Talent Gold to recruit pieces, expand your team, reach the Final Battle, and claim victory!
DictionaryDiagram.40090101.2.cn:
在“尖兵陷阵”模式中，您将与神秘的智者对弈，以您麾下的旅人或是曾为敌为友的强力成员作为棋子，展开棋局！
您的目标是：使用贤才金币招募棋子，持续扩充阵容并存活，抵达终盘赢得胜利！

DictionaryDiagram.40090102.2.en:
In a match of Through Hostile Depths, the board consists of a maximum 3 Offense slots and 6 Assist slots.
The 3 Offense slots each have unique buffs, and pieces placed here receive the corresponding bonuses.
Pieces deployed in Offense slots face enemies directly in battle, and cast Offense Skills when their Energy is full.
Pieces deployed in Assist slots do not enter the field, but cast Assist Skills when their Energy is full.
DictionaryDiagram.40090102.2.cn:
一局“尖兵陷阵”中，棋组的最多构成为3主战+6后援配置。
主战配置的3个棋位有分别不同的加成，置于该棋位的棋子将享受对应加成。
部署在主战配置的棋子在战斗中直面敌人作战，并在能量充满时施放主战技；
部署在后援配置的棋子不会常驻登场，但会在满能量时施放后援技。

DictionaryDiagram.40090103.2.en: A match is divided into several phases, each composed of multiple nodes. Node types include Encounter, Opportunity, Lord, and Final Battle.
DictionaryDiagram.40090103.2.cn: 棋局分为几个阶段，每个阶段有若干节点组成。节点的类型有遇敌、契机、首领和终盘决战。

DictionaryDiagram.40090104.2.en:
Encounter: Combat node. Enemies grow stronger as the match progresses. Only Encounter battles count toward Win/Lose Streaks.
Opportunity: Grants an Opportunity choice with three Challenge difficulties. You may roll the Dice before choosing. If the result meets the requirement, you can claim the reward directly without taking the Challenge.
DictionaryDiagram.40090104.2.cn:
遇敌：发生战斗的节点，随着棋局深入，敌人也将逐渐变强；只有“遇敌”节点的战斗结果会被计入连胜或连败次数。
契机：发生一次契机选择的节点，会提供3个难度的契机挑战对应不同难度。选择前可投掷尊者骰子，结果满足契机条件，可跳过挑战直接领奖。

DictionaryDiagram.40090105.2.en:
Sanity (SAN) is the key to maintaining your focus during a match. If SAN reaches 0, the match ends immediately.
Losing a battle reduces SAN, while winning restores a small amount.
Remaining SAN at the end of the Final Battle affects your final score.
DictionaryDiagram.40090105.2.cn:
理智值是您得以在对弈中保持清醒的关键。理智值归零时、本场棋局即告失败。
在对弈过程中，每次战斗失败都将会扣减一定的理智；战斗胜利时则会恢复少量理智。
终盘决战后，当前理智值也会影响本场棋局的最终得分。

DictionaryDiagram.40090106.2.en:
Battles, including Auto Attacks, Offense Skills, and Assist Skills, are fully automatic.
Victory is achieved by defeating all enemies; defeat occurs if all your Offense pieces are defeated.
Each battle has a countdown; once the countdown ends, all healing will be disabled across the field, and both sides will unleash their full firepower to speed up the battle.
DictionaryDiagram.40090106.2.cn:
棋局的战斗过程是全自动的，普通攻击、主战或后援技都不需要操控。
消灭所有敌人时战斗胜利；您的主战配置棋子全部倒下则战斗失败。
每局战斗中都存在倒计时，倒计时结束后，战场全面禁疗，双方将火力全开加速战斗结算过程。

DictionaryDiagram.40090107.2.en:
Each piece has a recruitment cost in the Shop, ranging from 1 to 5.
Higher-cost pieces generally possess more powerful Skills or superior stats, but they also have a lower probability of appearing in the Shop.
DictionaryDiagram.40090107.2.cn:
每个棋子在商店中都有对应的招募价格，分别为1、2、3、4、5费。
费用更高的棋子往往拥有更强力的技能或数值，但出现在商店中的概率也更低。

DictionaryDiagram.40090108.2.en:
Having 3 identical pieces automatically combines them into the same piece with a higher star level.
As the star level increases, the piece's stats will greatly improve. Typically, 3★ is the strongest level.
DictionaryDiagram.40090108.2.cn:
拥有3个完全相同的棋子时会自动合成为高1星的同名棋子。
随着星级提升，棋子的能力也会得到大幅提升，通常3星就是棋子的最强形态

DictionaryDiagram.40090109.2.en:
Pieces are classified as Offense, Assist, and Balanced.
Pieces can be deployed anywhere on the board, but the abilities or mechanics of Offense pieces only take effect when they're deployed in Offense slots. The same applies to Assist pieces.
Balanced pieces can use their full abilities in any slot.
DictionaryDiagram.40090109.2.cn:
棋子定位有3种：主战型、后援型与全能型。
棋子虽然都可部署在棋盘的任意位置，但主战型棋子的有关能力或机制只会在主战配置起效；
后援型棋子同理，只能在后援配置起效；而全能型棋子部署在任意棋位均可发挥其全部能力。

DictionaryDiagram.40090110.2.en:
Each piece comes with one or more Trait affixes.
Deploy pieces with matching Traits to activate powerful synergy effects when conditions are met.
The higher the Trait level, the stronger the effect.
DictionaryDiagram.40090110.2.cn:
每个棋子都附带有一个或多个“羁绊”词条。
部署具有相同羁绊的棋子，满足数量条件时即可激活羁绊效果，大幅提升棋组实力。
羁绊等级越高，效果越强

DictionaryDiagram.40090111.2.en: You can use the Track Traits function on specific Traits. In the Shop, pieces associated with tracked Traits will be marked to help you identify them and achieve synergy effects quickly.
DictionaryDiagram.40090111.2.cn: 可对特定羁绊使用“羁绊追踪”功能，在商店中，带有追踪羁绊的棋子将会被标记提醒，助您更顺利的组成羁绊阵容。

DictionaryDiagram.40090112.2.en: At the beginning of a match, you can choose 1 of 3 Starting Plans. Opportunity nodes may grant additional Blessing choices. Choosing the right Plan or Blessings can provide major bonuses for the match.
DictionaryDiagram.40090112.2.cn: 开局时，您可以从“起始方针”中进行一次3选1；每次抵达“契机”节点时，也有机会获得额外的一次“祝福”选择；方针或祝福效果都可能给您带来巨大增益。

DictionaryDiagram.40090113.2.en:
Talent Gold is the core currency used to recruit pieces, refresh the Shop, and raise the Shop Level.
Node Income = Base Gold + Interest + Win/Lose Streak Bonus + Gold from extra bonuses, special Pieces, or special Traits.
DictionaryDiagram.40090113.2.cn:
贤才金币是用于在商店中招募棋子，刷新商店、提升商店等级的核心资源，请小心规划使用。
每个节点完成后的金币收入=基础金币+利息+连胜/连败金币+额外增益/特殊棋子/特殊羁绊获取的金币

DictionaryDiagram.40090114.2.en: You can use Talent Gold to recruit desired pieces in the Shop. Spend 2 Gold to refresh the Shop. The Shop automatically refreshes once when entering a new node, unless you have set it to locked.
DictionaryDiagram.40090114.2.cn: 使用贤才金币可在商店中招募心仪的棋子；您可花费2贤才金币刷新商店中出现的棋子；每次进入新节点时商店会自动刷新1次；若您已将商店设置为锁定状态，进入下个节点时，商店将不会自动刷新。

DictionaryDiagram.40090115.2.en:
Higher Shop levels increase the probability of recruiting high-cost pieces and expand your deployment limit.
Shop EXP is earned automatically per node or can be purchased with Talent Gold.
DictionaryDiagram.40090115.2.cn:
随着商店等级提升，商店中将更容易刷新出更高费用的棋子，且棋盘上可部署的棋子数量也会逐渐增加。
每经过1个节点，将会自动获得商店经验；您同样也可花费贤才金币购买经验提升商店等级。

DictionaryDiagram.40090116.2.en:
During deployment, you can view Team Guides for lineup references.
You can use the Apply function on a specific lineup, and the Shop will display recommended pieces that match the lineup.
DictionaryDiagram.40090116.2.cn:
在部署棋盘时，可查看棋组攻略作为对弈的阵容参考。
您可对特定的棋组使用【应用配置】功能，商店中将会显示推荐提示符合棋组阵容的棋子。

DictionaryDiagram.40090204.2.en:
Lord: The final battle of each Phase against a powerful enemy.
Final Battle: The final battle of the match against a powerful boss. Clear it to win.
DictionaryDiagram.40090204.2.cn:
首领：每个阶段的最后一个战斗节点，会遇到强敌。
终盘决战：整场棋局的最后一战，会遇到强大的首领敌人；通过终盘决战考验后，即可赢得整场棋局的胜利

DictionaryDiagram.90010101.2.en: Complete daily tasks to earn Tyrant Points for item rewards. Accumulate more Tyrant Points to unlock milestone rewards. Tyrant Points and milestone rewards will reset at 1:00 PM every day.
DictionaryDiagram.90010101.2.cn: 完成任务可在当日累计权能点数并获取道具奖励，当日累计的权能点数可解锁多个节点奖励。每日4：00权能点数清空，节点奖励刷新重置。

DictionaryDiagram.90010102.2.en: In addition to daily tasks, a set number of random special commissions will be available.
DictionaryDiagram.90010102.2.cn: 每日除固定出现的任务类型外，还会随机出现一定数量的特别指派任务。

DictionaryDiagram.90010103.2.en: Complete weekly missions to earn Tyrant Points for item rewards. Accumulate more Tyrant Points in a week to unlock milestone rewards. Weekly Tyrant Points and milestone rewards will reset at 1:00 PM every Monday.
DictionaryDiagram.90010103.2.cn: 完成周任务可在每周累计权能点数并获取道具奖励，每周累计的权能点数可解锁多个节点奖励。每周一4：00权能点数清空，节点奖励刷新重置。

DictionaryDiagram.90020101.2.en: In each chapter, Tyrant Growth tasks are linked to the main objectives of the chapter. Completing them will grant you generous rewards.
DictionaryDiagram.90020101.2.cn: 每章魔王养成的任务对应当前阶段内游戏中的主要目标，完成后可获得丰厚的奖励。

DictionaryDiagram.90020102.2.en: After completing all the tasks in the current chapter, you can claim the chapter rewards and unlock the next chapter.
DictionaryDiagram.90020102.2.cn: 完成当前章节内所有任务后，可领取章节奖励，同时开启下一章。

DictionaryDiagram.90030101.2.en: Completing Company Goals raises your Grant Tier, unlocking both basic and exclusive rewards. The Start-up Grant will reset its tier and unlocked items after each season. A new round of goals and rewards will then become available.
DictionaryDiagram.90030101.2.cn:
完成营业目标中的任务可提升基金等级，获取基础补贴及尊享补贴中的各类奖励。
创业激励基金在到期后不会继承上一期的等级和解锁项目。后续将开启新一轮的营业目标与奖励项目。

DictionaryDiagram.90030102.2.en: The Starter Grant is available by default. Upgrading to the Elite or Royal Grant unlocks bigger rewards, with the Royal Grant coming with exclusive avatars and Appearance.
DictionaryDiagram.90030102.2.cn: 基础补贴默认开启，而购买尊享补贴及大亨尊享补贴凭证，即可解锁更丰厚的奖励。购买每期大亨尊享补贴还能获取限定头像及皮肤。

DictionaryDiagram.90030103.2.en: Complete daily and weekly Company Goals to earn bonus EXP. You can gain up to 12,000 EXP per week. Once this cap is reached, or the Startup Grant hits max level, no further EXP can be earned from Goals.
DictionaryDiagram.90030103.2.cn: 通过完成每日及每周营业任务可获得补贴经验，每周通过完成营业任务可获得的经验上限为12000点，经验获取数量达到上限或创业激励基金达到等级上限后，将不能再通过完成任务获取经验继续提升等级。

DictionaryDiagram.90030104.2.en: Spend currency to buy Grant Tiers and claim rewards instantly. When Company Goals refresh, unclaimed rewards are auto-collected. At the end of the Startup Grant, remaining rewards are sent to your mailbox, valid for 7 days.
DictionaryDiagram.90030104.2.cn: 消耗一定数量的货币可购买基金等级，直接获取对应等级的奖励。营业任务刷新时，若存在未领取的任务则自动领取。创业激励基金过期结束时，已解锁但未领取的奖励将会通过邮件发至邮箱中，邮件有效期为7天，请及时领取。

DiscIP.211001.4.en:
The world outside the window is just starting to lighten.
The girl stirs, only half-wake.
Half-asleep, she senses someone approaching.
"... Trouble...?"
Her hand moves instinctively toward her sword, but then she hears two familiar voices that put her at ease.
"Amazing recovery. She took a really hard hit yesterday... And almost heals overnight."
"... Still, that doesn't mean she should charge in every time."
"Let's go shopping. There are deals on meat and vegetables today. Noya can have a proper meal and recover then."
"You say that, but she'll still be the one doing the cooking, won't she?"
"Well... it's not like any of us can cook as well as she can."

"Click—"
Just before sleep takes her again, she hears the door close softly, the sound carefully muffled.

The morning light leaves patterns upon the mist in the forest.
DiscIP.211001.4.cn:
窗外的世界刚蒙蒙亮。
少女醒了，但没有完全醒。
迷糊间，她感觉到有人走到身边。
“……麻烦找上门了吗……”
她的手下意识想要去抓剑柄，却听到了令人安心的熟悉声响。
“好强大的恢复能力，明明昨天挨了那么重的一击……这才过了一晚上就几乎痊愈了。”
“……也不能因为这个，每次都冲那么前。”
“今天有打折的肉，还有蔬菜，回来尘沙可以好好吃一顿补补。”
“话是这么说，不过做饭的还是尘沙吧。”
“毕竟…毕竟我们没有她做的好吃嘛。”

“咔哒——”
再度进入睡眠前，她听到的是有小心翼翼地控制力度的关门声。

晨曦在森林的雾霭上留下光的形状。

DiscIP.211002.4.en:
A gentle breeze drifts by, and another patrol day begins in the countryside just like always.
"What? The Shrubshrews are causing trouble again?"
The birds chirp their complaints to the girl, then take off toward the forest.

"Wait—hold up! I don't have wings, you know!"
She heads out, wind in her face, trying to follow the birds' path.
The afternoon sun washes over the endless wheat fields, wrapping her small figure in warm, golden light.

"Grumble, grumble—"
That's when she remembers that she's already missed her lunch.
"Ugh, this time I'm really going to teach them a lesson!"

Across the fields and over the streams, the little guardian of the forest sets out once again, full of purpose and fire.
DiscIP.211002.4.cn:
温煦的微风中，乡野的日常如期上演。
“什么？！树树鼠又开始恶作剧了吗！”
鸟儿们叽叽喳喳地向少女哭诉着，随即朝着森林飞去。
 
“诶？等、等等我！我可没有翅膀啦！”
少女迈着步伐迎风向前，试图跟上鸟儿们的航迹。
余晖洒向无际的麦田，将小小的身影笼罩在一片柔和的暖色里。
 
“咕噜噜——”
少女这才想起，早已过了开饭的时间。
“真是的，这次得好好教训教训它们！”
 
越过田野，跨过溪流，怀揣内心的使命，森林的小守护今天也干劲满满的出发了。

DiscIP.211003.4.en:
The city quiets as dusk settles in, the sky glowing with iridescent light.

"Click—"
A camera shutter snaps somewhere above.
With a flash, the scene is caught and frozen in the lens.
A witch on a broom slips through the clouds, watching for the secrets hidden below.

"Oh? Isn't that the one everyone's been talking about lately? Love that expression~"
"Let's get one from this angle, too~"
"Whoops, guess they saw me. Well, I've already got some interesting shots!"
As night falls, the clever eyes behind the camera sparkle like stars, brightening the darkness above the city.

She looks quite satisfied with her unexpected finds tonight.
"Yep, you're going right on tomorrow's front page..."
DiscIP.211003.4.cn:
霞光环绕，虹彩交织，都市的喧嚣渐渐平息。
 
“咔嚓——”
上空传来快门的声响。
伴随闪光，现实被镜头牢牢捕捉。
乘着扫帚的魔女，正穿梭于云间，洞悉其下隐藏的真相。
 
“啊~这不是最近身陷舆论风暴的那家伙吗？不错的表情呢~”
“这个角度也来一张吧~”
“哎呀，被发现了吗？不过已经拍到了很有趣的内容了！”
夜幕降临，镜头后那双狡黠的眼眸，如同闪烁的群星，点亮被黑暗笼罩的天空。
 
她似乎对今日的意外收获很是满意。
“明天的头版素材，就是你了……”

DiscIP.211004.4.en:
Bubbles drift through her dreams, waves as soft as silk brushing the shore,
and every cloud glows with a gentle light.
She picks up her brush, dips it in paint, and sketches the reflections in the water, stroke by stroke.
Each line shimmers and sways with the current, and with every moment, her dreams ripple along with the waves.

—No matter how harsh reality gets, this place is always warm and calm.
As the waves rise and the clouds roll, the shadows in her heart are washed away like colors fading into the water.

The road to freedom really isn't as simple as she imagined.
Now that I've left the safety of my tower, is this the world I've longed to see?


She shakes her head, stands up, and shakes the water from her hands. With new resolve, she heads straight ahead.
—A princess who's left her castle won't be defeated by something this trivial!
DiscIP.211004.4.cn:
缤纷的气泡在梦境中漂浮，浪潮如纱轻柔地抚摸海岸，
每一朵云彩都散发着淡淡的柔光。
拿起画笔，沾上颜料，一笔一画勾勒水中的倒影。
每一笔，色彩随流水摇曳，每一瞬，梦想随浪花荡漾。
 
——无论现实多么残酷，这里总是温暖而平静。
浪起云涌，心中的阴霾如同被洗刷的色彩，渐渐消散在水面。
 
追求自由的道路，果然没有想象中那么简单。
离开高塔的庇护，这就是我所追寻的风景吗？
 
 
她摇了摇头，起身甩甩水花，以崭新的姿态，径直向前迈去。
——走出城堡的公主，可不会被这点小事打败！

DiscIP.211005.4.en:
"Oh, it's gone."
Without even realizing it, the girl has chased all the way into the heart of the desert.

As the legend has it, the long-haired cat that roams the Wilds can lead Trekkers to a hidden Monolith.
If you lock eyes with one, a secret path will appear.

A gust of sand sweeps by, and the quick little furball is nowhere to be seen.
The girl pauses for a moment, then lightly leaps onto the wind-carved rock behind her.
Dust swirls in the air; the endless sea of sand quietly keeps its secrets.

"Following those faint paw prints the whole way... I'm used to navigating the desert, but something about this place feels different.
Time seems to stand still here. It's like echoes from long ago are drifting on the wind. A strange feeling is welling up inside me..."
A ray of sunlight spills down, and her fingers freeze mid-tap on the keys—
She suddenly looks up and locks onto a pair of sparkling eyes in the distance.
DiscIP.211005.4.cn:
“啊，不见了。”
不知不觉间，少女已追到了沙漠深处。
 
传闻中，在荒野出没的长毛猫，会将旅人引向未知的星塔。
只要和它对上视线，隐藏的路径便会显现。
 
一阵风沙扬起，敏捷的毛球已不知去向，
她沉默片刻，轻轻跃上身后的风岩。 
尘埃弥漫空中，无际的沙海，悄然尘封着秘密。

“顺着浅浅的爪印一路前行，虽然早已习惯在沙漠里行动，但这里的感觉却有些陌生。
时间彷佛静止一般，风中似乎飘荡着远古的回声，一股奇特的情感正涌上心头……”
一束日光洒落，在按键上飞舞的指尖戛然停下——
她猛地抬头一瞥，迎上了远处那对闪耀的晶眸。

DiscIP.211006.4.en:
To let go of her heavy thoughts, she opens the door and walks out into the serenity.
On this mist-soaked morning, sunlight filters through the leaves, and shadows flicker at her feet as she moves.

"Sorry I'm late."
The forest's residents are already waiting for her by the stream.
She runs over to join her friends. With each step, the anxious voice inside her becomes quieter.

"Let's take care of each other today, too."
She steps into the cool water, splashing as she likes, joy bubbling up inside her.
Playful creatures, swirling skirts—everyone is bathed in morning light, welcomed by nature.

No matter how chaotic things get in the outside world, this will always be her place to find herself.
DiscIP.211006.4.cn:
为了卸下繁重的心事，她推开门扉，走向静谧。
薄雾缭绕的清晨，阳光透过树叶缝隙，斑驳的光影随步伐一同摇曳。
 
“抱歉，我来晚了。”
森林里的居民已在溪边聚集等待。
她朝伙伴们奔去，每迈出一步，内心焦虑的声音就减弱一分。
 
“今天也请多关照。”
踏入潺潺清流，随心所欲地踩起水花，内心的欢愉随之涌动。
嬉戏的生灵，跃动的裙摆，一同沐浴着晨曦与自然的洗礼。 
 
无论身外事如何纷扰，这里将一直是她找寻自我的乐园。

DiscIP.211007.4.en:
"Why are you coming at this hour? We're about to close."
"And you want a temporary residence permit. We only handles long-term permits here."
A weary voice came from behind the glass.
After a brief pause, the employee pushed a booklet through the slot below.
"Here, take this and read it carefully when you get back."
"Seriously... Trekkers are such a bunch of country bumpkins."

Thinking back on yesterday's ordeal, the girl feels a bit annoyed, but there's nothing she can do about it.
Looking down at the city from the rooftop, the view below is as beautiful as ever.
She already knows the city's harsh reality.

Gazing at the city where she's about to make her mark, she finally feels a surge of courage.
"Just wait. One day... I'll amaze everyone in this city."
For once, she lets go of her frustrations and lifts her head high—
letting her hair and cloak dance freely in the breeze.
DiscIP.211007.4.cn:
“你怎么这个点才来啊，都要准备下班了。”
“而且你要办理的是临时居留的证明，我这里是办长期居留的。”
玻璃另一边传出无奈的声音，
短暂的沉默后，一本小册子从下面的缝隙里推了出来。
“这个，你拿回去好好读一读吧”
“真是……旅人果然都是些没进过城的乡巴佬。”

回想起昨天的窘境，少女感到有些不快，却也无可奈何。
从屋顶上俯瞰都市，脚下的风景总是如此美丽。
她已经明白这残酷的本质。

眺望着面前这座接下来要打拼的城市，她终于燃起了战斗的勇气。
“等着瞧吧，总有一天……这座城，会因我而惊叹。”
常常沮丧的她，此刻终于卸下了包袱，扬起了头，
——任由发梢与她的披风一起舞动。

DiscIP.211008.4.en:
"Three letters from Emor, five packages from Philae... and twenty-five newspapers!"
She picks up her pen and checks off each item on her list one by one.
"All done. Everything's been delivered and all the fees are settled for today!"

As the sun slowly sinks below the horizon, she wipes the sweat from her brow and gazes off into the distance. 
A dreamy, small smile flickers across her face.

Look closely, and you'll see the answer in those bright eyes—
It's the joy of taking in this view after crossing so many mountain trails,
the pride of a courier who's worked hard all day,
and the boundless hope she has for the future after weathering so many storms.

"Nah, none of that."
"I was just thinking about how I should treat myself after all this running around. I'm exhausted!"
DiscIP.211008.4.cn:
“来自埃摩的三封信、菲莱的五个包裹……还有二十五份报纸！”
她拿起笔，将清单上的列表一个一个地打上了勾。
“没问题，今日快件已全部送达，费用也全部结清啦！”
 
太阳缓缓沉入地平线，她拂去额头的汗水，望向遥远的彼方。
不知陷入了何种畅想，一抹微笑跃上脸庞。
 
仔细看，答案就隐藏在这双闪亮的眼眸下——
是千山过尽后对此番光景的沉醉，
是辛勤奔波后对信使工作的自豪，
是历经风雨后对未来的无限期许。
 
“不是噢。”
“我只是在想待会要怎么犒劳自己才好，跑这么多地方真的很累！”

DiscIP.212001.4.en:
Snuffle—snuffle—
The feast is about to begin—

At the very front walks the brave one, their pointy hat shaped just like an ice cream cone—I bet it'd be perfectly crisp and crunchy.
The crawling magician isn't holding a wand but a lollipop you could crunch in one bite.
And you, long-haired weirdo hiding at the back of the line—I see you!
What's in all those bottles and jars in your pockets? I want to drink every single one!

Snuffle—snuffle—
They're climbing up onto the table—

Snuffle—snuffle—
They've spotted us—

One, two, three! Nobody's taking my bowl!
One, two, three! Don't break my plate!
Ready—ready—
Time to dig in—
DiscIP.212001.4.cn:
呼噜——呼噜——
宴席开始了——

走在最前面的勇者，尖尖的帽檐像甜筒，口感一定很酥脆。
匍匐行进的魔术师，手中拿着的不是法杖，是可以一口咬碎的棒棒糖。
躲在队伍最后的长头发怪人，我看见你了！
你口袋里的瓶瓶罐罐装的是什么？我要通通喝掉！

呼噜——呼噜——
他们走上餐桌了——

呼噜——呼噜——
他们发现我们了——

一二三！不准抢走我的碗！
一二三！不准打碎我的盘！
准备——准备——
我要开吃啦——

DiscIP.212002.4.en:
"Hoho! Who's on duty today?!"
"I set three big fires yesterday, so I know it's not me!"
"Not... Glopo... Glopo... Gonna take a bath..."
"Snuffle—snuffle—"
"Hoho! Hey, lazy penguin, quit napping! It's gotta be you!"
"Those long-armed, long-legged ones are about to climb up! Get moving!"
"Snuffle—I swapped position with Cursipot—"
"Cursipot' on gate duty, I'm up top—"
"Hoho! Cursipot! Where's Cursipot?"
"That guy's useless, I'll do it myself! I'll burn it all, nice and clean!"
"Snuf—snuffle—fire, fire!!"
"Glopo... can't take... a hot bath..."
"Glopo... gonna melt..."
"Look! This is my blazing firestorm!"
"Hoho! Just go already! Don't get in the way!"
"Snuffle—put out the fire—put out the fire—"
DiscIP.212002.4.cn:
“吼吼！今天轮到谁值班了？！”
“昨天咱痛痛快快烧了三场大火，可不是咱！”
“不是……冻冻……冻冻……要泡澡……”
“呼噜——呼噜——”
“吼吼！臭企鹅别睡了！就是你吧！”
“那帮长手长脚的家伙们就要爬上来了！还不快去！”
“呼噜——我和罐罐换过位置了——”
“它守门，我在上面——”
“吼吼！罐罐！罐罐呢？”
“那小子靠不住，还是咱去吧！烧它个痛痛快快，一干二净！”
“呼、呼噜——着、着火了！！”
“冻冻……不能泡……热水澡……”
“冻冻……要化掉了……”
“让你们见识见识！这就是咱的烈火熔焰！”
“吼吼！你快走吧！别添乱了！”
“呼噜——灭火——灭火——”

DiscIP.212003.4.en:
What wonderful music that is.
What an enchanting rhythm.
Once you set foot in my domain, you must dance with me before you can leave.

Come, lose yourself in this grand, eternal, dazzling ball.
Come, surrender your poor, fragile, frozen body.
My drumbeat is your heartbeat.
My applause is your scream.
Why is your face so pale?
Why does sweat pour down your skin?

Come, come, dance with me.
Come, come, let me grant you sleep.
What an irresistible beat.
What a obsessive melody.
Once you set foot in my domain, you must dance with me—never stopping, never coming out from this frenzy.
DiscIP.212003.4.cn:
那是多么美妙的音乐。
那是多么摄魂的节奏。
一旦踏入我的领域，须要同我共舞，方可离开。

来吧，尽情享受这盛大的、永恒的、闪耀的舞会。
来吧，尽情支配你可怜的、易碎的、冰冷的躯体。
我的鼓点，即是你的心跳。
我的掌声，即是你的尖叫。
你的脸色为何如此苍白？
你的汗水为何肆意流淌？

来吧，来吧，与我共舞。
来吧，来吧，赐你安眠。
那是多么抓耳的节拍。
那是多么沉醉的韵律。
一旦踏入我的领域，定要与我同舞，不醉不休。

DiscIP.212005.4.en:
Get fired up, get ready to move!
The hottest music is born from the fiercest flames!
Can't hear you! Louder!
Show me your passion, your anger, the ambition you're hiding behind those jokes!

That's it, just like that!
Give me your hand. Don't worry, you won't get burned.
As long as you play nice, I'll even let you touch my sharp claws—ever so lightly.
What's that? You think I'm "cute?!"
Hah, that's just because you haven't seen what I look like with my mask off~

Get fired up, get ready to move!
I still can't hear you—louder, let me hear it—!
DiscIP.212005.4.cn:
燃烧起来，摇摆起来，
最热情的音乐诞生于最热烈的火焰！
听不见，声音再大一点！
让我感受你的激情，你的愤怒，你潜藏在玩笑下的真实野心！

没错，就是这样！
把你的手给我，别担心，你不会被灼伤。
只要你乖乖听话，我会特别允许你轻轻摸一下我的利爪。
什么？你说我“可爱”？！
哼哼，那是你没见到我撕开伪装的一面~

燃烧起来，摇摆起来，
听不见，还是听不见，声音，请再大一点——！

DiscIP.212006.4.en:
I hear your summons.
I heed your prayers.
Those who once leaped over the heavenly gate have faded like smoke and cloud.
Those who defiled the throne still cling to the heights above.

You dare to meet my gaze,
You dare to pierce my armored scales.
Who gave you such courage?
Who lent you such strength?

Pitiful are you who have fools as honored guests.
And pitiful are you, the blind masses, who brand heroes as traitors.
Truth is hard to hear, and medicine bitter to taste.
The fate of the world—let it unfold, and watch in silence.
DiscIP.212006.4.cn:
吾知尔等之呼唤，
吾闻尔等之祝祷。
跨越天堑者，已烟散云销。
亵渎神位者，仍窃据星巅。

竟敢直视吾之双目，
竟敢刺穿吾之坚鳞。
何人予汝以胆气？
何人假汝以力量？

可悲尔等信徒，尊丑角为上宾。
可怜尔等愚众，贬英雄为逆者。
忠言逆耳，良药苦口。
天下之势，静观分晓。

DiscIP.212007.4.en:
"Chirp chirp, chirp chirp."
"Did you hear? There's going to be a huge party in the forest, chirp chirp!"
"Awo! You almost pecked down my front door, first thing in the morning, just for this?"
"We already knew, awo! We even got invitations, awo!"
"Invitations? How come I didn't get one, chirp chirp?"

"Could it be... I somehow made the Forest Spirit mad without realizing it?"
"Awo?! No way, right? Didn't those Shrubrat leave an apple with the Spirit's name on it at your door?"
"Those Shrubrat must've slacked off again. I'll go tell on them to the Spirit, awo!"
"Apple... I think... I ate it."
"I thought it just fell out of the tree, chirp chirp."
"Dummy! Dummy!"
"You'd better bring extra snacks and bribe those hedgehogs at the door, awo!"
DiscIP.212007.4.cn:
“啾啾，啾啾。”
“听说了吗？森林里要举办一场超级大的舞会，啾啾。”
“嗷！一大早上把我家门板都要啄破了，就为了这点事嗷？”
“我们早就知道了嗷！还收到邀请函了嗷！”
“邀请函？啾啾怎么没有？”

“难道……啾啾无意间，惹森神大人生气了？”
“嗷？！不会吧？那群鼠鼠没把刻有大人名字的苹果，放在你家门口吗？”
“一定是鼠鼠们又偷懒了，我帮你跟大人告状嗷！”
“苹果……啾啾……好像，吃掉了。”
“啾啾，以为是树上掉下来的苹果，啾啾。”
“笨蛋！笨蛋！”
“只能等下多带点好吃的，收买一下那些看门刺猬嗷！”

DiscIP.212008.4.en:
Bubbles, bubbles, swelling bubbles.
Splashes, splashes, endless splashes.

The most delightful time of the day again!
Set the temperature, grab a towel, and don't forget the rubber duck.
Turn on the music, rip open the snacks, twist the faucet wide.
Glug glug, fatigue melts away.
Drip drip, pressure goes poof.

Hot water is magic, strong enough to wash away every care.
The bath cures any and all worry.

In this rare moment of rest,
Glopo can finally put down the weight and title of the Glopo clan.
Even if a fearsome enemy drops from the sky,
they'll have to wait until Glopo finishes this bath.
DiscIP.212008.4.cn:
泡沫，泡沫，膨胀的泡沫。
水花，水花，无尽的水花。

又到了最愉悦的时光，
调好温度，备好毛巾，拿好橡皮鸭。
打开音乐，撕开零食，拧开出水口。
咕嘟咕嘟，疲乏融化了。
啪嗒啪嗒，压力爆开啦。

热水是足以忘却一切烦恼的魔法，
浴池是足以缓解一切忧虑的良方。

在这来之不易的休憩期间，
可以暂时放下冻冻家族的爵位与重负。
就算天降强敌，
也要等冻冻洗完这场澡。

DiscIP.212009.4.en:
At the dawn of life, where all desire begins...
I heed the ancient call and command the dice of fate.
Into the depths of the sea, I cast a silver coin.
At the edge of the heavens, I hang a single star.

I am the watcher beyond order, reside within the liminality of time,
listening to the greedy prayers of my faithful.
I sow seeds of fear, devour the power of belief, and abandon even the most devoted.
No one escapes my shifting labyrinth.
The endless repetition wearies me. A game with only one ending brings no joy.

Thus I take up the pen and rewrite the script of fate,
letting dreadful secrets spread through the world:
"Those who step through this door shall never return."
"Those who break this realm shall become unstoppable."
DiscIP.212009.4.cn:
生命诞生之初，一切欲望的源头，
我遵循古老的呼唤，掌控命运的骰子。
深海之底，我投下一枚银币。
九天之渊，我挂上一颗星星。

我是秩序之外的观察者，盘踞于时间的裂缝，
倾听众信徒贪婪的祈祷。
我播撒恐惧的种子，吞噬信仰的灵力，抛弃最虔诚的子民，
无人能走出我搭建的流动迷宫。
周而复始的循环令我疲倦，单一的游戏结局毫无乐趣。

于是我提笔，篡改命运之书的字符，
纵容可怕的秘密在世间传播：
“踏入此门者，将永劫不复。”
“破除此境者，将无所不能。”

DiscIP.212010.4.en:
Is it finally my turn to take the stage?
It feels like I've waited forever for this moment; yet somehow, like it only just happened.
The curtain's risen on the final battle, and the chains of the arena clink in anticipation.
This is my stage, and I'll deliver a flawless performance.

Come on, show me everything you've got.
If you think I'm just some minor character, you couldn't be deadly wrong.
I'll catch every tiny crack in your defense.
Even if I'm knocked down, I'll get right back up,
waiting for the next challenger.
Even if I'm mocked, I won't care.
I'm no pitiful thing crying my defeat in the corner.
Who says the spotlight belongs only to the final room?
With me standing guard, this place becomes everyone's end.
DiscIP.212010.4.cn:
终于轮到我登场了吗？
这一天似乎等了很久，又仿佛刚刚经历过。
决战的幕布已拉开，斗兽场的锁链泠泠作响。
这是属于我的舞台，我会交上最完美的答卷。

来吧，让我看看你的全部实力。
如果你认为我是什么小角色，那就大错特错，
我会抓住你每一处细微的破绽。
即便被人击倒，我会重新站起，
等待下一个挑战者的到来。
即便被人嘲笑，我也毫不在意，
我才不是躲在角落里哭哭啼啼的可怜虫。
谁说高光时刻只属于最后的房间，
由我守护，此地即是所有人的末路。

DiscIP.213001.4.en:
The dryer hums steadily.
The girl seems entertained; she bobs her head in sync with the spinning drum.
She's completely caught up in it and flashes a peace sign at her companion's reflection in the glass.
Her fingertips finds another set of fingers, just as warm and soft.
Her companion stands close and mirrors her gesture. But today isn't quite like the others:
A wide shadow falls over her; a soft white cloth drops down, covering her eyes.
"Ruby, no-prize quiz—what do you smell?" Asks a bright, teasing voice.

Hmm? The familiar scent of sunlight, of course.
Wait... A faint trace of fruit drifts past her nose...

Ruby quickly pulls the surprise off her face and locks eyes with her companion.
"Grapefruit? Don't tell me, Sapphire—we actually had enough extra money to get new detergent?"
"Sharp nose, as always."
Sapphire folds the laundry carefully, almost like she's afraid the scent might escape.
"I used my quarterly bonus to get this grapefruit-scented kind. A friend in Sales told me it's a Gold District exclusive."
"I didn't want to use it up too fast, so I mixed just a little into our regular bottle. The scent's fainter now, but if you really sniff..."

They exchange a knowing look. That soft, lingering citrus is just like Lady Firenze's.

"Hehe, I love the smell of grapefruit! Let's work hard next month and stock up on a few more bottles!"
"Yeah!"
DiscIP.213001.4.cn:
滚筒嗡嗡作响。
少女似是觉得有趣，头也一点一点，随着部件的运转而摆动。
她乐此不疲，还向着出现在那玻璃反光中的同伴比上一个耶。
指尖触碰到同样温软的指腹。
靠近的同伴就像往常一样，用相同的手势回应了少女的问好，可今天却也并不同以往：
一大片阴影笼罩在她的头顶，洁白的织物垂下，遮住了视线。
 “红宝石，无奖竞猜，你闻到了什么？”那道声音里带着雀跃。
 
嗯？当然是熟悉的太阳的味道。
诶等等，有一丝浅浅的果香滑过鼻间，这是……
 
红宝石飞快地扯下盖在脸上的这份“惊喜”，对上了同伴熠熠的双眼。
“柚子？蓝宝石，我们有闲钱换新的洗衣液啦？”
“属你鼻子最灵。”
蓝宝石像是怕这团香气消散般，小心翼翼地将手中的衣服叠成一小块。
“这个季度的绩效奖励，我选了这款柚子香型洗衣液。以前听销售部的朋友说起过，还是金城区特供哦。”
 “我怕用得太快，就在分配给我们的那瓶洗衣液里混了一点点。虽然味道变得不那么明显，但仔细闻闻……”

两人心照不宣地对视一眼，这份似有若无的香气，就和翡冷翠大人的味道一样。

“嘿嘿，我最喜欢柚子香了！下个月继续努力，争取多攒几瓶！”
“嗯！”

DiscIP.213002.4.en:
The dream called "idol" rings out, bright and chiming.
In this season of change, the girls charge forward with fearless energy.

They're the girl group that sold ten million albums in just a year, and every reporter in the country is desperate to figure out their secret.
For example, how did that reclusive genius composer, who never left her room, end up singing and dancing on stage for a tiny agency?
And that ordinary-looking girl with the long hair—how did she become that good at guitar in just three years? Even for a prodigy, that's a bit much.
Then there's the bombshell fan favorite—rumor has it someone caught her in a school uniform sneaking into campus. Seriously?!
As for the lack of buzz vocalist,
who would've thought it was her who brought the girls all together?

"I don't want to be apart from everyone anymore."

Spring rain softens the world, and a girl's tears call forth a miracle.
Summer casts its shade, flowers proudly bloom in the dark of night.
Autumn leaves blaze red, as the wind from afar waits quietly for the mountains' blessing.
Winter butterflies dance, and an out-of-season duckling coats the world in white.

They've had their highs and lows.
Every note has its own color, but their friendship never wavers.
Seasons may turn, but spring, summer, autumn, and winter remain the same.
DiscIP.213002.4.cn:
名为“偶像”的梦想，叮叮当当。
骚动时节的少女们，铿铿锵锵。

仅仅一年之内专辑销量就达到一千万份的少女组合，记者们挤破头都想瞧瞧她们的秘密。
比如说，那位长年家里蹲的天才网络作曲家，为什么会答应来这种小事务所登台唱跳？
比如说，那位看似平平无奇的长发女孩，怎么可能只用三年就弹成这种程度，天才也要有个限度吧！
比如说，那位在粉丝之中最有人气的火辣淑女，听说有人拍到她穿着学生装出入学校的画面，这怎么可能呢？！
比如说，那位看似最没有话题度的主唱。
又有谁能想到，是她率先向伙伴们提出的邀请呢？

“我不想再和大家分开了。”

春风化雨，少女的眼泪唤来奇迹。
夏日成荫，挺起胸膛的繁花在黑夜中绽放。
秋叶红遍，远方吹来的风听候着山脉静静的祝福。
冬蝶飞舞，丑小鸭在不属于他的季节为世上的一切染上洁白——

并非未曾历经峰与谷。
音符总是各有色彩，但彼此的友情永远也不会变。
有如四季轮转，不变的是春秋冬夏。

DiscIP.213003.4.en:
"This is it! Our final performance."
"You mean our first."
"But... But if it doesn't go well, we'll have no reason to ever come back."
I curl up in the corner, clutching my guitar as the words stumble out of my mouth.
"If you're not feeling well, it's okay to rest—I can take care of things out there on my own."
"... No. I want to go on. Please, let me be a part of it."
I lift my head sharply, frustration burning in my chest.
But the moment I see her fearless expression, I shrink back again, burying my face even deeper.
"Just give me a little more time... If I try harder, maybe..."

"What you need right now is this!"
She suddenly pulls back the edge of the heavy curtain. Joyful, colorful light floods into our eyes.

And then I remember. That rainy night, walking home under my umbrella.
The street was dark and silent,
which only made the grind of my boring life feel even heavier.

In that moment, a guitar riff cut through the night like lightning.
It was sharp, electric, and intoxicating—
breaking through the rain, shattering the stillness—
That kind of color.

That's it. I'm going to chase after and reach for that color again.

"Let's go! It's our turn!" You grab my hand and pull me toward the light.
Scream, shake, burn!
Turn the longing in your heart into action.
This scorching night won't end!
DiscIP.213003.4.cn:
“今晚就是最后的演出了。”
“是第一次演出哦。”
“可……可是，如果这场演出效果不好的话，我们就没有再次登场的理由了。”
我环抱着吉他蜷缩在角落，说着破碎的句子。
“身体不舒服的话就在这里休息吧——现在交给我就好！”
“……不，我要上场！请务必让我上场。”
我不服气、猛地抬起头。
但看到她那副天不怕地不怕的表情时，我又懊恼地将头埋得更深了，
“只要给我点时间……我再努力一下的话……”

“这时候就需要这个！”
突然，她掀开厚重幕布的一角。愉悦的、彩色的光芒，跃入了我们的眼眸。
 
想起来了，那是一个雨夜，我撑着伞走在回家的路上。
安静、漆黑、沉默的街道，
把这忙碌且无趣的循环，衬得又焦虑了几分。

而那个瞬间，吉他的乐句，像一束闪电，划破寂静的夜空。
那是让我浑身酥麻、沉醉、兴奋的……穿过雨幕、打破这份宁静的……
色彩。

没错，我此刻要重拾那份色彩，连接那道色彩。
 
“走吧，该我们上场了！”你牵起了我的手，把我拽向聚光灯朝向的那侧。
嘶吼吧，沸腾吧，灼烧吧，
将内心的“渴望”付诸行动吧——
热夜，不会结束。

DiscIP.213004.4.en:
Night falls, sirens wail.
The infamous Phantom Thief "Twin Moon," is on the move again.
"As the leader of the Special Task Force for the Twin Moon Case... Even if I'm the last one standing, I'll bring them in."
The helmet on her desk catches the glint of city lights bouncing off the skyscrapers.
She gears up and starts the engine—clearly not in the mood.

"Sis, I think there's some weirdo in armor on a motorcycle chasing us!"
"How could a tin can keep up with us? No way—watch this, I'll shout her off our tail."
"I don't think that's a good idea..."
"Hey, loser on the busted bike! You think you can catch us? Dream on! Enjoy the view from behind while you choke on our exhaust!"
"Skateboards don't really have exhaust, sis... Wait! She took off her helmet! I think she's aiming at us!"
"Huh? What is this, a Cliché in Stella drama? No way—"
A loud crash, the clatter of metal—and the two thieves go tumbling.
"Two birds, one stone. Twin Moon is in custody."

"... Since you caught us, I guess we'll reward you by answering three questions."
"Hmph. We are—"
"Save it!"
DiscIP.213004.4.cn:
夜幕揭开，警铃四起。
名为双月的怪盗姐妹再次出没。
“作为‘应对双月怪盗特别行动小组’的组长……哪怕只剩我一人，我也要将她们捉拿归案。”
办公桌上的头盔，随着都市楼宇间的灯光反射而闪烁。
少女穿好装备，猛踩油门——她的心情看来并不好。
 
“姐姐，我们脚底下……好像有个穿着盔甲的怪家伙骑着摩托在追我们！”
“那种笨拙的家伙怎么可能——你看着，我来吼她几句。”
“这样不太好吧……”
“嘿，跟在我们身后的蠢货，骑着那破烂玩意，你永远都不可能追上我们，就乖乖地在后面吃我们的尾气吧！”
“滑板好像没有尾气啊姐姐……不，不对，那个人把头盔脱下来了，好像在瞄我们！”
“哈？你以为在拍影戏呢？怎么可能——”
叮铃哐啷的巨响与骚动后，二人摔作了一团。
“一箭双雕，双月怪盗缉拿归案。”
 
“……既然你抓到了我们，作为奖励，就勉为其难地回答你三个问题吧。”
“哼，我们是——”
“少废话！”

DiscIP.213005.4.en:
Good evening, viewers. Up next, today's top story:
"Undercover Scoop! Flavio Idol Backstage Exposé!"
A special report brought to you by our field correspondent, Mistique...
