"It's my fault for not listening to the Luminar. I stayed up reading comics, and totally ruined my eyes..."
Medical artifacts fill the room with their numbing drone.
The girl on the bed stares at the Seeker nearby, her red clothing blazing like a flame against the coffin-white surroundings.

"That's alright. People actually call me the Reaper."
"Hehe ... you're lying. The Reaper wouldn't wear Seekers' clothes."
Gerie doesn't argue. Her mind drifts to days prior—

"You'll represent the Grand Sanctum. Spend a few days there—just keep up appearances, show them the gods haven't forsaken them."
The Elder's tone carried authority. Though aware of Gerie's other identity, here at least, she could rightfully command as a senior.
"I'm not refusing, but surely there are others more suited..."
"I'm done debating with those old fossils about who's best for this. Just go."
"And get changed first. You look like a demon straight from hell, with those stains on your shoes and robes..."

Gerie hastily packed her belongings and departed.
For someone who waded through bloodshed daily, this sudden assignment to act as a true Seeker left her disoriented.
But the moment she arrived, she was greeted by a scent she knows all too well—that of death.

The Luminar led Gerie to a backroom sickbed where a frail girl lay.
"This orphan was abandoned as an infant and grew up within these walls. She's become a devout believer. But her illness ... after all these years, I fear she's reaching her limit. She won't last much longer... Poor child."
"... Who ... who's there?"
"Now, now, stay still, dear. The Luminar of the Grand Sanctum has come to see you!"
"I'm not really—"
"Ohhh... Holy Luminar... The gods have answered my prayers... I'm so blessed, so blessed..."
Gerie froze. Though seasoned in countless battles, nothing had ever thrown her off like this.
"... Just call me sis. I'm more like ... a trainee."
After a long silence, she forced out a composed greeting.

"Sis ... it hurts so much...!"
The girl's struggle and the artifact's warning alarm snap Gerie back to reality.
Though skilled in dealing wounds rather than healing them, she instinctively lets the girl grab onto her arm.
Red marks slowly rise where nails dig in, almost breaking her skin, as the girl gradually calms down.
"Sis ... I'm in so much pain..."
"Pain is proof that we're alive."
"Sis ... aren't you afraid of pain?"
"... I'm someone who needs to feel pain to survive. So if you're hurting, share some of the pain with me, okay?"
After a pause, the girl tightens her grip, as if responding to her expectations.
"Sis ... do you think of the gods when it hurts...?"
"Sis ... will the gods hear my prayers?"
"Sis ... why must we feel pain to stay alive?"
"Sis ... are you still here...?"

The ancient bells echo from afar while black-clad children assemble in the courtyard, their voices rising in sacred song under the Luminar's guidance.
Gerie bends down, her fingers tracing the scars along her arm before she lays white roses before the stone.
"This pilgrimage was cruel, but now, your suffering ends."
"May the God of Grace watch over you..."
She closes her eyes in devotion.
"... I will pray for you."
DiscIP.214036.4.cn:
“天使吗……？你来接我了……？”
“不是天使哦，仔细看看，穿着修者的衣服……是我哦。”
“对不起姐姐……我看东西越来越模糊了……”
“是我不好，没听祭司的话，晚上偷偷看漫画，把眼睛看坏了……”
房间里重复回荡着令人麻木的医疗神器的声音。
躺在病床上的女孩望着身边的修者，在这片如棺木般的纯白中，那抹红显得格外亮眼。
 
“没关系，其实大家都管姐姐叫死神。”
“嘿嘿……骗人，死神才不穿修者的衣服。”
格芮没有反驳，她回忆起了前几天的事——

“你代表大圣所，就去那边待上几天吧——就当做做样子就行，表示神还没有抛弃他们。”
长者用命令的口吻催促着——她虽然知道格芮的另一个身份，但至少在这，她确实可以用前辈的口吻下指示。
“我并无推辞的意思，但，应该有比我更合适的……”
“我不想再和那帮老顽固争论谁最合适了，你出发吧。”
“还有，临走前记得换套衣服，你现在的样子，就像刚地狱里爬出来的恶魔，鞋底和衣角还沾着……”

格芮草草收拾好行李便出发了。
对每天都沐浴在猩红中的她而言，这时布置她去履行一个真修者的职责，反倒令她不知所措。
但当她真的来到这里时，却闻到了那无比熟悉的——死亡的味道。

祭司领着格芮来到深处的卧房，这里只躺着一位虚弱的少女。
“这个孤儿从小就被遗弃，她在这里长大，已是一位虔诚的信徒……但她的病，这么多年已经到极限了吧，估计是撑不了多久了……哎，好可怜。”
“……谁，谁在那……”
“乖，别起来，好好躺着，大圣所的祭司来看你了哦！”
“我——”
“啊啊……大人！神明听见我的祈愿了……太好了，太好了……”
格芮愣住了，已经历过大小无数次战役的她，还没有哪回让她慌乱至此。
“……还是叫我姐姐更合适吧，我只能算是个……实习修者。”
沉默良久，她憋出了一句冷静的问候。

“姐姐……好痛……！”
女孩的挣扎与神器的报警声将格芮的思绪拉了回来。
擅长伤人而非治人的她，几乎是下意识地，她让女孩的手抓住了自己的手臂。
抓痕处慢慢地渗出红印，就快渗出血来——女孩也逐渐恢复了平静。
“姐姐……我，好痛……”
“疼痛是活着的证明。”
“姐姐你不怕疼吗……？”
“……我是不感受疼痛就没办法活下去的人，所以你要是觉得痛了，就分姐姐一点吧？”
女孩犹豫了一下后，本就抓紧的手握的更用力了，就像回应了她的期待一样。
“姐姐……你痛的时候会想神明大人吗……？”
“姐姐……神明大人会听见我的祈愿吗……？”
“姐姐……为什么非要痛才能活下去呢……？”
“姐姐……你还在吗……？”

悠远的钟鸣自远方传来，孩子们穿着黑色的衣裳聚在院中，祭司领着大家齐唱颂歌。
格芮俯身，轻抚着手臂上的伤疤，然后为碑前献上了一束白玫瑰。
“这是一场痛苦的巡礼，但此刻，你便不用再受苦难了。”
“愿恩赐之神，护佑你身……”
她虔诚的闭眼。
“……我会为你祈祷。”

DiscIP.214037.4.en:
"Business is booming at this new doll shop, and there's something special about its dolls, or as experts phrase it—
"They've gained love and soul from all the careful attention they've received." Nazuna says this with a serious face, but everyone else is confused.
"So ... you're saying they take really good care of these dolls, right?" Fuyuka tries to make sense of Nazuna's claim.
"Exactly! And look at their accessories—it's like they were custom-made for each doll."
Nazuna transforms into an endless fountain of enthusiasm when it comes to dolls.
"Everything's just right, nothing feels out of place. You can only get that kind of perfection when there's tons of love involved!"
Nazuna gulps, then adds hopefully,
"... So, if we could just take one home..."

"Not happening! We've no space left at home. Besides, didn't we agree before coming here? Window shopping only." Kaede cuts off Nazuna's fantasy right there and then.
"Yeah, and if she actually gets started..." Nazuka lets out a sigh, "This place would be out of business by sunset. Right, Lord of the Prize Claw?"
That's right. This place has a special rule—you can't just buy any doll you want, you've got to try your luck with the claw machine!
"Hehe... Perfect chance to show off my skills. Better hope I go easy on them—"

"Hey there! Are you really good at the claw machine?" A child's innocent voice interrupts their conversation.
Four pairs of eyes land on their unexpected guest.
"Ah ... eh?" Nazuna blinks in confusion.
"I heard them call you the 'Lord of the Prize Claw,' so you must be super good, right?"
"Well, that's me..."
"Pretty please, Lord, help me get Mr. Roundy!"
"Wait, what?"

"Mr. Roundy"—no doubt the doll that's stolen this child's heart. He has nearly emptied his piggy bank trying to win it.

Push the button, drop the coin, then "click—", "buzz—," "clunk—."
"There you go, little one. Promise to keep it safe." Nazuna makes it look easy, passing "Mr. Roundy" to its eager new owner.
"Yay! Thank you so much! You really are the Lord of the Prize Claw!" The child dances away, hugging his doll.
"As expected of Nazuna..."
"... That was impressive."
"Just warming up today. Let's head back now. We can always return when we're in the mood—"

Just as they step outside, they notice the child from earlier being confronted by a girl, who seems determined to seize the Mr. Roundy he's carrying.
"Let go! Mr. Roundy was a special gift from the Lord of the Prize Claw to me!" The boy shields the doll with his whole body.
"You're the one who needs to let go! How dare you rename my Mr. Puff-Puff!" The girl tugs back just as fiercely.
"It's mine—"
"No, it's mine—"

"How should we deal with this?"
"... She's our expert on doll affairs." Following Nazuka's gaze, everyone turns to Nazuna.

"Hmm—! Something's definitely off here!" Without hesitation, she dashes toward the two. "Hey, you two! Stop right there!"
After some chaotic chasing, the three little ones finally calm down.
Turns out, the girl had lost a doll named Mr. Puff-Puff, and Mr. Puff-Puff looks exactly like Mr. Roundy.
"Not just the look... The stitching, the fuzzy spots ... even the tiny stains match up perfectly..."
Based on the girl's detailed account, Nazuna confirms that Mr. Roundy is Mr. Puff-Puff and vice versa.
"How is this even possible...?!"

"It must be the work of Ironclaw the Bandit!" the girl declares, her voice trembling with anger.
"Ironclaw the Bandit?"
According to the girl, this is an urban legend whispered among the children of the Ash District—a notorious thief who "steals children's beloved dolls."
Countless dolls have fallen victim to this villain, leaving a trail of heartbroken children who mourns the loss of their precious playmates. The girl before them is clearly one such victim.
"Ah, so ... that's what this shop's all about."
These dolls, each containing "love and soul,"—were they all taken from children?
How clever, hiding in plain sight all along.
"Leave it to me," Nazuna announces with burning passion. "In the name of the Lord of the Prize Claw, I will bring your companions back!"
"Nazuna seems ... really fired up about this," Kaede remarks, her expression caught between worry and admiration.
"... Leave her to it. We need to ready ourselves for a fight," Nazuka says quietly, cleaning her staff.
"A fight? Eh? Who are we fighting?" Fuyuka remains completely oblivious to the situation.

Later, the legend of Ironclaw the Bandit gained an interesting epilogue: A mysterious Lord of the Prize Claw appeared, single-handedly emptying every claw machine in the store, reuniting children with their beloved companions... As for the evil Ironclaw, he was shamefully brought to justice by the Lord of the Prize Claw!
What a truly delightful ending indeed.
DiscIP.214037.4.cn:
这家新开的娃娃店铺，生意很好，并且这里的布娃娃都很特别，用专业人士的话来说，就是——
“因长时间的细心呵护，而产生了爱与灵魂。”小禾满脸认真，但讲出的话却让别人摸不到头脑。
“应该是指……布娃娃被护理得很好的意思吧？”冬香尝试着理解小禾所说的话。
“没错！而且，你看它们身上的小饰品，简直就像是量身定做的一样。“
一旦讨论起布娃娃，小禾就开始变得滔滔不绝了起来。
“那种恰到好处、并且丝毫不会显得多余的感觉，只有满溢的爱意才能做到！”
说着，小禾咽了口口水。
“……所以，如果能带一只回家的话……！”

“不行！家里已经没有空间了。而且来之前已经说好了的吧？今天只是来看看的。”枫打破了小禾的梦想。
“是啊。而且，假如这家伙真的动手的话……”夏花也叹了口气，“这店过不了今天就会倒闭了。我说的没错吧？娃娃机仙人？”
没错，这家店的商法是——无论看上哪个娃娃，都不能直接购买，而是得用抓娃娃机碰运气！
“哼哼……这可是我大展神威的好机会，祈祷我会手下留情吧——”

“那个！请问你很会抓娃娃吗？”二人的对话被一名孩童的天真问句所打断。
四个人不约而同地看向这个小小的闯入者。
“啊……哎？”小禾还没有搞清楚情况。
“刚刚，是不是她叫你‘娃娃机仙人’，所以你很会抓娃娃，对吗？” 
“是我没错……”
“求求你了，娃娃机仙人，帮我抓到圆滚滚吧！”
“哎哎？”

“圆滚滚”大概是孩童最喜欢的布娃娃的名字吧，他攒下的零用钱都要见底了，仍然还是没有抓到。

按键，投币，然后“啪叽——”、“嗡嗡——”、“哐当——”。
“给你，记得要好好对待他。”小禾三下五除二地就搞定了这艰巨的任务，把“圆滚滚”递给了他。
“哇，谢谢你，你果然真的是娃娃机仙人！”孩童抱着娃娃开心蹦跳着离开了。
“不愧是小禾……”
“……确实很厉害啊。”
“今天小试牛刀，现在就先回家吧。等下次有心情再来——”

刚出门，众人发现方才的孩童被另一名女孩阻拦住了去路，她似乎想要抢走他手中的圆滚滚。
“放手！这是我刚求娃娃机仙人帮我抓来的圆滚滚君！”男孩蹲在地上死死地抱着娃娃。
“该放手的人是你才对！凭什么给我的噗咻噗咻君乱起名字！”女孩同样拼尽了全力。
“我的——”
“是我的——”

“这种状况一般怎么处理啊？”
“……关于娃娃的事，还是问她比较好。”顺着夏花的目光，众人看向了小禾。

“嗯——！这里面肯定有什么不对！”她没有过多的犹豫，就奔向了两人，“你们俩！给我停下！”
三个小个子在一番混乱的追闹中冷静了下来。
原来，女孩丢失了一个名字叫噗咻噗咻君的玩偶，而且噗咻噗咻君，简直就和圆滚滚长得一模一样。
“不仅仅是长得一样……如果缝线的路径、起球的地方……甚至难以注意的小污渍都能对得上的话……”
在听过女孩的描述后，小禾可以断定，眼前的圆滚滚就是噗咻噗咻君。
“这到底是怎么回事……？！”

“一定是铁爪大盗干的！”女孩愤愤不平的说道。
“铁爪大盗？”
听女孩描述，这是灰城区孩子们口中流传着的一个“专偷孩子们心爱布娃娃的大盗”的传说。
无数布娃娃遭其毒手，许多孩子们陷入了失去心爱同伴的悲痛中，久久不能自拔。眼前的女孩看来就是其中的受害者。
“难道这家店……原来如此。”
原来这些有着”爱与灵魂“的布娃娃，都是从孩子们手里偷来的吗？
——好一个铁爪大盗，原来这就是所谓的“灯下黑”？
“放心吧。” 小禾燃起了从未有过的斗志，“赌上娃娃机仙人之名，我一定会将你们的同伴解救出来的！”
“小禾她，好像……很有干劲呢。”枫有些担心又有些欣慰的扶住了脸。
“……随便她吧。我们待会，得做好打架的准备了。”夏花默默地开始擦拭手中的法杖。
“打架？诶？要和谁打架？”冬香似乎仍然在状况外。

后来，铁爪大盗的传说，就加上了一个有趣的收尾：一位神秘的抓娃娃仙人登场，仅凭一己之力、便将整个店的抓娃娃机搬空了，孩子们心满意足地找回了自己的同伴……而邪恶的铁爪大盗，在恼羞成怒后，也被抓娃娃仙人顺利地绳之以法！
真是可喜可贺，可喜可贺。

DiscIP.214038.4.en:
"Ugh, It's sooo hot..."
Shia shifts restlessly on her bed, her hair tangled and damp against her neck and back, unable to find comfort in her afternoon nap.
Summer after summer, her long hair annoys her, yet she can never part with more than a trim.
Since sleep eludes her, perhaps a walk would serve better.
The moment she pushes the door open, a gush of heated air barges in. The beach feels like one giant frying pan under the sun.
This crazy summer heat—there's just no escaping it.

"Help me! Somebody—!"
"Please! Is anyone there?!"
A little girl struggles in the sea, fighting to keep herself from being swallowed by the waves. Her friends panic, frozen in place on the shore.
Without a moment's hesitation, Shia kicks off her shoes and dashes toward the water, ignoring the searing heat burning her soles.
Fortunately, the girl isn't far from shore. She's just too small and the sea got too deep for her within a few steps.
"Easy now, sweetheart. You're safe with me."
Shia scoops up the girl with both hands and quickly brings her ashore. Her companions immediately crowd around.
"Lila, are you alright...?"
"We're so sorry. We shouldn't have laughed at you..."
Shia hears that and frowns, "What happened?"
The children mumble and avoid eye contact. Swimming rings scattered on the beach suggest they came to play together.
"They didn't believe me about my fish friend."
The quiet little girl suddenly speaks up, her voice laden with grievances, "I saw this huge fish yesterday while fishing with Mom. It was a gray fish with a big head that kept following us."
"We made plans to meet today—it even waved its tail to say yes."
"I wanted to bring everyone here to play with it ... but we waited and waited, and it never showed up."
"So you went into the water to look for it?" Shia pieces it together, "You wanted to prove your friendship with the fish was real, didn't you?"

After appeasing the children, Shia leads them to rest in a shady spot under a tree, keeping them from getting into any more trouble.
"... Sis, I want you to have this swimming ring."
As Shia turns around and meet the little girl's hopeful gaze, memories from deep within stir.

As a child, she had been certain that she shared a special bond with the fish.
The crabs, shells, and starfish ... every sea creature was her companion.
Back then, unable to swim, she would sit in her swimming ring, drifting with the waves—the long summer days were finally bearable.

And so, Shia takes the swimming ring and walks toward the seaside, hand-in-hand with the young girl.
DiscIP.214038.4.cn:
“天气也太热了吧……”
黏腻的发丝纠缠在后背和脖颈上，希娅翻来覆去换了各种姿势，还是无法舒适地午睡。
每逢盛夏，她总因这头长发而烦恼，却又舍不得剪去太多。
既然睡不着了，不如出去走走。
一推开门，室外的热气扑面而来，沙滩如同一张巨大的烤盘。
炎炎夏日，无处可逃。

“救命，救命——”
“有人吗？快来人啊！！”
一个小女孩在海中挣扎着，努力保持身体不被海水吞没。她的同伴们慌了神，手足无措地站在岸边。
希娅见状，顾不得脚下灼热的沙石，脱下鞋子赤脚飞奔向海边。
幸好小女孩离岸边不远，只是个子太小，往海里多走几步便触不到海底，陷入了危险之中。
“别怕，放轻松，你不会有事的。”
希娅双手托起小女孩，很快将她带上了岸。同伴们立刻围了上来：
“栗拉，你还好吗……”
“我们错了，我们不应该笑话你……”
希娅敏锐捕捉到了关键词，皱起眉头：“怎么回事？”
小孩子们支支吾吾不敢说话，几个游泳圈横七竖八地堆在沙滩上，看样子是一起来玩的。
“她们不相信我和鱼是好朋友。”
原本一言不发的小女孩突然开口，声音充满了委屈：“昨天妈妈带着我一起打渔，我遇到了一条脑袋大大的，身体是灰色的鱼，它一直跟着我们。”
“我和它约好了今天再见，它还冲我甩了甩尾巴。”
“我就想着带大家一起来找它玩……可是，等了好久它也没来。”
“所以，你就想去海里找它？”希娅大概猜出了事情原委，“大家不相信你和鱼是好朋友，你要证明给他们看，对不对？”

安抚好小朋友们后，希娅索性找了一块树荫坐下休息，省得她们一不小心再闯祸。
“……姐姐，这个游泳圈，送给你。”
希娅回过头，对上了小女孩充满期待的目光，内心深处的记忆突然被唤醒。

——小时候的她，也坚信自己和鱼是好朋友。
不仅是鱼，还有螃蟹、贝壳、海星……大海中的一切，都是她朝夕相处的同伴。
那时还不会游泳的她，常常坐在游泳圈里，顺着海浪漂流，漫长的夏日因此变得不再难捱——

于是，希娅接过游泳圈，牵着小女孩的手，朝海边走去。

DiscIP.214039.4.en:
Karin felt a little down.
Although she was in the clear with her grandmother, a new annoyance had emerged.
A bright sky, a light breeze—today should have been perfect. She ought to be at the beach with Shia, digging for crabs, picking shell fishes, letting Shia take her surfing, then sitting on the sandy beach, eating barbecue as the sun went down...
But all that went out of the window. The beach was crawling with way too many people.
People who shouldn't even be here.

"Wow, that surf board looks awesome! Iris, time to give Loxy a new look!"
"But we don't have the budget for decoration. We have to land a big commission first..."
"Hehe, if Noya's interested, I can teach you the basics of surfing."
"Really? Yay!"

"You are the most popular Trekker of seafaring in Carlo right now, Shia. Could you tell us one of your cool sea stories?"
"Sea stories...?"
"Yeah! The wilder the better—the scarier the better★"

"When are they going to leave?!"
Karin sulked in the shade while Shia was surrounded by throng of people. She crushed her soda can into a twisted mess.
Her phone buzzed. A message from Amber.
"Why don't you come join us?"
Karin froze. A few days ago, out of politeness, she'd exchanged contacts with these people. She had zero intention of socializing with any of them.
And this Amber girl... She hardly ever spoke. Why was she approaching her now? As Karin hesitated, another message appeared:
"If you don't speak honestly, how will anyone know what you feel?"
Karin shot to her feet and spotted Amber by the drink stand, clearly watching her the whole time.

Karin chose the direct approach. She stormed up to Amber, locked eyes with her and snapped:
"Why are you watching me?"
Shock, confusion, panic—all flickered in Amber's gaze. Then, slowly, her face reddened.
"W-what's that supposed to mean..." Karin grew flustered as well. The sun beat down on her face, and she felt hotter and hotter.

"Amber, Karin—what are you two chatting about?"
"Eh? Why are your faces so red? They remind me of watermelons!"
"See you later." And with that, Amber just bolted.
"Hey! What do you mean by that!"
But Karin's demand went unanswered. She stared after Amber, unaware of the "danger" closing in behind her.
"Ow—my ear! Let go! Now!"
"Yay! I got her ears! Iris, you come try it, too!"
"Noya, maybe this isn't such a good idea..."
"It's a terrible idea! Just what do you think I am?!"
Karin fought back, but Noya was far too strong. Out of options, she finally shouted the words she'd been holding back all this time:
"Shia—Shia—stop playing with them—"
"Come save meeee!!"
DiscIP.214039.4.cn:
花铃有些郁闷。
尽管圆满解决了奶奶的事情，但是随之而来产生了新的烦恼。
像今天这样晴朗微风的日子，本该是一个享受夏日的好天气。她可以和希娅在海边挖螃蟹捡贝壳，让希娅带着自己冲浪，傍晚和希娅坐在沙滩上一边看夕阳一边吃烧烤……
然而，她美好的计划无法实现了，此刻的沙滩上多了太多人。
……太多本不应该存在的人。

“哇，这个冲浪板好帅啊！鸢尾，是时候给‘小绿’换个新皮肤了！”
“可是，目前我们没有改装小车的预算，只能等什么时候接一个大委托……”
“呵呵，如果尘沙感兴趣的话，我可以教你简单的冲浪。”
“好耶——”

“作为卡洛镇当下最受欢迎的航海旅人，希娅可以分享一些你在出海时遇到的精彩故事吗？”
“精彩……故事？”
“对，越离奇越好，越恐怖越好哦★”

……这些人，到底什么时候能走啊？！
花铃坐在树荫下，望着希娅被各种人团团围住，手中的易拉罐捏成了麻花。
手机响了，她打开一看，竟然是琥珀发来的短信：
“为什么不过去一起玩？”
花铃瞪大了眼睛。出于礼貌，她前几天被迫和这些人交换了联系方式，但她根本不想产生多余的联系。
这个琥珀……平时没怎么见她说话，没想到她主动找上门了。就在花铃思考该怎么回复的时候，第二条信息弹了出来：
“不坦诚的话，对方就不会知道你的心意了。”
花铃猛地站起来，发现琥珀就站在离她不远的冷饮摊旁。很显然，她的一举一动都被对方暗中观察着。

于是，花铃选择了更直接的沟通方式，她气冲冲地跑到琥珀身边，盯着她的眼睛，一字一句地说：
“你干嘛关注我？”
她在琥珀眼中看到了震惊、动摇、惶恐……紧接着，琥珀的脸竟然慢慢变红了。
“你、你这是什么意思啊……”花铃也变得不知所措起来，太阳晒在她的脸上，她觉得越来越热了。

“琥珀、花铃——你们聊什么呢？”
“咦？你们的脸……怎么都像西瓜汁一样？”
“我先走了。”琥珀丢下一句话后，飞速逃窜。
“喂！你到底什么意思啊！”
然而，花铃的质问没有回应，她盯着琥珀的背影，没留意到身后逐渐逼近的危险：
“啊——我的耳朵！！你快松手！！”
“终于摸到了！太棒了，我早就想摸一摸了……鸢尾你也来试试吧！”
“尘沙，这样是不是不太好……”
“是非常不好！你们把我当成什么了啊？！”
花铃挣扎无果，尘沙的力气比她大了太多。无奈之下，她终于喊出了藏在心底的那句话：
“希娅——希娅——你不要和别人玩了——”
“快来、快来救救我啊！！”

DiscIP.214040.4.en:
In that instant, the girl's mind went blank.
She thought she was still searching for an answer, but her body had already instinctively reacted.

"Hah!"
Her fist stirred a gale. The steadfast enemy roared and raged, but was forced to stagger back.

The great monster had a tenacity that matched its size. A single punch was hardly enough to knock it down.
Lesser monsters kept swarming in, the fallen piling into mounds before her.

The fight dragged on.
But strangely—
She didn't feel like she could lose.
It was an emotion she was feeling for the first time, one she hesitated to name. It was—

... Trust ... faith ... reliance...
...And with that, a bit of self-confidence.

So this is what it feels like to fight as a team... She thought.
She had practiced it countless times, but it always felt like something from a dream.

Her heart pounded as sweat beaded on her brow.
The crisis was unlike any she had faced, the burden heavier than any she had shouldered.
And yet, she had never felt so free, so at ease, so alive.
She threw every punch with all her might, each one a thrilling release.

She knew where this strength came from.
From the person who gave her this precious chance, from the companions who silently guarded and guided her.
And now, it was her turn to protect them.
This thought alone filled her with endless courage.

She would not lose.
Not until the hulking enemy collapsed, not until cheers rose behind her, not until sunlight crept through the forest trees to warm her skin...
She looked down at her fist, where surging confidence had transformed into solid victory, and clenched it tight.
DiscIP.214040.4.cn:
在那个刹那，少女的头脑一片空白。
她以为自己还在寻找答案；可实际上，她的身体却比思维更先一步地行动了。

“哈！”
拳头刮起了风暴，岿然的敌人怒吼、咆哮，却不得不往后倒退。

巨大的魔物，有着与其体型相匹配的顽强生命力，光靠这一拳还不足以让它倒下。
更小的魔物们还在源源不断赶来，被打倒的怪物在面前堆砌成一堆堆小山。

战况依旧焦灼。
但奇妙的是——
她完全不觉得自己会输。
有生以来第一次触碰到的情感。她迟疑了很久才确认。那是——

……信任……相信……信赖……
……还有，一点点，自信。

原来我可以这么习惯……和别人一起战斗，少女心想。
她曾经练习过无数次，却总是觉得，只能在梦中实现。

心脏怦怦直跳，汗水从额头上流淌下来。
从未有过的危机，从未有过的重担。
然而，她的内心却又是从未有过的自由、放松、愉悦。
每一次挥出拳头，都拼尽全力、酣畅淋漓。

她知道这一切的来源。
那个给予了她宝贵机会的人、那群默默守护着、引领着她的伙伴。
而这一次，轮到她来保护大家了——
这个念头一旦浮上脑海，便有无止尽的勇气浮上心头。

她，绝不会输。
直到庞然敌人颓然倒下，直到欢呼声从背后响起，直到天空的光芒透过森林落在身上……
她看着自己的拳头，将激昂的信心转化为确实的胜利，紧紧攥在手心。

DiscIP.214041.4.en:
The storybook from the Monolith described the customs of another continent, where people celebrated a festival commemorating the birth of a deity in the midst of heavy winter snow. On that day, they would eat delicious roast chicken together and open gifts by a warm fireplace—gifts that were delivered by reindeer running across the sky.
It sounded pretty similar to Nova's Snowish Festival.
But they used reindeer to deliver gifts...
A week before the Snowish Festival, Laru looked at the sleigh in the warehouse, then remembered the whip Albedo had given her. Suddenly, she had an idea.

Early in the morning, she headed into the forest and found two reindeer nibbling on moss. With carrots in hand and plenty of coaxing, she managed to lure the big creatures to the area near her home.
Then she dragged the sleigh out from the warehouse and loaded it with the gifts she had prepared for her friends.
To make the sleigh look more fun, she placed a few cute dolls on top as decorations.
Now all that was left was to have the reindeer pull the sleigh into the sky—

She vaguely remembered learning a flying spell long ago during an outdoor training class. Holding the whip, she focused on the memory, murmured the incantation, and snapped the whip. Snow mist burst outward, and light danced between the sleigh and the reindeer like fluttering sprites.
Then the decorative dolls suddenly sprang to life. Startled, the reindeer broke free of the harness. The dolls grabbed the reins instead and took off across the snowfield, dragging the sleigh behind them.

Eh? Eh? Eh? This isn't how it's supposed to go!
But... But...
The magically empowered dolls raced across the snow with the sleigh. Meanwhile, the two reindeer ran beside them wild and free. Laru, who had fallen onto the sleigh, stood up against the bright morning light and suddenly felt that this "mistake" wasn't really a problem after all.

"Then let's go! We'll take these gifts to Willow and give her a huge surprise!"
DiscIP.214041.4.cn:
星塔里的故事书里，描绘了某个大陆的文化习俗，那里的人们会冬季大雪时庆祝一个纪念神诞生的节日。大家会在这一天一起吃美味的烤鸡，围在暖和的壁炉边拆礼物——听说礼物都是奔跑在天空的驯鹿送来的。
看起来和诺瓦大陆的雪愿节类似。
但用驯鹿送礼物……
雪愿节的前一周，菈露看着仓库里的雪橇，又想起之前奥尔贝德给她的那根鞭子，突然有了主意。

清早，她来到森林里，找到了两只正在吃草的驯鹿，拿着胡萝卜连哄带骗地把这两个大家伙引到了她家附近。
之后她又从仓库里把雪橇拖了出来，装上准备好要送给友人们的礼物。
最后，为了让这辆雪橇看上去更有趣，她在雪橇上摆放了几个可爱的玩偶。
那么接下来，只要让驯鹿拉着车飞上天空奔跑——

飞天的魔法似乎在很久之前学过，菈露隐约记得当年老师在室外的实训课上讲过。她拿起鞭子，凭着回忆，随着默念的吟唱结束，甩出去的鞭子打得出一片雪雾，光魔法像飞舞的精灵在雪橇和驯鹿之间跳跃。
随后，作为装饰的玩具突然动了起来，受到惊吓的驯鹿挣脱了缰绳，玩具们拉起缰绳，拖着雪橇在雪原上狂奔。

诶？诶？诶？这不对吧！
但是……但是……
得到了魔法加持的玩具拖着雪橇滑行，一旁是自由奔跑的驯鹿。摔在雪橇上的菈露站了起来，迎着明亮的晨光，突然觉得这样的失误好像也不是什么问题。

“那就这样出发吧！去让薇洛看看我们用玩具运送来的礼物！”

DiscIP.214042.4.en:
Every story gets its happy ending.

With the smuggling case solved, the chaotic mix of Trekkers meets up at the hotpot restaurant, swapping stories of the past year, discussing plans for the year ahead, or just fighting over food.
Amid the lively chatter, midnight arrives.

Hearing the fireworks, the slightly tipsy Coronis steps onto the balcony, wine glass in hand.
Maybe she just wants to watch the fireworks show. In the night breeze, she suddenly notices that someone's voice is missing from the crowd...
Where did you go?
She recalls you were just at the table, listening intently as Noya excitedly retold all the recent events.
And then...
Then—right, she'd joked about testing a new medicine on you, and you'd fled in a hurry...
Oh, right. You went out.
Of course. The drinks had run out, and you volunteered to buy more, leaving with a long list of orders.

You should be back by now, right?
Everyone inside is just chatting while fireworks continue in the distance. Coronis looks down and sees you returning with the drinks. As you look up and meet her gaze, she raises her glass your way with a grin.

"Happy New Year,"
says Coronis.
She isn't sure if you hear it, but she sees you smile and wave back—a moment she thinks she might cherish for a lifetime.
DiscIP.214042.4.cn:
故事总有大团圆落幕的时候。
 
解决了走私案之后，大家相约在火锅店里。性格各异的旅人聚在一起，或是讲述这一年的冒险，或是诉说着新春展望，或是争抢盘中的最后一只大虾。
这顿年夜饭就在这热热闹闹的氛围里，迎来了零点的钟声。
 
窗外的烟花炸开，微醺的科洛妮丝端着高脚杯走上阳台。
她或许是想看看这庆祝新年的烟花，夜晚的风拂过，科洛妮丝忽然发觉这热闹中似乎缺少了谁的声音……
你去哪了？
她开始寻找你的身影，依稀记得刚开始你还在桌边，听着尘沙手舞足蹈地讲述这几天的精彩瞬间。
然后呢……
然后她跟你开了个玩笑，要让你试试她新研发的药剂，你落荒而逃……
哦，对了，你走出去了。
科洛妮丝想起来了。因为饮料喝完了，所以你自告奋勇去给大家买，于是大家像点单似的争先恐后说出自己想喝的口味，科洛妮丝看着你拿着一张长长的单子走出去的。
 
你现在应该差不多回来了吧？
屋内的大家已经开始闲聊，远处的烟花依旧，科洛妮丝低下头，正好看见你提着袋子回来——你抬起头，目光相接的时候，科洛妮丝笑着向你举起了酒杯。
 
“新年快乐。”
科洛妮丝说道。
她不确定你听见了没有，但她看到你笑着摆摆手——她想，这一幕或许会成为她珍藏的回忆。

DiscIP.214043.4.en:
"Lady Firenze, the files."
As the turmoil in Philae finally subsides, the truth of the incident from four years ago was laid bare.
Firenze took the long-sealed dossier, her fingers brushing over the yellowed pages before freezing on a familiar name.
Giotto de Feltro.
Former Director of R&D at United Harvest. Sentenced to life for abuse of power, bribery, and leaking trade secrets.
"Father."

For a fleeting moment, reality blurred. She saw her younger self rushing toward her father on the sofa, only to remember her mother's lessons at the last second and stiffen into a proper lady's pose.
"Da... Father, good day. I... I wish to visit your lab today... Would that distract you from your work?"
"Of course not. But we need a plan to hide from Mom. Or I'll be grounded right next to you, writing our family rules over and over..."
She felt his large hand on her head, drawing her into a whispered conspiracy to test the matriarch's patience.

Firenze realized how alien that child's smile felt to her now.
She tried to mimic it, but her jaw clenched involuntarily until she tasted the sharp tang of iron.
"The truth is finally out..."
Her friend sighed. "Four years, we've waited."
"Witches from Flavio are swarming for an exclusive with you. How should we handle them?"
Firenze didn't hesitate. "Refuse them. If they want the truth, they shouldn't ask me for the story."
"Understood. Once the files are organized, we'll pick a few suitable reporters."

Is this the outcome Father wanted?
Firenze looked away, trying to grasp his fading image.
"Haha, I'm sure of it. I'll grow that plant. It's going to be revolutionary. By the time you're all grown up, those plants might just be part of our everyday life. Sounds fascinating, huh?"

Alright then. I shall make it my duty to fulfill that.
DiscIP.214043.4.cn:
“翡冷翠大人，您要的资料。”
随着菲莱的动荡平息，四年前那起事件的真相也终于呈现在了众人的面前。
翡冷翠接过尘封已久的案件档案，她抚过泛黄的纸张，指尖定在那道熟悉的名字上。
乔托·达·费尔特罗。
前联合种业研发部部长，因滥用职权收受贿赂、非法披露商业机密获罪，判处终身监禁。
“父亲。”

恍惚间，翡冷翠似乎看到尚且年幼的自己跌跌撞撞地奔向那道端坐在沙发上的身影，直到靠近前才记起母亲的教诲，努力摆出一副淑女的姿势——
“爸……父亲，日安。今天我、我想参观您的实验室……这会、会打扰您的工作吗？”
“当然可以。不过，我们得想个办法，瞒着妈妈才行。不然，连着我也要一起被关禁闭默写家规了……”
她感受到一双大手轻拍过头顶，悄悄和自己密谋起一个在家族女主人底线边缘来回试探的计划。
 
翡冷翠这才发现，回忆里那个孩子模样的自己，在那一日，嘴角扬起的弧度对现在的她而言，是如此陌生。
她试着复制那抹笑容，却不由自主紧咬牙关，直至在嘴中，尝到了血腥的锈味。
“真相终于大白……”
身边的友人发出一声感慨，“我们等了四年。”
“从弗拉维奥那儿来了不少魔女，怕是都等不及要来找你做独家专访。你打算怎么做？”
翡冷翠没有丝毫犹豫，“不接受。如果是为真相而来，那采访对象不应是我。”
“明白。之后等案卷资料梳理完成，再选择几名合适的魔女负责报道。”

这样的结果，父亲会满意吗？
翡冷翠遥遥望着那张模糊的脸。
“呵呵，爸爸有信心，一定能培育出那样的植物。这将会是伟大的革新，等你长大后，这个项目的成果说不定就已经融入日常咯？会很有意思的。”

那么，我将如您所愿。

DiscIP.214044.4.en:
What exactly is Coronis researching?

All you know is that she's been making frequent trips outside Cangwu lately, gone for two or three days at a time. Each return is the same: a satchel of herbs and small monsters, before she vanishes again. By the time she shows up again, those herbs and specimens are all gone.
If anything, the volume of liquid in her syringe seems to have increased.

What exactly is the liquid in that enormous syringe she always carries on her?
You've seen her use it against terrifying monsters, to destroy Stellaroids in the Monolith—it looks like some kind of dreadful, lethal potion. Yet you've also witnessed her injecting children and dying patients with it, as if it were a lifesaving elixir.
Finally, your curiosity gets the better of you.

"You wish to know what the liquid in my syringe does? Well, that's complicated," Coronis replies, her expression solemn. "Its properties change depending on the materials I acquire. It may heal. It may kill. Or perhaps..."
Her eyes linger on you, thoughtful.
"Would you like to find out the effects of what I prepared today?"
Before you can even process it, Coronis shoves you down onto a cot in the infirmary. After drawing the curtain shut, she climbs atop, her syringe already filled to the brim.
Your gaze fixes on the cold glint of the needle.
"W-wait!..."
"Remain calm. It'll be quick, and it won't kill."
"That's not what I'm worried about!"

Just as your heart is hammering and you're certain the syringe is about to pierce your skin, Coronis finally lets you go, looking utterly gratified.
"Just a joke. This batch isn't approved for human trials yet. But..." She puts the syringe away, her tone mischievous. "That said, you place far too much trust in me. You should have fled the moment I drew the syringe."
DiscIP.214044.4.cn:
科洛妮丝到底在做什么研究？
 
你只知道科洛妮丝最近总往苍梧城外跑，一去就是两三天，每次都会带回来一些草药和小型魔物，之后又是一天不见踪影。等她再出现的时候，那些草药和魔物都已经消失。
非要说的话，她那个注射器里的液体似乎变多了……？
 
她随身携带的那个巨大的注射器里，装的药剂到底是什么呢？
你见过她用这些药剂对付可怕的魔物，用来破坏星塔里的星骸，看上去像是某种药效可怖的致命药剂；但你又看过她给小朋友和垂危的病人注射，看上去又像是救命的良药。
终于，你还是忍不住好奇……
 
“你问我的注射器里的药剂是什么功效？这可不好说。”科洛妮丝认真地回答道，“具体的功效会根据最近我找到的药材不同而变化，或许能治病，或许能致命，又或许……”
她忽然若有所思地看着你。
“要来试试吗？我今天做出来的药剂的什么功效？”
你还没反应过来，科洛妮丝已经将你推倒在她的病床上。帷幕拉上，她坐上病床，手中的注射器已经在眨眼间抽满了药剂。
你盯着她手里冒着寒光的针头。
“等、等一下……！” 
“别怕，很快就好了，不会死的。”
“重点不是这个吧！！！”
 
最后，在你紧张得心脏砰砰直跳、真的以为注射器要扎到自己身上的时候，科洛妮丝终于心满意足地放过了你。
“开玩笑的，这个药剂还没有经过测试，我不会把它用在人身上的。不过……”她收起注射器，意味深长地说道：“你也太信任我了，遇到这种情况，你应该立刻逃走才对。”

DiscIP.214045.4.en:
A mountain breeze rustles through the trees, stirring their branches as they whisper in the quiet.
The peace doesn't last, shattered by gruff shouts a moment later.

"Flank her! Don't let her get away!"
Mercenaries charge out from the brush, their boots heavy against the damp earth and fallen leaves.
They've been hunting her since the foot of the mountain, finally hounding her out of the dense woods and into the open—a vast sea of flowers.
Wildflowers sway like rolling waves in the wind. At the center of the field stands Otoha, watching calmly as the mercenaries close in from all sides.
There is nowhere left to run.

"It's over," the lead mercenary pants, his voice cold. "Hand over what you took, and maybe we can still settle this peacefully."
The girl says nothing.
Instead, she looks down at her paper umbrella and begins to fold it with agonizing care, as if adjusting a precious accessory. She doesn't even seem to notice the weapons pointed at her.
"Are you even listening?!"
"I hear you," she says, finally looking up with the polite tone of a neighborly greeting. "I appreciate the warning, but..."
She tilts her head, her gaze sweeping over them.
"How can you be so sure the 'me' you've been chasing is actually me?"
A sudden gust whips through the trees just as she finishes.
The flowers dance. Petals are swept into the air, and through the floral storm, the mercenaries catch a glimpse of her faint smile—then freeze in shock.
Behind the girl who calls herself a "Goodwind Homecare Representative," a row of paper parasols suddenly appears, unfurling one by one.
In the blink of an eye, the wind kicks up a blinding cloud of petals. By the time it clears, the center of the field is empty. She is gone, leaving only a single parasol resting quietly among the flowers.
DiscIP.214045.4.cn:
山风穿过树林时，晃动着枝桠，在宁静中发出细微的“沙沙”声响。
只可惜这份宁静并没有维持多久，下一刻，林间响起一阵粗鲁的叫骂声——
 
“从两边包抄！别让她跑了！”
几名佣兵从林中冲出，靴子踩过落叶与泥土，发出凌乱的声响。
他们已经追踪她很久了，从山脚一路紧逼，终于，他们把目标从地形复杂的树林里逼出来——树林的尽头，是一片开阔的花海。
风吹过，大片不知名的野花摇曳起伏，像层层起伏的海浪；而花海中央，乙叶安静地站在那，扫了一眼包抄的佣兵们。
她已经无处可逃。
 
“事已至此，”为首的佣兵喘了口气，冷声说道，“把你拿走的东西还回来，我们还有商量的余地。”
少女没有回答。
她只是低头看了看自己手中的纸伞，然后慢条斯理地把伞面一点一点收拢，动作专注得像是在整理一件心爱的饰品，仿佛看不见面前举着武器的追兵。
“喂！你听见没有！”
“听见了。”她终于抬起头，语气礼貌得像是在回应邻居的问候，“谢谢您的好意提醒，只是——”
少女微微歪着头，看向他们。
“你怎么确定，你现在追踪的这个我，就是我本尊呢？”
话音落下的同时，一阵山风正好穿过树林。
花海被掀动。无数花瓣被卷上半空，佣兵从纷飞的花瓣间隙中看到那名少女浅浅的笑意，随后，他们愣住了。
这位自称是谷风家政代表的少女身后，多出一排纸伞，一柄，两柄，次第展开。
下一瞬，强风掀起散落的花瓣，不过一眨眼，当佣兵们再看向花海中央时，那里已经空无一人，只剩下一柄纸伞静静落在花丛里。

DiscIP.214046.4.en:
Once the dust had settled and the safety of the involved Trekkers was confirmed, Wraith slipped away from camp unnoticed.
She walked alone through the silent, frozen husk of the capital.

The frantic pace of recent events had made her forget that she owed herself a moment of peace.
Now, she intended to claim it—a solitary pilgrimage through the city that had raised her and taught her how to survive.
Known for her swift, decisive action, she now took her time, strolling aimlessly down the snow-blanketed streets.
In a city where time stood frozen, there was no need to rush. Her memories could unfold as slowly as her footsteps.

A broken sign marked what used to be her favorite bakery. She smiled, remembering how she used to hoard her breakfast allowance, racing here on Saturday mornings to snag the special bread fresh from the oven.

That shattered ruin of a street was once the Corridor of Glory. It used to welcome the Flame Hunters home in triumph, stretching all the way to Central Park where the grand Flame Hunt Feast drew thousands every year.

Then there was the fountain, now a sculpture of ice. She used to wash the grime from her gear there after morning drills. An older girl would always be on the nearby bench, reading. They never spoke, but their synchronized schedules felt like a silent contest of discipline.

She paused in front of an old tavern, struck by a memory, and stepped inside.
It had been run by her grandfather's friends. When she was little, the owner would always invent excuses to keep her out when she came to fetch her grandfather. She used to dream of returning as a grown woman, sitting at the bar to regale them with her own heroic tales.

A box in the corner caught her eye, covered by a frost-proof cloth. A note was taped where no one could miss it:
"A little help for lost Trekkers. Hope you make it through."
The owner must have left these emergency supplies for anyone stumbling into the ruins. Judging by the contents, it had seen use. Grateful Trekkers had left notes of thanks, and some had even added their own supplies to the cache, paying the kindness forward to strangers they would never meet.

Wraith decided to do the same. She deposited some extra canned food from camp and, for the sake of symbolism, took a single bottle of ginger ale.
"To Norstheim. And to ... all our tomorrows."
She toasted the silence as if the old patrons were still there.
However, she felt no sorrow. The physical vessels of her memories might be gone, but the people who built them survived. They were out there, fighting to build a new home.

Before leaving, Wraith added a note of her own:
"I returned. I finished our story in Norstheim—an adventure that belongs to me, and to all of us." —Wraith
DiscIP.214046.4.cn:
平息这场风波，并确认那些被卷入事件的旅人们都平安无事后。
风影独自一人离开了营地，徘徊在这座空无一人的冰封废都中。

来到这里之后，接连发生了许多事，以至于风影都忘记还欠自己一点时间，
她准备好好在这座曾经养育自己，教会自己生存的城市里，进行一场追忆的巡礼。
一向雷厉风行的她，此时却慢悠悠地走在积雪的马路上，
没有方向，没有目的，在这片冻结时间的城市中，记忆和脚步都可以走得很慢。

那边的缺了半个门牌的小店，那是曾经自己最喜欢的烘焙坊，她想起小时候，自己总是省下祖父给的早饭钱，赶在周六开店时跑去买限定的面包。

那边残破不堪的街道，过去是专门用来迎接猎火者们凯旋的荣耀长廊，它一路延伸到城市的中心公园，每年都会在这里举行万众瞩目的猎火盛宴。

那边被冻成冰花的公园喷泉，她还记得自己总在晨练结束后，到那里清理衣服和武器上的污渍。而一旁的长椅上，总会有一位独自看书的姐姐。她们从来没问过彼此的名字，却总是很默契地出现在同一时间，仿佛在进行一场无声的毅力较量

当来到一座酒馆前，风影突然想到了什么，随后便径直走进店内。
这家酒馆曾由祖父的朋友们经营着，幼时的风影每次来这里接晚归的祖父时，都会被店长以各种理由拦在外面。她曾想再过几年，等自己长大后能独当一面时，她便来这里讲述属于自己的英雄事迹。

余光间，她望见吧台的角落里放着一个被防寒布盖住的箱子。一张纸条被贴在最醒目的位置。
“给迷途的旅人一点小小的补给，希望你能挺过去。”
很显然，这是店长留给误入废都的旅人准备的应急物资。而从内部残留的些许补给来看，也确实有旅人得到了帮助，他们纷纷写下了表达感激的留言，也有旅人为后来者留下了自己的物资，鼓励陌生的人们继续前行。

风影也决定效仿，于是她从营地带回了多余的罐头，并象征性地拿走了一瓶姜汁汽水。
“敬北境，也敬，所有的明天。”
她对着空荡的酒馆举杯，仿佛曾经的人还生活在这里。
她并不觉得悲伤，虽然承载记忆的东西消失了，但创造这些记忆的人们依然存在，他们还在不远的地方，为了新的家园而努力着。

临走前，风影也在这里留下来自己的字条：
“我回到了这里，完成了在北境的，属于我，属于我们的冒险故事。”——风影

DiscIP.214047.4.en:
A gentle breeze drifted through the windows of Post Haste, reaching the three girls seated around the table.
The tabletop was covered in all kinds of letters, some freshly written, others showing the wear of time. Now that the monster had been dealt with, the backlog of mail could finally be delivered.
And at this very moment, each of the girls held pen and paper, writing down what they wished to say to someone close to their hearts.

To our most esteemed Boss:
May these words find you as though we were face to face... Since your last letter arrived, several days have passed without another.
If you do not get in touch soon, us at Post Haste may be forced to employ certain special measures...
"Hey, Freesia, what are you writing over there? You look so serious!"

The girl reading the letter leaned forward with both hands on the table as she scanned the lines her companion had written, puffing out her cheeks as she did. She bounced up and down to show her displeasure.
"But Donna, you are the one who said that if Boss doesn't reply again, we could use the Heartlink."
Freesia looked at her with such earnest sincerity that Donna could only sigh and let the air puff out of her cheeks.
"Yes, that is technically our "best measure"—but when you write it down like that, it makes Post Haste sound like some evil organization!"
"I see. Then I'll reword it..."
Freesia nodded quietly, pulled out a fresh sheet of letter paper, and bent over to start writing again.
Donna turned her attention to the third girl at the table. Teresa had slumped forward over the desk. Her pen kept tapping the same spot on the paper again, again, and again, leaving a spreading blot of dark ink. Her ink-stained fingers rubbed across it absent-mindedly until the mark had become a large cat paw print. Teresa lifted her eyes to meet Donna's.
"Donna, do I have to write one, too?"
"Of course~ If you do, Boss will definitely write back! Or do you not want to?"
"No... It's just... Does it have to follow that format?"
"Oh? Hehehe."
Donna ruffled Teresa's black hair.
"You can write it however you like. "All we need to do is make sure our feelings reach Boss. That's what matters!"
Teresa's eyes lit up at once. Then she threw herself into writing her own letter. Donna finally settled back into her chair.
She watched as the same focused look appeared on her friends' faces. She knew that every line of handwriting, every little drawing on those pages carried that same seriousness... And along with it, feelings that did not allow themselves to be shown openly but quietly flowed from the heart all the same.
A paper letter like this weighed almost nothing. Yet sometimes that tiny weight would become the final counterweight needed to snap a knot loose in someone's heart. Being a courier means carrying the responsibility like that.
With that thought, Donna took out an envelope and slid her finished letter inside.
The wind outside suddenly strengthened and rushed through the window with a low, whistling cry. Yet, the soft scratching of pens on paper drowned it out, and the girls did not notice. Only when the wind suddenly lifted the ends of their hair did they realize what had happened. The pile of letters on the table and the loose sheets beside them shot upward toward the ceiling, scattering across the room.
"Ah..."
"Waaah—! The letters are all blew away—!"
"I forgot to close the window. Oops..."
Donna tapped her head and stuck out her tongue.
"If we're not careful, everyone's heartfelt words might drift off into some corner where we can't find them."
"Mm-hmm. Which is exactly why this is the job of Courier Trekkers..."
Donna slapped the tabletop and sprang to her feet.
"Alright everyone, our newest emergency mission is—find every single letter scattered around the office!"
DiscIP.214047.4.cn:
微风和煦，穿过万送屋的窗，直至桌前的三位少女身旁。
桌上布满各式信件，从崭新的到颇显出些年头的。解决掉那只魔物后，积压的信件终于可以顺利送出。
而当下，少女们也正各执纸笔，要给思念之人写下心中所想。

魔王钧启：
见字如面……自您上次寄来信件起，已有数日没有新信往来。
若是再不保持联系，我们万送屋也会动用特殊手段……
“哎呀，苍兰你到底在一本正经地写什么呀——”

读信的少女前倾身子，双手撑住桌面，一边阅读身旁少女所写的信件正文，一边鼓圆脸颊。她娇小的身躯不断跃起，以此表达自己的不满。
“可是，是多娜说的，如果魔王再不回信，我们就要用心链催了。”
苍兰显出真诚的眼神，令多娜无奈地将两颊的气叹了出来。
“那确实是‘特殊手段’没错——但这样写的话，好像我们万送屋是什么奇怪的邪恶组织了！”
“是这样，那我再斟酌一下……”
苍兰默默点了点头，抽出一张新的信纸，继续埋头苦写起来。
多娜将视线转向桌边的第三位少女。特丽莎上半身伏在桌上，钢笔总在纸面的同一个位置上不断点下又抬起，洇出一片浓黑的墨团。沾了墨水的手指来回摩挲，让墨迹形成了一只巨大的猫爪印。特丽莎的眼神对上多娜的眼神：
“多娜，我也要写吗？”
“对哦~这样的话，魔王也一定会回信的！难道特丽莎不想写吗？”
“没有……只、只是，不按那个格式也没关系吗？”
“诶？嘿嘿嘿。”
多娜使劲揉了揉伏案少女的黑发：
“特丽莎怎么写都没事啦，只要让魔王感受到我们的心意就可以了！”
特丽莎两眼放光，随即投入进自己的创作中，多娜也终于得以将自己的身体安回椅子上。
她看着两位伙伴，认真的神情浮现于二人脸上。她知道，那信中的每一行字迹，每一枚图案，也都承载着这份认真，还有更多没有显于面上，却同样自心中流露的情感。
这样的纸质信，每一封都轻飘飘的，可有时，正是这微不足道的分量，成了扯断心结所需的最后一颗砝码。信使就是这样承载了如此重担的职业。
思绪就此为止，多娜也翻出一套信封，装套起自己写完的信件来。
骤然增强的风越过窗框，呜咽般地闯入室内。笔划过纸的簌簌声却将它盖过，未被少女们发觉。直到发尾突然被风吹起，堆积于桌上的信件与手边未压实的信纸一同被抛向天花板，飘散到房间各处。
“啊……”
“呜啊啊啊——信都被吹走了——”
“忘记关窗户了，哎呀呀~”
多娜敲敲脑袋，吐了吐舌头：
“一不注意的话，大家的心意就会丢到找不到的角落去的。”
“嗯嗯，所以说呀，这就是信使旅人该做的呢……”
多娜一拍桌面，猛地站起身。
“那么万送屋的大家，我们现在最新的紧急任务就是——找回所有散落在万送屋里的信件！”

DiscIP.214048.4.en:
"People give gifts to those they care about on the eve of the Snowish Festival, as a way of expressing their good will..."
That's how the tradition goes. But for Grace Imperium employees, there is no such thing as free time on that day. Everyone is busy preparing for the next day's events, and the gifts to be delivered are stacked in the warehouse like mountains. In all likelihood, their shift would run past midnight; then they'd shuffle home after exchanging exhausted well-wishes, catch a few hours of sleep, then dive straight into the "Big Battle."

"Even Laru, our queen of slacking, is working overtime? Now there's a sight."
Laru, mid-count, felt a coworker smack her on the back. Her sleepy brain blanked out for a second, and in that second, she promptly forgot the number.
A moment later, she let out a wail.
"No ... no no no!!! I was just about to finish counting and go home!"

Still, maybe this year's Snowish Festival would turn out a little different?
Earlier in the day, she'd seen a wooden doll in a shop window, and its face looked somewhat like her own. If she bought it as a gift... Who should it go to?
Willow? Laru instantly pictured the puzzled look on her face.
Albedo? Absolutely not—something this cute would be wasted on a boss who squeezed her dry.
The Boss, then? But what if Boss didn't like it?
Laru couldn't make up her mind, but she ended up going inside the store and buying the doll.

The Snowish Festival eventually came and went in a busy blur. By the time the midnight bells rang, Laru finally returned home after a long day and saw the neatly wrapped present waiting on her desk—
Maybe this one was meant for herself.
As a Grace Imperium messenger, she had delivered hundreds of gifts today; as the "Snowish Tree Spirit," she'd brought joy to the children. So as Laru, receiving a gift of her own felt more than fair.
Thinking that, she sat down, opened the wrapping, and placed the little doll on her desk.

And just like that, another Snowish Festival had passed.
As she drifted into the land of dreams, Laru thought she saw the tiny doll hop from her palm and lead her into a new snowy-night adventure.
DiscIP.214048.4.cn:
“人们会在雪愿节的前夜，向亲近的人赠送礼物，表达祝福……”
话虽这么说，但作为恩赐意志的员工，雪愿节的前夜根本不会有私人时间，所有人都在为明天的活动做准备，隔天要派送的礼物像小山一样堆在仓库里，不出意外，今晚的下班时间恐怕会越过零点，在大家有气无力的祝福声里，像游魂一样回家小睡几个小时，然后开始这一天的“战斗”。
 
“连摸鱼大王菈露都在这熬夜加班吗？真不可思议！”
正在清点礼物数量的菈露被同僚从背后拍了一下，有点犯困的意识宕机了一会，已经遗忘了刚到嘴边的计数。
几秒之后，少女发出惨叫。
“啊……啊啊啊啊！！！我就差数完这一点就能下班了！”
 
但或许今年的雪愿节会有些许不同呢？
路过商店橱窗时见到的木质人偶，雕刻的模样似乎和自己几分相像，如果把它当成礼物，那应该送给谁呢？
送给薇洛吗？这个名字在出现的那一瞬间菈露已经能想象到对方疑惑的表情。
送给奥尔贝德？不，这么可爱的小玩意才不要送给压榨自己的领导。
那送给魔王？万一那家伙很嫌弃怎么办？
菈露一时之间想不到答案，但在离开之前，她还是走进商店买下了这个人偶。
 
雪愿节最终还是在一片兵荒马乱中悄然过去，午夜的钟声响起，忙碌了一天的菈露回到自己的住所，再看到桌上那个被精心打包的礼物——
或许，这应该是送给自己的礼物？
作为恩赐意志的使者，她今天派送了上百份礼物；所谓“雪愿树精灵”，她今天给孩子们带来了快乐，那作为菈露，她理所应当也应该得到一份礼物吧！ 
想到这，她坐下拆开了礼物包装，最终，她将这个小人偶摆在了自己桌上。
 
今年的雪愿节就这么过去了。
进入梦乡的菈露，似乎看到了可爱的人偶从她掌心跳出去，带她去一场新的雪夜冒险。

DiscIP.214049.4.en:
The first step taken—this is the future. Stella's sky unfolds anew.
Look, the compass in your hand leads you toward the heights of the stars.


From that spark, a light is born, tearing through even the deepest darkness,
so ring the bell of our beginning—this adventure knows no end.

Across a thousand light-years, eternally constant, with these feelings held within our hearts.

Let's ascend this uncharted world, unbowed by any coming pain.
Beyond its veil, a dream awaits;
with you, we can cross the boundless plane.

The night I realized I'm not alone, memories long buried awaken.
The destiny once forgotten stirs to life—Memory of Stella Days.

Gathering scattered bonds, now that I can bid goodbye to the past.
I'll cast away all doubt and fear, and push forward beyond the stars.
Like soft clouds, gently drifting, free.
Across a thousand light-years, eternally constant, with these feelings held within our hearts.

If I'm the one to paint a tomorrow, I'll weave a future, vast and deep.
An unyielding heart that never dies, will overcome obstacles countless times.
On this long, long journey, I found my ground, a sanctuary I must protect.
My spirit soars towards a new era—Memory of Stella Days.

At the destination lies a hidden past, like a symphony of riddles resonating together.
Through every turn, no chain will hold;
you stand unbound, transcending all.
Just the Beginning—with courage held, I'll rediscover love in these hands.

Let's ascend this uncharted world, unbowed by any coming pain.
Beyond its veil, a dream awaits;
with you, we can cross the boundless plane.

The night I realized I'm not alone, memories long buried awaken.
The destiny once forgotten stirs to life—Memory of Stella Days.

DiscIP.214050.4.en:
The banquet, as usual, draws to its flawless close amid the clinking of glasses.
Dark motives may hide behind the evening's toasts, and malice may be baked into the cakes, but an air of perfect harmony fills the room ... at least it looks like that on the surface.

"But if it's all smooth sailing ... that'd be a little too boring, won't you agree?"

Bang.
In a loud crash, every light in the ballroom cuts out at once.
Plunged in darkness, the panicked guests cry out in alarm. As they scramble to find a light,
their eyes are drawn to the windows.

A lone spotlight has pierced the night from out of nowhere, shining directly onto the manor's wing.
A silhouette dances within the glare. The lithe, athletic figure darts effortlessly through the shadows.
Between the flowing hair, the fluffy tail, and the signature kunai, you already have a pretty good idea who is behind this.
Naturally, you keep quiet, eager to see how this little "prank" plays out.

The shadowy figure suddenly swells, swallowing the spotlight and plunging the room back into darkness.
A split second later, the sharp crash of shattering glass provokes another wave of screams.
The autumn wind pour in, sending chills down everyone's spine.

The chandeliers flicker before shimmering back to life.
With the chaos seemingly over, the rattled guests check on one another while cautiously edging toward the source of the noise.
Surprisingly, everyone is accounted for, and the windows, locked tight, remain perfectly intact...
Except for a single envelope that is resting on the windowsill.

Someone picks it up and pries it open. Within moments, the letter is passed around, fueling a frantic new wave of gossip.
You don't join the commotion, of course. Instead, you scan the room until you spot your real target lingering near the spiral staircase.
Naturally, there are no secret agents, ninjas, or phantom thieves at the banquet, only a maid with white hair dressed in pale blue, idly spinning a paper parasol.
She catches your eye, presses a finger to her lips with a knowing smile,
then gracefully vanishes into the shadows on the upper floor.

A strange realization hits you:
her attention was never on the decoy letter. From the very second you spotted her, she was already watching you.
DiscIP.214050.4.cn:
觥筹交错间，晚宴一如既往地迎来了圆满的尾声。
不论相撞的高脚杯中有多少暗流涌动，递出的蛋糕内又包藏了几分祸心，其乐融融的氛围仍贯穿整场宴会……即便只是看上去如此。

“不过，就这样风平浪静地抵达结尾，未免就有些太无聊了吧~？”

砰。
一声巨响，宴会厅的顶灯在瞬间全数熄灭。
陷入黑暗的人们惊呼起来，慌乱地寻找起其他光源。
他们最终不约而同地将视线投向窗外——

正有一束不知自何处而来的光柱，直直地打在翼楼上。
一道人影被光照出。那身影显出曼妙而矫健的轮廓，在光与影中穿梭不止。
你自然认得那飘逸的长发、蓬松的绒尾与标志性的苦无。你心中对它们的所属人选早已有了猜想。
不过自然，你暂不作声，只期望看到这场“恶作剧”会如何收尾。

于是，你看到这人形的影子骤然放大，直到将光源挡得严严实实，让人们再度置身昏暗之中。
随即玻璃碎裂的声音于近处响起，引得惊叫一片。
晚风灌入，携着秋的冷意，令人发怵……

吊灯闪了几闪，再度正常地亮了起来。
闹剧总算告一段落，人们一边紧张地确认着自己和身边人是否安好，一边不约而同地聚到声音传来的位置。
所幸，没有什么人失踪或倒下；窗户也仍旧完好无损，上锁紧闭着。
但有一封信函，正静静地躺在内侧窗沿上。

有人捡起信封，小心翼翼地拆开，不一会就开始在人群中论讨传阅起来，成为新一轮的谈资。
你当然不会去凑热闹，只是四处张望、寻找着，最终在通往高层的旋梯上找到了目标。
不过，宴会厅里自然不会有特工、忍者或是怪盗，取而代之的是一身苍衣、转着纸伞的白发女仆。
她对上你的视线，将食指放在唇上，向你报以一笑。
而后，她翩然转身，悄声隐没在更高处的阴影中。

不知为何，你产生了一个奇怪的想法——
她的注意力，好像从来都没有放在怪盗信上；而在你发现她的那一刻，你们便已四目相对了。

DiscIP.214051.4.en:
"Professor, look at the stars~"
Someone tugged at the hem of Canace's clothes. She turned and looked down. A long strand of stray hair was swaying freely, signaling an easy, carefree mood.
"Firefly, you're amazing. I never notice the scenery above my head."
The girl sat down and gazed at the starry sky spread across the ceiling. She fell silent. Even Avalanche seemed to share her mood, quiet now, no longer making a sound.
"Is something the matter, Firefly?"
The girl shook her head, then looked up at the professor beside her in confusion.

"The stars in the sky are so beautiful, but why do people still hurt each other beneath them?"
Canace fell silent for a moment. The world as children saw it was often the simplest, purest, and most true. But even she had no answer to this question.
"I think people know their origin, but they do not know where they are going. The future is uncertain, and that frightens them. Maybe that is why they end up in conflict."
Firefly's stray hair curled into an adorable question mark as she tilted her head at her professor.
"Sorry... That was probably too complicated."
"I get a little... But what is 'their origin'?"
Canace started to speak but stopped herself. Instead, she gently stroked Firefly's head.
"It means the place where someone's life first began."
"You are a child who came from the stars, Firefly. You came from that vast, endless river of stars."
In the direction Canace was pointing to, more and more constellations lit up in the distance. Starlight by the thousands spilled into the girl's eyes. She tried hard to catch where each ray had come from, standing on her toes as though she might reach that far-off place.
But then she hesitated. Her hand dropped, and her stray hair drooped with it. Canace crouched down, about to ask why she looked so downcast.
"Is that where I'm supposed to go in the future?"
Firefly reached for her professor's hand, and Canace understood at once.
"You're getting smarter every day, Firefly. You're asking questions even I do not know how to answer."
"But I can promise you this. I will help you find your future."
Firefly looked at Canace. She placed her small hand on the back of her professor's.
"We do it together."
"I trust you, professor. And you, trust me."
Canace closed her hand around those little fingers.
Moments like these need no words.
Amid the stars, they were all each other had, never to be parted.
DiscIP.214051.4.cn:
“老师~老师~看星星~”
卡娜丝的衣角被拉住，她转身低下头看，一根长长的呆毛在肆意摆动，诉说着悠闲的心情。
“火垂真厉害，平时我都不会注意头顶的那些景色呢。”
少女坐了下来，她遥望着天花板上的星空，不再言语，就连“雪崩”也随着她的心境一同沉默，不再发出任何声响。
“你有哪里不舒服吗？”
少女摇了摇头，她不解地向身边的老师发问。

“为什么，天上的星星这么漂亮，人们还要在星塔下互相伤害呢？”
卡娜丝愣住了，孩子眼中的世界往往是最简单纯粹且真实的。而这个问题，可能就连她也无法解答。
“我想，人们知道自己的来路，却不知道自己将要去往的未来，因对这种不确定性而感到恐惧，所以彼此才会有纷争吧。”
火垂的呆毛弯曲着变成了可爱的问号，她歪着头看向老师。
“抱歉……这些话对你来说可能有些复杂了吧。”
“懂一点……但，来路，是什么？”

卡娜丝欲言又止，她转而用手温柔地轻抚火垂的小脑袋。
“来路就是一个人来到这个世界的起点。”
“火垂是自星辰而来的孩子，那片广袤无垠的星河就是你的来路。”
顺着老师手指向的远方，更多的星座争先亮起，万千璀璨的星光落在少女眼中，她用力捕捉每一道光的来处，踮起脚尖，仿佛下一刻就要触及那遥远的彼方。
但火垂迟疑了，她的手和呆毛一起耷拉下来。卡娜丝蹲下了身子，想询问她为何沮丧。
“我的未来，是要到那里去吗？”
火垂拉住了老师的手，卡娜丝读懂了她的意思。
“火垂越来越聪明了，问的问题老师也不知道该怎么回答了。”
“但是老师答应你，火垂的未来，老师会帮你找到的。”
火垂看向卡娜丝，她将稚嫩的小手放在了老师的手背上。
“我陪老师一起。”
“我相信老师，老师也，相信我。”

卡娜丝也回握了那双稚嫩的小手。
此刻，再多的言语早已失去意义。
群星之间，二人互为唯一，彼此深信，永不分离。

DiscIP.214052.4.en: Mechanical arms methodically piece the finished components together on a workbench cluttered with blueprints. Sparkla holds her breath, waiting for the very last gear to click into place— "Done...!" A split second later, her supposedly flawless new invention makes a faint click, and the entire assembly crumbles to pieces. "Argh—why did it snap again?! This makes no sense! I ran the stress calculations over and over..." Frustrated, the girl pulls at her hair. She pores over the blueprints once more, but maybe she's just too tired, she can't seem to figure out what went wrong. "Could it be the materials...?" She turns her head and sees that "rabbit" lying on the other workbench. That's the girl's masterpiece—with an utterly adorable exterior and devastating, unpredictable firepower about to be equipped. Sparkla squints at Rabbit Pie, ideas blooming in her head. For a fleeting second, she's transported back to the first time she read Alicia's Underground Adventure—how she was completely blown away by its unbridled imagination. "It's already very cute as is, but what if I swapped out the bowtie? I could totally hide a gun barrel in there, right?" She slowly drifts into her own imaginary universe. The workshop has expanded into an endless cosmos, the gears and nuts its orbiting planets, and the scattered blueprints its nebulae. Every quirky idea she jots down is a brand-new star waiting to be discovered in the vastness of space. What if she tried a different material? Something plain, like building blocks? No, that wouldn't be cute enough... Wait, could she build it a carrot-shaped missile silo? That's when inspiration strikes. What about the pocket watch Mr. Rabbit carries in the story? Could that double as a miniature pistol? Or maybe some kind of pull-pin grenade...? As if tuning into the exact frequency of Rabbit Pie in her head, Sparkla rolls her wheelchair up to the workbench. She pushes aside some clutter, clearing just enough space to unroll a fresh drafting sheet. Pen hitting paper, she spills her wildest ideas onto the page, and a new invention—infinitely deadlier and undeniably cuter—slowly begins to take shape...
DiscIP.214052.4.cn:
机械臂正在有条不紊地将制作好的部件组装到一起，复杂的图纸散落在一旁的工作台上。斯帕克拉屏住呼吸，直到最后一个齿轮卡入凹槽——
“完成了……！”
她的话音刚落，零件完美契合的“新发明”突然发出细微的一声“咔哒”，随即刚组装好的整个装置分崩离析。
“啊啊——怎么又崩断了，这不应该啊！材料的受力计算明明已经验证过好几次了……”
少女烦躁地把头发抓得散乱。她再三检查她的图纸，但或许是因为有些累了，她一时之间并没有找到问题出在哪。
“难道是材料的问题……？”
她转过头，那只兔子就躺在她另一个工作台上。那是她的杰作——最可爱的外形，和即将加装上的，那最不可测的杀伤力。
少女眯着眼睛看着兔子派，脑海里的想法像烟花一样炸开，恍惚间仿佛回到了第一次打开童话《艾丽西亚的地下冒险》时被那天马行空的剧情震撼的那段时间。
“虽然现在已经很可爱了，如果换个领结……领结里也可以藏枪口吧？”
她慢慢陷入自己的想象宇宙。此刻，这间工作室已不再只是房间，而是一整个宇宙。齿轮和螺母构成了行星，摊开的图纸是星云，而每一个随手画下的奇怪点子，是藏在这浩瀚宇宙中被她观测到的星辰。

如果换一种材料呢？像积木一样不起眼，但那不够可爱……话又说回来，是不是可以给兔子做个胡萝卜形状的导弹仓？
斯帕克拉突然来了灵感。
还有故事里那位兔子先生的怀表，那或许可以是一把微型手枪？又或者是某种拉开就能扔出去的炮弹……？
像是在想象的宇宙中与眼前的兔子派对上了频道，斯帕克拉把轮椅开到工作台边，她把桌上的螺母、图纸和零件推到一旁，在空出来的一小块地方铺开新的设计稿。
笔尖落下，一条线，两条线，随着时间推移，天马行空的想法落在纸上，一个更加危险、也更加可爱的发明，正慢慢诞生……

DiscIP.214053.4.en:
A crimson sunset washed over Mirage, turning the sky and the endless desert below into a sea of liquid gold.
Outlaws and mercenaries in this lawless land rarely ended their nights huddled around a lonely campfire or sitting in the dead silence after a firefight. Instead, they washed up in the town's late-night bars.
Smaller mercenary guilds usually claimed one of these joints as their turf. It was where they geared up, planned their next move, and ultimately raised a glass to celebrate a job well done.
Running a bar also brought in a solid stream of cash for the guild. In return, the mercenaries kept the place safe from trouble.

But before you set foot in any of them, you had to know the ground rules:
1. No weapons.
2. No brawling.
3. Absolutely no dueling.
On top of that, you had to watch your step and know who ran what. Stumble into a rival guild's territory by mistake, and you were guaranteed a brutal beatdown.

Every bar in Mirage had its own draw. Some served great food, while others just had killer vibes, leaving you free to pick your poison.
But if you wanted a break from the usual rugged grub—something actually refined—and craved a lively, vibrant atmosphere without the constant threat of a bar fight, Eureka was the place to be.

"Chaton! Give me back my molten cheese tart right now!"
"No way! The great Chaton took this fair and square! Finders keepers!"
This was practically the soundtrack of the bar.

"Hey! One each! If you're still hungry, just get Benito to make you one more!"
"I can't! Benito said we're out of cheese! This is the last one!"
"Then you definitely shouldn't be stealing mine! You already hogged all the nachos anyway! And it's your own fault you lost yours—you just had to jump on the table for your little speech, and then you kicked it onto the floor when you jumped down!"

Thanks to a single pastry, the warm, cheerful vibe from just moments ago—and the fragile peace between the two of them—was on the verge of collapsing.
Like clockwork, someone had to step in and defuse the situation:
"Chaton, you can have mine, if you don't mind that I already took a bite."
"Uhm..."

Benito's sudden offer put Chaton in a serious bind.
If she turned down the tart, she'd be throwing Benito's kindness right back in her face.
But if she handed her "hard-earned" prize back to Kasimira, it meant admitting defeat. It would mean the great Chaton was forced to surrender her spoils.

She glanced at a fuming Kasimira, then down at Benito, who was still patiently holding out the tart. Finally, she scanned the rest of her squadmates, who were watching the standoff in total silence.
Deflated, Chaton obediently took the bitten pastry from Benito's hand.
"I don't mind... The great Chaton obviously doesn't mind at all."
DiscIP.214053.4.cn:
夕阳西下，赤红的晚霞将米拉什上空的云层与无垠荒漠一并浸染，天地之间仿佛都覆上了一层流动的金色。
在这片法外之地，亡命徒与佣兵们最终的归宿，往往不是荒野中的营火，也不是刀口舔血后的寂静，而是小镇里那些经营至深夜的水吧。
许多规模不大的佣兵团，都会将某间水吧视作自己的据点——在那里整装备战、商议行动，也在那里于任务结束后举杯庆功。
而水吧本身的经营收益，也能为佣兵团带来一笔颇为可观的资金；作为回报，佣兵团则会为自家经营的水吧提供必要的安全保障。

不过，在你踏入任何一家水吧之前，有几条规矩必须牢记：
1.不得携带武器
2.不得在水吧内斗殴
3.更不能在水吧内决斗
除此之外，你还得格外留意每间水吧所处的势力范围。千万千万！不要误入了对家的地盘，否则真的会被揍得很惨。

在米拉什众多的水吧之中，每一家都有属于自己的招牌：有的以餐饮见长，有的则胜在氛围。你可以依照自己的喜好，挑选不同的去处。
但如果你想尝尝有别于其他水吧那种粗犷狂野风格的精致料理，或想感受一种不同于混乱喧嚣、却同样热烈鲜活的欢快气氛，那么镇上那间名为尤里卡的水吧，无疑是最值得推荐的地方。

“猫眼！快把我的爆浆芝士塔塔还给我！”
“不要！这可是猫眼大人凭实力抢来的！凭什么还给你！”
这几乎是这间水吧里最常听见的对话之一。

“一人一个！你要想吃让蓝锥再给你做一个不好吗？”
“不要！蓝锥说芝士用完了！这是最后一个了！”
“那你就更不能抢我的了！而且这桌上的玉米片本来就都让你吃了！再说，刚才明明是你自己突然跳到桌子上讲话，下来的时候没看脚，把塔塔踢到地上的。”

眼看方才还欢快温馨的气氛，以及好不容易有所缓和的人际关系，就要因为一个塔塔而再度阴云密布。
每当这种时候，总需要有人站出来，及时化解危机——
“猫眼~你吃我的这份吧，如果你不介意我已经咬了一口的话。”
“唔……”

面对突如其来的好意，猫眼陷入了两难的境地。
若是不接过蓝锥递来的塔塔，似乎就等于拒绝了蓝锥的善意；
可若是把自己手里凭“实力”抢来的那一份还给卡西米拉，又仿佛意味着——即便是猫眼大人靠本事得到的东西，最后也还是得物归原主。

她先是看了看眼前明显有些恼火的卡西米拉，又看了看正把塔塔递向自己的蓝锥，最后再回过头，扫了一眼四周正默默注视着她的同伴们。
最终，猫眼还是乖乖地从蓝锥手中接过了那个已经被咬了一口的爆浆芝士塔塔。
“不介意，猫眼大人……当然不介意了。”

DiscIP.214054.4.en: "Hey Sparkla, guess what I've got?" Her mother pulls a gift box from behind and presses it into Sparkla's hands. "To celebrate my little girl finally coming home from the hospital, Mom and Dad got you a brand new ... fairy tale book!" "Wow! A new story!" Young Sparkla squeals, spinning around with the box before eagerly tearing into the gift— The cover is crisp and pristine, carrying that fresh paper scent she loves so much. "The Wizard in the Emerald Castle?" "Yep! I asked a Trekker friend who climbs the Monolith to wish for a story about a little girl going on adventures with lots of cute friends!" "I know my little Sparkla is itching to go outside, aren't you? But more than anything, I want you healthy and safe..." "O-Oh! But if the story is boring, you tell me. Next time, I'll personally supervise your Dad's survival training in the Wilds so he can climb the Monolith himself!" Sparkla throws her arms around her mother and laughs with her. "Mhm! I... I'll be good and stay home. I love all the storybooks you give me, Mom!" Feeling her mother's gentle stroke on her hair, she buries the faint pang of longing deep in her heart. Sparkla opens her eyes. The warmth of her mother's hands and the crisp scent of the pages still linger vividly from her dream. Suddenly, a mechanical rabbit head pops into her view. ":] Sparkla. Bookshelf organization protocol begins at 09:00. Querying sort criteria: alphabetical by title, or chronological by publication date?" Right. She tweaked Rabbit Pie's schedule last night before bed. Today's mission is to finally tackle that chaotic pile of old storybooks sitting in the corner of the workshop. No wonder she dreamt about her childhood... She changes her mind. "Actually, Rabbit Pie, let me handle the sorting. You just dig the books out of the pile for me." ":[ Request denied. Sparkla got distracted reading during the last bookshelf organization, resulting in task failure. Therefore, Rabbit Pie will execute the task this time." Ahaha... Right, that did happen. Sparkla scratches her nose and gives in. "Heh... I'll leave it to you, then, Rabbit Pie. Let's sort them alphabetically by title~" ":] Acknowledged." With the cleaning left to Rabbit Pie, and both Bloc and Leona blocked on her comms, the workshop glides smoothly along its preset track. Everything is perfectly in place, and a fresh spark of inspiration is just waiting to catch fire. Sparkla picks up her teacup, settling in to savor a rare, relaxing break.
DiscIP.214054.4.cn:
“斯帕克拉，瞧，这是什么？”
母亲将藏在身后的礼盒放到了斯帕克拉的手中，“庆祝我的小斯帕克拉出院，爸爸妈妈为你准备了新的……童话书！”
“哇！是新的童话！”小斯帕克拉捧着盒子开心地转了一个圈，迫不及待地拆开包装——
那书皮崭新又散发着纸香，是自己最喜欢的味道。
“《翡翠城堡里的魔法师》？”
“是哦，妈妈特意拜托爬塔的旅人朋友去许愿一本讲述小女孩和很多可爱同伴一起冒险的童话故事~”
“妈妈也知道我的小斯帕克拉很想出门对不对？可妈妈更希望你能健健康康，不要生病……”
“对、对了，如果不好看，就告诉妈妈，妈妈下次就亲自监督爸爸荒野特训，当旅人去爬塔！”
斯帕克拉抱住和自己一起在笑的母亲，“嗯！我、我会好好待在家。妈妈送的童话书，我都很喜欢的！”
她感受着头顶母亲温柔的抚摸，将内心深处一丝丝不甘抛诸脑后。

斯帕克拉睁开眼，发现自己似乎依旧清晰地记着梦境里母亲手心的温度，还有那本书的味道。
一只兔子脑袋突然占据了自己的视野，“：] 斯帕克拉，计划9点开始整理书柜，查询摆放顺序：书名首字母还是出版时间？”
对了，昨晚睡前调整了兔子派的日程安排，今天要把工坊角落那堆随意摆放了很久的故事书好好整理一番。
难怪会梦到小时候的情景……她改变了主意，“兔子派，还是我自己来吧，你负责把书从书堆里找出来~”
“：[ 否定。上次的整理书柜计划，斯帕克拉拿起书就看起来，导致最终中断。所以这次判定由兔子派执行。”
啊哈哈哈，还有这种事情哦。
斯帕克拉有些尴尬地摸摸鼻尖，默许了兔子派的提议。“那就拜托你了，兔子派。摆放顺序就按照书名首字母~”
“：] 了解。”

整理交给兔子派，布洛可和莱欧也都已经拉黑，工坊正平稳地行驶在预设好的移动轨道上。
一切都很完美，新的灵感也呼之欲出。
于是，斯帕克拉端起茶杯，享受起难得悠闲的休憩时光。

DiscIP.214055.4.en:
The underwater world is perfectly quiet.
 
Water presses against her ears, hushing the outside world into a gentle stillness. As she sinks deeper, her hair fans out like dark silk in the current. Schools of fish weave past her, and sunlight shines through the surface, painting wavering shapes of light on her skin.
It is a rare moment of peace.
The endless cries for help back on shore, the bitter arguments, the unspoken yet undeniable tensions—they all fade into the distance.
The shimmering surface seems to unlock fragmented memories. Willow swims into the mosaic of light, reaching out toward its swaying glow.

A flashback brings her to summers in Sailstead: gulls crying over the harbor, damp sea breezes carrying the heavy heat, and the ancient cooling Artifact in the office groaning from years of use.
Whenever the heat peaked, their boisterous Trekker Association President would find some undeniable excuse to herd everyone out of the office and down to the beach. They would set sail, hunting for whatever traces of summer they could find.
"The ocean embraces it all. Whether you're exhausted or completely lost, you'll always find your answers if you just return to the sea."
That vibrant woman always said that, drawing eager cheers from the rest of the crew. She just had that natural magnetism of a leader.
But Willow also knew the truth: it was an unspoken pact among them all, a gentle scheme to force Willow to take a break from work. 

The ocean truly does embrace it all.
In this empty stretch of water, the sea rinses away her distractions, leaving her alone with her own heart. Hopeful ambitions, gnawing fears, and secret burdens—the ocean receives them all in silence.
In this brief moment of tranquility, she reclaims her time, finding fresh courage to break the surface and face whatever awaits her above.
DiscIP.214055.4.cn:
水下的世界异常安静。
 
海水封住了鼓膜，一切声音都被温柔地隔开。少女缓缓下潜，长发在水中轻轻散开，鱼群在她身侧，阳光透过水面，折射出摇晃的光斑。
这是少有的宁静。
在岸上时，那些接连不断的求助声，那些人与人之间的争吵，那些无法明说却无法忽视的暗流涌动，似乎在这一刻都离她远去。
水面的波光粼粼仿佛折射出了某些碎片的记忆，薇洛划动手臂，游到那片斑斓的光影中，向着摇曳的光伸出手。

她忽然回想起了以前在塞尔斯泰的夏天，海鸥盘旋在港口的啼叫声，潮湿的海风带来夏日的闷热，办公室里的乘凉神器因为年久失修发出吱吱呀呀的声音。
每到这个时候，她们吵闹的地理协会会长总会找到一个无法反驳的时机，把所有人都赶出办公室，赶到海滩边，大家乘船出海，去海里寻找夏日存在过的痕迹。
“大海会包容，无论是疲惫还是迷茫，人只要回到大海里，都会找到自己的答案。”
那个神采奕奕的女人总是这么说，然后得到大家的积极响应——她身上似乎天生就有这种领导者的魄力。
但薇洛也知道，那也是大家为了让她脱离工作放松休息，大家心照不宣的默契。
 
大海确实会包容一切。
在这片无人的水域里，海水冲刷掉杂念，让她再次直面自己的内心，无论是积极的目标，还是消极的念头，甚至是无法明说的心事，都会被大海安静地接收。
她似乎在这短暂的宁静和放松中，找回了属于自己的时间，和新的勇气，去面对水面上的一切。

DiscIP.214056.4.en:
"Let's go camping this weekend!"
"Camping? Where is this coming from...?"
"Doesn't matter, it's decided! I've already got all the gear packed!"
The girl behind the desk looks up, shaking her head at her friend's familiar antics.
"You didn't leave me any room to say no, did you?"
The girl from Grace Imperium grins smugly. "Well, are you coming or what?"
This kind of back-and-forth happens a lot lately. Willow mulls it over for a second, then finally nods.
"Just this once."

But Willow never goes anywhere unprepared. Even for a completely spontaneous trip, she checks the weekend forecast, packs emergency kits, and brings everything they might possibly need. By the day before they leave, Laru catches her looking so heavily geared up that she seems ready to raid a Monolith, not camp in the woods.
"This is overkill. I thought camping was just pitching a tent near some water and eating fries while the birds sing!"
"Anyway, do you want barbecue?"
"Yes!"
"Do you want to sleep in a sleeping bag?"
"Obviously!"
"We'll need lanterns for the night. And even if we build a fire instead, did you bring a lighter?"
"Uh..." Laru is a master at pivoting, and her tune changes instantly. "Willow, you're the best! You're so reliable!"

Still, looking at the breathtaking sanctuary, Willow has to admit Laru knows how to pick a spot. The pool is crystal clear, a waterfall tumbles down the rocks, and sunlight catches the mist to paint faint rainbows.
To thank Willow for doing all the heavy lifting in prep, Laru handles setting up camp. She shoos Willow toward the water, assigning her the "job" of catching a fish.
There are no fish in that pond, and Willow knows full well it's just an excuse to let her unwind. She slips off her shoes and steps into the shallows, sending ripples outward. The refreshing chill seeps in, slowly washing away her stress.
It truly is a rare weekend that feels like one.
The realization suddenly settles over her. Here in this untouched oasis, there are only babbling streams, chirping birds, droning cicadas, and leaves rustling in the breeze. The whole world seems to have slowed down.
She turns back to see Laru waving enthusiastically from the bank and can't help but smile.

In a city tangled in complicated relationships, having a friend this pure at heart is truly her good fortune.
DiscIP.214056.4.cn:
“我们周末去野营吧！”
“野营？这么突然……”
“不管了，就这么决定了！野营的装备我都准备好了！”
办公桌前的少女闻声抬起头来，面对胡闹的友人，无奈地摇了摇头。
“你完全就没有准备让我拒绝是吗？”
恩赐意志的少女笑得得意，“那你就说你去不去嘛~”
这样的拉扯似乎最近经常出现。薇洛沉思了一会，最后还是点头答应了。
“就这一次。”

但薇洛从不会毫无准备地行事，即便是个毫无缘由的临时决定，她依然会认真地确认周末的天气，准备好应急的物品，带上一切可能用得上的物资——出发前一天，菈露见到她时，发现她一副严阵以待的姿态，仿佛她们要去的不是野营，而是星塔里的探险。
“这也太夸张了吧？野营不就是找个有水的地方，搭个帐篷，听着虫鸣鸟叫吃点薯条吗？”
“那你要吃烧烤吗？”
“要！”
“休息的话需要睡袋吗？”
“当然！”
“夜间照明需要工具吧？就算是点火，打火机你带了吗？”
“呃……”菈露向来擅长见风使舵，几句话之间已经变了一副面孔，“薇洛最好了！薇洛最可靠了！”

不过，当薇洛见到眼前的美景，潭水清凉见底，瀑布倾泻而下，阳光在飞溅的水花里晕散成淡淡的虹色——薇洛不得不承认，菈露确实很会找地方。
为了报答薇洛出发前周全的准备，菈露包揽了扎营的工作，她把薇洛赶到水边，给她的任务是去水里抓条鱼上来。
这水里哪里有鱼？薇洛心知肚明地接受了这份好意。她赤脚走入水中，掀起的涟漪一圈圈散开，沁人的凉意随着微波荡漾，一点点洗去疲惫。
这是一个罕见的周末。
她忽然深刻地意识到了这件事。这无人的秘境里，此刻只有潺潺的流水声、鸟啼与蝉鸣，和微风拂过树叶摇动的轻响，仿佛整个世界都慢了下来。
她回头看向岸边朝她挥手的菈露，忍不住笑了。

在这个人际关系复杂的城邦里，有这么一位心思纯粹的友人，这样是她的幸运吧。

DiscIP.214057.4.en:
The evening breeze rolling off the sea carries a touch of loneliness.
Karin leans by the window, watching flocks of seagulls disappear into the horizon.
Shia is running later than usual today. It's not quite late enough to worry, but still...
"Shia wouldn't forget, would she...? But why isn't she back yet?"

 When steady footsteps sound outside, Karin's fluffy ears perk right up.
"Shia's back! And it sounds like she's carrying something heavy!"
She rushes over and throws open the door, only to find Shia lugging a massive, long bundle on her back.
"Your ears are as sharp as ever. I was just wondering how I'd manage the door with this thing."
"Shia?! What is that? Actually, never mind—just put it down! Let me get you some juice!"
"No need. Just help me drag this inside first."

 The seaside cottage glows with warm orange light as the two girls cook dinner by the stove.
"We get to splurge a bit tonight. I picked up some special ingredients."
"Ah, Karin, mind prepping that fish? Careful, it's a bit lively."
"Sure, I'll handle it—Eek! Whoa, that scared me!"
"Hehe. You're totally distracted. Thinking about the package?"
"Of course! You came back so late lugging something that huge. Anyone would be curious!"
Karin deliberately lets Shia catch her glancing at the diary on the wall, then asks shyly, "So ... it's that, isn't it?"
"I wanted to surprise you, but with something this massive, there's really no point in hiding it."
Blushing and fighting back a smile, Karin just wants to finish making dinner so she can blow out her birthday candles and rip the gift open.

 "Okaaay. Thanks for being so patient. You can open it now!"
To Shia's surprise, when the moment finally arrives, Karin just sits there, staying quiet for a long time before finally forcing out a few words.
"Looking at it now... That thing you brought back is really huge..."
"Shia, be honest. That must have cost a fortune, right...?"
"Hehe. So that's what's bothering you. Relax, it costs less than what we make from a single catch during peak season. Besides, putting a price tag on a gift really kills the mood."
"Truth is, I was a little selfish when I picked this out. So don't worry about it—just open it."
Karin hesitates a moment longer before tearing into the packaging. As the heavy wrapping falls away, a brand-new surfboard comes into view.
"A surfboard... Shia, are we...?"
"You're always watching me out on the water. I figured it was time I finally took you out to ride the waves with me."
"Happy birthday, Karin. That's my wish for you."
DiscIP.214057.4.cn:
晚霞的海风中夹杂着一些寂寞的味道，
花铃正倚在窗前，看着海鸥们成群结队地飞向未知的方向。
今天的希娅不知为何来得比以往要晚些，话虽如此，但也没有到令人担心的地步，只是——
“希娅她应该不会忘了吧……但，为什么还没回来呢……”
 
一阵沉稳的脚步声从屋外传来，花铃立刻竖起两只毛茸茸的耳朵。
“是希娅回来了！好像还带着别的东西！”
花铃匆匆跑去提前开门迎接，只见希娅背着一个长条形的大包裹。
“花铃耳朵还是那么灵啊，我正愁背着这个要怎么开门呢。”
“希娅！？那是什么呀！不说这个，先把它放下来吧，我去给你拿果汁！”
“不用不用，先帮我把它搬到屋里去吧。”
 
夜晚海边的小屋亮起了温暖的橙光，两个女孩在灶台边准备今晚的佳肴。
“今天可以稍微奢侈一点哦，我买了特别的食材。”
“啊，那条鱼可以麻烦花铃处理一下吗？小心点哦，它有些闹腾。”
“嗯，好，我处理一下——噫啊！吓，吓死我了！”
“呵呵~花铃完全心不在焉呢，是在意那个包裹吗？”
“当然啦！希娅那么晚回来，还带着那么一大个东西，谁都会好奇里面有什么吧！”
花铃故意让希娅注意到自己在看墙边的日记，害羞地问道：“果然，是那个吧……？”
“本来想给花铃一个惊喜的。不过，这么大也没有隐藏的意义了呢~”
花铃脸红着，难掩嘴角的笑意，只想赶快准备完今天的晚饭，在吹蛋糕蜡烛后把礼物拆开。
 
“好~~~辛苦忍耐到这个时候了呢，可以拆礼物了哦~”
令希娅没想到，真到了拆礼物的时候，花铃反而不为所动，她沉默了很久，才终于从口中挤出了一句话。
“之前没注意到，我刚刚又确认了一下，希娅背回来的那个东西真的很大……”
“希娅，你说实话，那个得花不少钱吧……？”
“呵呵~原来是在担心这个呀。放心吧，其实还没有我们旺季一次鱼获赚得多哦。不过，要用朵拉来衡量礼物的心意有些坏风景了呢。”
“要问为什么——这份礼物，也有我的一点私心哦，所以不要有顾虑，拆开看看吧。”
花铃犹豫了一会，终于开始拆开包裹上的第一个封袋。而当纸皮铺开，一张崭新的冲浪板出现在她的眼前。
“冲浪板……希娅，难道……”
“一直以来都是你看着我在海浪上玩耍，所以我想着有朝一日也能带你一起尝试这份乐趣。”
“生日快乐，花铃。这，就是我的愿景哦。”

DiscIP.214058.4.en:
"You're wide open, Iris! Take this! Sapphire Splash!"
"Eek! So cold...! Noya, don't just splash me out of nowhere!"
"Iris, adorable. Snapping a pic~"
"Nice shot, Amber! Mind taking a picture of me surfing later?"
"Hey, you guys! Watch out so you don't drift into deep water while playing!" 

Watching the girls in the distance, Karin feels completely overwhelmed. She retreats to a shaded spot and sits down, fully prepared to just let the sea breeze carry her through this chaotic afternoon.

"Ah, you've got your eye on this spot, too. Good taste."
Hearing a familiar voice, Karin rubs her eyes, half-expecting her contact lenses to be acting up again like they did back at the Monolith.
"Huh...? Am I just exhausted? I swear I heard Leafia's voice, but no one's here..."
"Watch your step—I'm right down here!"
"Whoa! You—how did you get buried in the sand?!"
Leafia carefully wriggles out of the sand pile, and only then does Karin realize it's completely hollow underneath.
"I'm not buried. I'm constructing a 3D topographical model. Care to join my grand project?"
"I think I'll pass. I don't really understand that kind of stuff..."
Looking at the dark, damp sand, Karin hesitates before pointing out, "You know the tide will wash over this spot once it comes in, right?"
"Yeah, I figured as much."
"Doesn't that bother you? Your carefully built model is just going to get washed away soon."
"Watching it wash away is half the fun! Besides, I enjoy the process way more than the result anyway, just like field surveying."
"Instead of worrying about me, shouldn't you be enjoying your vacation? If you just sit around spacing out, summer's gonna slip right by."
"How did this suddenly get so philosophical...? I mean, I do want to play with Shia..."

Catching Karin's muttering, Leafia pulls a spare megaphone out of Willow's nearby toolbox.
"Testing, testing. We've got a lonely bunny on the shore. Can someone drag her into the water?"
"Y-You—! What are you doing?!"
Hearing the broadcast, the girls in the water start waving and cheering for Karin. In a flash, she becomes the center of attention on the entire beach.
"Come join us, Karin! The water feels amazing!"
"Want in on a water gun fight? I've got plenty of extras right here!"
"Karin—don't just stand there watching! Get in!"
"I! Said! Stop shouting my name so loudly!!!"
On the beach, the small figure grabs a water gun and charges straight into the sea, blasting away all her embarrassment.
Flying overhead, a witch raises her Photo Capturer to capture the perfect moment.
"I didn't make it in time for the event, but this photo alone definitely makes the trip worth it~"
DiscIP.214058.4.cn:
“鸢尾露出破绽了，看招！蓝宝石水花！”
“呀！好凉……！尘，尘沙，不要冷不丁地泼我一身水啊……”
“鸢尾的表情可爱，拍下来~”
“嘿~琥珀的抓拍很到位哦~等一下能帮忙拍我冲浪时的动作吗~？”
“你们几位！不要打着打着溜到深水区哦！”
 
望着远处打闹的少女们，花铃感到莫大的无力感，她只好找了个遮阳区坐下，打算就这样吹着海风度过这个吵闹的日常。
 
“啊，你也看中这里了呢，真有眼光。”
听见熟悉的声音，花铃揉了揉眼睛，还以为隐形眼镜又像在星塔那时一样出了问题。
“嗯……？我是不是累了啊，明明听见了优叶的声音，但是完全没个人影……”
“小心脚下，我在这里哦~”
“呜哇！你你你！你怎么被埋在沙子下面了！”
优叶小心翼翼地从沙堆里挪出来，花铃这时才发现沙堆底下是中空的。
“不是埋哦，我在做立体地形结构。怎么样，要加入这个宏大的工程吗~”
“我就不用了，也不是很懂这个……”
看着深色的沙土，花铃犹豫了一会还是开口提醒道：“到了涨潮期的时候，海水会漫过这里哦。”
“嗯，这点我还是知道的。”
“你不觉得可惜吗？精心搭好的结构可能过不久就会被冲垮哦。”
“搭好后冲垮也是乐趣之一，况且比起结果，我更喜欢建造的过程，就像跑野外测绘一样。”
“比起我，你不去享受一下难得的假期吗，一直发呆的话，夏天会偷偷溜走哦。”
“怎么突然变成哲学的话题了……我确实想和希娅一起玩啦……”
 
听见花铃的小声嘀咕，优叶从薇洛放在一旁的工具箱里拿出了备用喇叭。
“喂喂~能听到吗，岸上有一只寂寞的兔子，有人能带她一起下水吗~~~”
“你你你！你干什么呀！”
玩水的小伙伴们听闻后纷纷朝着花铃挥手呐喊，一瞬间，整个海滩的焦点都落在了花铃身上。
“一起来玩吧~花铃~很凉快的哦~”
“要试试水枪战吗~我正好有多余的好几把哦~”
“花铃——不要光看着啦~一起下水吧~”
“所——以——说！不要那么大声喊我的名字啦！！！”
海滩上，那个小小的身影拿着水枪冲到了海边，发泄着自己的羞耻与窘迫。
从空中掠过的魔女拿起留影器记录下这美好的一刻。
“虽然没能赶上活动，不过，这张照片倒是值回票价啦~”

GoldenSpyLevel.110101.3.en: Silent infiltration is the first lesson of the mission. Start by walking quietly through the garden's stone path.
GoldenSpyLevel.110101.3.cn: 无声潜入是任务的第一课，从安静穿过花园石径开始。

GoldenSpyLevel.110102.3.en: Any noise may spook the koi. Tread carefully—the danger in the garden must not be awakened before its time.
GoldenSpyLevel.110102.3.cn: 锦鲤会被任何动静惊扰，小心脚下，别让花园里的危险提前爆发。

GoldenSpyLevel.110201.3.en: Patrols are approaching. Move fast and leave no trace.
GoldenSpyLevel.110201.3.cn: 巡逻的脚步似乎正在靠近，动作要快，别留下破绽。

GoldenSpyLevel.110202.3.en: Security seems to have tightened. Stay focused to avoid all potential dangers.
GoldenSpyLevel.110202.3.cn: 警戒似乎升级了，集中注意力才能避开所有危机。

GoldenSpyLevel.110301.3.en: The informant has brought new intel. Read it carefully before you set out.
GoldenSpyLevel.110301.3.cn: 线人带来了新的情报，出发之前请仔细阅读。

GoldenSpyLevel.110302.3.en: What seems worthless could come in handy when the stakes are high.
GoldenSpyLevel.110302.3.cn: 看似无用的东西，或许也会在关键时刻派上用场。

GoldenSpyLevel.110401.3.en: The operation begins now. Retrieve the target's treasure before the banquet concludes.
GoldenSpyLevel.110401.3.cn: 行动正式开始，在宴会结束前取走目标的宝物。

GoldenSpyLevel.120101.3.en: Gathering intel at the market takes skill. Never reveal who you are or what you're after.
GoldenSpyLevel.120101.3.cn: 在集市上打探情报也是一门技巧，千万不要在话语间暴露了自己的身份与真实意图。

GoldenSpyLevel.120102.3.en: Sneak into the mine early to observe enemy deployment and record guard rotation schedules & sequences.
GoldenSpyLevel.120102.3.cn: 提前潜入矿洞观察敌人部署，记录换岗时间与顺序。

GoldenSpyLevel.120201.3.en: Intelligence can be true or false, vital or trivial. Our job is to filter out what is truly valuable.
GoldenSpyLevel.120201.3.cn: 情报有真有假，有重要的有不重要的，我们要做的是筛选出真正有价值的。

GoldenSpyLevel.120202.3.en: Together with your team, discuss, decide, and prepare for execution.
GoldenSpyLevel.120202.3.cn: 与同伴一同讨论，制定计划，并得出结论，准备实施。

GoldenSpyLevel.120301.3.en: Identify the ultimate goal and initiate combat deployment.
GoldenSpyLevel.120301.3.cn: 锁定最终目标，并开始作战部署。

GoldenSpyLevel.120302.3.en: Before the official operation begins, we need to conduct a targeted drill.
GoldenSpyLevel.120302.3.cn: 在正式行动开始前，我们还需要做一次针对性的演练。

GoldenSpyLevel.120401.3.en: The operation begins. When the dust settles, so will everything return to dust.
GoldenSpyLevel.120401.3.cn: 作战开始，当尘埃落定，一切都将归于尘土。
