InfinityTowerMsg.3001.2.en: Emor Missing Cat Notice: A black cat has been lost. It is quick and has a coat of shiny black fur. Please contact the South Gate Security Post if you have any information.
InfinityTowerMsg.3001.2.cn: 来自埃摩的寻猫启事：丢失黑猫一只，毛色鲜亮，动作机敏，如有线索请立即联络南门卫哨。

InfinityTowerMsg.3002.2.en: Speedy joyriders plague the Silver District. City officials promise max efforts in clearing up traffic and strictly enforcing the prohibition of the use of illegal artifacts.
InfinityTowerMsg.3002.2.cn: 银城区飙车乱象日益严重，城邦主管官员表示将尽力疏导交通问题，并严格限制非法神器使用。

InfinityTowerMsg.3003.2.en: The McFC Crazy Sunday event is here! Fill your belly and fill your heart with just 1900 Dorra!
InfinityTowerMsg.3003.2.cn: 麦肯基狂乱周日活动已开启！只需1900朵拉，大口美食吃到饱！

InfinityTowerMsg.3004.2.en: Forward this meme of Aobelle for success in your career and money in your pockets!
InfinityTowerMsg.3004.2.cn: 转发这个青叶，事业蒸蒸日上，钱景一片大好！

InfinityTowerMsg.3005.2.en: An old man in his 70s in Philae ingested 10 spotted mushrooms in hopes of seeing his deceased wife again. He was later successfully rescued by a private clinic doctor.
InfinityTowerMsg.3005.2.cn: 菲莱一七旬老人为见亡妻，连续吃下10个斑点菇后被某私人诊所医生成功救下。

InfinityTowerMsg.3006.2.en: Expert: Drinking too much energy drinks is harmful to your health. People need to be more efficient at work.
InfinityTowerMsg.3006.2.cn: 专家：能量饮料过量饮用有害健康，员工应注意提高工作效率。

InfinityTowerMsg.3007.2.en: "Ozora Production" has arrived at the Thousand Monoliths. The "Era of Miracles" returns once again.
InfinityTowerMsg.3007.2.cn: “野空事务所”抵达千塔，"见证奇迹”时刻再度重现。

InfinityTowerMsg.3008.2.en: Emor Weather Today: Sunny. High Monolith light-pollution.
InfinityTowerMsg.3008.2.cn: 艾摩今日天气：晴，星塔光污染较高。

InfinityTowerMsg.3009.2.en: Philae Weather Today: Rain. Surrounding creatures and plants will sometimes berserk.
InfinityTowerMsg.3009.2.cn: 菲莱今日天气：雨，周边动植物偶发狂暴。

InfinityTowerMsg.3010.2.en: Sailstead Weather Today: Strong Wind. Be aware of the waves.
InfinityTowerMsg.3010.2.cn: 塞尔斯泰今日天气：大风，注意波浪。

InfinityTowerMsg.3011.2.en: South Serpent Peak Weather Today: Cloudy. Occasional fog.
InfinityTowerMsg.3011.2.cn: 蛇脊山南今日天气：多云，偶有迷雾。

InfinityTowerMsg.3012.2.en: Flavio Weather Today: Thick Fog. Cool and breezy. Filled with pleasant fragrance.
InfinityTowerMsg.3012.2.cn: 弗拉维奥今日天气：大雾，凉爽，香味扑鼻。

InfinityTowerMsg.3013.2.en: Cang Wu Weather Today: Warm. Suitable day for exercising and walks.
InfinityTowerMsg.3013.2.cn: 苍梧今日天气：温和，宜健身、散步。

InfinityTowerMsg.3014.2.en: Songchuan Weather Today: Drizzle. Warm. High humidity.
InfinityTowerMsg.3014.2.cn: 松川今日天气：降雨，气候温和，湿度较高。

InfinityTowerMsg.3015.2.en: Staff from Philae United Harvest hired a chauffeur after drinking at a banquet. Unfortunately, the chauffeur drove drunk as well.
InfinityTowerMsg.3015.2.cn: 菲莱某联合种业职员宴会后找自动车代驾，不料代驾是醉驾。

InfinityTowerMsg.3016.2.en: Mercenaries in the Mirage area have been condemned for lacking "holiday spirits" for using suppressed barrels in the firefights during the holidays.
InfinityTowerMsg.3016.2.cn: 正值假日，米拉什地区雇佣兵在火拼时使用消音枪管，被批评没有假日气氛。

InfinityTowerMsg.3017.2.en: A scholar claims that monsters near Flavio may have learned fan support dance routines.
InfinityTowerMsg.3017.2.cn: 有学者称：在弗拉维奥附近的魔物可能已经学会了应援舞蹈。

InfinityTowerMsg.3018.2.en: New philosophy academic curriculum has been confirmed. Its title: If you want to make a name for yourself in Emor, you need to be at least 1 year old and healthy.
InfinityTowerMsg.3018.2.cn: 新哲学教材曝光，标题为：如果要在埃摩站稳脚跟，需要至少1周岁且身体健康。

InfinityTowerMsg.3019.2.en: The winning article in the Grace Light Academy writing contest, "My Father, The Guard Captain," has contributed massively to the investigation of the armory and weapons embezzlement case.
InfinityTowerMsg.3019.2.cn: 星辉附属大学作文比赛第一名《我的卫队长父亲》为追查军械库资产侵吞案提供了不可估量的帮助。

Item.1.2.en: A basic currency that can be used in various features.
Item.1.2.cn: 基础的货币，可在各个功能中进行使用。

Item.1.3.en:
Issued by Deepsea Finance, this currency circulates throughout Nova Continent ... but only within cities.
If you're alone in the Wilds, all the Dorra you carry might as well be scrap paper.
Item.1.3.cn:
由渊海星融发行的货币，能通行于诺瓦大陆的各处……仅限城里。
要是孤身沦落荒野，再多的朵拉也只是废纸。

Item.1000.3.en:
A soul key, radiant and brimming with emotional power.
It unseals the latent talents buried in the deepest corners of the soul...
Item.1000.3.cn:
饱含情感力量、闪耀着璀璨光芒的心链。
它能解封埋藏于心相最深层的天赋……

Item.100000.2.en: Log in daily to earn Diamonds and Stamina.
Item.100000.2.cn: 每日登录可以领取钻石和体力

Item.100000.3.en: Purchasing a Monthly Card is a wise choice.

Item.1001.3.en:
A soul key, radiant and brimming with emotional power.
It ignites the talents hidden in the depths of a soul...
Item.1001.3.cn:
蕴含情感力量、光芒四射的心链。
可以激发心相深处的天赋……

Item.10303.2.cn: 解锁琥珀专属形象「玩心无邪」的凭证！

Item.10303.3.en:
Woven from flowing flames and adorned with golden clouds—a majestic spirit, fierce and free.
Rawr—
Item.10303.3.cn:
锦绣织就流火，金饰点缀祥云。不怒自威、顾盼神飞。
嘎呜——

Item.10304.2.en: Certificate that unlocks Amber's exclusive appearance "Ease Into an Unhurried Summer"!
Item.10304.2.cn: 解锁琥珀专属形象「邀你静心，悠然一夏」的凭证！

Item.10304.3.en: Following the hot sea breeze, I steal a moment from the carnival to catch your eye. It was serene.
Item.10304.3.cn: 顺着炙热的海风，捉住那狂欢的隙间，悠悠然望向你的视线。

Item.107.2.en: Proof of invitation to add Tilia to your squad
Item.107.2.cn: 邀请「缇莉娅」加入队伍的凭证

Item.107.3.en: Pure and flawless, that's the heartfelt yearning of the "Guardian of Justice."
Item.107.3.cn: 纯粹无暇，那是「正义伙伴」的心之所向。

Item.10703.2.en: Certificate that unlocks Tilia's exclusive appearance "This Is My Justice!"!
Item.10703.2.cn: 解锁缇莉娅专属形象「此即吾之正义！」的凭证！

Item.10703.3.en:
Suit up, transform! My fighting spirit burns hotter than the sun!
Clad in the armor of justice, I'll defend every street like a knight—
This is my justice!
Item.10703.3.cn:
系紧腰带，利落变身，斗志如烈阳般炽热！
披上正义的战衣，以骑士之姿守护每一条街道——
此即吾之正义！

Item.2.3.en:
This shard vibrates with the power of Stellnanite Veins, exhibiting purity yet bearing the hallmarks of human craftsmanship.
Though not as pristine as natural crystals, it holds immense value.
Item.2.3.cn:
散发着星脉力量的碎片，虽纯净，却有人造的痕迹。
虽然没有源晶来得天然，但也价值不菲。

Item.20.2.en: Stamina used for engaging in various game modes.
Item.20.2.cn: 用于进行各类玩法的体力。

Item.20.3.en:
Taking on commissions and completing quests becomes doubly hard without enthusiasm.
Don't forget to pep up your Trekkers before embarking on your journey!
Item.20.3.cn:
承接委托，完成工作，少了活力只会事倍功半。
出发之前，记得给旅人们加把劲喔。

Item.20003.2.en: Used for certain Trekker skill upgrade (Lv.7 to Lv.10).
Item.20003.2.cn: 用于部分旅人能力7~10级等级提升

Item.20003.3.en:
A fang hunted from the beasts that haunt the forest.
It's covered with eerie vines that seem to pulsate with a life of their own,
whispering the protests of the forest.
Item.20003.3.cn:
从林中栖息的巨兽身上猎取的獠牙。
奇异的枝条爬满了壳体，若有似无地颤动。
像是森林在抗议的声音。

Item.20013.2.en: Used for certain Trekker skill upgrade (Lv.7 to Lv.10).
Item.20013.2.cn: 用于部分旅人能力7~10级等级提升

Item.20013.3.en:
Nestled deep in the forest, is it the flower... or the fruit of a mysterious parasitic plant?
Countless blood-like mouths like these lure prey into their traps...
Item.20013.3.cn:
森林深处，神秘寄生植物的花朵……还是果实？
就是这样的无数张血盆大口，在勾引着猎物……

Item.20023.2.en: Used for certain Trekker skill upgrade (Lv.7 to Lv.10).
Item.20023.2.cn: 用于部分旅人能力7~10级等级提升

Item.20023.3.en:
A core collected from the remnants of the Colossus.
Indeed...it seems to know you; you are its chosen target.
Item.20023.3.cn:
从巨像的残骸上搜集的核心。
没错……它似乎认识你；而它的目标正是你。

Item.20043.2.en: Used for certain Trekker skill upgrade (Lv.7 to Lv.10).
Item.20043.2.cn: 用于部分旅人能力7~10级等级提升

Item.20043.3.en:
The fully bloomed flower of "Lithe Beauty."
It emits a strange, demoralizing scent of darkness and anxiety.
Item.20043.3.cn:
“流风美人”盛开的花朵。
它散发着诡异的、让人提不起劲的，阴郁而焦躁的气味。

Item.20053.2.en: Used for certain Trekker skill upgrade (Lv.7 to Lv.10).
Item.20053.2.cn: 用于部分旅人能力7~10级等级提升

Item.20053.3.en:
An accessory crafted from the tail feathers of the Emerald Blade.
As a symbol of your triumph over the boss, wearing it may bring you more commission opportunities.
Item.20053.3.cn:
由翠煌之刃的尾羽制成的饰品。
战胜首领的象征。将它的尾羽挂在胸前，或许就能为自己争取到更多的委托机会。

Item.20063.2.en: Used for certain Trekker skill upgrade (Lv.7 to Lv.10).
Item.20063.2.cn: 用于部分旅人能力7~10级等级提升

Item.20063.3.en:
A hidden reef paradise atop the Hexhorn Whale's head.
The sea giant's very body becomes a sanctuary where creatures live out their long lives in the winding maze, day after day, year after year.
Item.20063.3.cn:
六角鲸头顶的暗礁乐园。
海中的巨兽用身躯为生灵们打造乐园。日往月来，它们在这座纵横交错的迷宫中度过漫长的一生。

Item.20071.2.en: A basic material used for Trekker tier-up.
Item.20071.2.cn: 用于旅人升阶的初级材料。

Item.20071.3.en:
An old hat with torn fringes. 
It still carries dust that has risen from eerie dance moves.
Item.20071.3.cn:
边缘磨损的旧帽。
还残留着诡异舞步激起的尘埃。

Item.20072.2.en: An intermediate material used for Trekker tier-up.
Item.20072.2.cn: 用于旅人升阶的中级材料。

Item.20072.3.en:
An elaborate bowler.
In the spotlight, it is a reflection of the master's ever-shifting grace.
Item.20072.3.cn:
做工精美的礼帽。
在聚光灯下，与主人的身姿一同变幻莫测。

Item.20073.2.en: An advanced material used for Trekker tier-up.
Item.20073.2.cn: 用于旅人升阶的高级材料。

Item.20073.3.en:
A top hat decorated with ornament.
When the spotlight fades, its frenzy retreats like a receding tide.
Item.20073.3.cn:
嵌有华丽装饰的礼帽。
当舞台之上的主角谢幕，它也随之收敛所有的疯狂。

Item.20081.2.en: A basic material used for Trekker tier-up.
Item.20081.2.cn: 用于旅人升阶的初级材料。

Item.20081.3.en: Mortal, this is the reward from great Count of the Duloos. You should show gratitude for his generosity.
Item.20081.3.cn: 凡人，这是我，伟大的热嘟噜噗男爵，给予你的嘉赏。虽不及至高无上，但你仍应心怀感激。

Item.20082.2.en: An intermediate material used for Trekker tier-up.
Item.20082.2.cn: 用于旅人升阶的中级材料。

Item.20082.3.en: I, the great Count of the Duloos, now grant you the treasure, a jar of vintage wine. Praise me for my generosity, mortal!
Item.20082.3.cn: 我，伟大的热嘟噜噗男爵，将要把珍品赏赐于你，这罐中盛装的是我积年的秘酿，赞美我的慷慨吧，凡人！

Item.20083.2.en: An advanced material used for Trekker tier-up.
Item.20083.2.cn: 用于旅人升阶的高级材料。

Item.20083.3.en: Kneel down, mortal! Here is a gift from the great Count of the Duloos! Accept this supreme honor with gratitude and awe.
Item.20083.3.cn: 跪拜吧，凡人！这是伟大的热嘟噜噗男爵的恩典！你应当心怀敬畏地接受这至高无上的荣耀！

Item.20091.2.en: A basic material used for Trekker tier-up.
Item.20091.2.cn: 用于旅人升阶的初级材料。

Item.20091.3.en:
The unburned wick of Evernight Emberflies. 
It is so faint that it seems like it can never be ignited again.
Item.20091.3.cn:
终宵萤辉遗留的灯芯。
已然黯淡无光，仿佛永远无法再次点亮。

Item.20092.2.en: An intermediate material used for Trekker tier-up.
Item.20092.2.cn: 用于旅人升阶的中级材料。

Item.20092.3.en:
The essence of Evernight Emberflies. 
It was once brightly lit.
Item.20092.3.cn:
终宵萤辉遗留的灯髓。
它也曾明亮过。

Item.20093.2.en: An advanced material used for Trekker tier-up.
Item.20093.2.cn: 用于旅人升阶的高级材料。

Item.20093.3.en:
The core of Evernight Emberflies. 
It refuses to close its eyes, and every crack is a sign of recurring frenzies.
Item.20093.3.cn:
终宵萤辉遗留的灯核。
它拒绝阖眼，每道裂纹都在复诵一次又一次的彻夜狂欢。

Item.20997.2.en: Grants a random basic material for Trekker tier-up.
Item.20997.2.cn: 随机获得一种旅人升阶的初级材料。

Item.20997.3.en: A random basic material used for Trekker tier-up.
Item.20997.3.cn: 随机掉落旅人升阶的初级材料。

Item.21.2.en: Proof of the Tyrant's influence on the world. Increases your Authorization Level.
Item.21.2.cn: 魔王影响世界的证明，获取后可提升权限等级。

Item.21.3.en: The Throne system requires a certain amount of EXP. Increase your Authorization Level to unlock more features.
Item.21.3.cn: 王权系统所需要的经验，提高权限等级解锁更多功能。

Item.21003.2.en: Used for certain Trekker skill upgrade (Lv.7 to Lv.10).
Item.21003.2.cn: 用于部分旅人能力7~10级等级提升

Item.21003.3.en: In some parts, this mighty beast is known as the "Forest Lord." Legends say it's more than just a force of destruction: It's nature incarnate, a true king whose soul is bound to the forest it rules.
Item.21003.3.cn: 这头巨兽在某些地区被称作“森林之主”，传说中，它们不仅是凶恶的灾难，更是自然界的化身，是统治着整片森林、灵魂与土地相连的王。

Item.21013.2.en: Used for certain Trekker skill upgrade (Lv.7 to Lv.10).
Item.21013.2.cn: 用于部分旅人能力7~10级等级提升

Item.21013.3.en: Cunning and spooky, it sets traps and shifts its form endlessly... Only the truly fearless can overcome its twisted evil and harness the power at its core.
Item.21013.3.cn: 诡异狡诈，设置陷阱，化形万千……只有真正无畏的冒险者，才能战胜这份邪恶与扭曲，驾驭它最核心的力量。

Item.21023.2.en: Used for certain Trekker skill upgrade (Lv.7 to Lv.10).
Item.21023.2.cn: 用于部分旅人能力7~10级等级提升

Item.21023.3.en:
Its tall, imposing form was meant to stand in that mysterious and regal chamber.
Whether it was the master's mistake to leave, or its own for following, no longer seems to matter with the passing of time.
Item.21023.3.cn:
它高大威武的姿态本应匹配的是那座神秘而尊贵的房间。
是房间的主人擅自离开的错误，还是追随着房间的主人的它的错误，都已随时间流逝而不再显得重要。

Item.21043.2.en: Used for certain Trekker skill upgrade (Lv.7 to Lv.10).
Item.21043.2.cn: 用于部分旅人能力7~10级等级提升

Item.21043.3.en: It wasn't born of nature. Beneath its lovely facade runs poison, driven by the ruthless ambition of corporate schemers.
Item.21043.3.cn: 那并非自然的产物，美丽的外表之下，流淌着毒液，承载起野心家的虎狼之志。

Item.21053.2.en: Used for certain Trekker skill upgrade (Lv.7 to Lv.10).
Item.21053.2.cn: 用于部分旅人能力7~10级等级提升

Item.21053.3.en: It was forced to dwell within this delicate cage, its wild nature howling and thrashing beneath the mask.
Item.21053.3.cn: 它被迫栖息于这座精巧的牢笼之中，覆面下的野性在嘶吼，在挣扎。

Item.21063.2.en: Used for certain Trekker skill upgrade (Lv.7 to Lv.10).
Item.21063.2.cn: 用于部分旅人能力7~10级等级提升

Item.21063.3.en: A colossal shadow lurking beneath the deep sea. Each time it surfaces, it brings surging waves and the awe-inspiring force of nature.
Item.21063.3.cn: 潜伏于深海下的阴影，每一次出没都将带来汹涌的波荡与令人生畏的自然之力。

Item.21071.2.en: A basic material used for Discs tier-up.
Item.21071.2.cn: 用于秘纹升阶的初级材料。

Item.21071.3.en:
Grasp the lingering aura on this eerie breath. 
You can still feel the force of the eerie power within, a call from another dimension.
Item.21071.3.cn:
握住这份怪诞中残留的气息。
你尚能感觉到其上那股诡异之力，仿佛来自另一个维度的呼唤。

Item.21072.2.en: An intermediate material used for Discs tier-up.
Item.21072.2.cn: 用于秘纹升阶的中级材料。

Item.21072.3.en:
The lingering soul holds the purest essence of spirit. 
As you grasp it, the image of uncanny phantom step rises once more in your mind.
Item.21072.3.cn:
遗留的灵魂中蕴含着最纯粹的精神。
握在手中，你的脑海里又一次浮现那虚空幻步的幽影，难以捉摸。

Item.21073.2.en: An advanced material used for Discs tier-up.
Item.21073.2.cn: 用于秘纹升阶的高级材料。

Item.21073.3.en: It enjoys the frenzied stage, bowing just in preparation for embracing more impassioned beats.
Item.21073.3.cn: 它享受着疯狂的舞台，每一次的躬身行礼都只为迎接更为迷乱的节拍。

Item.21081.2.en: A basic material used for Discs tier-up.
Item.21081.2.cn: 用于秘纹升阶的初级材料。

Item.21081.3.en:
The great Count is unbeatable. 
It just fights to test the strength of the mortal and mercifully rewards them with treasure.
Item.21081.3.cn:
伟大的男爵从不会被打倒。
它只是体验了凡人的实力，并心怀仁慈地给予了嘉赏。

Item.21082.2.en: An intermediate material used for Discs tier-up.
Item.21082.2.cn: 用于秘纹升阶的中级材料。

Item.21082.3.en:
The great Count fights beyond the cause of victory. 
It just fools with reckless mortals to spend afternoon tea time and generously shares with them its cellaring.
Item.21082.3.cn:
伟大的男爵早已超脱胜负的戏码。
它只是假借凡人的莽撞调剂午后茶会的无聊，并随手分享了自己的窖藏。

Item.21083.2.en: An advanced material used for Discs tier-up.
Item.21083.2.cn: 用于秘纹升阶的高级材料。

Item.21083.3.en:
The great Count won't bear disgrace!
The count pretends to be sleeping to let the mortal win, and the dropped fragment is its generous gift to the mortal for their perseverance.
Item.21083.3.cn:
伟大的男爵岂能容忍尊严蒙尘！
它只是用假寐嘉奖了凡人的毅力，遗落的碎屑权当展现慷慨的恩典。

Item.21091.2.en: A basic material used for Discs tier-up.
Item.21091.2.cn: 用于秘纹升阶的初级材料。

Item.21091.3.en:
Grasp the lingering aura on this faint light. 
You can still feel its obsession with ever-glowing.
Item.21091.3.cn:
握住这缕微光上残留的气息。
你尚能感觉到其上那微微闪烁的执念，它不甘晦暗。

Item.21092.2.en: An intermediate material used for Discs tier-up.
Item.21092.2.cn: 用于秘纹升阶的中级材料。

Item.21092.3.en:
The lingering soul holds the purest essence of spirit. 
As you grasp it, the image of touching glow rises once more in your mind. The stunning light is both a sword and a cage.
Item.21092.3.cn:
遗留的灵魂中蕴含着最纯粹的精神。
握在手中，你的脑海里又一次浮现那令人几乎落泪的炫目，光会成为利刃，也将成为牢笼。

Item.21093.2.en: An advanced material used for Discs tier-up.
Item.21093.2.cn: 用于秘纹升阶的高级材料。

Item.21093.3.en:
It indulges in the night and shuns the day.
It just hopes to have its own valuable time and freedom.
Item.21093.3.cn:
它沉溺于夜晚，它逃避明日来临。
它只是希望，拥有彻底属于自己的时间，以及自由。

Item.211001.3.en:
Standing in the wilderness, a gentle breeze caresses.
Another day blooms anew.
Item.211001.3.cn:
置身在原野，吹拂着微风——
新的一天又要开始了。

Item.211002.3.en:
A golden sea, brimming with the joy of harvest.
Make sure to eat well and take care of yourself!
Item.211002.3.cn:
金黄色的海洋，承载了丰收的喜悦。
要记得好好吃饭哦。

Item.211003.3.en:
A tiny broom soaring with grand dreams.
The cloud-hidden scenery awaits tomorrow's discovery.
Item.211003.3.cn:
窄窄的扫帚乘着宽宽的理想。
云彩背后的景色，明天再来猜吧。

Item.211004.3.en:
A princess revered by all, a hero returning with honors.
Dreams are blind to status; your harvest grows with every step you take.
Item.211004.3.cn:
众星捧月的公主，荣归故里的勇者。
梦想没有尊卑，行动越多，收获越多。

Item.211005.3.en:
The sand sea engulfs the horizon, obscuring the journey's end.
It's time to pause and catch your breath.
Item.211005.3.cn:
沙海漫过了远景，让终点模糊起来。
这是在提醒你驻足歇脚的时机。

Item.211006.3.en:
A sparkling spring kisses your skirt hem, stopping you in your tracks.
Quench your thirst first, then brace yourself for the thorny path ahead.
Item.211006.3.cn:
一汪清泉，沾湿了裙摆，停下了脚步。
务必先止渴，再蹋荆踩棘。

Item.211007.3.en:
Shimmering stars light up the night sky.
Brave maidens, it's time to embark on your journey!
Item.211007.3.cn:
闪耀的星光，贯彻长空。
勇敢的少女们，是时候踏上路途了！

Item.211008.3.en:
Gentle starlight, farewell to today.
The bell rings to close today's business!
Item.211008.3.cn:
温柔的星光，告别今日。
钟声已至——今天的营业到此为止！

Item.212001.3.en:
I can't wait!
I'm desperate to savor my favorite iced black tea, sweetened with sugar, topped with creamy foam, infused with tangerine slices, sprinkled with chocolate crumbs, and blended with pineapple and mango juice!
Item.212001.3.cn:
好期待！
我已经等不及点上一杯我最爱的加糖加奶盖塞橘子片撒巧克力碎加菠萝汁混芒果汁的刨冰红茶了！

Item.212002.3.en:
Spinning around in circles, vying for the chairs.
Only those who grab a chair get to sit down.
Wait, aren't we playing "Freeze Dance"?
Item.212002.3.cn:
团团转，转圈圈。
抢到椅子的才有资格坐下——
欸，不是在玩「三二一木头人」吗？

Item.212003.3.en:
To Whom It May Concern,
With admiration for your outstanding dance skills,
you are warmly invited to this never-ending dance party.
Item.212003.3.cn:
敬启：
由于您的舞蹈天分优秀得惹人嫉妒。
特邀您来参加这场舞会——不设散场时间。

Item.212005.3.en:
Pump up the jam, and keep the dance floor thumpin'!
Let the volume shatter the skies, let our passion ignite the clouds!
My adrenaline has skyrocketed to its absolute limit!
Item.212005.3.cn:
接着奏乐接着舞！
音量突破天际，燃情烧尽云霞！
我已经——飙到极限啦！

Item.212006.3.en:
At the dawn of creation,
shattered beliefs hovered above the horizon, casting its glow over the world.
Humans leaped over mountains, gazing boldly at the gods.
And then, heaven and earth split, the light dimmed, and days merged into an endless flow.
Item.212006.3.cn:
万物伊始，
破碎信仰盘踞于天际之上，
人类飞跃高山，直视神灵，
而后天地分裂，光消日融。

Item.212007.3.en:
The wind awakens all creatures and paints the forest with a splash of vibrant colors, whispering the news of the party to every corner of the woods and caves:
The grand celebration of the forest and its elves is about to begin!
Item.212007.3.cn:
穿过森林的风唤醒万物，掀起绚丽的色彩，将派对的消息吹到林间与洞穴：
属于森林与精灵的庆典，马上就要开始了哟。

Item.212008.3.en:
Keep the joyful moments for yourself.
Embrace it as a break—immerse yourself in this refreshing, fleeting joy.
Item.212008.3.cn:
快乐的时间，要留给自己。
就当是放个假吧——只享受这清爽一刻。

Item.212009.3.en:
Its grudge still rages within, burning fiercely.
"——! ——————!!"
Alas, it's hard to comprehend its sorrowful cries.
Item.212009.3.cn:
怨恨还在灼烧着它。
「——！——————！！」
可惜，很难听懂它的悲泣。

Item.212010.3.en:
Once the war horn sounds, there's no going back.
Fight! Fight until the bitter end!
Item.212010.3.cn:
出征的号角一旦响起，就没有退后的余地。
战斗吧！直到最后一刻。

Item.213001.3.en:
"Isn't a laundry room for washing clothes?"
"Aren't oranges just for eating?"
"What are we doing here?"
"Stop chatting and look at the camera..."
"This is the hottest photo trend right now!"
Item.213001.3.cn:
“洗衣房不是洗衣服的地方吗？”
“橙子不是用来吃的食物吗？”
“我们现在是在做什么啊？”
“别唠叨了，快看镜头吧——”
“这可是当下最流行的拍照方式呢！”

Item.213002.3.en:
In spring and summer's embrace, petals dance in the air;
in autumn and winter's chill, rain drizzles relentlessly.
The scenes mirrored in your eyes
fluctuate with the changing seasons,
how am I supposed to understand them?
Item.213002.3.cn:
春天夏天，花瓣飞舞，
秋天冬天，阴雨蔓延，
你眼中倒映的景色，
随着季节波动，
我该如何读懂。

Item.213003.3.en:
On the stage enveloped by cheers, they shine brightly as they play their final melody.
The tumultuous emotions ignite the notes, consuming this night with fiery passion.
Item.213003.3.cn:
被欢呼声包围的舞台上，闪闪发光的她们奏响了最后一曲。
躁动的情绪化为音符的燃料，烧尽了这个夜晚。

Item.213004.3.cn:
动人而优雅的灰风双月；
睿智和幽默的绝对主角。
黑洞，漆黑的明天在等着你们！

Item.213005.3.en:
Bammm! The cells are splitting!
Gurgleee! The brains are boiling!
Sliced right from the top,
one me multiplies into a thousand—how do you find the true me?
Item.213005.3.cn:
嘭嘭嘭，细胞要分裂啦！
咕嘟嘟，脑浆都沸腾啦！
从躯壳顶端向下切割，
一份的我、千份的我，要如何分辨真面目呢？

Item.213006.3.en:
Sinking into the cozy embrace of my soft bed, I find myself utterly unwilling to stir.
If we drift off together, will our dreams intertwine?
Item.213006.3.cn:
躺在软绵绵的床上，就再也不想动弹了——
与她一起安眠的话，我们会梦到彼此吗？

Item.213007.3.en:
Golden birds flap their wings, splitting the dreamscape as soft as clouds.
In the cracks where memories weave, we will eventually meet the ones we long to see.
Item.213007.3.cn:
金色的飞鸟振动翅膀，分开了柔软如云的梦境。
在回忆蔓延的裂痕里，我们终能遇到想见的人。

Item.213008.3.en: The scenery along the journey is a gift we should appreciate. Let's take it slow, bring some snacks, and enjoy this bright, sunny break—it'll surely add a joyful chapter to our memories.
Item.213008.3.cn: 沿途的风景是旅行的馈赠，值得我们放缓脚步，带上美食，享受这天朗气清的小憩时光——那一定会在我们的回忆里，留下欢声笑语的一笔。

Item.213009.3.en: Warm raindrops trickle down from head to toe, sliding down every inch of my skin. Ah—choo! It's not a cold, just the soap bubbles tickling me again.
Item.213009.3.cn: 温暖的雨丝从头顶流至脚底，路过每一寸皮肤。阿...阿嚏，这不是感冒，只是肥皂泡泡又调皮了。

Item.213010.3.en:
The whirling harbor breeze,
The hot air from the steaming baskets...
As you lean in close, your breath merges with.
The neon-hued vapors, blurring my vision.
Item.213010.3.cn:
旋转翻腾的港口海风，
新鲜出炉的笼屉热气，
你靠近肩头时呼出的吐息，
霓虹色水蒸气迷蒙了眼睛。

Item.213011.3.en: Beyond the veil of silence and solemnity, is there another side of you that I haven't yet discovered? Electronic-distorted notes peel away the mundane facade, revealing a tender gaze under the neon glow that beckons me toward you.
Item.213011.3.cn: 沉默与严肃之外，是否还有其他的你是我未曾了解的？电子失真的音符揭开名为日常的外衣，霓虹灯笼罩之下，那温柔的视线，正吸引着我向你迈进。

Item.213012.3.en:
With the earth as our stage and the starry sky as our backdrop,
Listen up, universe—this is our moment to shine!
Item.213012.3.cn:
把大地当做舞台，将星空当做幕布。
——听好了，宇宙，现在开始就是我们的主场！

Item.213013.3.en:
Dart through fields of wheat and play in maple forests, pausing where the seasons meet.
Oh, sun-kissed child, hide away, before the pains of growing up can find you.
Item.213013.3.cn:
穿过麦田，游乐枫林，在季节交替的路口停下。
太阳色的孩子啊，快快躲起来，不要被成长的烦恼找到。

Item.213014.3.en:
Tighten the screws, apply the grease.
Behind every great knight is an even greater blacksmith.
Safe travels—and don't ride too fast!
Item.213014.3.cn:
拧紧螺丝，做好润滑。
最棒的骑士背后是最棒的铁匠。
一路顺风，别开太快喔！

Item.213015.3.en:
I smile often, yet true happiness is a rare guest.
For that scent, once vibrant, now fades and drifts further away.
Yet, whenever I reach for it, there's a stinging pain in my heart...
Item.213015.3.cn:
我经常笑，可我不经常开心。
因为，那香气已越来越淡，越来越远。
可碰触它，却总是令我刺痛……

Item.213016.3.en:
You've tasted the sweet forbidden fruit,
now you're the goddess of art.
Stand as the sole, ever-blooming rose in this pond of love and desire.
Sing, dance, shine, and repeat.
Keep going till the strings break, never stop.
Item.213016.3.cn:
你已初尝禁果的甜美，
你已化身艺术的女神，
便做这片爱欲池塘上，唯一盛放的不夜蔷薇。
歌唱，舞动，闪耀，重复。
直至提线崩落，别再停下。

Item.213017.3.en:
Summer wraps up in a blur of sweat, yet there's still time to touch up for the next show.
In the corner of a winter celebration, I score the last ice cream cone before closing.
No matter how life is divided between work and leisure,
I'm still me, whole and unchanged.
Item.213017.3.cn:
盛夏在汗水中结束，还有点时间补妆给下一场演出。
冬日里的庆典角落，买到了打烊前的最后一只甜筒。
工作和生活再怎么切割，
所有的我，依旧是同一个我。

Item.213018.3.en:
On this eagerly anticipated day,
Standing before the dazzling shelves,
Which beverage holds the most anticipated flavor?
If you're torn between decisions,
Then take them all with you!
Item.213018.3.cn:
在期待已久的日子里
在琳琅满目的货架前
哪一罐饮料才是最值得期待的口味
如果无法抉择
那就全部都带走吧~

Item.213019.3.en:
Shimmering like fragile bubbles, they are dreams woven from pure imagination.
As these dreams burst and their shimmer fades, they uncover the purest truth,
whispering it all in silence.
Item.213019.3.cn:
如泡沫般绚烂而脆弱，那是建立在虚构之上的美梦。
而当美梦消散，所有浮华褪去后，才会在这世间留下最纯粹的证明。
——它们用沉默诉说着一切。

Item.213020.3.en:
The moment wood splinters flew, a ravenous hunger burst through the door.
"No—get away from my emergency food stash! Aaaaah!"
Item.213020.3.cn:
木屑飞溅的刹那，疯狂的饥饿已破门而入。
“不要——不要抢我的储备粮啊啊啊啊——”

Item.213021.3.en:
Mirrors never tell lies;
they beckon you in and bid you farewell.
Your fate is inscribed on a particle of drifting dust,
while divine prophecy mirrors itself in my gaze.
Item.213021.3.cn:
镜子从不诉说谎言，
它呼唤你来，送你离开。
你的命运刻印在一粒浮尘之上，
神圣的预言倒映在我的眼里。

Item.213022.3.en:
Here lies the gateway to the Inferno.
It leads straight to the abyss of sin.
I wait by the riverbank, illuminating your sorrowful journey ahead,
blessing you to plunge into my eternal love.
Item.213022.3.cn:
这里直通炼狱之都，
这里直通罪恶之底。
我在河岸守候，照亮你悲苦的前路，
祝福你沉入我永恒的爱。

Item.213023.3.en:
You skillfully push open the door,
And her pristine wings bring solace to your aching heart.
Together, you share a serene silence, a peaceful bond just between the two of you.
You know that her silence is her ultimate compassion towards you.
And your visit is the sole redemption she can ever hope for.
Item.213023.3.cn:
你熟练地推开大门，
她至洁的羽翼抚慰了你的伤痛，
你们沉默着，沉默着度过只有两人的恬静时光。
你深知，沉默是她对你最后的垂怜。
而你的来访，是她唯一能获得的救赎。

Item.213024.3.en:
"Hey, regular! Good to see ya! Your usual?"
"Huh? This seat's for toddlers only?"
"Eh, rules are made to be broken, right? Nobody's watching anyway!"
"Zoning out is adult paradise!"

Perfect vacation goals right here!
Resting on the register, she savors a dream, tart and sweet.
Item.213024.3.cn:
“哟~老主顾，你来啦，今天要点什么？”
“嗯？什么？你说这个位子三岁以下才能坐？”
“唉，有什么关系嘛，反正又没人看见！”
“浑浑噩噩，这才是大人最了不起的放松方式！”

假如拿到年假，一定要这样子放松一回！
趴在收银机上，她今天也邂逅了酸甜的梦。

Item.213025.3.en:
O little bunny,
close your eyes and drift to sleep,
I'll cradle you in the arms of the night;

O little bunny,
rest your head and dream sweetly,
I promise you the sweetest treat of all.
Item.213025.3.cn:
小兔子啊，
安心睡吧，
我会与夜色一道拥你入怀；

小兔子啊，
乖乖睡吧，
我会为你送上最甘美的奖励。

Item.213026.3.en:
"La-la-la—welcome home, Master! ♥"
"Whether it's the weariness in your heart or the misfortune at your side,"
"I will personally help you sweep all that nasty trash away!"
"Let me turn my energy into your magic! ♥"
"Heaven's cutest maid, Beatrixa, at your service! ♥"

With a clear, lively voice and an impossibly cute demeanor,
she gave her all every day
to deliver healing and hope to her fans across the Nova Continent.
Item.213026.3.cn:
“哩哩哩——欢迎主人回家~♥”
“无论是主人心灵的疲惫，还是主人身边的不幸。”
“丽丽都会亲手帮助主人，将垃圾先生们完——完全全地清扫干净。”
“把丽丽的活力转化为主人的魔力~♥”
“这里是天界第一可爱的女仆，贝缇丽DA♥YO~！”

清楚灵动的嗓音，朝气蓬勃的姿态，
可爱到不真实的她，今天也在拼劲全力，
向诺瓦大陆上的每一名粉丝们传递着治愈与希望。

Item.214001.3.en:
Humans are born alone.
Only in the heat of battle do we truly feel alive.
Huh? Cool guys don't look at explosions? Fine, I heard you—
Item.214001.3.cn:
人就是那样孤独的生物
只能在战斗的时候才能鲜明地感觉到自己的存在 
什么，开炮的时候不准回头看爆炸？ 我知道了啦——

Item.214002.3.en:
Like flower petals, your departing form dissolves,
Beneath starlit nights, our vows still warm my palm,
These perfumed days bring thoughts of you, despite my own will.
Item.214002.3.cn:
当你离去，花瓣般消散的背影，
夜幕星尘间，誓约之言仍在掌心，
在香气弥漫的日子里，不情愿也会想起你。

Item.214003.3.en:
Upward, upward, ever upward.
Through twelve heavens I soar, your gaze still following.
Not gravity's bond, but a homeward stellar road.
Item.214003.3.cn:
向上，向上，向上。
即使腾跃十二重天，依旧能感受到你的视线。
这绝非引力的束缚，而是星海中归家的航路。

Item.214004.3.en:
Look who's here—two little soft kittens on my knee?
Afternoon tea time stretches far.
Sleep soundly. Let purple wisteria shade your beautiful dreams.
Item.214004.3.cn:
哪来的两只小野猫，躺在了我的膝盖上？
下午茶的时间还很长，
安心小憩，在紫藤萝下做一个美丽的梦吧。

Item.214005.3.en:
The blossoms drift in rainy haze,
That flowered in bright sunny days.
A rainbow's gleam within my hand—
Could such beauty ever stay?
Item.214005.3.cn:
雨中飘落的花，
盛开于晴空之上。
掬一捧彩虹，
可否停留在我手中。

Item.214006.3.en:
The witch stands proud, head held high,
Granting honey, venom, and love divine.
You who failed to choose your princess right,
Embrace this cruel pleasure, and dance with me tonight?
Item.214006.3.cn:
魔女就该高傲地扬起头
赐你蜜，赐你毒，赐你爱
没选好公主的你
接受甜美的凌虐，来和我跳一支舞吧？

Item.214007.3.en:
They set the rules of right and wrong,
but if you loathe these bindings, rise as a midnight knight.
Even if bloodied and broken, we're staying true to who we are!
To those arrogant jerks:
"See this mighty fist?"
"After the clock strikes twelve, this is our domain!"
Item.214007.3.cn:
他们规定什么是正确，什么是错误，
如果厌恶这些枷锁桎梏，就成为午夜的骑士。
哪怕最后搞得头破血流，也要活出真正的自己！
对那些自以为是的混蛋说：
“看到这沙包大的拳头没？”
“告诉你们，十二点以后，这里我们说了算！”

Item.214008.3.en:
Why chase that distant rainbow on the horizon,
when you can hold these colorful balloons right here?
Soaring through clear skies on the roller coaster ride.
Listen!
The echoes of pure joy just made their way to you!
Item.214008.3.cn:
仰望雨后那道远在天边的彩虹，
不如伸手抓住眼前这束缤纷的气球。
快乐乘着过山车，越过晴空，
听，
这份欢声笑语，已经投递到你身边~！

Item.214009.3.en:
Only one day of food left. Our wallets are empty. The Oasis's Grace is running low...
We've staked everything on this Monolith commission...
—Still, when it's time for the group photo, don't forget to smile!
Item.214009.3.cn:
粮食储备仅剩一天，钱包已经见底，“绿洲号”的恩赐不足……
我们的全部，都赌在这趟出征了……
——合影的时候，还是要保持微笑！

Item.214010.3.en:
We beseech Thee, have mercy; heed our plea.
Goddess, do the cries of mortals reach Thine ears?
...
—Each word finds Me, finds Us all.
We shall guide humanity towards its glorious destiny.
Item.214010.3.cn:
求祢垂怜我们；求祢俯听我们的祈祷。
神啊，妳听得到人间的声音吗？
……
——我听得见，我们都听得见。
我们将指引世人，走向荣光。

Item.214011.3.en:
Before looking back at the start, what seemed the end was just
the start of a new chapter.
Are you happy as you've always dreamed you'd be?
Let's meet again tomorrow.
Item.214011.3.cn:
回望起点之前，错当作终点
故事翻落新章节。
快乐吗？如你千万次设想般
约定明日再相见。

Item.214012.3.en:
On United Harvest's grand design, Philae stands as just a single point.
From here, I shall draw a perfect circle, claiming the entire Nova.
—Follow me. Pledge loyalty. March ever onward.
Item.214012.3.cn:
在联合种业的商业版图上，菲莱只是其中的一个点。
而我，则将以此为中心，画出完美的圆，囊括整片大陆。
——追随我，效忠我，永不止步。

Item.214013.3.en:
"First, we need a ship, then courage, and lastly, faith."
The adventurer pinned the map
While whitecaps rage from point to point
Wild waters crash and beckon towards mysteries
She waits for kindred souls to sail.
Item.214013.3.cn:
「首先，我们需要一艘船，其次是勇气，然后是信仰。」
冒险者在地图上打下图钉
点与点之间便是旅途的惊涛骇浪
风浪翻涌着指向未知的海域
她在等那敢于同行的人。

Item.214014.3.en:
We trekked, picked, and laughed with our friends,
sharing sweet fruit that burst with juice in our mouths.
Item.214014.3.cn:
与朋友们一起跋涉、采摘、欢笑。
分享果实，任由甘美在齿间流淌。

Item.214015.3.en:
Deer call softly in the grove, wild grass their sweet feast.
A maiden rests in afternoon shade, where sunbeams dance and weave.
Like wind through time the moments flow, "Click"—a memory to keep.
Item.214015.3.cn:
呦呦鹿鸣，食野之苹。
阳光斑驳的午后，林中少女驻足小憩。
岁月像风一样流转，“咔嚓”，凝固在时光的相片里。

Item.214016.3.en:
As dawn arrives to greet the day, the last petal falls.
I search through time's unending flow, for traces lost so long ago.
As sun and moon their cycles keep, and time flows like a river deep,
Through your gaze, forever bright, I'll bloom eternal in your sight.
Item.214016.3.cn:
当清晨来临，最后一片花瓣落下，
我周而复始寻找，流失的痕迹。
日月轮转，光阴更迭，
以你的目光观照，我将永不凋谢。

Item.214017.3.en:
Like a human life, fireworks bloom, flourish, and fade—
brief yet brilliant, leaving their unique mark across the night sky.
It's much like a Trekker's endless quest to climb the Monolith,
all for that one day when they might finally hold the stars in their hands...
Item.214017.3.cn:
烟花的绽放、盛开与熄灭，就像人的一生，
短暂而辉煌，在夜空中留下属于自己的印记；
就像旅人不断攀登星塔的冒险，
为了终有一日，能捧起那天上的星星……

Item.214018.3.en:
With guilt my heart was heavy worn, to heal the bridge that had been torn.
Thought friendship's door was closed for good,
Till here we sit, just as we should.
New décor graces these old walls, new packages the sweet food calls.
One drink runs hot, one drink runs cold,
Same taste remains from days of old.
Item.214018.3.cn:
曾心怀愧疚，也试过拯救，
以为无法再度交心联手，
终于还是相邀再次对坐。
餐厅换了装潢，点心换了包装，
冷热不同的两款饮品，
入口仍是熟悉味道。

Item.214019.3.en:
Kasimira, are you ready?
This is round 37 and our final match for today.

Too bad, just one shot shy.
If that shot had landed, you'd have had me beat.
Chaton, your hand wavered at the critical moment.

Just the thought of besting you gets my adrenaline pumping!
Let's do it again!

Rack the gun, we've got the next commission to prep for.

—Looks like Chaton's challenge isn't over yet.
Item.214019.3.cn:
卡西米拉，准备好了吗？
这是第三十七局，也是今天的最后一局。

可惜了，只差一发。
要是命中，你就能够战胜我。
猫眼，最后的关键时刻，你手抖了。

一想到有机会超越你，我就兴奋了起来！
再来！

把枪放回去吧，我们该去准备下一轮委托了。

——看来，猫眼的挑战仍将继续。

Item.214020.3.en:
"Uneventful days aren't worth recording."
"Dull little things aren't worth recording."
"Repetitive work isn't worth recording."
But...are they truly worthless?
A teammate's reminder before you head out, the wrong turn you took, the smiles and thanks you received...
These ordinary fragments of memory condense into tiny points of light.
Even if the paper turns yellow with time, the brilliance of each day will never be forgotten.
Item.214020.3.cn:
“平淡稀松的日常不值得记录。”
“索然无味的小事不值得记录。”
“繁杂重复的工作不值得记录。”
难道，这一切真的毫无价值吗？
出门前的同伴的叮嘱，不小心走错的岔路，收获的微笑感谢……
看似普通的回忆碎片，凝聚成一个个闪烁的光点。
即便纸张泛黄，也会永远记得熠熠生辉的每一天。

Item.214021.3.en:
Friends, companions...whatever the name, they all embody the same group of souls united by fate. They converge when the threads of fate intertwine, and disperse when they unwind.
What we can do is cherish every fleeting moment of this reunion, laughing and playing with all our hearts, and etching those precious memories deep into our hearts.
And as the hour of parting draws near, we cling to the hope of a future encounter, anticipating the day we shall meet again.
Item.214021.3.cn:
朋友，伙伴……无论如何称呼，它们指的都是同一群因缘分相聚的人，缘至而来，缘尽则散。
我们能做的，就是在这短暂相聚的日子里，尽情欢笑、尽情玩闹，将那份宝贵的回忆烙印在心底。
当离别到来之际，再一次地，心怀对重逢之日的期盼。

Item.214022.3.en:
Behold, something looms in the dark.
Listen closely, do you hear those footsteps echoing?
Odd, a sudden shiver runs down my spine.

A faulty projector, an unknown film reel, and eerie visuals flickering...
A Trekker's camp at midnight, an uninvited guest, and an unexpected visitor.
"Meow—"
The silence envelops all. You close the door, but it has already slipped inside.
Item.214022.3.cn:
你看，有什么东西正在靠近
你听，是不是有脚步的声音
奇怪，怎么突然有一阵寒意

故障的显影器，陌生的留影盒，奇怪的影像画面……
夜半的旅人营地，不速之客，意外来访。
“喵——”
四周静悄悄，你关上门，它进来了。

Item.214023.3.en:
We had to take a day off now and then.
Escape the gang fights and the daily grind,
step out under a clear sky, and spray paint a rainbow of our own across it.
Item.214023.3.cn:
偶尔也要抽出一天吧。
远离帮派间的争斗，摆脱苦闷的日常，
走进晴空万里，在上面喷绘出我们颜色的彩虹。

Item.214024.3.en:
A rope
dangled from a sunlit ledge,
dropping into the long-forgotten ruins.
The girl grabbed it
and rappelled down.
"Hah, just some treasure?
Watch me haul it up!"
Item.214024.3.cn:
一根绳索
从阳光照射的地方出发
通往没落许久的遗迹
少女抓住它
从天而降
“——不就是宝物嘛
看我把它拿上来！”

Item.214026.3.en:
Damp hair clung to her back.
Her clothes were a mess, yet the air was stiflingly still.
Carrying a heavy heart, even the falling petals seemed to weigh her down.
As the rain fell endlessly, your silhouette began to blur.
Item.214026.3.cn:
濡湿的发丝，纠缠在身后
衣衫已不整，却无处透风
心烦意乱，连落花都变得沉重
雨不停歇的日子，你的轮廓逐渐模糊

Item.214027.3.en:
Brush and ink are her weapons.
On the stretched rice paper,
She weaves her magic, each brushstroke dancing in unconventional places.
This is her realm, a world of enchantment solely under her command.
Item.214027.3.cn:
笔和墨都是她的武器
在铺开的宣纸上
一笔一划，落在不合常规的位置
这是她创造的，独属于她的魔法世界

Item.214028.3.en:
A petal without a name or number
drifts into the silent garden,
carrying a blush of crimson and a vision of pure white,
settling into a golden specimen, alongside a vanished dream.
Item.214028.3.cn:
一片没有姓名、编号的花瓣，
飘落在寂静的花园中，
注入绯红的气息，纯白的幻象，
凝固成金黄的标本，连同消逝的梦。

Item.214029.3.en:
The Meow God said my treasure would appear in my favorite place.
So I searched every amusement park in the Monoliths.
And finally... right here, I nabbed this tiny, squishy little thing!
Item.214029.3.cn:
喵喵神说，猫眼的珍宝会出现在她最喜欢的地方。
于是，猫眼大人我便找遍了星塔的所有游乐场。
终于……终于，在这里，抓到了这只小小的，软绵绵的小家伙。

Item.214030.3.en:
The girl burst in with the afternoon sun,
bringing with her the aroma of snacks.
Fries? Grilled fish? Or a loaf of fluffy, warm bread?
You got to grab something
to enjoy this stolen moment of peace.
Item.214030.3.cn:
少女踏着午后的日光闯入
随她一起入侵的还有点心的香气
薯条？烤鱼？还是烤得松软的面包？
你可以选一个
来填充这个忙里偷闲的间隙~

Item.214031.1.en: The Clash of Blade and Axe

Item.214031.3.en:
An alarm blared as blade met axe.
The cage shattered, and she plunged into the abyss.
Through the crimson rain, she met your eyes.
Item.214031.3.cn:
刀斧碰撞的瞬间 拉响警报
斩断牢笼之际 堕入深渊 
雨天淋下的深红色 你的眼睛

Item.214032.3.en:
Facts captured.
Photos printed.
Story broadcast.
Welcome to the witches' Dream Factory of ☆Truth!
Item.214032.3.cn:
捕捉事实的第一时间；
印出相片的第一时间；
口播报道的第一时间；
欢迎来到，魔女们的真相☆梦工厂！

Item.214033.3.en:
Ah, welcome to my ball, my dear patient.
Listen, the music is playing. Come, dance with my collection among these phantom bubbles.
Item.214033.3.cn:
哎呀，欢迎可爱的病人光临我的舞会。
听，音乐已经响起，就在这片泡沫的幻影中与我的藏品们共舞一曲吧~

Item.214036.3.en:
Body bound, soul eroded,
even pain masquerades as a mire of salvation.
The fallen priestess still wanders
on a pilgrimage with no answers and no end,
awaiting a righteous one to grant her release.
Item.214036.3.cn:
肉体受缚，内心空蚀，
疼痛也伪装成救济的泥沼。
堕落的圣职者如今仍在徘徊，
在没有答案和终点的朝圣中，
等待着将她解救的义人。

Item.214037.3.en:
The children of the Ash District tell a legend:
when despair grips the world and tears loved ones apart,
a green-haired heroine called the "Lord of the Prize Claw" and her brave companions
will lead everyone to catch the last glimmer of hope and reunite with their families.
Item.214037.3.cn:
灰城区的孩子们间，流传着一个传说：
在整个世界陷入绝望与无助，被迫与重要的人分离之时，
名为“娃娃机仙人“的绿发勇者和她勇敢的伙伴们，
会带领众人抓住仅存的希望，重新与家人团聚。

Item.214038.3.en:
Floating on a thousand crests,
a translucent, shimmering thing.
Escaping the searing summer heat,
drifting along with the migrating fish.
Item.214038.3.cn:
漂浮于千层浪花间
透明闪烁之物
逃离灼热夏日
乘着游鱼流浪

Item.214039.3.en:
I long for the sea breeze to linger, for the waves to remain.
I pray for the sunset to stretch endlessly, for the starlight to never fade.
I wish to share with you alone—a summer that belongs to us.
Item.214039.3.cn:
盼望海风停驻，盼望浪花凝固
祈祷夕阳绵长，祈祷星光永恒
只愿与你独享，我们的专属夏天

Item.214040.3.en:
To protect your companions, to summon the courage and become your best self,
strike your fist at the colossal enemy,
and clear the path to a future full of hope.
Item.214040.3.cn:
守护同伴的信念，改变自我的勇气。
朝着庞然之敌挥出拳头——
打开通往明天与希望的道路。

Item.214041.3.en:
A sleigh full of gifts
guided by the messenger
heading toward the sunrise and its destination
except—
shouldn't reindeer be pulling it?!
Item.214041.3.cn:
满载礼物的雪橇
在使者的指挥下
向着朝阳和目的地前行
只是——
拉动雪橇的不应该是驯鹿吗？！

Item.214042.3.en:
Midnight bells chime to welcome the Springseek Festival
as fireworks set the night sky ablaze.
Amid the revelry, the crowd wishes
that there is joy and peace for the days and years ahead.
Item.214042.3.cn:
新春的零点钟声响起
烟花在夜空绽放
人们在热闹中祈愿
愿年年有今日，岁岁有今朝

Item.214043.3.en:
Beneath the soil steeped in conspiracy and intrigue,
Watchful, calculating gazes interweave.
Something is struggling to break through the earth.
Item.214043.3.cn:
浸润着阴谋与诡计的土壤下
翘望与算计的目光互相交织
有什么正挣扎着破土而出

Item.214044.3.en:
The drawn curtains create a cozy, warm retreat.
Her smile is tender,
but the syringe in her hand glints chillingly.
"Don't be afraid. It will be over before you know it."
Item.214044.3.cn:
帷幕隔出暖色的空间
她的笑意温和
指尖的针管却掠过一丝寒芒
“别怕，很快就好了。”

Item.214045.3.en:
A fierce wind sends petals swirling through the sky as paper umbrellas snap shut 
Look—within the sea of blossoms, before the formation of parasols 
A slender figure dances gracefully
Is it real… or just a fleeting dream?
Item.214045.3.cn:
强风掀起漫天花雨，纸伞应声收拢
你看，在花海之中，在伞阵之前
纤细的人影翩翩起舞
那到底是真，还是幻梦一场

Item.214046.3.en:
Think of it as nothing more than a marvelous Stella Drama.
When we return our present, our trusted friends are still here with us.
Leave the dark Monolith behind. The winter night will pass.
And look: spring's warm sunlight will shine once more upon this city that once thrived.
Item.214046.3.cn:
全然当作是看了一场惊奇的影戏，
回过神来，炉火边仍有信赖的伙伴相随。
走出黑暗的高塔，冬夜终将过去。
看吧，春日的暖阳会重新照耀这片曾经繁荣的都市。

Item.214047.3.en:
Sharpen the crease, press firm the wax,
Longing turns to ink upon the page.
A sudden gust sweeps the words away,
Leaving a thousand thoughts ... lighter than the air.
Item.214047.3.cn:
压紧折痕，拓实火漆，
惦念化作纸上的墨迹。
忽而风起，卷去文字与载体，
余下的万千思绪，它比风还轻盈。

Item.214048.3.en:
The winter wind carries prayers from afar
The messenger arrives with blessings and gifts
Stepping into view as the midnight bells ring
This Snowish Festival gift is for you, who never lost your childish wonder
Item.214048.3.cn:
雪夜的风吹来远方的祷告
使者携着祝福和礼物
在零点的钟鸣声里登场
这份雪愿节的礼物，送给童心未泯的你

Item.214049.3.cn:
吹散迷茫，冲向星辰的彼方；
敲响起始的钟声，开启属于我们的冒险。
爱与希望，就在路上；这一程，感谢有你。

Item.214050.3.en:
Countless toasts exchanged, endless lofty talks—
visions and dreams only seem real in this fleeting moment.
Yet beyond the light, on the moon's hidden side,
shadows long for a world where dreams can truly exist.
Item.214050.3.cn:
无数的传杯换盏，不尽的高谈阔论，
愿景与畅想仅于此刻可堪一用。
可在那光的背后，月亮的暗面，
影子正期望着梦存在的世界。

Item.214051.3.en:
As flowers and water embrace the earth, as stars revolve in search of one another,
all things in this world lean on each other—so let me share your solitude as well.
In the dark depths of space, let me light the starlight that guides you home.
Item.214051.3.cn:
就像花与水拥抱着大地，星与星环绕着追寻，
世间的一切彼此依偎，也请让我分担你的孤寂。
在黑暗的深空中，为你点亮回家的星光。

Item.214052.3.en:
Gears lock into place, sparking a universe of wild imagination.
The rabbit unrolls her inspiration list while tweezers and wrenches cobble together absurd inventions.
The girl's pen skips across the blueprints.
And beneath an adorable shell, a dangerous new weapon comes to life.
Item.214052.3.cn:
齿轮嵌合转动，妄想的宇宙开始运行，
兔子展开灵感的清单，镊子和扳手拼接无厘头的创意；
少女的笔尖在图纸上跃动，
可爱的外壳之下，一个新的危险武器诞生。

Item.214053.3.en:
Whether after a nerve-wracking, narrow escape from death,
or a candid, grudge‑shattering conversation,
there is always a joyful, open‑hearted gathering, where people share a meal together, finally letting go of the past.
Looking at everything around her, she suddenly realizes this very moment is what is most worth cherishing.
Item.214053.3.cn:
或是在惊心动魄、死里逃生的行动之后，
或是在推心置腹、冰释前嫌的交谈之后，
总少不了一场敞开心扉的欢聚，让人们在同席共餐之间，彻底放下过往的芥蒂。
望着眼前的人与事，才忽然意识到，最值得珍惜的，正是此时此刻。

Item.214054.3.en:
A little paradise that's ours alone,
running with her through the dim lamplight.
Don't be afraid of stumbling—I'll hold your hand tight,
until we make it to the end together.
Item.214054.3.cn:
独属于自己的小小乐园，
和她一起奔走在幽幽的灯下。
不要害怕止步不前，我会永远握紧你的手，
直到我们抵达彼此的终点。

Item.214055.3.en:
Sunlight filters through the clear water,
warming the ocean with a gentle glow.
A girl gazes up at the shimmering light—
what lies beyond those ripples?
Item.214055.3.cn:
阳光透过澄澈的水面，
冰凉的海水因此拥有了温度。
水中的少女仰望那一片光斑，
波光粼粼的另一边会是什么呢？

Item.214056.3.en:
Broken patterns of light drift across her hair,
as she steps into a flowing stream.
The forest wind follows the sound of insects,
whispering that midsummer has quietly arrived.
Item.214056.3.cn:
斑驳的树影吻过少女的发梢，
目送她走入流动的清泉；
林间的风循着虫鸣而来，
提醒着她盛夏已悄然来临。

Item.214057.3.en:
The sea reaches for you with gentle waves.
Every sound joins the celebration in perfect harmony.
With friends by your side and the breeze beneath you,
sail toward summer, toward the sea beyond the horizon.
Item.214057.3.cn:
清波摇曳，海水吻着肌肤，
万籁共鸣，庆典气氛正热。
携友同行，乘在轻风之上，
向着夏日，向着海的彼方。

Item.214058.3.en:
One by one, we count the seasons gone by,
laying yesterday's sorrows to rest.
O summer memories, poured out with every burst of laughter,
may you never be carried away by the tides of time.
Item.214058.3.cn:
掰着手指细数过往的季节，
将昨日的苦涩埋藏在心底。
随欢笑一同倾泄的夏日回忆啊，
请不要随着时间的潮水退去。

Item.21997.2.en: Grants a random basic material for Disc tier-up.
Item.21997.2.cn: 随机获得一种秘纹升阶的初级材料。

Item.22.2.en: A proof of your activity in the Startup Grant. Used to level up the Grant Tier.
Item.22.2.cn: 在激励基金中活跃的证明，可以用于提升基金等级。

Item.22.3.en: As you explore the Monolith and beyond, the Startup Grant will amplify your progress, making every step count double.
Item.22.3.cn: 在探索星塔和世界的路上，创业基金能让你事半功倍。

Item.221001.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.221001.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.221001.3.en:
Standing in the wilderness, a gentle breeze caresses.
Another day blooms anew.
Item.221001.3.cn:
置身在原野，吹拂着微风——
新的一天又要开始了。

Item.221002.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.221002.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.221002.3.en:
A golden sea, brimming with the joy of harvest.
Make sure to eat well and take care of yourself!
Item.221002.3.cn:
金黄色的海洋，承载了丰收的喜悦。
要记得好好吃饭哦。

Item.221003.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.221003.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.221003.3.en:
A tiny broom soaring with grand dreams.
The cloud-hidden scenery awaits tomorrow's discovery.
Item.221003.3.cn:
窄窄的扫帚乘着宽宽的理想。
云彩背后的景色，明天再来猜吧。

Item.221004.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.221004.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.221004.3.en:
A princess revered by all, a hero returning with honors.
Dreams are blind to status; your harvest grows with every step you take.
Item.221004.3.cn:
众星捧月的公主，荣归故里的勇者。
梦想没有尊卑，行动越多，收获越多。

Item.221005.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.221005.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.221005.3.en:
The sand sea engulfs the horizon, obscuring the journey's end.
It's time to pause and catch your breath.
Item.221005.3.cn:
沙海漫过了远景，让终点模糊起来。
这是在提醒你驻足歇脚的时机。

Item.221006.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.221006.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.221006.3.en:
A sparkling spring kisses your skirt hem, stopping you in your tracks.
Quench your thirst first, then brace yourself for the thorny path ahead.
Item.221006.3.cn:
一汪清泉，沾湿了裙摆，停下了脚步。
务必先止渴，再蹋荆踩棘。

Item.221007.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.221007.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.221007.3.en:
Shimmering stars light up the night sky.
Brave maidens, it's time to embark on your journey!
Item.221007.3.cn:
闪耀的星光，贯彻长空。
勇敢的少女们，是时候踏上路途了！

Item.221008.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.221008.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.221008.3.en:
Gentle starlight, farewell to today.
The bell rings to close today's business!
Item.221008.3.cn:
温柔的星光，告别今日。
钟声已至——今天的营业到此为止！

Item.222001.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.222001.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.222001.3.en:
I can't wait!
I'm desperate to savor my favorite iced black tea, sweetened with sugar, topped with creamy foam, infused with tangerine slices, sprinkled with chocolate crumbs, and blended with pineapple and mango juice!
Item.222001.3.cn:
好期待！
我已经等不及点上一杯我最爱的加糖加奶盖塞橘子片撒巧克力碎加菠萝汁混芒果汁的刨冰红茶了！

Item.222002.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.222002.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.222002.3.en:
Spinning around in circles, vying for the chairs.
Only those who grab a chair get to sit down.
Wait, aren't we playing "Freeze Dance"?
Item.222002.3.cn:
团团转，转圈圈。
抢到椅子的才有资格坐下——
欸，不是在玩「三二一木头人」吗？

Item.222003.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.222003.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.222003.3.en:
To Whom It May Concern,
With admiration for your outstanding dance skills,
you are warmly invited to this never-ending dance party.
Item.222003.3.cn:
敬启：
由于您的舞蹈天分优秀得惹人嫉妒。
特邀您来参加这场舞会——不设散场时间。

Item.222005.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.222005.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.222005.3.en:
Pump up the jam, and keep the dance floor thumpin'!
Let the volume shatter the skies, let our passion ignite the clouds!
My adrenaline has skyrocketed to its absolute limit!
Item.222005.3.cn:
接着奏乐接着舞！
音量突破天际，燃情烧尽云霞！
我已经——飙到极限啦！

Item.222006.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.222006.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.222006.3.en:
At the dawn of creation,
shattered beliefs hovered above the horizon, casting its glow over the world.
Humans leaped over mountains, gazing boldly at the gods.
And then, heaven and earth split, the light dimmed, and days merged into an endless flow.
Item.222006.3.cn:
万物伊始，
破碎信仰盘踞于天际之上，
人类飞跃高山，直视神灵，
而后天地分裂，光消日融。

Item.222007.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.222007.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.222007.3.en:
The wind awakens all creatures and paints the forest with a splash of vibrant colors, whispering the news of the party to every corner of the woods and caves:
The grand celebration of the forest and its elves is about to begin!
Item.222007.3.cn:
穿过森林的风唤醒万物，掀起绚丽的色彩，将派对的消息吹到林间与洞穴：
属于森林与精灵的庆典，马上就要开始了哟。

Item.222008.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.222008.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.222008.3.en:
Keep the joyful moments for yourself.
Embrace it as a break—immerse yourself in this refreshing, fleeting joy.
Item.222008.3.cn:
快乐的时间，要留给自己。
就当是放个假吧——只享受这清爽一刻。

Item.222009.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.222009.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.222009.3.en:
Its grudge still rages within, burning fiercely.
"——! ——————!!"
Alas, it's hard to comprehend its sorrowful cries.
Item.222009.3.cn:
怨恨还在灼烧着它。
「——！——————！！」
可惜，很难听懂它的悲泣。

Item.222010.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.222010.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.222010.3.en:
Once the war horn sounds, there's no going back.
Fight! Fight until the bitter end!
Item.222010.3.cn:
出征的号角一旦响起，就没有退后的余地。
战斗吧！直到最后一刻。

Item.223001.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.223001.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.223001.3.en:
"Isn't a laundry room for washing clothes?"
"Aren't oranges just for eating?"
"What are we doing here?"
"Stop chatting and look at the camera..."
"This is the hottest photo trend right now!"
Item.223001.3.cn:
“洗衣房不是洗衣服的地方吗？”
“橙子不是用来吃的食物吗？”
“我们现在是在做什么啊？”
“别唠叨了，快看镜头吧——”
“这可是当下最流行的拍照方式呢！”

Item.223002.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.223002.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.223002.3.en:
In spring and summer's embrace, petals dance in the air;
in autumn and winter's chill, rain drizzles relentlessly.
The scenes mirrored in your eyes
fluctuate with the changing seasons,
how am I supposed to understand them?
Item.223002.3.cn:
春天夏天，花瓣飞舞，
秋天冬天，阴雨蔓延，
你眼中倒映的景色，
随着季节波动，
我该如何读懂。

Item.223003.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.223003.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.223003.3.en:
On the stage enveloped by cheers, they shine brightly as they play their final melody.
The tumultuous emotions ignite the notes, consuming this night with fiery passion.
Item.223003.3.cn:
被欢呼声包围的舞台上，闪闪发光的她们奏响了最后一曲。
躁动的情绪化为音符的燃料，烧尽了这个夜晚。

Item.223004.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.223004.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.223004.3.cn:
动人而优雅的灰风双月；
睿智和幽默的绝对主角。
黑洞，漆黑的明天在等着你们！

Item.223005.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.223005.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.223005.3.en:
Bammm! The cells are splitting!
Gurgleee! The brains are boiling!
Sliced right from the top,
one me multiplies into a thousand—how do you find the true me?
Item.223005.3.cn:
嘭嘭嘭，细胞要分裂啦！
咕嘟嘟，脑浆都沸腾啦！
从躯壳顶端向下切割，
一份的我、千份的我，要如何分辨真面目呢？

Item.223006.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.223006.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.223006.3.en:
Sinking into the cozy embrace of my soft bed, I find myself utterly unwilling to stir.
If we drift off together, will our dreams intertwine?
Item.223006.3.cn:
躺在软绵绵的床上，就再也不想动弹了——
与她一起安眠的话，我们会梦到彼此吗？

Item.223007.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.223007.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.223007.3.en:
Golden birds flap their wings, splitting the dreamscape as soft as clouds.
In the cracks where memories weave, we will eventually meet the ones we long to see.
Item.223007.3.cn:
金色的飞鸟振动翅膀，分开了柔软如云的梦境。
在回忆蔓延的裂痕里，我们终能遇到想见的人。

Item.223008.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.223008.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.223008.3.en: The scenery along the journey is a gift we should appreciate. Let's take it slow, bring some snacks, and enjoy this bright, sunny break—it'll surely add a joyful chapter to our memories.
Item.223008.3.cn: 沿途的风景是旅行的馈赠，值得我们放缓脚步，带上美食，享受这天朗气清的小憩时光——那一定会在我们的回忆里，留下欢声笑语的一笔。

Item.223009.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.223009.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.223009.3.en: Warm raindrops trickle down from head to toe, sliding down every inch of my skin. Ah—choo! It's not a cold, just the soap bubbles tickling me again.
Item.223009.3.cn: 温暖的雨丝从头顶流至脚底，路过每一寸皮肤。阿...阿嚏，这不是感冒，只是肥皂泡泡又调皮了。

Item.223010.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.223010.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.223010.3.en:
The whirling harbor breeze,
The hot air from the steaming baskets...
As you lean in close, your breath merges with.
The neon-hued vapors, blurring my vision.
Item.223010.3.cn:
旋转翻腾的港口海风，
新鲜出炉的笼屉热气，
你靠近肩头时呼出的吐息，
霓虹色水蒸气迷蒙了眼睛。

Item.223011.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.223011.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.223011.3.en: Beyond the veil of silence and solemnity, is there another side of you that I haven't yet discovered? Electronic-distorted notes peel away the mundane facade, revealing a tender gaze under the neon glow that beckons me toward you.
Item.223011.3.cn: 沉默与严肃之外，是否还有其他的你是我未曾了解的？电子失真的音符揭开名为日常的外衣，霓虹灯笼罩之下，那温柔的视线，正吸引着我向你迈进。

Item.223012.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.223012.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.223012.3.en:
With the earth as our stage and the starry sky as our backdrop,
Listen up, universe—this is our moment to shine!
Item.223012.3.cn:
把大地当做舞台，将星空当做幕布。
——听好了，宇宙，现在开始就是我们的主场！

Item.223013.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.223013.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.223013.3.en:
Dart through fields of wheat and play in maple forests, pausing where the seasons meet.
Oh, sun-kissed child, hide away, before the pains of growing up can find you.
Item.223013.3.cn:
穿过麦田，游乐枫林，在季节交替的路口停下。
太阳色的孩子啊，快快躲起来，不要被成长的烦恼找到。

Item.223014.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.223014.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.223014.3.en:
Tighten the screws, apply the grease.
Behind every great knight is an even greater blacksmith.
Safe travels—and don't ride too fast!
Item.223014.3.cn:
拧紧螺丝，做好润滑。
最棒的骑士背后是最棒的铁匠。
一路顺风，别开太快喔！

Item.223015.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.223015.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.223015.3.en:
I smile often, yet true happiness is a rare guest.
For that scent, once vibrant, now fades and drifts further away.
Yet, whenever I reach for it, there's a stinging pain in my heart...
Item.223015.3.cn:
我经常笑，可我不经常开心。
因为，那香气已越来越淡，越来越远。
可碰触它，却总是令我刺痛……

Item.223016.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.223016.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.223016.3.en:
You've tasted the sweet forbidden fruit,
now you're the goddess of art.
Stand as the sole, ever-blooming rose in this pond of love and desire.
Sing, dance, shine, and repeat.
Keep going till the strings break, never stop.
Item.223016.3.cn:
你已初尝禁果的甜美，
你已化身艺术的女神，
便做这片爱欲池塘上，唯一盛放的不夜蔷薇。
歌唱，舞动，闪耀，重复。
直至提线崩落，别再停下。

Item.223017.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.223017.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.223017.3.en:
Summer wraps up in a blur of sweat, yet there's still time to touch up for the next show.
In the corner of a winter celebration, I score the last ice cream cone before closing.
No matter how life is divided between work and leisure,
I'm still me, whole and unchanged.
Item.223017.3.cn:
盛夏在汗水中结束，还有点时间补妆给下一场演出。
冬日里的庆典角落，买到了打烊前的最后一只甜筒。
工作和生活再怎么切割，
所有的我，依旧是同一个我。

Item.223018.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.223018.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.223018.3.en:
On this eagerly anticipated day,
Standing before the dazzling shelves,
Which beverage holds the most exciting flavor?
If you can't decide,
Why not just take them all~
Item.223018.3.cn:
在期待已久的日子里
在琳琅满目的货架前
哪一罐饮料才是最值得期待的口味
如果无法抉择
那就全部都带走吧~

Item.223019.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.223019.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.223019.3.en:
Shimmering like fragile bubbles, they are dreams woven from pure imagination.
As these dreams burst and their shimmer fades, they uncover the purest truth,
whispering it all in silence.
Item.223019.3.cn:
如泡沫般绚烂而脆弱，那是建立在虚构之上的美梦。
而当美梦消散，所有浮华褪去后，才会在这世间留下最纯粹的证明。
——它们用沉默诉说着一切。

Item.223020.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.223020.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.223020.3.en:
The moment wood splinters flew, a ravenous hunger burst through the door.
"No—get away from my emergency food stash! Aaaaah!"
Item.223020.3.cn:
木屑飞溅的刹那，疯狂的饥饿已破门而入。
“不要——不要抢我的储备粮啊啊啊啊——”

Item.223021.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.223021.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.223021.3.en:
Mirrors never tell lies;
they beckon you in and bid you farewell.
Your fate is inscribed on a particle of drifting dust,
while divine prophecy mirrors itself in my gaze.
Item.223021.3.cn:
镜子从不诉说谎言，
它呼唤你来，送你离开。
你的命运刻印在一粒浮尘之上，
神圣的预言倒映在我的眼里。

Item.223022.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.223022.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.223022.3.en:
Here lies the gateway to the Inferno.
It leads straight to the abyss of sin.
I wait by the riverbank, illuminating your sorrowful journey ahead,
blessing you to plunge into my eternal love.
Item.223022.3.cn:
这里直通炼狱之都，
这里直通罪恶之底。
我在河岸守候，照亮你悲苦的前路，
祝福你沉入我永恒的爱。

Item.223023.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.223023.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.223023.3.en:
You skillfully push open the door,
And her pristine wings bring solace to your aching heart.
Together, you share a serene silence, a peaceful bond just between the two of you.
You know that her silence is her ultimate compassion towards you.
And your visit is the sole redemption she can ever hope for.
Item.223023.3.cn:
你熟练地推开大门，
她至洁的羽翼抚慰了你的伤痛，
你们沉默着，沉默着度过只有两人的恬静时光。
你深知，沉默是她对你最后的垂怜。
而你的来访，是她唯一能获得的救赎。

Item.223024.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.223024.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.223024.3.en:
"Hey, regular! Good to see ya! Your usual?"
"Huh? This seat's for toddlers only?"
"Eh, rules are made to be broken, right? Nobody's watching anyway!"
"Zoning out is adult paradise!"

Perfect vacation goals right here!
Resting on the register, she savors a dream, tart and sweet.
Item.223024.3.cn:
“哟~老主顾，你来啦，今天要点什么？”
“嗯？什么？你说这个位子三岁以下才能坐？”
“唉，有什么关系嘛，反正又没人看见！”
“浑浑噩噩，这才是大人最了不起的放松方式！”

假如拿到年假，一定要这样子放松一回！
趴在收银机上，她今天也邂逅了酸甜的梦。

Item.223025.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.223025.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.223025.3.en:
O little bunny,
close your eyes and drift to sleep,
I'll cradle you in the arms of the night;

O little bunny,
rest your head and dream sweetly,
I promise you the sweetest treat of all.
Item.223025.3.cn:
小兔子啊，
安心睡吧，
我会与夜色一道拥你入怀；

小兔子啊，
乖乖睡吧，
我会为你送上最甘美的奖励。

Item.223026.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.223026.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.223026.3.en:
"La-la-la—welcome home, Master! ♥"
"Whether it's the weariness in your heart or the misfortune at your side,"
"I will personally help you sweep all that nasty trash away!"
"Let me turn my energy into your magic! ♥"
"Heaven's cutest maid, Beatrixa, at your service! ♥"

With a clear, lively voice and an impossibly cute demeanor,
she gave her all every day
to deliver healing and hope to her fans across the Nova Continent.
Item.223026.3.cn:
“哩哩哩——欢迎主人回家~♥”
“无论是主人心灵的疲惫，还是主人身边的不幸。”
“丽丽都会亲手帮助主人，将垃圾先生们完——完全全地清扫干净。”
“把丽丽的活力转化为主人的魔力~♥”
“这里是天界第一可爱的女仆，贝缇丽DA♥YO~！”

清楚灵动的嗓音，朝气蓬勃的姿态，
可爱到不真实的她，今天也在拼劲全力，
向诺瓦大陆上的每一名粉丝们传递着治愈与希望。

Item.224001.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224001.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224001.3.en:
Humans are born alone.
Only in the heat of battle do we truly feel alive.
Huh? Cool guys don't look at explosions? Fine, I heard you—
Item.224001.3.cn:
人就是那样孤独的生物
只能在战斗的时候才能鲜明地感觉到自己的存在 
什么，开炮的时候不准回头看爆炸？ 我知道了啦——

Item.224002.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224002.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224002.3.en:
Like flower petals, your departing form dissolves,
Beneath starlit nights, our vows still warm my palm,
These perfumed days bring thoughts of you, despite my own will.
Item.224002.3.cn:
当你离去，花瓣般消散的背影，
夜幕星尘间，誓约之言仍在掌心，
在香气弥漫的日子里，不情愿也会想起你。

Item.224003.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224003.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224003.3.en:
Upward, upward, ever upward.
Through twelve heavens I soar, your gaze still following.
Not gravity's bond, but a homeward stellar road.
Item.224003.3.cn:
向上，向上，向上。
即使腾跃十二重天，依旧能感受到你的视线。
这绝非引力的束缚，而是星海中归家的航路。

Item.224004.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224004.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224004.3.en:
Look who's here—two little soft kittens on my knee?
Afternoon tea time stretches far.
Sleep soundly. Let purple wisteria shade your beautiful dreams.
Item.224004.3.cn:
哪来的两只小野猫，躺在了我的膝盖上？
下午茶的时间还很长，
安心小憩，在紫藤萝下做一个美丽的梦吧。

Item.224005.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224005.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224005.3.en:
The blossoms drift in rainy haze,
That flowered in bright sunny days.
A rainbow's gleam within my hand—
Could such beauty ever stay?
Item.224005.3.cn:
雨中飘落的花，
盛开于晴空之上。
掬一捧彩虹，
可否停留在我手中。

Item.224006.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224006.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224006.3.en:
The witch stands proud, head held high,
Granting honey, venom, and love divine.
You who failed to choose your princess right,
Embrace this cruel pleasure, and dance with me tonight?
Item.224006.3.cn:
魔女就该高傲地扬起头
赐你蜜，赐你毒，赐你爱
没选好公主的你
接受甜美的凌虐，来和我跳一支舞吧？

Item.224007.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224007.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224007.3.en:
They set the rules of right and wrong,
but if you loathe these bindings, rise as a midnight knight.
Even if bloodied and broken, we're staying true to who we are!
To those arrogant jerks:
"See this mighty fist?"
"After the clock strikes twelve, this is our domain!"
Item.224007.3.cn:
他们规定什么是正确，什么是错误，
如果厌恶这些枷锁桎梏，就成为午夜的骑士。
哪怕最后搞得头破血流，也要活出真正的自己！
对那些自以为是的混蛋说：
“看到这沙包大的拳头没？”
“告诉你们，十二点以后，这里我们说了算！”

Item.224008.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224008.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224008.3.en:
Why chase that distant rainbow on the horizon,
when you can hold these colorful balloons right in your hand?
Soaring through clear skies on the roller coaster ride.
Listen!
The echoes of pure joy just made their way to you!
Item.224008.3.cn:
仰望雨后那道远在天边的彩虹，
不如伸手抓住眼前这束缤纷的气球。
快乐乘着过山车，越过晴空，
听，
这份欢声笑语，已经投递到你身边~！

Item.224009.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224009.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224009.3.en:
Only one day of food left. Our wallets are empty. The Oasis's Grace is running low...
We've staked everything on this Monolith commission...
—Still, when it's time for the group photo, don't forget to smile!
Item.224009.3.cn:
粮食储备仅剩一天，钱包已经见底，“绿洲号”的恩赐不足……
我们的全部，都赌在这趟出征了……
——合影的时候，还是要保持微笑！

Item.224010.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224010.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224010.3.en:
We beseech Thee, have mercy; heed our plea.
Goddess, do the cries of mortals reach Thine ears?
...
—Each word finds Me, finds Us all.
We shall guide humanity towards its glorious destiny.
Item.224010.3.cn:
求祢垂怜我们；求祢俯听我们的祈祷。
神啊，妳听得到人间的声音吗？
……
——我听得见，我们都听得见。
我们将指引世人，走向荣光。

Item.224011.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224011.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224011.3.en:
Before looking back at the start, what seemed the end was just
the start of a new chapter.
Are you happy as you've always dreamed you'd be?
Let's meet again tomorrow.
Item.224011.3.cn:
回望起点之前，错当作终点
故事翻落新章节。
快乐吗？如你千万次设想般
约定明日再相见。

Item.224012.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224012.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224012.3.en:
On United Harvest's grand design, Philae stands as just a single point.
From here, I shall draw a perfect circle, claiming the entire Nova.
—Follow me. Pledge loyalty. March ever onward.
Item.224012.3.cn:
在联合种业的商业版图上，菲莱只是其中的一个点。
而我，则将以此为中心，画出完美的圆，囊括整片大陆。
——追随我，效忠我，永不止步。

Item.224013.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224013.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224013.3.en:
"First, we need a ship, then courage, and lastly, faith."
The adventurer pinned the map
While whitecaps rage from point to point
Wild waters crash and beckon towards mysteries
She waits for kindred souls to sail.
Item.224013.3.cn:
「首先，我们需要一艘船，其次是勇气，然后是信仰。」
冒险者在地图上打下图钉
点与点之间便是旅途的惊涛骇浪
风浪翻涌着指向未知的海域
她在等那敢于同行的人。

Item.224014.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224014.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224014.3.en:
We trekked, picked, and laughed with our friends,
sharing sweet fruit that burst with juice in our mouths.
Item.224014.3.cn:
与朋友们一起跋涉、采摘、欢笑。
分享果实，任由甘美在齿间流淌。

Item.224015.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224015.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224015.3.en:
Deer call softly in the grove, wild grass their sweet feast.
A maiden rests in afternoon shade, where sunbeams dance and weave.
Like wind through time the moments flow, "Click"—a memory to keep.
Item.224015.3.cn:
呦呦鹿鸣，食野之苹。
阳光斑驳的午后，林中少女驻足小憩。
岁月像风一样流转，“咔嚓”，凝固在时光的相片里。

Item.224016.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224016.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224016.3.en:
As dawn arrives to greet the day, the last petal falls.
I search through time's unending flow, for traces lost so long ago.
As sun and moon their cycles keep, and time flows like a river deep,
Through your gaze, forever bright, I'll bloom eternal in your sight.
Item.224016.3.cn:
当清晨来临，最后一片花瓣落下，
我周而复始寻找，流失的痕迹。
日月轮转，光阴更迭，
以你的目光观照，我将永不凋谢。

Item.224017.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224017.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224017.3.en:
Like a human life, fireworks bloom, flourish, and fade—
brief yet brilliant, leaving their unique mark across the night sky.
It's much like a Trekker's endless quest to climb the Monolith,
all for that one day when they might finally hold the stars in their hands...
Item.224017.3.cn:
烟花的绽放、盛开与熄灭，就像人的一生，
短暂而辉煌，在夜空中留下属于自己的印记；
就像旅人不断攀登星塔的冒险，
为了终有一日，能捧起那天上的星星……

Item.224018.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224018.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224018.3.en:
With guilt my heart was heavy worn, to heal the bridge that had been torn.
Thought friendship's door was closed for good,
Till here we sit, just as we should.
New décor graces these old walls, new packages the sweet food calls.
One drink runs hot, one drink runs cold,
Same taste remains from days of old.
Item.224018.3.cn:
曾心怀愧疚，也试过拯救，
以为无法再度交心联手，
终于还是相邀再次对坐。
餐厅换了装潢，点心换了包装，
冷热不同的两款饮品，
入口仍是熟悉味道。

Item.224019.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224019.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224019.3.en:
Kasimira, are you ready?
This is round 37 and our final match for today.

Too bad, just one shot shy.
If that shot had landed, you'd have had me beat.
Chaton, your hand wavered at the critical moment.

Just the thought of besting you gets my adrenaline pumping!
Let's do it again!

Rack the gun, we've got the next commission to prep for.

—Looks like Chaton's challenge isn't over yet.
Item.224019.3.cn:
卡西米拉，准备好了吗？
这是第三十七局，也是今天的最后一局。

可惜了，只差一发。
要是命中，你就能够战胜我。
猫眼，最后的关键时刻，你手抖了。

一想到有机会超越你，我就兴奋了起来！
再来！

把枪放回去吧，我们该去准备下一轮委托了。

——看来，猫眼的挑战仍将继续。

Item.224020.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224020.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224020.3.en:
"Uneventful days aren't worth recording."
"Dull little things aren't worth recording."
"Repetitive work isn't worth recording."
But ... are they truly worthless?
A teammate's reminder before you head out, the wrong turn you took, the smiles and thanks you received...
These ordinary fragments of memory condense into tiny points of light.
Even if the paper turns yellow with time, the brilliance of each day will never be forgotten.
Item.224020.3.cn:
“平淡稀松的日常不值得记录。”
“索然无味的小事不值得记录。”
“繁杂重复的工作不值得记录。”
难道，这一切真的毫无价值吗？
出门前的同伴的叮嘱，不小心走错的岔路，收获的微笑感谢……
看似普通的回忆碎片，凝聚成一个个闪烁的光点。
即便纸张泛黄，也会永远记得熠熠生辉的每一天。

Item.224021.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224021.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224021.3.en:
Friends, companions ... whatever the name, they all embody the same group of souls united by fate. They converge when the threads of fate intertwine, and disperse when they unwind.
What we can do is cherish every fleeting moment of this reunion, laughing and playing with all our hearts, and etching those precious memories deep into our hearts.
And as the hour of parting draws near, we cling to the hope of a future encounter, anticipating the day we shall meet again.
Item.224021.3.cn:
朋友，伙伴……无论如何称呼，它们指的都是同一群因缘分相聚的人，缘至而来，缘尽则散。
我们能做的，就是在这短暂相聚的日子里，尽情欢笑、尽情玩闹，将那份宝贵的回忆烙印在心底。
当离别到来之际，再一次地，心怀对重逢之日的期盼。

Item.224022.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224022.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224022.3.en:
Behold, something looms in the dark.
Listen closely, do you hear those footsteps echoing?
Odd, a sudden shiver runs down my spine.

A faulty projector, an unknown film reel, and eerie visuals flickering...
A Trekker's camp at midnight, an uninvited guest, and an unexpected visitor.
"Meow—"
The silence envelops all. You close the door, but it has already slipped inside.
Item.224022.3.cn:
你看，有什么东西正在靠近
你听，是不是有脚步的声音
奇怪，怎么突然有一阵寒意

故障的显影器，陌生的留影盒，奇怪的影像画面……
夜半的旅人营地，不速之客，意外来访。
“喵——”
四周静悄悄，你关上门，它进来了。

Item.224023.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224023.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224023.3.en:
We had to take a day off now and then.
Escape the gang fights and the daily grind,
step out under a clear sky, and spray paint a rainbow of our own across it.
Item.224023.3.cn:
偶尔也要抽出一天吧。
远离帮派间的争斗，摆脱苦闷的日常，
走进晴空万里，在上面喷绘出我们颜色的彩虹。

Item.224024.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224024.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224024.3.en:
A rope
dangled from a sunlit ledge,
dropping into the long-forgotten ruins.
The girl grabbed it
and rappelled down.
"Hah, just some treasure?
Watch me haul it up!"
Item.224024.3.cn:
一根绳索
从阳光照射的地方出发
通往没落许久的遗迹
少女抓住它
从天而降
“——不就是宝物嘛
看我把它拿上来！”

Item.224026.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224026.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224026.3.en:
Damp hair clung to her back.
Her clothes were a mess, yet the air was stiflingly still.
Carrying a heavy heart, even the falling petals seemed to weigh her down.
As the rain fell endlessly, your silhouette began to blur.
Item.224026.3.cn:
濡湿的发丝，纠缠在身后
衣衫已不整，却无处透风
心烦意乱，连落花都变得沉重
雨不停歇的日子，你的轮廓逐渐模糊

Item.224027.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224027.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224027.3.en:
Brush and ink are her weapons.
On the stretched rice paper,
She weaves her magic, each brushstroke dancing in unconventional places.
This is her realm, a world of enchantment solely under her command.
Item.224027.3.cn:
笔和墨都是她的武器
在铺开的宣纸上
一笔一划，落在不合常规的位置
这是她创造的，独属于她的魔法世界

Item.224028.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224028.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224028.3.en:
A petal without a name or number
drifts into the silent garden,
carrying a blush of crimson and a vision of pure white,
settling into a golden specimen, alongside a vanished dream.
Item.224028.3.cn:
一片没有姓名、编号的花瓣，
飘落在寂静的花园中，
注入绯红的气息，纯白的幻象，
凝固成金黄的标本，连同消逝的梦。

Item.224029.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224029.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224029.3.en:
The Meow God said my treasure would appear in my favorite place.
So I searched every amusement park in the Monoliths.
And finally ... right here, I nabbed this tiny, squishy little thing!
Item.224029.3.cn:
喵喵神说，猫眼的珍宝会出现在她最喜欢的地方。
于是，猫眼大人我便找遍了星塔的所有游乐场。
终于……终于，在这里，抓到了这只小小的，软绵绵的小家伙。

Item.224030.1.en: A Moment in the Afternoon Melody

Item.224030.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224030.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224030.3.en:
The girl burst in with the afternoon sun,
bringing with her the aroma of snacks.
Fries? Grilled fish? Or a loaf of fluffy, warm bread?
You had to grab something
to enjoy this stolen moment of peace.
Item.224030.3.cn:
少女踏着午后的日光闯入
随她一起入侵的还有点心的香气
薯条？烤鱼？还是烤得松软的面包？
你可以选一个
来填充这个忙里偷闲的间隙~

Item.224031.1.en: The Clash of Blade and Axe Melody

Item.224031.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224031.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224031.3.en:
An alarm blared as blade met axe.
The cage shattered, and she plunged into the abyss.
Through the crimson rain, she met your eyes.
Item.224031.3.cn:
刀斧碰撞的瞬间 拉响警报
斩断牢笼之际 堕入深渊 
雨天淋下的深红色 你的眼睛

Item.224032.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224032.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224032.3.en:
Facts captured.
Photos printed.
Story broadcast.
Welcome to the witches' Truth ☆ Dream Factory!
Item.224032.3.cn:
捕捉事实的第一时间；
印出相片的第一时间；
口播报道的第一时间；
欢迎来到，魔女们的真相☆梦工厂！

Item.224033.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224033.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224033.3.en:
Ah, welcome to my ball, my dear patient.
Listen, the music is playing. Come, dance with my collection among these phantom bubbles.
Item.224033.3.cn:
哎呀，欢迎可爱的病人光临我的舞会。
听，音乐已经响起，就在这片泡沫的幻影中与我的藏品们共舞一曲吧~

Item.224036.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224036.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224036.3.en:
Body bound, soul eroded,
even pain masquerades as a mire of salvation.
The fallen priestess still wanders
on a pilgrimage with no answers and no end,
awaiting a righteous one to grant her release.
Item.224036.3.cn:
肉体受缚，内心空蚀，
疼痛也伪装成救济的泥沼。
堕落的圣职者如今仍在徘徊，
在没有答案和终点的朝圣中，
等待着将她解救的义人。

Item.224037.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224037.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224037.3.en:
The children of the Ash District tell a legend:
when despair grips the world and tears loved ones apart,
a green-haired heroine called the "Lord of the Prize Claw" and her brave companions
will lead everyone to catch the last glimmer of hope and reunite with their families.
Item.224037.3.cn:
灰城区的孩子们间，流传着一个传说：
在整个世界陷入绝望与无助，被迫与重要的人分离之时，
名为“娃娃机仙人“的绿发勇者和她勇敢的伙伴们，
会带领众人抓住仅存的希望，重新与家人团聚。

Item.224038.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224038.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224038.3.en:
Floating on a thousand crests,
a translucent, shimmering thing.
Escaping the searing summer heat,
drifting along with the migrating fish.
Item.224038.3.cn:
漂浮于千层浪花间
透明闪烁之物
逃离灼热夏日
乘着游鱼流浪

Item.224039.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224039.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224039.3.en:
I long for the sea breeze to linger, for the waves to remain.
I pray for the sunset to stretch endlessly, for the starlight to never fade.
I wish to share with you alone—a summer that belongs to us.
Item.224039.3.cn:
盼望海风停驻，盼望浪花凝固
祈祷夕阳绵长，祈祷星光永恒
只愿与你独享，我们的专属夏天

Item.224040.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224040.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224040.3.en:
To protect your companions, to summon the courage and become your best self,
strike your fist at the colossal enemy,
and clear the path to a future full of hope.
Item.224040.3.cn:
守护同伴的信念，改变自我的勇气。
朝着庞然之敌挥出拳头——
打开通往明天与希望的道路。

Item.224041.1.en: A Gift for the Journey Melody

Item.224041.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224041.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224041.3.en:
A sleigh full of gifts
guided by the messenger
heading toward the sunrise and its destination
except—
shouldn't reindeer be pulling it?!
Item.224041.3.cn:
满载礼物的雪橇
在使者的指挥下
向着朝阳和目的地前行
只是——
拉动雪橇的不应该是驯鹿吗？！

Item.224042.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224042.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224042.3.en:
Midnight bells chime to welcome the Springseek Festival
as fireworks set the night sky ablaze.
Amid the revelry, the crowd wishes
that there is joy and peace for the days and years ahead.
Item.224042.3.cn:
新春的零点钟声响起
烟花在夜空绽放
人们在热闹中祈愿
愿年年有今日，岁岁有今朝

Item.224043.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224043.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224043.3.en:
Beneath soil steeped in conspiracy and intrigue,
Watchful, calculating gazes interweave.
Something is struggling to break through the earth.
Item.224043.3.cn:
浸润着阴谋与诡计的土壤下
翘望与算计的目光互相交织
有什么正挣扎着破土而出

Item.224044.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224044.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224044.3.en:
The drawn curtains create a cozy, warm retreat.
Her smile is tender,
but the syringe in her hand glints chillingly.
"Don't be afraid. It will be over before you know it."
Item.224044.3.cn:
帷幕隔出暖色的空间
她的笑意温和
指尖的针管却掠过一丝寒芒
“别怕，很快就好了。”

Item.224045.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224045.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224045.3.en:
A fierce wind sends petals swirling through the sky as paper umbrellas snap shut 
Look—within the sea of blossoms, before the formation of parasols 
A slender figure dances gracefully
Is it real… or just a fleeting dream?
Item.224045.3.cn:
强风掀起漫天花雨，纸伞应声收拢
你看，在花海之中，在伞阵之前
纤细的人影翩翩起舞
那到底是真，还是幻梦一场

Item.224046.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224046.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224046.3.en:
Think of it as nothing more than a marvelous Stella Drama.
When we return our present, our trusted friends are still here with us.
Leave the dark Monolith behind. The winter night will pass.
And look: spring's warm sunlight will shine once more upon this city that once thrived.
Item.224046.3.cn:
全然当作是看了一场惊奇的影戏，
回过神来，炉火边仍有信赖的伙伴相随。
走出黑暗的高塔，冬夜终将过去。
看吧，春日的暖阳会重新照耀这片曾经繁荣的都市。

Item.224047.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224047.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224047.3.en:
Sharpen the crease, press firm the wax,
Longing turns to ink upon the page.
A sudden gust sweeps the words away,
Leaving a thousand thoughts ... lighter than the air.
Item.224047.3.cn:
压紧折痕，拓实火漆，
惦念化作纸上的墨迹。
忽而风起，卷去文字与载体，
余下的万千思绪，它比风还轻盈。

Item.224048.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224048.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224048.3.en:
The winter wind carries prayers from afar
The messenger arrives with blessings and gifts
stepping into view as the midnight bells ring
This Snowish Festival gift is for you, who never lost your childish wonder
Item.224048.3.cn:
雪夜的风吹来远方的祷告
使者携着祝福和礼物
在零点的钟鸣声里登场
这份雪愿节的礼物，送给童心未泯的你

Item.224049.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224049.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224049.3.cn:
吹散迷茫，冲向星辰的彼方；
敲响起始的钟声，开启属于我们的冒险。
爱与希望，就在路上；这一程，感谢有你。

Item.224050.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224050.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224050.3.en:
Countless toasts exchanged, endless lofty talks—
visions and dreams only seem real in this fleeting moment.
Yet beyond the light, on the moon's hidden side,
shadows long for a world where dreams can truly exist.
Item.224050.3.cn:
无数的传杯换盏，不尽的高谈阔论，
愿景与畅想仅于此刻可堪一用。
可在那光的背后，月亮的暗面，
影子正期望着梦存在的世界。

Item.224051.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224051.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224051.3.en:
As flowers and water embrace the earth, as stars revolve in search of one another,
all things in this world lean on each other—so let me share your solitude as well.
In the dark depths of space, let me light the starlight that guides you home.
Item.224051.3.cn:
就像花与水拥抱着大地，星与星环绕着追寻，
世间的一切彼此依偎，也请让我分担你的孤寂。
在黑暗的深空中，为你点亮回家的星光。

Item.224052.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224052.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224052.3.en:
Gears lock into place, sparking a universe of wild imagination.
The rabbit unrolls her inspiration list while tweezers and wrenches cobble together absurd inventions.
The girl's pen skips across the blueprints.
And beneath an adorable shell, a dangerous new weapon comes to life.
Item.224052.3.cn:
齿轮嵌合转动，妄想的宇宙开始运行，
兔子展开灵感的清单，镊子和扳手拼接无厘头的创意；
少女的笔尖在图纸上跃动，
可爱的外壳之下，一个新的危险武器诞生。

Item.224053.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224053.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224053.3.en:
Whether after a nerve-wracking, narrow escape from death,
or a candid, grudge‑shattering conversation,
