there is always a joyful, open‑hearted gathering, where people share a meal together, finally letting go of the past.
Looking at everything around her, she suddenly realizes this very moment is what is most worth cherishing.
Item.224053.3.cn:
或是在惊心动魄、死里逃生的行动之后，
或是在推心置腹、冰释前嫌的交谈之后，
总少不了一场敞开心扉的欢聚，让人们在同席共餐之间，彻底放下过往的芥蒂。
望着眼前的人与事，才忽然意识到，最值得珍惜的，正是此时此刻。

Item.224054.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224054.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224054.3.en:
A little paradise that's ours alone,
running with her through the dim lamplight.
Don't be afraid of stumbling—I'll hold your hand tight,
until we make it to the end together.
Item.224054.3.cn:
独属于自己的小小乐园，
和她一起奔走在幽幽的灯下。
不要害怕止步不前，我会永远握紧你的手，
直到我们抵达彼此的终点。

Item.224055.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224055.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224055.3.en:
Sunlight filters through the clear water,
warming the ocean with a gentle glow.
A girl gazes up at the shimmering light—
what lies beyond those ripples?
Item.224055.3.cn:
阳光透过澄澈的水面，
冰凉的海水因此拥有了温度。
水中的少女仰望那一片光斑，
波光粼粼的另一边会是什么呢？

Item.224056.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224056.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224056.3.en:
Broken patterns of light drift across her hair,
as she steps into a flowing stream.
The forest wind follows the sound of insects,
whispering that midsummer has quietly arrived.
Item.224056.3.cn:
斑驳的树影吻过少女的发梢，
目送她走入流动的清泉；
林间的风循着虫鸣而来，
提醒着她盛夏已悄然来临。

Item.224057.1.en: Ride the Waves With Me Melody

Item.224057.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224057.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224057.3.en:
The sea reaches for you with gentle waves.
Every sound joins the celebration in perfect harmony.
With friends by your side and the breeze beneath you,
sail toward summer, toward the sea beyond the horizon.
Item.224057.3.cn:
清波摇曳，海水吻着肌肤，
万籁共鸣，庆典气氛正热。
携友同行，乘在轻风之上，
向着夏日，向着海的彼方。

Item.224058.2.en: Material required for the Crescendo of specific Discs.
Item.224058.2.cn: 特定秘纹突破所需的素材

Item.224058.3.en:
One by one, we count the seasons gone by,
laying yesterday's sorrows to rest.
O summer memories, poured out with every burst of laughter,
may you never be carried away by the tides of time.
Item.224058.3.cn:
掰着手指细数过往的季节，
将昨日的苦涩埋藏在心底。
随欢笑一同倾泄的夏日回忆啊，
请不要随着时间的潮水退去。

Item.23.2.en: A certificate obtained through recruiting Trekkers. Can be exchanged for items in the Shop.
Item.23.2.cn: 旅人招募中获得的凭证，可用于在商店中兑换道具。

Item.23.3.en:
A testament to every distant voyage,
where each stack's thickness whispers tales of delightful encounters.
Item.23.3.cn:
记录了每次远途旅行的凭证。
每一沓厚度，都是某段美好的邂逅。

Item.24.2.en: A certificate obtained through recruiting Trekkers. Can be exchanged for rare items in the Shop.
Item.24.2.cn: 旅人招募中获得的凭证，可用于在商店中兑换稀有道具。

Item.24.3.en:
A testament to extraordinary journeys,
where each miracle represents relentless pursuit.
Item.24.3.cn:
记录了稀有珍贵旅途的凭证。
每一次奇迹背后都是无数次的尝试。

Item.25.2.en: A certificate earned in Trekker Duel. Can be exchanged for items in the Duel Shop.
Item.25.2.cn: 旅人对决中赢取的凭证，用于对决商店兑换道具。

Item.25.3.en:
Bestowed by the Trekker Association, it's a testament to your prowess in Trekker Duel.
Rumor has it that it can unlock hidden options in the Shop.
Item.25.3.cn:
地理协会发放给在旅人对决中证明了自己的强者的证明。
据说可以使用它开启商店中的隐藏选项。

Item.2701001.3.en: Who's dropping in to save the day this time?
Item.2701001.3.cn: 又会是哪位神兵天降呢？

Item.2701002.2.en: A chance to select a random blessing.
Item.2701002.2.cn: 一次随机的祝福选择机会。

Item.2701002.3.en: Fingers crossed for a good draw this time!
Item.2701002.3.cn: 这回总要发个好牌了吧！

Item.28.2.en: A certificate used for unlocking Proving Grounds.
Item.28.2.cn: 用于开启真格挑战的凭证。

Item.28.3.en:
A hunting bounty posted by the Trekker Association.
Be sure to gauge your strength before taking on the hunt.
Item.28.3.cn:
地理协会发布的狩猎悬赏单。
在揭下悬赏单前最重要的一件事，就是掂量掂量自己的斤两。

Item.29.2.en: A pass used to initiate a Monolith Express.
Item.29.2.cn: 用于开启星塔速通的门票。

Item.29.3.en:
Once you have obtained the "Key to the Monolith Stairs," you can use the pass to go straight to the top and snag the ultimate "Record"... Yeah, like luck ever works that way.
You still have to face every single twist and turn. This just saves you a bit of the boring slog.
Item.29.3.cn:
当获知“星梯的密码”后，就能凭着搭乘票一步登天，得到最强的“纪录”……什么的，哪有这种掉馅饼的好事？
该有的运气和麻烦一点都少不了——不过是省下了一些烦闷的过程罢了。

Item.3.2.en: An extremely rare crystal of immense value.
Item.3.2.cn: 非常稀有的水晶体，具有极高的价值。

Item.3.3.en:
A condensed mass imbued with the power of Stellnanite Vein, both hard and clear.
For centuries, it has been revered as the material for crafting Soul Stones, carrying immense value.
Item.3.3.cn:
饱含星脉力量的凝结体，坚硬而清透。
长久以来都被认为是制作心相石的原料，有着贵重的价值。

Item.30.2.en: A pass used to initiate a Monolith Express.
Item.30.2.cn: 用于开启星塔速通的门票。

Item.30.3.en:
Once you have obtained the "Key to the Monolith Stairs," you can use the pass to go straight to the top and snag the ultimate "Record"... Yeah, like luck ever works that way.
You still have to face every single twist and turn. This just saves you a bit of the boring slog.
Item.30.3.cn:
当获知“星梯的密码”后，就能凭着搭乘票一步登天，得到最强的“纪录”……什么的，哪有这种掉馅饼的好事？
该有的运气和麻烦一点都少不了——不过是省下了一些烦闷的过程罢了。

Item.30001.2.en: Grants a small amount of EXP for leveling up Trekkers.
Item.30001.2.cn: 提供少量旅人升级经验。

Item.30001.3.en:
A beginner's guide tailored for novice Trekkers.
Even though it's just a few pages long, reading it will always be beneficial.
Item.30001.3.cn:
为新手旅人准备的入门手册。
虽然只有薄薄几页，但看了总有帮助。

Item.30002.2.en: Grants a moderate amount of EXP for leveling up Trekkers.
Item.30002.2.cn: 提供中量旅人升级经验。

Item.30002.3.en:
A journal filled with handy tips for Trekkers.
Read through a couple, and you'll avoid making mistakes your seniors made.
Item.30002.3.cn:
记载了许多旅人小贴士的日志。
多读几本，就能避开许多前人踩过的坑了。

Item.30003.2.en: Grants a large amount of EXP for leveling up Trekkers.
Item.30003.2.cn: 提供大量旅人升级经验。

Item.30003.3.en:
Each page is packed with reflections and lessons learned.
Its weight signifies not only the memories of the journey, but also the wisdom accumulated.
Item.30003.3.cn:
每一页都写满了悔恨和教训。
沉甸甸的重量，是回忆也是经验。

Item.30004.2.en: Grants tons of EXP for leveling up Trekkers.
Item.30004.2.cn: 提供特大量旅人升级经验。

Item.30004.3.en:
Absorbing knowledge without comprehension is futile; even the finest books deserve repeated perusals.
A true Trekker has every line of their books etched in their memory.
Item.30004.3.cn:
囫囵吞枣的知识不好消化，写的再棒的书也得多读几遍。
一个优秀的旅人总能熟背书里的每句话。

Item.31.2.en: A medal obtained through Cataclysm Survivor. Can be exchanged for items in the Shop.
Item.31.2.cn: 灾变防线中所获得的奖章，可用于在商店中兑换道具。

Item.31.3.en:
A medal awarded to Trekkers who actively fight in the defense front.
With enough badges, you can exchange them at the Association for generous rewards.
—Perhaps this is the kind of currency that truly holds weight in a Trekker's circles.
Item.31.3.cn:
颁发给积极参与防线作战旅人们的奖章。
攒够数量，就能从协会兑换丰富的奖励。
——或许这才是在旅人的社会里更有说服力的货币。

Item.31002.3.en:
A testament to your victory over a mysterious and powerful boss.
"Exactly! If you don't work hard, how can I enjoy this fine wine?"
Item.31002.3.cn:
击败了神秘强大 BOSS 的证明。
「没错！你不努力，我怎么喝上这杯好酒呢！」

Item.31007.3.en:
Proof of having defeated a mysterious and powerful boss.
"You've got to be kidding me. I bet this belongs to someone else!"
Item.31007.3.cn:
击败了神秘强大 BOSS 的证明。
「你在开什么城际玩笑——七成是人家的！」

Item.32000.2.en: A generic material used for Trekker skill upgrades.
Item.32000.2.cn: 用于旅人能力提升的通用材料。

Item.32000.3.en:
For Trekkers, wisdom, skill and experience are more important than strength and magic.
—One can always learn something by playing chess with the more experienced.
Item.32000.3.cn:
对于旅人的实力来说，智慧、技巧与经验，比纯粹的力量和魔法更为重要。
——和前辈们多下下棋总不会有坏处。

Item.32001.2.en: A basic material used for Trekker skill upgrades.
Item.32001.2.cn: 用于旅人能力提升的初级材料。

Item.32001.3.en: Tap the buttons to the rhythm of the music—a game anyone can pick up. It's a fun and effortless way to improve one's coordination, making it a hit among Trekkers.
Item.32001.3.cn: 跟随乐曲拍击按钮——人人都能学会的游戏。跟着音乐就能锻炼协调感，这种省力又愉悦的方式在旅人之间颇为流行。

Item.32002.2.en: An intermediate material used for Trekker skill upgrades.
Item.32002.2.cn: 用于旅人能力提升的中级材料。

Item.32002.3.en:
Step up your game with this challenging hardcore rhythm game. Most people struggle to keep up with so many notes.
But, true virtuosos glide through with seamless elegance.
Item.32002.3.cn:
难度稍有提升的硬派节奏游戏。大部分人面对如此之多的音符都招架不住。
而真正的强者从来都是行云流水。

Item.32003.2.en: An advanced material used for Trekker skill upgrades.
Item.32003.2.cn: 用于旅人能力提升的高级材料。

Item.32003.3.en: Enter the realm of "Boss's Tune," a music game series that pushes the limits. Only those with lightning-fast reflexes or perhaps an extra pair of hands dare to take up the challenge. Could this be the next step in human evolution?!
Item.32003.3.cn: 被称为「魔王乐曲」的系列音乐游戏卡带……只有超越极限的手速，或是干脆多长几只手才能挑战的难度之巅——这就是人类进化的可能性吗！

Item.32011.2.en: A basic material used for Trekker skill upgrades.
Item.32011.2.cn: 用于旅人能力提升的初级材料。

Item.32011.3.en:
Dodge bullets and blast your enemies to smithereens. This game features simple rules, but it significantly sharpens your reflexes.
Trekkers often joke about these games, calling them "Little Butterflies."
Item.32011.3.cn:
躲开子弹，打爆敌人——看上去规则非常简单的游戏，却可以很好的锻炼反应能力。
旅人之间常笑称这些游戏为「小蝴蝶」。

Item.32012.2.en: An intermediate material used for Trekker skill upgrades.
Item.32012.2.cn: 用于旅人能力提升的中级材料。

Item.32012.3.en: As the saying goes, "A little goes a long way," and "Barrage" is a testament to this. It evolves its gameplay purely through escalating difficulty. While ordinary players are still struggling for "survival," geniuses are already shooting for "high scores."
Item.32012.3.cn: 量变会引起质变，「弹幕」游戏就是这样一种纯粹因为难度增加而让玩法变化的游戏——在普通人还在追求「生存」时，天才们已经在想着「高分」了。

Item.32013.2.en: An advanced material used for Trekker skill upgrades.
Item.32013.2.cn: 用于旅人能力提升的高级材料。

Item.32013.3.en:
For all those previous shooter games, Trekkers would always boast, "It's nothing special..." But then "Demon Bee" showed up.
Oh boy, is it a beast! Not a single soul has managed to clear the game without using continues or losing a life.
Could this be the ultimate test of skill?
Item.32013.3.cn:
以往的任何射击游戏，都总有旅人叫嚣「不过如此」……直到「妖蜂」的出现。
它……实在是太难了。难到至今为止，不丢保险、一命通关的人类，仍未曾出现。
或许这才是真正的修行？

Item.32021.2.en: A basic material used for Trekker skill upgrades.
Item.32021.2.cn: 用于旅人能力提升的初级材料。

Item.32021.3.en:
Punch! Kick! Rising Dragon Strike! Knock your enemies off the stage!
This Kung Fu game serves as both a battleground for Trekkers to hone their combat skills and a fantastic outlet for stress relief.
Item.32021.3.cn:
拳！腿！升龙！把敌人揍下擂台！
功夫游戏不仅是旅人们思考战斗技巧的试验场，同时也是个不错的泄压阀。

Item.32022.2.en: An intermediate material used for Trekker skill upgrades.
Item.32022.2.cn: 用于旅人能力提升的中级材料。

Item.32022.3.en: To the masters, "fighting" is the "art of outflanking." In other words, patience often leads to victory—cultivating this hunter's mindset is crucial for protecting Trekkers.
Item.32022.3.cn: 所谓「格斗」，在前辈们眼中是「迂回的艺术」。也即是，能沉住气的往往能得到最终的胜利——锻炼出这种猎手般的心态，能够更好保护旅人们的安全。

Item.32023.2.en: An advanced material used for Trekker skill upgrades.
Item.32023.2.cn: 用于旅人能力提升的高级材料。

Item.32023.3.en:
Mindless attacks won't secure a win. Take the game "Phantom" as an example; there's an opponent who can seamlessly block 15 punches in the blink of an eye.
If you can break through his defense, your combat skills will truly be unparalleled.
Item.32023.3.cn:
无脑出击并不能带来胜利。比如这款名为「鬼神」的游戏里，就有个能在一瞬之间，连续正确地防下 15 次出拳的对手。
要是能突破他的防御，战斗技巧也算神功大成了吧。

Item.33001.2.en: Used to craft random common gifts in Material Crafting.
Item.33001.2.cn: 用于在材料合成中制造成随机的普通礼物

Item.33001.3.en:
Each time a Monolith is explored, Wishing Eggs will appear along with Wishing Boxes and can be used to wish for common Artifacts.
In addition to selling Artifacts to the people of the cities for money, Trekkers sometimes save some "leftovers" for themselves.
Item.33001.3.cn:
每次探索完星塔，总会伴随着许愿盒出现的许愿蛋，可以许愿出常见的神器。
除了把神器卖给城邦人赚钱之外，旅人偶尔也会给自己留一些“余粮”。

Item.33011.2.en: A gift that increases a Trekker's Affinity by 150.
Item.33011.2.cn: 用于赠礼，可提升旅人150点默契。

Item.33011.3.en:
A marvelous Artifact that ignites with just a flick. It's a truly handy tool for Trekkers journeying through the Wilds.
Strictly prohibited in dense forests!
Item.33011.3.cn:
轻轻一拨就能生火的奇妙神器。对于常在荒野的旅人来说是极为便利的道具。
严禁于密林区域使用！

Item.33012.2.en: A gift that increases a Trekker's Affinity by 500.
Item.33012.2.cn: 用于赠礼，可提升旅人500点默契。

Item.33012.3.en:
Equipped with directional nozzles, this Artifact boasts enhanced capacity and firepower, making it perfect for heating food.
Even in the Wilds, you can whip up delicious grilled meat patties that taste just like mom's!
Item.33012.3.cn:
装有定向喷口的点火神器，容量和火力都进一步加大了，足以用来加热食物。
即使在野外，也能做出像妈妈做的那样香甜可口的烤肉排！

Item.33013.2.en: A gift that increases a Trekker's Affinity by 2,000.
Item.33013.2.cn: 用于赠礼，可提升旅人2000点默契。

Item.33013.3.en:
With super-charged firepower and capacity, it can even serve as a weapon to fend off wild beasts.
Be warned, it's banned from all forms of transportation in Nova's cities due to its hazardous nature. Yet, it remains a highly sought-after treasure among Trekkers, chefs, and acrobats!
Item.33013.3.cn:
超级加倍的火力和容量，以至于可以当做驱离猛兽的武器。
它是在诺瓦的任何城市都严禁带上车船的危险品——但也同时是旅人、厨子、杂技演员都争相抢夺的绝妙道具。

Item.33021.2.en: A gift that increases a Trekker's Affinity by 150.
Item.33021.2.cn: 用于赠礼，可提升旅人150点默契。

Item.33021.3.en:
The unveiling of camera Artifact marks another groundbreaking moment in the arts and media landscape.
Some believe capturing a photo steals a part of one's soul, making it a niche hobby.
Item.33021.3.cn:
留影神器的发现，被认为是艺术和媒体行业的又一次变革。
有许多人担心，留影实际上会偷走一部分灵魂——这让留影成了一种小众爱好。

Item.33022.2.en: A gift that increases a Trekker's Affinity by 500.
Item.33022.2.cn: 用于赠礼，可提升旅人500点默契。

Item.33022.3.en: When the Reflective Photo Capturer first emerged, painters cried foul, fearing job loss. But soon, some embraced the change, adopting the title of "Photographist" and carving out a new field.
Item.33022.3.cn: 画家们起初抗议留影器抢了他们的工作，但很快，有些人就把自己的头衔改成了「留影师」，开拓出全新的领域。

Item.33023.2.en: A gift that increases a Trekker's Affinity by 2,000.
Item.33023.2.cn: 用于赠礼，可提升旅人2000点默契。

Item.33023.3.en:
The ultimate dream Artifact for Photographists.
With this, you can capture any fleeting moment from afar, preserving it forever on film...
Still, maybe it's this fleeting nature that gives life its meaning.
Item.33023.3.cn:
留影师们梦寐以求的最强神器。
有了它，就能在千尺开外抓捕到任何一瞬间，让它在底片上永恒……吗？
虽然，生命正因为不永恒才有意义。

Item.33031.2.en: A gift that increases a Trekker's Affinity by 150.
Item.33031.2.cn: 用于赠礼，可提升旅人150点默契。

Item.33031.3.en:
One of the most popular daily Artifacts in the Shop, and a must-have for many female Trekkers.
Before this handy device, Novians would rely on magical spells or simply sitting in warm places to dry their wet hair.
Item.33031.3.cn:
商店最为普及的日用神器之一，也是大多数女性旅人的必备出行用品。
在它出现之前，诺瓦人似乎都是用术式或坐在温暖的地方自然风干来处理湿发。

Item.33032.2.en: A gift that increases a Trekker's Affinity by 500.
Item.33032.2.cn: 用于赠礼，可提升旅人500点默契。

Item.33032.3.en:
An upgraded hair dryer with precise temperature and speed settings, minimizing hair damage.
Just like savoring a glass of fine red wine after a gourmet meal, using this after a refreshing bath takes your relaxation to the next level.
Item.33032.3.cn:
功能更为多样的风枪，能够更精细调节温度和风速，对发质损伤也较小。
就像高档用餐后的红酒，一次舒适的沐浴过后，使用上它之后才算是完整的享受。

Item.33033.2.en: A gift that increases a Trekker's Affinity by 2,000.
Item.33033.2.cn: 用于赠礼，可提升旅人2000点默契。

Item.33033.3.en:
An extremely expensive daily Artifact, exclusive to the boudoirs of aristocrats and legendary stars.
Though boasting powerful functions, the owners often prefer to flaunt it as a status symbol rather than putting it to actual use.
Item.33033.3.cn:
极其昂贵的日用神器，仅出现在名门贵族或传奇偶像艺人的闺房中。
即便功能强大，他们似乎也不热衷于使用，而是将之作为彰显身份的附庸品。

Item.33041.2.en: A gift that increases a Trekker's Affinity by 150.
Item.33041.2.cn: 用于赠礼，可提升旅人150点默契。

Item.33041.3.en: A simple blowing device, compact and easy to carry, but don't expect too much when it comes to its cooling effect.
Item.33041.3.cn: 简易的吹风装置，小巧易携带，相应的是降温效果并不理想。

Item.33042.2.en: A gift that increases a Trekker's Affinity by 500.
Item.33042.2.cn: 用于赠礼，可提升旅人500点默契。

Item.33042.3.en:
A cooling artifact that really makes a splash, but its size and weight make it less portable.
However, it's a potent weapon against the heat and irritability.
Item.33042.3.cn:
在降温效果上较为显著的神器，更大只也更难携带。
至少，它算是对抗焦躁感的有力武器。

Item.33043.2.en: A gift that increases a Trekker's Affinity by 2,000.
Item.33043.2.cn: 用于赠礼，可提升旅人2000点默契。

Item.33043.3.en:
An Artifact that is hailed as the ultimate savior against scorching heat,
It not only rescues any Novian from the deadly grip of blazing summers but also boasts a pivoting function, spreading its benevolent coolness far and wide.
Item.33043.3.cn:
被认为是终于能正面战胜高温的神器。
它不仅能把任意一个诺瓦人从炎炎夏日的致命威胁中拯救出来，甚至还给予了左右摇摆的功能，得以将这份慈悲分享出去。

Item.33051.2.en: A gift that increases a Trekker's Affinity by 150.
Item.33051.2.cn: 用于赠礼，可提升旅人150点默契。

Item.33051.3.en:
Push the button, and it'll radiate a warm, inspiring burst of colored light. Perfect for live performances to ignite the atmosphere!
You're my top pick!
Item.33051.3.cn:
按下按钮，它就能散发温暖而鼓舞人心的彩色光芒。在演出的现场，它就是炒热气氛的最好道具。
——原来你就是我的推！

Item.33052.2.en: A gift that increases a Trekker's Affinity by 500.
Item.33052.2.cn: 用于赠礼，可提升旅人500点默契。

Item.33052.3.en:
Even though not a superstar yet, this raw gem already shines so brightly... Is this what it feels like to grow together?
—You over there, and you over here—I see you all!
Item.33052.3.cn:
尽管未成为巨星，但原石就已如此炫目……这就是陪伴你成长的感觉吗！
——那边的观众，这边的观众，我都看的很清楚喔！

Item.33053.2.en: A gift that increases a Trekker's Affinity by 2,000.
Item.33053.2.cn: 用于赠礼，可提升旅人2000点默契。

Item.33053.3.en:
Even if you've become a megastar, I'll be in the stands, waving the glow stick for you with all my heart once more!
In the instant our eyes meet, that's when magic happens.
Item.33053.3.cn:
即便你已经成为闪闪发光的大明星了，站在遥远看台上的我也会再一次全力挥起代表你的荧光棒！
——目光交汇的时刻，就是奇迹的诞生。

Item.33061.2.en: A gift that increases a Trekker's Affinity by 150.
Item.33061.2.cn: 用于赠礼，可提升旅人150点默契。

Item.33061.3.en:
It's said that placing it beside your bed will summon stars to your dreams.
Did these twinkles traverse the night sky just for us?
Item.33061.3.cn:
听说只要把它放在床头，就能让梦境里出现星星。
这闪烁是跨越了夜空而来的吗？

Item.33062.2.en: A gift that increases a Trekker's Affinity by 500.
Item.33062.2.cn: 用于赠礼，可提升旅人500点默契。

Item.33062.3.en:
Display a moon at home to keep you company.
This mysterious ruler of the night, whose secrets have remained hidden for millennia,
Is both the mirror of the day and a reflection of our souls.
Item.33062.3.cn:
在家中摆上一个月亮充当伴侣吧——
千年未曾明晓的夜幕之主，
是白日的倒影，也是人心的镜面。

Item.33063.2.en: A gift that increases a Trekker's Affinity by 2,000.
Item.33063.2.cn: 用于赠礼，可提升旅人2000点默契。

Item.33063.3.en:
Scholars have yet to fathom the universe,
So the Starry Tyrant grants wisdom from beyond this world,
Crystallizing truth into tangible shapes.
Item.33063.3.cn:
学者尚不能通晓宇宙，
星之僭主便恩施此世之外的智慧，
真理最终凝结于有形。

Item.33071.2.en: A gift that increases a Trekker's Affinity by 150.
Item.33071.2.cn: 用于赠礼，可提升旅人150点默契。

Item.33071.3.en: Escape the scorching heat of summer with a delightful bowl of refreshing crushed ice!
Item.33071.3.cn: 炎炎夏日，快来做一碗爽口的碎碎冰给身体降温吧！

Item.33072.2.en: A gift that increases a Trekker's Affinity by 500.
Item.33072.2.cn: 用于赠礼，可提升旅人500点默契。

Item.33072.3.en: Wandering the streets on a lazy afternoon, I passed by an ice cream shop with inviting chill, dreaming of sharing a sweet treat with you on my next visit.
Item.33072.3.cn: 午后在街上闲逛，经过冷气充足的冰淇淋店时，幻想下次经过这里时和你一同品尝。

Item.33073.2.en: A gift that increases a Trekker's Affinity by 2,000.
Item.33073.2.cn: 用于赠礼，可提升旅人2000点默契。

Item.33073.3.en:
I've finally asked you out. The "Buy One, Get One Half Off" deal was just my excuse.
My favorite flavor? Same as yours!
Item.33073.3.cn:
终于向你发出了邀请，“第二杯半价”的活动，只不过是我的借口。
——我最喜欢的口味，其实和你一样啦！

Item.33081.2.en: A gift that increases a Trekker's Affinity by 150.
Item.33081.2.cn: 用于赠礼，可提升旅人150点默契。

Item.33081.3.en: This uniquely shaped tea bowl is said to attract purring mystical beasts when placed at your doorstep. The more delicious the food inside, the more cracks will appear on its surface—greedy beasts often knock it over in their haste.
Item.33081.3.cn: 造型独特的茶碗，据说放在家门口可以吸引喵喵叫的神兽，碗中盛放的食物越美味，碗上裂纹的数量越多——馋嘴的神兽常常会不小心打翻它。

Item.33082.2.en: A gift that increases a Trekker's Affinity by 500.
Item.33082.2.cn: 用于赠礼，可提升旅人500点默契。

Item.33082.3.en: A treasured heirloom passed down through generations, delicately crafted with intricate designs of azure blossoms on its pristine white glaze. Whenever esteemed guests visit, the enthusiastic Loong retrieves it from the wooden cabinet to brew a cup of warm tea.
Item.33082.3.cn: 代代相传的珍藏品，造型精巧，素白釉面上绘以青蓝色飞花图样。每当家中有重要的客人来访，热情的龙裔会从木柜中将它取出，为客人泡上一杯温热的茶。

Item.33083.2.en: A gift that increases a Trekker's Affinity by 2,000.
Item.33083.2.cn: 用于赠礼，可提升旅人2000点默契。

Item.33083.3.en: This kettle pulses with enigmatic energy. It looks like It's made of glass, but It's actually crafted from a special material, making it robust enough to withstand any harsh environment. Whether it holds a life-saving antidote or a mesmerizing poison is entirely up to the whim of its maker.
Item.33083.3.cn: 蕴藏着神秘力量的药壶，尽管外表看似是玻璃制品，实际上由特殊材质打造而成，可以在各类恶劣环境中使用。至于壶中盛放的是救人一命的解药还是摄人心魂的毒药，全凭制作者的心情。

Item.33901.2.en: Grants a common gift of your choice.
Item.33901.2.cn: 可以在所有的普通礼物中任选一件获取。

Item.33901.3.en: Wanna give a little surprise to your closest companion? Pick one from these lightweight and practical artifacts—they're perfect gifts for Trekkers!
Item.33901.3.cn: 想给亲密无间的伙伴一些小惊喜？在这些轻巧实用的神器里挑选一件，作为旅人的赠礼是最合适的选择！

Item.33902.2.en: Grants an exquisite gift of your choice.
Item.33902.2.cn: 可以在所有的精美礼物中任选一件获取。

Item.33902.3.en: How to express your heartfelt gratitude and blessings? Pick an elegant and exquisite artifact here as a symbol of your unspoken bond!

Item.35000.2.cn: 用于旅人纹章重置时锁定词条的特殊素材。

Item.35000.3.en: An emblem shines with a different hue when you polish it again.
Item.35000.3.cn: 重新抛光纹章的话，纹章就会闪烁另一重别样的光芒。

Item.35001.2.cn: 用于旅人纹章提升的素材。

Grace Imperium occasionally pays for their commissions with this.

Item.35001.3.cn:
完成恩赐意志的委托后，偶尔会用这种方式收到报酬。
大公司自己印的“饭票”，总也是能花出去的吧？

Item.35002.2.cn: 用于旅人纹章提升的素材。

Item.35002.3.en:
Trekker Association occasionally pays for their commissions with this.

Item.35002.3.cn:
完成地理协会的委托后，偶尔会用这种方式收到报酬。
旅人间口耳相传的名声，比金钱、职位更宝贵。

Item.35003.2.cn: 用于旅人纹章提升的素材。

Item.35010.3.cn: 受恩赐之神眷顾的圣洁之水，经它洗礼的物件总会闪耀更灿烂的辉光——不过要切记，仪式的机会是有限的。

Item.36.2.en:
During the event, you get three challenge attempts per day.
Each attempt gives you a 60-minute window to enter as many battles as you can.
Simulation battles don't consume any Showdown Decree.
After the challenge period ends, you can no longer use Showdown Decree to start new challenges, but any ongoing challenge can still be completed normally.
Item.36.2.cn:
活动期间，每天可获得三次挑战机会。
每次挑战开始后获得60分钟的战斗时间，期间可发起多次战斗。
模拟战不消耗决战号令。
挑战截止后不可消耗决战号令发起新的挑战，进行中的挑战仍可正常完成。

Item.37.2.en: A certificate obtained through Operation: Shadow Siege. Can be exchanged for items in the Shop.
Item.37.2.cn: 「猎影合围」中获得的凭证，可用于在商店中兑换道具。

Item.37.3.en: A Guild medal of appreciation for pioneer Trekkers—those who always answer the hunt or lead the first wave of investigation.
Item.37.3.cn: 协会特用于赞赏那些总是积极响应围猎，或总是最先发起调查的先锋旅人们的奖章。

Item.4.3.cn:

Item.73101.3.en: How many of these squid rice crackers she made can you eat in one go?

Item.73102.3.en: Provided by an anonymous arcade enthusiast. It's said that collecting 777 of them can summon a real "Lord"?
Item.73102.3.cn: 由某位不愿意透露姓名的游戏厅爱好者提供。据说集齐777个可以召唤真正的仙人……？

Item.73103.2.en: Currency earned via active participation in the Beyond the Dream event. Can be used to redeem items in the Event Shop.
Item.73103.2.cn: 「梦的彼岸」活动中积极参与获得的代币，可用于在活动商店中兑换道具！

Item.73103.3.en: Food prepared by Kaede for battles against monsters. Stuffed with vegetables, it tastes refreshing while offering good nutrition.
Item.73103.3.cn: 枫为支援魔物讨伐战准备的食物，内含注重营养平衡的蔬菜馅料，风味清爽。

Item.73104.2.en: Currency earned via active participation in [Radiant Messenger, Holy Night Spirit]. Can be used to redeem items in the Event Shop.
Item.73104.2.cn: 「闪耀的使者与圣夜的精灵」活动中积极参与获得的代币，可用于在活动商店中兑换道具！

Item.73104.3.en: A traditional Snowish Festival treat baked in the shape of a person. It often stars as the hero in children's dream adventures.
Item.73104.3.cn: 雪愿节的传统食物，特意制作成了人形的轮廓——它经常成为孩子们梦境中的冒险主角。

Item.73105.2.en: Currency earned via active participation in the Miracle of a Flicker event. Can be used to redeem items in the Event Shop.
Item.73105.2.cn: 「微火的奇迹」活动中积极参与获得的代币，可用于在活动商店中兑换道具！

Item.73105.3.en: Please submit all paper receipts to the Finance Department by the deadline. Late submissions will not be reimbursed.
Item.73105.3.cn: 请各位员工将需要付款的纸质单据在规定时间内交到财务部，逾期不予报销。

Item.73106.2.en: Currency earned via active participation in the Crackling Hint of Spring event. Can be used to redeem items in the Event Shop.
Item.73106.2.cn: 「烟火绮丽寻春意」活动中积极参与获得的代币，可用于在活动商店中兑换道具！

Item.73106.3.en:
Loong's signature cuisine. Excessive consumption may lead to weight gain.
—A word of advice from your doctor.
Item.73106.3.cn:
龙裔的特色美食，一次吃多的话会有体重增长的可能性。
——来自医生的忠告。

Item.73107.2.en: Currency earned via active participation in the Winter Requiem and the Trigger of Dawn event. Can be used to redeem items in the Event Shop.
Item.73107.2.cn: 「冬夜镇魂曲与破晓扳机」活动中积极参与获得的代币，可用于在活动商店中兑换道具！

Item.73107.3.en: Vital supply found within the frozen city. It tastes so much better when heated.
Item.73107.3.cn: 在冰封的城市内找到的重要物资，有加热条件的话能让口感更上一个层次。

Item.73108.2.en: Currency earned via active participation in the To My Dearest You event. Can be used to redeem items in the Event Shop.
Item.73108.2.cn: 「敬启，致珍重的你」活动中积极参与获得的代币，可用于在活动商店中兑换道具！

Item.73108.3.en: A gleaming feather that belongs to none other than the fabled "mail-stealing monster"...
Item.73108.3.cn: 闪闪发光的羽毛，它的主人正是传闻中的“偷信魔物”……

Item.73109.2.en: A token earned through active participation in the Solitary Waltz in Night's Embrace event. Can be exchanged for items in the event shop!
Item.73109.2.cn: 「幽夜独舞孤影乱」活动中积极参与获得的代币，可用于在活动商店中兑换道具！

Item.73109.3.en: Don't open this beautifully wrapped letter so casually—it might be a trap.
Item.73109.3.cn: 不要轻易拆开这封包装精美的来信——它说不定是个陷阱。

Item.73110.2.en: Currency earned via active participation in the Framing the Feelings Unseen event. Can be used to redeem items in the Event Shop.
Item.73110.2.cn: 「穿透心壁的取景框」活动中积极参与获得的代币，可用于在活动商店中兑换道具！

Item.73110.3.en: Complete a mission and you'll get a sticker. Be a good kid and do what the grown-ups say!
Item.73110.3.cn: 完成一个任务，奖励一张贴纸。乖乖听大人的话，当个好孩子！

Item.73111.2.en: Currency earned via active participation in the Heartbeat! Neo-Inspired Rhapsody event. Can be used to redeem items in the Event Shop.
Item.73111.2.cn: 「心跳！柔光狂想曲」活动中积极参与获得的代币，可用于在活动商店中兑换道具！

Item.73111.3.en: These are unused parts after assembling the machine according to the blueprint... Well, if the machine runs properly, it should be fine... right?
Item.73111.3.cn: 按照图纸组装后没用上的设备零件……这，机器能顺利启动的话，应该问题不大？

Item.73112.2.en: Currency earned via active participation in the A Sandstorm of Gunfire event. Can be used to redeem items in the Event Shop.
Item.73112.2.cn: 「枪林弹雨覆黄沙」活动中积极参与获得的代币，可用于在活动商店中兑换道具！

Item.73112.3.en: Special ammunition infused with dark energy. It can only be fired from Chaton' sniper rifle and is extremely precious. Try to make every shot count.
Item.73112.3.cn: 蕴含着黑暗之力的特殊弹药，只能由猫眼的狙击步枪发射，十分的珍贵……希望能省着点打。

Item.73113.2.en: Currency earned via active participation in the event: Sunlit Breeze, Azure Seas: Checking In for A Cozy Summer~. Can be used to redeem items in the Event Shop.
Item.73113.2.cn: 「晴风碧海 · 悠哉盛夏依然打卡~」活动中积极参与获得的代币，可用于在活动商店中兑换道具！

Item.73113.3.en: When the tide recedes, the sea leaves behind its gifts. Press close and listen. You can still hear the seaside summer.
Item.73113.3.cn: 潮水退去后，大海留下它的馈赠。贴近耳畔，仍能听见那个充斥着海风味道的夏日。

Item.73114.2.en: Currency earned via active participation in the Surfing Splash: A Sparkling Holiday Adventure! event. Can be used to redeem items in the Event Shop.
Item.73114.2.cn: 「欢歌劲浪 · 闪耀假日惊涛探险！」活动中积极参与获得的代币，可用于在活动商店中兑换道具！

Item.73114.3.en: The moment the marble hits the bottom of the bottle, the summer heat and all those petty worries fade away with the rising bubbles.
Item.73114.3.cn: 当弹珠坠入瓶底的瞬间，恼人的暑气与琐碎的烦忧，都随着气泡悄然消散。

Item.73201.2.en: Currency earned via active participation in the Call for Best Records event.
Item.73201.2.cn: 「攻略纪录大征集」活动中积极参与获得的道具！

Item.73201.3.en: A banner sent by the Trekker Association to recognize Trekkers who have fully explored the Monolith and contributed Records—"All for one, one for all."
Item.73201.3.cn: 地理协会为表彰充分探索星塔并留下攻略纪要的旅人送出的旌旗——人人为我，我为人人。

Item.73202.2.en: Item earned via active participation in the Bouncing Bumper Bash event!
Item.73202.2.cn: 「缭乱碎晶球」活动中积极参与获得的道具！

Item.73202.3.en:
Tokens distributed to honor combatants who made outstanding contributions to Planetary Defense.
"Dedicate your hearts to the United Council!"
Item.73202.3.cn:
为了表彰所有在星球保卫战中做出卓越贡献的战斗员而分发的代币。
“为了联合理事会，献出你的心脏！”

Item.74201.2.en: An item used to support streamers in "Summit Show." Grants +1 Popularity and +1 Fan Club EXP when used.
Item.74201.2.cn: 「巅峰秀场」活动中用于打赏主播的道具，使用后可提升直播间1点热度并获得1点粉丝团经验。

Item.74201.3.en:
Show your love for your favorite streamer! 
A small investment… for a chance at something legendary!
Item.74201.3.cn:
为你最喜欢的主播，点燃你的小小热情！
——小小投入，邂逅历史性机遇！

Item.74202.2.en: An item used to support streamers in "Summit Show." Grants +10 Popularity and +10 Fan Club EXP when used.
Item.74202.2.cn: 「巅峰秀场」活动中用于打赏主播的道具，使用后可提升直播间10点热度并获得10点粉丝团经验。

Item.74202.3.en:
Gift your favorite streamer a fragrant bouquet! 
Not yesterday, not tomorrow—right now!
Item.74202.3.cn:
为你最喜欢的主播，献上一束馥郁浓香的鲜花！
——不是昨天，不是明天，就在今天！

Item.74203.2.en: An item used to support streamers in "Summit Show." Grants +50 Popularity and +50 Fan Club EXP when used.
Item.74203.2.cn: 「巅峰秀场」活动中用于打赏主播的道具，使用后可提升直播间50点热度并获得50点粉丝团经验。

Item.74203.3.en:
Launch a massive rocket for your favorite streamer! 
Let your voice echo across the world!
Item.74203.3.cn:
为你最喜欢的主播，打出一发震彻寰宇的大火箭！
——跨越山海，让世界听到我们的声音！

JointDrillAffix.10001.2.en: The boss gains an Echo Codex that dissipates after taking a certain number of hits. When the boss casts certain skills, the Echo Codex casts similar skills.
JointDrillAffix.10001.2.cn: 首领敌人拥有「回响魔典」，「回响魔典」在受到一定次数的伤害后消散。「回响魔典」会在首领敌人施放特定技能时施放相似的技能

JointDrillAffix.10002.2.en: The boss gains a Record Codex that dissipates after taking a certain number of hits but revives after some time. When the boss casts certain skills, the Record Codex records similar skills and casts them later.
JointDrillAffix.10002.2.cn: 首领敌人拥有「记录魔典」，「记录魔典」在受到一定次数的伤害后消散，并在一定时间后复活。「记录魔典」会在首领敌人施放特定技能时记录相似的技能，并随后施放已经记录的技能

JointDrillAffix.10003.2.en: The boss initially has high DMG Resistance. Each Echo Codex or Record Codex removed lowers the boss's DMG Resistance.
JointDrillAffix.10003.2.cn: 首领敌人初始拥有高额伤害减免，己方每清除1个「回响魔典」或「记录魔典」，可以降低首领敌人的伤害减免

JointDrillAffix.10004.2.en: Each time a friendly unit deals DMG to the boss, increases the boss's DMG Taken for a short period.
JointDrillAffix.10004.2.cn: 己方每次对首领敌人造成伤害时，会使首领敌人在短时间内受到的伤害增加

JointDrillAffix.10005.2.en: The boss summons multiple Echo Codices to continuously channel energy. The fewer Echo Codices remaining when the channeling ends, the weaker the attacks from the boss.
JointDrillAffix.10005.2.cn: 首领敌人召唤多个「回响魔典」持续引导能量，引导结束时「回响魔典」数量越少，首领敌人形成的攻击越弱

JointDrillAffix.10006.2.en: The boss summons the Record Codices on the battlefield and absorbs them. The more Record Codices absorbed, the stronger the boss's attacks will become.
JointDrillAffix.10006.2.cn: 首领敌人召集场地内的「记录魔典」并吸收，吸收的「记录魔典」越多，首领敌人形成的攻击越强

JointDrillAffix.10007.2.en: The boss gains an Echo Codex that takes much less Auto Attack DMG. When the boss casts certain skills, the Echo Codex casts similar skills.
JointDrillAffix.10007.2.cn: 首领敌人拥有「回响魔典」，「回响魔典」受到的普攻伤害大幅降低。「回响魔典」会在首领敌人施放特定技能时施放相似的技能

JointDrillAffix.10008.2.en: The boss gains a Record Codex that takes much less Auto Attack DMG and revives after some time. When the boss casts certain skills, the Record Codex records similar skills and casts them later.
JointDrillAffix.10008.2.cn: 首领敌人拥有「记录魔典」，「记录魔典」受到的普攻伤害大幅降低，并在一定时间后复活。「记录魔典」会在首领敌人施放特定技能时记录相似的技能，并随后施放已经记录的技能

JointDrillAffix.10009.2.en: After a friendly unit deals damage to the boss a certain number of times, it increases the damage the boss takes for a short period.
JointDrillAffix.10009.2.cn: 己方对首领敌人造成一定次数的伤害后，会使首领敌人在短时间内受到的伤害增加

JointDrillAffix.10010.2.en: When a friendly unit is on yellow or blue tiles, this unit's DMG to same-color bosses is greatly reduced.
JointDrillAffix.10010.2.cn: 己方单位处于黄/蓝色棋盘格内时，该单位对颜色相同的首领伤害大幅降低

JointDrillAffix.10011.2.en: When a friendly unit is on yellow or blue tiles, this unit's DMG to opposite-color bosses is significantly increased.
JointDrillAffix.10011.2.cn: 己方单位处于黄/蓝色棋盘格内时，该单位对颜色不同的首领伤害大幅提升

JointDrillAffix.10012.2.en: Certain boss skills can change the color of specific tiles on the board.
JointDrillAffix.10012.2.cn: 首领的部分技能会改变棋盘内指定格子的颜色

JointDrillAffix.10013.2.en: Upon the defeat of either boss, the battle permanently enters the second phase. Players will face the remaining boss alone on a newly manifested chessboard.
JointDrillAffix.10013.2.cn: 任意一名首领被消灭后，战斗将永久进入第二阶段，玩家将在新的棋盘上单独面临另一名首领

JointDrillAffix.10014.2.en: In the second phase, prioritize neutralizing the Flaming Lanterns. Their explosions will color massive tiles across the board.
JointDrillAffix.10014.2.cn: 在第二阶段，请积极处理「燃灯」，它们会在爆炸后大范围染色

JointDrillAffix.10015.2.en: In the first phase, the boss summons extra Flaming Lanterns.
JointDrillAffix.10015.2.cn: 首领在第一阶段将会召唤额外的「燃灯」

JointDrillAffix.10016.2.en: Chess Piece: Mortar fires projectiles directly at the target. Chess Piece: Knight targets an enemy Soldier and performs a leaping trample attack.
JointDrillAffix.10016.2.cn: 棋子·迫击炮使用直线炮弹攻击目标；棋子·骑士瞄准对方召唤出来的棋子·士兵，进行跳跃踩踏攻击

JointDrillAffix.10017.2.en: Chess Piece: Mortar fires parabolic projectiles at the target. Chess Piece: Knight scans all tiles within a "knight's move" (L-shaped) range, selects the tile closest to the target, and performs a leaping trample attack.
JointDrillAffix.10017.2.cn: 棋子·迫击炮使用抛物线炮弹攻击目标；棋子·骑士获取自身周边所有日字格对角线格子，并选中距离目标最近的格子，进行跳跃踩踏攻击

JointDrillControl.510001.2.en:
She wears fear as her etiquette and feeds despair with paranoia.
In her repertoire, she performs the most ancient of nightmare.
JointDrillControl.510001.2.cn:
将恐惧当成礼仪，以偏执滋养绝望。
她的剧目里，演绎着最为古老的噩梦。

JointDrillControl.510001.3.en:
During A Finale Echoing, you get 3 challenge attempts per day. You can choose any unlocked difficulty, and rewards include tokens and ranking points.

Each challenge phase lets you deploy multiple squads across several rounds, but Trekkers cannot be used in more than one squad.

Winning grants points based on difficulty and battle time. Even if time runs out or all attempts are used, you'll still earn points.

Accumulate points throughout the event to claim Mission Rewards.
JointDrillControl.510001.3.cn:
在终焉绝响活动开启期间，每天有三次挑战机会，可选择任意已解锁的难度进行挑战，并基于战斗结果获得代币以及排名积分。
挑战将持续一段时间，在此时限内可以派遣多个行动队进行多轮次战斗，但是每个行动队内的旅人不可重复出战。
战斗胜利时将根据挑战难度以及战斗时长获得积分。时长耗尽或是战斗次数耗尽时同样可以结算并获得一定积分。
每个活动周期通过积累积分可以领取任务奖励。

During A Finale Echoing, you get 3 challenge attempts per day. You can choose any unlocked difficulty, and rewards include tokens and ranking points.

Each challenge phase lets you deploy multiple squads across several rounds, but Trekkers cannot be used in more than one squad.

Winning grants points based on difficulty and battle time. Even if time runs out or all attempts are used, you'll still earn points.

Accumulate points throughout the event to claim Mission Rewards.
JointDrillControl.510006.3.cn:
在终焉绝响活动开启期间，每天有三次挑战机会，可选择任意已解锁的难度进行挑战，并基于战斗结果获得代币以及排名积分。
挑战将持续一段时间，在此时限内可以派遣多个行动队进行多轮次战斗，但是每个行动队内的旅人不可重复出战。
战斗胜利时将根据挑战难度以及战斗时长获得积分。时长耗尽或是战斗次数耗尽时同样可以结算并获得一定积分。
每个活动周期通过积累积分可以领取任务奖励。

MailTemplate.90001.3.en:
Hello there, renowned Tyrant!
We have prepared a questionnaire to better understand your gaming experience in this beta test and to improve the quality of the game. You can find and participate in the questionnaire through "Questionnaire" at the bottom.
Once you've completed the questionnaire, you will receive [Stellanite Dust x100]. Your feedback and suggestions during the beta test are highly appreciated, and we look forward to joining you on your adventure across Nova Continent as you make your wishes come true!
MailTemplate.90001.3.cn:
尊敬的魔王大人:
为了更加了解您在本次测试中的游戏体验，进一步提升游戏品质，我们在此准备了一份问卷，您可以通过下方「前往问卷」参与填写。
完成问卷后可获得【星之砂*100】。我们非常重视您在本次体验中的反馈和建议，希望可以与您一起，在诺瓦大陆登塔摘星，实现愿望！

MainSkill.401501.2.en:
Increases the Skill DMG of Ventus Support Trekkers in the squad by {1}</color>.
When any Ventus Support Trekker deals Skill DMG, inflicts Flowing Fragrance on the target, up to {2} stacks.
When any Ventus Support Trekker deals Skill DMG to a target with max stacks of Flowing Fragrance, removes all stacks and inflicts the following effects on the target: Increases the Skill DMG Taken by the target by {3}</color> for {4}s, up to {5} stacks.
MainSkill.401501.2.cn:
队伍中风系援护角色技能伤害提升{1}</color>。

MallMonthlyCard.monthlyCard.small.2.en:
[Everbright Wishes: Stardust Details]

1. Purchase to immediately receive 600 Stellanite Lumina and activate a 30-day duration.

2. While active, logging in each day grants 150 Stellanite Dust and 1 Bottled Vigor Soda.

3. If your remaining duration is 180 days or less, purchasing again will extend the time cumulatively.

4. The maximum duration is 210 days. If you already have more than 180 days left, you cannot purchase again.

5. Missed daily rewards will not be compensated.

5. 在激活期间因未登录而未能领取的奖励不会进行补发

MiningTreasure.1001.2.en: As sand is brushed away, time stands still.
MiningTreasure.1001.2.cn: 拂去沙砾，岁月在此驻足。

MiningTreasure.1002.2.en: Beneath its pure luster lies a heart of utmost sincerity.
MiningTreasure.1002.2.cn: 纯净的光泽下，包裹着一颗赤诚的心。

MiningTreasure.1003.2.en: A frozen wave, a silent song of the ocean.
MiningTreasure.1003.2.cn: 一株凝结的浪花，一首静谧的海洋之歌。

MiningTreasure.1201.2.en: A relic from an ancient kingdom, fragments of its iron-bound body now buried in the soil.
MiningTreasure.1201.2.cn: 来自古代王国的遗产，钢铁之躯的碎片埋藏在泥土之中。

MiningTreasure.1202.2.en: A relic from an ancient kingdom. In the fine, intricate details of the gear, one can almost glimpse the brilliance of the civilization that forged it.
MiningTreasure.1202.2.cn: 来自古代王国的遗产，从齿轮的精密细节处，似可窥见过去文明的辉煌。

MiningTreasure.1203.2.en: The puppet-making craft has long been lost. But with a core like this, perhaps one day one could recreate it...
MiningTreasure.1203.2.cn: 制造傀儡的技术本已失传，但有了核心，或许有朝一日能让它重现天日……

MiningTreasure.1301.2.en: A Ritual of Mysterious Origin: Tossing a coin into the greenhouse is said to boost the approval rate for project proposals.
MiningTreasure.1301.2.cn: 不知何时起流行的仪式：在花房中丢下一枚硬币，能提高工作方案的通过率。

MiningTreasure.1302.2.en: Coins just weren't enough anymore. Employees seem convinced that tossing larger bundles of cash guarantees their proposals will be accepted.
MiningTreasure.1302.2.cn: 员工已不满足于扔硬币许愿，似乎笃信钱撒得越多，越能保证自己的方案通过。

MiningTreasure.1303.2.en: Company Notice: Stop wasting money on superstitions. Buy some Pep Pep Juice and put in some honest overtime instead.
MiningTreasure.1303.2.cn: 公司辟谣：与其寄希望于传说，不如把钱花在能量沛沛上，好好加班。

MiningTreasure.1401.2.en: A ferry ticket discarded in the woods. It was once valid for travels between Port Bellin and Sailstead.
MiningTreasure.1401.2.cn: 被随手丢弃在森林的，在贝林港与塞尔斯泰间往来的通勤船票。

MiningTreasure.1402.2.en: These silver coins can sometimes be found on the beach or in the water. Sailors love to skip stones with them.
MiningTreasure.1402.2.cn: 在沙滩或者海水中偶尔会找到这种银币，水手们很喜欢用它来打水漂。

MiningTreasure.1403.2.en: An Artifact designed for measuring objects. It's durable, compact, and easy to carry.
MiningTreasure.1403.2.cn: 用于测量物体尺寸的神器，优点是结实耐用，小巧轻便，可以随身携带。

MiningTreasure.2202.2.cn: 曾属于某个探险家的遗失物，残破的碎片上仅留下模糊的图纹字迹。

MiningTreasure.2203.2.en: Once belonged to an adventurer, this lost pocket watch is engraved with constellations across its dial. It is beautifully crafted and remarkably well preserved.
MiningTreasure.2203.2.cn: 曾属于某个探险家的遗失物，表盘刻有星座符号，样式精美，保存完好。

MiningTreasure.2301.2.en: A generic rock found all over the greenhouse. It's a notorious tripping hazard for employees rushing to clock in on time.
MiningTreasure.2301.2.cn: 花房里随处可见的石头，经常绊倒赶着去打卡的员工。

MiningTreasure.2302.2.en: An empty can tossed carelessly aside. The Greenhouse Manager has filed countless complaints about this litter.
MiningTreasure.2302.2.cn: 喝完被随手扔在花房里的饮料罐，花房管理员已不止一次投诉此事。

MiningTreasure.2303.2.en: Announcement: Littering is strictly prohibited. It is everyone's duty to uphold the company's image.
MiningTreasure.2303.2.cn: 公司声明：严禁员工乱扔垃圾，维护公司形象，人人有责。

MiningTreasure.2401.2.en: A twig snapped underfoot by someone passing through the woods. It still has fresh leaves clinging to it.
MiningTreasure.2401.2.cn: 被踏足林间的人们压断的枝条，上面还挂着嫩叶。

MiningTreasure.2402.2.en: A sturdy rope, useful for marking routes or rappelling down from heights.
MiningTreasure.2402.2.cn: 一条扎实的绳子，用来标记路线或者从高处垂降都十分实用。

MiningTreasure.2403.2.en: An Artifact that drives tent stakes deep into the ground with a single swing, ideal for outdoor camping.
MiningTreasure.2403.2.cn: 可以一锤把钉子深深固定在土中的神器，特别适合用于野外扎营

MiningTreasure.2501.2.en: The most adorable monster crystal in the world.
MiningTreasure.2501.2.cn: 世界上最可爱的魔物结晶。

MiningTreasure.2502.2.en: A single drop grants understanding of all elvish tongues.
MiningTreasure.2502.2.cn: 只需一滴，即可通晓所有精灵的语言。

MiningTreasure.2503.2.en: The bearer of the scepter rides the waves and commands the shark packs.
MiningTreasure.2503.2.cn: 持杖者，可乘风踏浪，统御深海鲨群。

MiningTreasure.2601.2.en: The most adorable monster crystal in the world.
MiningTreasure.2601.2.cn: 世界上最可爱的魔物结晶。

MiningTreasure.2602.2.en: A single drop grants understanding of all elvish tongues.
MiningTreasure.2602.2.cn: 只需一滴，即可通晓所有精灵的语言。

MiningTreasure.2603.2.en: The bearer of the scepter rides the waves and commands the shark packs.
MiningTreasure.2603.2.cn: 持杖者，可乘风踏浪，统御深海鲨群。

MiningTreasure.3001.2.en: Beneath its filthy surface lurks unsettling secrets.
MiningTreasure.3001.2.cn: 肮脏的表面下，隐藏着令人不安的秘密。

MiningTreasure.3002.2.en: Is it the source of all disasters or the dawn of supreme glory?
MiningTreasure.3002.2.cn: 一切灾难的源头，抑或无上荣光的起点？

MiningTreasure.3003.2.en: Lost in the sea of time, it writes an eternal forbidden spell of the unknown.
MiningTreasure.3003.2.cn: 遗落于时光之海，书写着未知的永恒禁咒。

MiningTreasure.3201.2.en: Rotten vines. Once useful for weaving tools, they are now fairly worthless.
MiningTreasure.3201.2.cn: 腐烂的藤蔓。完好时能用来编织道具，如今只剩下价值寥寥的残骸。

MiningTreasure.3202.2.en: The remnant of a felled old tree. Once polished and painted, it can be used as garden or indoor decorative piece.
MiningTreasure.3202.2.cn: 老树被砍伐后的残骸，经过打磨处理后能作为花园和室内的家具摆件。

MiningTreasure.3203.2.en: A resin sphere with a butterfly inside it. Placed under light, it glows brilliantly—an artwork shaped entirely by nature.
MiningTreasure.3203.2.cn: 封存着蝴蝶的树脂球，置于光源下熠熠生辉，只属于大自然的艺术品。

MiningTreasure.3301.2.en: A key dropped by a careless employee. They used its loss as an excuse to play hooky the next day.
MiningTreasure.3301.2.cn: 某位粗心的员工遗落在花房的花房钥匙，第二天以此为由翘了一天班。

MiningTreasure.3302.2.en: An earth drill left behind by an absent-minded employee from R&D. The entire department tried to find it the next day but failed.
MiningTreasure.3302.2.cn: 某位粗心的研发部员工遗落在花房的土钻，第二天发动了整个部门，也没有找到。

MiningTreasure.3303.2.en: A stake forgotten by a distracted Greenhouse Manager. The plant had somehow been propped up already the next day.
MiningTreasure.3303.2.cn: 某位粗心的花房管理员遗落在花房的固定杆，第二天发现有人已帮忙做好了支撑。

MiningTreasure.3401.2.en: A fishing rod left behind by an angler. Was it broken, or just not suited for forest fishing?
MiningTreasure.3401.2.cn: 垂钓者落下的钓竿，是因为损坏了还是因为不适合在林间使用呢？

MiningTreasure.3402.2.en: It looks like an ordinary oar, but it's exceptionally light yet sturdy since it's an Artifact.
MiningTreasure.3402.2.cn: 看上去只是划船的船桨，但因为是神器的关系所以格外轻便耐用。

MiningTreasure.3403.2.en: A harpoon that fires at the lightest trigger pull, so there's no need to panic even in the face of ferocious sea monsters.
MiningTreasure.3403.2.cn: 只要轻按扳机就会发射出去的鱼叉，即使遇上凶猛的海中魔物也丝毫不慌。

MiningTreasure.3501.2.en: Beneath its filthy surface lurks unsettling secrets.
MiningTreasure.3501.2.cn: 肮脏的表面下，隐藏着令人不安的秘密。

MiningTreasure.3502.2.en: Is it the source of all disasters or the dawn of supreme glory?
MiningTreasure.3502.2.cn: 一切灾难的源头，抑或无上荣光的起点？

MiningTreasure.3503.2.en: Lost in the sea of time, it writes an eternal forbidden spell of the unknown.
MiningTreasure.3503.2.cn: 遗落于时光之海，书写着未知的永恒禁咒。

MiningTreasure.3601.2.cn: 肮脏的表面下，隐藏着令人不安的秘密。

MiningTreasure.3602.2.en: Is it the source of all disasters or the dawn of supreme glory?
MiningTreasure.3602.2.cn: 一切灾难的源头，抑或无上荣光的起点？

MiningTreasure.3603.2.en: Lost in the sea of time, it writes an eternal forbidden spell of the unknown.
MiningTreasure.3603.2.cn: 遗落于时光之海，书写着未知的永恒禁咒。

MiningTreasure.4001.2.en: Though coarse and heavy, it stands as the sturdiest fortress.
MiningTreasure.4001.2.cn: 它粗粝而厚重，却是最坚固的堡垒。

MiningTreasure.4002.2.en: The moment it sees daylight again, everyone is astonished by its crystalline brilliance.
MiningTreasure.4002.2.cn: 重见天日的那一刻，无人不为它的晶莹所惊叹。

MiningTreasure.4003.2.en: Legend says only those who vanquish the dragon are worthy of this extraordinary treasure.
MiningTreasure.4003.2.cn: 传说，唯有战胜巨龙者，方能获得这绝世珍宝。

MiningTreasure.4201.2.en: A bark torch soaked in resin, now too damp to serve its original purpose.
MiningTreasure.4201.2.cn: 浸透树脂的树皮火炬，因潮湿而失去了原来的作用。

MiningTreasure.4202.2.en: The lantern's glass surface is covered in moss stains and cracks, but all it needs is a new wick to work again.
MiningTreasure.4202.2.cn: 玻璃灯罩的表面布满苔痕和裂纹，换过灯芯后依旧能使用。

MiningTreasure.4203.2.en: A rare oil lamp said to burn for centuries. A true treasure for adventurers.
MiningTreasure.4203.2.cn: 据说能燃烧数百年之久的珍贵油灯，对冒险者而言是不可多得的宝物。

MiningTreasure.4301.2.en: A Greenhouse Ghost Story: In the dead of night, the sound of splashing water echoes from greenhouses that should be empty.
MiningTreasure.4301.2.cn: 花房的不可思议传说：夜半时分，部分闲置的花房里会传出浇水的动静。

MiningTreasure.4302.2.en: A Greenhouse Ghost Story: In the dead of night, faint lights can be seen flickering inside greenhouses that should be empty.
MiningTreasure.4302.2.cn: 花房的不可思议传说：夜半时分，部分闲置的花房会透出隐约的光亮。

MiningTreasure.4303.2.en: It turns out a Manager was just growing vegetables for their own table. They have since been publicly reprimanded.
MiningTreasure.4303.2.cn: 调查发现，竟是一名管理员在种植瓜果，自给自足。该名管理员被通报批评。

MiningTreasure.4401.2.en: In this coastal town known for its fishing industry, a sturdy fishing net is hardly a rare sight.
MiningTreasure.4401.2.cn: 在这座以渔业闻名的海滨小镇，发现一张结实的渔网并不是什么稀奇事。

MiningTreasure.4402.2.en: An Artifact that makes climbing steep rock faces easier. Master it, and you can unlock new paths!
MiningTreasure.4402.2.cn: 便于攀登陡峭岩体的神器。熟练运用它就能开拓出全新的路线！

MiningTreasure.4403.2.en: If the letter-devouring monsters keep wreaking havoc, Trekkers may no longer take on mail delivery jobs.
MiningTreasure.4403.2.cn: 吃信的魔物继续肆虐的话，旅人们就不会再愿意接送信的活了……

MiningTreasure.4501.2.en: Though coarse and heavy, it stands as the sturdiest fortress.
MiningTreasure.4501.2.cn: 它粗粝而厚重，却是最坚固的堡垒。

MiningTreasure.4502.2.cn: 重见天日的那一刻，无人不为它的晶莹所惊叹。

MiningTreasure.4503.2.cn: 传说，唯有战胜巨龙者，方能获得这绝世珍宝。

MiningTreasure.4601.2.cn: 它粗粝而厚重，却是最坚固的堡垒。

MiningTreasure.4602.2.en: The moment it sees daylight again, everyone is astonished by its crystalline brilliance.
MiningTreasure.4602.2.cn: 重见天日的那一刻，无人不为它的晶莹所惊叹。

MiningTreasure.4603.2.en: Legend says only those who vanquish the dragon are worthy of this extraordinary treasure.
MiningTreasure.4603.2.cn: 传说，唯有战胜巨龙者，方能获得这绝世珍宝。

MonsterManual.1000111.2.en: A kind of Shrubshrews often encountered in the Wilds, always eager to swing their clubs at anyone who gets too close. If you don't want to get knocked out, it's best to steer clear of them.
MonsterManual.1000111.2.cn: 在野外随处可见的树树鼠，手拿棍棒，总是急不可耐地就想敲人。不想被抡晕的话就绕着走吧。

MonsterManual.1000161.2.en: A kind of Shrubshrews often encountered in the Wilds. They seem to have been affected by the polluted forest, becoming disoriented and more aggressive.
MonsterManual.1000161.2.cn: 在野外随处可见的树树鼠，似乎被污染的森林所影响，有些神志不清而更有攻击性了。

MonsterManual.1000200.2.en: Shrubshrews with longer tails are skilled at throwing objects. They seem to have been affected by the polluted forest, becoming disoriented and more aggressive.
MonsterManual.1000200.2.cn: 尾巴较长，善于投掷的树树鼠，似乎被污染的森林所影响，有些神志不清而更有攻击性了。

MonsterManual.1000211.2.en: Shrubshrews with longer tails are skilled at throwing objects. They throw annoying rocks to scare off anyone trespassing on their territory. Watch out, or you might end up with a bump on your head.
MonsterManual.1000211.2.cn: 尾巴较长，善于投掷的树树鼠，它们会丢出烦人的石块来吓退侵犯它们领地的过路人。小心别被砸出满头包。

MonsterManual.1000261.2.en: Shrubshrews with longer tails are skilled at throwing objects. They seem to have been affected by the polluted forest, becoming disoriented and more aggressive.
MonsterManual.1000261.2.cn: 尾巴较长，善于投掷的树树鼠，似乎被污染的森林所影响，有些神志不清而更有攻击性了。

MonsterManual.1000311.2.en: Shrubshrews teams that use tree stumps as their base. They not only throw rocks but also use their elevated position to strike intruders on the head. When working together, the Wood Rat Trio make for a very tough opponent.
MonsterManual.1000311.2.cn: 利用树桩搭起阵地的树树鼠组合，它们既会投掷石块，还会利用高处猛敲来犯者的脑门。合作起来的树树鼠是十分难缠的敌手。

MonsterManual.1000411.2.en:
A peculiar-looking wild beast, it has antlers resembling withered branches and sharp fangs.
It often responds to provocation with straightforward charging attacks.
MonsterManual.1000411.2.cn:
长相奇特的野外猛兽，长着仿若枯枝丫的角与锐牙。
它常以简单易懂的冲撞攻击回应挑衅。

MonsterManual.1000516.2.en: A bulky beast that leads its herd. It uses its enormous tusks to charge forward relentlessly, stomping any and all obstacles in its path.
MonsterManual.1000516.2.cn: 统帅族群的巨型猛兽，凭借巨大的獠牙，猪突猛进地踏平所有出现在视线中的障碍。

MonsterManual.1000641.2.en:
A type of owl that resides in the forest, capable of casting basic Ventus magic.
It is well-known for its highly distinctive call.
MonsterManual.1000641.2.cn:
在森林中栖息的枭类，能发动初级风系魔法。
因为叫声非常特别而闻名。

MonsterManual.1000705.2.en:
A monster lurking near Port Bellin.
During nesting season, it snatches envelopes containing "hard objects" as materials for its nest.
MonsterManual.1000705.2.cn:
在贝林港附近出没的魔物。
由于处在筑巢期，将一些装有“硬物”的信封当成筑巢材料叼走了。

MonsterManual.1000800.2.en: A long-tailed scorpion that dwells in the desert, its sturdy pincers possess lethal power that matches its intimidating appearance.
MonsterManual.1000800.2.cn: 生活在沙漠中的长尾蝎，粗壮的前臂有着与造型相符的杀伤力。

MonsterManual.1000841.2.en: A long-tailed scorpion that dwells in the desert, its sturdy pincers possess lethal power that matches its intimidating appearance.
MonsterManual.1000841.2.cn: 生活在沙漠中的长尾蝎，粗壮的前臂有着与造型相符的杀伤力。

MonsterManual.1000861.2.en: A long-tailed scorpion that dwells in the desert, its sturdy pincers possess lethal power that matches its intimidating appearance.
MonsterManual.1000861.2.cn: 生活在沙漠中的长尾蝎，粗壮的前臂有着与造型相符的杀伤力。

MonsterManual.1001066.2.en: Legend has it that a young lady devoured her lover and gave herself to the Wilds. It is obviously the source of the curse that plagues this forest.
MonsterManual.1001066.2.cn: 传闻中，少女吞噬了爱人后，将身心献给了荒芜。显然，它就是这片森林诅咒的罪魁祸首。

MonsterManual.1001205.2.en: This golem guard wields a massive axe with formidable skill. The sound of its blade slicing through the air strikes fear into the hearts of the disrespectful and silences them.
MonsterManual.1001205.2.cn: 挥舞长斧的遗像禁卫，身怀傲人绝技。利刃破空之声，令无礼之徒陷入静默。

MonsterManual.1001216.2.en: This golem guard wields a massive axe with formidable skill. Its blade slices through the air, leading the disrespectful onto a path of thorns.
MonsterManual.1001216.2.cn: 挥舞长斧的遗像禁卫，身怀傲人绝技。利刃破空之声，铺开无礼之徒的荆棘之路。

MonsterManual.1001226.2.en: This golem guard wields a massive axe with formidable skill. Its blade slices through the air, cutting off any path of retreat for the disrespectful by drowning them.
MonsterManual.1001226.2.cn: 挥舞长斧的遗像禁卫，身怀傲人绝技。利刃破空之声，将无礼之徒的退路淹没。

MonsterManual.1001236.2.en: This golem guard wields a massive axe with formidable skill. Its blade slices through the air, reducing the disrespectful to cinders.
MonsterManual.1001236.2.cn: 挥舞长斧的遗像禁卫，身怀傲人绝技。利刃破空之声，将无礼之徒以熔芯之焰焚尽。

MonsterManual.1001246.2.en: This golem guard wields a massive axe with formidable skill. The sound of its blade slicing through the air reminds one of squalls above the vast firmament itself.
MonsterManual.1001246.2.cn: 挥舞长斧的遗像禁卫，身怀傲人绝技。利刃破空之声，如苍穹之上的狂风。

MonsterManual.1001256.2.en: This golem guard wields a massive axe with formidable skill. Its blade slices through the air and engulfs the disrespectful in endless radiance.
MonsterManual.1001256.2.cn: 挥舞长斧的遗像禁卫，身怀傲人绝技。利刃破空之声，将无礼之徒埋葬于无尽光辉。

MonsterManual.1001266.2.en: This golem guard wields a massive axe with formidable skill. Its blade slices through the air and pushes the disrespectful into the abyss of nightmares.
MonsterManual.1001266.2.cn: 挥舞长斧的遗像禁卫，身怀傲人绝技。利刃破空之声，为无礼之徒指向噩梦深渊。

MonsterManual.1001500.2.en: A magical creature resembling a balloon, its tenacious vitality makes it a common sight across the Nova Continent. In some regions, it is known by a cute nickname.
MonsterManual.1001500.2.cn: 外形如同气球的神奇生物，顽强的生命力令这种生物在诺瓦大陆随处可见。在某些地区有个可爱的俗称。

MonsterManual.1001511.2.en: A magical creature resembling a balloon, known for its habit of burying itself in the soil. In some regions, it is known by a cute nickname.
MonsterManual.1001511.2.cn: 外形如同气球的神奇生物，喜欢把自己埋在土里。在某些地区有个可爱的俗称。

MonsterManual.1001521.2.en: A magical creature resembling a balloon, known for its habit of drifting with the currents. In some regions, it is known by a cute nickname.
MonsterManual.1001521.2.cn: 外形如同气球的神奇生物，会漂在水中随波逐流。在某些地区有个可爱的俗称。

MonsterManual.1001531.2.en: A magical creature resembling a balloon that dislikes water. In some regions, it is known by a cute nickname.
MonsterManual.1001531.2.cn: 外形如同气球的神奇生物，讨厌水。在某些地区有个可爱的俗称。

MonsterManual.1001541.2.en: A magical creature resembling a balloon. Its round body is filled with air. In some regions, it is known by a cute nickname.
MonsterManual.1001541.2.cn: 外形如同气球的神奇生物，圆圆的身体一肚子气。在某些地区有个可爱的俗称。

MonsterManual.1001551.2.en: A magical creature resembling a balloon, it can be used as a makeshift light source—though doing so tends to make it quite angry. In some regions, it is known by a cute nickname.
MonsterManual.1001551.2.cn: 外形如同气球的神奇生物，可以用来当临时照明设备，虽然这么做会让它很生气。在某些地区有个可爱的俗称。

MonsterManual.1001561.2.en: A magical creature resembling a balloon with a dark disposition. In some regions, it is known by a cute nickname.
MonsterManual.1001561.2.cn: 外形如同气球的神奇生物，性格阴沉。在某些地区有个可爱的俗称。

MonsterManual.1001800.2.en: A tentacled creature lurking inside a steam pot. Its true form remains a mystery. If it locks onto you, run away immediately or you'll be crushed flat.
MonsterManual.1001800.2.cn: 藏匿在汽锅中的触手生物，本体不明。被锁定后请立刻逃跑，不然会被狠狠砸扁。

MonsterManual.1001811.2.en: A tentacled creature lurking inside a steam pot. Its true form remains a mystery. It draws power from Terra element. If it locks onto you, run away immediately or you'll be crushed flat.
MonsterManual.1001811.2.cn: 藏匿在汽锅中的触手生物，本体不明，驾驭着源自大地的力量。被锁定后请立刻逃跑，不然会被狠狠砸扁。

MonsterManual.1001821.2.en: A tentacled creature lurking inside a steam pot. Its true form remains a mystery. It draws power from Aqua element. If it locks onto you, run away immediately or you'll be crushed flat.
MonsterManual.1001821.2.cn: 藏匿在汽锅中的触手生物，本体不明，驾驭着源自流水的力量。被锁定后请立刻逃跑，不然会被狠狠砸扁。

MonsterManual.1001831.2.en: A tentacled creature lurking inside a steam pot. Its true form remains a mystery. It draws power from Ignis element. If it locks onto you, run away immediately or you'll be crushed flat.
MonsterManual.1001831.2.cn: 藏匿在汽锅中的触手生物，本体不明，驾驭着源自烈火的力量。被锁定后请立刻逃跑，不然会被狠狠砸扁。

MonsterManual.1001841.2.en: A tentacled creature lurking inside a steam pot. Its true form remains a mystery. It draws power from Ventus element. If it locks onto you, run away immediately or you'll be crushed flat.
MonsterManual.1001841.2.cn: 藏匿在汽锅中的触手生物，本体不明，驾驭着源自疾风的力量。被锁定后请立刻逃跑，不然会被狠狠砸扁。

MonsterManual.1001851.2.en: A tentacled creature lurking inside a steam pot. Its true form remains a mystery. It draws power from Lux element. If it locks onto you, run away immediately or you'll be crushed flat.
MonsterManual.1001851.2.cn: 藏匿在汽锅中的触手生物，本体不明，驾驭着源自辉光的力量。被锁定后请立刻逃跑，不然会被狠狠砸扁。

MonsterManual.1001861.2.en: A tentacled creature lurking inside a steam pot. Its true form remains a mystery. It draws power from Umbra element. If it locks onto you, run away immediately or you'll be crushed flat.
MonsterManual.1001861.2.cn: 藏匿在汽锅中的触手生物，本体不明，驾驭着源自幽暗的力量。被锁定后请立刻逃跑，不然会被狠狠砸扁。

MonsterManual.1100300.2.en: A second-generation co-op unit with guard modules added to the basic features. It can be used both as a heavy-duty machine and as a makeshift guard.
MonsterManual.1100300.2.cn: 第二代协作机，在基础功能上加装了防卫模块。既能承担重工任务，也可临时胜任保安。

MonsterManual.1100400.2.en: A fifth-generation support unit with a reinforced structure and enhanced materials. It can work in harsh environments and perform diverse complex support missions.
MonsterManual.1100400.2.cn: 第五代辅助机，机身采用了强化设计与加固材料。能够适应恶劣环境，执行多种复杂支援任务。

MonsterManual.1100700.2.en:
A reliable UH professional with years of field experience.
A master of navigating chaotic workflows and ambiguous standards.
Unfazed by overtime and unmoved by empty promises.
MonsterManual.1100700.2.cn:
在工作岗位上浸淫多年的种业员工，专业、可靠。
擅长应付各种没有流程的流程和没有标准的标准。
面对加班从不慌乱，面对画饼毫无动摇。

MonsterManual.1102100.2.en: A canine-modeled patrol and reconnaissance unit. It has excellent mobility and is often used for patrol and tracking missions.
MonsterManual.1102100.2.cn: 犬型巡逻侦察机，具备优良的机动性，常用于巡逻与追踪任务。

MonsterManual.1103105.2.en: A crab-modeled obstacle clearing unit with outstanding obstacle-breaking capabilities. It is often used for forestry operations.
MonsterManual.1103105.2.cn: 蟹型清障机，具备卓越的障碍破除能力，常用于林业作业。

MonsterManual.1300100.2.en: A member of the Ashwind Clan who uses a plain baseball bat as a weapon.
MonsterManual.1300100.2.cn: 灰风俱乐部的成员，用朴实无华的球棒当做武器。

MonsterManual.1301100.2.en: A technician of the Ashwind Clan. They are better technicians than fighters.
MonsterManual.1301100.2.cn: 灰风俱乐部的技师，比起战斗能力还是修理技术更强一点。

MonsterManual.1302100.2.en: A core member of the Ashwind Clan and a loyal follower of Minova's. She may look like a kid but her fist punch is formidable.
MonsterManual.1302100.2.cn: 灰风俱乐部的核心成员，密涅瓦的追随者之一。年纪看起来小小，拳头砸下去痛痛。

MonsterManual.1303100.2.en: A core member of the Ashwind Clan and a loyal follower of Minova's. People who always wear a smiling face can be terrifying when they get angry, and she is no exception.
MonsterManual.1303100.2.cn: 灰风俱乐部的核心成员，密涅瓦的追随者之一。笑眯眯的人生起气来通常都很恐怖，她也不例外。

MonsterManual.1304151.2.en: The leader of the Ashwind Clan and protector of Ash District. Fierce and has a problem with authority. Those who cross her will be met with an inevitable demise, sooner or later.
MonsterManual.1304151.2.cn: 灰风俱乐部的领袖，灰城区的守护者。桀骜不驯的灰风大姐头，招惹到她的话想必会立刻完蛋，也可能缓缓完蛋。

MonsterManual.1305136.2.en: A colossal golem guard that sits atop of the Monolith. Fueled by a timeless longing that endured through years within its armored body, it incinerates all threats in its path.
MonsterManual.1305136.2.cn: 自星塔顶端现身的巨型遗像禁卫。以本不该出现在那坚甲身躯中的，跨越时光的漫长思念为燃料，烧却一切威胁。

MonsterManual.1306100.2.en: A formidable golem guard with an imposing presence, its arms brimming with immense strength, fueled by rage. It seeks vengeance against anyone who dares disturb the peace.
MonsterManual.1306100.2.cn: 气魄骇人的遗像禁卫，双臂似有千钧之力。以狂怒为燃料，向打破宁静之人发起复仇。

MonsterManual.1306105.2.en: A formidable golem guard with an imposing presence, its arms brimming with immense strength, fueled by rage. It unleashes fury upon those who disrupt the peace.
MonsterManual.1306105.2.cn: 气魄骇人的遗像禁卫，双臂似有千钧之力，向打破宁静之人宣泄怒火。

MonsterManual.1306111.2.en: A formidable golem guard with an imposing presence, its arms brimming with immense strength that draws power from Terra element. Fueled by rage, it seeks vengeance against anyone who dares disturb the peace.
MonsterManual.1306111.2.cn: 气魄骇人的遗像禁卫，双臂似有千钧之力，驾驭着源自大地的力量。以狂怒为燃料，向打破宁静之人发起复仇。

MonsterManual.1306116.2.en: A formidable golem guard with an imposing presence, its arms brimming with immense strength. Its punches carry the weight of mountains, unleashing fury upon those who disrupt the peace.
MonsterManual.1306116.2.cn: 气魄骇人的遗像禁卫，双臂似有千钧之力。拳势如山峦般沉重，向打破宁静之人宣泄怒火。

MonsterManual.1306121.2.en: A formidable golem guard with an imposing presence, its arms brimming with immense strength that draws power from Aqua element. Fueled by rage. It seeks vengeance against anyone who dares disturb the peace.
MonsterManual.1306121.2.cn: 气魄骇人的遗像禁卫，双臂似有千钧之力，驾驭着源自流水的力量。以狂怒为燃料，向打破宁静之人发起复仇。

MonsterManual.1306126.2.en: A formidable golem guard with an imposing presence, its arms brimming with immense strength. Its punches rain down like raging waves, unleashing fury upon those who disrupt the peace.
MonsterManual.1306126.2.cn: 气魄骇人的遗像禁卫，双臂似有千钧之力。拳势如怒涛般汹涌，向打破宁静之人宣泄怒火。

MonsterManual.1306131.2.en: A formidable golem guard with an imposing presence, its arms brimming with immense strength that draws power from Ignis element. Fueled by rage. It seeks vengeance against anyone who dares disturb the peace.
MonsterManual.1306131.2.cn: 气魄骇人的遗像禁卫，双臂似有千钧之力，驾驭着源自烈火的力量。以狂怒为燃料，向打破宁静之人发起复仇。

MonsterManual.1306136.2.en: A formidable golem guard with an imposing presence, its arms brimming with immense strength. Its punches, like raging flames, unleash fury upon those who disrupt the peace.
MonsterManual.1306136.2.cn: 气魄骇人的遗像禁卫，双臂似有千钧之力。拳势如烈焰般灼热，向打破宁静之人宣泄怒火。

MonsterManual.1306141.2.en: A formidable golem guard with an imposing presence, its arms brimming with immense strength that draws power from Ventus element. Fueled by rage, it seeks vengeance against anyone who dares disturb the peace.
MonsterManual.1306141.2.cn: 气魄骇人的遗像禁卫，双臂似有千钧之力，驾驭着源自疾风的力量。以狂怒为燃料，向打破宁静之人发起复仇。

MonsterManual.1306146.2.en: A formidable golem guard with an imposing presence, its arms brimming with immense strength. It punches with the speed of swift winds, unleashing fury upon those who disrupt the peace.
MonsterManual.1306146.2.cn: 气魄骇人的遗像禁卫，双臂似有千钧之力。拳势如疾风般迅速，向打破宁静之人宣泄怒火。

MonsterManual.1306151.2.en: A formidable golem guard with an imposing presence, its arms brimming with immense strength that draws power from Lux element. Fueled by rage, it seeks vengeance against anyone who dares disturb the peace.
MonsterManual.1306151.2.cn: 气魄骇人的遗像禁卫，双臂似有千钧之力，驾驭着源自辉光的力量。以狂怒为燃料，向打破宁静之人发起复仇。

MonsterManual.1306156.2.en: A formidable golem guard with an imposing presence, its arms brimming with immense strength. It punches with dazzling lights, unleashing fury upon those who disrupt the peace.
MonsterManual.1306156.2.cn: 气魄骇人的遗像禁卫，双臂似有千钧之力。拳势如辉光般耀目，向打破宁静之人宣泄怒火。

MonsterManual.1306161.2.en: A formidable golem guard with an imposing presence, its arms brimming with immense strength that draws power from Umbra element. Fueled by rage, it seeks vengeance against anyone who dares disturb the peace.
MonsterManual.1306161.2.cn: 气魄骇人的遗像禁卫，双臂似有千钧之力，驾驭着源自幽暗的力量。以狂怒为燃料，向打破宁静之人发起复仇。

MonsterManual.1306166.2.en: A formidable golem guard with an imposing presence, its arms brimming with immense strength, Its punches move like spectral shadows, unleashing fury upon those who disrupt the peace.
MonsterManual.1306166.2.cn: 气魄骇人的遗像禁卫，双臂似有千钧之力。拳势如幽影般鬼魅，向打破宁静之人宣泄怒火。

MonsterManual.1400100.2.en: A Trekker wielding a light sword, with only basic training and little combat experience. Still, if they surround you, you're likely to be overrun.
MonsterManual.1400100.2.cn: 挥舞轻剑的旅人，只经过了基本的训练，没有什么战斗经验。但要是被她们团团围住的话还是会寡不敌众。

MonsterManual.1400170.2.en: An ordinary Prosperity Gang swordsman with mediocre intelligence and combat skills. Desperately wants to get rich.
MonsterManual.1400170.2.cn: “恭喜发财”团的剑士，智力普普通通，武力也普普通通。想要发财。

MonsterManual.1401100.2.en: A Trekker skilled in magic. Quiet and reserved, with no mastery of advanced spells. However, if they set their sights on you, you might find yourself attacked from all sides.
MonsterManual.1401100.2.cn: 擅长法术的旅人，有些沉默寡言，并不会什么高级法术。但要是被她们盯上了，可能会腹背受敌。

MonsterManual.1401170.2.en: A Prosperity Gang mage who saved up some money but lost it all in a failed investment. Desperately wants to get rich.
MonsterManual.1401170.2.cn: “恭喜发财”团的法师，攒了一笔钱，投资大失败。想要发财。

MonsterManual.1402100.2.en:
A warrior Trekker who wields a massive axe and is clad in heavy armor.
His powerful muscles and imposing physique are his greatest shields. Even in negotiations, his presence alone can weaken his opponent's resolve.
MonsterManual.1402100.2.cn:
手持大斧，护甲坚实的战士旅人。
他强壮的肌肉和硕大的身躯是他最好的护身符。哪怕只是谈判都能让对手的气势下降三分。

MonsterManual.1500100.2.en: A new hire pushing through two weeks of intense overtime, working 13-hour days! And that's not even anywhere close to their limit—hand them an energy drink, and they can power through 24 hours nonstop.
MonsterManual.1500100.2.cn: 高强度连续加班两周的新人员工，每日工作时长已达到13个小时！这还远不是他们的极限——只要喝下能量饮料，24小时连轴转也不成问题。

MonsterManual.1501100.2.en: A veteran employee with years on the job, utterly indifferent to management's prep talks about "the prospects" or "the company's future." The only thing that keeps them showing up at work is payday.
MonsterManual.1501100.2.cn: 入职多年的资深精英员工，对领导谈话里提到的“项目前景”“公司未来”毫不关心，只有每月的发薪日才能提起上班的动力。

MonsterManual.1551056.2.en: A bird-type monster that thrives alongside Radiant Grass in the Wilds. Following the advice of two new employees with extensive Trekker experience, the R&D Department of United Harvest captured the leader of a flock and put it inside the plant's ecosystem in the Greenhouse of United Harvest Park.
MonsterManual.1551056.2.cn: 荒野上与辉草伴生的鸟类魔物。种业研发部在两位富有旅人经验的新人员工的建议下捕捉了一只鸟群首领，用以在花房模拟植物的生态环境。

MonsterManual.1552041.2.en: Transformed from the Blade of Jade, its iridescent glow on its feathers is mesmerizing enough to dazzle all enemies.
MonsterManual.1552041.2.cn: 由翠煌之刃的羽毛幻化而来，虹彩的流光足以令所有敌人目眩神迷。

MonsterManual.1552051.2.en: Transformed from the Blade of Jade, its agility allows it to escape danger with ease.
MonsterManual.1552051.2.cn: 由翠煌之刃的羽毛幻化而来，灵动的身姿总能让自己逃脱险境。

MonsterManual.1600141.2.en: A failed product of a cultivation experiment. Its grotesque mutations forced researchers to quickly abandon further development of this line.
MonsterManual.1600141.2.cn: 培育实验中的失败品，外观的丑陋异变令实验人员很快便叫停了该品类的培育。

MonsterManual.1601141.2.en: A failed product of a cultivation experiment. Its uncontrollable aggression forced researchers to quickly abandon further development of this line.
MonsterManual.1601141.2.cn: 培育实验中的失败品，无法由人为控制的攻击性令实验人员很快便叫停了该品类的培育。

MonsterManual.1651046.2.en: An elegant and graceful plant artificially cultivated to enhance the company image of the United Harvest appearance. However, as cultivation advanced, exposure to NGO-made device caused it to develop self-awareness and a natural instinct for aggression.
MonsterManual.1651046.2.cn: 为了配合宣传联合种业的公司形象而人工培育出的植物，外观飘逸美丽。随着培育的深入，在柔光设备的影响下，它产生了自我意识和攻击本能。

MonsterManual.1700100.2.en: No one knows whether he put on this armor for the sake of his honor or a paltry paycheck.
MonsterManual.1700100.2.cn: 没人知道他披上这身铠甲，究竟是为了捍卫荣耀，还是只为领那份微薄的薪水。

MonsterManual.1701100.2.en: A seemingly upright knight, more suited for catching jaywalkers than fighting evil forces.
MonsterManual.1701100.2.cn: 看似一本正经的骑士，比起与恶势力作战，更擅长抓捕违反交通规则的路人。

MonsterManual.1702100.2.en: A loyal and formidable captain, whose silvery lance and swift charge strike fear into every enemy's heart.
MonsterManual.1702100.2.cn: 忠诚而强势的卫队分团长，银亮的长枪与疾风般的冲锋，足以让敌人闻风丧胆。

MonsterManual.1703100.2.en: The oldest knight in the Imperial Guard. The heavy crossbow he carries is both his trademark and the best evidence that he is still as deadly as ever.
MonsterManual.1703100.2.cn: 卫队中最年长的骑士，手中那把重弩既是他的独门武器，也是他老当益壮的最好证明。

MonsterManual.1751026.2.en:
When pristine waters become polluted, the gentle "neighbor" living outside Philae will personally come to voice its protest—
Go-gobble... Go-go-gobble... Go-bble-bble-bbbbble!!!
MonsterManual.1751026.2.cn:
当清澈的水域被污染，那只居住在菲莱城外温和的“邻居”，会亲自前来提出抗议——
噗噜噗噜……噗噜噜……噗噜噜噜噜！！！

MonsterManual.1800100.2.en: These young bladesmen were meant to fight the Nocturn Eterna. Now, they have become nothing more than weapons for those with sinister intentions.
MonsterManual.1800100.2.cn: 年轻的黎明近卫刀手，本应肩负着对抗永夜的使命，然而此刻，却已化作居心叵測之人的利刃。

MonsterManual.1801100.2.en: These proud mages were meant to act solely under the authority of the Tetrad Aspects. Now, they have been reduced to mere pawns for schemers.
MonsterManual.1801100.2.cn: 高傲的黎明近卫法师，本应由心相四角授权行事，然而如今，却已沦为别有用心之人的棋子。

MonsterManual.3000100.2.en: A cheerful and friendly member of the Treasure Hunters, always concerned about sun protection.
MonsterManual.3000100.2.cn: 寻宝旅人团的成员，爽朗亲切，会努力做好防晒。

MonsterManual.3001100.2.en: A fearless member of the Treasure Hunters, with unmatched grilling skills.
MonsterManual.3001100.2.cn: 寻宝旅人团的成员，勇敢无畏，烤肉技术一绝。

MonsterManual.3002100.2.en: A burly member of the Treasure Hunters, currently practicing hard at fishing.
MonsterManual.3002100.2.cn: 寻宝旅人团的成员，健壮强悍，最近在苦练捕鱼技巧。

MonsterManual.3010100.2.en: A bright and lovely member of the Treasure Hunters, who dreams of swimming in an ocean of watermelons.
MonsterManual.3010100.2.cn: 寻宝旅人团的成员，清新可爱，梦想是在西瓜的海洋里畅游。

MonsterManual.3011100.2.en: A quick-witted member of the Treasure Hunters, forever craving a massive seafood feast.
MonsterManual.3011100.2.cn: 寻宝旅人团的成员，聪慧机敏，馋海鲜大餐馋疯了。

MonsterManual.3012100.2.en: A powerful and imposing member of the Treasure Hunters, who cannot stand sugar-free drink.
MonsterManual.3012100.2.cn: 寻宝旅人团的成员，威猛有力，接受不了无糖饮料。

MonsterManual.3020100.2.en: Smelling so delicious, a Gingerbread Vanguard drives off any intruder with its crunchy body.
MonsterManual.3020100.2.cn: 香喷喷姜饼先锋，以酥酥脆脆的身体驱逐一切闯入者。

MonsterManual.3021100.2.en: Smelling so delicious, a Gingerbread Mage blasts passing Trekkers with sweet, spiced magic ... irresistibly mouthwatering.
MonsterManual.3021100.2.cn: 香喷喷姜饼巫师，会使用甘芳的魔法轰炸过往的旅人……令人嘴馋不已。

MonsterManual.3022100.2.en: Smelling so delicious, a Gingerbread Marksman awakens its targets' hunger to deliver precise strike.
MonsterManual.3022100.2.cn: 香喷喷姜饼射手，会唤起饥饿感对目标进行精准打击。

MonsterManual.3023100.2.en:
A pot filled with creamy sweet soup. Just being near this delicacy brings joy.
But wait... Is it really just soup?
MonsterManual.3023100.2.cn:
装着奶油甜汤的罐子，被这种美味东西靠近的话，一定很幸福。
等等……真的是奶油甜汤吗？

MonsterManual.3024100.2.en:
A strange creature crazy for berries, gathering them in a cauldron.
Don't even think about stealing those berries, or you'll be crushed flat.
MonsterManual.3024100.2.cn:
喜欢浆果的不明生物，把收集来的浆果都藏在大锅里。
千万不要打这些浆果的主意，不然会被狠狠砸扁。

MonsterManual.3025100.2.en: A strange creature hiding in a jar of frosting. It's not short on sugar at all, but it still looks grumpy.
MonsterManual.3025100.2.cn: 躲在糖霜罐子里的不明生物。明明已经不缺糖吃，却还是摆出气鼓鼓的样子。

MonsterManual.3026100.2.en:
A dangerous creature dwelling in a jar, all dressed up in flashy ribbon.
It cheers and applauds when its enemy suffers.
MonsterManual.3026100.2.cn:
寄宿在壶中的危险生物，把自己打扮得花里胡哨。
它的欢呼与喝彩建立在敌人的痛苦之上。

MonsterManual.3027100.2.en: Sherlock the sleepyhead parading with a pile of gift. Hurry! Catch it!
MonsterManual.3027100.2.cn: 睡不醒的夏洛克，带着礼物招摇过市。快！快追上它！

MonsterManual.3028105.2.en: A hulking furnace that looks like an indestructible fortress. No winter chill can ever freeze its burning body.
MonsterManual.3028105.2.cn: 魁梧厚重的巨型暖炉，彷如不可摧毁的堡垒。就算再寒冷的冬季，也冻结不了它火热的身躯。

MonsterManual.3090100.2.en: This soldier races across searing dunes, leaving scorched earth in his wake.
MonsterManual.3090100.2.cn: 奔跑在灼热沙丘中的士兵，所到之处化作一片焦土。

MonsterManual.3091100.2.en: This crossbowman weaves through dust-choked skies, her venomous bolts striking true.
MonsterManual.3091100.2.cn: 穿梭于漫天黄土中的弩手，穿心毒矢随风而至。

MonsterManual.3092100.1.en: Desert Scorpion: Eye of the Desert

MonsterManual.3092100.2.en: This sniper lies in wait behind sheer cliffs, scanning the sandstorms for targets.
MonsterManual.3092100.2.cn: 潜伏在陡崖之后的狙击手，视线所及，皆为靶心。

MonsterManual.3093105.2.en:
Turning poison into fine wine and blood into a scarlet trail,
She grants no mercy, only a choice—
Bow to her and stay your breath, or choose the path of silent death.

将毒液酿成美酒，以鲜血铺就红毯。
她不施舍怜悯，只提供选择——
臣服于她，或就此消失。

MonsterManual.3110100.2.en:
An elite knight tracking NGO members, known as the "Hound."
Nothing escapes her sight.
MonsterManual.3110100.2.cn:
追踪柔光成员的精英骑士，被称为“猎犬”的女人。
一切痕迹在她眼中都无所遁形。

MonsterManual.3130105.2.en:
A monster that roams the resorts around Port Bellin.
After treasure hunters stole its secret treasure, it strapped an Automatic Vending Artifact to its back as a replacement. Even so, that is nowhere near enough to calm its fury.

在贝林港周边度假村出没的魔物。
被寻宝猎人夺走秘宝后，将自动售货神器作为替代品背在了背上。但即便如此，还远不足以平息它的怒火。

MonsterManual.3141105.2.en:
The regal Duke Glopo is a sea racing fanatic.
He believes victory belongs to the ruthless. Sink the rival, and emerge as the true champion.
MonsterManual.3141105.2.cn:
高贵的冻冻公爵，痴迷海上竞速。
它坚信，真正的胜者不必拘泥于规则——只要把竞争对手都拖下水，胜利自然唾手可得。

MonsterManual.5028156.2.cn: 四肢如刀锋般锐利的遗像禁卫，以其多样的攻击方式，给予入侵者别样的恐惧。

MonsterManual.5030146.2.en: A knight who always keeps its promise. It hides its pink toe beans to look more reliable.
MonsterManual.5030146.2.cn: 谨守誓约的骑士。为了使自己看起来更加可靠，特地藏起了粉红色的肉垫。

MonsterManual.5030166.2.en: A knight sworn to a code of discipline. To appear more dignified, it has dutifully given up the habit of chasing its own tail.
MonsterManual.5030166.2.cn: 恪守戒律的骑士。为了使自己看起来更加威严，特地改掉了玩尾巴的习惯。

MonsterManual.5031116.2.en:
An ankylosaurus-looking creature with nice smell who lures hungry Trekkers with aura. 
Tips from Trekker Association: Do not bring a butter knife when approaching Delicious Dragon.
MonsterManual.5031116.2.cn:
香气扑鼻的甲龙状生物。无数饥饿的旅人为之神魂颠倒。
地理协会友情提示：请勿携带黄油刀靠近麦香铠龙。

MonsterManual.5050166.2.en: A mysterious creature that rides a shark-like sea monster. Its true form remains unknown. This pilot charges with its dependable partner through the battlefield, seizing victory after victory.
MonsterManual.5050166.2.cn: 骑着鲨鱼海怪的未知生物，本体不明。机师驾驶它信赖的搭档横冲直撞，摘取一个又一个的胜利果实。

MonsterManual.5051126.2.en: A towering, heavy golem guard, resembling an indestructible fortress. Even if it falls into the abyss, it will still silence those who dare to defy it.
MonsterManual.5051126.2.cn: 魁梧厚重的遗像禁卫，彷如不可摧毁的堡垒。就算坠入深壑，也定会击碎狂傲者的妄语。

MonsterManual.5051136.2.en: A towering, heavy golem guard, resembling an indestructible fortress. Even if its body rots, it will still silence those who dare to defy it.
MonsterManual.5051136.2.cn: 魁梧厚重的遗像禁卫，彷如不可摧毁的堡垒。就算身躯腐朽，也定会击碎狂傲者的妄语。

MonsterManual.5052166.2.en: A wandering spirit always accompanied by music and an eerie smile. Step out of sync with its dance or rhythm, and you'll face its ruthless punishment.
MonsterManual.5052166.2.cn: 总是伴随着音乐和诡异笑容出现的游魂。如果踩错了他定好的舞步或节拍，就会被无情的惩罚。

MonsterManual.5053116.2.en: A majestic-looking elemental being and the leader of the Cursipots. The jar it resides in serves as a throne, a testament to its noble status.
MonsterManual.5053116.2.cn: 看起来很有威严的元素化物，热腾罐们的领袖。它所处的罐头就像王座一样，足以彰显它的尊贵地位。

MonsterManual.5054136.2.en: A ruthless figure wielding oversized kitchen tools, fixated on finding the perfect ingredients. If you're not an invited guest, tread carefully—he might just add you to tonight's menu.
MonsterManual.5054136.2.cn: 挥舞着巨大厨具的残暴存在，偏执地想要寻找完美的食材。没被邀请为客人的话就得小心行动——他可能会把旅人也列入今晚的菜单。

MonsterManual.5055100.2.en: A mimic creature that charges forward with the aroma of roasted meat. Watch out for its fork—don't let it skewer you like a kebab.
MonsterManual.5055100.2.cn: 带着一股烤肉香气突进的拟态生物。小心躲避它的餐叉，别被它叉成串了。

MonsterManual.5056100.2.cn: 长得像餐具的漂浮生物，本体不明。它旋转的可爱姿态只是个伪装。

MonsterManual.5057146.2.en:
A graceful lady who can effortlessly blow Trekkers out of a Monolith.
"Oh my! How dare you bring dust in here!"
MonsterManual.5057146.2.cn:
不费吹灰之力就能把旅人吹出星塔的美丽贵妇。
“天呐！你竟敢把灰尘带进来！”

MonsterManual.5058156.2.en:
A terrifying entity that robs you of sleep with its luminescence light.
The night is still young. Forget about sleeping and join the all-night revelry!
MonsterManual.5058156.2.cn:
用强光夺走安眠的恐怖存在。
美好的夜晚才刚刚开始，抛弃睡眠吧，让我们彻夜狂欢。

MonsterManual.5060146.2.cn:
他对自己的时尚品味无比自满；
他无法容忍一切“不美丽”的事物；
他将为所有顾客拼凑出全新容颜。
禁断丽容，赋予你新生。

MonsterManual.5080100.2.en: The perpetually drowsy Sherlock, flaunting its wealth as it wanders the streets. Should you steer clear of it... Or chase after it?
MonsterManual.5080100.2.cn: 睡不醒的夏洛克，带着它的财富招摇过市。避开它……或是追上它？

MonsterManual.7000105.2.en:
She wears fear as her etiquette and feeds despair with paranoia.
In her repertoire, she performs the most ancient of nightmare.
MonsterManual.7000105.2.cn:
将恐惧当成礼仪，以偏执滋养绝望。
她的剧目里，演绎着最为古老的噩梦。

MonsterManual.7002136.2.en:
In the bizarre yet exciting digital worlds, she reigns supreme as the invincible Boss.

※Combat Capabilities</color>
Rapid Fire: In Assault Mode, Chaton rapidly fires a barrage of bullets at the target.
Dark Bullet: In Sniper Mode, Chaton fires a high-powered energy round after aiming.
Laser Beam: In Sniper Mode, Chaton continuously fires a high-powered laser beam after aiming.
Kitty Bullets: Chaton fires a massive flurry of kitty bullets in all directions.
Eye of the Demon Lord: Chaton summons the Eye of the Demon Lord to unleash a volley of homing missiles that relentlessly track targets.
MonsterManual.7002136.2.cn:
在光怪陆离的虚幻世界里，她才是那个高高在上，天下无敌的混世魔王。

※作战能力</color>
「快速射击」：在突击模式下，猫眼可向目标连续发射大量子弹。
「暗黑子弹」：在狙击模式下，猫眼在瞄准后发射一颗高威力的能量弹。
「镭射光束」：在狙击模式下，猫眼在瞄准后持续发射一条高威力的镭射光束。
「猫猫弹幕」：猫眼向四周发射大量猫猫子弹。
「魔神之眼」：猫眼召唤魔神之眼，倾泻大量可持续追踪目标的导弹。

MonsterManual.7002246.2.en:
Those who are lost in the past do not fear death. As the ninja sword grazes your throat, all she seeks is the warmth of your touch.

※Combat Skills</color>
Sunflower Dance: hurls a massive shuriken to deal DMG.
Scattered Gale: performs a backflip and throws numerous kunai to deal DMG.
Shrouded Moon: moves at extreme speed, dealing DMG to targets along her zigzag path.
Shadow Dance: Leaf Barrier: summons clones, then unleashes massive shurikens whirlwinding around each clone.
Shadow Dance: Wither: summons clones and vanishes into smoke, creating a large-area dealing DMG.
MonsterManual.7002246.2.cn:
彷徨之人从不畏惧毁灭，利刃贴近喉管的那一刻，她只是想感受你的体温。

※作战能力</color>
「葵幻舞」：花原投掷出巨大的手里剑造成伤害。
「岚散落」：花原后空翻并投掷出大量苦无造成伤害。
「隐月」：花原以极快的速度在折线上冲刺，沿路径造成伤害。
「影舞·障叶」：花原发动分身，随后围绕各个分身发动极大范围的手里剑旋风。
「影舞·花凋」：花原发动分身并隐入烟雾，并与分身创造一片大范围伤害区域。

MonsterManual.7003156.2.en:
Torn between the desire for true companionship and the urge to wield weapons of destruction—that is Firefly's choice. 
Those she defeats, and those who defeat her, are destined to become her closest allies. That's the promise…

※Abilities: </color>
Firefly: Flash — Fires drones that deal damage to enemies hit. 
Firefly: Spin — Forms drones into a returning boomerang, damaging enemies along its path. 
Firefly: Meteor — Creates a circular field on the ground that contracts and explodes. 
Cosmic Symphony— Bombards the battlefield at high frequency. 
Omni-Blade: Dashes along a set path, dealing massive damage to enemies in its path. 
All Fired Up — Gains 5 Heat when Skills or attacks hit. At 100 Heat, enters All Fired Up: skills consume Heat to enhance their effects, exits when Heat is depleted and heat generation is significantly increased afterward.
MonsterManual.7003156.2.cn:
一边渴望真正的朋友，一边举起杀戮的武器，这便是火垂的选择。
她打赢的人，以及打赢她的人，都要成为她的挚友。就这么.......约好了。

※作战能力</color>
「萤火·一闪」：火垂发射浮游兵装，对命中目标造成伤害。
「萤火·回转」：火垂操控浮游兵装组合成回旋镖，飞到远端后折返，对途经目标造成伤害。
「萤火·流星」：火垂操控浮游兵装在地表形成光圈，光圈会收缩并爆炸。
「万象协奏」：火垂操控浮游兵装，对场地内进行高频率的轰炸。
「万仞归一」：火垂以特定轨迹高速移动，对途经目标造成高额伤害。
「热力全开」：火垂释放技能或者攻击命中之后都会增加5点热力值。热力值达到100后会进入“热力全开”状态，在该状态下释放技能，会消耗热力值强化技能，热力值清零则退出状态，之后热力值获取速度大幅增加。

MonsterManual.7200105.2.en:
She tears across the endless battlefield,
reveling in the searing heat of combat.
It isn't madness that drives her, but pure, unadulterated desire.
As long as the war rages, her roar will never die.
MonsterManual.7200105.2.cn:
在无尽的战场上驰骋；
在灼热的战火中狂欢。
她并非陷入疯狂，只是心怀渴望。
只要还有战争，她就永远不会停止轰鸣。

MonsterManual.7200205.2.en:
Crushed by the endless battlefield
and scorched by the fires of war.
Her desire became her undoing, leading her straight into despair.
Now she screams on forever, fueling the very war that destroyed her.
MonsterManual.7200205.2.cn:
被无尽的战场所碾碎；
被灼热的战火所灼烧。
她只是心怀渴望，因而步入绝望。
她永远不会停止轰鸣，只为延续战争。

MonsterManual.9912101.2.en: Is that all you've got? Harder!
