"梦萌贝斯音"

PlayerHead.14903.1.en:
Acquire the appearance to unlock
Promise Beyond the Thaw
PlayerHead.14903.1.cn:
获得形象后解锁
"相约融雪后"

PlayerHead.15603.1.en:
Acquire the appearance to unlock
Quirky Tea Party
PlayerHead.15603.1.cn:
获得形象后解锁
"古灵精怪茶话会"

Plot.10301.2.en: A single "hunt," one unfortunate mistake, and a pair of innocent eyes.
Plot.10301.2.cn: 一场“狩猎”，一个失误，一双无辜的眼睛。

Plot.10302.2.en: A grand adventure with you, a girl, and a cat.
Plot.10302.2.cn: 猫与少女与你的大冒险。

Plot.10303.2.en: Words spoken from the heart, and a promise made.
Plot.10303.2.cn: 吐露心扉的话语，以及立下的约定。

Plot.10701.1.cn: 蒙面骑士缇莉娅 上

Plot.10701.2.cn: 危机将至！暴风雨从未停歇。

Plot.10702.1.cn: 蒙面骑士缇莉娅 中

Plot.10702.2.en: The heart of justice awakens! A knight who hunts giants.
Plot.10702.2.cn: 正义之心觉醒！狩猎巨人的骑士。

Plot.10703.1.cn: 蒙面骑士缇莉娅 下

Plot.10703.2.en: Friendship and bonds! The hero returns riding Falcon.
Plot.10703.2.cn: 友谊与羁绊！英雄驾着骏鹰归来。

Plot.10801.2.en: A lost lucky charm? Nothing is more important than that!
Plot.10801.2.cn: 幸运符丢了？那不是头等大事吗！

Plot.10802.2.en: Where shall a new lucky charm be found? Out in the Wilds? Or in a fortune cookie shop?
Plot.10802.2.cn: 去哪才能找到新的幸运符呢？是野外？还是幸运饼干店？

Plot.10803.2.en: Run, Boss! Run if you wanna keep your shoes!
Plot.10803.2.cn: 为了不丢失自己的鞋子！奔跑吧！魔王！

Plot.11001.2.en: A side of her you have never seen.
Plot.11001.2.cn: 从未见过的，她的另一面。

Plot.11002.2.en: The super-popular girl makes her debut?!

Plot.11003.2.en: I want to share this taste with you, for it is linked to my memories.
Plot.11003.2.cn: 想与你品尝相同的味道，因它曾与记忆相连。

Plot.11101.2.en: Oh no! Everything's on the line! Iris's future must be saved!
Plot.11101.2.cn: 出大事了！赌上一切，只为拯救鸢尾的未来！

Plot.11102.2.en: Time is life! Speed means survival! There is no time to hesitate! Every second counts!
Plot.11102.2.cn: 时间就是生命，速度关乎存亡，即便犹豫也不能停下脚步。

Plot.11103.2.en: Leave your worries and gloom behind—lose yourself in the sweet scent of butter and sugar.
Plot.11103.2.cn: 将沮丧与坏心情丢到一旁，沉醉在黄油与砂糖的香甜之中吧。

Plot.11201.2.en: Having successfully modified Loxy, Noya warmly invites you to join her for a "relaxing" joyride.
Plot.11201.2.cn: 尘沙热情地邀请你乘坐由她改造完成的小绿，一起来次“悠闲”的兜风。

Plot.11202.2.en: Her wild driving quickly makes you fear for your life. And sure enough, your worst fears start to come true...
Plot.11202.2.cn: 她狂野的驾驶风格令你担忧起自己的人身安全。随后，这不详的预感应验了……

Plot.11203.2.en: You get caught in a tense, high-speed chase against street racers. In a critical moment, Noya makes her choice...
Plot.11203.2.cn: 你们与飙车族进行了一场紧张刺激的追逐战。危险时刻，尘沙做出了她的选择……

Plot.11301.2.en: Commission From Shimiao: Case investigation... Wait, why does this sound dangerous?
Plot.11301.2.cn: 来自师渺的委托：案件调查。……等等，为什么听上去很危险？

Plot.11302.2.en: The first step in solving the case: retrace the steps of the Xuan Shi group!
Plot.11302.2.cn: 破案第一步，还原玄师们的行动轨迹！

Plot.11303.2.en: The truth comes to light... But a new commission appears?!
Plot.11303.2.cn: 案件真相大白之际，又有新的委托出现了？！

Plot.11401.1.cn: 名为“魔王试炼”的委托 上

Plot.11401.2.en: Ready to unlock your true power? Chaton is inviting you to a new commission.
Plot.11401.2.cn: 为了解放你真正的力量，猫眼邀请你一起做委托。

Plot.11402.1.cn: 名为“魔王试炼”的委托 中

Plot.11402.2.en: Building a Tyrant's army means starting them young.
Plot.11402.2.cn: 魔王军的培养，要从小孩子抓起。

Plot.11403.1.cn: 名为“魔王试炼”的委托 下

Plot.11403.2.en: Feeling energized and on a roll! It's the perfect time to beat that record!
Plot.11403.2.cn: 精神焕发，手感正热！是刷记录的好时机！

Plot.11501.1.en: Searching, Searching for a Friend, Part Ⅰ
Plot.11501.1.cn: 找呀找呀找朋友 上

Plot.11501.2.en: You decide to help Firefly make a new friend.
Plot.11501.2.cn: 你决定帮火垂找个新朋友。

Plot.11502.1.en: Searching, Searching for a Friend, Part Ⅱ
Plot.11502.1.cn: 找呀找呀找朋友 中

Plot.11502.2.en: You find a new candidate for a friend! But... Something's not right?
Plot.11502.2.cn: 找到朋友新候选人了！但……好像有点不对劲？

Plot.11503.1.en: Searching, Searching for a Friend, Part Ⅲ
Plot.11503.1.cn: 找呀找呀找朋友 下

Plot.11503.2.en: Teasing, sulking, and making up in a flash.
Plot.11503.2.cn: 捉弄，闹别扭，以及超快和好。

Plot.11601.2.en: You are invited to Ridge's greenhouse, but wait ... is it really just a greenhouse?
Plot.11601.2.cn: 受邀前往岭川的温室，等一下……这真的可以被称为温室吗？

Plot.11602.2.en: You and Ridge caught a few food thieves. What? They did it out of necessity?
Plot.11602.2.cn: 和岭川抓住了偷窃粮食的窃贼，什么？窃贼原来也有苦衷。

Plot.11603.2.en: The peas are thriving with Ridge's boost, but ... aren't they a little too big now? Oh no, the pea plants are eating people!
Plot.11603.2.cn: 豌豆在岭川的催化下长势喜人，不过这是不是过于庞大了。天呐，豌豆苗要吃人啦！

Plot.11701.1.en: Candy Hidden within the Promise, Part Ⅰ
Plot.11701.1.cn: 糖果藏在约定里 上

Plot.11701.2.en: "The place in front of you is the most popular restaurant in all of Philae!"—says the little manager proudly, her tail wagging.
Plot.11701.2.cn: 你面前的这家店，可是菲莱人气第一的餐馆哦！——小店长正摇晃着尾巴，自豪地介绍道。

Plot.11702.1.en: Candy Hidden within the Promise, Part Ⅱ
Plot.11702.1.cn: 糖果藏在约定里 中

Plot.11702.2.en: Beat a Loong master at mahjong? That challenge should be a piece of cake for the Boss!
Plot.11702.2.cn: 在麻雀牌上打败龙裔高手？这个挑战，魔王想必不在话下吧！

Plot.11703.1.en: Candy Hidden within the Promise, Part Ⅲ
Plot.11703.1.cn: 糖果藏在约定里 下

Plot.11703.2.en: "Thank you... For sticking with someone childish like me~"
Plot.11703.2.cn: “谢谢你……愿意陪着这个不着调的我~”

Plot.11801.2.en: The guild arrived at Coronis' clinic to confirm whether the Boss's sickness truly is terminal. From the expression on the three's faces, you realize your life is about to come to an end...
Plot.11801.2.cn: 为了确认魔王是否身患绝症，旅团的大家来到了科洛妮丝诊室。从三人的表情中，你意识到自己似乎命不久矣……

Plot.11802.2.en: As you stay and rest, you witness Coronis' superior medical practice techniques. Would a doctor with such skills be able to cheat death...?
Plot.11802.2.cn: 被留下养病的你，见识到了科洛妮丝精湛的医术。拥有如此能力的医生，究竟是否能起死回生……

Plot.11803.2.en: When you were discharged, Coronis bestowed upon you her treasured specimen.
Plot.11803.2.cn: 临别之际，科洛妮丝将珍藏的标本赠予了你。

Plot.11901.1.en: The Maid's Secret Mission, Part Ⅰ
Plot.11901.1.cn: 女仆的秘密任务 上

Plot.11901.2.cn: 女仆的任务一：分享甜蜜。

Plot.11902.1.en: The Maid's Secret Mission, Part Ⅱ
Plot.11902.1.cn: 女仆的秘密任务 中

Plot.11902.2.en: Maid's Mission Two: Win the Grand Prize.
Plot.11902.2.cn: 女仆的任务二：赢下大奖。

Plot.11903.1.en: The Maid's Secret Mission, Part Ⅲ
Plot.11903.1.cn: 女仆的秘密任务 下

Plot.11903.2.cn: 女仆的任务三：……骗你的，哪有什么任务！

Plot.12001.1.cn: 课后的秘密论文 上

Plot.12001.2.en: Nobody's told me that freelance Trekkers need to write papers!
Plot.12001.2.cn: 没人提过自由旅人也要写论文啊！

Plot.12002.1.cn: 课后的秘密论文 中

Plot.12003.1.cn: 课后的秘密论文 下

Plot.12003.2.en: Does anyone still remember that we came here to write a paper!
Plot.12003.2.cn: 还有人记得我们是来写论文的吗？

Plot.12301.1.cn: 睡不着的小守护者 上

Plot.12301.2.en: There's no age requirement for being a forest guardian.
Plot.12301.2.cn: 森林守护者这个职业是没有年龄限制的。

Plot.12302.1.en: The Sleepless Little Guardian, Part Ⅱ
Plot.12302.1.cn: 睡不着的小守护者 中

Plot.12302.2.en: Trap handling, medicine grinding, wound treatment, animal communication... Don't be surprised—these are all required skills.
Plot.12302.2.cn: 处理陷阱、捣药治伤、动物沟通。别惊讶，都是必修课。

Plot.12303.1.cn: 睡不着的小守护者 下

Plot.12303.2.en: When something doesn't make sense, get some sleep first. One day, you'll understand.
Plot.12303.2.cn: 想不通的事先睡一觉，总有一天会明白的。

Plot.12501.2.en: What does it take to become a Special Delivery Person at Post Haste?
Plot.12501.2.cn: 成为万送屋的“特邀嘉宾”，代价是什么？

Plot.12502.2.en: When the girl swings her great axe, the earth itself trembles.
Plot.12502.2.cn: 当少女挥动巨斧，大地为之震动。

Plot.12503.2.en: This time, the one standing across the ring is you.
Plot.12503.2.cn: 这一次，站在擂台对面的，是你。

Plot.12601.2.en: The grand stage of the Magician Maximus—today, you're the guest of honor.
Plot.12601.2.cn: 魔术大师的华美舞台，今天请你来当座上宾。

Plot.12602.2.en: A chance to be a big star's personal assistant—better make the most of it.
Plot.12602.2.cn: 给大明星当贴身助理的机会，可要好好把握。

Plot.12603.2.en: When the spotlight fades, she reveals the true secrets behind her "magic."
Plot.12603.2.cn: 褪去光环的她，为你揭开“魔术”的奥秘。

Plot.12701.1.en: The Nimble yet Unbreakable Messenger, Part Ⅰ
Plot.12701.1.cn: 机敏信使不会受伤 上

Plot.12701.2.en: They say that if you always walk by the water, your shoes are bound to get wet, but even so...
Plot.12701.2.cn: 虽说常在河边走哪有不湿鞋，但这也……

Plot.12702.1.en: The Nimble yet Unbreakable Messenger, Part Ⅱ
Plot.12702.1.cn: 机敏信使不会受伤 中

Plot.12702.2.en: Some people just have ... very strange talents.
Plot.12702.2.cn: 总有人把奇怪的天赋点得特别高。

Plot.12703.1.en: The Nimble yet Unbreakable Messenger, Part Ⅲ
Plot.12703.1.cn: 机敏信使不会受伤 下

Plot.12703.2.en: A band-aid can hide the wound, but not the fact that you were hurt.
Plot.12703.2.cn: 创可贴能遮住伤口，却不能遮住受伤的事实。

Plot.13001.2.en: Courier Donna knows the town like the back of her hand. This is the Donna with whom you're familiar.
Plot.13001.2.cn: 信使多娜了解这个城镇的每个角落，这是你熟悉的多娜。

Plot.13002.2.en: Donna of Post Haste loves to dress everyone up. Check out the new clothes she just made!
Plot.13002.2.cn: 万送屋的多娜喜欢打扮大家，看，这是她做的新衣服！

Plot.13003.2.en: Now which Donna do you see?
Plot.13003.2.cn: 那你现在看到的多娜是哪一面呢？

Plot.13201.1.cn: 不良少女的一天 上

Plot.13201.2.en: Throwing down over honor and turf is just another day's work for a "delinquent girl."
Plot.13201.2.cn: 赌上名誉和地盘的约架，是不良少女的日常工作。

Plot.13202.1.cn: 不良少女的一天 中

Plot.13202.2.en: The battlefield of pen and paper is the delinquent girl's voluntary overtime.
Plot.13202.2.cn: 使用纸笔的战场，是不良少女的主动加班。

Plot.13203.1.cn: 不良少女的一天 下

Plot.13203.2.en: Bombs! More bombs! Phantom Bomb Rider are her secret hobby.
Plot.13203.2.cn: “炸弹”，更多的“炸弹”，是不良少女的秘密爱好。

Plot.13301.1.en: Whispers in the Wind, Part Ⅰ

Plot.13301.2.en: The meaning of the pinwheel gift is a secret that I would never tell.
Plot.13301.2.cn: 风车的象征是秘密，绝不告诉你。

Plot.13302.1.en: Whispers in the Wind, Part Ⅱ

Plot.13302.2.en: The real reason for being late is a secret; I just wanted to share your burden.
Plot.13302.2.cn: 迟到的真相是秘密，想要为你分担压力。

Plot.13303.1.en: Whispers in the Wind, Part Ⅲ

Plot.13303.2.en: What I said that day is a secret; someday, I'll tell you what's truly in my heart.
Plot.13303.2.cn: 那天说过的话是秘密，总有一天会向你倾诉真心。

Plot.13401.2.en: The adventures have come to a temporary end. Growth has brought on new troubles. You and the timid white-haired girl reunite once again as Philae is slowly covered in snow.
Plot.13401.2.cn: 冒险暂告结束，成长带来新的烦恼，菲莱的飘雪下，你与那位有些怯懦的白发少女再度相遇。

Plot.13402.2.en: Her efforts may be clumsy, but they're sincere. And the change is happening before anyone realizes it.
Plot.13402.2.cn: 她的努力笨拙却真诚，改变正在不知不觉间发生。

Plot.13403.2.en: She speaks on the stage to say farewell to her past. With your help and care, she rediscovers her true self.
Plot.13403.2.cn: 用台上的演讲告别过去，在你的关照下，她阐释了真实的自己。

Plot.13501.1.cn: 魔女的特别专访 上

Plot.13501.2.en: Sensing a gaze on you, you turn around to find the Witch sneaking closer—as it turns out, she's plotting a big scoop!
Plot.13501.2.cn: 感受到身后恶寒，你发现魔女正在鬼鬼祟祟的靠近中——原来她想要搞个大新闻！

Plot.13502.1.cn: 魔女的特别专访 中

Plot.13502.2.en: The Boss and the Witch arrange a private, up-close interview, only for a mysterious thug to crash the scene!
Plot.13502.2.cn: 魔王与魔女相约进行贴身专访，神秘歹徒竟乱入其中！

Plot.13503.1.cn: 魔女的特别专访 下

Plot.13503.2.en: After an honest heart-to-heart with the Witch, their most guarded secret is about to be revealed!
Plot.13503.2.cn: 与魔女坦诚交心的事后！两人最特殊的秘密，即将在此揭开！

Plot.14001.1.cn: 斯帕克拉的烦恼 上

Plot.14001.2.en: A genius inventor has unexpectedly hit a creative wall. Where should I go to find new inspiration?
Plot.14001.2.cn: 天才发明家竟意外陷入瓶颈期，我该去哪里寻找新的灵感？

Plot.14002.1.cn: 斯帕克拉的烦恼 中

Plot.14002.2.en: I only acknowledge people who truly understand my inventions~
Plot.14002.2.cn: 我只认可，懂我发明的人~

Plot.14003.1.cn: 斯帕克拉的烦恼 下

Plot.14003.2.en: Boss, what kind of features do you want to add to Tyrant Pie? I can make anything happen, you know~
Plot.14003.2.cn: 魔王，你想给魔王派，加点什么功能呢？我啊，都能满足~

Plot.14101.2.en: Spooky things continue to happen in the wilderness outside the city. There are suspicions of areas being "haunted." The cowardly Xuan Shi is tasked with the incident... With only one step into the village, Xuan Shi began to scream frantically—
Plot.14101.2.cn: 城外荒村怪事连连，或有“闹鬼”的嫌疑，胆小的玄师临危受命，却从踏入村口就开始尖叫——

Plot.14102.2.en: Does the old diary's record of that unfinished wedding contain a trace of regret? A shadow flickers—could it really be a ghost?
Plot.14102.2.cn: 旧日记本记录的那场婚礼是否留有遗憾？未知的黑影闪现，难道是真的有“鬼”？

Plot.14103.2.en: Are the secrets veiled by night the doings of "ghosts" or simply humans? As the candlelight flickers, it points to what took place beneath the red silk.
Plot.14103.2.cn: 藏在黑夜中的秘密，到底是真的有“鬼”还是人为的捉弄，烛火摇曳，指向红绸缎下的那一段往事。

Plot.14201.2.en: Supposedly a date invitation ... But there's no way it's a normal date, right!?
Plot.14201.2.cn: 说是约会邀约……但绝对不会是正常的约会吧！？

Plot.14202.2.en: Always remember the main goal of this "date" is to gather intel... Huh?? What drink?!
Plot.14202.2.cn: 时刻记得“约会”的首要目的，是打探……嗯？？什么饮料？？！

Plot.14203.2.en: This "date" is actually kinda fun... Oh no! I forgot all about the mission!
Plot.14203.2.cn: “约会”好像还挺开心的……糟了！把任务忘记了！

Plot.14301.1.en: The You I Know, Part Ⅰ

Plot.14301.2.en: Elite warriors have elite appetites... Wait, what do you mean you almost died from skipping meals?
Plot.14301.2.cn: 精锐的战士，也有精锐的胃……嗯？什么叫忘记吃饭差点饿死了？

Plot.14302.1.en: The You I Know, Part Ⅱ

Plot.14302.2.en: You said you were going to hunt some food, but what's with this entire BEAR?
Plot.14302.2.cn: 你说要去搞点野味，但这头熊是怎么回事？

Plot.14303.1.en: The You I Know, Part Ⅲ

Plot.14303.2.en: Are you taking them off?! Right here, right now?!

Plot.14401.1.cn: 人刀合一的修行 上

Plot.14401.2.en: You ran into Chitose on the street, and the two of you started talking about how to achieve the state of Oneness...
Plot.14401.2.cn: 与千都世在街上偶然会面，然后聊起了关于“人刀合一”的修行……

Plot.14402.1.cn: 人刀合一的修行 中

Plot.14402.2.en: They say if you hold your breath, focus, and gaze into each other's eyes, your hearts will connect... But for two people who are always out of sync, can it really work?
Plot.14402.2.cn: 据说，屏气凝神，注视彼此，就能心意相通……总是错位的彼此，努力能否成功？

Plot.14403.1.cn: 人刀合一的修行 下

Plot.14403.2.en: The rain poured down, and she seemed a little dejected. In that moment, you realized the duty you must fulfill as the "Wielder..."
Plot.14403.2.cn: 大雨倾盆，她略显失落。此刻，你意识到了作为“持刀人”的应尽之责……

Plot.14501.2.en: Driven by hidden designs, she engineered your crossing of paths.
Plot.14501.2.cn: 怀着不可告人的目的，她精心制造了一场偶遇。

Plot.14502.2.en: Step by step, her guidance leads you right into the spotlight.
Plot.14502.2.cn: 你跟随着她的引导，一步步走上早已布置好的舞台。

Plot.14503.2.en: As the curtain drops, who can truly tell the mask from the face beneath?
Plot.14503.2.cn: 表演落幕之后，真实与伪装，又该如何分辨？

Plot.14701.1.en: Echo of Hearts and Stars, Part Ⅰ

Plot.14701.2.en: Given the task of "healing the trauma of war-ridden Trekkers," a troubled Boss unexpectedly hears a familiar melody in Flavio...
Plot.14701.2.cn: 接受了“治愈旅人心伤”的委托，烦恼的魔王在弗拉维奥遇见了熟悉的旋律……

Plot.14702.1.en: Echo of Hearts and Stars, Part Ⅱ

Plot.14702.2.en: Caramel asks you to become her personal producer. You think of a great way for her to get inspired...
Plot.14702.2.cn: 焦糖拜托你成为她的制作人，而你给出的寻觅灵感的答案是……

Plot.14703.1.en: Echo of Hearts and Stars, Part Ⅲ

Plot.14703.2.en: At the Trekker Camp beneath the Monolith, you and Caramel step on the stage. Flavio's next legend is about to be born...
Plot.14703.2.cn: 在星塔之下的旅人营地，你和焦糖迈向舞台，弗拉维奥的传说即将在此铸就……

Plot.14901.2.en: An unbreakable cursed bond. An unforeseen reunion.
Plot.14901.2.cn: 一段无法斩断的孽缘，一场意料之外的重逢。

Plot.14902.2.en: What terrible secrets lie behind those wild, cynical eyes?
Plot.14902.2.cn: 在那狂乱无序，玩世不恭的眼神背后，有着怎样不可告人的秘密？

Plot.14903.2.en: The reins of fate have been placed in your hands—you are destined to tame the ravenous beast before you.
Plot.14903.2.cn: 命运的缰绳已经递到了你的手上，你注定要驯服眼前饥渴的怪物。

Plot.15001.2.en: No work talk while fishing on company time! But if you catch a fish, Laru will hear you out~
Plot.15001.2.cn: 摸鱼时间不谈工作，不过你要是钓到鱼了，菈露愿意听你说说~

Plot.15002.2.en: Even if you only catch a strand of weed, it still counts as a catch—but you said fries, what fries?!
Plot.15002.2.cn: 就算只有一根水草也不算空军，但你说薯条订购，什么薯条？！

Plot.15003.2.en: At this point, Laru's future is in your hands...!
Plot.15003.2.cn: 事已至此，菈露的未来就只能指望你了……！

Plot.15501.2.en: A scent adrift on the sea breeze, stirring memories.
Plot.15501.2.cn: 飘散在海风中，令人怀念的气味。

Plot.15502.2.en: A scent lingering in the old alleys, long since vanished.
Plot.15502.2.cn: 回荡于街巷间，已然消失的气味。

Plot.15503.2.en: A scent clinging to your back, constant and unchanging.
Plot.15503.2.cn: 紧贴在背后的，永恒不变的气味。

Plot.15601.1.en: Big Cleanup Job in a Small Room, Part Ⅰ

Plot.15601.2.en: Death K has delivered the final verdict, the end draws near. And then—that person appeared.
Plot.15601.2.cn: 死神下达了最后的判决，终结将至。这时，那个人出现了。

Plot.15602.1.en: Big Cleanup Job in a Small Room, Part Ⅱ

Plot.15602.2.en: Even with eyes clouded by desire and a soul worn down by time, they never stopped moving forward.
Plot.15602.2.cn: 就算双眼被欲望蒙蔽、灵魂被时间折磨，那个人也未曾停下脚步。

Plot.15603.1.en: Big Cleanup Job in a Small Room, Part Ⅲ

Plot.15603.2.en: The crisis was averted. Following those footsteps, her adventure had only just begun.
Plot.15603.2.cn: 危机解除了。追随着那个人的脚步，她的冒险才刚刚开始。

Plot.15701.2.en: Come on, Karin, let's give Shia a surprise! Wait, no—not that way!
Plot.15701.2.cn: 为了给希娅一个惊喜，加油啊，小花铃——等一下！不是走那边！

Plot.15702.2.en: Even if your signature skill is sealed, there's no need to worry. You're not alone, remember?
Plot.15702.2.cn: 就算被封印了引以为傲的技能也别担心，这里不是还有另一个人在嘛~

Plot.15703.2.en: Of course, there's a reward waiting at the finish line. But honestly, her face when she sees it is the real treat!
Plot.15703.2.cn: 到达终点后，当然要给一点奖励了。不过她的反应也是另一种美味呢~

Plot.15801.2.en: The Snowish Festival has already passed, but the work isn't over, and the new mission is... Huh? A cannon?!
Plot.15801.2.cn: 雪愿节已经过去，但工作不会结束，新的任务是……嗯？大炮？！

Plot.15802.2.en: First test of the cannon delivery system, the capsule we fired... Why is it coming back?
Plot.15802.2.cn: 大炮配送系统首次测试，发射出去的胶囊……为什么飞回来了？

Plot.15803.2.en: If the gift of gratitude were me, myself... Of course, I'm just kidding!
Plot.15803.2.cn: 感恩的礼物如果是我的话，这当然是开玩笑的啦！

Plot.15901.2.en: While vacationing in Cangwu, she casually wrote a few more prescriptions.
Plot.15901.2.cn: 来到苍梧度假的她，又顺手开了几个处方。

Plot.15902.2.en: A cup of herbal tea threw the doctor into a predicament—"Assistant," come help her.
Plot.15902.2.cn: 因为一杯消食茶，医生陷入了困境——“助手”，快来帮帮她！

Plot.15903.2.en: Among the Loong's many well-known methods of self-care, massage is by far the most renowned.
Plot.15903.2.cn: 说起龙裔最著名的养生技巧——那自然是按摩。

Plot.16001.2.en: Finally, a holiday! Why is my schedule already exploding with random drama?!
Plot.16001.2.cn: 珍贵的假期开始，但事与愿违，突发的事件还是填满了所有时间。

Plot.16002.2.en: Work??? Ⅴacation??? Forget it—another event has popped up!
Plot.16002.2.cn: 工作？？度假？？别想了又有新的事件发生了！

Plot.16003.2.en: It's a hard-to-come-by holiday, so why not clock out for once and just enjoy the vacation?
Plot.16003.2.cn: 这是一次难得的假期，不如就暂时放下工作，去享受假日吧。

ScoreBossAbility.100001.2.en:
The boss starts with 1 stack of Berserk and gains 1 stack every 10s (up to 5 stacks). Each stack increases the boss' DMG by &Param1&</color>.

[Event Period]
12:00, Jul 21, 2026 – 04:00, Aug 4, 2026

[Requirement]
Authorization Level ≥10

[Details]
1. In Through Hostile Depths, you will match your wits against a mysterious sage, leading the Trekkers under your command—along with powerful allies and former foes—as Chess Pieces to play out the match!
2. Completing challenges will earn you points. Accumulate the required point total to complete missions and claim the rewards.

【活动时间】
2026/07/21 12:00~2026/08/04 04:00 

【参与条件】
权限等级≥10级

【活动说明】
1、在“尖兵陷阵”模式中，您将与神秘的智者对弈，以您麾下的旅人或是曾为敌为友的强力成员作为棋子，展开棋局！。
2、完成对弈挑战将会累计积分，累计至任务所需积分即可完成任务获得奖励。

StarTower.102.2.en:
The Monolith is shrouded by shadows and vapor. The vibe and atmosphere here is depressing and suffocating...
Trekkers who wield the element of Lux or Terra will have an advantage here.
StarTower.102.2.cn:
遍布着阴影与水汽的星塔。堕入此处的情感，让人压抑而难以呼吸……
掌控地或光属性的旅人，在此会获得优势。

StarTowerBookEventReward.10301.2.en:
This is a phone-shaped ... game console?
More accurately, it's more like a kind of arcade machine from the Monolith's Game Room, a device that can never be brought out of the Monolith.
The device looked exactly like a Trekker's communication Artifact, but it couldn't make calls or send messages—it's only for games, and each one seemed to have a different game installed.
The first one Amber tried was a crate-pushing game. Every time she slid a crate into its designated spot, a Stella Coin dispensed from the bottom.
That day, Amber won a whole pouch of coins from that one machine alone.
StarTowerBookEventReward.10301.2.cn:
这是一种只能在星塔里找到的长得像手机的……游戏机？
准确来说，这是在星塔的游戏厅里发现的东西——也就是说，只能在星塔里玩，却带不走它。
它的样子，和旅人们在用的通讯神器别无二致，但这个手机无法通讯发信息，只能玩游戏，而且似乎不同的手机里的游戏，并不一样。
琥珀第一次在游戏厅里发现这个手机时，游戏的内容是让一个小人推箱子——只要推到指定的地方，就会从手机底部掉出来一个辉光币。
那一天，琥珀光是靠这个就赢了一大兜辉光币。

StarTowerBookEventReward.10301.3.en: Clear Monolith with Amber in your squad once

StarTowerBookEventReward.10302.2.en:
Amber found another game phone.
This one featured a snake that ate pellets to grow longer. Crashing into a wall or its own tail meant game over.
Amber wasn't very good at this kind of game. Before the little snake could grow much, she would accidentally crash it into the wall.
"So hard..."
After a few tries, Amber put the Monolith phone back where she found it and left.
But for the rest of the day, she daydreamed about a different version: a big cat picking up kittens, which would then follow behind to form a long kitten train. Now that was a game she would've stuck with for longer.
StarTowerBookEventReward.10302.2.cn:
琥珀又发现了一台新的游戏手机。
这一次的游戏是，吃豆子的蛇，屏幕里的蛇会越吃越长，长到一不小心就会因为撞到自己尾巴——撞到自己或者墙都意味着输。
琥珀不太擅长这种类型的小游戏，每次还没等小蛇长长，就先一步撞在了“墙”上。
“好难……”
试了几次之后，琥珀把游戏手机放回原处就离开了。
不过那一整天，琥珀都在想，如果这个小游戏不是蛇而是猫猫，大猫猫在路上捡小猫猫，捡到的小猫猫跟着大猫猫走，变成一条长长的猫猫火车，可能自己就会愿意再多努力一会儿了。

StarTowerBookEventReward.10302.3.en: Clear Monolith with Amber in your squad 2 times

StarTowerBookEventReward.10303.2.en:
"Not a game today?"
The screen only had a single button: "Gacha," but tapping it only summoned a pop-up: "Insufficient tokens. Please recharge."
"30 Stella Coins for 1 draw, 128 for 10, 648 for 60...?"
She chose the cheapest option and hit the button.
The screen lit up with a flash of rainbow light, then out popped a black longhair cat. It meowed twice at Amber and that was it.
"What is this...?"
The cat was cute, but Amber knew full well it wasn't going to step out of the screen.
By the time she left, she had emptied her entire pouch of Stella Coins.
StarTowerBookEventReward.10303.2.cn:
“今天……不是游戏？”
琥珀发现屏幕上只有一个“抽卡”的按钮，但点击之后只会弹出提醒：没有抽卡道具，请充值。
“30辉光币1次，128辉光币10次，648辉光币60次……？”
琥珀选择了最便宜的那个，然后点下了“抽卡”。
随着屏幕闪现七彩的光，出现了一只黑色的长毛猫猫，它在屏幕里冲琥珀喵喵两声，然后就没有动静了。
“这到底是什么……？”
猫猫很可爱，但猫猫并不会变成真的走出来——虽然她很清楚这个道理。
今天的琥珀离开的时候，她发现自己兜里的辉光币已经清空了。

StarTowerBookEventReward.10303.3.en: Clear Monolith with Amber in your squad 3 times

StarTowerBookEventReward.10701.2.en:
Lately, Tilia's been obsessed with collecting Masked Knights cards.
She's always muttering about rarities, secret cards, and completing the set,
leaving everyone around her baffled.
"Hey, is Tilia only eating "Monolith Premium" instant noodles now? Must be a new flavor or something."
"It's awful!" Tilia cried out.
"I'm only buying it for the holographic Masked Knights cards! I still can't pull the last one... I'm getting ten more packs on my way home!"
"Uh-huh..."
And just like that, Tilia was lost in her own world again.
StarTowerBookEventReward.10701.2.cn:
缇莉娅最近在收集的东西，是一种印着《蒙面骑士》的小卡片。
她总在嘴边念叨着什么——稀有度啊，隐藏卡啊，全收集啊……之类的事。
身边的人听得云里雾里。
“说起来，缇莉娅最近吃的都是星塔严选的泡面？这是什么新出的口味吗？这么好吃？”
“不好吃！！！”缇莉娅大声抗议，
“要不是这个系列的泡面里有《蒙面骑士》的反光幻彩小卡，我才不会买呢！可恶……怎么就差最后一张无论如何都抽不到……回去我要再去买十包！”
“哦……”
缇莉娅又说起了别人听不懂的话。

StarTowerBookEventReward.10701.3.en: Clear Monolith with Tilia in your squad once
StarTowerBookEventReward.10701.3.cn: 携带缇莉娅通关1次星塔

StarTowerBookEventReward.10702.2.en:
Today, Tilia was eating instant noodles once again.
"Tilia, are you okay? You don't look so good."
"I'm fine... Just feel like throwing up from eating too much instant noodles..."
At the mention of it, Tilia looked like she was about to cry. Then she launched into a full five-minute rant.
She had lost count of how many packs she'd eaten,
yet that final Masked Knights hologram still wouldn't appear.
She was ready to quit,
but after all the noodles she'd choked down and the money she'd spent... She was in too deep to stop now.
Just one more...
With grim determination, she ripped the pack open—
StarTowerBookEventReward.10702.2.cn:
今天的缇莉娅又在吃泡面。
“缇莉娅你还好吗？你脸色看上去很差耶？”
“我很好，我只是泡面吃太多现在很想吐而已……”
一提到这个，缇莉娅露出了快要哭的表情，接着就是长达五分钟的倾诉——
她说着，自己已经不知道吃了多少盒泡面了。
但她收集的《蒙面骑士》反光幻彩小卡，却还剩下最后一张，始终拆不出来。
她已经快想要放弃了。
但已经吞下去的面，花掉的钱，托人帮忙换的人情……如此巨大的沉没成本让她无法就这样割舍。
再，再吃最后一碗……！
她毅然决然地撕开包装纸——

StarTowerBookEventReward.10702.3.en: Clear Monolith with Tilia in your squad twice
StarTowerBookEventReward.10702.3.cn: 携带缇莉娅通关2次星塔

StarTowerBookEventReward.10703.2.en:
"Still nothing—!" Her hope crashed
She'd blown her entire monthly allowance on instant noodles, and this was her last pack.
Where in the world was that final Masked Knights card? It's nowhere to be seen.
The question followed her everywhere. Then, one day near a Monolith, she spotted it: another Trekker was holding the shimmering, final card.
"Trade me! I'll give you anything! Please!"
She got her wish. The price was completing the Trekker's Monolith commission for the day—an easy task she gladly accepted.
Her joy didn't last long. A stunning revelation hit her:
you could just wish for the cards inside a Monolith. Any one you wanted.
Still, Tilia had no regrets. The struggle was real, but so was the thrill of finally completing her collection.
StarTowerBookEventReward.10703.2.cn:
“还是没有嘛——！”虽抱有希望，但回敬缇莉娅的还是失望。
缇莉娅已经在泡面上花完了这个月的所有补贴，这已经是她能拆的最后一包了。
一直没得到的那最后一张《蒙面骑士》的小卡片……究竟会在哪里？
她带着这个疑问巡逻、值班、吃饭、睡觉……直到在某次星塔附近遇到其他旅人时，她发现了亮闪闪的最后一张——
“跟我换吧！！我什么都会给你的！！请你把它给我吧！！！”
她最终如愿以偿，不过交换条件是，替旅人完成今天的爬塔委托——这种小事，她当然愿意！
不过她没有高兴很久，就迎来了属于她的晴天霹雳——不知是好事还是坏事的那种。
这种小卡片在星塔里居然也能被许愿出来，想要哪张，就有哪张。
不过缇莉娅没有后悔，毕竟自己努力吃泡面时的感动是真实的，拆出卡片时的感动也是真实的。

StarTowerBookEventReward.10703.3.en: Clear Monolith with Tilia in your squad 3 times
StarTowerBookEventReward.10703.3.cn: 携带缇莉娅通关3次星塔

StarTowerBookEventReward.10801.2.en:
This was one of Kasimira's little pleasures during her adventures in the Monolith.
"It's time to roll the dice!"
She put six dice into a cup. The game was a classic: high or low.
A squadmate who was in a good mood wagered a pack of instant noodles and decided to go all-in.
Kasimira rummaged through her bag. She hadn't brought any noodles today, but she was feeling confident.
"High or low?"
"High!"
"Alright, let's see!"
Five seconds later, Kasimira was dutifully handing over the noodle's equivalent value in Stella Coins.
StarTowerBookEventReward.10801.2.cn:
这是卡西米拉在星塔冒险途中的一个小小的乐趣。
“趁现在，赌一把吧！”
她拿着一个骰蛊，装入六粒骰子，今天玩的是经典的猜大小。
同行的队友今天心情不错，押了一袋泡面，决定跟卡西米拉豪赌一把。
卡西米拉翻了翻自己的包，今天她没有带泡面，但她自信自己今天应该运势不错——
“买大买小？”
“大！”
“好咧，开！”
五秒后，卡西米拉按星塔商店的价格，老实把辉光币分给了队友。

StarTowerBookEventReward.10801.3.en: Clear Monolith with Kasimira in your squad once
StarTowerBookEventReward.10801.3.cn: 携带卡西米拉通关1次星塔

StarTowerBookEventReward.10802.2.en:
Today, Kasimira was once again looking for someone to play high-or-low with.
While White Cat Squad was taking a break, Kasimira was tugging at an ally's sleeve, saying she'd made a wish to Pep Pep Juice before setting out, so her luck today must be through the roof.
The squadmate was already used to this kind of talk from her, but seeing how excited she looked, she finally gave in and agreed to a round.
It was best two out of three. Kasimira wagered a newly acquired Artifact, clearly full of faith in her rituals.
Unfortunately, the outcome was as a familiar one. Kasimira meekly handed over her Stella Coins.
Even after they left the Monolith, Kasimira was still muttering about why Pep Pep Juice didn't grant her wish.
StarTowerBookEventReward.10802.2.cn:
今天的卡西米拉又在找人赌大小。
白猫小队正在原地休整，卡西米拉正拉着身边的队友，说她今天出发前对能量沛沛进行了祈愿，今天的她一定运气爆棚。
队友对她的这套说辞早已习以为常，但看她一副兴致勃勃的样子，最后还是顶不住卡西米拉的邀请，决定跟她赌一局。
三局两胜，卡西米拉押上了她刚刚许愿出的神器，看上去是对那个“求福玄学”充满了自信。
只可惜，结果还是一如既往，卡西米拉老实地又把辉光币分给了队友。
直到她从星塔离开，卡西米拉还在碎碎念为何能量沛沛没有回应她的愿望。

StarTowerBookEventReward.10802.3.en: Clear Monolith with Kasimira in your squad twice
StarTowerBookEventReward.10802.3.cn: 携带卡西米拉通关2次星塔

StarTowerBookEventReward.10803.2.en:
Kasimira loved playing high-low, but her luck wasn't great. Actually... It was pretty bad.
"Maybe we should let her win this one time?"
One day, a few of Kasimira's squadmates whispered behind her back. All of them had won plenty from her already, and the more it happened, the guiltier they felt.
So they all agreed to a plan to let Kasimira finally win one without her realizing it.
"Wanna bet on a round?"
"What's the special occasion?" Kasimira asked, surprised, since it was rare for her squadmates to make the offer.
"No reason. It's about time you had a win."
"Heh, well then, thanks for sharing the good luck."
In truth, Kasimira knew of their plan. She just kept quiet about it.
StarTowerBookEventReward.10803.2.cn:
卡西米拉很喜欢找人赌大小，但她的运气一直很一般，甚至可以说，很差。
“要不我们让她一次吧？”
某天，同行的队友背着她偷偷商量，几个人都在卡西米拉那赢过不少东西，次数多了，总有些不太好意思。
于是她们一拍即合，在卡西米拉没有注意的地方，商量好了作弊的方法，计划让卡西米拉赢一次。
“来赌一局吧？”
“今天吹的什么风？”面对难得的来自队友的提议，卡西米拉感到非常意外。
“没事，今天也该轮到你赢一次了。”
“嘿嘿，那就谢谢你们分享福气咯。”
其实卡西米拉什么都知道，只是她不说。

StarTowerBookEventReward.10803.3.en: Clear Monolith with Kasimira in your squad 3 times
StarTowerBookEventReward.10803.3.cn: 携带卡西米拉通关3次星塔

StarTowerBookEventReward.11001.2.en:
It wasn't the first time Firenze had seen that music box.
The first time must have been when a Stellaroid had it. After her squad took the Stellaroid down, Firenze had picked the little box up from the ground.
She hadn't known what it was for; only that when she wound the lever on the side, it would start to spin and play a tune.
But Firenze didn't care for the box's plain appearance, nor the cheerful music it played, so she set it aside without much thought and left.
Ever since then, every time she entered a Monolith, she would encounter that music box again.
"I don't like your music. There's no point in following me around."
Firenze muttered under her breath to the box without even knowing why.
StarTowerBookEventReward.11001.2.cn:
翡冷翠不是第一次见到这个音乐盒。
最开始好像是在一个星骸手里。当时的翡冷翠一行人消灭了星骸之后，从地上捡起了这个小盒子。
她并不知道这个小盒子有什么用，只是拧动旁边的杠杆时，这个小盒子会开始运转，然后传出音乐。
但翡冷翠不喜欢这个小盒子的朴素，也不喜欢这个小盒子传出来的欢乐的乐曲。于是便随手把它放在了一边。
从那之后，只要翡冷翠进星塔，她总能在不同的地方看到这个小盒子。
“我不喜欢你的音乐，跟着我是没有意义的。”
神使鬼差地，翡冷翠对着那个小盒子自言自语了一句。

StarTowerBookEventReward.11001.3.en: Clear Monolith with Firenze in your squad once
StarTowerBookEventReward.11001.3.cn: 携带翡冷翠通关1次星塔

StarTowerBookEventReward.11002.2.en:
It was a long time before Firenze saw the music box again.
She'd heard that familiar cheerful melody and looked over to see the plain little box in the hands of a middle-aged Trekker in her group.
They were taking a break, and the man looked excited. He said he'd just found the singing box tucked in a corner and thought it was interesting. He wanted to take it home to his young daughter.
In the midst of his excitement, he suddenly noticed that Firenze was watching him. He grew flustered.
"Uh... Are you interested in this, by any chance?"
"No. It doesn't suit me. Take it if you like."
StarTowerBookEventReward.11002.2.cn:
再一次看到那个音乐盒，已经是隔了很久之后的事情。
翡冷翠听到了那段熟悉的欢快的乐曲，顺着声音看去，那个朴素的小盒子在她们同行的一个中年旅人手里。
他们正在原地休整，那个旅人有些激动，他刚刚在角落里见到了这个会唱歌的小盒子，觉得很有意思，想带回家给他的小女儿。
他说得激动，忽然注意到了翡冷翠的视线，顿时有些尴尬。
“那个……翡冷翠大人对这个感兴趣吗？”
“不感兴趣，它不适合我，你喜欢就拿去吧。”

StarTowerBookEventReward.11002.3.en: Clear Monolith with Firenze in your squad twice
StarTowerBookEventReward.11002.3.cn: 携带翡冷翠通关2次星塔

StarTowerBookEventReward.11003.2.en:
Later, Firenze spotted the music box again in a second-hand shop.
At first, she was annoyed, thinking how the man had bothered to invent a story for her only to sell the box for money.
But her frustration subsided after she asked the shopkeeper about its origins.
"He ... couldn't survive in Philae? Had to sell everything he owned and leave..."
She began to reflect on the relationship between United Harvest and the city.
"I'll take this."
She then placed the music box squarely in the most prominent spot in her office.
She still disliked the melody, but the bitter story it carried was a stark reminder, one that would keep her clear-eyed about her company and the state of Philae.
StarTowerBookEventReward.11003.2.cn:
后来，翡冷翠在二手商店里又看到了这个音乐盒。
她起初有些恼火，心想着，何必还要当着她的面说这样的理由，结果还是用来卖钱。
不过当她向店主打听了物品的来源后，她释然了不少。
“在菲莱……没法生存下去，不得不变卖了所有东西搬走吗……？”
她开始思考起了联合种业与这座城的关系。
“这个，我买下了。”
她端正地将这个音乐盒放在了自己办公室里最显眼的地方。
虽然这首曲子她还是不喜欢，但它所背负的这个稍有苦涩的故事，能让她对公司、对菲莱的现状保持清醒。

StarTowerBookEventReward.11003.3.en: Clear Monolith with Firenze in your squad 3 times
StarTowerBookEventReward.11003.3.cn: 携带翡冷翠通关3次星塔

StarTowerBookEventReward.11101.2.en:
Iris once met someone purely by chance inside a Monolith who, when Iris was injured, extended her a helping hand.
Her mindset was the complete opposite of Iris's: giving without expecting anything in return, receiving without guilt or hesitation. She believed in that a person's gain and loss were already determined for this lifetime. There was no ledger that could be balanced.
Iris couldn't make sense of such logic. To her, nothing came without a price. If there was such a thing as a free lunch, it would be the most expensive kind. Kindness was the type of debt that was most difficult to repay.
In the end, the woman refused any kind of "thank-you gift," but out of respect for Iris's beliefs, she accepted a single Dorra.
StarTowerBookEventReward.11101.2.cn:
鸢尾遇到过这么一个旅人，她们只是在星塔里偶然的相遇，她在鸢尾受伤的时候向她伸出援手。
她和鸢尾是截然相反：付出不求回报，得到也不会不安。她相信人活着的一生，得失是注定的，得到什么，失去什么，都不是当下的交换能平衡的。
鸢尾不能理解她说的话。在鸢尾看来，得到就得付出，世界上没有免费的午餐，免费的东西才是最贵的，人情最难偿还了。
最后，她拒绝了任何“谢礼”，但为了尊重鸢尾的理念，她拿走了一朵拉的硬币。

StarTowerBookEventReward.11101.3.en: Clear Monolith with Iris in your squad once

StarTowerBookEventReward.11102.2.en:
"If you want something from me, isn't it only natural for you to pay for it?"
That's what Iris always says.
But when it comes to setting a price, whether for a trade or a favor, her terms are always so unexpectedly "cheap" that it leaves people stunned. Noya, in particular, struggles to understand her approach to these wildly unbalanced "transactions."
Does Iris really want the money or not?
One day, after Noya hounded her with this question, Iris let out a sigh.
"I don't want to owe anyone anything, and I don't want anyone to feel like they owe me anything. Give and take—that's how people stay connected, isn't it?"
Noya nodded without fully understanding what she meant.
But perhaps that's just Iris's way of dealing with the world.
StarTowerBookEventReward.11102.2.cn:
“想要我手里的东西，用钱来买不是理所当然的事情吗？”
鸢尾总会这么说。
但对于交易的定价，又或者帮助的酬劳，却又总是“廉价”得让人大跌眼镜。尘沙对她的这种根本不等价的“交易”的行为尤其不理解。
鸢尾到底是想要钱，还是不想要钱呢？
某天，在尘沙的追问下，鸢尾叹了口气。
“我既不想欠下谁的人情，也不想让人对我留有亏欠感，而且，有来有往，才能称之为‘来往’，不是吗？”
尘沙似懂非懂。
大概这就是鸢尾的处世之道吧。

StarTowerBookEventReward.11102.3.en: Clear Monolith with Iris in your squad twice

StarTowerBookEventReward.11103.2.en:
On her birthday, Noya and Amber gave Iris a box of cookies.
They weren't expensive, but they weren't cheap, either. The pair must have saved for a long time or run a few commissions on the sly to afford them.
Whatever the case, the moment Iris took the box, it felt heavier than cookies ever should.
But seeing Noya's beaming smile and Amber's hopeful gaze, she accepted the precious gift with a smile of her own.
They gave her cookies. In return, she would give them her trust and her all.
For Iris, this was the most priceless exchange of all.
StarTowerBookEventReward.11103.2.cn:
生日的那天，尘沙与琥珀送给了鸢尾一盒曲奇。
曲奇的价格不算贵，但也说不上便宜。那或许是尘沙和琥珀攒了很久的钱买下来的，也可能是她们偷偷结伴去做了一些委托后买的。
总之，在接下曲奇的那一刻，鸢尾总觉得手中的分量，比一盒曲奇要重得多。
但是看着笑得灿烂的尘沙，还有一脸期待的琥珀，她还是笑着收下了这份在她看来略有贵重的礼物。
她们送她一份曲奇，而她将回赠她们自己的信任、付出与依赖。
在鸢尾看来，这就是最为珍贵的等价交换。

StarTowerBookEventReward.11103.3.en: Clear Monolith with Iris in your squad 3 times

StarTowerBookEventReward.11201.1.en: When You Wish Upon Pep Pep Juice (1)

StarTowerBookEventReward.11201.2.en:
Wishing on Pep Pep Juice brings good luck.
No one really knows when this strange rumor started spreading among Trekkers. Why Pep Pep Juice? What kind of magic could it possibly have to make good things happen—and what kind of good things, anyway? It all sounds like a nonsense urban legend.
"It's not a rumor!! I once wished for money in front of Pep Pep, and I actually found some Dorra!"
Noya protested the others' skepticism.
"And it's not just Pep Pep! People also say that wishing to Sherlock the Penguin or to Portia at the convenience store will bring good luck, too!"
Nothing ever sounded odd coming from Noya, and her stories always had a strange way of being believable.
StarTowerBookEventReward.11201.2.cn:
向能量沛沛祈愿，就会有好事情发生。
不知道从什么时候开始，旅人之间有了这么一个莫名其妙的传言。为什么是能量沛沛，这东西又有什么魔力可以让好事发生，又会发生什么。总之，听上去像是无稽之谈。 
“才不是谣言呢！！我之前对着能量沛沛祈愿想要有钱，结果真的捡到朵拉了！”
尘沙对这个猜测表示抗议。
“而且也不是只有能量沛沛哦，还有传言说对着企鹅夏洛克祈愿、对着便利店的波西亚祈愿都会有好事发生哦！”
从尘沙嘴里说出来任何话都不奇怪，而且可信度往往异乎寻常的高。

StarTowerBookEventReward.11201.3.en: Clear Monolith with Noya in your squad once

StarTowerBookEventReward.11202.1.en: When You Wish Upon Pep Pep Juice (2)

StarTowerBookEventReward.11202.2.en:
So how did the rumor start?
There are all kinds of stories, but the most widely told version goes like this: When a Trekker came under attack by a Stellaroid, she happened to be holding a bottle of Pep Pep Juice. In that moment of desperation, she wished to Pep Pep that she would survive. The bottle flew from her hand and hit the Stellaroid square on its head, knocking it out cold. The Trekker made it out alive. Ever since then, the legend of "wishing upon Pep Pep Juice" started to spread.
Noya who was, squatting nearby and listening in, tilted her head and pointed to herself.
"Wait, wasn't that me? That was seriously dangerous! I almost died back then!"
StarTowerBookEventReward.11202.2.cn:
所以传言是从哪里开始的？
大家众说纷纭，但流传最广的版本是，一开始是一个旅人在遇到星骸袭击的时候，手里正好拿着能量沛沛，她在危急时刻向能量沛沛祈愿，希望自己能顺利度过这次危机，结果脱手而出的能量沛沛正好砸在了星骸头上，于是那个星骸晕倒了，旅人也成功获救。从那之后，“向能量沛沛祈愿”这个传言就流传开了。
尘沙蹲在一旁听完，歪着头指着自己。
“那不是我遇到的事情吗？那次真的很危险耶，我差点就要死掉了。”

StarTowerBookEventReward.11202.3.en: Clear Monolith with Noya in your squad twice

StarTowerBookEventReward.11203.1.en: When You Wish Upon Pep Pep Juice (3)

StarTowerBookEventReward.11203.2.en:
So who actually first spread the story?
Noya stood in the middle of the group, trying hard to remember just how many people she'd told it to. Maybe she'd forgotten a few things during her Monolith runs, but she felt like she really hadn't told that many people. Except for...
"I think I ran into a group of Trekkers back then. Their leader was this girl with a high ponytail... What was her name...? I told them how I'd just made it out alive, and the leader got all serious and said it must have been the mysterious power of Pep Pep Juice..."
What was her name again...?
Noya never did manage to recall.
StarTowerBookEventReward.11203.2.cn:
那又是谁把这件事流传出去的？
尘沙被大家围在中间，努力回忆自己对多少个人说过这件事。但不知道是星塔冒险的途中她又丢失了一些记忆的细枝末节，还是事实本就如此，尘沙认为自己并没有跟多少人说过这件事，除了……
“那个时候好像刚好遇到了一队旅人，领队的是个扎高马尾的女孩，叫什么来着……我跟她们说了我刚刚脱险的事情，那个领队的女孩子特别认真地说，这是能量沛沛的神秘力量……”
她叫什么名字呢……
直到最后尘沙也没想起来。

StarTowerBookEventReward.11203.3.en: Clear Monolith with Noya in your squad 3 times

StarTowerBookEventReward.11301.2.en:
The Baize Bureau runs supply stations outside the Monoliths on certain days. Originally, they were meant to help their Loong kin adventuring inside, but the custom has since expanded to serve all Trekkers.
Each station needs people to staff it. While Shimiao isn't officially on the duty roster, she often tags along to help if she has time.
Her reasoning was simple: the more chances to help people, the better.
However, there's something that always puzzles her. Trekkers who seem to need help often only peek at the station, or just pace around nearby for a while, then they would leave.
Why is that the case...?
StarTowerBookEventReward.11301.2.cn:
白泽公署会在特定的日子里，在星塔外设置补给站点，初衷是帮助那些在星塔中冒险的龙裔族人——这个习俗延续到现在，已经逐渐成为面向所有旅人的补给站点。
站点需要人员驻守，虽然师渺并不在值班人员的名单里，但如果她有空，大多数情况都会跟着去星塔里帮忙。
她的理由很简单——能帮助到别人的地方，多多益善。
不过，有一件事师渺很疑惑，那些需要帮助的旅人，总是小心翼翼地走上前张望一番，又或者驻足踱步一会，然后离开了。
为什么呢……

StarTowerBookEventReward.11301.3.en: Clear Monolith with Shimiao in your squad once

StarTowerBookEventReward.11302.2.en:
"You just look too serious, Shimiao!" said the senior Loong stationed with her, letting out a huge yawn. "You've got the expression of someone hunting down a criminal."
"But I practiced it in the mirror... It's supposed to scare off any opportunists."
"Hahaha, you really read that entire thick manual, didn't you?" The senior patted her shoulder. "But you can overdo it. We've got to find the right balance."
"Is that so..."
Shimiao fell deep in thought.
StarTowerBookEventReward.11302.2.cn:
“是师渺看上去太严肃啦！”和师渺一起驻守的龙裔前辈打了一个大大的哈欠，“你的表情像是在追捕犯人。”
“但这是为了震慑来补给站投机取巧分子，我对着镜子练了好久……”
“哈哈哈哈，师渺真的把那本厚厚的流程规范全看完了。”前辈拍了拍师渺的肩膀，“只是，过犹不及，我们啊，可要好好把握那个‘度’。”
“是吗……”
师渺陷入了思考。

StarTowerBookEventReward.11302.3.en: Clear Monolith with Shimiao in your squad twice

StarTowerBookEventReward.11303.2.en:
"This is a supply station. State your needs. But before you get any supplies, please answer a few questions..."
 So, Shimiao came up with another method. A real Trekker would know the Monolith's conditions inside and out. By quizzing them, she could tell if they were actually prepared.
It was just...
Her Loong senior chuckled as a crowd of Trekkers gathered around Shimiao.
"Yes, it's highly likely you'll run into a Forbidden Beauty in this Monolith. If you do, you should first..."
Turns out, Shimiao's knowledge was so extensive that her questions always helped Trekkers patch the holes in their own plans. Eventually, whenever she was on duty, the supply station became a Q&A session.
But hey, that isn't such a bad thing, right?
StarTowerBookEventReward.11303.2.cn:
“这里是补给站，有需要的话请说。另外，在领取补给前，有几个问题请回答一下……”
于是，师渺便想了另外一个法子——真正前来爬塔的旅人，必然掌握了这座星塔的情况。而她则通过向旅人提问的方式来分辨他们究竟对自己将要面对的事物是否了解。
只是……
同行的龙裔前辈有些好笑地看着在师渺面前围成一圈的旅人。
“是的，在这座塔里出现禁断丽容也是极有可能的。假设碰到了那个怪物，你可以先……”
——或许是师渺的情报储备过于丰富，她提出的问题总能为来爬塔的旅人查漏补缺。于是，当师渺在场时的补给站，总会变成这样一个问答大会。
当然， 这也不算坏事，对吧？

StarTowerBookEventReward.11303.3.en: Clear Monolith with Shimiao in your squad 3 times

StarTowerBookEventReward.11401.2.en:
Chaton spotted an unranked arcade cabinet tucked away in a dusty corner of the Monolith Arcade.
Whether it was due to its obscure location or the game itself just sucking, the player leaderboard was completely blank.
For Chaton, however, this was a godsend. She finally had the perfect chance to prove that her gaming skills were vastly superior to Kasimira's.
She eagerly stepped up to the machine, which looked suspiciously like a front-loading washer.
Unlike the button-mashers she was used to, this one involved swiping and tapping along the inside of a circular ring.
"Hmph, as if a little gimmick could stump the great Chaton!"
Despite it being her first try, it only took a few slip-ups for her to completely master the controls.
Now there was only one thing left to do: speedrun every stage, claim the number one spot, and rub it right in Kasimira's face.
StarTowerBookEventReward.11401.2.cn:
猫眼在星塔游戏厅的角落发现了一台没有排名的游戏机。
不知道是因为摆放的位置太不起眼，还是因为里面的游戏实在不好玩，这台游戏机的玩家排行榜上空空如也。
不过，这对于猫眼来说简直是天赐良机。她终于有机会证明，自己在游戏上的天赋要比卡西米拉更强。
于是，猫眼迫不及待地站到了那台看起来酷似洗衣神器的游戏机前。
不同于她以前玩的那些需要疯狂拍按钮的机器，这台游戏机似乎需要通过触摸圆形内壁来完成操作。
“哼，这怎么可能会难得倒猫眼大人呢？”
哪怕是第一次上手，仅仅失误了几次之后，猫眼便迅速掌握了操作方式。
接下来要做的事情只有一件——以最快的速度打通所有关卡，拿下排行榜第一名，然后回去找卡西米拉好好炫耀一番。

StarTowerBookEventReward.11401.3.en: Clear Monolith with Chaton in your squad once

StarTowerBookEventReward.11402.2.en:
Most games started off easy to hook you in, only ramping up the difficulty once you'd caught onto the rhythm.
But this machine clearly hadn't gotten the memo.
It felt like it was deliberately out to get her. The bizarre controls, the constantly shifting hand gestures, and the ridiculously complex beatmaps during the climax—it was all pushing her patience to the breaking point.
Finally, with a sharp clack, she pressed the dark barrel of her pistol right against the screen.
"Wait."
Chaton froze for a second.
"Kasimira hasn't beaten this game either. So, if I can clear it..."
At that thought, she quietly holstered her weapon and sat back down.
StarTowerBookEventReward.11402.2.cn:
通常来说，任何一款游戏为了吸引玩家入坑，前面的几关都会尽量降低难度，等玩家逐渐熟悉节奏之后，难度才会慢慢提升。
然而……摆在猫眼面前的这台游戏机似乎完全没有这种设计。
它就像是在故意为难猫眼，从未见过的操作方式，几乎不会重复的手势变化，还有高潮段落复杂得离谱的乐谱，每一样都在挑战猫眼的耐心。
终于，随着一声清脆的枪械上膛声，黑洞洞的枪管抵在了游戏机的显示屏上。
“等等”
猫眼沉默了一秒。
“既然是卡西米拉也从未打通过的游戏，如果我能够打通的话……”
想到这里，猫眼默默地把枪收了回去，乖乖坐回了游戏机前。

StarTowerBookEventReward.11402.3.en: Clear Monolith with Chaton in your squad twice

StarTowerBookEventReward.11403.2.en:
As the saying goes, hard work pays off.
If a game existed, it could be beaten. If it couldn't, the developer was the one who messed up.
After what felt like an eternity, a groan echoed from the corner of the arcade.
"Ahhh..."
Unlike her usual triumphant cheers, this sigh was filled with sheer exhaustion and the sweet relief that it was finally over.
Chaton stared at the results screen like she'd just crawled to the end of the world, watching her name locked into the leaderboard.
But as she looked at her solitary name, a realization hit her.
If she was the only player on the board, she was automatically in first place.
So what was the point of being number one if she hadn't actually beaten anyone?
With that, Chaton packed up her gear and headed out, determined to drag someone back there to challenge her.
StarTowerBookEventReward.11403.2.cn:
俗话说得好，功夫不负有心人。
游戏既然被设计出来，那就一定存在通关的方法。如果没有，那一定是设计者的问题。
在经历了不知道多长时间之后，终于，从游戏厅角落里传出了一个声音——
“啊——”
不同于往常通关时的兴奋与欢呼，那个声音里只有疲惫以及一种终于结束的解脱。
猫眼盯着游戏机的结算画面，就像是刚刚走到了世界的尽头，直到她的名字出现在排行榜上。
然而——看着排行榜上唯一的名字，猫眼突然产生了一个问题。
如果排行榜上只有一个人，那无论如何……这个人都会是第一名。
既然没有打败任何人，那这个第一名的意义又在哪里？
于是，猫眼收拾好自己的装备，准备回去找一个人，来和自己一较高下。

StarTowerBookEventReward.11403.3.en: Clear Monolith with Chaton in your squad 3 times

StarTowerBookEventReward.11501.2.en:
Don't ever take playing hide-and-seek with Firefly lightly.
—Not unless you want to realize every possible hiding spot around you has been blasted to rubble, and Firefly's "Avalanche" cannon is locked right on you as she cheerfully announces "gotcha" and opens fire.
"Did those old geezers from Grace Imperium never teach her what 'hide-and-seek' actually is?!"
That's what everyone ends up yelling while running for their lives after playing with her.
But Firefly doesn't get it. At all.
All she sees is people running as fast as they can, just like Sherlock does. In that case—
"Pursuing!"
So Firefly gives chase.
StarTowerBookEventReward.11501.2.cn:
不要轻易和火垂玩捉迷藏。
——如果你不想在自己藏好之后，发现身边所有可以藏身的地方都被一炮轰平，而火垂的「雪崩」正对着你，说着“抓到了”向你发射火炮的话。
“恩赐意志那些老古董到底有没有好好教她什么叫‘捉迷藏’啊？！”
所有跟火垂玩捉迷藏的人最后都会这么大叫地逃走。
但火垂不明白，火垂不理解。
她只觉得大家都在拼了命地逃走，就像夏洛克跟她玩捉迷藏的时候那样。这种情况下——
“追踪！”
火垂腾空飞了过去。

StarTowerBookEventReward.11501.3.en: Clear Monolith with Firefly in your squad once

StarTowerBookEventReward.11502.2.en:
"Do you want to play hide-and-seek with me?"
That's what Firefly asks every Trekker she encounters inside the Monolith. But most Trekkers turn her down because they already have their own plans. Even the willing ones are quickly stopped by their teammates.
"Are you crazy? Look at her outfit. She looks like Grace Imperium's ultimate weapon, the one they stashed inside the Monolith."
Then the group would shuffle off in a hurry.
Firefly stands there for a moment, then turns and runs toward the area where Stellaroids roam.
"Wanna play hide-and-seek with me?"
The Stellaroid, unable to understand human language, lunge at her—the "tagger" has come to catch her.
Firefly is thrilled. Another day, another round of playing hide-and-seek with the Stellaroids.
StarTowerBookEventReward.11502.2.cn:
“你要跟火垂玩捉迷藏吗？”
火垂在星塔里见到每一个旅人，都会这么问一句。但在星塔里冒险的旅人都有自己的计划，大部分旅人会拒绝她，就算偶尔会有好心想要答应，也会被同行的人劝阻。
“你想死吗？你看她的衣服，她好像是恩赐意志那个放在星塔里的终极兵器。”
旅人们推推搡搡快步离开。
火垂在原地站了一会，转身跑到了星骸出没的区域。
“要跟火垂玩捉迷藏吗？”
无法识别人类语言的星骸朝她扑了过来——“鬼”来抓人了。
火垂很开心，火垂今天也跟星骸玩了捉迷藏。

StarTowerBookEventReward.11502.3.en: Clear Monolith with Firefly in your squad twice

StarTowerBookEventReward.11503.2.en:
"Do you want to play hide-and-seek with me?"
"Sure! I'll be 'it.' You go hide!"
One day, Firefly met a girl who didn't turn her down. She happily grabbed Firefly's hand and marked out a hiding zone; then stood by the wall and started counting.
Firefly didn't understand what she was doing.
"Why are you just standing there? Why aren't you coming after me?"
The girl looked confused, too.
"Huh? You don't know how hide-and-seek works? You're supposed to hide while I count to ten! Then I come find you! That's how the game's played!"
That day, Firefly learned how to play hide-and-seek.
StarTowerBookEventReward.11503.2.cn:
“你要跟火垂玩捉迷藏吗？”
“好呀，我当‘鬼’你先藏！”
某一天，火垂在星塔里遇到了一个女孩，她没有拒绝火垂的捉迷藏邀请，反而兴致勃勃地拉着她，划定好捉迷藏的躲藏范围，然后站在墙边开始数数。
火垂不理解。
“为什么站在那里，不来抓我吗？”
女孩也很疑惑。
“诶？你不知道捉迷藏怎么玩吗？在我数到十之前，你要先找个地方藏好，躲起来！然后我来找你，这才是捉迷藏！”
这一天，火垂学会了玩捉迷藏。

StarTowerBookEventReward.11503.3.en: Clear Monolith with Firefly in your squad 3 times

StarTowerBookEventReward.11601.2.en:
Ridge still remembers how she felt when she first entered the Monolith.
It was a place brimming with marvels, with vast inner spaces and an endless stream of wondrous artifacts.
Monoliths are gifts from the gods to the Novians, and the very reason they get to enjoy a prosperous life. These Monoliths are indestructible, impervious to external forces, much like the mercy of the gods, which never ceases.
Like all her companions, Ridge looks up at the Monolith with exhilaration.
She thinks:
This place is the ideal granary!
StarTowerBookEventReward.11601.2.cn:
岭川仍记得第一次进入星塔时的心情。
那里充斥着令人眼花缭乱的景象，那里有巨大的内部空间，那里源源不断地产出各种神器……
星塔是神赐给诺瓦人的礼物，正是星塔的存在，诺瓦人才过上了富足生活。它们坚不可摧，无法被外力毁坏，如同神的慈悲永不消弭。
与所有同行人一样，岭川仰头看着星塔，神情激动。
她想：
这里简直就是理想的粮仓！

StarTowerBookEventReward.11601.3.en: Clear Monolith with Ridge in your squad once

StarTowerBookEventReward.11602.2.en:
It is always easier to think than to act.
All the Monoliths in the cities are controlled by major companies, and without permission, entering them is simply impossible.
Ridge is left with no option but to venture into Monoliths in the wild — unmonitored sites open to all. But within them dwell not only countless Stellaroids, but also Trekkers.
The Stellaroids may not necessarily steal her grain, but if a stockpile of food is discovered by Trekkers, that would be disastrous!
Ridge is more than happy to share the food she grows, but there is a world of difference between "sharing" and "having it stolen."
She decides to hide her grain in a room that is well-concealed in a Monolith rarely visited by Trekkers.
To do this, she must work hard to grow more grain—what if she starved to death before finding the ideal room?
StarTowerBookEventReward.11602.2.cn:
想永远比做容易。
城邦里的星塔都被各大公司掌控，没有许可的话，根本无法进塔。
岭川只能选择那些位于荒野之中，缺乏管理，能够自由进出的星塔。但这些星塔之中，不仅有大量的星骸，也有大量的旅人。
星骸不一定会偷吃她的粮食，但如果囤积粮食的房间被旅人发现，那可就不妙了！
岭川乐于分享自己种的粮食，然而“分享”和“被偷”之间，可是隔了一百亩的距离。
她决定要把粮食藏在某座旅人很少前往的星塔里，并且房间的位置还要足够隐蔽。
为此，她要努力多种点粮食，不然在找到合适的房间前就饿死了怎么办？

StarTowerBookEventReward.11602.3.en: Clear Monolith with Ridge in your squad twice

StarTowerBookEventReward.11603.2.en:
To this day, Ridge still hasn't found the perfect room to store her grain.
But she remains patient.
The City of a Thousand Monoliths wasn't built in a single day, nor does wheat ripen overnight. So what if she has to spend a little extra time to find a safe and secure place for her grain?
One day, she'll have an entire Monolith as a granary, filled to the brim with grain she's grown. A fireproof, theft-proof, damp-proof, mold-proof, and temperature-control site for the freshest grain...
That way, she would never have to worry about starving, even if it were the end of the world.
StarTowerBookEventReward.11603.2.cn:
时至今日，岭川还是没在星塔中找到一个完美的，用来存放粮食的房间。
但是岭川很有耐心。
千塔之城不是一日建成的，小麦也不是一天成熟的。为了拥有安全安心的屯粮之所，多花点时间又如何？
总有一天，她会拥有一整座星塔粮仓，里面屯满了她种的粮食。这座粮仓防火防盗，防潮防霉，恒温保鲜……
这样的话，就算世界末日，也不用担心会饿肚子了。

StarTowerBookEventReward.11603.3.en: Clear Monolith with Ridge in your squad 3 times

StarTowerBookEventReward.11701.2.en:
Jinglin loves to cook. She's still young, but her skills in the kitchen rival those of seasoned chefs.
She used to have a cooking partner—her trusty little step stool.
It was a necessity for a girl who barely cleared three feet tall! Without it, she could barely see into the pot.
But standing on a stool in the kitchen wasn't exactly safe, especially since the floor was often damp and the stool was small. Slipping was a real risk. For her safety, Jinglin's mother made a decision: she had a custom stovetop built to match Jinglin's height.
From then on, the kitchen stool that had faithfully served Jinglin for two years quietly retired and began a second life as her go-to seat for watching projector Artifact.
StarTowerBookEventReward.11701.2.cn:
璟麟喜欢做饭，虽然年纪不大，但烹饪手艺并不比老师傅们差多少。
她以前有一个做饭时的搭档——一个垫脚的凳子。
这对一个身高只有三尺六的女孩子来说并不是什么丢人的事情！毕竟如果不用凳子垫脚，她可能连锅里放的是什么都看不清。
但踩着凳子做饭并不安全，更何况凳子很小，厨房地面潮湿，时常有打滑摔倒的风险。出于安全考虑，璟麟的母亲做了一个决定：在厨房为璟麟打造一个适合她身高的灶台。
在那之后，陪伴了璟麟两年的做饭搭子脚凳“无奈退休”，转行成了她看显影器的小凳子。

StarTowerBookEventReward.11701.3.en: Clear Monolith with Jinglin in your squad once

StarTowerBookEventReward.11702.2.en:
Jinglin loves exploring all kinds of cuisines. In fact, many of Jing's Bistro's signature meals were specialties she developed with her mother and Grandpa Qin.
Due to a shared taste, they had a habit of adding a pinch of sugar at the final step of cooking. They called it a way to "bring out the flavor" because sugar enhances the natural taste of the ingredients and makes everything more savory.
In reality, their "pinch" was far more than what other Novians expected. Early customers politely asked if the chef had mixed up the sugar and salt, and business soon suffered. To save the restaurant, Jinglin began inviting patrons to taste-test new recipes and adjusted them to the local palate.
StarTowerBookEventReward.11702.2.cn:
璟麟喜欢研究各种各样的菜品，如今的怀璟食府有不少招牌菜都是她和母亲，还有秦爷爷一起钻研出来的特色菜。
但或许是口味偏好，三人习惯在烹饪的最后一步，加入一点砂糖提鲜。当然，这是他们的说法，糖分能让口味更加鲜美，诱发食材最原本的味道。
而实际上，因为口味偏好，食府的大伙对“一点砂糖”和诺瓦人认知的“一点砂糖”并不是同一个计量。早期有食客礼貌提问，厨子是否把糖当成了盐放了。渐渐地，生意也变得不好了。后来，为了适应诺瓦人的口味，璟麟时常会邀请顾客参与新菜品试吃，这才避免了了怀璟食府门可罗雀的局面。

StarTowerBookEventReward.11702.3.en: Clear Monolith with Jinglin in your squad twice

StarTowerBookEventReward.11703.2.en:
Lately, Jinglin's been keeping a little secret.
During one of her adventures inside the Monolith, she watched a film where a chef made a golden bun—one so magical that everyone who ate it would laugh with joy. Jinglin was fascinated. The moment she got back, she threw herself into the kitchen, determined to recreate this bun.
The play had not shown a full recipe; but it did mention a few ingredients and some key steps. So Jinglin had to figure out the rest on her own through trial and error.
At last, just before her mother's birthday, she managed to recreate the golden, deep-fried bun. She can hardly wait to see the smile it would bring to her mother's face.
StarTowerBookEventReward.11703.2.cn:
璟麟的最近有个小秘密。
她在星塔冒险的时候看到了影戏，里面的厨师制作了一种金色的包子，会让吃到的人都发出幸福的笑声。璟麟对这个金色包子的制作方法很感兴趣，从星塔回来之后就一直在厨房里尝试复刻。
影戏里并没有完整的制作方法，只是提到了一些原材料，一些关键的步骤，具体的配方和制作方法，璟麟只能自己一次次失败，又再一次次调整尝试。
终于，她在母亲生日之前，复刻出了这个金色的油炸包子，她已经迫不及待地想看到母亲幸福的笑容。

StarTowerBookEventReward.11703.3.en: Clear Monolith with Jinglin in your squad 3 times

StarTowerBookEventReward.11801.2.en:
What exactly are Stellaroids made of?
Coronis has always been curious.

They possessed structures similar to conventional life-forms, yet were also heavily mineral-based. If left undisturbed, they would eventually vanish completely—every last part.
They were truly creations that defied all
But one day, Coronis made a discovery: if you cut off a piece of a Stellaroid's body before it vanished, that severed part wouldn't disappear along with the rest.
It remained on its own.
"Fascinating..."
Coronis stared at the small piece of Stellaroid she had sliced off.
"Let's see what's inside, shall we~?"
StarTowerBookEventReward.11801.2.cn:
星骸的构造到底是什么？
科洛妮丝一直都很好奇。

它们似乎有类似通常生命体的结构，但同时又存在大量的矿成分，把它们静置一段，无论哪个部分都会消失——
确实是认知完全不合常规的造物。
但某一天，科洛妮丝发现，如果在星骸消失之前切下它们的一部分躯体，脱离主体的这一部并不会随着整个星骸的消失而消失。
它单独存在了。
“还真是神奇……”
科洛妮丝盯着地上被她切下来的那一小块星骸。
“那就来解剖看看吧~”

StarTowerBookEventReward.11801.3.en: Clear Monolith with Coronis in your squad once
StarTowerBookEventReward.11801.3.cn: 携带科洛妮丝通关1次星塔

StarTowerBookEventReward.11802.2.en:
Stellaroid extract—despite the name, the process is simply dropping a piece of Stellaroid into clean water and boil it until the water turns cloudy. That murky liquid is the "base extract."
Is it poisonous?
Coronis mixed the base extract into food and fed it to various monsters. Within fifteen minutes to three hours, depending on the subject, they began to show signs of being poisoned.
The main symptoms: twitching, hallucinations, loss of motor coordination, and the usual vomiting and diarrhea.
It appeared to act like some kind of neurotoxin.
"But if it is a neurotoxin, then if I could just control the dosage a little..."
Coronis suddenly had a bold idea.
StarTowerBookEventReward.11802.2.cn:
星骸提取液，虽然是这么称呼了，但实际上只是将切下来的星骸放入清水中煮沸，直到清水变得浑浊，这锅“星骸汤”就是原液了。
它有毒吗？
科洛妮丝将原液混入魔物的食物中，魔物在食用之后，经过十五分钟到三小时不等的时间，出现了不同程度的中毒现象。
主要表现为：抽搐、幻觉、四肢不协调以及常规的呕吐腹泻。
看上去像是某种针对神经毒素。
“但如果是针对神经的毒素，如果稍加控制……”
科洛妮丝有了一个大胆的想法。

StarTowerBookEventReward.11802.3.en: Clear Monolith with Coronis in your squad twice
StarTowerBookEventReward.11802.3.cn: 携带科洛妮丝通关2次星塔

StarTowerBookEventReward.11803.2.en:
If refined properly, with careful control over concentration and dosage, this particular type of Stellaroid could potentially produce a painkiller agent; though the side effect was hallucinations.
Coronis could not find a way to suppress that part. After all, this type of Stellaroid inherently caused neural disruptions.
Pain relief, hallucinations, and interference with neural signaling—enough to induce a pleasurable state.
"I've made something pretty dangerous, haven't I..." Coronis muttered, staring at the liquid in the test tube. In the end, she sighed and tossed her research notes into the fire.
"This type of Stellaroid won't work... I'll try a different one."
StarTowerBookEventReward.11803.2.cn:
如果通过萃取提纯，再进一步控制浓度和剂量。这个种类的星骸，似乎可以制造出一种有镇痛效果的药剂，但副作用是致幻。
科洛妮丝无法消除这个副作用，毕竟这个种类的星骸能提取到的，本身就是一个让神经紊乱的物质。
镇痛、致幻、有一半的概率出现神经信号错乱，另一半概率是刺激多巴胺分泌产生愉悦感……
“做了个很不妙的药剂出来啊……”她看着试管里的溶液，最后叹了口气，烧掉了这次的研究笔记。
“这种星骸不行的话，那就换一种吧。”

StarTowerBookEventReward.11803.3.en: Clear Monolith with Coronis in your squad 3 times
StarTowerBookEventReward.11803.3.cn: 携带科洛妮丝通关3次星塔

StarTowerBookEventReward.11901.2.en:
"Goodwind Homecare at your service."
Nanoha is a professional maid.
She is skilled in handling all kinds of household chores. She can get everything tidy and in order in the shortest amount of time possible.

Today's client is an elderly noblewoman living alone. With age catching up to her, she often needs help cleaning the house.
This is Nanoha's third time at her place.
As she packed her tools, Nanoha glanced at the old woman. "On this night, three years ago, do you recall which restaurant you dined at?"
"... I don't remember. Why do you ask?"
"Oh, it's nothing. Thank you again for your commission. Have a nice day."
StarTowerBookEventReward.11901.2.cn:
“谷风家政，为您服务。”
花原是专业女仆。
她擅长处理一切家务杂事，能在最短的时间内，把所有的事情井井有条地解决。

今天的雇主是一个独居的贵族妇人，因为年纪大了，时常需要有人上门帮忙打扫。
花原已经是第三次为她服务了。
清扫结束之际，花原整理好工具，望向老妇人：“三年前的今天，您还记得当晚去了哪家餐厅用餐吗？”
“……我记不清了。怎么了？”
“没什么，感谢您今天的委托，再见。”

StarTowerBookEventReward.11901.3.en: Clear Monolith with Nanoha in your squad once

StarTowerBookEventReward.11902.2.en:
"Goodwind Homecare at your service."
Some Trekkers eyed the young noble girl climbing the tower with a maid in tow with curiosity. As her sunflower emblems flashed through the air, the nearby Stellaroids vanished without a sound.

"That maid is amazing..."
The girl puffed her chest out proudly. "Nanoha's not a maid! She's my personal bodyguard."
"To be accurate, I am serving as your bodyguard for this Monolith expedition. Your father entrusted me to keep you safe until you are back home."
"I know! C'mon, let's go! I want to check out that area over there!"
"... As you wish."
StarTowerBookEventReward.11902.2.cn:
“谷风家政，为您服务。”
旅人们好奇地打量着那个带着女仆爬塔的贵族少女。向日葵上下翻飞间，星骸悄无声息地湮灭了。

“好厉害的女仆……”
少女一脸得意：“花原可不是女仆，她现在是我的私人保镖~”
“准确来说，我是您这次星塔冒险的保镖，我会护送您安全到家。”
“知道啦！我们走吧，那边我也想去玩一玩~”
“……好。”

StarTowerBookEventReward.11902.3.en: Clear Monolith with Nanoha in your squad twice

StarTowerBookEventReward.11903.2.en:
"Goodwind Homecare at your service."
Removing any obstacle that ought to disappear—that was what the maids of Goodwind Homecare were truly made for.

"This is incredible intel. Mightily useful. Name your price."
"I'd like to trade for information," Nanoha said after a moment. "Have you heard of 'Pest Control 003'?"
A flicker of surprise crossed the client's face, followed by a shake of the head.
"I don't know anything. And... I'm going to pretend I never heard that name."
"... Understood. Thank you for the commission."
StarTowerBookEventReward.11903.2.cn:
“谷风家政，为您服务。”
清扫一切应当消失的障碍，谷风家政的女仆本就是为此而生的。

“这真是不得了的情报，帮大忙了。你开个价吧。”
“我希望交换情报。”花原斟酌了片刻，问：“您听说过‘除虫计划003’吗？”
对方的表情闪过一丝错愕，随后摇头。
“我不清楚，但……我会假装从未听说这个名字。”
“……明白了，谢谢您的委托。”

StarTowerBookEventReward.11903.3.en: Clear Monolith with Nanoha in your squad 3 times

StarTowerBookEventReward.12001.2.en:
"You have a homework assignment today!"
Ms. Canace, usually so stern in class, sounded noticeably more relaxed this time. Standing at the front of the room, she pointed out the window.
"Your assignment is to leave this classroom and go out to find something that you think is interesting. I won't set any parameters. It can be anything, just as long as you find it interesting. The exact number is up to you. Just bring your 'treasure' back before for our next class~"
It was a special kind of assignment. As Canace listened to the excited murmurs spreading through the room, she began looking forward to seeing the "treasures" her students would return with.
StarTowerBookEventReward.12001.2.cn:
“今天我们有一份课后作业！”
卡娜丝老师在课堂上的口吻总是很严肃，但这次却略显轻松。她站在讲台上，指了指窗户外面：
“作业的内容是，走出这个教室，去外面寻找一些你们觉得有意思的东西，具体是什么种类的东西，我没有任何限制，只要是你觉得有趣的，可以是一件，也可以是三五件。总之，在下次上课之前，带上你们寻到的‘宝藏’回到这里~”
这是一个很特殊的课后作业，卡娜丝看着窃窃私语的学生们，期待着他们下次带回来的“宝藏”。

StarTowerBookEventReward.12001.3.en: Clear Monolith with Canace in your squad once
StarTowerBookEventReward.12001.3.cn: 携带卡娜丝通关1次星塔

StarTowerBookEventReward.12002.2.en:
For their last homework assignment, Canace's students brought back all kinds of items: oddly shaped rocks, bug-eaten leaves, old books, and unopened letters.
The sheer variety was impressive. One after another, the students eagerly stood up to explain why they'd chosen their "treasure," what made it special, and what they liked about it. The classroom was full of noise and laughter.
Canace was very pleased. She announced the followup assignment:
"For your next homework assignment, I want you to use magic to transform the treasure you brought back. How you transform it is up to you, but it must be done using magic alone~"
The bubbly classroom fell into stunned silence. Then, all at once— "Ehhhhh!?"
StarTowerBookEventReward.12002.2.cn:
上一次的课后作业，卡娜丝的学生们带回来了各种各样的东西：形状奇特的石头、被昆虫啃食过的树叶，老旧的图书，没有拆封的信件。
种类繁多，五花八门。学生们兴致勃勃地解释着自己为什么选择这个“宝藏”，它的特点、有趣之处，热闹的教室里充满了欢声笑语。
卡娜丝对此非常满意，于是，她布置了第二次课后作业。
“这一次的课后作业，我需要大家用魔法，去改造这个你们捡回来的这个‘宝藏’，改造的方向没有限制，但只可以用魔法~”
原本欢乐的教室安静了一会，发出了学生么一致的惨叫：“诶——！？”

StarTowerBookEventReward.12002.3.en: Clear Monolith with Canace in your squad twice
StarTowerBookEventReward.12002.3.cn: 携带卡娜丝通关2次星塔

StarTowerBookEventReward.12003.2.en:
Compared to last time, nearly half the students returned with their projects looking a little anxious, even glum.
"Has my transformation ruined it?"
"I liked it the way it was, but maybe it could use a few decorations."
"I tried to make it like that, but I think I messed up."
"I didn't want to change it. I think it was already perfect the way I found it."
...
One by one, the students showed their creations. When they were done, Canace clapped her hands and gave them their third assignment.
"For this last assignment, I'd like you to write a journal entry about these two assignments. You can write about your opinions, what you learned, or anything else that comes to mind. But this time, I won't be checking it. Whether you write it or not is entirely up to you~"
StarTowerBookEventReward.12003.2.cn:
和上一次相比，这次学生们有近一半愁眉苦脸地端着他们的作品回来。
我的改造会对这个东西造成破坏吗？
我觉得它这样也挺好的，不过还可以再添加一些装饰。
我本来想这么改，但似乎失败了。
我不想改，我觉得它最美的状态，就是我初次遇见它时的样子。
……
学生们逐一展示了自己的作品之后。卡娜丝拍了拍手，留下了第三次课后作业。
“那么我们的最后一次课后作业，去写一份日记吧，关于这两次课后作业的感想、启发或者任何事情。但这次作业我不会检查，是否要完成这次作业，就看大家自己的选择~”

StarTowerBookEventReward.12003.3.en: Clear Monolith with Canace in your squad 3 times
StarTowerBookEventReward.12003.3.cn: 携带卡娜丝通关3次星塔

StarTowerBookEventReward.12301.2.en:
Maybe it's her Flufla heritage, or maybe it's that animals just naturally trust children, but whenever Ann wanders into the big patches of forest near her village, all sorts of creatures would approach her in curiosity.
"All of them are my friends~"
That's what Ann always says.
She says she loves her village, the forest, and everything about Eaze Village. So she hopes life in Eaze would always stay like this, peaceful and happy. She also hopes the visitors would fall in love with the way of life in Eaze.
StarTowerBookEventReward.12301.2.cn:
或许是因为有绒绒族的血统，又或许是小孩子天生就能让动物觉得友好，杏子所在的村庄附近有大片的森林，每当她去森林里，都会有各种各样的动物好奇地向她靠近。
“它们都是我的朋友~”
杏子总是这么说。
她说她喜欢村庄，喜欢森林，喜欢伊西村的一切，所以很希望这里的生活能一直这样平静幸福地延续，也希望远道而来的朋友，也能喜欢上这里的一切。

StarTowerBookEventReward.12301.3.en: Clear Monolith with Ann in your squad once

StarTowerBookEventReward.12302.2.en:
For Ann, leaving home was as daunting as wrangling a school of rowdy puffloon.
After a reluctant send-off from the village elder and many other adults, Ann joined a few other youths on a journey to the nearest city. Each had a mission—Ann's was to help sell produce.
"Hup ... heave ... oof!"
A pair of fluffy ears poked out from behind a mountain of glistening produce, and then...
"Heave-ho! I finally climbed up!"
Ann cleared her throat.
"Open for business!"
Thanks to the little vendor's energetic cries, the fruits and vegetables sold out early that day.
StarTowerBookEventReward.12302.2.cn:
出远门对于杏子来说是一项不亚于制服暴乱的嘭嘭鱼群同等难度的挑战。
在村长与众多大人的不舍目送下，杏子与村里的几个年轻人一起踏上了前往就近城邦的旅程——他们每个人都被赋予了不同的使命，而杏子需要做的是——帮忙销售蔬果。
“嘿，嘿咻，诶呀！”
晶莹剔透的新鲜蔬果堆成的小山上，露出了一对毛茸茸的耳朵，随后……
“嘿咻！可算爬上来了！”
杏子清了清嗓子。
“开张啦！”
有这位小小店员的吆喝，今天的果蔬也早早售罄，恭喜发财！

StarTowerBookEventReward.12302.3.en: Clear Monolith with Ann in your squad twice

StarTowerBookEventReward.12303.2.en:
A rumor circulated among Trekkers about a mysterious figure in a certain Monolith: a girl riding a wolf.
At first, they dismissed her as an illusion, since a "wolf-riding girl" sounded like something from a fairy tale. But then a lost Trekker swore the girl had saved him, describing her as being as warm as a small sun, and most definitely real.
The Trekker told his story to a friend who wrote children's tales. It was made into a picture book that, after several reprints, found its way to a small, unassuming village in a distant land.
A young Flufla girl tore open a package, excited for a new story. This time, however, she was stumped.
"Hmm? Coco, this looks just like you."
"Awoo!"
StarTowerBookEventReward.12303.2.cn:
旅人们之间流传着一个说法，在某座星塔里会出现的神秘身影——骑着狼的少女。
起初，旅人们将之与星塔制造的幻象联系在一起，因为“骑着狼的少女”怎么看都像是童话中出现的组合。直到某天，一位迷路的旅人确切得到了少女的相助。他形容少女像小小的太阳一样温暖，绝非虚假。
旅人将其经历讲给了写童话的朋友，再制成绘本，几经转载，其中的一本正运向远方一座不起眼的小村庄里。
绒绒族的少女满怀欣喜地打开了包裹，期待着她最喜欢的新故事，不过这次，少女却犯了难。
“嗯？可可，这上面的好像你呀。”
“嗷呼！”

StarTowerBookEventReward.12303.3.en: Clear Monolith with Ann in your squad 3 times

StarTowerBookEventReward.12501.1.en: A Sunny Day for Fine Weather (1)

StarTowerBookEventReward.12501.2.en:
Okay, what do I say after I knock?
How do I introduce Post Haste's services?
What if a customer complains?

Before heading out, Freesia went through her contingency plans one last time, a lifelong habit of hers.
It was her first day as a courier, and she was determined for everything to be flawless.

"Thank you for coming all this way! It's scorching out there. Why don't you come in for some tea?"
But she was greeted by a warmth and a smile she hadn't planned for.
It dawned on her that maybe she assumed it all wrong.
StarTowerBookEventReward.12501.2.cn:
敲门后的第一句话应该说什么？
如何介绍万送屋的业务？
被客人投诉怎么办？

出发之前，苍兰再次梳理了一遍各类问题的解决方案，正如她曾经习惯的那样。
这是她第一天担任信使，她要确保万无一失。

“辛苦你了，今天这么热，要不要进来喝杯茶歇歇？”
然而，迎接她的却是计划之外的热情和微笑。
她忽然意识到，自己好像搞错了什么。

StarTowerBookEventReward.12501.3.en: Clear Monolith with Freesia in your squad once

StarTowerBookEventReward.12502.1.en: A Rainy Day for Fine Weather (2)

StarTowerBookEventReward.12502.2.en:
After a few rumbles of thunder, the rain began to pour as expected.
Freesia huddled under a tree, several undelivered letters still in her pack.
After a moment, she tucked the letters inside her jacket and hugged her pack to her chest.
"There. That should keep them dry."

Just as she was about to step into the downpour, she heard footsteps sprinting up behind her.
"Finally... I found you!"
A panting girl with orange hair ran up, umbrella in hand.
"I saw you forgot your raincoat when you left this morning."
"Come on, let's deliver the rest of these together."
StarTowerBookEventReward.12502.2.cn:
几声闷雷过后，大雨如期而至。
苍兰躲在树下，背包里还塞着几封未送达的信。
思索过后，她把信件一封封塞进外套里，抱紧背包挡在胸前。
“这样的话，信就不会被淋湿了。”

正当她准备踏入雨中，身后传来急促的脚步声。
“总算……找到你了。”
橘色头发的少女一手撑着伞，气喘吁吁地跑来。
“早上你出门时，我就发现你忘记带雨衣了。”
“走吧走吧，我们一起去送剩下的信。”

StarTowerBookEventReward.12502.3.en: Clear Monolith with Freesia in your squad twice

StarTowerBookEventReward.12503.1.en: A Snowy Day for Fine Weather (3)

StarTowerBookEventReward.12503.2.en:
So cold. It was bone-chillingly cold.
Ankle-deep in snow, Freesia pushed her bicycle, trudging toward the last house on her route.
She knocked, the sound swallowed by the frigid wind. No one answered.

When Freesia opened her eyes, she thought she was dreaming.
Her once-frozen fingers rested on a soft blanket. She was all warm, and the air smelled of hot cocoa.
(Sniffles) "You're finally awake!"
"Thanks goodness Teresa found you collapsed on the path near her house. I don't know what would've happened otherwise..."
Freesia glanced out the window. The snow had stopped and the sun was out—something worth celebrating.
"... Let's build a snowman."
StarTowerBookEventReward.12503.2.cn:
好冷，好冷。
厚厚的积雪盖过脚面，苍兰推着自行车，艰难地走到最后一户人家。
寒风里回荡着长长的敲门声，无人应答。

再次睁开眼时，苍兰还以为自己出现了幻觉。
原本冻僵的手指搭在柔软的棉被上，身体暖烘烘的，空气中还漂浮着热可可的味道。
“呜呜呜呜……你终于醒了。”
“得亏特丽莎在家附近的小路上发现你晕倒了，不然的话……”
苍兰望向窗外，雪已经停了，似乎应该庆祝一下重新见到了太阳。
“……我们去院子里堆雪人吧。”

StarTowerBookEventReward.12503.3.en: Clear Monolith with Freesia in your squad 3 times

StarTowerBookEventReward.12601.2.en:
This was an era when Flora still belonged to Flavio.
The audience was growing tired of the same old scripted programming.
Scarlet Sights Media desperately needed a show that was "Bigger! Bolder! More REAL!"
To meet that demand, the Monolith Reality Show was born.
It had no script—only raw reactions, genuine screams, and real accidents. The only price was a "small risk" the idols had to expose themselves to.
As guinea pigs for this experiment, superstars like Flora were the first to be shoved onto its dangerous stage.
StarTowerBookEventReward.12601.2.cn:
那是一个弗拉维奥还拥有紫槿的时代。
彼时的观众们厌倦节目的固定编排已初见端倪。
绯瞳传讯急需一个“更爆！更火！更真实！”的节目。
为了回应观众们愿景，“星塔真人秀”的雏形便诞生了。
这里没有固定剧本，只有偶像们更真实的反应，更真实的尖叫，甚至更真实的意外——所需要的代价不过是偶像们要承担一点小小的风险。
而作为试验的表率，像紫槿这样的大明星们，被第一时间推上了这危险的舞台。

StarTowerBookEventReward.12601.3.en: Clear Monolith with Flora in your squad once

StarTowerBookEventReward.12602.2.en:
This was an era when Flavio was about to lose Flora.
The pilot episode was an instant sensation,
flooding Scarlet Sights Media with praise and Dorra.
Flora's face was everywhere—plastered on city streets, flying off video store shelves, and branded on products in every mall.
But no one suspected this would be her last moment in the spotlight.
Soon, the posters would come down, the branded merchandise would vanish, and her films would become her swan song.
Looking back, scholars in Flavio would say: 
"At the peak of her fame, Flora brought her era to an end herself."
StarTowerBookEventReward.12602.2.cn:
那是一个弗拉维奥即将失去紫槿的时代。
试播节目一经推出，便收获了大量好评。
观众的热情与他们口袋中的朵拉，也如潮水般向绯瞳传讯涌来。
街道上满是印有紫槿的广告，专卖店的录像带早已被洗劫一空。商场里，住宅区，到处都是紫槿代言的商品。
只是当时的人们还没有想到，这将是紫槿的最后一次风光。
海报上的人将被替换，联动过的产品将会下架，就连影戏也将成为她的绝唱。
回首彼时，弗拉维奥的学者们会说：
“紫槿在最高光的时刻亲手结束了属于她的时代。”

StarTowerBookEventReward.12602.3.en: Clear Monolith with Flora in your squad twice

StarTowerBookEventReward.12603.2.en:
This was an era when Flora departed from Flavio.
To this day, speculation swirls around why she left.
Was it mounting conflict with the studio? An accident during filming?
It no longer mattered. At first, people lamented her absence.
But as new stars rose and new posters went up, the public simply moved on.
"What's on next?"
With the click of a button, memories of Flora vanished in the flicker of a changing channel.
And yet...
Some were no longer content to just watch her on a screen. They wanted to see the real her—to climb the Monolith with her for real.
This time, there would be no script, no cameras, and no constraints.
A new era had begun for them: the era of Ozora Production.
StarTowerBookEventReward.12603.2.cn:
这是一个紫槿离开弗拉维奥的时代。
如今，仍然有众多声音猜测紫槿离开的原因。
究竟是与事务所日积月累的矛盾？还是录制节目时发生的意外。
这些都不重要了，早期的人们些许会对她的离开感到惋惜，
但当窗外的海报换了一个又一个，明星的头牌几经易主又授予新的人物。
“下一个节目看什么？”
拿起遥控器，按下按钮，与紫槿的记忆就像魔术一样，随着切换节目的闪光被一齐抛去。
只是……
仍有人不愿干坐在显影器前观看她的身姿，想看见更真实的她，想与她一起正式攀登星塔。
这次，真的没有剧本，没有镜头，更没有约束。
属于她们的新时代开始了，那是一个名为“野空”的时代。

StarTowerBookEventReward.12603.3.en: Clear Monolith with Flora in your squad 3 times

StarTowerBookEventReward.12701.2.en:
"Is... is anyone there? Please, help me..."
How many times had she yelled that by now?
Teresa was, at that very moment, spectacularly stuck.
She was on her way back to Post Haste, a full hour after Donna and Freesia were supposed to have started their big dinner.
"Ugh... Even if I get free now, I'm still gonna miss the whole meal..."
"Waaah... Huh? Wait, that smells... amazing!"
A familiar aroma wasn't drifting down from above, but wafting up from the ground.
"I had a feeling you'd get into trouble, so decided we'd have a picnic tonight instead."
"Donna... If we don't get her down soon, her tears are going to flavor the stew."
StarTowerBookEventReward.12701.2.cn:
“有……有人吗？请，请帮帮忙……”
已经是不知道第几次喊出这样的台词。
特丽莎——目前绝赞受困中，
地点是返回万送屋的路上，时间是多娜和苍兰约好今晚吃大餐的后一个小时。
“咕呜呜……这样下去就算脱困了，回去也只能饿肚子……”
“呜呜，嗯？好，好香！”
一股熟悉的味道从头顶，不，应该说从地面的方向传来。
“我就猜到你会在路上出意外，所以今晚改成野炊了。”
“多娜……再不救她下来，她的眼泪会掉到锅里的……”

StarTowerBookEventReward.12701.3.en: Clear Monolith with Teresa in your squad once
StarTowerBookEventReward.12701.3.cn: 携带特丽莎通关1次星塔

StarTowerBookEventReward.12702.2.en:
"Donna! All done with today's deliveries!"
"Oh... 'kay. Good work. Dinner's ready."
"Thanks! I'll clean the first floor right after I eat!"
"What's gotten into you lately? So eager to clean."
The wind chime on the door jingled as Freesia returned, a birdcage in hand.
"Welcome back. Any luck finding its owner?"
"Searched the whole port, but no one's claimed it. This little fella must've flown into our window by mistake."
"If it's a stray, we could keep it and train it to deliver letters—"
"By the way, Donna ... why do I feel like someone's trying to kill me with a stare?"
From a dim corner, a pair of eyes was boring into them.
"Oh, I see. I think I know why now."
StarTowerBookEventReward.12702.2.cn:
“多娜！今天的信送完了！”
“哦……噢，辛苦了，晚饭做好了哦。”
“谢谢！我吃完饭就打扫一楼！”
“怎么了最近，干劲满满的样子……”
清脆的风铃响起，苍兰提着装有鸽子的鸟笼也回来了。
“欢迎回来，今天也没找到它的主人吗？”
“我找遍整座港口都没见，这孩子应该是碰巧飞进二楼的吧。”
“如果没有主人的话，留在我们这培养它送信——”
“另外，多娜……我怎么感觉房间里有股杀气……”
房间昏暗的角落里，似乎有双眼睛在死死地盯着这边。
“看，看来我知道原因了……”

StarTowerBookEventReward.12702.3.en: Clear Monolith with Teresa in your squad twice
StarTowerBookEventReward.12702.3.cn: 携带特丽莎通关2次星塔

StarTowerBookEventReward.12703.2.en:
Teresa loved to treasure hunt. It didn't matter what an item did; if it was cast-off but looked usable, she'd add it to her collection. Over time, her trove grew until it was bursting at the seams.
This caused more than a few problems. Storing different Artifacts together could make them react, and one time, a pile of them just blew up.
To manage her collection, Teresa had to cram her head with knowledge she had no talent for.
After dealing with so many disasters, she nearly gave up several times. But then...
"No way, it can do that too? You're amazing, Teresa!"
"Hey ... excuse me, little miss? Is that the Artifact I dropped?"
Her friends' praise or an owner's gratitude...
Those were what made all the hard work felt worth it.
StarTowerBookEventReward.12703.2.cn:
特丽莎经常寻宝，不论那些物品有何作用，只要它是被抛弃的，看起来还能使用的，她都会将之纳入自己的收藏库。久而久之，这个收藏库也渐渐地要被塞满。
由此还产生过不少问题，比如不同的神器放在一起会影响另一神器，甚至引发过爆炸。
特丽莎为了管理好收藏库，也学习过很多知识，尽管她本人并不擅长这些。
哪怕是她，在经历过各种各样的问题后，也几度有过放弃的想法，但……
“居然还有这样的作用，特丽莎真厉害！”
“诶……？那边的小妹妹，那件神器是不是我掉的？”
只要再听见伙伴的夸奖，失主的致谢。
她觉得，似乎努力做出这些不习惯的改变，也是值得的。

StarTowerBookEventReward.12703.3.en: Clear Monolith with Teresa in your squad 3 times
StarTowerBookEventReward.12703.3.cn: 携带特丽莎通关3次星塔

StarTowerBookEventReward.13001.2.en:
"Hello, I have a delivery commission."
"I'm sorry, but I lost my memories inside a Monolith. I believe this letter is meant to be delivered to someone, but I can't remember who they are, what they look like, or where they live. The only clue is the name written on this envelope."
"If I had to say one thing... They go to this Monolith outside Sailstead every summer."
"If Post Haste could help me find this person and deliver the letter to them..."

And so Donna accepted the commission. She endured the long winter, waited through the falling blossoms at the end of spring, and at last the summer arrived.
Starting today, she would search this Monolith for the recipient of this letter.
StarTowerBookEventReward.13001.2.cn:
“你好，我有一个送信的委托。”
“对不起，我在星塔里丢失了记忆。我猜这封信是要交给对方的，但对方是谁、长什么样、住在哪儿，完全不记得了。线索只有信封上的这个名字。”
“硬要说的话……他每年夏季都会去塞尔斯泰城外的这个星塔。”
“如果万送屋能帮我找到这个人把信交给他……”

就这样，多娜接下了这个送信委托，熬过了寒冬，等到春末花落，终于到了委托人说的夏季。
从今天起，她要在这座星塔里搜寻这个收信人。

StarTowerBookEventReward.13001.3.en: Clear Monolith with Donna in your squad once

StarTowerBookEventReward.13002.2.cn:
守株待兔不是多娜的风格，在夏季来临之前，早已经在塞尔斯泰的旅人营地里，打听到了不少相关的情报。

有人说可能是个二十出头的年轻旅人，因为喜欢塞尔斯泰的海，所以每年夏天都会来这里；
有人说可能是个四十岁左右的中年旅人，他在某次进入那个星塔探险时，弄丢了一个重要的东西，所以每年夏天都会来寻找；
也有人说，对方可能是位女性旅人，因为是红色的头发，再加上每年夏季都会见到，所以留下了印象。
……

到底会是什么样的收信人呢？

StarTowerBookEventReward.13002.3.en: Clear Monolith with Donna in your squad 2 times

StarTowerBookEventReward.13003.2.en:
After waiting there for a month, one day, a passing Trekker came to Donna.
"I heard you're looking for someone who comes to this Monolith every summer?"
Donna immediately perked up. "Yes! Do you know anything about them? Or do you recognize this name?"
"I've seen that letter before." The Trekker looked at the name written on the envelope. "It's a letter his girlfriend wrote to him. At the time he said he'd wait until he left the Monolith and found a safe place before reading it."
"What?! You mean this letter was already delivered to him?!"
"Yes. That time, inside the Monolith, he apparently made some kind of Wish and lost most of his memories. Later we settled him in the camp. We were going to take him home after finishing our commission. But when we got back, he had already disappeared."
It took Donna a moment to piece everything together.
"So that means ... he's the actual recipient? The person I'm supposed to find now is the amnesiac client who ran off somewhere?!"

Still, situations like this weren't unusual in a courier's life.
A few days later, Donna set out with Freesia and Teresa to search for the missing client who had lost his memory.
StarTowerBookEventReward.13003.2.cn:
在蹲守了一个月后，这一天，一位路过的旅人找到多娜。
“听说你在找一个每年夏天都来这座星塔的人？”
多娜一听来了精神：“对！你知道相关的消息吗？或者，你认识这个名字吗？”
“我见过这封信。”对方看了信件上的名字，“这是他女友写给他的信件，当时他说，他要等离开星塔之后找个安全的地方再慢慢看。”
“诶？！！你是说这封信是他收到的？！”
“是的，那一次他在星塔里不知道许了什么愿望，丢失了大部分记忆，后来我们把他安置在营地里，想着委托结束之后再带他回家，没想到等我们回来的时候他已经不见了。”
多娜花了一点时间才理清来龙去脉。
“也就是说，他才是那个收件人，所以现在我要找的，其实是不知道跑到哪里去的，失忆的收信人？！”

不过送信的路上，这样的情况也不奇怪。
几天后，多娜带上了苍兰和特丽莎，启程去寻找这位失忆的收信人。

StarTowerBookEventReward.13003.3.en: Clear Monolith with Donna in your squad 3 times

StarTowerBookEventReward.13201.2.en:
"Augh—that's all to the story?!"
Minova slammed the manga shut with a pained sigh.
"But there's obviously more! I still need to know—"
The thought hit her. She clapped a hand over her mouth and peeked out the library door.
No one was there.
"Phew. Good, nobody heard me."
Her eyes darted from the manga to the blank notebook on her desk.
A daring idea came to her.
If the author wouldn't continue the story, then she'd just have to do it herself.
StarTowerBookEventReward.13201.2.cn:
“啊——这就完结了啊！”
密涅瓦合上手中的漫画，发出一声痛苦的叹息。
“这起事件明显还有后续吧！我还想知道——”
密涅瓦仿佛突然意识到了什么，捂上了自己的嘴巴，转而走向地下书库的门。
门口空无一人。
“呼~还好没人听见。”
密涅瓦回头望向角落的漫画书，又看了看写字台上的空白笔记本。
内心萌生了一个“大胆”的想法。
如果作者不愿意再往下写的话，就由我来接替他好了。

StarTowerBookEventReward.13201.3.en: Clear Monolith with Minova in your squad once
StarTowerBookEventReward.13201.3.cn: 携带密涅瓦通关1次星塔

StarTowerBookEventReward.13202.2.en:
