"Yes, yes! There's definitely a secret mastermind behind it all."
Minova reread her dialogue, a satisfied smirk on her face.
"Wait ... does this even look like the same character?"
She snatched up her fan art and held it next to the original manga. The outline was similar, but the crooked lines and warped features made her drawing look like the character's drunken doppelgänger.
Minova stared at her eraser-smudged drawing. The clean, sharp strokes and expert paneling of the original seemed a world away from her scribbles.
"Ugh... Guess I really do have to learn to draw from scratch."
StarTowerBookEventReward.13202.2.cn:
“嗯嗯！这里绝对还有真正的幕后黑手。”
密涅瓦反复品读着自己创作的台词，脸上露出满意的笑容。
“等等，这真的是原本的角色吗？”
她猛地抓起自己的同人画稿，贴近原作反复比对。画中的角色确实有着相似的轮廓，但那些歪歪扭扭的线条、比例失调的五官，怎么看都像是原角色的远房亲戚。
密涅瓦看着自己布满橡皮碎屑的画稿，原作干净利落的笔触和精心设计的分镜，在她的涂鸦面前显得如此遥不可及。
“啊——果然还是得从头开始练习画画呢...”

StarTowerBookEventReward.13202.3.en: Clear Monolith with Minova in your squad twice
StarTowerBookEventReward.13202.3.cn: 携带密涅瓦通关2次星塔

StarTowerBookEventReward.13203.2.en:
"And so, O true mastermind, prepare to meet ... your final curtain call!"
With a final period, Minova's fanfic was done.
"Ah! That last line is so cool!"
All she had to do now was sign the cover to launch her career in the Ash District fan scene and win legions of followers...
But!
The fact that "Minova draws shojo manga" was a secret even more shocking than "Minova reads shojo manga."
Her hand froze mid-air above the cover, hesitating.
"Maybe... I'll wait till my art gets better before I think about publishing this."
StarTowerBookEventReward.13203.2.cn:
“就这样了，真正的幕后黑手，迎接属于你的——最终谢幕吧！”
随着最后一个句号落下，密涅瓦的同人作品正式完成。
“啊！最后一句话太帅了！”
接下来只要在封面署上大名，就能在灰城区文学界崭露头角，收获无数粉丝...
但是！
“密涅瓦会画少女漫画”这个秘密，恐怕比“密涅瓦会看少女漫画”还要惊人。
密涅瓦的手悬停在本子的封面上迟迟不敢落下。
“还是等画技进步些再考虑发布吧...”

StarTowerBookEventReward.13203.3.en: Clear Monolith with Minova in your squad 3 times
StarTowerBookEventReward.13203.3.cn: 携带密涅瓦通关3次星塔

StarTowerBookEventReward.13301.2.en:
Venturing into the Monolith alone is a challenge. To do so while trying to investigate and analyze your surroundings like a scholar makes it all the more astonishing.
These rooms teem with monsters; they are not quiet libraries or peaceful classrooms.
For this reason, only large organizations like the Grace Imperium can mount in-depth research expeditions. Trekkers survive on experience passed down from one generation to the next.
But now, there is someone who intends to break that long-standing pattern...
StarTowerBookEventReward.13301.2.cn:
在星塔里独行，从来不是一件容易的事；而如果要像一个学者那样，还要一边调查和思考的话，那就更显得不可思议了。
这里是危机四伏的星塔房间，不是悠闲的书斋或和平的课堂。
所以，除去恩赐意志等大型组织有能力深入调查，旅人们依靠的往往是过往累积的经验，是前辈与后辈间的传承。
但现如今，却有一个人想要打破这种惯例……

StarTowerBookEventReward.13301.3.en: Clear Monolith with Nazuka in your squad once

StarTowerBookEventReward.13302.2.en:
Nazuka has always been a serious person; whether studying magic or becoming a Trekker, once she decides to do something, she gives it her all.
It's not just about herself; she hopes everyone around her can grow together.
She never drags others forward by force; what she truly wants is to record and to share.
To remove errors, to compile knowledge—every advancement in the world begins from that.
With her friends working in unison, she has overcome monsters and Stellaroids that once seemed invincible; so then, if there were even more friends, could they not overcome even greater challenges?
StarTowerBookEventReward.13302.2.cn:
夏花从来都是一个认真的人，学习魔法也好、 成为旅人也罢，要做，就要做到最好。
不止是她自己，她还希望所有人都能一起进步。
她不会强行拽着别人一起向前；她真正想做的，是记录与共享。
剔除错误、总结知识，世间一切的进步皆来源于此。
与朋友们齐心协力，能战胜看似强大到不可一世的魔物与星骸；那么，如果朋友再多些，是否就能战胜更为艰巨的困难？

StarTowerBookEventReward.13302.3.en: Clear Monolith with Nazuka in your squad twice

StarTowerBookEventReward.13303.2.en:
Rather than chasing lofty ideals, it's better to keep one's feet on the ground.
Spending time and energy on things like this will inevitably draw mockery from those who don't understand.
Nazuka keeps writing—about everything from the ecology of Stellaroids to the structure of each layer, from vegetation patterns to shortcuts through dense forests. She records as much as she can, what she knows and what she doesn't. Sometimes she writes questions, sometimes warnings, sometimes her own reflections and lessons learned.
The handbook is still far from completion, with many pages yet to be filled.
Before distributing it to other Trekkers, she thinks, she'll treat it as her own journal for now.
She will wait quietly, until the day comes when the chance for change arrives.
StarTowerBookEventReward.13303.2.cn:
与其好高骛远，不如脚踏实地。
将时间与精力浪费在这种事上，总免不了被不理解的人嘲笑。
夏花持续地写着，从星骸的生态到楼层的构造，从植被的分布到密林的捷径，她尽可能地记录下自己懂与不懂的事情。有时提出疑问，有时备注上警告，有时记上自己的感悟和教训。
距离手册正式完成，可能还有不少页。
在给旅人们分发之前，就先当做自己的日记吧，她想。
她会默默等待，直到有一天，改变的契机到来。

StarTowerBookEventReward.13303.3.en: Clear Monolith with Nazuka in your squad 3 times

StarTowerBookEventReward.13401.2.en:
"I'll be fine... I can do this on my own!"
That's what Fuyuka told herself on her very first solo Monolith climb.
She didn't realize then that being alone wasn't the issue. The real trouble was what to do when she didn't want to be.
Too afraid of being a bother to ask for advice and too shy to risk conflict, she avoided other Trekkers all the time.
So she just barreled forward blindly, pushing on and on...

By the time she reached the summit, she was forced to stop, all alone.
"Huh? Is... is that it?"
Behind her lay a wreckage-strewn path, with terrified Stellaroids scrambling for cover.
StarTowerBookEventReward.13401.2.cn:
“我一个人……一定没问题的！”
这是冬香下定决心头一次独自爬塔时，对自己说的话。
当然，那个时候的她还没有意识到，她“一个人”的时候确实没问题，问题在于当她不想一个人的时候该怎么办。
因为怕麻烦别人，她没有去请教前辈；因为怕生，她更不敢和别的旅人产生冲突。
结果，她只能自顾自地一个人闷头往前冲，一直往前，一直，一直……
直到她真的独自一人踏上塔顶的时候，才不得不停下脚步。
“欸？这，这就到了？”
在她身后，是一地狼藉，与瑟瑟发抖想要躲起来的弱小星骸。

StarTowerBookEventReward.13401.3.en: Clear Monolith with Fuyuka in your squad once

StarTowerBookEventReward.13402.2.en:
For a while, her methods didn't change.

She charged straight ahead, eyes closed, crushing everything in her path. And when she finally opened her eyes, she was already at the top of the Monolith.
The higher she climbed, the lonelier she felt. Within the Monolith, she could unleash her power unrestrained; outside of it, she was a weirdo who belonged nowhere.
What Fuyuka didn't know was that while she wallowed in self-pity, stories about her had already begun spreading among nearby Trekker circles...

The Trekker whom no one could catch up to—the solitary powerhouse who radiated an air of cold pride—had become a legend within the community.
StarTowerBookEventReward.13402.2.cn:
在那之后的一段时间里，冬香始终没有改变自己的作风。
一路狂奔，闭着眼睛碾碎眼前的一切，睁开眼睛的时候就到了塔顶。
她愈发感到寂寞。身处星塔中的她可以肆意发泄力量，星塔外却是个找不到归属感的笨蛋。
然而，冬香不知道的是，在她自怨自艾的时候，有关于她的传闻，已经开始在附近的旅人群体中流传……
谁都追赶不上的背影，散发着孤高氛围的强者，已成为小圈子里的传说。

StarTowerBookEventReward.13402.3.en: Clear Monolith with Fuyuka in your squad twice

StarTowerBookEventReward.13403.2.en:
"Hey, the 'Ice-Cold, White-Haired Speedrunner'... T-that's her, right? I heard she drove her whole squad away to push her own limits. I thought that was just another wild rumor..."
"Shh, don't make eye contact. You don't want to interrupt her training and get decked."
"With fists like those? You'd get destroyed."

Later, after Fuyuka became a renowned Trekker, some of those who had heard the tales or seen her in action became her most fervent admirers.
They began to emulate her solo Monolith speed-runs, obsessively competing over clear times... But that is another story, one Fuyuka herself knows nothing about.
StarTowerBookEventReward.13403.2.cn:
“喂，‘超冷漠的白发速通高手’，就、就是那个人吧……？据说她为了挑战自我，把队友全都赶跑了。我还以为只是一个荒野传说……”
“嘘，不要和她对上视线。妨碍了她的锻炼，小心被揍一顿。”
“那双大拳头要是砸在身上，整个人都会变得七零八落吧。”
后来，当冬香名声大噪，真正成为厉害的旅人时，曾经听闻和目睹过她事迹的旅人们，有一部分成为狂热的崇拜者，效仿她过去独自一人快速登塔的行为，沉迷于比拼各自的攀登速度……这就是冬香本人不知道的另一个故事了。

StarTowerBookEventReward.13403.3.en: Clear Monolith with Fuyuka in your squad 3 times

StarTowerBookEventReward.13501.2.en:
For a bombshell exposé on Flavio's corrupt spice merchant, Mistique hid her beloved broom and fully disguised herself as a rookie Trekker.
"So, what does the company make you wish for?"
"Atomizers, storage tanks ... all huge and heavy. And we have to haul every last one!"
"Must be good pay for such tough work, huh?"
"Pay? We're lucky when they don't just give us perfume instead of wages!"
Mistique plastered that last quote in her article's subtitle, sparking a public firestorm.
The merchant scrambled to issue a rebuttal, claiming with a straight face that the perfume was "as good as cash." What a joke!
StarTowerBookEventReward.13501.2.cn:
在撰写轰动弗拉维奥的“无良香料商”的报道时，为了混入被香料商雇佣的旅人队伍，雾语难得地把她最喜欢的扫帚和帽子都好好藏了起来，彻底伪装成了一个新手旅人。
“公司每天都要你们许愿些什么东西出来啊？”
“从喷雾器到储存罐——最关键的是，这些东西又重又大，居然要一个个搬出去……！”
“这么辛苦，待遇应该很好吧？”
“别提了，能正常发工资就不错了，他们有时还拿做好的香水来当工资发呢！”
这句关键的证言最后被精心安排在了副标题上，引发了众怒。
最后，香料商不得不出来驳斥，但却用了“这些香水实际上早就是硬通货了，完全可以起到等价物的作用”——之类的可笑说辞。

StarTowerBookEventReward.13501.3.en: Clear Monolith with Mistique in your squad once

StarTowerBookEventReward.13502.2.en:
Mistique once tried her hand at being an idol.
She entered Flavio's talent competition under a fake name to expose rumored vote-rigging. Her sweet voice and dramatic flair charmed both judges and fans, carrying her all the way to the finals.
Her infiltration paid off—she got a look at the final rankings before the show.
When she saw she was ranked last for lacking a sponsor, a fire ignited within her. She decided to expose the whole sham live on stage.
Predictably, security dragged her off the second she charged the stage, giving her an early exit.
Her hastily written exposé didn't get out before the official results were announced, and the organizers just shrugged it all off as "a coincidence."
StarTowerBookEventReward.13502.2.cn:
雾语还当过几天偶像。
为了揭露传闻中的黑箱操作，她化名打扮、参加了弗拉维奥的偶像选秀。凭借甜美的歌喉和夸张的演技，她征服了许多评委和粉丝，一路过关斩将来到总决赛的舞台。
成功潜伏的她，真的提前于决赛开始前，就瞥见了最终名次。
当发现自己因为没有自带赞助而被排在末尾时，她燃起了少有的斗志，并决定在舞台的现场把一切都揭发出来——
不出所料，雾语刚冲上台还没开口就被安保拖走丢出了场——但她也得以提前离开。
她紧急制作的报道，最终还是没能提前于选秀结果发出——组委会轻飘飘地用一句“这只是巧合的推测”，就将事情简单地压了下去。

StarTowerBookEventReward.13502.3.en: Clear Monolith with Mistique in your squad twice

StarTowerBookEventReward.13503.2.en:
A witch's work is always risky, but it was rare to have a price put on your head.
Mistique's article, "Media and Energy: The Truth About Nova," had only scratched the surface of the open secret between Flavio and the Grace Imperium.
But that was enough. After its release, no one would publish her stories. Scarlet Sights Media even publicly announced that the Witch Protection Act no longer applied to her.
For Mistique, this was the ultimate undercover mission. Free from deadlines, word counts, and waiting for assignments, she could finally write for herself.
Besides, the best stories weren't in the city—they were out in the Wilds and among the Monoliths.
StarTowerBookEventReward.13503.2.cn:
魔女的工作向来伴随着风险——但像雾语这样被点名追杀的情况还是很少见的。
她那篇名为《传媒与能源——诺瓦的真相》的报道，仅仅只是稍稍揭开了一点点弗拉维奥和恩赐意志之间的公开秘密。
可从此以后，她的新闻就再也没法被接收登报了；绯曈传讯也公开表示《魔女保护条例》将不再适用于雾语。
对雾语来说，这次的以身入局最为彻底——她真的不再需要顾及什么版面、字数、截稿日了，只为自己兴趣去写报道就行。
也不再需要整日都待在城里等待绯曈的发号施令了——荒野和星塔里，往往也有精彩的新闻值得一写。

StarTowerBookEventReward.13503.3.en: Clear Monolith with Mistique in your squad 3 times

StarTowerBookEventReward.14001.2.en:
Ever since the Tech Convention, Sparkla had rejected all other commissions to made Tyrant Pie's development her top priority. It was rare she found a muse that fit her aesthetic so perfectly—a perfect chance to turn a unique being into a fun invention.
As for the name "Tyrant Pie"? It was borrowed directly from that person's title. But anyone familiar with Sparkla knew this "inspiration" was just a cover for her total lack of naming talent. Every single robot she built was simply named after its appearance, with the word "Pie" slapped on the end.
StarTowerBookEventReward.14001.2.cn:
那次技术大会后，斯帕克拉就推掉了一切订单，将魔王派的研发提到最高的优先级。毕竟，很少有机会能将这样一个符合自己审美的存在作为灵感，转变成一件有意思的发明。
对了，魔王派这个名字，也是以那个人的“称谓”为基础取的——当然，如果熟知斯帕克拉的取名模式，便会知道这个所谓的灵感也掩盖不了她不擅长取名的事实：她所制造的每一个机器人，名字都由外形加一个‘派’字构成。

StarTowerBookEventReward.14001.3.en: Clear Monolith with Sparkla in your squad once
StarTowerBookEventReward.14001.3.cn: 携带斯帕克拉通关1次星塔

StarTowerBookEventReward.14002.2.en:
The time had finally come to test Tyrant Pie. Sparkla yanked Leona and Bloc off her blocklist and invited them to climb the Monolith, completely ignoring Leona's furious spam and the ninety-nine new feature requests from Bloc.
"Interesting! Let's see who's better—your Tyrant Pie or my Tick-Tock-Boom-Bang-Pop!" Sizing up the new robot at the Monolith entrance, Leona issued a challenge.
Taking a leisurely sip of tea, Bloc delivered a crushing blow. "Your Tick-Tock-Boom-Bang-Pop couldn't even beat her Rabbit Pie last time."
Sparkla added fuel to the fire without looking up from Tyrant Pie's final diagnostics. "It's a support bot. If you can't even tell that much, Leona, I seriously question your skills."
"Arrrgh! Just you wait! You'll see what Tick-Tock-Boom-Bang-Pop can really do once we're inside!"

Having successfully goaded Leona into charging in first to clear the way, Sparkla and Bloc shared a knowing nod.
StarTowerBookEventReward.14002.2.cn:
终于到了魔王派投入测试的阶段。斯帕克拉将莱欧和布洛可拉出了黑名单，在无视了莱欧暴跳如雷的问候消息和布洛可发来的九十九个新需求的同时，邀请她们和自己组队攀爬星塔。
“有意思。就用你的魔王派和我的嘀嗒蹦蹦叮当啪决一胜负吧！”星塔入口处，前来会合的莱欧仔细观察了一番斯帕克拉的新发明，代表自己的机器人给魔王派下了战书。
“你的嘀嗒蹦蹦叮当啪那次连她的兔子派都没打过。”布洛可悠然地品了一口茶，给莱欧一记重拳。
在给魔王派进行最后检修的斯帕克拉又火上浇油了一把，“它是辅助型机器人。连这个都看不出，我很怀疑你的水平，莱欧。”
“啊啊啊啊啊可恶！你们给我等着，等着在星塔见识见识嘀嗒蹦蹦叮当啪的厉害！”

成功刺激莱欧抢先进入星塔开路后，斯帕克拉和布洛可心照不宣地朝对方点了点头。

StarTowerBookEventReward.14002.3.en: Clear Monolith with Sparkla in your squad 2 times
StarTowerBookEventReward.14002.3.cn: 携带斯帕克拉通关2次星塔

StarTowerBookEventReward.14003.2.en:
Inside the Monolith.
Tick-Tock-Boom-Bang-Pop's wild bombardment drew a massive swarm of Stellaroids right toward the trio.
"It really does make an excellent decoy," Sparkla noted approvingly.
Now it was time for Tyrant Pie and Rabbit Pie to shine. Tuning out Leona's distant screams of "It's not a decoy! It's my ultimate invincible bomber!", Sparkla hit Tyrant Pie's start button.
"Commencing calculations." A human voice emanated from within the robot. Sparkla had actually gone out of her way to have that person record the audio, even installing a dedicated voice module for it. Unfortunately, Tyrant Pie could at that point only transmit its calculation results to Rabbit Pie via voiceprint.
"Three o'clock. Four small Stellaroids and one medium Stellaroid approaching at 10.44 meters per second."
Guided by the steady stream of beeps, Rabbit Pie easily wiped out the vast majority of the swarm—beating Tick-Tock-Boom-Bang-Pop by exactly forty-three kills.

"You guys are double-teaming me! That's not fair!!" Leona's furious roar echoed through the tower.
StarTowerBookEventReward.14003.2.cn:
星塔内。
嘀嗒蹦蹦叮当啪的狂轰滥炸吸引了无数的星骸向斯帕克拉三人涌来。
“确实是很厉害的诱饵型机器人。”斯帕克拉对嘀嗒蹦蹦叮当啪予以了肯定。
接下来就看魔王派和兔子派的了。斯帕克拉继续无视了从莱欧处传来的“它才不是诱饵！它可是我无敌的最强型号炸弹人！”之类的大吼大叫，按下了魔王派的启动键。
“测算开始。”人声从魔王派的内部传来，这是斯帕克拉专程找那个人录制的语音，为此她还特意加装了语音模块。只是可惜，目前魔王派在测算过程中暂时只能以音纹的形式将结果传输给兔子派。
“三点钟方向，四个小型星骸和一个中型星骸以10.44米每秒的速度靠近。”
就这样，在滴滴嗒嗒的信号声中，兔子派歼灭了绝大多数星骸，比嘀嗒蹦蹦叮当啪多了四十三只。

“你们二打一！这不公平！！”星塔内回响着莱欧的怒吼。

StarTowerBookEventReward.14003.3.en: Clear Monolith with Sparkla in your squad 3 times
StarTowerBookEventReward.14003.3.cn: 携带斯帕克拉通关3次星塔

StarTowerBookEventReward.14101.2.en:
They say you can find anything in a Monolith.
Chixia snagged a videotape with a crooked label: The Rixx. A few letters were smudged beyond recognition.
How was she supposed to play it?
A few steps away, she found a small black box with a slot that looked like a perfect fit.
Why not?
She shoved the tape in. An image instantly flickered to life on the wall—a movie!
Her master and senior weren't due back for a while, so Chixia settled in comfortably. Moments later, a piercing scream ripped through the Monolith.
"GHOST—!"
StarTowerBookEventReward.14101.2.cn:
早就听说星塔里什么都有。
赤霞捡到了一个录像带，上面贴着一个标签，歪歪扭扭地写着“午夜○铃”，第三个字字迹模糊，已经看不出来是什么。
这要怎么用呢？
赤霞带着录像，走了几步，又在一个房间里找到了一个黑色的小方盒，上面有个缺口，看上去似乎正好能把录像带放进去。
那就放进去吧？
赤霞不做多想，在把录像带塞进去之后，小方盒在她背后的墙面上投影出了画面——原来是影戏。
师父和师姐还有一段时间才会回来，于是赤霞找了个舒服的位置，开始观看这个影戏，过了一会，星塔里传出了赤霞震耳欲聋的尖叫声。
“有‘鬼’啊——！”

StarTowerBookEventReward.14101.3.en: Clear Monolith with Chixia in your squad once

StarTowerBookEventReward.14102.2.en:
But Chixia never learned her lesson. Her master's warnings about grabbing random things in the Monoliths went in one ear and out the other.
This time, her prize was a book.
Its brown cover was scrawled with bizarre symbols in black ink, and a yellow paper talisman was stuck to its spine. It looked incredibly ominous, but Chixia's curiosity flared. She picked it up, studying the talisman's strangely familiar handwriting.
Suddenly, she spotted a paper slip tucked inside. Her hand shot out before her brain could catch up. She yanked it free—and found a giant Stellaroid stuck to the other end.
Only did it click that the handwriting on the talisman click belonged to her master...
StarTowerBookEventReward.14102.2.cn:
但赤霞吃一堑不长一智。即使师父再三强调，让她不要在星塔里乱捡东西，她还是会一而再地，去捡一些来路不明的东西。
这次捡到的是一本书……
褐色封面上被黑色的墨水画满了意义不明的符号，侧边还贴着黄色的符纸。虽然看上去就非常诡异，但赤霞还是管不住自己的好奇心，她把书捡起来，仔细看了好久，总觉得这个符纸上的字迹有点似曾相识。
忽然，赤霞发现书中间夹着一张纸条。她眼快手更快，还没等大脑反应过来，已经把那张纸条抽了出来——纸条的另一端黏着一只巨大的星骸。
直到这时，赤霞才反应过来那个符纸上的字迹是自己师父的笔迹……

StarTowerBookEventReward.14102.3.en: Clear Monolith with Chixia in your squad twice

StarTowerBookEventReward.14103.2.en:
Chixia spotted another strange object in the Monolith.
Her hands twitched, dying to snatch it up. Her brain was losing control over her actions. Sure, anything could appear in a Monolith, but this clay pot sat right in the middle of the path, practically begging to be picked up.
For once, though, a chill of fear stopped her. She'd just read a story about a village where people sealed skulls in pots, believing they were vessels for resurrection, waiting for "them" to return...
The longer she stared, the more she became convinced the pot was exactly the right size for a skull.
"Nope! I'm getting out of here!"
StarTowerBookEventReward.14103.2.cn:
赤霞又在星塔里看到一个奇怪的东西。
她感觉自己的手已经快要脱离大脑的控制，想去把那东西捡起来看看是什么——虽说这里是星塔，什么东西都有可能出现，但这个看上去像陶罐一样的东西，突兀地出现在路中间，无论怎么看都像是在引诱过路人捡起来看看。
但赤霞难得对这个东西产生了一些害怕的情绪，这源于昨天她看了一个话本，上面记录了在某个神秘的村庄里，他们相信头骨是复生的媒介，所以当地人会把头骨装进陶罐里，等待“他们”回来的那一天……
赤霞越看越觉得，这个陶罐像是够装下的大小。
“呜……我还是赶紧离开吧！”

StarTowerBookEventReward.14103.3.en: Clear Monolith with Chixia in your squad 3 times

StarTowerBookEventReward.14201.2.en:
Aeloria's first assignment for Cosette on the Nova Continent: survey the Monoliths and find a way to blow them up.
Deceptively simple.
To Cosette, a Monolith was just a big tree. Find the right spot at the base, plant a big enough bomb, and down it goes.
She headed to the nearest one outside the city to scout it out, but...
Cosette walked all afternoon. The Monolith loomed right ahead, yet she only ever seemed to circle its base, never getting any closer.
"How is this possible...?"
StarTowerBookEventReward.14201.2.cn:
珂赛特来到诺瓦大陆之后，极光给她的第一个任务：调查星塔的结构，寻找能够炸毁星塔的办法。
听上去似乎不难。
在珂赛特的概念里，星塔就像大树，只要在底部找到合适的位置，放上足够的炸药，让一座星塔倒塌简直轻而易举。
于是她朝着城邦外最近的星塔走去，决定先去踩个点，只是……
珂赛特走了整整一个下午，明明星塔就在眼前，但她却像是在星塔底部绕圈一样，无论如何都无法靠近。
“到底为什么会这样……”

StarTowerBookEventReward.14201.3.en: Clear Monolith with Cosette in your squad once
StarTowerBookEventReward.14201.3.cn: 携带珂赛特通关1次星塔

StarTowerBookEventReward.14202.2.en:
This was her first big mission from Lady Aeloria, and Cosette was determined to crush it.
She started tailing Trekkers. After losing her target three times and following the wrong group five times, she finally tracked a squad to a supposed Monolith entrance—an elevator.
She watched them get on, planning to take the next car down into the Monolith. But just as the doors shut, the elevator dematerialized.
Cosette sprinted to the spot and spun around, completely bewildered.
"Huh?! Where did it go?! Could I be following ... ghosts?!"
StarTowerBookEventReward.14202.2.cn:
这可是极光大人交给她的第一个重要任务，无论如何，珂赛特都要好好完成。
于是她开始跟踪过往的旅人，在跟丢了三次、跟错了五次之后，终于，珂赛特尾随着一队旅人，找到了据说可以进入星塔的入口——一部升降梯。
于是，就在她眼睁睁地看着那群旅人上了升降梯，计划着等下一趟，自己也能进入星塔内部一探究竟时，升降梯在她面前消失了。
珂赛特跑到刚刚升降梯出现的位置，又在附近转了几圈，根本不敢相信自己的眼睛。
“诶？？怎么不见了？？难道说我刚刚跟踪的旅人……是幽灵？！”

StarTowerBookEventReward.14202.3.en: Clear Monolith with Cosette in your squad twice
StarTowerBookEventReward.14202.3.cn: 携带珂赛特通关2次星塔

StarTowerBookEventReward.14203.2.en:
After extensive trial and error, Cosette finally found out how to enter the Monolith.
If she couldn't get to the base from the outside, she'd just plant the bomb on the inside. Perfect!
Today's task was to calculate her escape time after setting the charge...
But her train of thought was derailed by a nearby shop. Bright lights bathed rows of shelves in an irresistible, heavenly glow.
Cosette drifted over...
"Whoa! Soda! I've never seen this flavor before! Or this one! And this one too...!"
Drowning in delight, her mission was completely forgotten.
StarTowerBookEventReward.14203.2.cn:
经过多番调查取证，珂赛特终于找到了进入星塔的正确方法。
既然无法从外部靠近星塔底部，那么，只要在星塔内部放置好炸药，然后引爆，摧毁星塔的任务也能顺利完成！
因此，今天的任务就是，计算从放置了炸药的星塔底部，到彻底离开星塔所需要的时间……
正想着，珂赛特突然注意到旁边有一个商店，明亮的灯光打在一排排货架上，商品宛如沐浴在圣光之中，吸引着路过的行人。
珂赛特忍不住走过去……
“呜哇——！是饮料！！这是什么，完全没有见过的口味，这个也是，还有这个……！”
沉浸在喜悦中的珂赛特似乎把任务抛在了脑后。

StarTowerBookEventReward.14203.3.en: Clear Monolith with Cosette in your squad 3 times
StarTowerBookEventReward.14203.3.cn: 携带珂赛特通关3次星塔

StarTowerBookEventReward.14301.2.en:
The blizzard has howled since the birth of the North, and the battle to survive it has never ceased.
They felled giants of the forest to raise high walls and stoked great fires against the cold. Huddled in that warmth, bonds of kinship were forged that would last for generations.
But survival is not living. To build a true home, they needed a stronger flame. And so, they turned their eyes to the starlight flickering within the storm.
Defeat the foes. Endure the trial. Ascend the Monolith.
At the summit, the prize was always the same: warmth and light.
This was a rite reserved for the proven. They called it the Flame Hunt.
StarTowerBookEventReward.14301.2.cn:
这场无止境的风雪自北国的土地诞生起就从未停歇，而生活在这里的人们同样未曾停止与其的抗争。
他们砍倒巨木，筑起围墙，堆起篝火，人们围在这片温暖中，诞生一个又一个联系紧密的家族。
但仅仅是这样还远远不够，要建设能让所有人都安居乐业的家园，他们需要带来更多的火种，为了这一伟大的目标，他们向那片风雪中不断闪烁的星光求索。
战胜强敌，通过试炼，攀上塔顶。
然后，所有人索取的都会是同一个结果——温暖与光明。
这是一个只有被认可的战士才能参与的特别狩猎，人们将之称为“猎火”。

StarTowerBookEventReward.14301.3.en: Clear Monolith with Wraith in your squad once

StarTowerBookEventReward.14302.2.en:
The end of a Flame Hunt marked the start of a feast. As wine flowed and ancient ballads rang out, the clan celebrated the heroes who brought home the Artifacts of light.
Young Wraith always claimed a spot in the front row, eyes fixed on the clan's renowned Chief Warden, her grandfather.
Tracing the scars on his mighty arms, she began to dream of the day she would sit at the head of that table.
She packed her gear with care and shadowed the hunting parties, but she sought no glory in this. She came only to learn.
Wraith etched every swing of the blade and every shift of the Stellaroids into her memory.
She let this wisdom build, waiting for the moment she could finally wield it.
StarTowerBookEventReward.14302.2.cn:
每一次“猎火庆典”的结束都会是一场盛宴的开始，人们将美酒与佳肴摆上巨大的圆木桌上，合唱那传承百年的歌谣，欢庆猎火者将温暖与光明的神器带到众人的身边。
年幼的风影时常会站在最前排围观这份荣耀的加冕，只因她的祖父是族内有名的“战士之长”。
望着祖父健硕的臂膀上无数的伤痕，风影也逐渐萌生了想要成为这场欢宴的主角的想法。
风影精心地挑选着装备，每一次都悄悄跟在出发队伍的身后，但她并不是想去证明自己，相反，她是来虚心学习的。
风影将那些战士们挥动武器的身姿，将那些星骸的行动，牢牢地记在了心里。
这些知识与经验会不断地累计，直到它们为风影所用。

StarTowerBookEventReward.14302.3.en: Clear Monolith with Wraith in your squad twice

StarTowerBookEventReward.14303.2.en:
Wraith thought she was unseen on those hunts, but the hunters always knew she was there.
It was an unspoken pact. They lured beasts into her line of sight—close enough to study, too far to strike—turning every hunt into a lesson for the brave girl.
Eventually, the clan noticed a white-haired girl marching at the rear of the returning column. Yet no one questioned her place. In this land, if you return to the song of triumph, you are a warrior.
This was their way. Skills were passed down like heirlooms. From parent to child, clan to city. Bound by warmth, they shared the joy and glory as they awaited the next hunt expectantly.
But they could not have known back then that Wraith would be their youngest Flame Hunter ... as well as their last.
StarTowerBookEventReward.14303.2.cn:
风影不知道的是，每一次出征，除了她自己以外，所有人都知道风影跟在了队伍的身后。
战士们心照不宣，他们尽量将怪物引至风影能仔细观察，又不会被威胁的位置，将每一次狩猎都当做是赠给只属于这位勇敢孩子的额外课程。
而当某一次宴会开启的时候人们才注意到，在归来的队伍末尾中，多了一位长着白色秀长头发的少女。但不会有任何人质疑她的存在，在这片尚武之地，于凯旋的歌谣中一同归来的，也必定是值得敬佩的战士。
在风雪中建立城邦的人们就是这样，如同纽带般，他们将战斗的技巧与知识毫无保留地传承给下一代人，从亲子到家族，从家族到社会，人们在温暖和光明中共享喜悦和荣耀，并期待着下一次狩猎的到来。
只是当时的人们没有想到，风影，会是这座城邦里最年轻也是最后一位“猎火者”。

StarTowerBookEventReward.14303.3.en: Clear Monolith with Wraith in your squad 3 times

StarTowerBookEventReward.14401.2.en:
When Chitose first heard of the Monoliths, she was baffled.
Living as a blade, she couldn't comprehend the purpose of the climb. That so many would fight endlessly and sacrifice their memories for the greedy wishes of a few struck her as bizarre.
She believed the truly strong could obtain anything through their own power and should lack for nothing.
Relying on others was a sign of weakness, and the weak commanded no one.
Chitose clung to these views throughout her travels—until the day she spent her last coin. It was then she learned that in this world, enough Dorra could make even the mightiest warrior bow.
And climbing the Monoliths was the surest way to earn it. So, she joined the climbing parties.
StarTowerBookEventReward.14401.2.cn:
千都世第一次知晓星塔的存在时是震惊的。
以“刀”处世的她，最初并不理解探索星塔这种行为的意义，只是为了少数人的贪欲，就要如此多的人不断战斗、然后付出记忆去许愿，怎么想都很奇怪。
她总觉得，真正的强者应该什么都可以靠自己的实力获得，理应什么都不缺才对。
如果还要拜托他人来代行，说明不够强，而不够强的人又怎么命令的动别人呢？
就这样，千都世持续抱持着这样的意见旅行着——直到她把从家中带出的盘缠全部花完的那一刻，她才意识到，原来这个世界，没有足够多的朵拉的话，再强的强者也要卑躬屈膝。
而攀登星塔，恰恰能够赚来这最宝贵的朵拉——所以，她也加入了攀登的队伍。

StarTowerBookEventReward.14401.3.en: Clear Monolith with Chitose in your squad once
StarTowerBookEventReward.14401.3.cn: 携带千都世通关1次星塔

StarTowerBookEventReward.14402.2.en:
Chitose's first climb left the other Trekkers gaping in disbelief.
She fearlessly and decisively swept through every monster.
But when her temporary squadmates nervously approached her to divide the loot, they found they couldn't get through to her. The seasoned warrior simply lacked the common sense of the Nova Continent.
She showed no interest in the valuable Artifacts they found, always ending with the same statement:
"Just give me my share after you trade it for Dorra."
Unlike other Trekkers who saved money, stockpiled supplies, or kept useful Artifacts, she never seemed to plan for the future. She just kept climbing with her large quilt and rice balls, as if she were always starting anew.
StarTowerBookEventReward.14402.2.cn:
千都世第一次攀登星塔时，其他旅人是震惊的。
她三下五除二地将怪物全部一扫而空，毫无恐惧，毫无犹豫。
临时结伴的旅人队友战战兢兢地找她商量怎么分配战利品时，却发现是鸡同鸭讲——因为这位富有经验的武人缺乏诺瓦大陆的常识。
她对偶尔找到的高价值神器也没什么特别的兴趣，最后总是归到一句
“等换了朵拉再分我就行。”
与其他旅人会尝试存下钱，存下物资，存下有用的神器不同，她似乎从未考虑过以后的事，只是带着她的大被子和饭团持续地攀登着——就好像在不断地重新启程。

StarTowerBookEventReward.14402.3.en: Clear Monolith with Chitose in your squad twice
StarTowerBookEventReward.14402.3.cn: 携带千都世通关2次星塔

StarTowerBookEventReward.14403.2.en:
Portia was also shocked when she found Chitose sleeping inside a Monolith.
It's common knowledge among Trekkers: the Monoliths are dangerous, and you don't linger, not even in seemingly safe areas.
So when Portia spotted the girl wrapped in a quilt inside the convenience store, she was the one who panicked.
"Is she here to take my spot? Great, I'm finally getting fired..."
She poked Chitose's cheek, getting no response. But then a loud "Grrrrumble..." reached her ears.
"... Not only are you sleeping on the floor, but you entered the Monolith on an empty stomach? Do you have a death wish?"
Portia went to great lengths to wake Chitose with the aroma of rice balls. After eating, Chitose groggily rolled up her quilt and wandered off.
Later, all that remained in her memory was a vague dream of tasting some incredibly delicious rice inside the Monolith.
StarTowerBookEventReward.14403.2.cn:
波西亚发现千都世居然在星塔里睡觉时，也是震惊的。
星塔是个很危险的地方，即使是看似安全的区域，也不能久留——这应该是旅人的常识才对。
所以当波西亚在便利店里发现了这个裹着被子的少女时，慌乱的反而变成了她。
“这是来踢馆的吗？好吧，我的工作终于要丢了……”
她戳了戳千都世的脸，却毫无反应。但一声“咕——”的响动却传进耳朵。
“……不仅直接打铺盖睡觉，还敢饿着肚子进星塔里……你到底要不要命……？”
波西亚花费了许多功夫用饭团的香气唤醒了千都世，她迷迷糊糊地卷起了被子就扬长而去。
后来，千都世的记忆里，只模糊地剩下了“在星塔里曾经尝到过非常美味的米饭”的梦境。

StarTowerBookEventReward.14403.3.en: Clear Monolith with Chitose in your squad 3 times
StarTowerBookEventReward.14403.3.cn: 携带千都世通关3次星塔

StarTowerBookEventReward.14501.2.en:
Pain and a blinding white glare are the first things Otoha notices as she drifts back to consciousness.
She realizes with a sinking feeling that she might not make it out of the Monolith this time. Pushing her limits while her mind was in such turmoil was a fatal mistake.
As the light fades, she closes her eyes and braces for the end—only to hear a voice call out.
Not a familiar whisper from her past, but a stranger's.
An enemy! Her instincts kick in as she throws three kunai into the dark, only to be met with silence.
Then, her hand brushes against something smooth and cold... A mirror?

Why is there a mirror here?
"Now, open your eyes and look at yourself," the stranger commands. Light suddenly floods the room, turning the darkness into day.
A massive mirror stands before her, holding Otoha's reflection in its depths.
StarTowerBookEventReward.14501.2.cn:
乙叶从疼痛与混沌中苏醒，眼前浮现出一团白光。
她意识到，自己可能无法走出这座星塔了。她的确不应该在心绪混乱的时候挑战极限。
白光慢慢消散，像是走马灯最后的余光，她闭上眼睛，准备迎接终结，却听到了一声呼唤。
——那呼唤并非来自过往熟悉的呢喃，而是一个陌生的声音。
有敌人！她本能地掷出三枚苦无，却没传来任何回响。
她的手抚摸到了一块光滑的、冰冷的……镜子？！

这里怎么会有镜子？
“现在，你可以睁开眼，看一看镜中的自己了。”陌生的声音再次响起，周遭骤然亮如白昼。
一面巨大的镜子，映照着乙叶的身影。

StarTowerBookEventReward.14501.3.en: Clear Monolith with Otoha in your squad once

StarTowerBookEventReward.14502.2.en:
Otoha comes to again, the pain sharper now, though the brief blackout gave her just enough strength to move.
That obnoxious mirror remains, an invisible wall cutting her off from the rest of the world.
Is this some trick of the Monolith? She knows illusions are always weakest at the seams. Taking a steadying breath, she prepares to shatter the facade.

"So violent for such an elegant lady."
As Otoha fires, the "ghost" behind the glass finally speaks again. "This is a simple mirror. It reveals everyone's true nature. Are you trying to break it because you can't face the truth?"
Otoha scoffs. "And you? Are you staying hidden because you're too hideous to show your own face? Let me guess: you're just a hideous monster lurking in the shadows with cheap tricks."

At that, the mirror shatters into a thousand shards.
Standing before Otaha is a white-haired girl wearing a faint smile—a living contradiction to her insults.
StarTowerBookEventReward.14502.2.cn:
当乙叶再次醒来时，身上的痛楚愈发尖锐，所幸短暂的昏睡让她恢复了些许体力。
那面讨厌的镜子仍未消失，宛如一道无形的屏障，将她与外界彻底隔绝。
这是星塔内独有的幻术吗？幻象的边缘往往是最薄弱的。她深吸了一口气，准备突破。

“明明看上去是一位优雅的小姐，竟然如此粗暴呢……”
子弹出膛的刹那，镜子背后的“幽灵”终于再次开口了：“这只是一面普通的镜子，每个人都会在其中看到真实的自我。你如此逃避，是因为无法面对吗？”
乙叶觉得这话有些好笑：“既然如此，你一直不肯露面，是因为不敢以真实的面貌示人吗？让我猜猜，你该不会是一个整日躲在阴暗角落、只会故弄玄虚的丑八怪吧？”

话音刚落，巨大的镜子轰然碎裂。
一位白发少女微笑着站在乙叶面前，仿佛是对先前话语的无声回击。

StarTowerBookEventReward.14502.3.en: Clear Monolith with Otoha in your squad twice

StarTowerBookEventReward.14503.2.en:
Otoha realizes instantly that this girl is no ordinary Trekker. Her appearance is too perfect, flawless like a masterwork sculpture.
She has to be a creation of the Monolith itself.

The girl bows slightly, stepping aside with polite grace. "You have proven your strength, Trekker. Your trial with me has ended. You may go."
"Much appreciated," Otoha replies with a practiced, polite smile. "I'm in a bit of a rush, so please don't take my little joke to heart."

"A word of advice," the girl whispers as they pass. "Your mind is fraying. You're on the brink of losing control. Turn back now, while you still can."
This time, Otoha doesn't bother to answer. She knows she doesn't need to look back anymore.
StarTowerBookEventReward.14503.2.cn:
乙叶清楚眼前的少女并非普通的旅人。她的容貌和衣着没有一丝瑕疵，仿佛一件完美雕琢的艺术品。
——那就意味着，她一定是星塔制造出来的。

少女微微颔首，恭谨地为她让出一条通路：“您是一位十分强大的旅人，我的考验结束了，请从这边离开吧。”
“谢谢。”乙叶报以同样礼貌的微笑，“我赶时间，所以开了一个小小的玩笑，还请不要介意。”

二人擦肩而过时，少女低声说道：“容我提醒一下，你的精神太紧绷了，已经处于失控的边缘。还请就此折返，不要再前行了。”
这一次，乙叶没有应答。 她不需要再回头了。

StarTowerBookEventReward.14503.3.en: Clear Monolith with Otoha in your squad 3 times

StarTowerBookEventReward.14701.2.en:
Caramel loved her bass—it was a one-of-a-kind gift from the Monolith.
It didn't have the brilliant, eye-catching sound of a lead instrument.
Instead, its notes were deep and powerful, like a beating heart.
"Huh? I didn't even think it was making a sound."
"Is this guitar broken? All it does is make a thumping noise."
Caramel paid little mind to their teasing remarks.
"That's exactly why more people need to hear the bass!"
In that moment, she had unwavering determination.
StarTowerBookEventReward.14701.2.cn:
焦糖喜欢贝斯，因为这是星塔赠与她的独一无二的礼物。
虽然，贝斯不像其它担任主旋律的乐器，拥有华丽的、引人注目的音色，
但它所演奏出的声音仿佛跳动的心脏般，低沉有力。
“啊这？我还以为它没发出声音呢。”
“这吉他不会是坏了吧，怎么只会发出嘭嘭的声音。”
面对大家带有些许戏谑的疑惑，焦糖并没有太在意。
“正因如此，才有必要让贝斯的声音传达到更多人的耳朵中！“
在这一刻，焦糖充满了决心。

StarTowerBookEventReward.14701.3.en: Clear Monolith with Caramel in your squad once

StarTowerBookEventReward.14702.2.en:
Caramel loved her bass—it was a one-of-a-kind gift from the Monolith.
Anyone who heard her play marveled at her musical talent.
"It's such a shame. If she'd learned any other instrument, she'd be famous by now."
But Caramel was never swayed; fame held no appeal for her.
To Caramel, the bass was her destined musical partner.
With just a slight change in scale, melody, or style,
she could coax any genre of music from its strings.
"That's exactly why I have to show more people its charm!"
In that moment, she had unwavering determination.
StarTowerBookEventReward.14702.2.cn:
焦糖喜欢贝斯，因为这是星塔赠与她的独一无二的礼物。
听过她演奏的人无一不惊叹她的音乐天赋，
“真是可惜，如果学别的乐器，这孩子说不定早就出名了。“
焦糖从不为所动，毕竟出名对她来说并没有什么吸引力。
对焦糖而言，贝斯就是她命中注定的音乐搭档。
只要稍稍改变音阶、旋律或是演奏方法，
贝斯就可以简单地在焦糖手中演奏出任何种类的曲子。
“正因如此，才有必要让更多人了解到贝斯的魅力！“
在这一刻，焦糖充满了决心。

StarTowerBookEventReward.14702.3.en: Clear Monolith with Caramel in your squad twice

StarTowerBookEventReward.14703.2.en:
Caramel loved her bass—it was a one-of-a-kind gift from the Monolith.
She had a secret hobby: practicing for the caves in the ground.
They couldn't speak, but at least they listened to her entire performance without complaint.
Through daily practice,
she realized that for the bass, understanding the music was more important than technique.
She began composing new pieces that captured the impression, atmosphere, and feeling of the Monolith's sound.
She played these songs for the Monolith, hoping to one day earn its approval.
Her relentless effort gradually won over the people around her,
but the Monolith itself had yet to respond.
"It must mean I'm not doing enough. One day, I will definitely earn its approval."
In that moment, she had unwavering determination.
StarTowerBookEventReward.14703.2.cn:
焦糖喜欢贝斯，因为这是星塔赠与她的独一无二的礼物。
她有一个神秘的爱好——对着地上的洞穴练习贝斯。
虽然地洞不会说话，但它至少会毫无怨言地、完整地听完焦糖所演奏的曲子。
在日积月累的练习中，焦糖意识到，
对于贝斯来说，对乐曲的理解比演奏技术更重要。
焦糖会将自己所听到的，星塔之音的印象、氛围，以及所传达的感情，
创作成新的乐曲，并将这些乐曲演奏给星塔听，希望有朝一日可以获得星塔的认可。
在坚持不懈的努力下，人们逐渐认可了焦糖，
但星塔却还没有做出任何回应。
“一定是做的还不够。总有一天，我一定可以得到星塔的认可的。“
这一刻，焦糖充满了决心。

StarTowerBookEventReward.14703.3.en: Clear Monolith with Caramel in your squad 3 times

StarTowerBookEventReward.14901.2.en:
This tower to the Gods has no place for the weak.
That was what a young Gerie realized on her first climb up the Monolith.
The Dusk Arbiter had named her an acolyte—a title that both tested her abilities and hid her true purpose.
But this arbiter, who would one day be feared by all,
was then just a timid girl who shied away from combat, yet dared to question the Gods on behalf of her people.
"Oh, omniscient Lord, why do you treat your children so?" she wondered.
Back then, she still thought like a true Seeker.
That wouldn't last.
The next battle was already upon her...
StarTowerBookEventReward.14901.2.cn:
通往觐见神赐的高塔却不容许弱者的存在。
这是年幼时格芮第一次登上星塔时的所想。
黄昏裁判为了测试她的能力，同时也为了掩人耳目，赋予了她见习修者的身份。
而这位在日后令人闻风丧胆的审判官，
现在不过是一个逃避战斗，胆小懦弱，但却愿意替人们向神明发问的少女。
“全知全能的主啊，你为何这般待你的子民……”
她如此想着，彼时的她还会站在真正修者的角度去思考。
但很快，她就没这个机会了。
因为下一场战斗已经来了……

StarTowerBookEventReward.14901.3.en: Clear Monolith with Gerie in your squad once

StarTowerBookEventReward.14902.2.en:
A small vial of sticky liquid.
Gerie carefully worked it into the torn scraps of paper before her,
piece by piece, page by page.
When the final fragment was in place, a picture book—creased, cracked, and worn—lay in her hands.
It was the only thing she had brought from home when she first entered the Dusk Arbiter's sanctuary.
The last time she'd seen it, her mind had been more stable.
"Finished...!"
Gazing at the book was like looking into a mirror.
She carefully sealed it away, lest she tear it to shreds the next time she breaks down.
StarTowerBookEventReward.14902.2.cn:
一种装着黏糊糊液体的小瓶子。
格芮将它慢慢涂抹在自己面前，一个个碎掉的纸张上，
一片接着一片……一张接着一张……
当最后拼凑好全部的碎片时，一本满是裂痕和褶皱的绘本静静躺在它的手上。
这是格芮刚进入黄昏裁判的收容所时，从家里唯一带来的东西，
而上一次见到它时，格芮的精神要更加稳定。
“完成了……！”
格芮望着它，就像在照着镜子。
她小心翼翼地将它封装了起来，以免下一次暴走时再把它撕得粉碎。

StarTowerBookEventReward.14902.3.en: Clear Monolith with Gerie in your squad twice

StarTowerBookEventReward.14903.2.en:
"Get lost in here, and the Stellaroids'll eat you."
Whether from the calm after battle or a sudden flicker of pity,
Gerie, the acolyte, found herself talking to a child lost in the Monolith.
"My papa's been in here for a long time. I picked some sweet dates for him."
"I've killed—er, purified all the Stellaroids around here. I didn't see him," Gerie said.
"He must be worried sick lookin' for you. I'll walk you out."
Gerie led the girl out of the tower, where she reunited with her father.
The girl gave Gerie half of her dates, and they waved goodbye as the sun set.
Gerie stared at the dates in her basket before finally trying one.
"Mm. Just like always, I can't taste a thing."
she murmured.
"Still... makes for an easy dinner."
StarTowerBookEventReward.14903.2.cn:
“在这迷路的话，很快就会被星骸吃掉的。”
究竟是消耗魔力后回归冷静，还是因怜悯心一时的兴起，
总之，见习修者格芮，与一位在星塔内迷路的孩子搭上了话。
“爸爸他，来星塔里很久了，我在外面四处找了甜枣，想给他。”
“这附近的星骸都被我杀……净化掉了，我没有看见你爸爸的身影。”
“他一定是在外面焦急地找你，我送你出去吧。”
女孩在格芮的护送下于塔外和失散的父亲重逢，
她将一半的甜枣赠与对方，在夕阳下两人挥手道别。
格芮望着篮子里的甜枣，愣了一会，最后还是决定尝一口。
“嗯，和以前一样，果然尝不出味道呢。”
“不过……”
“作为随便应付的晚饭，倒是方便~”

StarTowerBookEventReward.14903.3.en: Clear Monolith with Gerie in your squad 3 times

StarTowerBookEventReward.15001.2.en:
"Let's see... This Monolith always has some sweet fishing gear."
Talk like that was the only thing that could get Laru fired up enough to lead her squad up a Monolith.
She knew every shortcut and the safest routes to dodge Stellaroids. But her goal wasn't the summit, nor was it valuable Artifacts or treasure. All she ever wanted was the fishing aisle in the Monolith Shop.

"Alright, let's see what goodies they have this time!"
The shelves were packed with rods, accessories, consumables, and chum she'd never seen before.
Laru picked through the items for a long time before leaving with some new tackle and two bags of bait made from completely unidentifiable ingredients.
"Another great haul today!"
StarTowerBookEventReward.15001.2.cn:
“我想想，这个星塔里每次都会有很厉害的渔具”
菈露只有在这种时候的时候，会突然干劲满满地带着队伍爬塔。
哪里有捷径可以快速上塔，哪条路线可以最大限度地避开和星骸的战斗。但她的目标显然和大多数人的目标不同，她没有兴趣登顶，也没有兴趣去寻找值钱神器和宝箱，她的唯一目的永远都是星塔里的商店——的渔具货架。

“让我来看看这次会有什么新奇的玩意~”
货架上琳琅满目的钓竿，各种数值不一的配件和消耗品，没见过的打窝饲料。
菈露在商店里挑挑拣拣选了半天，带走了一部分没见过的钓具，和那两袋根本看不出原材料是什么的饲料。
“今天也是大丰收的一天~”

StarTowerBookEventReward.15001.3.en: Clear Monolith with Laru in your squad once

StarTowerBookEventReward.15002.2.en:
The Monolith Shop always had some special fishing gear.
Laru had been here once before and left with a mechanical device she still hadn't gotten a chance to use. It looked like something you'd mount on a boat—an auto-fisher, maybe?

"Let's see what treasures I can find this time!"
Laru strode confidently to the shelves. This time, there was only a single two-meter fishing rod with a few assorted attachments.
"What is this?! This rod is huge! Whoa ... with these stats, I could probably land a Hexagloo Whale, no problem..."
But once the excitement faded, Laru stared at the massive rod and its accessories and really wished she'd brought a handcart.
StarTowerBookEventReward.15002.2.cn:
这个星塔商店里总会有一些特殊的渔具。
菈露来过一次，上一次，她带走了一个至今都没有机会使用的机械装置，看上去像是应该安装在船上，也许它会自动捕捞？

“让我看看这次能开出什么好东西~”
菈露轻车熟路地走到货架边。这一次，货架上只有一柄两米长的鱼竿，和配套的一些零散的装置。
“这是什么……？！好大的鱼竿！唔哇……按照这个参数，感觉钓个六角咕噜鲸也完全不是问题啊……”
但兴奋劲过去之后，菈露对着这个钓竿和配套的装置，开始后悔今天没有带个小推车来。

StarTowerBookEventReward.15002.3.en: Clear Monolith with Laru in your squad twice

StarTowerBookEventReward.15003.2.en:
The Monolith was unusually quiet.
Laru reached the shop without a problem and found the same shelves, packed with dazzling fishing gear. But something was different. Deep in the aisle, she spotted a small boat.
It was a fisherman's dream, complete with rod holders, spots for a net and bait, and even mounting brackets for a fish trap...
Laru's eyes lit up.
She dragged the boat out of the Monolith with all her might. On a perfect, sunny day, she took it to sea and, with a stroke of incredible luck, caught a fish as tall as she was.
As Laru excitedly took a photo of her prize, its tail suddenly swiped her feet, knocking her back with a thump. Rubbing her aching head, she found herself staring at her office ceiling.
"... What? It was just a dream."
StarTowerBookEventReward.15003.2.cn:
今天的星塔异常的安静。
菈露一路顺利地找到商店，依旧是那一排货架，依旧是琳琅满目的渔具。但这一次显然有所不同，菈露远远就注意到了，货架的最深处，摆着一艘小船。
这简直是给钓鱼人准备的船，安装好的鱼竿支架，抄网和饵料都有专门的位置，甚至在船身侧边留了鱼笼的安装卡扣……
菈露几乎双眼放光。
她费劲力气把这艘小船从星塔里拖了出来，又找了一个风和日丽的好日子，开船出海，最后更是运气爆棚地从海里钓起来了一条和她差不多高的大鱼。
就在菈露兴奋地对着大鱼拍照，鱼尾扫到她的脚边，她向后一仰，“哐当”一声，菈露捂着自己撞痛的后脑勺，看着办公室的天花板。
“……什么啊，怎么是做梦。”

StarTowerBookEventReward.15003.3.en: Clear Monolith with Laru in your squad 3 times

StarTowerBookEventReward.15501.2.en:
Shia couldn't remember exactly when she learned to swim.
But she clearly remembered the first time she nearly drowned.
She sank like an anchor, her limbs frozen, yet she felt no fear.
As the cold water seeped into her clothes, she opened her eyes to see small fish glide past her fingertips and into the branches of orange-red coral.
The next second, her grandmother fished her out of the water.

"Ooh, that's spicy... Grandma, this fish soup has gone bad!"
"I put ginger oil in it. It's for your cold."
"And remember, you are absolutely not to go near the sea when you're sick."
StarTowerBookEventReward.15501.2.cn:
究竟是什么时候学会的游泳，希娅已经记不清了。
但她清楚记得第一次溺水的经历。
整个人像船锚般下沉，手脚动弹不得，她却并不害怕。
冰凉的海水浸透身体，她试着睁开眼睛，几条小鱼游过指尖，钻入橙红的珊瑚枝杈中。
——下一秒，她就被奶奶捞了上来。

“嘶，好辣……奶奶，这碗鱼汤坏掉了！”
“里面加了姜油，治感冒的。”
“记住，下次生病时，绝对不能去海边。”

StarTowerBookEventReward.15501.3.en: Clear Monolith with Shia in your squad once

StarTowerBookEventReward.15502.2.en:
Floating on her back with her eyes closed, letting her mind go blank and feeling the gentle lift of the water.
This was Shia's favorite way to relax.

But ever since a certain little tagalong entered the picture, life had suddenly become much busier.
She used to spend her days and nights in the sea, letting time drift by.
Now, floating like this had become a rare pleasure snatched between moments of chaos.

"Shia, Shia! Where are you—"
"Shia, Shia—"
It seems Karin is awake.
StarTowerBookEventReward.15502.2.cn:
闭着眼睛飘在水面上，放空思绪，感受海水轻柔的托举。
这是希娅最喜欢的放松方式。

然而，自从身边多了一个小跟班，她的生活突然充实了起来。
曾经她没日没夜泡在海里，任由时间流逝。
现在，这项活动反倒成了忙里偷闲的乐趣。

“希娅，希娅！你在哪儿——”
“希娅，希娅——”
看来花铃睡醒了。

StarTowerBookEventReward.15502.3.en: Clear Monolith with Shia in your squad twice

StarTowerBookEventReward.15503.2.en:
Shia sank into the sea once more.
The deep ocean floor was deathly silent, the water shackling her body like invisible chains.
This was not the sea she knew. It was cold, dark, and suffocating.
A moment later, her eyes shot open and she burst from the water.
The illusion had been torn apart.

"That was close... I didn't know the Monoliths could create illusions. How did you figure it out?"
"Nothing like the real sea. That was nothing more than a pool of stagnant water."
StarTowerBookEventReward.15503.2.cn:
希娅又一次沉入海中。
幽深的海底死寂无声，海水如无形的枷锁一般，牢牢禁锢着她的身体。
这不是她熟悉的大海，这里阴冷、黑暗、令人窒息。
片刻之后，希娅猛然睁开眼睛，冲出海面。
——幻象被撕开了一道口子。

“好险啊……没想到星塔还会让人产生幻觉。你是怎么发现的？”
“与真正的大海相比，那不过是一潭死水。”

StarTowerBookEventReward.15503.3.en: Clear Monolith with Shia in your squad 3 times

StarTowerBookEventReward.15601.2.en:
Near a little-known Monolith on the Nova Continent, Count Chompchomp the Shark and her friends lived a carefree life.
One day, Count Chompchomp saw King High Flyer in the sky and asked,
"Hey, why do you fly so high? Won't it be nicer to roll in the soft grass together?"
King High Flyer landed gently beside her, folded his wings, and puffed out his chest.
"Hoo hoo! The soft grass is lovely, of course, but the gentle breeze is hard to give up!"
Count Chompchomp's eyes suddenly lit up. She jumped up and down excitedly.
"I want to fly high, too! I want to feel the gentle breeze!"
"Alright, hoo hoo," King High Flyer readily agreed and began to teach her the secrets of flight.
First, he told her to imagine the feeling of floating in the air.
Next, he told her to take a biiig, deep breath.
Finally, he told her to paddle her limbs as if she were swimming.
It was magic! Like a balloon filled with air, Count Chompchomp began to fly.
"Thank you, King High Flyer!" she called out happily, waving goodbye as she floated freely through the air.
StarTowerBookEventReward.15601.2.cn:
在诺瓦大陆一片不为人知的星塔附近，鲨鲨咬咬伯爵和她的伙伴们无忧无虑地生活着。
有一天，鲨鲨咬咬伯爵看到飞高高国王在空中飞翔，便问他：
“国王国王，你为什么要飞那么高？在地面上软软的草地里一起打滚不好吗。”
飞高高国王缓缓地降落在鲨鲨咬咬伯爵旁边，收起翅膀挺起胸脯回答道：
“吼吼，软软的草地固然舒服，但柔柔的微风也让人难以舍弃呐。”
鲨鲨咬咬伯爵突然双眼放光，她跳来跳去，撒娇似地说到：
“我也想飞高高！我也想摸摸柔柔的微风！”
“好的啊，吼吼。”飞高高国王爽快地答应了，开始教给鲨鲨咬咬伯爵飞行的技巧。
首先，他让鲨鲨咬咬伯爵在脑海中想象飘在空中的感觉；
其次，他让鲨鲨咬咬伯爵深吸一大~口气；
最后，他让鲨鲨咬咬伯爵像游泳一样滑动四肢。
好神奇！鲨鲨咬咬伯爵像鼓足了气的气球，飞了起来。
“国王国王，谢谢你！”她开心地告别了飞高高国王，自由地在空中漂浮着。

StarTowerBookEventReward.15601.3.en: Clear Monolith with Nazuna in your squad once

StarTowerBookEventReward.15602.2.en:
Near a little-known Monolith on the Nova Continent, Count Chompchomp the Shark and her friends lived a carefree life.
One day, their leader, Princess Windrise, left without a word.
From that day on, the same question gnawed on Count Chompchomp:
Did I do something wrong to make Princess Windrise angry?
Princess Windrise used to say that she was always rolling around and wasn't mature like a grown-up.
But Count Chompchomp would argue back, "That's because you don't know how to relax!"
The princess also used to say she only thought about the here and now and never planned for the future.
But Count Chompchomp would retort, "That's because you don't appreciate the little joys around you!"
Suddenly, an idea sparked in her little head.
Could it be my chomping? Is that what made her angry?
If I stop my chomping habit, maybe she'll come back.
That day, Count Chompchomp didn't roll around and she didn't chomp on anything.
She just sat on the soft grass, quietly watching the nearby water wheel turn.
StarTowerBookEventReward.15602.2.cn:
在诺瓦大陆一片不为人知的星塔附近，鲨鲨咬咬伯爵和她的伙伴们无忧无虑地生活着。
有一天，大家的领导者——风来公主，毫无征兆地离开了。
自那天后，鲨鲨咬咬伯爵的脑子里一直在思考着同一个问题：
是不是自己做错了什么事，让风来公主生气了？
曾经风来公主说过，鲨鲨咬咬伯爵总是喜欢滚来滚去、一点也没有大人的成熟，
鲨鲨咬咬伯爵则会反驳道：那是因为风来公主不懂得给自己放松的时间！
曾经风来公主说过，鲨鲨咬咬伯爵只顾眼前、从来不做长远打算，
鲨鲨咬咬伯爵则会反驳道：那是因为风来公主不会珍惜身边的美好！
突然，鲨鲨咬咬伯爵小小的脑袋中闪过了一丝灵光。
一定因为自己总到处咬咬的原因，所以才会让风来公主生气的？
如果改掉自己咬咬的习惯的话，风来公主也许就会回来了吧。
这一天，鲨鲨咬咬伯爵没有打滚也没有咬咬，
她只是坐在软软的草地上，默默地望着一旁转动的水车。

StarTowerBookEventReward.15602.3.en: Clear Monolith with Nazuna in your squad twice

StarTowerBookEventReward.15603.2.en:
Near a little-known Monolith on the Nova Continent, sickness struck Count Chompchomp's friends.
A strange illness spread among them. Count Chompchomp felt helpless and alone, not knowing what to do.
Just then, a traveler from a faraway land appeared.
He had sharp eyes, a clever mind, and was a natural leader—just like Princess Windrise.
With the traveler's help, her friends were cured in no time at all.
When the traveler was about to leave, Count Chompchomp gathered her courage and decided to join his journey.
She wanted to repay his kindness and see more of the world.
But most importantly, she wanted to see Princess Windrise again and tell her in person:
That she wouldn't roll in the grass like a child anymore.
That she wouldn't only think about the here and now and would plan for the future.
And she would promise to never, ever chomp on things again.
And so—
"Please, let's go home together."
StarTowerBookEventReward.15603.2.cn:
在诺瓦大陆一片不为人知的星塔附近，鲨鲨咬咬伯爵的伙伴们生病了。
未知的病痛在伙伴间蔓延着，鲨鲨咬咬伯爵不知道该怎么办，她感觉到绝望和无助。
这时，一名来自外乡的旅行者出现了。
他有着锐利的双眼、聪明的才智、以及出众的领导能力——像是风来公主一样。
在外乡旅行者的帮助下，眨眼间，伙伴们的病痛痊愈了。
当外乡旅行者要离开的时候，鲨鲨咬咬伯爵鼓起勇气，决定要和他一起踏上旅途。
为了报答恩情，也为了开阔眼界。
最重要的，鲨鲨咬咬伯爵想要再次见到风来公主，并亲口告诉她：
自己不会再像个小孩子一样、在草地上滚来滚去了；
自己不会再只顾眼前、从来不做长远打算了；
并且还要答应她，自己再也不会咬咬了。
所以——
一起回家吧。

StarTowerBookEventReward.15603.3.en: Clear Monolith with Nazuna in your squad 3 times

StarTowerBookEventReward.15701.2.en:
The damp, stifling air was thick with unsettling noise.
On the gray shore, Karin stood alone, waiting for someone to arrive.
Footsteps drew closer and closer. But the person who came was not anyone she knew. It was a memory from the past.

"Well, well. Little Miss Four-Eyes isn't so four-eyed today, huh? Where'd your glasses go?"
"Can you even see right now? Don't trip on your way home, okay? Ahahaha."
"She's ugly and stupid. Let's not play with her anymore."

"Stop laughing!"
Karin jolted awake. Darkness filled her vision.
The sea breeze, the chirping of insects, and the sound of steady breathing beside her told her she was still somewhere familiar.
"Thank goodness I didn't wake Shia up..."
She calmed herself down and lay back, trying to pretend nothing had happened.
But beside her, Shia had already caught the scent of her unease.
StarTowerBookEventReward.15701.2.cn:
潮湿闷热的空气裹挟着令人不安的杂音，
灰色的海岸上，花铃独自站在那里，等待某人的到来，
脚步声逐渐逼近，来的却不是熟悉的人，而是过去的记忆。

“噢哟，四眼妹今天怎么不是四眼啦？眼镜丢哪去了~？”
“话说现在能看清吗~别摔跟头回去哦哈哈哈哈~”
“又呆又丑，我们还是不要和她玩了哈哈~”

“不许笑——！”
花铃惊醒，眼前是一片黑暗。
海风、虫鸣，以及安稳的呼吸声，她确认自己还在熟悉的环境里。
“幸好没把希娅吵醒……”
她平复了心情，躺回床上想当做无事发生。
一旁的希娅却闻到她不安的气息。

StarTowerBookEventReward.15701.3.en: Clear Monolith with Karin in your squad once

StarTowerBookEventReward.15702.2.en:
"That's pretty impressive. You actually wished up an Artifact like this?"
A girl named Nuz turned the delicate box Shia had handed her over in her hands.
"That was all little Karin. She's the one who wished for it."
"Oh? Not bad. Mind telling me what prayer you used?"
"I just ... wished for an Artifact that could help improve my eyesight."

Once Nuz had finished the inspection, she handed the artifact back to Karin, along with a small bottle filled with a special liquid.
"Here. You'll need this when you use it."
"So what kind of Artifact is it, exactly?"
"It's not all that rare, actually. I hear they're pretty popular in Flavio. They're transparent lenses you place directly on your eyes."
Karin cupped it carefully in both hands, as if she were holding a treasure she had spent her whole life searching for.
StarTowerBookEventReward.15702.2.cn:
“不赖啊，这种神器都被你许愿出来了。”
名叫纳茨的少女摆弄着希娅递来的精致盒子。
“这是小花铃的功劳哦，是她许愿出来的。”
“嘿~有一手嘛，许愿的祷词能告诉我吗？”
“我只是……希望得到一个能帮我改善视力的神器。”

纳茨确认完神器后交还给了花铃，还递上了一瓶装有特殊液体的小瓶子。
“拿着吧，到时候使用这个神器的时候要用得上。”
“所以这到底是什么神器？”
“倒也不是很稀有啦，听说在弗拉维奥很流行，是一种透明、可以直接贴在眼睛上的隐形眼镜。。”
花铃小心地将它捧在手里，仿佛正捧着一生都在寻找的至宝。

StarTowerBookEventReward.15702.3.en: Clear Monolith with Karin in your squad 2 times

StarTowerBookEventReward.15703.2.en:
Karin put on her gear. Before entering the water, she carefully checked the seal on her goggles.
Although she had spent some time around the sea by now, she had always worn glasses before. Because of that, she had never truly seen the world beneath the water.

"Ready to step into a whole new world?"
"Wait. Let me mentally prepare myself... Whew."
"I'm ready. Let's go!"

Shia only smiled and took her hand, and the two of them slowly sank beneath the surface.
Karin watched as the clear blue water rose over their heads, with ripples of light swaying gently above them.
Schools of fish brushed past their fingertips, weaving through the gaps between vivid coral.
Everything about the sea was so beautiful. And now, she no longer had to look at this new world through the thick frame of her glasses.
StarTowerBookEventReward.15703.2.cn:
花铃戴上了护具，在入水前，她仔细检查了一下护目镜的密封性。
对她而言，即便已经和大海打过一段时间交道，但因为先前一直戴着眼镜的原因，她还没有见过水下的世界。

“准备好来到新世界了吗~？”
“等一下，我做一下心理准备……呼~”
“我准备好了，出发吧！”

希娅只是笑着牵住她的手，两人缓缓地沉入水中。
她看见湛蓝的水面没过她们的头顶，波光在上方轻轻摇曳。
成群的鱼儿们游过她们的指尖，穿梭在鲜艳的珊瑚缝隙中。
大海的一切是那般美丽，而她已不再需要透过那个厚厚的镜框看向这片新的世界。

StarTowerBookEventReward.15703.3.en: Clear Monolith with Karin in your squad 3 times

StarTowerBookEventReward.15801.2.en:
This Monolith expedition was led by the Trekker Association, under the Grace Imperium's supervision—an assignment that sounded easy and comfortable, and one Laru secured through means best left unspoken.
A few months earlier, she had visited this very Monolith. She remembered that the climate inside had been pleasant, the view decent, and the higher you climbed, the warmer it got. Before setting out, she even told Willow that this trip would feel like going on a summer vacation.
But the moment the group stepped inside, a blast of cold wind hit her and she began to shiver—the interior, which should have been warm, was now no different from the outside. There was even fine snow drifting through the air.

In theory, anything could happen inside a Monolith, but this was the first time Laru learned it could snow.
StarTowerBookEventReward.15801.2.cn:
这次的星塔冒险由地理协会领队，恩赐意志派人监工——这个一听就很惬意的活，被菈露以不可告人的手段拿下。
目标地点的这座星塔菈露几个月前来过，记忆中这座塔内气候宜人，景色也还不错，甚至越往星塔顶层越暖和，出发前菈露还和薇洛说，她这一趟堪比穿越回夏天度假。
却不想，一行人刚进入星塔，菈露就被迎面而来的寒风吹了个冷颤——原本应该温暖的塔内，温度却和外面别无二致，看上去甚至还在飘着小雪。

从理论上来说，星塔里发生任何事情都不是什么怪事，但菈露也是第一次知道，原来星塔里也会下雪？！

StarTowerBookEventReward.15801.3.en: Clear Monolith with Snowish Laru in your squad once
StarTowerBookEventReward.15801.3.cn: 携带菈露（圣夜）通关1次星塔

StarTowerBookEventReward.15802.2.en:
Shivering from the cold, Laru finally managed to find Portia, who sold supplies inside the Monolith.
But after rummaging around under the counter, the unmotivated shopkeeper regretfully told her that after it started snowing, all the warm gear had already been bought out by other Trekkers.
Still, why had the Monolith suddenly begun to snow?
"There are more people wishing for Snowish Festival gifts this year," Portia drawled. "But if someone can't describe their 'gift' clearly when they make the wish, then the Monolith can't fulfill it properly, and sometimes it even..."
She didn't finish the sentence.
Laru didn't press her. She said goodbye to Portia and followed the group up to the next level of the Monolith.
StarTowerBookEventReward.15802.2.cn:
冻得瑟瑟发抖的菈露好不容易在星塔里找到了贩卖补给的波西亚。
但这个没什么干劲的店员在柜台下翻找一番之后，很遗憾地告诉她，自从塔里开始下雪，商店里的保暖用品就都被旅人们买走了。
但星塔到底为什么会突然下雪呢？
“今年许愿想要雪愿节礼物的人变多了呢。”波西亚懒洋洋地说道，“不过，如果许愿的时候无法准确地描述想要的‘礼物’，星塔是没有办法实现的，甚至……”
她没有继续说下去。
菈露也没有追问，道别了波西亚，跟着队伍前往星塔的下一层。

StarTowerBookEventReward.15802.3.en: Clear Monolith with Snowish Laru in your squad 2 times
StarTowerBookEventReward.15802.3.cn: 携带菈露（圣夜）通关2次星塔

StarTowerBookEventReward.15803.2.en:
Not long after the Monolith climb, Laru was fishing by the river when she overheard a couple of Trekkers passing by, saying that the snow inside that Monolith had disappeared shortly after the Snowish Festival.
"On the night of the festival, someone made a pretty outrageous wish. When he walked out of the Monolith, he didn't even remember who he was."
The story piqued Laru's interest, so she stopped them to ask what the wish had been and whether the Monolith had given him some sort of Artifact. But the Trekkers only knew bits and pieces and couldn't give a clear answer.
Laru suddenly remembered Portia from that day.
"I should ask her next time I run into her."
Just as the thought crossed her mind, her fishing line twitched: A big fish had taken the bait!
StarTowerBookEventReward.15803.2.cn:
爬塔任务结束后不久，某天菈露在河边钓鱼，听到路过的旅人说，雪愿节过后没多久，那个星塔里的雪就消失了。
“雪愿节那天晚上，好像有个旅人许了一个不得了的愿望，他离开星塔的时候，连自己是谁都不记得了。”
菈露听了好奇，于是叫住了路人，打听那个旅人到底许了个什么愿望，星塔给了什么神器吗？可惜旅人们也是道听途说，七嘴八舌说不出个所以然。
菈露突然又想到了那天的波西亚。
“要不下次见到去问问她好了。”
正想着，菈露抛出去的鱼线动了，大鱼上钩！

StarTowerBookEventReward.15803.3.en: Clear Monolith with Snowish Laru in your squad 3 times
StarTowerBookEventReward.15803.3.cn: 携带菈露（圣夜）通关3次星塔

StarTowerBookEventReward.15901.2.en:
Cangwu may not house a Monolith of its own, but it serves as the perfect staging ground for expeditions to the periphery. Coronis steps out of the city gates, her trusty syringe packed and ready. She intends to verify a rumor she has heard: that Monoliths mimic their surroundings. Specifically, have the Monoliths near Cangwu adopted the traits of the Loong? With any luck, she might bag a unique Stellaroid specimen. Even if she fails, the local fauna and medicinal flora offer immense research value.

She just hopes the Monolith yields good data.
StarTowerBookEventReward.15901.2.cn:
虽然苍梧城内没有星塔，但若想探索城邦外围的那些星塔，从这儿出发可真是再合适不过了。科科洛妮丝带着她的注射器离开苍梧城。她早听说星塔会随周遭环境而变，这次正好亲自验证一番——苍梧城附近的星塔，会不会也沾上几分龙裔的特征？万一运气好能让她抓到几个不一样的星骸……即便不是星骸，不同地域的魔物或者植物药材也很有研究价值。

总之，只希望星塔不要让她失望。

StarTowerBookEventReward.15901.3.en: Clear Monolith with Springseek Coronis in your squad once
StarTowerBookEventReward.15901.3.cn: 携带科洛妮丝（新春）通关1次星塔

StarTowerBookEventReward.15902.2.en:
The Monolith lies deep within the woods. As Coronis navigates the undergrowth, a peculiar plant immediately catches her eye.
Before the trip, she purchased The Grand Compendium of Herbs from a Loong healer. This specimen matches the book's description of a powerful paralytic agent perfectly.
"Processed into a serum, this would be invaluable for surgeries," she muses.
She begins scanning the area for more samples, but is quickly distracted by a new target near the tree roots—yet another unidentified herb.
One discovery follows another, and before she realizes it, the day has slipped away into darkness.
StarTowerBookEventReward.15902.2.cn:
这座星塔坐落在森林深处。科洛妮丝穿行林间，很快被一株奇特的植物吸引了注意。
出发前，她从一位龙裔医者那里买了一本《草药大全》。眼前这株植物，似乎正是书中记载的一种能麻痹知觉的草药。
如果能拿来做成药剂的话，之后给患者开刀应该能用上。
这么想着，科洛妮丝开始在四周搜寻同种植株，可没过多久，她又在灌木丛中发现了新目标——树根旁长着另一种陌生的草药。
就这样，时间一点点过去，天色渐渐黑了……

StarTowerBookEventReward.15902.3.en: Clear Monolith with Springseek Coronis in your squad twice
StarTowerBookEventReward.15902.3.cn: 携带科洛妮丝（新春）通关2次星塔

StarTowerBookEventReward.15903.2.en:
Night falls. Coronis sits by her campfire, gazing toward the distant Monolith.
She clearly underestimated this region's biodiversity. The closer she gets to the Monolith, the stranger the vegetation becomes, with poisonous weeds and hallucinogens popping up at every turn.
"If only I could extract compounds from every single one of them..."
Coronis nibbles on her rations, flipping through The Grand Compendium of Herbs. As she reaches the final quarter of the book, she notices a new metric listed alongside the medicinal effects:
"Delicious."
"Tasty no matter how you cook it."
"Fragrant when stir-fried."
"Incredible in stew."
She lets out a chuckle. "Of course a Loong wrote this. Even medicine requires a taste test."
StarTowerBookEventReward.15903.2.cn:
夜里，科洛妮丝坐在火堆边，抬头眺望森林深处的星塔。
她似乎低估了龙裔地区的物种多样性。越是靠近星塔，沿途生长的植物就越发奇特，《草药大全》里记载的各类毒草、致幻植物层出不穷。
“要是都能一一提取成分做成药剂就好啦。”
科洛妮丝一边啃着干粮，一边继续翻看那本《草药大全》。翻到书的后四分之一时，她忽然发现：后面的植物记录除了药用功效，竟多了一项新评价标准——
“好吃。”
“怎么煮都好吃。”
“爆炒特别香。”
“炖汤绝了。”
她忍不住笑出声：“果然是龙裔编的书——连草药都要先尝一口好不好吃。”

StarTowerBookEventReward.15903.3.en: Clear Monolith with Springseek Coronis in your squad 3 times
StarTowerBookEventReward.15903.3.cn: 携带科洛妮丝（新春）通关3次星塔

StarTowerBookEventReward.16001.2.en:
Monolith No.1 Outside Sailstead

Coords: 23.106428, 113.324521
Artifact Variety: Average
Stellaroid Danger: Low
Monster Distribution: Sparse

Rec. Level: ★★★★☆
Notes: While the Artifact selection here isn't anything special, the relatively docile Stellaroids and clear surrounding area make it a fantastic training ground for rookie Trekkers. The Trekker Association has already pitched a camp right outside, so just check in with the staff if you need a hand.
StarTowerBookEventReward.16001.2.cn:
塞尔斯泰外围一号星塔 

坐标：23.106428，113.324521
塔内神器品类丰富度：一般
塔内星骸危险程度：较低
塔外魔物分布数量：较少

推荐等级：★★★★☆
批注：塔内神器品类较为单一，但星骸活跃性较低，塔外魔物较少，适合作为新手旅人前期的训练场所。目前地理协会已在塔外设立营地，如有任何需要，可以向营地的管理人员寻求帮助。

StarTowerBookEventReward.16001.3.en: Clear Monolith with Suntide Willow in your squad once
StarTowerBookEventReward.16001.3.cn: 携带薇洛（盛夏）通关1次星塔

StarTowerBookEventReward.16002.2.en:
Monolith No.2 Outside Sailstead

Coords: 39.91806, 116.30028
Artifact Variety: High
Stellaroid Danger: Moderate
Monster Distribution: Sparse

Rec. Level: ★★★☆☆
Notes: Out of all the Monoliths bordering Sailstead, this one easily offers the most diverse loot. You can dig up practically any everyday Artifact you might need, drawing in huge crowds. Just don't let your guard down—the Stellaroids inside are highly active and heavily populated. It's completely off-limits for greenhorns, and even seasoned Trekkers should stick to a group and not push their luck.
Fortunately, the outside perimeter is much safer and mostly monster-free. You'll find a Trekker Association camp stationed to the north if you ever need assistance.
StarTowerBookEventReward.16002.2.cn:
塞尔斯泰外围二号星塔 

坐标：39.91806，116.30028
塔内神器品类丰富度：丰富
塔内星骸危险程度：中等
塔外魔物分布数量：较少

推荐等级：★★★☆☆
批注：是塞尔斯泰城邦外围星塔中，神器品类最丰富的一个星塔，几乎日常所需的神器，无论是什么类型的都可以从星塔中找到，也是塞尔斯泰外围最受欢迎的一个星塔。但星塔内星骸活跃度较高，数量较多，并不适合毫无经验的新人，且建议所有旅人结伴登塔，切勿逞强。
不过，塔外魔物稀少，是相对安全的地带。星塔北侧有地理协会驻扎的营地，如有任何需要，可以向营地的管理人员寻求帮助。

StarTowerBookEventReward.16002.3.en: Clear Monolith with Suntide Willow in your squad twice
StarTowerBookEventReward.16002.3.cn: 携带薇洛（盛夏）通关2次星塔

StarTowerBookEventReward.16003.2.en:
Monolith No.3 Outside Sailstead

Coords: 31.2397, 121.4997
Artifact Variety: Low
Stellaroid Danger: High
Monster Distribution: Dense

Rec. Level: ★★☆☆☆
Notes: The Artifact types found inside Monolith No. 3 are relatively limited. However, many Trekkers have obtained extremely rare high-grade Artifacts from this Monolith over the years, so it continues to attract visitors every year. Stellaroids are highly active and extremely dangerous. Inexperienced Trekkers are strongly advised against entering; solo exploration is prohibited.
The surrounding area is rich in resources and home to many rare plants and herbs. However, there are many monsters outside the Monolith, and there are no Trekker Association encampments nearby. Therefore, even gathering activities outside the Monolith require heightened vigilance. ALWAYS travel in groups.
StarTowerBookEventReward.16003.2.cn:
塞尔斯泰外围三号星塔 

坐标：31.2397，121.4997
塔内神器品类丰富度：较少
塔内星骸危险程度：较高
塔外魔物分布数量：较多

推荐等级：★★☆☆☆
批注：三号星塔内的神器种类较为单一，但迄今为止有不少旅人在这里带出了非常罕见的高级神器，因此每年都有慕名而来的旅人前往挑战。塔内星骸活跃度非常高，攻击力和杀伤力也很高，建议所有经验不足的旅人不要轻易涉足，禁止单独进入探索。
星塔周边资源丰富，生长有不少奇珍异草，但塔外魔物分布众多，且周围没有地理协会驻扎的营地，综上所述，即便是在塔外进行采集活动，也需要提高警惕，结伴而行，切勿落单。

StarTowerBookEventReward.16003.3.en: Clear Monolith with Suntide Willow in your squad 3 times
StarTowerBookEventReward.16003.3.cn: 携带薇洛（盛夏）通关3次星塔

StarTowerBookEventReward.913301.2.en:
Portia couldn't figure it out.
The whole idea of this "convenience store" had started as a way for her to strike up conversations with Trekkers; so how had it turned into this? Now she was hauling goods around the Monolith, actually selling things.
It's not like she needed the money, and Stella Coins didn't even mean anything to her.
How did it get to this point...? Ugh, this is such a hassle... Can I just sell everything fast and go play at the arcade already...?
After thinking it over, Portia grabbed a piece of cardboard and scribbled out a sign.
"Clearance Sale. Stuff for Money."
"That should do it... Right?"
She propped the sign next to the pile of supplies she'd brought out and waited, hoping the next Trekker who came along would just take everything wholesale.
StarTowerBookEventReward.913301.2.cn:
波西亚想不明白。
这个「便利店」诞生的初衷，只是她想和旅人搭上话的一种方法，为什么会演变成现在这样，居然还要带着东西在星塔各处兜售。
明明她也不缺钱，更何况辉光币对她而言也没有任何作用。
怎么就变成这样了……感觉好麻烦……能不能快点卖完然后去玩游戏机……
波西亚思考了一下，捡了块纸板，“唰唰”写好了招牌。
「降价促销，给钱就卖。」
“这样的话应该可以很快卖完吧……”
她把牌子放在她带出来的那些补给物品旁边，开始期待下一个旅人能把所有东西都带走。

StarTowerBookEventReward.913301.3.cn: 波西亚默契等级达到5级

StarTowerBookEventReward.913302.2.en:
After that first clearance sale, Portia found a new way to slack off.
She was a part of the "Rules," after all, and it wasn't like her boss Sherlock really cared how much money she brought back... And even if he did, so what? Inside the Monolith, she could get more Artifacts and treasures anytime she wanted.
Besides...
The expressions Trekkers made when they saw her discount signs were really fun to watch.
But before long, Portia ran into a new problem: as she lowered prices while out selling on the road, people started complaining that they were overcharged in the convenience store.
"... Maybe I should have a sale in the store, too..."
StarTowerBookEventReward.913302.2.cn:
有了第一次的促销经验之后，波西亚找到了一个新的偷懒方式。
反正她就是「规则」的一部分，她的老板夏洛克也不会真的跟她计较东西卖了多少钱……计较也无意义，她在星塔中，这些神器和宝物要多少就有多少。
而且……
那些旅人看到降价促销时的表情都很有意思。
不过没过多久，波西亚又有了新的烦恼：如果在外兜售时降价，那就会有旅人嫌弃便利店内的物品定价过高。
“要不连店里的东西也降价好了……”

StarTowerBookEventReward.913302.3.cn: 波西亚默契等级达到10级

StarTowerBookEventReward.913303.2.en:
Soon, every item in her store had a sales tag.
But before long, taking a break from her game, Portia overheard Trekkers grumbling.
"Thirty percent off? You call that a sale?"
They had a point. If everything was always discounted, nothing was. Sales would just return to normal.
But if she kept slashing prices ... she'd just be giving stuff away!
"Hey! Why'd the sale end?" an annoyed Trekker snapped.
Portia didn't even look up from her handheld.
"Promo's over. Can't afford it? Go somewhere else."
StarTowerBookEventReward.913303.2.cn:
很快，便利店里的商品也挂上了促销标签。
但没过多久，波西亚在打游戏的间隙，听到旅人们的嘀咕：
“怎么才七折啊！这也叫促销？”
是啊，如果所有东西都在打折，那「促销」本身不就失去意义了？销量迟早会回到原来的水平。
可如果继续加大折扣……那岂不是要变成「零元购」了！
“喂！怎么不打折了！”
波西亚看着眼前有些生气的旅人，漫不经心的玩起了手中的掌机。
“促销活动今天截止了，钱不够的话……就去别处看看吧。”

StarTowerBookEventReward.913303.3.cn: 波西亚默契等级达到20级

StarTowerBookEventReward.917201.2.en:
A piece of advice for Trekkers in the Monolith:
"Watch out for Nurse Beatrixa's needles."
Sure, she'll patch up anyone, no questions asked and free of charge. But she doesn't treat you based on your wounds; she treats you based on her judgment. And it all boils down to one question:
Can this Trekker survive what's ahead?
If her answer is no, she'll hit you with a "sleepwalker shot." That's according to the Trekkers of course, since no one knows what's in it—only that when you wake up, you're outside the Monolith, your expedition over.
StarTowerBookEventReward.917201.2.cn:
星塔冒险中，请小心护士贝缇丽给你打的针。
有时候，旅人们会这样互相告诫。
虽然人们总说贝缇丽会无偿无条件地给每个人治疗，这话不假，但贝缇丽给予你的治疗，并不是根据你需要，而是根据她自己的判断，而她判断的标准中有一条准则：
这位旅人是否还能继续这一次的星塔冒险？
如果她判定为否，那她有可能为你打上一记“梦游针”——这是旅人们的说法，因为没有人知道贝缇丽到底做了什么——总之，一段时间后当那些旅人醒来时，已身处星塔之外。

StarTowerBookEventReward.917201.3.cn: 贝缇丽默契等级达到5级

StarTowerBookEventReward.917202.2.en:
Other Trekkers will also tell you to be grateful for Beatrixa's care.
She might be impatient and sharp-tongued, but she follows her own code, one that compels her to save any Trekker in need.
She is the Monolith's final mercy, a failsafe to ensure no one dies needlessly within its walls.
"Don't die on me."
That's her parting line to everyone she helps.
She'll never understand why humans chase such foolish adventures.
But she is the very idea of "salvation" given form, born from the echoes of hope and sorrow left behind in the Monolith.
For all of time, she will carry out this duty. It is her sole reason for being.
StarTowerBookEventReward.917202.2.cn:
星塔冒险中，请感恩护士贝缇丽给你的治疗。
她有一套自己的价值标准，以尖酸刻薄的态度和不耐烦的姿态，却总会无偿地为每一个旅人提供治疗和救助。
她就像星塔留给旅人最后的温柔，是给旅人留下最后一丝生机的保底。
“别死了哦？”
她总会对每个旅人这么说。
她虽然不能理解人类为何要追求这种不知死活的冒险——
但她本身，就是从遗落在塔里的情绪和思考的残片沉淀中诞生出的「救赎」的概念实体。
在这永恒的时间里，她会继续履行这职责，也是她存在的意义。

StarTowerBookEventReward.917202.3.cn: 贝缇丽默契等级达到10级

StarTowerBookEventReward.917203.2.en:
The last piece of advice about Beatrixa is this: pay attention to her insults.
Many Trekkers would complain.
"Why's she gotta be so harsh all the time?"
But think about it. Her jabs about your flimsy armor or inadequate skills aren't just insults; they're wake-up calls.
Her words are sharp enough to stick with you, replaying in your head during the brutal fights to come.
When you face a wall you can't possibly scale, her voice is what convinces you to back off and try again next time instead of getting yourself killed.
Truth is, she's always known exactly who has what it takes to make it out alive.
StarTowerBookEventReward.917203.2.cn:
星塔冒险中，请留意护士贝缇丽对你的讥讽。
个别旅人总会抱怨：
“她怎么老是要说这样尖酸刻薄的话呢？”
但如果冷静下来仔细想想，那些对简陋的防具武器的讥讽，对尚不熟练的技艺的嘲弄，又何尝不是一种警告呢？
这些话语是那么锐利刺耳，以至于能深深烙印在旅人们的心中，并在接下来愈发艰难的战斗里被反复在耳边回放。
真到了翻越不了的高墙时，大多数人才会因此选择知难而退，去尝试下一次的挑战——而不是把小命丢在这里。
她其实一直都很清楚，什么样的旅人才能活到最后。

StarTowerBookEventReward.917203.3.cn: 贝缇丽默契等级达到20级

StarTowerBookEventReward.917301.2.en:
Of the many Trekkers Bernina tried to swindle, a few never took the bait.
Some even exposed her tricks on the spot, scaring off other, more hesitant Trekkers in the process.
"We're down to our last 100 Stella Coins. If this fails, we lose everything."
Just as a deal was about to close, a companion yanked one of the Trekkers back by the sleeve.
Bernina choked down her fury, her face twisting into a ghastly smile.
"Oh, but an opportunity like this is so rare. It would be a true shame to miss it..."
She feigned regret, though she knew it was pointless. By then, no amount of coaxing could change their minds.
All she could do was wait for the next mark.
StarTowerBookEventReward.917301.2.cn:
在珀尔娜诱骗过的众多旅人中，总有那么几个不吃她这套。
更有甚者会直接拆穿她的把戏，连带着让其他犹豫的旅人也打退堂鼓。
“我们只剩100辉光币了，要是失败就血本无归。”
某次即将得手之际，一个旅人突然被同伴拽住了衣袖。
珀尔娜只能强压怒火，努力控制表情，露出一副扭曲的微笑。
“哎呀，机会难得，错过可就可惜了……”
她故作惋惜地劝说着——不过她很清楚，到这个时候，无论她如何挽留，终究也只是徒劳。
只好等待下一个机会了。

StarTowerBookEventReward.917301.3.cn: 珀尔娜默契等级达到5级

StarTowerBookEventReward.917302.2.en:
After repeated failures, Bernina spotted the pattern: cautious, idealistic Trekkers were the toughest to fool.
Then again, Virigia's polished spiel seemed to resonate with that exact crowd. An idea sparked...
She began to mimic Virigia's delivery, her voice dripping with a sickly sweet charm.
"A forward-thinking Trekker like you is destined for greatness! But even the grandest ambitions need seed money, don't you think?"
At these words, a Trekker's resolve would waver, their fingers unconsciously drifting toward their coin pouch.
"Just 100 Stella Coins for a threefold return. Think of the time you'll save, how much further you'll go!"
Bernina discovered that most people were simply too proud to openly admit their own greed.
All she had to do was wrap up a pretty bow on the bait and give a little nudge. They'd leap into the trap themselves.
StarTowerBookEventReward.917302.2.cn:
屡次碰壁后，珀尔娜摸清了规律：那些怀揣理想、行事谨慎的旅人最难上当。
但反过来想，维嘉尔说的那套话，听起来就对这些人很有吸引力，不如……
于是，她开始模仿维嘉尔的腔调，声音轻柔，带着几分蛊惑的甜腻：
“您这样深谋远虑的旅人，将来必定成就非凡呢——！不过再伟大的理想，总需要第一桶金来奠基吧？”
不少旅人听到这番话，原本坚定的眼神就渐渐浮动，手指开始无意识地摸起口袋。
“100辉光币，就能换来3倍的回报，省下的时间，足够您走得更远呢！”
从这个例子上，珀尔娜发现，很多人只是表面拉不下脸，不敢当面谈什么欲望与贪婪而已。
只要稍稍包装一下，然后轻轻一推，他们便会自己跳进陷阱——

StarTowerBookEventReward.917302.3.cn: 珀尔娜默契等级达到10级

StarTowerBookEventReward.917303.2.en:
Maybe it was Bernina's subpar acting, or maybe her abrasive nature was just too hard to hide. Whatever the reason, her new method rarely landed.
A wavering Trekker would catch a flicker of her true expression, see through the ruse, and their resolve would harden.
"You know, that other person was right. When in doubt, it's better to play it safe."
Next to Virigia's elegant wording and flawless logic, Bernina's impatient pressuring only backfired.
Bernina stood frozen, watching them depart.
Only after the elevator doors slid shut did she click her tongue in disgust.
This acting gig is better left to Virigia, she thought.
It's not like she actually believes her own nonsense, right?
StarTowerBookEventReward.917303.2.cn:
或许是珀尔娜的演技不够，或者说她本性难移——总之，这个方法奏效的时候似乎有点少。
原本都开始动摇的旅人，从她细微的表情里总会看穿端倪，反而变得更坚定了。
“还是那个人说的对，犹豫不决的话，还是选择稳妥一点会比较好。”
相比维嘉尔文雅的措辞与合理的论证，珀尔娜急不可耐的催促起到了反效果。
望着旅人远去的身影，珀尔娜呆立原地。
直到星梯的门完全关上，她才会鄙夷地咂舌。
看来这种需要演技的工作，还是该交给维嘉尔才对——她这样想着。
……总不见得，她真信吧？

StarTowerBookEventReward.917303.3.cn: 珀尔娜默契等级达到20级

StarTowerBookEventReward.917401.2.en:
Across Nova, people become Trekkers for countless reasons.
Some seek the freedom of the Wilds, others hunt the power of Artifacts. And then there are those just in it for a quick buck.
These types had no grand ambitions or idealistic dreams. Their minds were set on one simple goal: get an Artifact, then go live it up in the Silver District.
Virigia rarely wasted her breath on such Trekkers.
After all, their concerns boiled down to, "Did I make enough for a good drink tonight?" A trip to the Monolith was a wash if they couldn't even secure a basic profit.
To them, the greatest tragedy imaginable was losing their coin and having to sleep under a bridge again.
Virigia would simply stand aside, her gentle gaze following them as they passed. This, most likely, is how the rumor of a "gentle demon in the Monolith" was born.
StarTowerBookEventReward.917401.2.cn:
在诺瓦大陆，成为旅人的理由千奇百怪。
有人向往荒野的自由，有人追逐神器的力量，而有些人——他们只想赚笔快钱。
这些家伙既没有远大的抱负，也不在乎什么理想生活。满脑子都是「搞到神器就去银城区花天酒地」的简单念头。
——这样的旅人，维嘉尔一般也提不起什么搭话的兴趣。
毕竟他们的水平也就停留在「今天赚的钱够不够喝个痛快」这种程度，要是连保底收益都捞不到，这趟星塔岂不是白来了？
他们认为最大的苦难，就是万一输掉了口袋里的钱，今晚就又得睡桥洞。
维嘉尔此时只会默默地伫立在一旁，眼看着他们经过，再用温柔的视线目送他们远去——这大概就是“星塔里有个温柔的恶魔”传言的由来。

StarTowerBookEventReward.917401.3.cn: 维嘉尔默契等级达到5级

StarTowerBookEventReward.917402.2.en:
"Only one drink yesterday, was it?" Virigia would lean in, her voice laced with saccharine persuasion.
"But if you were to triple your Stella Coins today, reach a higher floor, claim a better Artifact ... you could spend the next two days lounging in an inn, never again worrying about pocket change."
They never cared for the future, only for the sweet temptations of the now. But adding a dash of "tomorrow" worked wonders.
"So, what do you say? Care to wager all your coins for a wonderful tomorrow, the day after ... and perhaps a whole year to come?"
At that, the Trekker's breath would quicken, their eyes glinting with a gambler's fever.
Makes sense, they'd think. I risk my life in here every day anyway. Why not go all in on one big score?
Win or lose, as they parted, Virigia always offered the same heartfelt blessing.
"May today's hardships distill into tomorrow's finest vintage."
StarTowerBookEventReward.917402.2.cn:
“原来您昨天只喝了一杯啊？”维嘉尔微微倾身，声音里带着一丝甜腻。
“若是今天能拿到三倍辉光币，登上更高层，拿到更好的神器……说不定明后两天都能躺在旅馆里，再也不用为这点小钱发愁了呢。”
——他们从不在乎「未来」，只贪恋「此刻」的甜头。但……稍稍加一点名为「明天」的佐料，就可以有不错的效果。
“怎么样，要交出你身上所有的币，然后期待一下明天，后天……乃至一整年的美妙吗？”
三言两语间，旅人的呼吸已然急促，眼中燃起熟悉的、赌徒般的狂热。
是啊，反正每天都要来星塔拼命，何不赌一把大的？
无论输赢，离别的时候，维嘉尔都会一如既往地为旅人送上衷心的祝福。
“愿您今日的苦难，终将成为明日的佳酿。”

StarTowerBookEventReward.917402.3.cn: 维嘉尔默契等级达到10级

StarTowerBookEventReward.917403.2.en:
The Monolith was bustling, and Virigia stood by the elevator doors, poised as ever.
Her dress hung perfectly still, as unshakable as her serene composure.
Suddenly, a figure came barreling toward her from down the hall.
"Miss Virigia! When I got home... I thought really hard about what you said!"
"I can't live hand-to-mouth like this anymore!"
"I'm going to save up, open a little restaurant, and never set foot in this Monolith again!"
The smile on Virigia's face froze solid.
This sudden epiphany completely threw her off her rhythm.
She rattled off a few robotic pleasantries, practically shoving the Trekker into the stairs.
Whatever... I'll just have him forget this grand ideal after his next wish.
StarTowerBookEventReward.917403.2.cn:
今天的星塔依旧喧嚣，维嘉尔如常站在星梯的门口。
她的裙摆纹丝不动——就如同她从不动摇的面容和气息。
直到某个身影，跌跌撞撞地从远方冲来。
“维嘉尔小姐！我回家后……我仔细想了你说的话！”
“我再也不要过这种有上顿没下顿的日子了！”
“我要攒钱开家小餐馆，永远、永远都不要再来星塔了！”
维嘉尔的笑容僵在了脸上。
这突如其来的「醒悟」，彻底打乱了她的节奏。
她机械地应付了几句，几乎是推着把旅人塞进了星梯。
“算了……还是让他在某次许愿后，忘掉这宏伟的理想吧。”

StarTowerBookEventReward.917403.3.cn: 维嘉尔默契等级达到20级

StarTowerNPC.9133.2.en:
In the convenience stores scattered throughout the Monolith, you'll always find Portia, who often sits lazily behind the counter, dark circles under her eyes from lack of sleep, responding to customers' requests with a half-hearted tone.
It's not difficult to strike up a conversation with her, despite her usual unenthusiasm. Mention "the world beyond the Monolith," and you'll see the subtle wobble of expectation and curiosity in her eyes. Maybe she's really interested in knowing more about it?
StarTowerNPC.9133.2.cn:
在散落于星塔各处的便利店里，你总会见到波西亚——她常常懒散地坐在柜台上，顶着睡眠不足的黑眼圈，用提不起劲的声调勉强回复着客人的诉求。
和她搭话并不困难，只是她常常提不起劲——但当话题提到了“星塔外的世界”时，她就总会露出有些微妙、带着期许和好奇的表情。或许她真的很感兴趣吧？

StarTowerNPC.9172.2.en:
When a battle ends, you'll find Beatrixa in front of the stairs with her medical kit. She is the very "Angel of the Monolith" that people talk about.
She never starts a conversation, so many Trekkers never even notice her. She always wears a cold expression and sounds like she's unhappy that you're hurt. Yet, regardless of her attitude, she always heals every Trekker's injuries and reminds them to stay safe. So, maybe she's actually a great caretaker?
StarTowerNPC.9172.2.cn:
每当一场恶战结束，贝缇丽就会拖着她的医疗箱冷不丁地等候在星梯的门前——她正是传言中那个“星塔里的天使”本人。
她从不主动搭话，因此有不少旅人从未注意到她的存在；她总是挂着冷淡的表情，话语间带着埋怨和嗔怪——但无论如何，她总会悉心疗愈好旅人的伤口，并公平地留下一句“注意安全”的告诫。或许，她其实很会照顾人？

StarTowerNPC.9173.2.en:
One of the two mysterious "Demons of the Monolith."
They always appear before resting Trekkers and talk to them.
Bernina always holds a lantern in her hand, which can expose a Trekker's deepest desires.
With threats and temptations, she often succeeds in persuading Trekkers to give up what they have in exchange of she offers.
StarTowerNPC.9173.2.cn:
传言中，神秘的两位“星塔里的恶魔”之一。
她们似乎总是出现在修整的旅人面前，并主动来搭话。
珀尔娜的手里总是提着一盏提灯，旅人的欲望会在她面前无所遁形。
在她的威逼利诱下，总有旅人会接受她抛出的诱惑，而去放弃掉某些东西。

StarTowerNPC.9174.2.en:
One of the two mysterious "Demons of the Monolith."
They always appear before resting Trekkers and talk to them.
Virigia always holds a mirror in her hand, which can reveal a Trekker's wildest dreams.
With alluring hints and promises, she often succeeds in persuading Trekkers to give up what they have in exchange of she offers.
StarTowerNPC.9174.2.cn:
传言中，神秘的两位“星塔里的恶魔”之一。
她们似乎总是出现在修整的旅人面前，并主动来搭话。
维嘉尔的手里总是提着一面镜子，旅人的理想会在她眼中全盘揭示。
在她的暗示与承诺中，总有旅人会接受她抛出的诱惑，而去放弃掉某些东西。
