StarTowerTalk.913301.2.en:
Ha! ... Ugh...
Sorry... I was up all night playing games yesterday.
StarTowerTalk.913301.2.cn:
哈啊……唔……
不好意思，昨晚熬夜打游戏了。

StarTowerTalk.913302.2.en: Ugh, this is so annoying. Why do I have to be here...?
StarTowerTalk.913302.2.cn: 好麻烦，为什么我要一直守在这里……

StarTowerTalk.913303.2.en: Hmm? You were talking to me? I thought it was a dream...
StarTowerTalk.913303.2.cn: 嗯？你刚刚跟我说话了？我还以为是做梦呢……

StarTowerTalk.913304.2.en: Just grab anything you want, as long as you pay.
StarTowerTalk.913304.2.cn: 想买东西的话就随便拿吧，记得付款。

StarTowerTalk.913305.2.en: You can take as much as you want from the Monolith, but is that really good for you Trekkers...? I wonder... Heh...
StarTowerTalk.913305.2.cn: 只要你愿意，星塔里的东西你想拿多少就能拿多少。但对于你们旅人来说，这真的是好事吗……呵呵。

StarTowerTalk.913306.2.en: So tired... I need some sleep right now... Be my guest.
StarTowerTalk.913306.2.cn: 困死了，我要睡一会儿……你请便吧。

StarTowerTalk.913307.2.en: Shhh... If the manager catches me chatting with a customer, I'll be fined.
StarTowerTalk.913307.2.cn: 嘘，小点声，要是让店长看到我在和顾客闲聊，会扣工资的。

StarTowerTalk.913308.2.en: You're looking good, way better than me. I say you should be working here at the Monolith.
StarTowerTalk.913308.2.cn: 你看起来状态不错，比我还有精神，我看你更适合在星塔里打工。

StarTowerTalk.913309.2.en: You want my advise? Come on, I just work here.
StarTowerTalk.913309.2.cn: 想向我寻求建议？可我只是个便利店店员啊。

StarTowerTalk.913310.2.en: Speaking of which, you play games? Let's play a round then.
StarTowerTalk.913310.2.cn: 说起来，你会打游戏？那就陪我来一局吧。

StarTowerTalk.913311.2.en: Welcome... We've got some new stock today... Want anything?
StarTowerTalk.913311.2.cn: 欢迎光临……今天进了些新货……有你想要的吗？

StarTowerTalk.913312.2.en: That penguin? Ah, it's the manager.
StarTowerTalk.913312.2.cn: 你说那只企鹅？它是我的店长。

StarTowerTalk.913313.2.en:
Just leave the Stella Coins on the table to pay.
I need to finish this game first.
StarTowerTalk.913313.2.cn:
要结账的话，把辉光币放桌上就好。
我先把这局游戏打完了再说。

StarTowerTalk.913314.2.en: Pick something useful, yeah? I don't want to see you all bruised and battered next time.
StarTowerTalk.913314.2.cn: 尽可能买点有用的东西，我可不想下次看到你鼻青脸肿地进来。

StarTowerTalk.913315.2.en:
I always think trying hard doesn't really help.
But ... when you're in danger, please, try your best to survive.
StarTowerTalk.913315.2.cn:
我一直觉得努力也没什么用。
不过……如果遇到了危险，还请努力活下去。

StarTowerTalk.913316.2.en:
Anything else you need?
If not, see you next time then.
StarTowerTalk.913316.2.cn:
还有什么事吗？
没有的话，就谢谢惠顾了。

StarTowerTalk.913318.2.en:
Sorry, we don't do credit here.
If you're low on Stella Coins, you'll need to find ways to earn more.
StarTowerTalk.913318.2.cn:
抱歉，我这里不赊账。
如果辉光币不够了，自己想办法再攒点吧。

StarTowerTalk.913319.2.en: Wanna take another look? No rush, take all the time you want.
StarTowerTalk.913319.2.cn: 还想再看看吗？想看多久都行。

StarTowerTalk.913320.2.en: Still browsing? You know, you can always come back later.
StarTowerTalk.913320.2.cn: 看得差不多就行了，一会儿还会再见的。

StarTowerTalk.913321.2.en: That's all we've got here. No secret items.
StarTowerTalk.913321.2.cn: 我这里只卖这些东西，没有什么隐藏道具。

StarTowerTalk.913322.2.en: You're interested in the manager? It'll talk to you when it feels like it, and if it doesn't ... then it's in a bad mood.
StarTowerTalk.913322.2.cn: 你对店长感兴趣？店长心情好的时候就会和你说话，如果不理你......那就是心情不好。

StarTowerTalk.913323.2.en:
Tell me more about what's happening outside the Monolith. I'd really appreciate it.
A discount? Ugh, that's out of my hands...
StarTowerTalk.913323.2.cn:
跟我多说说星塔外的事吧，我会感谢你的。
打折？这我可做不了主……

StarTowerTalk.913324.2.en:
Why do you Trekkers climb the Monolith anyway?
For the Artifacts, really?
StarTowerTalk.913324.2.cn:
你们旅人究竟是为了什么才来攀登星塔？
就那么想要神器吗？

StarTowerTalk.913325.2.en:
Thank you for shopping with us.
Now I can pass the time by counting these Stella Coins when there's no one around to talk to...
StarTowerTalk.913325.2.cn:
谢谢惠顾。
唉，没人和我说话的时候，倒是还能数数这些辉光币打发时间……

StarTowerTalk.913326.2.en: We can chat a little longer, a special service for a valued customer.
StarTowerTalk.913326.2.cn: 我可以陪你再聊会儿，就当是给老顾客的特别回馈了。

StarTowerTalk.913327.2.en: If this stuff can help you out, then all my work was worth it.
StarTowerTalk.913327.2.cn: 如果这些东西能帮到你，我也算没白忙活。

StarTowerTalk.913328.2.en: Come back again if you're satisfied with your purchase. I'd be bored out of my mind if you don't.
StarTowerTalk.913328.2.cn: 满意的话下次再来哦，要是见不到你，我会感到很无聊的。

StarTowerTalk.913329.2.en:
Feel free to take a rest here if you're feeling tired.
Want something to drink?
StarTowerTalk.913329.2.cn:
如果累了的话，在这里休息一会也不是不行。
要喝点什么吗？

StarTowerTalk.913330.2.en: Sometimes I'd also like to see what's outside the Monolith... Hah, I should stop talking nonsense.
StarTowerTalk.913330.2.cn: 有时候也想去星塔外看看……呵呵，还是别做白日梦了。

StarTowerTalk.917201.2.en: Where's the wound? Let me see.

StarTowerTalk.917202.2.en: If you don't need treatment, then move along.
StarTowerTalk.917202.2.cn: 不需要治疗的话就快走。

StarTowerTalk.917203.2.en: Can't go on? Leave and find yourself a place to rest then.
StarTowerTalk.917203.2.cn: 已经不行了？那就出去歇着吧。

StarTowerTalk.917204.2.en: Met me before? Must be your imagination.
StarTowerTalk.917204.2.cn: 感觉在哪里见过我？那只是你的错觉。

StarTowerTalk.917206.2.en: Don't waste my time. Let me treat you and you're good to go.
StarTowerTalk.917206.2.cn: 别浪费时间，赶紧治好赶紧走。

StarTowerTalk.917207.2.en: That's not very serious. Keep moving.
StarTowerTalk.917207.2.cn: 轻伤不下火线，继续前进吧。

StarTowerTalk.917208.2.en: Good, still alive. How many shots this time?
StarTowerTalk.917208.2.cn: 不错，还活着。这次需要扎几针？

StarTowerTalk.917209.2.en: I only treat Trekkers here. If you think you've seen me somewhere else, then that's probably a mistake.
StarTowerTalk.917209.2.cn: 我只会在这里治疗旅人，你在其他地方见到的……是别人。

StarTowerTalk.917210.2.en: I've never known anyone who pesters me for shots like you.
StarTowerTalk.917210.2.cn: 我从没见过有人像你这样，缠着要我扎针的。

StarTowerTalk.917211.2.en: I'm not here to tend to you only... So, where's the injury?
StarTowerTalk.917211.2.cn: 我不是来专程照顾你的……说吧，伤哪了？

StarTowerTalk.917212.2.en: Be more careful next time. Just try to make my life easier, would you?
StarTowerTalk.917212.2.cn: 下次多注意一些，别再给我添麻烦了。

StarTowerTalk.917213.2.en: Good, you did better than I had expected. Come, let's do a checkup.
StarTowerTalk.917213.2.cn: 不错，表现比我预想的要好。来吧，给你做个检查。

StarTowerTalk.917214.2.en: Streaming? Did you hit your head?
StarTowerTalk.917214.2.cn: 什么直播？你是伤到脑子了吗？

StarTowerTalk.917215.2.en: Alright, alright. One shot coming up. Don't rush.
StarTowerTalk.917215.2.cn: 好好好，给你来一针，别着急。

StarTowerTalk.917216.2.en: You're good to go. Leave and don't be in my way.
StarTowerTalk.917216.2.cn: 赶紧走吧，别在这里碍手碍脚的。

StarTowerTalk.917217.2.en: I don't take in the wounded here. Sorry, you can't stay.
StarTowerTalk.917217.2.cn: 我这里不收留伤患，请回吧。

StarTowerTalk.917218.2.en: No need to push yourself so hard. It's okay to turn back if it gets too tough.
StarTowerTalk.917218.2.cn: 勉强是没有意义的，坚持不下去就算了，回头不丢人。

StarTowerTalk.917219.2.en: What? You're addicted to my shots?

StarTowerTalk.917220.2.en: It's normal to get hurt, but honestly, you're pretty fragile.
StarTowerTalk.917220.2.cn: 受伤不奇怪，但你很脆弱也是真的。

StarTowerTalk.917221.2.en: Was that scream just acting? Not bad at all.
StarTowerTalk.917221.2.cn: 刚才的惨叫是装的吗？那你演技不错啊。

StarTowerTalk.917222.2.en: I don't do inpatient care here. You can leave once you're treated.
StarTowerTalk.917222.2.cn: 我这里不安排住院，治完了就自觉离开吧。

StarTowerTalk.917223.2.en: You may die if you keep going up... Whatever, not my problem.
StarTowerTalk.917223.2.cn: 再往上走，可能会没命……不过，这和我有什么关系？

StarTowerTalk.917224.2.en: Quite athletic. Looks like you'll survive a few more rounds.
StarTowerTalk.917224.2.cn: 素质不错，看来还能撑个几轮。

StarTowerTalk.917225.2.en: I don't provide any other services here.
StarTowerTalk.917225.2.cn: 我这里不提供其他服务。

StarTowerTalk.917226.2.en: If you want to rest here a while, be my guest. Just leave me alone.
StarTowerTalk.917226.2.cn: 如果还想在这里休息一会，请便吧。别打搅到我就行。

StarTowerTalk.917227.2.en: I don't mind giving you more help. Just come back to me the next time you're hurt.
StarTowerTalk.917227.2.cn: 我不介意多帮你几次，下次受伤的话来找我就好。

StarTowerTalk.917228.2.en: If your goal's the top, don't linger here.
StarTowerTalk.917228.2.cn: 既然目标是塔顶，就不要在这里逗留了。

StarTowerTalk.917229.2.en: Just here to chat for a bit? Fine by me.
StarTowerTalk.917229.2.cn: 就是想和我聊两句吗？无妨。

StarTowerTalk.917230.2.en: Hmm, I'm starting to expect more from you.
StarTowerTalk.917230.2.cn: 呵呵，我开始对你有点期待了。

StarTowerTalk.917301.2.en: Risk and reward always go hand in hand...

StarTowerTalk.917302.2.en: Don't fight it. Strength belongs to those brave enough to seek it.
StarTowerTalk.917302.2.cn: 别抗拒，力量本就属于敢于寻求它的人~

StarTowerTalk.917303.2.en: Want more rewards? Try this one~
StarTowerTalk.917303.2.cn: 想要获得更多的报酬？来试试这个吧~

StarTowerTalk.917304.2.en:
Fortune favors the bold!
Isn't that what you Trekkers always say?
StarTowerTalk.917304.2.cn:
富贵险中求~
你们旅人不都这么说的吗？

StarTowerTalk.917305.2.en: No more boring constraints! Yield to your desires!
StarTowerTalk.917305.2.cn: 无聊的约束在这里已经不存在了，尽管遵从自己的欲望吧！

StarTowerTalk.917306.2.en: Lucky day, eh? Why not challenge your fate now?
StarTowerTalk.917306.2.cn: 今天运气不错呢，来挑战一下命运吧～

StarTowerTalk.917307.2.cn: 既然已经决定了，可就不要再犹豫了哦~

StarTowerTalk.917308.2.en: My great Boss, don't you want the grandest prize?
StarTowerTalk.917308.2.cn: 我的大魔王，难道不想要最丰厚的奖励吗？

StarTowerTalk.917309.2.en: A deal? Don't make it sound so cold. I just took care of that little bit of greed inside you.
StarTowerTalk.917309.2.cn: 交易？别说得这么生分嘛~我只是满足了你心底的小小贪念罢了。

StarTowerTalk.917310.2.en: Since you're here, why not play a game with me?
StarTowerTalk.917310.2.cn: 来都来了～不来和我做个游戏吗？

StarTowerTalk.917311.2.en: Come on. Make your choice! As long as you leave everything to me, I will satisfy all your desires...
StarTowerTalk.917311.2.cn: 来吧，做出选择吧~只要你愿意将一切交给我，你的欲望就会得到满足……

StarTowerTalk.917312.2.en:
Took you long enough.
I've been here waiting for you, my great Boss! And I'll give you a really, really good time.
StarTowerTalk.917312.2.cn:
总算来了？
我在这里等您很久了！我的大魔王，今天我会好好让你享受的~

StarTowerTalk.917313.2.en: Caught my attention the moment you stepped into the Monolith... I've been so fascinated by your explicit desire.
StarTowerTalk.917313.2.cn: 在您踏入星塔时，我就被您吸引了～真想一直注视着您这副袒露欲望的模样啊。

StarTowerTalk.917314.2.en: Are you sure you can trust me? My sweet words and gentle gestures ... can well be traps for you to fall...
StarTowerTalk.917314.2.cn:
你这么信任我真的好吗？
甜言蜜语也好，柔情似水也好……
说不定都是我为你准备的陷阱哦~

StarTowerTalk.917315.2.en: I'm in a great mood today! Ask me for anything, and I will grant it!
StarTowerTalk.917315.2.cn: 我今天的心情超好～尽情向我渴求吧，无论什么我都会满足你哦~

StarTowerTalk.917316.2.en:
Want another round? 
Sorry, one game at a time~
StarTowerTalk.917316.2.cn:
还想再来？
抱歉啦～一次只能玩一局哦～

StarTowerTalk.917318.2.en: Mmm~ Still not satisfied, are you?
StarTowerTalk.917318.2.cn: 嗯哼~是还有些意犹未尽吗？

StarTowerTalk.917319.2.en: You're not going without a hug, are you?
StarTowerTalk.917319.2.cn: 还需要我和你亲热一下才愿意离开吗？

StarTowerTalk.917320.2.cn: 继续攀登吧～我们还会再见的！

StarTowerTalk.917321.2.en: You're addicted, huh? Look forward to the next time we meet then.
StarTowerTalk.917321.2.cn: 上瘾了吗？那就期待我们的再次相会吧~

StarTowerTalk.917322.2.en: Don't look so reluctant to leave. You'll still have plenty of chances.
StarTowerTalk.917322.2.cn: 不用露出这么恋恋不舍的表情，以后的机会还多着呢~

StarTowerTalk.917323.2.en: Stop searching... I don't have anything better to offer...
StarTowerTalk.917323.2.cn: 别摸来摸去了，我可拿不出更好的东西了~

StarTowerTalk.917324.2.en: May Lady Fortune always smile on you, my great Boss.
StarTowerTalk.917324.2.cn: 愿好运永远眷顾您，我的大魔王~

StarTowerTalk.917325.2.cn: 这么容易就上钩了啊~真可爱~

StarTowerTalk.917326.2.en: Wonderful! I prefer people who know what they want over indecisive ones.
StarTowerTalk.917326.2.cn: 真不错啊，比起犹豫不决的人我还是更喜欢你这样的行动派~

StarTowerTalk.917327.2.en: If I let you pat on my horn ... will you be happy?
StarTowerTalk.917327.2.cn: 如果让您摸摸我的角……您会开心吗？

StarTowerTalk.917328.2.en: Want to continue chatting for a while? Stay here then. We can do this forever...
StarTowerTalk.917328.2.cn: 想再和我聊一会？那就一直待在这里吧~这样我们就能永远地聊下去了……

StarTowerTalk.917329.2.en: The idea that I'll meet you again makes the job less boring.
StarTowerTalk.917329.2.cn: 一想到还能再遇到你，就觉得我的工作都不那么乏味了呢。

StarTowerTalk.917330.2.en: I really like your scent ... of desire.
StarTowerTalk.917330.2.cn: 真喜欢您身上这种……欲望的香气～

StarTowerTalk.917401.2.en: A choice without risks is like gambling without betting — completely worthless.
StarTowerTalk.917401.2.cn: 没有风险的选择，就像没有赌注的赌局，注定毫无价值。

StarTowerTalk.917402.2.en: Those Trekkers who go down in history weren't all that special. Most of the time, they just made the right choice.
StarTowerTalk.917402.2.cn:
那些名垂青史的旅人，并没有什么特别的地方。
大多数情况下，他们只是做出了最正确的选择。

StarTowerTalk.917403.2.en: A single wise decision can save countless wasted efforts. Work smarter, not harder...
StarTowerTalk.917403.2.cn: 一次明智的选择能省去无数徒劳，这可是事半功倍的秘诀……

StarTowerTalk.917404.2.en: One never regrets the outcome, but rather the chances they never take.
StarTowerTalk.917404.2.cn: 遗憾的从来不是结果，而是未被选择的契机。

StarTowerTalk.917405.2.en: To make it this far, you truly are an impressive Trekker.
StarTowerTalk.917405.2.cn: 竟然能坚持到这里，您真是一位了不起的旅人。

StarTowerTalk.917406.2.en:
Indecision won't lead to greatness.
As an experienced Trekker, you must understand the importance of acting decisively.
StarTowerTalk.917406.2.cn:
优柔寡断可成不了大事。
但作为经验丰富的旅人，您一定懂得当机立断的重要性吧。

StarTowerTalk.917407.2.en: The right choice always beats undirected effort. That's the first rule of survival in the Monolith, don't you think?
StarTowerTalk.917407.2.cn: 正确的选择永远胜过盲目努力，这可是星塔生存的第一法则，您说呢？

StarTowerTalk.917408.2.en: A seasoned Trekker like you should be able to make the best choice.
StarTowerTalk.917408.2.cn: 像您这样有经验的旅人，一定能做出最正确的选择吧。

StarTowerTalk.917409.2.en: No need to fear. All it'll cost is you an entrance ticket.
StarTowerTalk.917409.2.cn: 无需畏惧，你所付出的代价只是通行的门票。

StarTowerTalk.917410.2.en: Reaching this place is no small feat. Please continue to strive on the road ahead!
StarTowerTalk.917410.2.cn: 能抵达这里实属不易，接下来的路也请继续挣扎吧。

StarTowerTalk.917411.2.en: A mature Trekker like you wouldn't hesitate like a novice, right?
StarTowerTalk.917411.2.cn: 您这样成熟的旅人，总不会像新手般踌躇不前吧。

StarTowerTalk.917412.2.en: Just follow your heart, and you'll become the brightest star in the Monolith's history!
StarTowerTalk.917412.2.cn: 只要遵循内心的指引，您必将成为星塔史上最耀眼的传奇。

StarTowerTalk.917413.2.en: Look, the rewards are right before you... So, why not aim for greater prizes?
StarTowerTalk.917413.2.cn: 您看，报酬都摆在眼前了……何不尝试挑战更高收益呢？

StarTowerTalk.917414.2.en: A true Trekker makes every choice a road sign along their journey.
StarTowerTalk.917414.2.cn: 真正的旅人，会把每个选择都作为旅途中的道标。

StarTowerTalk.917415.2.en: If you feel lost, close your eyes and listen to the voice within.
StarTowerTalk.917415.2.cn: 若是迷惘，就闭上眼睛，倾听你内心的声音。

StarTowerTalk.917416.2.en:
Cutting your losses is the smart thing to do.
But a true Boss never quits halfway, right?
StarTowerTalk.917416.2.cn:
及时止损是聪明人的选择。
但魔王不会半途而废，对吧？

StarTowerTalk.917417.2.en: Everyone should follow their heart. I'm only offering a little advice.
StarTowerTalk.917417.2.cn: 人人都应当遵从自己的内心，我只是给出一些微不足道的建议罢了。

StarTowerTalk.917418.2.en: Opportunities slip away in an instant. If you want to try again ... I'll always be here.
StarTowerTalk.917418.2.cn: 机遇稍纵即逝，若您想再试一次……我随时恭候~

StarTowerTalk.917419.2.en: No one can predict the outcome, not even me.
StarTowerTalk.917419.2.cn: 谁都不能提前预知结果，我也一样。

StarTowerTalk.917420.2.en: May your journey ahead be smooth. Until we meet again.
StarTowerTalk.917420.2.cn: 愿您前路顺遂，后会有期。

StarTowerTalk.917421.2.en: Don't worry, this is only a small obstacle.
StarTowerTalk.917421.2.cn: 别担心，这只是一个小小的挑战。

StarTowerTalk.917422.2.en: If the reward is tempting enough, it's worth staking everything, isn't it?
StarTowerTalk.917422.2.cn: 只要回报足够诱人，即便赌上一切也值得尝试，对吧？

StarTowerTalk.917423.2.en: Your time is precious. You must have more important things to attend to, don't you?
StarTowerTalk.917423.2.cn: 您的时间如此宝贵，一定还有更重要的事情等着您去处理，不是吗？

StarTowerTalk.917424.2.en: Lady Luck will smile upon you — if not this time, then next time, yeah.
StarTowerTalk.917424.2.cn: 幸运女神会眷顾您的，不是这次，就是下次，呵呵。

StarTowerTalk.917425.2.en: Don't miss great opportunities for small gains, and don't throw away what's within reach for empty dreams.
StarTowerTalk.917425.2.cn: 别因小利错失良机，也别为虚妄的目标放弃触手可得的收获。

StarTowerTalk.917426.2.en: I'll be keeping an eye on your destiny.
StarTowerTalk.917426.2.cn: 我会一直注视着您的命运。

StarTowerTalk.917427.2.en: The cost itself isn't scary. What's really upsetting is wasted effort. But at least, it's become our little secret now.
StarTowerTalk.917427.2.cn: 代价本身并不可怕，可怕的是付出代价后却一无所获。而现在，至少它成为了我们之间的秘密。

StarTowerTalk.917428.2.en: If a quick chat could help you reach your goal, I'd be happy to spend some time with you.
StarTowerTalk.917428.2.cn: 如果短暂的闲聊能帮助您成功通往终点，那我很乐意将时间花在您身上。

StarTowerTalk.917429.2.en: Opportunities only come to those who are ready. I hope to see you again soon.
StarTowerTalk.917429.2.cn: 机会只会留给有准备的人，期待我们下次再见~

StarTowerTalk.917430.2.en: That courage you have, facing hardship head-on... It's truly fascinating.
StarTowerTalk.917430.2.cn: 您身上那份直面苦难的勇气…….真令人着迷。

Story.100.2.en: When words fail, the sword shall speak.
Story.100.2.cn: 言语说不通的时候，就需要用剑来开路。

Story.101.2.en: Every awakening brings a fresh start.
Story.101.2.cn: 每一次醒来，都是一段新的人生。

Story.102.2.en: As you lost all memories, an ancient gift finds its way to you.
Story.102.2.cn: 失去了所有记忆的你，收到了一份久远的礼物。

Story.103.2.en: In the blink of an eye, the only place you could call home is taken away.
Story.103.2.cn: 一转眼，你们的容身之所就被夺走了。

Story.104.2.en: Those without shelter must find a new place to weather the storm.
Story.104.2.cn: 无家可归的人，总要找个遮风挡雨的地方。

Story.105.2.en: The streets you once knew are now nothing but ghostly strangers.
Story.105.2.cn: 物是人非，旧日的街道上已经没有了熟悉的风景。

Story.106.2.en: This is her story—and the story of the Ash District.
Story.106.2.cn: 这是她的故事，也是灰城区的故事。

Story.107.2.en: A new way to make wishes...will it bring change, or unleash catastrophe?
Story.107.2.cn: 崭新的许愿方式，是变革还是灾祸？

Story.108.2.en: More often than not, the answers hide in plain sight.
Story.108.2.cn: 很多时候，答案就藏在最显眼的地方。

Story.109.2.en: Sometimes, the simplest meals hold the greatest power to heal a wounded soul.
Story.109.2.cn: 治愈人心的美食，往往只需要最朴素的烹饪方式。

Story.111.2.en: The best way to fight amnesia is by creating more memorable moments.
Story.111.2.cn: 抵御失忆的方法就是创造更多有趣的记忆。

Story.112.2.en: With the Grace Seal, you can do whatever you please.
Story.112.2.cn: 有恩赐印章就是可以为所欲为。

Story.201.2.en: There will always be those who think they can trap wind in a cage.
Story.201.2.cn: 总有人想用笼子抓住风。

Story.202.2.en: Those who mess with rules never know how to lose gracefully.
Story.202.2.cn: 玩弄规则的人从来不会好好认输。

Story.203.2.en: A Trekker never loses to the same Stellaroid twice.
Story.203.2.cn: 旅人不会两次败给同一只星骸。

Story.204.2.en: The more benefits fall from the sky, the more carefully you must tread.
Story.204.2.cn: 从天而降的好处越多，就越要谨慎行事。

Story.205.2.en: Since they call us barbarians, we should really do something barbaric.
Story.205.2.cn: 既然说我们是野蛮人，那就做点野蛮的事吧。

Story.206.2.en: People are judged by their clothes—because some can only see the clothes.
Story.206.2.cn: 人靠衣装，是因为有些人只看得见衣装。

Story.207.2.en: Complex plans always come with unexpected consequences.
Story.207.2.cn: 复杂的计划总会出意外。

Story.208.2.en: There's more than one set of eyes watching you in the night.
Story.208.2.cn: 夜色中盯着你们的人不止一个。

Story.209.2.en: Don't the employees of the Chalk Consortium ever sleep?
Story.209.2.cn: 白垩商会的员工难道不用睡觉吗？

Story.210.2.en: Raising the cost of your enemies is a weapon in itself.
Story.210.2.cn: 提升敌人的成本也是一种武器。

Story.211.2.en: What must be protected is the lord—and everything the lord holds dear.
Story.211.2.cn: 要守护的是主公，以及主公关心的一切。

Story.212.2.en: Rules, money, and force—Feagin doesn't know how to lose.
Story.212.2.cn: 规则、金钱和武力，菲金不知道怎么输。

Story.213.2.en: To fight a company, you must first become one.
Story.213.2.cn: 想要对抗公司，只有先成为公司。

Story.214.2.en: How do you put a price on a human soul?
Story.214.2.cn: 人类的灵魂要怎么定价？

Story.215.2.en: The war ends the moment it begins.
Story.215.2.cn: 战争在开始的那一刻就结束了。

Story.216.2.en: Victory or defeat—it's decided in the blink of an eye.

Story.217.2.en: The journey of the stars and the tower begins in earnest.
Story.217.2.cn: 星星和高塔的旅程正式开始了。

Story.301.2.cn: 了解自身，是成长的第一步。

Story.304.2.en: There's a strange "secretary" living in my phone.
Story.304.2.cn: 我的手机里住着一位奇怪的“秘书”。

Story.305.2.en: A pawn, power, destiny... The legendary Tyrant, am I?
Story.305.2.cn: 棋子、权能、未来，我真的是传说中的魔王吗？

Story.306.2.cn: 传说中的任务，适合传说中的旅人。

Story.307.1.en: The Hidden Lord in the Forest

Story.307.2.en: In tales, the greatest masters are always found in the humblest of places.
Story.307.2.cn: 故事中的高人往往隐居在不起眼的地方。

Story.308.2.en: Time for a little brain teaser.

Story.310.2.en: Fear is a ghost from the past.

Story.311.2.en: You need someone to confide in.

Story.312.2.cn: “负重训练”这个词听起来很热血。

Story.315.2.en: I won't accept defeat this time.

Story.316.2.en: There's a special "magic" hidden in everyone's heart.
Story.316.2.cn: 每个人的心中都藏着了不起的“魔法”。

Story.317.2.en: Shared laughter and tears define the bonds of friendship.
Story.317.2.cn: 一起欢笑、一起哭泣，这就是伙伴的真谛。

Story.318.2.en: Some things change, while others stay...
Story.318.2.cn: 有的东西改变了，有些则没有……

Story.401.2.en: Once again, I'm covering the retreat—but with different allies by my side.
Story.401.2.cn: 又是断后，但陪在身边的人已经不同。

Story.402.2.en: Wishes are things you make happen with your own hands.
Story.402.2.cn: 愿望只能靠自己的双手实现。

Story.403.2.en: A dream beyond, a person in front.

Story.404.2.en: Some truths, once heard, cannot be escaped.
Story.404.2.cn: 有些事，听到了就逃不开了。

Story.405.2.en: Strict adherence to a promise is not always a virtue.
Story.405.2.cn: 刻板地遵守承诺，有时并不是好事。

Story.406.2.en: Since the truth cannot be told, you shall become Nazuka's help.
Story.406.2.cn: 既然无法说出真相，那就由你来做夏花的帮手。

Story.407.2.en: As long as Nazuka's secret is kept, the promise is not broken.
Story.407.2.cn: 只要不说出夏花的秘密，就不算违背承诺。

Story.408.2.en: There is no single best tactic, only the most appropriate one.
Story.408.2.cn: 没有最好的战术，只有最适合的战术

Story.409.2.en: Muscle memory is not something you can simply forget.
Story.409.2.cn: 肌肉记忆不是想忘记就能忘记的。

Story.410.2.en: More troops always mean better odds.

Story.411.2.en: Everyone has something to protect, and what that is differs for each soul.
Story.411.2.cn: 每个人都有想保护的东西，每个人想保护的东西都不同。

Story.412.2.en: The cheapest peace requires nothing more than sacrificing but one outsider.
Story.412.2.cn: 最廉价的和平，只需献祭一名外乡人。

Story.413.1.en: A Rain That Reads the Air

Story.413.2.en: When you cannot stop the rain, you simply raise an umbrella.
Story.413.2.cn: 无法让雨停下来的时候，撑起伞就好了。

Story.414.2.en: Unexpected support arrives. The enemy is not unbreakable.
Story.414.2.cn: 支援来自令人意外的势力，敌人并非铁板一块。

Story.415.2.en: That dream was perfect in every way, yet Nazuka wanted no part of it.
Story.415.2.cn: 那场梦的一切都很美好，但夏花偏不想要。

Story.416.2.en: A true promise needs no inscription.
Story.416.2.cn: 真正的约定，无须刻印在任何地方

Story.417.2.en: Cut the grass first, then fell the tree.

Story.501.2.en: Can a stone thrown on a whim strike the heart of the truth?
Story.501.2.cn: 随手掷出的石子，能正中答案的红心吗？

Story.502.2.en: The more dazzling the throne, the deeper the shadow it casts.
Story.502.2.cn: 王座越辉煌，它投下的阴影就越浓重。

Story.503.2.en: Welcome to this gilded cage, exquisitely crafted, and utterly inescapable.
Story.503.2.cn: 欢迎光临这座精心打造、无处可逃的金丝笼。

Story.504.2.en: To seize the prize, one must brave the danger.

Story.505.2.en: Those destined for greatness do not fuss over trifles.

Story.506.2.en: The visible truth is but the tip of the iceberg.
Story.506.2.cn: 浮于水上的真相，总只有冰山一角。

Story.507.2.en: That deafening boom? Merely the fireworks of inspiration!
Story.507.2.cn: 巨响，是灵感迸发的烟火！

Story.508.2.en: Tepid water neither boils to catch the eye, nor freezes to invite scorn.
Story.508.2.cn: 温吞的水，既不沸腾引人注目，也不冰冷招人嫌弃。

Story.509.2.en: To possess untiring power is, in itself, a form of arrogance.
Story.509.2.cn: 不知疲倦的伟力，亦是一种傲慢。

Story.510.2.en: String enough coincidences together, and they become inescapable destiny.
Story.510.2.cn: 将偶然连成线，便是无处可逃的必然。

Story.511.2.en: Beware the cheese left conspicuously in the middle of the path.
Story.511.2.cn: 不要轻易触碰那些摆在路中央的奶酪。

Story.512.2.en: A gentle tug on a stray thread, and the impossible knot miraculously unravels.
Story.512.2.cn: 被轻轻拉动的线头，奇迹般地解开了死结，

Story.513.2.en: Truth is often rough and thorny, while false order is always smooth as jade.
Story.513.2.cn: 真理往往粗糙带刺，虚伪的秩序却总光滑如玉。

Story.514.2.en: Evil fears the fangs of its own kind far more than the judgment of the sun.
Story.514.2.cn: 比起正午的审判，罪恶更畏惧同类的獠牙。

Story.515.2.en: Desperation makes monsters of us all—and you are far from invincible.
Story.515.2.cn: 困兽亦可吞虎，何况你的铠甲并不坚硬。

Story.516.2.en: A single spark falls upon dry grass, igniting a glow in the silent night.
Story.516.2.cn: 火星落入了枯草，沉寂的暗夜燃起荧光。

Story.517.2.en: As you chase the light, never forget the shadow trailing at your heels.
Story.517.2.cn: 追逐光明时，别忘了阴影始终跟随身后。

Story.518.2.en: To rewrite the ending, one must first step into the eye of the storm.
Story.518.2.cn: 要改写结局，就得先踏入风暴的中心。

Story.519.2.en: As the dust settles, the moonlit ruins fall into an eerie peace.
Story.519.2.cn: 尘埃落定，月光下的废墟却是诡异的安详。

Story.601.2.en: Things are looking bad. It's time to make a quick exit!
Story.601.2.cn: 眼见气氛不妙，就赶紧撤退吧！

Story.602.2.en: Parting the tangled branches, the silhouette is the best guide.
Story.602.2.cn: 拨开纷乱的枝条，背影是最好的路标。

Story.603.2.en: The wildly flailing vine is about to strangle itself.
Story.603.2.cn: 癫狂挥舞的藤蔓，即将绞杀它的自身。

Story.604.2.en: After turning away, the rift between us seems like an abyss.
Story.604.2.cn: 转身之后的她们，裂隙仿若深渊。

Story.605.2.en:
Level the ruins, plant flowers—
And so, war never came to this place.
Story.605.2.cn:
铲平废墟，种上鲜花——
于是，这里便从未有过战争了。

Story.606.2.en: The roundabout shortcut always conveniently leads to utter ruin.
Story.606.2.cn: 迂回的捷径，总恰巧通向万劫不复。

Story.607.2.en: Once you hear the ice crack, the chance to escape has already passed.
Story.607.2.cn: 听见冰裂的声音再跑，就要来不及了。

Story.608.2.en: Beyond the lock lies the wasteland of power.
Story.608.2.cn: 锁扣之外，便是权力的荒原。

Story.609.2.en: The moth seeks the flame, only to see its truth before perishing.
Story.609.2.cn: 飞蛾扑火，是为了在灰飞烟灭前看清火的真容。

Story.610.2.en: High wall ahead? Time to remember that pole vault trick!
Story.610.2.cn: 厚壁在前，要想起来还有这招撑杆跳！

Story.611.2.en: Once the game has begun, there is no path leading back.
Story.611.2.cn: 过河之卒，既已入局，便再无回头的路。

Story.612.2.en: The prey lights the torch, burning through the hunter's net.
Story.612.2.cn: 猎物点燃了火把，烧断了猎人布下的罗网。

Story.613.2.en: A happy ending with everyone here... Truly a cause for celebration, isn't it?
Story.613.2.cn: 让所有人都抵达幸福的结局……真是可喜可贺？

Story.614.2.en: The tendrils of crisis have begun to draw upon terrifying nourishment.
Story.614.2.cn: 危机的藤蔓，已开始汲取可怖的养分。

Story.615.2.en: In the long silence, the rhythm of the heartbeat completes the confession.
Story.615.2.cn: 在漫长的沉默中，心跳的频率完成了供述。

Story.616.2.en: All hesitations and escape routes are sealed within this moment of sincerity.
Story.616.2.cn: 所有的试探和退路，都封在了此刻的真诚中。

Story.617.2.en: She's well aware that this path is not an easy one, and so...
Story.617.2.cn: 她也深知，这条道路并非坦途，因此……

Story.618.2.en: A damp fuse for your rival, and expired powder for you.
Story.618.2.cn: 对手的引线受潮未燃，而你的火药也恰巧过期。

Story.619.2.en: Beneath the gloom, only the curtain of trust can shield us from the storm.
Story.619.2.cn: 阴霾之下，唯有信任的幕帘能遮风避雨。

Story.620.2.en: The blade flashes past, her eyes bloodshot and wild, glaring with fury—
Story.620.2.cn: 剑锋划过，她的双眼充血混乱、怒目圆睁——

Story.621.2.en: She has swallowed too much of the flames of rage, and her roar abruptly ceases at that moment.
Story.621.2.cn: 她吞下了太多的怒焰，咆哮在此刻戛然而止。

Story.622.2.en: Though the flames have died down, the lingering heat beneath the ashes still burns the touch.
Story.622.2.cn: 怒火虽灭，但灰烬下的余温仍在烫手。

Story.6501.2.en: Such a small crowd? This is no fun at all.
Story.6501.2.cn: 只有这点人，不够过瘾啊。

Story.6502.2.en: The desert wind will never reach Philae.
Story.6502.2.cn: 沙漠的风，终究吹不到菲莱。

Story.6503.2.en: Finally, I get to meet you face-to-face.

Story.6504.2.en: Dusk is the hour when one's mind can easily drift into a daze.
Story.6504.2.cn: 黄昏是人一天中最容易恍惚的时刻。

Story.6506.2.en: Memories of the past do not linger fondly.

Story.6507.2.en: Can you truly believe what you see?

Story.6508.2.en: Let me be a weirdo who honors every promise.
Story.6508.2.cn: 就让我做个遵守约定的怪人吧。

Story.6509.2.en: It's not just the identity that has changed.

Story.6510.2.en: Make the world a different place.
Story.6510.2.cn: 让世界变成另外的样子吧。

Story.6511.2.en: No matter where you are, I wish you a wonderful night.
Story.6511.2.cn: 无论你身在何方，都祝你度过一个愉快的夜晚。

Story.6512.2.en: It solidified into golden specimens, alongside a vanished dream.
Story.6512.2.cn: 凝固成金黄的标本，连同消逝的梦。

Story.802.2.en: Focus on the threat at hand. Time is running out.
Story.802.2.cn: 要紧眼前事，时间不等人。

Story.803.2.en: An ancient, slumbering god wakes without warning.
Story.803.2.cn: 旧日沉睡的神明，在意外中苏醒。

Story.804.2.en: Even the filthiest scandal can serve as a stepping stone to the top.
Story.804.2.cn: 声名狼藉的污泥，也能被筑成通向高处的台阶。

Story.805.2.en: Time is a slow, silent mutation.
Story.805.2.cn: 时间是一场漫长而隐秘的变异。

Story.806.2.en: A storm is breaking, and every card is on the table.
Story.806.2.cn: 风暴将至，底牌于此刻叠为同摞。

Story.807.2.en: Every hidden agenda is finally laid out on the table.
Story.807.2.cn: 各怀心思的筹码，皆已明牌亮于台上。

Story.808.2.en: Let reason be your final fuel. Then set it ablaze!
Story.808.2.cn: 把理智当做最后的燃料，然后……点火吧！

Story.809.2.en: A single crack is all it takes for the floodwaters to rush in.
Story.809.2.cn: 片丝的疏忽，也足够让致命的洪流倒灌。

Story.810.2.en: From a dead leaf, a new sprout breaks through.
Story.810.2.cn: 坠灭的枯叶，抽出了新芽。

Story.811.2.en: Run all you want—you can't shake the shadow snapping at your heels.
Story.811.2.cn: 再怎么逃，也甩不掉咬在脚跟的阴影。

Story.812.2.en: A rigged game with no way to balance the books.
Story.812.2.cn: 这注定是无法平账的死局。

Story.813.2.en: You've only ever scratched the surface.
Story.813.2.cn: 你摸到的仅仅是最表层的截面。

Story.814.2.en: Cowardice locks the soul away, but hope doesn't set you free either.
Story.814.2.cn: 懦怯确实囚禁了灵魂，但希望没能还你自由。

Story.815.2.en: A voice calls out that familiar greeting.

Story.816.2.en: Through the fog of chaos, she's still your anchor.
Story.816.2.cn: 充满变数的迷雾里，她依旧令人心安。

Story.817.2.en: You can never have too many friends.

Story.818.2.en: At long last, she shares this sky with you.
Story.818.2.cn: 终于，她和你共赏这片天空了。

Story.819.2.en: You have to take things one bite at a time.

Story.820.2.en: The water keeps rising. Time to pick up the pace.
Story.820.2.cn: 水面还在不断上涨，得加紧步伐了。

Story.822.2.en: Don't overthink it. This is strictly business.
Story.822.2.cn: 别多想，这只是一场公平、清醒的交易。

Story.823.2.en: Even when it seems all hope is lost, a single spark can start a wildfire.
Story.823.2.cn: 尽管被釜底抽薪，但星星之火也能燎原。

Story.824.2.en: Are you trying to be the Armless Saint too?
Story.824.2.cn: 你也要当“断臂的英雄”吗？

Story.825.2.en: She asks, you answer, and then...
Story.825.2.cn: 她在提问，你在回答，然后……

Story.901.2.en: Do I even need a reason to wipe you out?
Story.901.2.cn: 让你消失……难道还需要理由？

Story.902.2.en: A successful retreat takes just as much guts and strategy as an attack.
Story.902.2.cn: 撤退也需要勇气和战术。

Story.903.2.en: I draw this scepter for one reason: to uncover your true motives.
Story.903.2.cn: 拔出这权杖，只为确认你的真意。

Story.904.2.en: The hazier your past gets, the heavier this question weighs on you.
Story.904.2.cn: 过去越模糊，这个问题就越沉重。

Story.905.2.en: Whether you're actually the "bad guy" hardly matters right now. You just need to get the "good guys" on your side.
Story.905.2.cn: 你是不是“坏人”不重要，但总之得先拉拢“好人”。

Story.906.2.en: One isn't enough to pull this off, but two is just right.
Story.906.2.cn: 一个人不够，两个人刚好。

Story.907.2.en: Out here, a path you walked just yesterday could completely vanish by tomorrow.
Story.907.2.cn: 即使刚走过的路，隔天或许就再也找不到了。

Story.908.2.en: All the reading in the world and there are still questions left unanswered.
Story.908.2.cn: 书读得再多，也有答不上的问题。

Story.909.2.en: How much support does it take to keep a single dream alive?
Story.909.2.cn: 一个梦想，需要多少支撑呢？

Story.910.2.en: The "best" choice on paper isn't always the right one for you.
Story.910.2.cn: 最好的选择，未必是最正确的答案。

Story.911.2.en: Some folks prefer to let their fists do the talking.
Story.911.2.cn: 总有人急着用拳头代替问候。

Story.912.1.en: The Good, the Bad and the Jester

Story.912.2.en: If everyone sees themselves as the "good guy"... Then who gets to decide?
Story.912.2.cn: 都觉得自己是“好人”的话……那谁说了算？

Story.913.2.en: Unwritten rules? That's just mutual understanding.
Story.913.2.cn: 不写在纸上的规矩，叫做默契。

Story.914.2.en: You search far and wide, only to find her right where you least expect...
Story.914.2.cn: 众里寻他千百度，那人却在……

Story.915.2.en: Finally, a chance to catch your breath.
Story.915.2.cn: 终于有机会，好好喘一口气。

Story.916.2.en: Swords, guns, clubs—it's all just business!
Story.916.2.cn: 什么刀枪棍棒的——都是生意！

Story.917.2.en: The enemy of my enemy is my friend... Right?
Story.917.2.cn: 敌人的敌人就是朋友……吗？

Story.918.2.en: All the puzzle pieces are here, except the one that connects them.
Story.918.2.cn: 谜团拼在了一起，缺的是同一块。

Story.919.2.en: Just give the fulcrum a little push...
Story.919.2.cn: 只需要小小的撬动这个支点……

Story.920.2.en: A familiar blur—like her, but not.
Story.920.2.cn: 那模糊的身影，似是，又非。

Story.921.2.cn: 这是不惜用遗忘换来的守护。

Story.922.2.en: Time to bury your past self.

Story.923.2.en: Enough lies... What we need is truth and trust.
Story.923.2.cn: 谎言太多……而现在需要的，是真相与信任。

Story.924.2.en: "They do call me that, yeah... But I think you're the real one."
Story.924.2.cn: “你知道他们确实这样叫我……但我想你才是。 ”

Story.925.2.cn: 古老的问题，只能用古老的方式来回答。

Story.926.2.en: Long gone, yet standing right here.
Story.926.2.cn: 她已消失不见，而她此刻已至。

Story.927.2.en: You miss out on what you want, only to get stuck with what you don't.
Story.927.2.cn: 得不到你想要的，得到了你不想要的。

Story.928.2.cn: 永远不要与战争有任何瓜葛。

StoryEvidence.102.2.en: Leave it to someone with more experience
StoryEvidence.102.2.cn: 交给经验更丰富的人吧

StoryEvidence.201.2.en: The best plan is having no plan
StoryEvidence.201.2.cn: 没有计划的计划就是好计划

StoryEvidence.202.2.en: Those who plan more will reign victorious
StoryEvidence.202.2.cn: 有算胜无算，多算胜少算

StoryEvidence.203.1.en: Hide in crates to get inside

StoryEvidence.203.2.en: The enemies never bother to check the boxes
StoryEvidence.203.2.cn: 敌人从来不会检查箱子

StoryEvidence.301.2.en: Since it's a pain in the heart, it must be resolved from within.
StoryEvidence.301.2.cn: 既然是心病，还得从心中解。

StoryEvidence.302.2.en: "Habit is second nature," and what you lack is precisely the experience of cooperation.
StoryEvidence.302.2.cn: 正所谓“习惯成自然”，现在的你欠缺的正是合作的经验。

StoryEvidence.303.2.en: Stubborn illnesses require strong medicine. I must prepare some "special" methods.
StoryEvidence.303.2.cn: “顽疾需用猛药”。关于你的情况，我得准备一些“特别”的手段。

StoryEvidence.402.2.en: I'll keep her secret, but I have to protect her.
StoryEvidence.402.2.cn: 保守秘密，也要保护夏花

StoryEvidence.403.2.en: This isn't something that can be determined using logic alone.
StoryEvidence.403.2.cn: 这不是理性思考的时候

StoryEvidence.405.1.en: Let Petal Bloom fight with Nazuka
StoryEvidence.405.1.cn: 花令旅团和夏花并肩作战

StoryEvidence.405.2.cn: 夏花和花令的配合也很默契

TowerDefenseMonster.8069904.1.cn: 【普通】经过强化的快速星骸，可别小看它们。

TowerDefenseMonster.8070201.1.en: [Elite] Increases Weight when planting its hands into the ground. Fierce attacks can interrupt this state.
TowerDefenseMonster.8070201.1.cn: 【精英】双手插入大地时重量增加，猛烈的进攻可以打断。

TowerDefenseMonster.8070401.1.en: [Elite] Creates a heated zone around itself, causing the Heat effect to build up faster.
TowerDefenseMonster.8070401.1.cn: 【精英】在自身周围生成炎热领域，加速炎热效果累积。

TowerDefenseMonster.8070402.1.en: [Elite] Shoots a fireball. Upon hit, increases Heat and sets the deployment slots ablaze.
TowerDefenseMonster.8070402.1.cn: 【精英】发射火球，命中后增加炎热值并使部署位着火。

TowerDefenseMonster.8079901.1.en: [Elite] Steps are slow and steady. High Durability.
TowerDefenseMonster.8079901.1.cn: 【精英】步伐缓慢而沉稳，耐久度很高。

TowerDefenseMonster.8079902.1.en: [Elite] Keeps speeding up while rolling. Resets after being inflicted with a control effect.
TowerDefenseMonster.8079902.1.cn: 【精英】翻滚途中不停加速，一旦受到控制就会恢复原状。

TowerDefenseMonster.8079903.1.en: [Elite] Increases Weight when planting its hands into the ground. Fierce attacks can interrupt this state.
TowerDefenseMonster.8079903.1.cn: 【精英】双手插入大地时重量增加，猛烈的进攻可以打断。

TowerDefenseMonster.8079904.1.en: [Elite] Buries tentacles in the ground, creating 1 Brush tile after a short delay.
TowerDefenseMonster.8079904.1.cn: 【精英】触手插入大地，延迟后生成一格草丛。

TowerDefenseMonster.8080401.1.en: [Boss] Calls down heavenly fire on deployment slots and periodically summons full‑screen flame waves.
TowerDefenseMonster.8080401.1.cn: 【首领】向部署位降下天火，并且每隔一段时间召唤全屏焰浪。

TowerDefenseMonster.8080402.1.en: [Boss] Calls down heavenly fire on deployment slots and periodically summons full‑screen flame waves.
TowerDefenseMonster.8080402.1.cn: 【首领】向部署位降下天火，并且每隔一段时间召唤全屏焰浪。

TowerDefenseMonster.8080403.1.en: [Boss] Calls down heavenly fire on deployment slots and periodically summons full‑screen flame waves.
TowerDefenseMonster.8080403.1.cn: 【首领】向部署位降下天火，并且每隔一段时间召唤全屏焰浪。

TowerDefenseMonster.8089901.1.en: [Boss] Grants a speed boost to all nearby allies. Must be eliminated first.
TowerDefenseMonster.8089901.1.cn: 【首领】会给周围所有队友施加加速效果，需要优先消灭。

TowerDefenseMonster.8089902.1.en: [Boss] Spreads mud that slows all squadmates and grants DMG Boost or DMG RES based on Weight.
TowerDefenseMonster.8089902.1.cn: 【首领】泥泞区域为队友附加减速、重量增加与减伤效果。

TowerDefenseMonster.8089903.1.en: [Boss] Waves a staff, spawning Brush across an area after a short delay.
TowerDefenseMonster.8089903.1.cn: 【首领】挥动法杖，延迟后使一片区域生成草丛。

TowerDefensePotential.1030101.2.en: Increases ATK gradually while casting Auto Attacks. Resets upon dealing the Skill.
TowerDefensePotential.1030101.2.cn: 普通攻击期间，攻击力逐渐提升，释放技能时重置。

TowerDefensePotential.1030102.2.en: When casting a skill, every target killed charges the skill, up to 50%.
TowerDefensePotential.1030102.2.cn: 释放技能时，每消灭一个目标都会为技能进行充能，最多充能50%。

TowerDefensePotential.1030103.2.en: After casting a skill, Auto Attacks become AoE Attacks for a period of time.
TowerDefensePotential.1030103.2.cn: 释放技能后，普通攻击强化为范围攻击，持续一段时间。

TowerDefensePotential.1030104.2.en: When casting a skill, generates a phantom of Amber that spins and shoots at the target's location.
TowerDefensePotential.1030104.2.cn: 释放技能时，会在目标位置生成琥珀的幻影并进行旋转射击。

TowerDefensePotential.1070101.2.en: After casting a skill, enhances Tilia's Auto Attacks for a period of time.
TowerDefensePotential.1070101.2.cn: 施放技能后，缇莉娅普攻获得强化，持续一段时间。

TowerDefensePotential.1070102.2.en: Aegis of Light stuns the target upon hit.
TowerDefensePotential.1070102.2.cn: 「圣光之盾」在命中时眩晕目标。

TowerDefensePotential.1070103.2.en: Upon casting the skill, creates a sphere for a period of time. Targets inside the sphere continuously take DMG over time and are inflicted with Vulnerability.
TowerDefensePotential.1070103.2.cn: 施放技能时生成结界，持续一段时间。结界内的目标持续受到伤害，并附加易伤效果。

TowerDefensePotential.1070104.2.en: Throws Aegis of Light at up to 5 targets simultaneously.
TowerDefensePotential.1070104.2.cn: 技能对最多5个目标同时掷出「圣光之盾」。

TowerDefensePotential.1100102.2.en: Reduces the duration of clones but significantly increases ATK.
TowerDefensePotential.1100102.2.cn: 「分身」的持续时间减少，攻击力大幅度提升。

TowerDefensePotential.1100103.2.en: Summons an extra clone on the field every few seconds.
TowerDefensePotential.1100103.2.cn: 每隔数秒在场上召唤一个额外的「分身」。

TowerDefensePotential.1100104.2.en: When a clone vanishes, it deals Self-Destruct DMG in a small area.
TowerDefensePotential.1100104.2.cn: 「分身」消失时，造成小范围自爆伤害。

TowerDefensePotential.1110101.2.en: Increases the attack frequency and Skill DMG of Glacier Array.
TowerDefensePotential.1110101.2.cn: 「冰柱阵列」的打击频率提升，总伤害增加。

TowerDefensePotential.1110102.2.en: Increases the max stack limit of the slowing effect of Glacier Array. Upon reaching the max stack limit, freezes the target.
TowerDefensePotential.1110102.2.cn: 「冰柱阵列」的减速叠加上限提升，到达上限层数后将目标冰冻。

TowerDefensePotential.1110103.2.en: Increases the range of Glacier Array.

TowerDefensePotential.1110104.2.en: When casting Glacier Array, delivers an iceberg strike that deals additional DMG and stuns the target.
TowerDefensePotential.1110104.2.cn: 释放「冰柱阵列」时，产生一次冰山打击，造成额外伤害与眩晕。

TowerDefensePotential.1120101.2.en: When casting a skill, unleashes sword auras that pierce through the enemy.
TowerDefensePotential.1120101.2.cn: 释放技能时，附加贯穿敌人的剑气。

TowerDefensePotential.1120102.2.en: When dealing DMG with Auto Attacks, there is a chance to unleash multiple sword auras at the target's location. This effect can only be triggered once every 5s.
TowerDefensePotential.1120102.2.cn: 普通攻击造成伤害时，有概率在目标处施放多重剑气。该效果每5秒最多触发1次。

TowerDefensePotential.1120103.2.en: Adds a second phase: Devastating Wind.

TowerDefensePotential.1120104.2.en: Adds a second phase: Dragon Slash.

TowerDefensePotential.1140101.2.en: Fires 2 consecutive lasers in the current direction.
TowerDefensePotential.1140101.2.cn: 技能会向当前方向连续释放2次激光。

TowerDefensePotential.1140102.2.en: After every 12 Auto Attacks, throws 2 Rebound Bombs at random targets within range.
TowerDefensePotential.1140102.2.cn: 每12次普攻会向范围内随机目标丢出2颗「弹跳炸弹」。

TowerDefensePotential.1140103.2.en: Marked targets take increased DMG from Chaton's attacks. When the laser hits a marked target again, it refreshes the Mark's duration and enhances its effect.
TowerDefensePotential.1140103.2.cn: 带有「标记」的目标受到猫眼所有伤害提升。再次被激光命中时，刷新「标记」时间并强化其效果。

TowerDefensePotential.1140104.2.en: For a short duration after casting the skill, Auto Attacks enter rapid-fire mode.
TowerDefensePotential.1140104.2.cn: 释放技能后的一段时间内，普攻变为高速连射模式。

TowerDefensePotential.1180101.2.en: The skill has a stronger pull effect, increasing the DMG dealt from breaking the chains.
TowerDefensePotential.1180101.2.cn: 技能具有更强的拉动效果，扯断锁链的伤害提升。

TowerDefensePotential.1180102.2.en: Increases the skill's targeting range. A Shadow Scythe is thrown with the horizontal sweep, and the first few enemies hit will also be chained and pulled back.
TowerDefensePotential.1180102.2.cn: 技能索敌范围提升，横斩时额外投掷一把暗影飞镰，被命中的前数名敌人也会被挂上锁链并拉回。

TowerDefensePotential.1180103.2.en: When the skill's chains bind 3 or fewer targets, performs one powerful horizontal slash and inflicts prolonged Vulnerability on them.
TowerDefensePotential.1180103.2.cn: 当技能的锁链连接3名及以下目标时，会额外进行大力横斩，并对目标额外附加长时间的易伤效果。

TowerDefensePotential.1180104.2.en: When the skill's chains bind 3 or more targets, significantly increasing the DMG dealt from breaking the chains.
TowerDefensePotential.1180104.2.cn: 当技能的锁链连接3名及以上目标时，扯断锁链的伤害大幅度提升。

TowerDefensePotential.1230101.2.en: Ann's third Auto Attack can also trigger Wind Burst.
TowerDefensePotential.1230101.2.cn: 杏子的第3段普通攻击也可以引发「风爆」。

TowerDefensePotential.1230102.2.en: Increases the ATK SPD of Bubble.

TowerDefensePotential.1230103.2.en: Increases the effectiveness of Wind Burst's Weight Reduction and its duration.
TowerDefensePotential.1230103.2.cn: 「风爆」施加的减重效果更有效，持续时长增加。

TowerDefensePotential.1230104.2.en: Bubble fires lasers as Auto Attacks, knocking back targets and inflicting Weight Reduction on them.
TowerDefensePotential.1230104.2.cn: 「泡泡」的普通攻击改为发射激光，击飞所有命中的目标并附加减重效果。

TowerDefensePotential.1260101.2.en: Each Mindflare Butterfly additionally increases the charge speed of friendly units' skills.
TowerDefensePotential.1260101.2.cn: 每只「沐蝶」都会额外提升友方技能充能速度。

TowerDefensePotential.1260102.2.en: When a target with Butterfly Mark takes DMG, there is a chance to spawn an additional Soulflare Butterfly that attacks other targets.
TowerDefensePotential.1260102.2.cn: 带有「蝶之印」的目标受到伤害时，有概率生成额外「炎蝶」攻击其他目标。

TowerDefensePotential.1260103.2.en: The skill spawns 2 additional Mindflare Butterflies.

TowerDefensePotential.1260104.2.en: The skill spawns 2 additional Soulflare Butterflies.

TowerDefensePotential.1270101.2.en: Additional effect of Tidal Domain: increases the ATK SPD of squadmates within the Tidal Domain.
TowerDefensePotential.1270101.2.cn: 「浪域」追加效果：处于「浪域」内的队友攻速提升。

TowerDefensePotential.1270102.2.en: Additional effect of Tidal Domain: When a squadmate within the Tidal Domain deals DMG, there is a chance to generate a fountain at the target's location that deals DMG and a slight knockback. This effect can only be triggered once every 3s.
TowerDefensePotential.1270102.2.cn: 「浪域」追加效果：处于「浪域」内的队友造成伤害时，一定概率在目标处产生喷泉造成伤害与小力度的击飞。该效果每3秒最多触发1次。

TowerDefensePotential.1270103.2.en: Increases the duration of Tidal Domain.

TowerDefensePotential.1270104.2.en: Additional effect of Tidal Domain: increases the range and DMG of Teresa's waves, knocking back targets slightly.
TowerDefensePotential.1270104.2.cn: 「浪域」追加效果：特丽莎施放的波浪的攻击范围与伤害增加，并造成小力度的击退。

TowerDefensePotential.1300101.2.en: After casting the skill, permanently gains 1 stack of Agile: Increases Donna's ATK SPD and allows her to fire additional ice arrows, stacking up to 4 times.
TowerDefensePotential.1300101.2.cn: 施放技能后永久获得1层「灵巧」：使多娜攻击速度提升且射击时额外射出冰箭，最多获得4层。

TowerDefensePotential.1300102.2.en: Increases the Advertising Doll's attack frequency. When the Advertising Doll is present, increases Donna's ATK.
TowerDefensePotential.1300102.2.cn: 「宣传人偶」的攻击频率加快，且「宣传人偶」存在期间使多娜攻击力提升。

TowerDefensePotential.1300103.2.en: After casting a skill, enhances Donna's Auto Attacks for a period of time.
TowerDefensePotential.1300103.2.cn: 施放技能后多娜普攻获得强化，持续一段时间。

TowerDefensePotential.1300104.2.en: The Advertising Doll can briefly control targets with its attacks. It deals additional DMG upon leaving the battlefield.
TowerDefensePotential.1300104.2.cn: 「宣传人偶」的攻击能短暂控制目标，且在离场时额外造成伤害。

TowerDefensePotential.1330101.2.en: The skill has a stronger push effect and deals increased DMG.
TowerDefensePotential.1330101.2.cn: 技能具有更强的推动效果，伤害提升。

TowerDefensePotential.1330102.2.en: The skill deals damage while inflicting Vulnerability.
TowerDefensePotential.1330102.2.cn: 技能在造成伤害的同时附加易伤效果。

TowerDefensePotential.1330104.2.en: Significantly increases the skill's attack range.
TowerDefensePotential.1330104.2.cn: 技能的攻击范围大幅度提升。

TowerDefensePotential.1340101.2.en: When casting a skill, becomes encircled by fire, dealing DMG over time.
TowerDefensePotential.1340101.2.cn: 释放技能时，自身被火环笼罩，造成持续伤害。

TowerDefensePotential.1340102.2.en: After casting a skill, increases ATK SPD for a period of time.
TowerDefensePotential.1340102.2.cn: 释放技能后，一段时间内攻击速度提升。

TowerDefensePotential.1340103.2.en: Increases the skill's punches to 9 times.
TowerDefensePotential.1340103.2.cn: 技能的挥拳次数提升到9次。

TowerDefensePotential.1340104.2.en: Accumulates "Paw Prints" every time an Auto Attack deals damage. When casting a skill, increases its Skill DMG according to the number of stacks of "Paw Prints" and consumes them all.
TowerDefensePotential.1340104.2.cn: 普通攻击每次造成伤害时累积「猫爪」，施放技能时，根据「猫爪」叠加层数，提升此次技能伤害，并消耗所有「猫爪」。

TowerDefensePotential.1350101.2.en: Increases the DMG and size of the Lanterna Phantoms summoned by the same magic circle over time.
TowerDefensePotential.1350101.2.cn: 同一法阵中召唤的「提灯影灵」伤害和体型逐渐提升。

TowerDefensePotential.1350102.2.en: The magic circle deals DMG to targets inside it and can slowly track them.
TowerDefensePotential.1350102.2.cn: 法阵会对内部目标造成伤害，并可缓慢追踪目标。

TowerDefensePotential.1350103.2.en: Reduces the intervals between magic circle's each summon of a Lanterna Phantom.
TowerDefensePotential.1350103.2.cn: 法阵召唤「提灯影灵」的间隔缩短。

TowerDefensePotential.1350104.2.en: The magic circle expands, slowly pulling weak targets toward its center.
TowerDefensePotential.1350104.2.cn: 法阵范围增大，且可向中心缓慢牵引弱小目标。

TowerDefensePotential.1400101.2.en: Performs a quick burst of shots periodically in Rapid-Fire Cannon mode.
TowerDefensePotential.1400101.2.cn: 「速射炮」形态下，每隔一段时间便会进行一次快速连射。

TowerDefensePotential.1400102.2.en: Switches to Tank mode, reducing Fire Rate but firing shells to deal DMG in a large area on hit.
TowerDefensePotential.1400102.2.cn: 技能变为进入「坦克」形态，射速降低，但会发射炮弹造成大范围伤害。

TowerDefensePotential.1400103.2.en: While transformed, inflicts Crystal Attachment on the attacked target. At certain stacks, the target is briefly stunned and takes additional DMG when hit by Sparkla's attacks.
TowerDefensePotential.1400103.2.cn: 变形状态下攻击对目标附加「晶体附着」，累积一定层数后使其短暂眩晕，并在受到斯帕克拉攻击时额外附加伤害。

TowerDefensePotential.1400104.2.en: In Tank mode, each shot also releases a fan-shaped burst of energy forward, dealing DMG and knocking back targets.
TowerDefensePotential.1400104.2.cn: 「坦克」状态下，每次射击时还会对前方释放扇形能量，造成伤害并推动目标。

TowerDefensePotential.1410101.2.en: After casting a skill, increases Chixia's ATK for a period of time.
TowerDefensePotential.1410101.2.cn: 施放技能后赤霞攻击力提升，持续一段时间。

TowerDefensePotential.1410103.2.en: After casting a skill, Chixia gains 3 stacks of Heat. Enhances Chixia's Auto Attacks, consuming 1 stack per attack.
TowerDefensePotential.1410103.2.cn: 施放技能后赤霞获得3层热量，赤霞普攻获得强化每次消耗1层热量。

TowerDefensePotential.1410104.2.en: Increases the duration of the skill. The skill inflicts Ignite on the target when dealing DMG.
TowerDefensePotential.1410104.2.cn: 技能持续时间增加，且技能对目标造成伤害时引燃目标。

TowerDefensePotential.1430101.2.en: When casting the skill, generates a small cyclone: deals AoE DMG over time.
TowerDefensePotential.1430101.2.cn: 施放技能时生成「小旋风」：持续造成范围伤害。

TowerDefensePotential.1430102.2.en: The skill's bullets become laser ones.
TowerDefensePotential.1430102.2.cn: 技能的子弹变为激光弹。

TowerDefensePotential.1430103.2.en: Increases the number of bullets fired during the skill by 4. When casting the skill, significantly increases Wraith's ATK for a period of time.
TowerDefensePotential.1430103.2.cn: 技能的子弹数量增加4发。施放技能时风影攻击力大幅提升，持续一段时间。

TowerDefensePotential.1430104.2.en: The skill can be cast multiple times.

TowerDefensePotential.1560101.2.en: Increases the penguin plushie's Explosion DMG. When the penguin plushie stops, it pounces on the target.
TowerDefensePotential.1560101.2.cn: 企鹅玩偶自爆伤害提升，在移动结束时会尝试扑向目标。

TowerDefensePotential.1560102.2.en: Upon exploding, the penguin plushie inflicts Vulnerability on the target.
TowerDefensePotential.1560102.2.cn: 企鹅玩偶自爆时会对目标附加易伤效果。

TowerDefensePotential.1560103.2.en: Increases the penguin plushie's size and Explosion DMG. Enhances the Vulnerability effect it inflicts.
TowerDefensePotential.1560103.2.cn: 企鹅玩偶的体积与自爆伤害提升，附加的易伤效果强化。

TowerDefensePotential.1560104.2.en: The penguin plushie dances longer on the battlefield, dealing DMG over time to targets around it and inflicting Vulnerability.
TowerDefensePotential.1560104.2.cn: 企鹅玩偶在场上进行持续时间更久的热舞，对周围造成持续性的伤害并附加易伤效果。

TraceHuntLogEntryTemplate.53.1.en: Target Hunted by a Natural Predator
TraceHuntLogEntryTemplate.53.1.cn: 目标被闯入的天敌讨伐

Target Location Confirmed.
Finish the Hunt Before Time Runs Out.
TraceHuntLogEntryTemplate.9.1.cn: 已锁定目标位置，开启讨伐后，请在规定时间内完成讨伐

TravelerDuelBossLevel.100100.2.en: In the bizarre yet exciting digital worlds, she reigns supreme as the invincible Boss.
TravelerDuelBossLevel.100100.2.cn: 在光怪陆离的虚幻世界里，她才是那个高高在上，天下无敌的混世魔王。

TravelerDuelBossLevel.200100.2.en: Those who are lost in the past do not fear death. As the ninja sword grazes your throat, all she seeks is the warmth of your touch.
TravelerDuelBossLevel.200100.2.cn: 彷徨之人从不畏惧毁灭，利刃贴近喉管的那一刻，她只是想感受你的体温。

TravelerDuelBossLevel.300100.2.en:
Yearning for true friendship while wielding a weapon of destruction—that's the path Firefly has chosen.
Anyone she defeats, and anyone who defeats her, is bound to become her great friend. It's a deal then, yes?
TravelerDuelBossLevel.300100.2.cn:
一边渴望真正的朋友，一边举起杀戮的武器，这便是火垂的选择。
她打赢的人，以及打赢她的人，都要成为她的挚友。就这么.......约好了。

TravelerDuelChallengeAffix.100.2.en: Fire multiple rapid shots at the target
TravelerDuelChallengeAffix.100.2.cn: 对目标发起多段连射攻击

TravelerDuelChallengeAffix.100201.2.en: Sunflower Dance enhanced: The shuriken Nanoha hurls is attached to a string. After a brief delay, she pulls the player toward her.
TravelerDuelChallengeAffix.100201.2.cn: 强化「葵幻舞」，花原投掷的手里剑会连带丝线，在间隔后朝目标位置牵引。

TravelerDuelChallengeAffix.100202.2.en: Shrouded Moon enhanced: When Nanoha dashes, generates shurikens randomly on the battlefield.
TravelerDuelChallengeAffix.100202.2.cn: 强化「隐月」，花原在冲刺过程中，会在场地内随机生成手里剑。

TravelerDuelChallengeAffix.100203.2.en: Shrouded Moon enhanced: When Nanoha dashes, continuously summons clones to launch coordinated attacks.
TravelerDuelChallengeAffix.100203.2.cn: 强化「隐月」，花原在冲刺过程中，会持续发动影分身协同攻击。

TravelerDuelChallengeAffix.100204.2.en: Scattered Gale enhanced: The kunai Nanoha throws is attached to a string. Nanoha retracts the kunai thrown.
TravelerDuelChallengeAffix.100204.2.cn: 强化「岚散落」，花原投掷的苦无会连带丝线，在投掷后收回。

TravelerDuelChallengeAffix.100205.2.en: Shadow Dance: Leaf Barrier enhanced: Nanoha's clones will dash like her in Shrouded Moon, dealing DMG along their paths.
TravelerDuelChallengeAffix.100205.2.cn: 强化「影舞·障叶」，花原发动的分身之间会如同「隐月」一样冲刺并沿路径造成伤害。

TravelerDuelChallengeAffix.100206.2.en: Shadow Dance: Wither enhanced: Nanoha summons more clones to launch coordinated attacks.
TravelerDuelChallengeAffix.100206.2.cn: 强化「影舞·花凋」，花原会发动更多的分身协同攻击。

TravelerDuelChallengeAffix.101.2.en: Shoot beam energy rounds at the target
TravelerDuelChallengeAffix.101.2.cn: 对目标发射光束能量弹

TravelerDuelChallengeAffix.102.2.en: Unleashes the sealed Power of the Demon Lord in the right eye, and fires a barrage of destruction from the air, dealing continuous Ignis DMG
TravelerDuelChallengeAffix.102.2.cn: 解封右眼内的魔神之力，从高空投射弹幕扫荡地面，不断造成火系伤害

TravelerDuelChallengeAffix.103.2.en: Attack the target while continuing to aim
TravelerDuelChallengeAffix.103.2.cn: 对目标持续瞄准同时攻击

TravelerDuelChallengeAffix.110.2.en: Enhanced Assault Form: The multiple rapid shots now fire more bullets
TravelerDuelChallengeAffix.110.2.cn: 强化突击形态：多段连射会发射更多的子弹

TravelerDuelChallengeAffix.111.2.en: Enhanced Sniper Form: Transforms oblivion rounds into more powerful beam energy rounds.
TravelerDuelChallengeAffix.111.2.cn: 强化狙击形态：将鬼灭弹增幅为更强大的光束能量弹

TravelerDuelChallengeAffix.112.2.en: Enhanced Assault Form: Additional attack from the power of the Eye of the Demon Lord
TravelerDuelChallengeAffix.112.2.cn: 强化突击形态：追加附带魔神之眼力量的复合攻击

TravelerDuelChallengeAffix.113.2.en: Enhanced Sniper Form: Additional beam during the aimed attack. Additional explosion attack when the beam ends
TravelerDuelChallengeAffix.113.2.cn: 强化狙击形态：新增光束持续瞄准攻击，并在光束结束时追加爆发攻击

TravelerDuelChallengeAffix.114.2.en: Enhanced Assault Form: The Eye of the Demon Lord unleashes large numbers of magic bolts
TravelerDuelChallengeAffix.114.2.cn: 强化突击形态：魔神之眼向外倾泄巨量魔法弹

TravelerDuelChallengeAffix.115.2.en: Enhanced Eye of the Demon Lord: Extended tracking time with greater threat

UIText.Guide_101_2.1.en:
In addition to Core Potentials, you can obtain Common Potentials of varying quality during Ascension.
These Potentials grant additional skill effects, stat boosts, or other enhancements, and can be upgraded multiple times.
UIText.Guide_101_2.1.cn:
除了核心潜能外，星塔探索中还会获取其他不同品阶的普通潜能。
这些潜能可以增强或追加特定的技能效果，或产生数值或其他机制的加成。潜能本身还可多次升级。

UIText.Guide_102_2.1.en:
During the Ascension, you will get Core Potentials first.
Different combinations of Core Potentials correspond to various skill changes and combat builds.
UIText.Guide_102_2.1.cn:
星塔探索中，首先会获取核心潜能。
核心潜能的组合，对应着多种技能变化与战斗流派。

UIText.Guide_102_3.1.en: Select this button to view potential details and toggle between [Brief] and [Detailed] descriptions.
UIText.Guide_102_3.1.cn: 想要更进一步了解潜能的详情时，可点按此按钮，切换显示“简洁”或“详细”的潜能描述。

UIText.Guide_104_1.1.en:
You have unlocked Memory Snapshots for Trekkers.
Memory Snapshots can be set as your main screen. Select here to return to the home screen.
UIText.Guide_104_1.1.cn:
已解锁旅人的回忆特写。
回忆特写可配置为首页画面，点按此处回到首页。

UIText.Guide_104_2.1.en:
You can select any of your recruited Trekkers and set their Memory Snapshot as your main screen.
A sign will be shown for Trekkers with Memory Snapshots unlocked.
UIText.Guide_104_2.1.cn:
可选择任意一名已招募的旅人，设置为首页画面。
如已解锁了该旅人的回忆特写，将显示标识。

UIText.Guide_104_3.1.en:
Select here to toggle display mode:
Illustration mode: Display the chosen Trekker's Illustration.
Memory Snapshot mode: Display the chosen Trekker's Memory Snapshot.
UIText.Guide_104_3.1.cn:
点按此处，即可切换展示模式：
立绘模式——展示当前选择的旅人形象立绘。
回忆特写模式——展示当前选择旅人的回忆特写。

UIText.Guide_104_4.1.en:
You can set up to five different main screen images for Trekkers, Discs, and Stories. Swipe to switch between them.
You can drag the icon to change their order.
UIText.Guide_104_4.1.cn:
包括旅人形象、秘纹图片和故事CG在内，总共可设置五个不同的首页画面，可通过滑动切换；
拖动图标，可调整看板的顺序

UIText.Guide_105_1.1.en: During a battle, you can select the button to turn auto-battle on or off at any time.
UIText.Guide_105_1.1.cn: 战斗过程中，可随时通过按钮开关自动战斗

UIText.Guide_106_1.1.en:
And this is... the convenience store!
Finally, you can take some rest here and spend the Stella Coins you collected along the way.
UIText.Guide_106_1.1.cn:
这里是……便利店！
总算可以歇脚了，正好一路上搜集了不少星辉币。

UIText.Guide_106_2.1.en: Use Stella Coins at the Monolith Convenience Store to buy items that boost your squad's power. Talk to the shop assistant to see what's available.
UIText.Guide_106_2.1.cn: 星辉币可以用来在星塔的便利店里购买道具，增强队伍实力。问问店员小姐，看看有什么存货吧？

UIText.Guide_10_1.1.en: Select the portrait to view Trekker details.
UIText.Guide_10_1.1.cn: 点击头像，即可查看该旅人的详细情报。

UIText.Guide_10_2.1.en: Select [Upgrade] to increase Trekker base level.
UIText.Guide_10_2.1.cn: 点按培养，提升旅人的基础等级。

UIText.Guide_10_3.1.en: The Trekker's Training results can also influence saved records.
UIText.Guide_10_3.1.cn: 对角色的培养结果，仍然可以影响已保存的纪录。

UIText.Guide_11_1.1.en: You've got enough supplies. Time to explore more areas!
UIText.Guide_11_1.1.cn: 物资准备充分，是时候拓展一下探索范围了。

UIText.Guide_11_2.1.cn: 一起尝试探索另一座星塔吧。

UIText.Guide_11_3.1.en: Monoliths of various Elements are scattered across the wilds, each featuring diverse enemy distributions and environments.
UIText.Guide_11_3.1.cn: 荒野中散布着许多不同元素种类的星塔，敌人分布与环境都各不相同。

UIText.Guide_12_1.1.en: Please note: Higher-difficulty Monoliths require a higher Authorization Level to challenge.
UIText.Guide_12_1.1.cn: 请注意：更高难度的星塔，需要更高的权限等级才可挑战

UIText.Guide_12_2.1.en: When challenging Monoliths of different Elements, note their recommended lineup Element.
UIText.Guide_12_2.1.cn: 在挑战不同属性的星塔时，要留意其推荐配队属性

UIText.Guide_12_3.1.en: The Monolith we'll be tackling this time is [Dust and Flames]. It's time to adjust our strategy!
UIText.Guide_12_3.1.cn: 这次要挑战的星塔是“烈焰与尘埃”，得调整一下策略了！

UIText.Guide_12_4.1.en: Trekkers attuned to Ventus or Aqua will have the upper hand in this Monolith. Switch the main Trekker!
UIText.Guide_12_4.1.cn: 擅长风和水属性的旅人，能够在这座星塔获得优势，更换一下主控旅人吧！

UIText.Guide_12_5.1.en: Select [Auto-deploy] for a quick change of your lineup based on the recommended Element and your Trekkers' levels.
UIText.Guide_12_5.1.cn: 点击“自动编队”，可快速根据推荐属性和当前养成进度，调整配队方案

UIText.Guide_12_6.1.en: This Monolith is much more difficult. You must choose your Discs wisely.
UIText.Guide_12_6.1.cn: 这次的星塔难度提升了不少，得谨慎考虑秘纹的选择了。

UIText.Guide_13_1.1.en:
Your Authorization Level has increased.
Go to [Missions] for more details.
UIText.Guide_13_1.1.cn:
您的权限等级又有新进展了。
请打开“任务”了解详情

UIText.Guide_14_1.1.en:
The Daily Affairs page refreshes daily targets.
Try to complete them all to earn more Activity Points.
UIText.Guide_14_1.1.cn:
“今日事务”页签每天都会刷新目标列表。
设法完成这些日常任务，可积攒活跃点数。

UIText.Guide_14_2.1.en: Reach Activity Points goals to claim rewards.
UIText.Guide_14_2.1.cn: 达成点数目标即可领取奖励。

UIText.Guide_15_1.1.en: A new challenge is available. Select [Bounty Trial].
UIText.Guide_15_1.1.cn: 有新的挑战可以进行了，点按“悬赏行动”

UIText.Guide_15_2.1.en: Spend Vigor in [Tier-up Trials] to acquire Tier-up Materials.
UIText.Guide_15_2.1.cn: 消耗干劲，进行“晋升试炼”获取升阶素材

UIText.Guide_16_1.1.en: Defeat bosses to receive Tier-up Materials of various kinds.
UIText.Guide_16_1.1.cn: 讨伐各种强敌头目，即可获得各类升阶素材。

UIText.Guide_16_3.1.en: Complete all challenges when clearing the level to unlock the Express Battle feature and collect materials more efficiently.
UIText.Guide_16_3.1.cn: 通关时若能完成全部挑战，即可解锁“快速战斗”功能，高效获取素材。

UIText.Guide_17_1.1.en: Boss, the time has come. Opening the path to the [Menace Arena].
UIText.Guide_17_1.1.cn: 魔王大人，时机已至，现为您开启通向“心危擂台”的门扉。

UIText.Guide_18_1.1.en:
Welcome, Boss. This is the Menace Arena.
Your Trekkers can get trained like never before here...
UIText.Guide_18_1.1.cn:
欢迎，魔王大人，此处就是心危擂台。
您的麾下，在此可以获得前所未有的锻炼机会……

UIText.Guide_18_2.1.en: Only true champions can survive this never-ending arena challenge... Be careful as you move higher.
UIText.Guide_18_2.1.cn: 只有真正的强者，才能在这场无尽的擂台挑战中，存活下来……请小心谨慎地，向上进发吧。

UIText.Guide_19_1.1.en: Boss, New Bounty Trial are now available!
UIText.Guide_19_1.1.cn: 魔王，又有新的悬赏试炼可以进行了！

UIText.Guide_19_2.1.en: The Skill Trials grant materials used to enhance Trekker skills, also consuming Vigor.
UIText.Guide_19_2.1.cn: “技巧试炼”可以获得增强旅人技能的素材，同样需要消耗干劲。

UIText.Guide_19_4.1.en: Complete Skill Trials to collect Game Cartridges that can boost Trekker skills!
UIText.Guide_19_4.1.cn: 完成技巧试炼，就可以收集可以增强旅人技能的“游戏卡带”！

UIText.Guide_201_1.1.en:
Besides Core Potentials, you can also acquire Common Potentials of different quality during the Ascension.
These Potentials can enhance or provide certain extra skill effects, or boost stats or other features. Potentials can be leveled up multiple times.
UIText.Guide_201_1.1.cn:
除了核心潜能外，星塔探索中还会获取其他不同品阶的普通潜能。
这些潜能可以增强或追加特定的技能效果，或产生数值或其他机制的加成。潜能本身还可多次升级。

UIText.Guide_202_1.1.en:
During the Ascension, you will get Core Potentials first.
Different combinations of Core Potentials correspond to various skill changes and combat builds.
UIText.Guide_202_1.1.cn:
星塔探索中，首先会获取核心潜能。
核心潜能的组合，对应着多种技能变化与战斗流派。

UIText.Guide_20_1.1.en: You can choose from Skill Trials of different difficulty levels. Higher-difficulty Skill Trials require a higher Authorization Level to unlock.
UIText.Guide_20_1.1.cn: 技巧试炼有多个难度选择，高难度的试炼需要更高的权限等级才可解锁。

UIText.Guide_20_2.1.en: Acquire different kinds of Game Cartridges from the trials to level up your Trekkers' skills.
UIText.Guide_20_2.1.cn: 试炼中获取的不同种类的“游戏卡带”，可用于提升旅人的能力等级

UIText.Guide_20_3.1.en: Complete all challenges to unlock the [Express Battle] feature and collect Game Cartridges faster!
UIText.Guide_20_3.1.cn: 完成所有挑战条目，即可开启“快速战斗”功能，迅速收集“游戏卡带”了！

UIText.Guide_21_1.1.en: Themes of the Discs can bring Trekkers good luck and blessings. They are important during your Monolith exploration.
UIText.Guide_21_1.1.cn: “秘纹”的旋律，能为旅人带来好运和祝福，是探索星塔时的重要助力。

UIText.Guide_21_3.1.en: Equip any Disc that you have now and embark on your adventure!
UIText.Guide_21_3.1.cn: 先装配好手头现有的秘纹，然后就立刻出发吧！

UIText.Guide_229_1.1.en: You can collect Musical Notes in the Monolith, each note type granting different bonus effects that are stronger the more you collect.
UIText.Guide_229_1.1.cn: 在星塔内可以收集“音符”，每种音符都有各自不同的加成效果，随收集数量提升

UIText.Guide_229_2.1.en: Collect the required number of a certain type of Musical Notes to activate the Harmony Skill of your squad's current Disc.
UIText.Guide_229_2.1.cn: 收集足够数量的特定种类音符，即可激活当前队伍配置中秘纹的“协奏技能”

UIText.Guide_22_1.1.en:
Until now, Trekkers still have a lot to learn about Monoliths.
This Research Plan will help us find out more about it.
UIText.Guide_22_1.1.cn:
至今为止，旅人对星塔的了解还远远不足。
这份研究计划，可以帮助我们更了解它的情况

UIText.Guide_22_2.1.en: Complete Research Plans to receive materials that help reveal how the Monolith works.
UIText.Guide_22_2.1.cn: 完成研究计划，可以获得星塔机制的解密素材

UIText.Guide_22_3.1.en: Some Research Plans have already been completed. Claim these rewards first.
UIText.Guide_22_3.1.cn: 有些研究计划已经完成了，先领取这些奖励吧

UIText.Guide_22_4.1.en: Select here to go to Monolith Research.
UIText.Guide_22_4.1.cn: 点按这里前往星塔研究

UIText.Guide_22_5.1.en:
During Monolith Research, there are many Nodes to be resolved.
Once you resolve them, you will be able to change how the Monolith works. That will be very helpful for future explorations!
UIText.Guide_22_5.1.cn:
星塔研究的过程中有许多节点尚待解密，
解开这些节点，就可以让星塔的机制发生变化，这对未来的探索大有助力！

UIText.Guide_22_6.1.en: Select here to use all your collected materials to resolve the Node.
UIText.Guide_22_6.1.cn: 点按这里，可以一键消耗已有的素材，解开节点

UIText.Guide_22_8.1.en:
After certain Nodes are resolved, the research will progress, and more research targets will be unlocked.
Just explore Monoliths as much as possible and try to complete all the Research Plans.
UIText.Guide_22_8.1.cn:
解开特定的节点后，计划就会往下推进，同时，也会解锁更多的研究目标待完成。
总之，积极探索星塔，慢慢完成研究计划吧

UIText.Guide_232_1.1.en: Discs with Harmony Skill activated can grant more bonuses to the squad.
UIText.Guide_232_1.1.cn: 激活协奏技能的秘纹可以为队伍带来更多的加成效果

UIText.Guide_23_1.1.en: Short on supplies? Sometimes you can synthesize what you need—let's go over how it works.
UIText.Guide_23_1.1.cn: 手头缺乏的物资，有时可以通过合成来获得，是时候介绍一下了。

UIText.Guide_23_3.1.en: Select the required recipe to craft the item.
UIText.Guide_23_3.1.cn: 选择当前所需的合成配方进行物品合成。

UIText.Guide_23_4.1.en: Select here to view the target item's details.
UIText.Guide_23_4.1.cn: 点击这里，就可以查看合成目标物品的详情。

UIText.Guide_23_5.1.en: Select here to see the material details. Give it a try!
UIText.Guide_23_5.1.cn: 点击这里，可查看合成材料详情，立刻动手试试吧！

UIText.Guide_24_1.1.en: It's time to introduce you to the Trekker Commission. I'll guide you through it!
UIText.Guide_24_1.1.cn: 是时候介绍“旅人委托派单系统”了，我来协助您了解！

UIText.Guide_24_2.1.en: Send Trekkers out on commissions to earn rewards!
UIText.Guide_24_2.1.cn: 派遣旅人完成委托，就可获得奖励！

UIText.Guide_24_3.1.en: Different commissions have different squad requirements—make sure you meet them before you set off!
UIText.Guide_24_3.1.cn: 不同的委托任务会有不同的成员要求，要注意满足条件才能出发喔

UIText.Guide_24_4.1.en: Let's dispatch your first commission now!

UIText.Guide_24_5.1.en: Confirm the duration, and the commission will begin!
UIText.Guide_24_5.1.cn: 确认时长后，委托就顺利开始啦！

UIText.Guide_25_1.1.en: Discs boost your entire squad during Monolith explorations. Leveling them up further improves these buffs.
UIText.Guide_25_1.1.cn: 秘纹可以为探索星塔的整个队伍带来加成。提升秘纹等级可以进一步提高加成。

UIText.Guide_25_2.1.en: When the Disc is equipped in the main slot, the Melody Skill will be activated.
UIText.Guide_25_2.1.cn: 秘纹被置于主位时，可激活主旋律技能。

UIText.Guide_25_3.1.en:
The Harmony Skill, on the other hand, requires a certain type and amount of Musical Notes to activate.
Musical Notes can be collected during Monolith exploration.
UIText.Guide_25_3.1.cn:
协奏技能则需要搜集特定种类和数量的“音符”才能激活。
音符可在探索星塔过程中搜集。

UIText.Guide_26_1.1.en:
Boss, you have made progress in your Power.
Open [Missions] for more details.
UIText.Guide_26_1.1.cn:
魔王，您的权能又有进展了。
请打开“王权”查看详情。

UIText.Guide_27_1.1.en: You've just obtained some more powerful Discs. Go ahead and equip one.
UIText.Guide_27_1.1.cn: 刚才获得了一些更强力的秘纹，这次就带上它吧。

UIText.Guide_27_2.1.en: Select here to confirm the Disc's effect.
UIText.Guide_27_2.1.cn: 点按这里即可确认秘纹的具体效果。

UIText.Guide_28_1.1.en: Discs equipped in support slots also offer bonus effects, but their Disc Skills will remain inactive.
UIText.Guide_28_1.1.cn: 装配于辅位的秘纹同样提供加成，但是秘纹技能不会生效。

UIText.Guide_28_2.1.en: Support Discs grant extra Musical Notes right at the start of an exploration. They can improve the efficiency of the build when properly paired.
UIText.Guide_28_2.1.cn: 置于辅位秘纹可在探索之初就获得额外的音符，合理搭配即可提升构筑效率。

UIText.Guide_28_3.1.en:
Besides, you can gradually unlock more support Disc slots through [Monolith Research]!
All set? Time to move out!
UIText.Guide_28_3.1.cn:
另外，辅位秘纹的可配置数量可以通过“星塔研究”逐步解锁！
准备就绪，我们出发吧！

UIText.Guide_29_1.1.en: These are the Musical Notes in the Monolith. Each type of Musical Note offers a different bonus effect, which can be improved when you collect more of them.
UIText.Guide_29_1.1.cn: 这是星塔里的“音符”。每种音符都具备不同的加成效果，重复获得会进一步提升效果。

UIText.Guide_29_2.1.en: Select here to check your current Musical Note collection.
UIText.Guide_29_2.1.cn: 点击这里可以确认当前获得音符的状况。

UIText.Guide_2_1.1.en: Before you set off, how about recruiting a Trekker to join your adventure? Having some trusty company along would be great.
UIText.Guide_2_1.1.cn:
出发之前，顺路捎上能一起爬塔的旅人吧？
要是能有更多可靠的同伴就再好不过了。

UIText.Guide_2_2.1.en: You can perform [Recruit x10] up to 20 times on the Beginner Limited Banner and save 5 results. Pick any saved result to begin your journey.
UIText.Guide_2_2.1.cn: 新手招募可最多进行20次并保存其中5次招募结果。您可选择任意一个保存结果开始旅程。

UIText.Guide_2_3.1.en: You can recruit now or after completing all the tutorials.
UIText.Guide_2_3.1.cn: 您可以于此时完成招募，也可在完成全部新手教程后再行招募。

UIText.Guide_301_1.1.en:
Welcome to Fatebound Stellar Deck!
Start by picking your preferred Fatebound Stellar Card!
UIText.Guide_301_1.1.cn:
欢迎来到命运星牌局！
开始对局时，就先选择一张喜欢的星命牌吧！

UIText.Guide_301_2.1.en: As the game progresses, you may collect more Fatebound Stellar Card types.
UIText.Guide_301_2.1.cn: 随着牌局进行，将有可能收集到更多种类的星命牌。

UIText.Guide_301_3.1.en: Tap here to start the game!
UIText.Guide_301_3.1.cn: 点按这里正式开始对局！

UIText.Guide_302_1.1.en:
Time to reveal your fate!
Flip the Elemental Cards to unveil your answer—
UIText.Guide_302_1.1.cn:
揭示命运的时刻到来了。
翻开元素牌揭晓您的答案——

UIText.Guide_302_2.1.en:
Nice pull! The divination went well. These Fate Coins are yours now!
Specific Elemental Card combos, boosted by your Fatebound Stellar Card bonus, will earn you even more Fate Coins.
UIText.Guide_302_2.1.cn:
占卜的结果不错喔，这些命运币是属于您的馈赠！
达成特定的元素牌型，并结合星命牌的加成，可使您获得更多命运币。

UIText.Guide_303_1.1.en: This shows your current Fate Coins.
UIText.Guide_303_1.1.cn: 此处显示的您当前持有的命运币。

UIText.Guide_303_2.1.en: Your goal is simple: collect as many Fate Coins as you can before your turns run out to clear the stage.
UIText.Guide_303_2.1.cn: 您的目标就是在回合耗尽前，收集到尽可能多的命运币，达成通关目标。

UIText.Guide_303_3.1.en:
Sometimes, spending a few Fate Coins to unlock buffs will give you the edge you need.
Let's see what you've got, Boss.
UIText.Guide_303_3.1.cn:
有时，消耗一些命运币解锁各类增益效果能够带来更大优势。
期待您的表现喔，魔王大人~

UIText.Guide_32_1.1.en: Here are all the Musical Notes collected during this Ascension.
UIText.Guide_32_1.1.cn: 这是本次探索中已获得的所有音符。

UIText.Guide_32_2.1.en: Each Harmony Skill requires a specific set of Musical Notes to activate.
UIText.Guide_32_2.1.cn: 每一种协奏技能需要特定的音符组合才能激活。

UIText.Guide_32_3.1.en:
You need to re-collect Musical Notes in each Ascension.
Musical Notes and Harmony Skills are inseparable components for setting new Records.
UIText.Guide_32_3.1.cn:
每次探索都要重新搜集音符，
音符和协奏技能是“纪录”的重要组成部分。

UIText.Guide_32_4.1.en: Collect as many powerful Musical Note combination as you can during your Ascension.
UIText.Guide_32_4.1.cn: 尽可能在探索过程中收集强力的音符组合吧。

UIText.Guide_3_1.1.en: You haven't finished your recruitments in the Beginner Limited Banner. After completing the tutorials, you can return and recruit more. Continue your journey now and recruit later?
UIText.Guide_3_1.1.cn:
新手招募尚未完成，
您可在新手教程完成后继续招募。
是否先搁置招募，继续旅途？

UIText.Guide_3_2.1.en: Time to set out. Select Go</color>!
UIText.Guide_3_2.1.cn: 是时候启程了，点击出发</color>！

UIText.Guide_401_1.1.en: In this stage, you need to select your chess pieces to deploy.
UIText.Guide_401_1.1.cn: 本关需要您自行选择出战的游棋。

UIText.Guide_401_2.1.en: Tap here to select your lineup.
UIText.Guide_401_2.1.cn: 点按此处进行阵容挑选

UIText.Guide_401_3.1.en: Tap to select the chess pieces you wish to deploy in this stage.
UIText.Guide_401_3.1.cn: 点按选择想要在本关出阵的游棋

UIText.Guide_401_4.1.en: Note: The stage will only start when all empty slots are filled.
UIText.Guide_401_4.1.cn: 注意，仅当全部空置栏位都完成选择后才可开始关卡

UIText.Guide_41_1.1.en: Select [Trekker] to view Trekker details and level them up.
UIText.Guide_41_1.1.cn: 点按“旅人”，可查看旅人详情并进行养成。

UIText.Guide_42_1.1.en: Select [Story] to continue with the main story.
UIText.Guide_42_1.1.cn: 点按“故事”按钮，即可继续进行主线故事。

UIText.Guide_42_2.1.en:
Select [Main Story] to continue your adventure.
Or, you can go on with your Monolith exploration or challenges of other modes.
UIText.Guide_42_2.1.cn:
点按主线剧情，继续您的冒险旅途。
或者，您也可以继续探索星塔及其他模式的挑战。

UIText.Guide_43_1.1.en: You can use [Heartlink] to message Trekkers you've befriended. This is the key feature of a cellphone.
UIText.Guide_43_1.1.cn: “心链”可以和结识的旅人发送信息，是手机最重要的功能。

UIText.Guide_43_2.1.en: Select the portrait to view messages from Trekkers.
UIText.Guide_43_2.1.cn: 点按头像，就可以查看旅人给您发送的信息了。

UIText.Guide_43_3.1.en: Switch to [Invite] to select Trekkers you've befriended and invite them to join your journey. Note that you can only invite Trekkers with the required Affinity Level.
UIText.Guide_43_3.1.cn: 切换到“邀约”，可以选择结识的旅人邀请一起结伴出行，要注意，只有默契等级达标的旅人才可以邀约。

UIText.Guide_43_4.1.en: Select [Mail] to send a gift, increasing the Affinity of the chosen Trekker.
UIText.Guide_43_4.1.cn: 点按“邮寄”，可以立刻送出礼物，提升特定旅人的默契。

UIText.Guide_44_1.1.en:
As a newcomer, joining more events will help you improve faster.
Select [Events] to check what's going on.
UIText.Guide_44_1.1.cn:
初来乍到，积极参加活动跟上节奏吧。
点按“活动”，看看当前有什么举办中的活动。

UIText.Guide_45_1.1.en: When a Trekker reaches a certain level, you need to increase their rank to further their development.
UIText.Guide_45_1.1.cn: 旅人达到特定等级后，需要“升阶”才能继续养成

UIText.Guide_45_2.1.en: Tiering up the Trekkers will also improve their base stats and the level cap of their skills.
UIText.Guide_45_2.1.cn: 升阶也会提升旅人基础属性，并提升技能的等级上限

UIText.Guide_45_3.1.en: Materials required for tiering up a Trekker need to be obtained through [Tier-up Trial] of a certain kind.
UIText.Guide_45_3.1.cn: 旅人升阶需要的材料，需通过特定种类的“晋升试炼”获取

UIText.Guide_45_4.1.en: Try to use the materials you obtained to tier up.
UIText.Guide_45_4.1.cn: 尝试使用获得的素材进行“升阶”吧

UIText.Guide_46_1.1.en: This Trekker's Level Cap has been increased to Level 20.
UIText.Guide_46_1.1.cn: 旅人的等级上限，现已提高至20级

UIText.Guide_46_3.1.en: Upon reaching Tier 3, Trekkers can unlock their Awakened Appearance.
UIText.Guide_46_3.1.cn: 进阶至3阶时，还可解锁旅人的“觉醒形象”

UIText.Guide_47_1.1.en: Finally ... the key to the stairs to the stars has been cracked. You can now use the Monolith Stairs Pass to complete the Ascension in no time.
UIText.Guide_47_1.1.cn: 终于……星梯的密码被破解了，现在可以使用“星梯搭乘票”来快速地完成星塔探索了

UIText.Guide_47_3.1.en: Select a Monolith of any Element.
UIText.Guide_47_3.1.cn: 选择任意一种属性的星塔

UIText.Guide_48_1.1.en: You can see how many Monolith Stairs Passes you own here.
UIText.Guide_48_1.1.cn: 这里显示了当前拥有的“星梯搭乘票”的数量

UIText.Guide_48_2.1.en: You must clear one Monolith of the corresponding difficulty before using the Monolith Stairs Pass!
UIText.Guide_48_2.1.cn: 使用“星塔速通”前，先得通关一次对应难度的星塔才行！

UIText.Guide_48_3.1.en: With the Monolith Stairs Pass, you can breeze through Monoliths to get the best Records.
UIText.Guide_48_3.1.cn: 有了“星梯搭乘票”，就可以快速通关星塔，获得最优质的“纪录”了

UIText.Guide_49_1.1.en:
Each Trekker has different combat styles and a unique set of abilities.
When fighting as the main Trekker, a Trekker can activate Auto Attacks.
UIText.Guide_49_1.1.cn:
每位旅人都有各自不同的战斗方式与一组能力。
作为主控角色出场时，可发动“普通攻击”

UIText.Guide_49_2.1.en: Also, when fighting as the main Trekker, a Trekker can activate their Main Skill.
UIText.Guide_49_2.1.cn: 作为主控角色出场时，还可发动“主控技能”

UIText.Guide_49_3.1.en: And when fighting as a support Trekker, a Trekker can activate their Support Skill.
UIText.Guide_49_3.1.cn: 而作为援护角色时，则可发动“援护技能”

UIText.Guide_49_4.1.en: Whether the main Trekker or a support Trekker, a Trekker can activate their Ultimate. Casting the Ultimate consumes Energy, which slowly recovers during the battle.
UIText.Guide_49_4.1.cn: 无论作为主控还是援护出场，都可以发动“绝招”，绝招的发动需要消耗能量，能量会在战斗过程中缓慢恢复

UIText.Guide_49_5.1.en: Targeted enhancement of Trekker abilities can actively improve your battle performance and influence even previous records.
UIText.Guide_49_5.1.cn: 针对性地强化旅人能力，可有效提升战斗效果，并且对原有的纪录也可起效

UIText.Guide_49_6.1.en: Upgrading Trekker skills costs Skill Cartridges of a certain kind, which can be obtained through Skill Trials.
UIText.Guide_49_6.1.cn: 升级能力需要消耗特定种类的技能卡带，可通过“技巧试炼”关卡获取

UIText.Guide_4_10.1.en: Noya and I will be responsible for Support</color> and provide combat assistance to the Main</color> during the exploration.
UIText.Guide_4_10.1.cn: 我和尘沙，会担任援护</color>，在探索中提供战斗支援，辅助主控</color>。

UIText.Guide_4_12.1.en: After getting the squad ready, we can get your Discs in order!
UIText.Guide_4_12.1.cn: 小队成员安排妥当之后，进行“秘纹”的准备！

UIText.Guide_4_13.1.en: Besides building a line-up on your own, you can also select [Auto-deploy], and the system will select suitable Trekkers for the current Monolith for you.
UIText.Guide_4_13.1.cn: 除了手动配置外，也可以点按“自动编队”，自动选取适合攻略此星塔的旅人组合。

UIText.Guide_4_2.1.en: The New Star Guild is still just getting started. Let's try exploring Misstep On One</color> first.
UIText.Guide_4_2.1.cn: “空白旅团”现在还是初出茅庐。先试着探索原初的迷途</color>吧。

UIText.Guide_4_4.1.en:
Before you start exploring, assign your squad members! 
Select and open the Squad</color> interface.
UIText.Guide_4_4.1.cn:
开始探索前，得先安排好小队成员！
点击打开编队</color>面板。

UIText.Guide_4_5.1.en: Select a Trekker's portrait to add them to your squad.
UIText.Guide_4_5.1.cn: 点击头像就可以选择对应旅人加入编队。

UIText.Guide_4_6.1.en: Amber</color> is the most agile of the Trekkers. Let's select her and place her in the squad.
UIText.Guide_4_6.1.cn: 琥珀</color>是我们几个里行动最灵敏的，先选择她编入小队。

UIText.Guide_4_7.1.en: The first Trekker to be placed in the squad will take the role of the Main</color>, and lead the squad as the squad leader.
UIText.Guide_4_7.1.cn: 首个加入小队的旅人会担任主控</color>，带领大家行动。

UIText.Guide_4_8.1.en: Then, add me, Iris,</color> to the squad.
UIText.Guide_4_8.1.cn: 然后把我，鸢尾</color>也加入小队。

UIText.Guide_4_9.1.en: Finally, add Noya</color> to the squad as well. A squad requires 3 Trekkers</color> to be able to start the exploration.
UIText.Guide_4_9.1.cn: 最后再把尘沙</color>也加入小队。小队必须要配置齐三位角色</color>才能开始探索。

UIText.Guide_50_1.1.en: Trekkers can activate Contribution Emblems to get Combat Power bonuses.
UIText.Guide_50_1.1.cn: 旅人可以点亮贡献纹章，获得战力加成

UIText.Guide_50_2.1.en: Complete Emblem Trials of corresponding factions to obtain Faction Coins, and use them to activate Contribution Emblems.
UIText.Guide_50_2.1.cn: 完成对应势力的纹章试炼，即可获得对应的势力代币，用以点亮贡献纹章

UIText.Guide_50_3.1.en: Spend coins to light up this Emblem.
UIText.Guide_50_3.1.cn: 消耗代币，点亮这个纹章吧

UIText.Guide_50_4.1.en: Here you can see the stat boosts you received by activating this Element. Each activation may yield different results.
UIText.Guide_50_4.1.cn: 此处显示了本次点亮纹章所获取的属性加成结果，每次点亮纹章，都可能结果不同。

UIText.Guide_50_5.1.en: You can equip this Emblem once it's activated. If you're not satisfied with the outcome, use the Emblem Polisher to try activate it again.
UIText.Guide_50_5.1.cn:
点亮完毕后，即可装配此纹章。
之后如果对结果不满意，还可消耗“纹章抛光剂”，重新点亮纹章。

UIText.Guide_51_1.1.en: Affinity Level with the current Trekker is displayed here.
UIText.Guide_51_1.1.cn: 此处显示了当前旅人的默契等级

UIText.Guide_51_2.1.en: You can increase a Trekker's Affinity through completing Companion Targets, gift-giving, or sending invitations.
UIText.Guide_51_2.1.cn: 通过完成伙伴目标，或是进行送礼和邀约等行动，均可提升与旅人的默契值

UIText.Guide_51_3.1.en: With increased Affinity, the Trekker's combat power will increase slightly, and more archive entries and voiceovers will be unlocked.
UIText.Guide_51_3.1.cn: 默契度提升后，旅人的战斗力也会获得些许增强，并解锁更多档案内容和语音

UIText.Guide_51_4.1.en:
Increased Affinity level will also unlock the Trekker's personal stories.
Finishing the key stories unlocks Memory Snapshots, which can be set as your main screen.
UIText.Guide_51_4.1.cn:
默契度等级提升后，还会解锁旅人的个人剧情。
阅读关键剧情后，即可解锁旅人的“回忆特写”，并设置为主页画面

UIText.Guide_52_1.1.en:
A properly assembled Trekker squad will make your Monolith exploration so much easier.
Tap Tutorial to learn more.
UIText.Guide_52_1.1.cn:
妥善的旅人队伍配置，助力您更顺利地探索星塔。
点按“教学”即可了解。

UIText.Guide_52_2.1.en: Let's begin with a Ventus squad and start the lineup tutorial mission.
UIText.Guide_52_2.1.cn: 先以风系队伍为例，开启对应的配队教学任务吧。

UIText.Guide_52_3.1.en: This section explains the different roles each Trekker plays in a Ventus squad.
UIText.Guide_52_3.1.cn: 此处讲解了风系配队中，各旅人承担的不同职能。

UIText.Guide_52_4.1.en: Follow the instructions to complete the lineup mission goals.
UIText.Guide_52_4.1.cn: 根据提示，设法完成此处的各项配队任务目标吧。

UIText.Guide_52_5.1.en: Complete the lineup tutorial and you can claim tons of resources.
UIText.Guide_52_5.1.cn: 完成配队教学系列任务，即可领取丰富的资源奖励。

UIText.Guide_5_1.1.en: The Potentials</color> and Disc Skills</color> activated during this exploration will be saved and generated into a Record</color> that can be used for other battles.
UIText.Guide_5_1.1.cn: 本次探索中激活的潜能</color>与秘纹技能</color>会被保存下来，生成纪录</color>，可用于其他战斗。

UIText.Guide_5_2.1.en: The activated Potentials</color> and Disc Skills</color> will affect the Record Rating</color>. The higher the Rating, the stronger the Record.
UIText.Guide_5_2.1.cn: 激活的潜能</color>与秘纹技能</color>会影响纪录评分</color>，评分越高的纪录也越强。

UIText.Guide_5_3.1.en: Records</color> are bound</color> to the Trekkers in this exploration. The Record cannot be changed when using it for other battles.
UIText.Guide_5_3.1.cn: 纪录</color>与本次探索的旅人绑定</color>，后续使用该纪录进行其他战斗时，无法更换。

UIText.Guide_5_4.1.en:
Select Save Record</color>.
