UIText.Login_Age_Tip_Content.1.en:
Stella Sora Suitable Age Notice
1. This game is a simple Trekker roleplay game suitable for users of 18 years old or above.
2. The background story and world of the game is based on fiction and fantasy. The plot is simple and positive, and is not based on history or true events. The game interacts through physical inputs and encourages players to achieve their goals through training and practice. There is a limited amount of customizable text-based systems. The social system abides by and is managed according to related and applicable laws and regulations.
3. A real-name verification system is included in this game. The game will be available to users of 18 years or older. Users who verify with identification information of below 18 years old will be unable to enter the game.
UIText.Login_Age_Tip_Content.1.cn:
《星塔旅人》游戏适龄提示
1、本游戏是一款玩法简单的旅人扮演游戏，适用于年满18周岁及以上的用户。
2、本游戏基于架空的故事背景和幻想世界观，剧情简单且积极向上，没有基于真实历史和现实事件的改编内容。游戏玩法基于肢体操作，鼓励玩家通过训练达成目标。游戏中有少量自定义文字系统，该社交系统遵循相关法律法规进行管理。
3、本游戏中有用户实名认证系统，对年满18周岁及以上的用户开放，使用18周岁以下的身份信息认证账号将无法进入游戏。

WeekBossAffix.620111.2.en: The Garden of Parasite lashes out at enemies with its vines.
WeekBossAffix.620111.2.cn: 寄生之庭甩动藤蔓攻击敌人

WeekBossAffix.620112.2.en: The roots of the Garden of Parasite grow into sharp spikes, dividing the battlefield.
WeekBossAffix.620112.2.cn: 寄生之庭的根部生长出尖刺分割战场

WeekBossAffix.620113.2.en: The Garden of Parasite continuously spreads spores that grow into patches of toxic grass upon landing, periodically releasing clouds of miasma.
WeekBossAffix.620113.2.cn: 寄生之庭持续散播孢子，孢子落地后长出成片毒草，并周期性喷涌出瘴气

WeekBossAffix.620114.2.en: The Garden of Parasite produces mimic seeds. Upon maturing and wilting, they spawn a swarm of groundhogs that relentlessly attack their enemies.
WeekBossAffix.620114.2.cn: 寄生之庭结出拟态种子，种子成熟凋零后生出土拨鼠群，持续对敌人发起攻击

WeekBossAffix.620115.2.en: Summons two flower buds that periodically release spreading attacks around it.
WeekBossAffix.620115.2.cn: 召唤2颗花苞，花苞会周期性生成扩散环攻击

WeekBossAffix.620211.2.en: The Spirit of Brutality locks onto its target and launches a mid-to-long-range charge.
WeekBossAffix.620211.2.cn: 猛进之灵瞄准敌人，发起中远距离的冲锋

WeekBossAffix.620212.2.en: The Spirit of Brutality swings its tusks, knocking enemies into the air.
WeekBossAffix.620212.2.cn: 猛进之灵甩动獠牙，击飞敌人

WeekBossAffix.620213.2.en: The Spirit of Brutality quickly crashes into the enemy's side.
WeekBossAffix.620213.2.cn: 猛进之灵对敌人身侧发起快速冲撞

WeekBossAffix.620214.2.en: The Spirit of Brutality dashes to the enemy's side and strikes, repeated three times in a row.
WeekBossAffix.620214.2.cn: 猛进之灵冲锋至敌人身侧并发起快速冲撞，以此种方式连续攻击三次

WeekBossAffix.620215.2.en: The Spirit of Brutality summons a horde of followers to launch a straight-line charge at the enemy.
WeekBossAffix.620215.2.cn: 猛进之灵召唤大量追随者，对敌人发起直线冲锋

WeekBossAffix.620311.2.en: Spellbound Golem moves its hands to either side of the upper battlefield, releasing a laser beam connecting its palms and slowly sweeping it downward across the battlefield.
WeekBossAffix.620311.2.cn: 魔侍巨像的双手移至场地上方两侧，施放连接掌心的激光，并缓慢向场地下方平移

WeekBossAffix.620312.2.en: Spellbound Golem locks onto its enemy with both fists. Once locked on, it delivers rapid consecutive charges toward the enemy's position.
WeekBossAffix.620312.2.cn: 魔侍巨像操纵双拳瞄准敌人，完成瞄准后，双拳先后向敌人所在的方向发起快速冲锋

WeekBossAffix.620313.2.en: Spellbound Golem continuously fires laser beams that track its enemies.
WeekBossAffix.620313.2.cn: 魔侍巨像持续发射能够追踪敌人的激光

WeekBossAffix.620314.2.en: Spellbound Golem unleashes a wide-range machine gun barrage across the battlefield.
WeekBossAffix.620314.2.cn: 魔侍巨像对场地进行大范围机枪扫射

WeekBossAffix.620315.2.en: Spellbound Golem unleashes Declaration of Destruction, building up energy for an extended period of time before firing a massive, wide-range laser beam. During the buildup, it disrupts enemies with punches or supplementary laser beams.
WeekBossAffix.620315.2.cn: 魔侍巨像施放毁灭宣告，经过长时间蓄力后，发射攻击范围巨大的激光。期间会同时利用双拳或激光进行干扰

WeekBossAffix.620411.2.en: Lithe Beauty swings the branches on both sides forward in an attack, then pauses briefly before sweeping them to each side.
WeekBossAffix.620411.2.cn: 流风美人同时甩动左右两侧枝条朝前方进行攻击，略作停顿后，分别向两侧横扫

WeekBossAffix.620412.2.en: Lithe Beauty spits flower orbs into the air, which split into multiple fragments and explode upon landing, dealing AoE DMG.
WeekBossAffix.620412.2.cn: 流风美人朝空中喷吐花球，花球分裂多个落地爆炸造成范围伤害

WeekBossAffix.620413.2.en: Lithe Beauty unleashes a dangerous pollen ring that expands and contracts. If the ring touches the flowers at the edge of the battlefield, they will become activated.
WeekBossAffix.620413.2.cn: 流风美人施放带有伤害的扩散回缩花粉圈，且花粉圈触碰到场地边缘的花朵会使其激活并施放技能

WeekBossAffix.620414.2.en: Lithe Beauty charges toward the target, releasing tornadoes to attack during the second strike.
WeekBossAffix.620414.2.cn: 流风美人朝目标发起冲锋，二阶段期间会有放出龙卷风攻击目标

WeekBossAffix.620415.2.en: Lithe Beauty charges, releasing an expanding pollen ring during the process. Once charged, it summons a large tornado that keeps following its target.
WeekBossAffix.620415.2.cn: 流风美人进入蓄力状态，在蓄力时会释放扩散花粉圈，蓄力成功后会召唤大型持续追踪龙卷风

WeekBossAffix.620511.2.en: The Blade of Jade quickly charges once.
WeekBossAffix.620511.2.cn: 翠煌之刃进行一次迅捷的冲锋

WeekBossAffix.620512.2.en: The Blade of Jade soars into the sky before delivering a devastating peck attack on the ground level.
WeekBossAffix.620512.2.cn: 翠煌之刃飞上天空，随后对地面进行毁灭性啄击

WeekBossAffix.620513.2.en: The Blade of Jade fires a narrow beam of light forward.
WeekBossAffix.620513.2.cn: 翠煌之刃向前发射细长的光束

WeekBossAffix.620514.2.en: The Blade of Jade drives its tail deep into the ground, releasing powerful electricity all around.
WeekBossAffix.620514.2.cn: 翠煌之刃将尾部深扎入地下，向周围放出强电

WeekBossAffix.620515.2.en: The Blade of Jade awakens all the flowers on the battlefield, unleashing a barrage of hummingbird bullets across the field.
WeekBossAffix.620515.2.cn: 翠煌之刃唤醒所有的花朵，向场内投射大量蜂鸟子弹

WeekBossAffix.620611.2.en: Gobble Hexhorn Whale spits water bubbles forward.
WeekBossAffix.620611.2.cn: 咕噜六角鲸向前喷吐水炮

WeekBossAffix.620612.2.en: Gobble Hexhorn Whale summons a bubble from above. The bubble will lock onto the enemy and fire medium to long range water bubbles.
WeekBossAffix.620612.2.cn: 咕噜六角鲸召唤从天而降的咕噜泡泡，咕噜泡泡会锁定敌人并发射中远距离的水炮

WeekBossAffix.620613.2.en: Gobble Hexhorn Whale charges across the battlefield, knocking the enemy back.
WeekBossAffix.620613.2.cn: 咕噜六角鲸对场地发起冲撞，击退敌人

WeekBossAffix.620614.2.en: Gobble Hexhorn Whale summons a huge water pillar bomb that triggers a water torrent to impact the battlefield and knock the enemy back.
WeekBossAffix.620614.2.cn: 咕噜六角鲸召唤巨大的水柱炸弹，引发洪流冲击场地，击退敌人

WeekBossAffix.620615.2.en: Gobble Hexhorn Whale dives underwater and launches a ferocious attack at the enemy's feet, destroying the field and knocking them back.
WeekBossAffix.620615.2.cn: 咕噜六角鲸潜入水中，瞄准敌人的脚下发起凶猛的攻击，毁坏场地并击退敌人

Word.1021.2.en: Light Orbs orbit the Trekker, dealing Lux DMG when colliding with a target. There can be a maximum of 3 Light Orbs at a time, lasts 3s
Word.1021.2.cn: 「光球」环绕角色旋转，碰撞目标时造成光系伤害；默认最多同时存在3个「光球」，持续3秒

Word.1022.2.en: Chains of Light will ricochet at a maximum of 2 times by default. Damage is reduced by 10% after each ricochet
Word.1022.2.cn: 「光之锁链」默认最多弹射2次，每次弹射后伤害降低10%

Word.1023.2.en: Light of Thunder deals are of effect Lux DMG to targets within the area with an increased base Crit Rate of 12%
Word.1023.2.cn: 「雷光」对落点范围内目标造成光系伤害，基础暴击率提升12%

Word.1024.2.en: Wind Shear will automatically track and ricochet between targets at a maximum of 3 times by default
Word.1024.2.cn: 「风切」自动追踪并在目标之间弹射，默认弹射次数为3次

Word.1025.2.en: Aqua Mark, reduce target Movement SPD by 5%, up to 10 stacks
Word.1025.2.cn: 水系印记，目标移动速度降低5%，最多叠加10次

Word.1026.2.en: Ventus Mark, reduce target ATK SPD by 20%
Word.1026.2.cn: 风系印记，目标攻击速度降低20%

Word.1027.2.en:
Reduces Movement SPD by 25% for &Param2&s, up to &Param3& stacks.
At &Param3& stacks, converts into Freeze for &Param4&s.
Word.1027.2.cn:
移动速度降低25%，持续&Param2&秒，可叠加&Param3&层。
累计至&Param3&层时，转化为「冻结」，持续&Param4&秒。

Word.1028.2.en: Burn deals 5% ATK + 20 as Ignis DMG to the target every second for 5s
Word.1028.2.cn: 「灼烧」每秒对目标造成5%攻击力+20火系伤害，持续5秒

Word.1029.2.en: Increase target DMG received by 40% for 5s
Word.1029.2.cn: 目标受到伤害提升40%，持续5秒

Word.1030.2.en: Each Electric Soul increases the Trekker's damage by 5%. When reaching 3 Electric Souls, Electric Soul will be activated and will automatically seek out enemies, dealing area of effect Lux DMG
Word.1030.2.cn: 每只「电魂」为角色附加5%伤害提升效果；累计3只时，「电魂」进入激活状态，自动索敌并造成范围光系伤害

Word.1031.2.en:
Determined after throwing Unstable Flowery Cloud:
Normal: Explode 1 time
Success: Explode 2 times
Great Success: Explode 3 times
Word.1031.2.cn:
投掷「不稳定的花云朵」后进行判定：
普通：爆炸1次
成功：爆炸2次
大成功：爆炸3次

Word.1032.2.en:
Summon Dew to accumulate Ring of Fog
For every 3 Dew summons, expand 1 stack of Ring of Fog, up to 3 stacks
Deal 30% ATK as Aqua DMG to targets within Ring of Fog every 2s
If less than 3 Dews are casted within 10s, remove 1 stack of Ring of Fog
Word.1032.2.cn:
召唤「露滴弹」可以蓄积「凝雾之环」
每累计召唤3个「露滴弹」，展开1层「凝雾之环」，最多展开3层
每2秒对「凝雾之环」内目标造成30%攻击的水系伤害
如果10秒内释放「露滴弹」不足3次，移除1层「凝雾之环」

Word.1033.2.en:
Firing Wind Shots can accumulate 15 Ventus Energy
Accumulate 60 Ventus Energy to expand 1 stack of Wind Zone, up to 3 stacks
Each stack of Wind Zone increases Ventus DMG received by the target by 5%
If less than 3 Wind Shots are fired within 10s, remove 1 stack of Wind Zone
Word.1033.2.cn:
发射「风弹」可以蓄积15点「风能」
累计积蓄60点「风能」，展开1层「风之领域」，最多展开3层
每层「风之领域」使目标受到风系伤害提升5%
如果10秒内发射「风弹」不足3次，移除1层「风之领域」

Word.1040.2.en: Light Orbs detonate and disappear, dealing single-target Lux DMG
Word.1040.2.cn: 「光球」爆炸消失，造成单体光系伤害

Word.1041.2.en: Increase Kamatachi damage to the marked target by for 5s, up to 10 stacks.
Word.1041.2.cn: 对目标附加受到「镰鼬」伤害提升的效果，持续5秒，最多叠加10次

Word.1042.2.en: Increase Kamatachi damage and Crit Rate to the marked target for 30s. Cannot stack with Mark of Kamaitachi
Word.1042.2.cn: 对目标附加受到「镰鼬」伤害及暴击率提升的效果，持续30秒，不可与「镰鼬标记」效果叠加

Word.1043.2.en: When receiving ranged damage, remove Protection of Ranged Evasion and Evade the damage
Word.1043.2.cn: 受到的远程伤害时，移除「避矢加护」并闪避此次伤害

Word.1044.2.en: Increase damage received from Electric Soul

Word.1045.2.en: Abnormal behavior that causes periodic convulsion
Word.1045.2.cn: 行为异常症状，表现为间歇性抽搐

Word.1046.2.en: Increase damage received from Dive Shark
